ni—/ dkar po dmar po ser po dang / /ljang gu dang ni mthing ga dang / /la la dkar ser dmar ser dang / /la la ser nag ljang nag dang / /mgo bo ser po mjug ma nag /smad dkar stod gnag khra bo'i ①gzugs/ /sna tshogs gzugs te phyed gzugs so/ /lag na rdo rje 'khor lo thogs/ /gtun shing dang ni rtse gsum mo/ /la la ral gri lag na thogs/ / gtor ma rwa ②dang mdung thung thogs/ /'phang mdung dang ni nar tsa dang / /la la dbyug pa thogs pa dang / /rtse gcig dang ni mdung rings thogs/ /mdung dang mda' gzhu lcags kyu dang / /la la mda' ①rings ga ge dang / /cha lang dang ni rol mo'i tshogs/ /pi wang gling bu glu len cing / /gnod sbyin pho mo glu len cing / /yan lag lnga dang ldan pa yis/ /rol mo'i tshogs ni la la byed/ /la la mi lpags gon pa dang / /mi mgo lag na thogs pa dang / /mi yi rgyu mas thod kyang byed/ /la la mi yi rus pa thogs/ /sna tshogs rgyan dang sna tshogs phyag mtshan dang / /'byung po'i tshogs su shes par bya/ /sku mdog dang phyag mtshan bstan pa'o/ /'jig rten mgon po'i spyan snga ru/ /thal sbyar 'khod nas 'di skad smras/ /zhes bya ba ni 'byung po'i gnas ston pa'o/ /skya snar dubu ni ka ba na—/ /grong khyer bzang na byang phyogs na/ /bya rgod phung po'i rgyal po'i khab/ /rgya mtsho mtha' yi bar kyi sar/ /lan gsum bar du 'gro byed grong / /mkha' lding rgyas pa sted pa nas/ /rgyal khab dang ni ser skya'i gnas/ /shākya'i tog na gar ltam ③bar/ /sgra gcan medang ni tsir da na/ /mnyan ⑦yod dang ni gnas dang bcas/ /rgya mtsho'i gnas dang yangs pa can/ /gyad yul dang ni g.yog ④'dor dang / /tsam pa yul dang 'jug sgo ⑨can/ /sgo drug dang ni 36—1014

zangs kyi 'dab ma can/ /brang gis ①'gro na 'brog sdeganas dang / /'bru mangs na ni mchog tu srungs/ /srung ba khrucan dang gso ba'i mtha'/ /bsnyen rjodaga' grong khyer gnas dang ni/ /chu mchog na ni 'chi med zhag /rnga bzangs dang ni gzi ⑤can dang / /ri ldan grong khyer phyogs mtshams dang / /'od ma'i 'gram dang ka ling rjoka /'gro 'joms dang ni mi thub gnas/ /mdun khab gnas dang phreng ba brtsigs/ /rtad mar na dang ma rdzogs pa/ /snyems pa can dang ma rgyal gnas/ /gnas bcas dang ni zhi ba'i grong khyer dang / /'jigs byed dang ni brang ⑦'gro dang / /rdo grong dang ni shing gi grong khyer na/ /kha dog can dang tshangs par ldan/ /ba glang ⑧'dzin dang rdo 'jog dang / /bong srungs sel dang ri la gnas/ /ldan grogs dang ni bro nu'i dang / /dga' ba dga' byed grong khyer na/ /rlung gi sa dang 'phyang 'gyur na/ /bcom brlag ⑨na dang lang ⑩ka dang / /rab nyams dang ni mdzod 'dzin dang / /rnam rgyal ldan dang bcom brlag ⑪na yang gnas/ /ma la ya dang rtse 'dzin dang / /po 'dra na dang rab tu gnas/ /pi tang ⑫ka le dang ni rlabs ldan dang / /sna nas thung dang gso ba'i mtha'/ /dga' byed dang ni lag pa dang / /pu mtshan dang ni mdzod 'dzin dang / /pho brang ngan dang g.yog 'khor dang / /'gram ldan phung po grong khyer drug /mtha' ma na dang srung ba can/ /ba lang 'jog dang phyogs mtshalas na/ /gdugs 'dra na dang grong khyer gsum/ /tshang tshing gcig dang u dusmrar/ /kau shāsbyi dang ⑫zhi ldan na/ /sbrul gyi gdugs dang g.yo 'dzin na/ /gyen du 'gro dang thob byed na/ /grong ldan tshol ba lang chenamadzod/ /lha yi g.yul dang g.yul 'gyed ldan/ /dgra ngan zhing dang rgyal 36—1015

gnyis na/ /de nyid dang ni rab brten ①dang / /don grub grub dang don gnas dang / /'gro 'joms dang ni sbom po nyid/ /seng ge'i stobs dang sde bo che/ /de bzhin gzhan gyi grong dang ni/ /tsam pa dang ni ri mangs dang / /ba lang 'byor dang grong khyer dang / /gnas dang khwa la kau shāsdi④/ /bzang po can dang dam pa can/ /mching ①bu dang ni ma la ya/ /tshang rjotshing gnas dang ma rgyal gnas/ /chu mchog dang ni sen ⑤dha ba/ /'gro ldan dag dang ser skya'i gnas—/ /gzhan snyas dang ni sgo gnas dang / /dbu ma'i sde dang bzang mdzes dang / /grong khyer snying dang mya ngan sa/ /khyus 'gro dang ni nga rgyal brag /'jig byed dang ni kha che'i yul/ /ral pa can dang grong dang ni/ /kha che'i yul kyi sa mtshams na/ /sa la gnas dang spu yi mtshan/ /dkyil 'khor bstan dang ka bu sha /dga' ba'i tshang dang ni nam bsrung / /ngan pa dang ni tho gar yul—/ /grong bcas pa dang rgya mtsho gnas/ /grong khyen gsum ni sbu yi gnas//gra mi ngar dang sing ga la/ /ne+e tso rjobazhin dang 'og na gnas/ / pun dha ⑦gar dang grong khyer che/ /'jigs pa bzhin dang chu dang ldan/ /rtogs po'i yul dang ka ta ka /'phral ring 'phral dang u rgyan yul/ /thong shol ⑧ngan dang mya ngan na/ /yo ga na dang dga' dang ldan/ /phung po'i dbang dang chung ma can/ /rgyal po'i khab dang yangs pa ni/ /gnas te dug sbrul dang ni ⑨lcang lo'i grong / /dga' ba'i grong dang lha las babs pa dang / /de dag ni 'byung po'i gnas bstan pa'o/ /sbrul gyi gang gis 'byung po'i dkyil 'khor kun/ /zhes bya ba ni stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten kyi khams su 'gyu ba'i 'byung po rnams/ nga'i bka' las ma 'das na/ pho brang lcang lo can du skye ba thob 36—1016

pa'oske/ /'di bshad pa na ①mi nyan pa/ /de dag chad pa bshad par bya②/ /zhes bya ba ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bka'/ rig sngags kyi bden pa'i dmod ①mos rlag par byed pa'o/ /tshangs pas sprul pa'i mdo sde ste/ /sangs rgyas zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bya ba ni tshad med pa bzhi'i sgo nas gnas pa/ byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal ba'o/ /phan tshun du ni bltas byas na/ /bai ḍūr+ya dang gser dngul dang //zhes bya ba ni 'byung po rnams kyi gzhal yas khang lta na sdug cing rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'o/ /mu tig rnams dang shel dag dang / /spug dang rdo yi snying po dang / /zhes bya ba ni mu tig dmar po dkar pos dra rjob byas pa/sa gzhi dang rtsig pa shel las byas pa/ spug dang rdo'i snying pos ka tan ⑤dang /ka ba byas pa'o/ /rin chen bdun gyis brgyan pa yi/ /rtsibs stong kha dog gser 'dra ba'i/ /zhes bya ba ni sgo bzhi ka ba brgyad/ twa ra rnam bzhi ni gzhi gser las byas pa/ rin po che sna bdun gyis phra rjobyas pa'o/ /shing rta rnam pa bzhi ⑦byas pa/ /bzo rnams kun dang ldan pa ste/ /zhes bya ba ni/ shar phyogs seng ge'i shing rta dang / / twa ra rnam ⑧bzhis mdzes pa'o/ /de bzhin du go rims bzhin du sbyar bar bya'o/ /glang po che dang / rta dang / ri dwags shartu ⑫la'o/ /rdzu 'phrul gyis ⑩ni mkha' la 'gro/ /rgyal po dag ni der bzhugs nas/ /zhes bya ba ni yang na shing rta de dang ldan zhing / nam mkha' la rgyu'o/ /'byung po'i dkyil 'khor nyid du dong / /sa ni gser gyi phye ma la/ /zhes bya ba ni sems kyis sprul pa'i gzhal yas khang dang 'dra ba⑪/ lta na sdug pa sna tshogs kyi gzugs su snang ba'o/ /me tog dag gis bkang byas nas/ /36—1017

mgul par rtsang dang skud pa dang / /zhes bya ba ni sa gzhi yang me tog gis bkang ba/ pho brang yang me tog gis snang ba ste/ 'byung po dang 'byung mo rnams me tog gis stimago la brgyan pa ste/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga spyod pa'o/ /zhags pa dag kyang gdags byos ④la/ /phyogs kyi sa ni ji snyed pas①/ /zhes bya ba ni 'byung po de rnams kyang tshangs pa'i thag pas bcings te/ sa dang bar snang la rgyu ba rnams la'o/ /'byung po thams cad khrid shog ces/ /gnod sbyin gyi ni ded dpon kun/ /zhes bya ba ni/ gnod pa byed pa'i 'byung po rnams/ /kun kyang zhags pas drangs pa'o0/ /phyogs bcu dag tu dgye bar bya/ /zhes bya ba ni phyogs bcu na gnas pa'i stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i rjo'ajig rten gyi khams kyi 'byung po rnams dgye ba'o/ /stong chen rab tu 'joms pa yi mdo sde yi ni dam pa 'di/ /zhes bya ba ni seng ge'i sgra lta bus dam pa rnams kyi dam pa'o—/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten bar du du'abyung / /lha rnams kun gyis rnam par bsams⑦/ /zhes bya ba ni chos sku'i rang bzhin nam mkha'i rang bzhin thams cad khyab pa/ sems can rnams kyi yum lta bu'o/ /stong chen mo yi lus kyis su④/ /gnod sbyin dang ni srin po btul/ /zhes bya ba ni rig sngags kyis spulus ngag yid gsum gyis kyang ma rungs pa thams cad 'dul ba'o/ /lus ngan po yi tshig thos nas/ /gnod sbyin gyi ni ded dpon stong / /zhes bya ba ni rgyal po chen po ku be+e ra'i tshig thos nas/ gnod sbyin ded dpon stong phrag gnas pa'o—/ /phyogs bzhi dag tu song nas su/ /gsang ba po la drag tu bsgo/ /zhes bya ba ni gnod sbyin de rnams kyang / bka' stsal pa'i tshig snang ba'o/ /thub pa 'byung po nyi shu brgyad/ /dri za las byung gdon gyi tshogs/ /zhes bya ba 36—1018

ni thub pa ni sangs rgyas la zhus pa'o/ /dri za'i ded dpon gyi gdon phyogs der 'khod pa dag go/ /shar phyogs cha na 'khod pa dag /mdo sde'i zhags pas de dag kun/ /zhes bya ba ni shar phyogs nas ①gnod par byed pa/ rig sngags kyi dmod mo'i ②zhags pas bcings pa'o/ /bcing ba lnga yis bsdams pa yis/ /'byung po mang po nga la nyon/ /zhes bya ba ni ye shes lnga'i zhags pas bsdams pa ste—/ dri za'i gdon stong phrag brgyad cu rnams/ rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung gis bka' stsal pa'o/ /thub pa 'byung po nyi shu brgyad/ /grul bum las byung ①gdon gyi rnams/ /zhes bya ba ni thub pa ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar zhus pa'o/ /grul bum gyi ded dpon la sogs pa/rig sngags kyi dmod mo'i rjozhags pas 'dren pa'o/ /lho phyogs cha 'dir 'khod pa dag /mdo sde'i rjozhags pas de dag kun/ /zhes bya ba ni lho phyogs nas glags tshol zhing sems can la gnod pa byed pa rnams/ rig pa'i duzhags pas bcings pa'o/ / bcing ba lnga yis bsdams ⑦pa yi/ /'byung po mang po nga la nyon—/ /zhes bya ba ni ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gti mug la sogs pa de de'i bsdams pas ④bcings pa ste/ ma rungs pa'i gdon la sogs pa rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes pos 'dul ba'o/ /thub pa 'byung po nyi shu brgyad/ /klu las gdon du gyur pa rnams/ /zhes bya ba ni thub pa ⑨ni sangs rgyas la zhus pa/klu'i ded dpon du gyur pa/ nub ngos na ⑩'khod pa'o/ /nub phyogs cha 'dir 'khod pa dag /mdo sde'i zhags pas de dag kun/ /zhes bya ba ni ma rungs pa'i klu dang sa bdag la sogs pa/ rig sngags kyi dmod mo'i zhags pas bcings pa'o/ / bcing ba ⑪lnga yis bsdams pa yi/ /'byung po mang po nga 36—1019

la nyon/ /zhes bya ba ni nub ngos nas glags tshol zhing / sems can rnams la gnod pa ①ste/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis bcings pa bsdams nas/rgyal po chen po spyan mi bzang gis klu'i gdon la sogs pa la chad pa gcod ②pa'o//thub pa 'byung po nyi shu brgyad/ /gnod sbyin las ni gnod dze+egyur pa/ /zhes bya ba ni thub pa ni sangs rgyas la zhus pas terjo/ gnod sbyin kyi ded dpon rnams byang ngos na gnas pa'o/ /byang phyogs cha 'dir 'khor ba dag /mdo sde'i zhags pas de dag kun/ /zhes bya ba ni byang ngos nas glags tshol zhing /sems can la gnod par byed de/ de rnams kyang rig sngags kyi dmod mo'i zhags pas bcings pa'o/ /bcing ba lnga yis bsdams pa yi/ /'byung po mang po nga la nyon/ /zhes bya ba ni gnod sbyin kyi gdon la sogs pa/ ye shes lnga'i bcing bas bsdams te/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos bus chad pas gcod pa'o/ /lus ngan gyi ni bu thu bo/ /kun du rgyal ba mi la zhon/ /zhes bya ba ni gnod sbyin gyi ded dpon sde bo che rnams yin te/ 'dir yang gnod pa byed pa rnams so—/ /de yi drung na 'khod pa yi⑤/ /gnod sbyin bye ba drug cu dag /ces bya ba ni rnam thos kyi bu che shos la 'khod pa'o/ /bcing ba rnam pa lngas bsdams nas—/ /mdo sde'i zhags pas rab tu drangs/ /zhes bya ba ni 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga'i bcing bas rjobasdams pas/ rig sngags kyi dmod mo'i zhags pas bsdams pa'o/ /de nyid kyi ni bu gnyis pa/ /skyed pa po zhes rnam grags pa/ /zhes bya ba ni rnam thos kyi bu che shos kyi 'og ma'o/ /de yi drung na 'khod pa yi/ /gnod sbyin bye ba drug cu rnams/ /zhes bya ba ni bu de'i 'khor ded dpon sde bo che rnams so/ / bcing ba ⑦rnam pa lngas bsdams nas/ /mdo sde'i zhags pas 36—1020

kun du drangs/ /zhes bya ba ni ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin kyis bsdams ①shing /rig sngags kyi dmod mo'i zhags pas bcings pa'o/ /de nyid kyi ni bu gsum pa//de yi ming ni gdon po che/ /zhes bya ba ni rnam thos kyi bu mtha' ltag go/ /de yi drung na 'khod pa yi/ /gnod sbyin bye ba drug cu rnams/ /zhes bya ba ni gnod sbyin kyi ded dpon sde bo che rnams so/ / bcing ba ①rnam pa lngas bsdams nasaske/ /mdo sde'i zhags pas kun du drangs/ /zhes bya ba ni 'dod pa'i yon tan lngas bsdams pa/ rig sngags kyi dmod mos bcings pa'o/ /de nyid kyi ni bu bzhi pa/ /de yi ming ni bum bu'i lto/ /zhes bya ba ni rnam thos sras kyi bu tha ma'o/ /de yi drung na 'khod pa yi/ /gnod sbyin bye ba drug cu rnams/ /zhes bya ba ni bu de'i 'khor ded dpon sde bo che rnams sneso/ /bcing ba rnam pa lngas bsdams nas/ /mdo sde'i zhags pas kun du drangs/ /zhes bya ba ni de rnams kyang ye shes lngas bsdams shing / rig sngags kyi zhags pas bsdams pa'o//dbang phyug chen po lha chen po/ /lag bzhi pa la stobs po che/ /zhes bya ba ni g.yas gnyis na tri shu rjol dang / bum pa spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ g.yon gnyis na phreng ba dang mchod sbyin mdzad pa/ stobs dang gzi brjid dang ldan pa khams gsum la dbang byed pa'o/ /de yi drung na 'khod pa yi/ /gnod sbyin bye ba drug cu rnams/ /zhes bya ba ni dbang phyug chen po'i 'khor rnams zhes bya ba ni ded dpon du gnas shing sde che ba'o/ / bcing ba rjornam pa lngas bsdams nas—/ /mdo sde'i zhags pas kun du drangs/ /zhes bya ba ni 'dod pa'i yon tan lngas rjobasdams shing / rig sngags kyi dmod mo'i zhags pas bsdams pa'o//'byung po 'joms pa'i ri la ni/ /'byung po thams cad lhags nas ⑦su/ /36—1021

zhes bya ba ni rigs ①mi gcig pa'i gdon thams cad gnas pa'o/ /'joms pa ni rig sngags kyis 'joms pa'o/ /rig sngags thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas//rig sngags 'di ni kun du bsam/ /zhes bya ba ni nam mkha' bzhin thams cad la khyab pa/ sems can dang byang chub sems dpa' la sogs pa skyed pa'i yum 5lta bu'o/ /chad pa mi bzad drag po ste/ /gang phyir sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs—/ /zhes bya ba ni 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang ①da ltar gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyis rjogasungs pa/ gzhan rnams kyis mi thub pa dmod mo'i chad pa'o—/ /sangs rgyas la ni gus par ni/ /thams cad 'di la skyabs su song ⑤//zhes bya ba ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la skyabs su 'dong zhing zhes bya ba rgo/ dam pa'i chos rig sngags la gus pa'o/ /g.yo med par ni rjes zhugs shing / /thams cad med par gyur ta re/ /zhes bya ba ni brdzun skyemi smra bar sems can mi slu bas te/ stong pa'i rang bzhin du snang ba'o/ /de nas thang cig tsam gyis ⑦ni/ /'byung po mang po thams cad lhags/ /zhes bya ba ni gzugs sna tshogs su snang ba'i 'byung po rnams kyang / /rig sngags kyi ye shes zhags pas drangs nas/ phyogs bzhir snang ba'o/ /ri rnams dang ni g.yang sa dang / /rgya mtsho dang ni mtsho rnams dang / /zhes bya ba ni 'byung po'i gnas ni de rnams dang ldan pa'o/ /klung ④dang 'bab chu lu ma dang / /dba' 4 klong dag na ⑩gang 'khod dang / /zhes bya ba ni de dang ldan pa'i gnas su bsdad cing / sems can rnams la gnod pa byed pa'o/ /skyed mos tshal dang gzhal med khang / /kun dga' dang ni nags rnams dang / /zhes bya ba ni 'byung po rnams ⑫gnas gcig tu mi gnas te/ gzugs ⑫sna tshogs su snang 36—1022

ba'o—/ /mchod rten gnas dang grong gi ①gnas/ /shing ljon drung na gang gnas dang / /zhes bya ba ni gnas de dang de la gnas shing / 'jig rten khams su rgyu ba'o/ /grong khyer sgo dang grong rnams dang / /grong rdal dang ni ljongs rnams dang / /zhes bya ba ni 'byung po tshan gcig ni grong dang grong khyen rnams su rgyu zhing / sems can rnams la glags tshol ba'o/ /rgyal po'i pho brang sgo rnams dang / /gzhal med khang na dze+eganas pa dang / /zhes bya ba ni tshan gcig kyang rgyal po la gnod pa byed pa rnams/ gnas der bsdad cing glags tshol ba'o/ /dkyil 'khor dag dang dur khrod dang / /de bzhin lha khang rnams dang ni/ /zhes bya ba ni tshan gcig ni lha khang rnying ①pa la chags shing dge ba la bar chod byed pa'o/ /mtshams dang sho gam gnas rnams dang / /khang stong dang ni gram sa dang / /zhes bya ba ni de dang der ldan pa'i gnas su bsdad cing /gzugs mi gcig par snang ba'o/ /gnod sbyin gang rnams bla 'og dang / /phyogs bzhi dang ni mtshams rnams nas/ /zhes bya ba ni gnod sbyin de dang ldan pa ni/ /phyogs mtshams brgyad du gnas pa'o/ /gnod sbyin bye ba stong rnams no—/ /rig sngags zhags pas bkug pa rnams/ /zhes bya ba ni/ stong phrag de dang de yod pa/ /ma rungs pa yi bu'abyung po rnams/ /rig sngags kyi dmod mo'i zhags pas 'dren pa'o/ /rdza rnga dag ni brdungs nas su/ /la las sda zlum dag ni brdungs/ /zhes bya ba ni sgra la dga' ba'i gnod sbyin rnams bsam gyis ⑤mi khyab par snang ba'o/ /pi wang gling bu khar ba'i rnga/ /stobs chen dag ni sgra 'byin te/ /zhes bya ba ni tshan gcig kyang rol mo la dga' zhing /sems can rnams la gnod par byed pa'o/ /rol mo'i sgra dbyangs sna tshogs 36—1023

dang / /glu dang gar rnams byas nas su/ /zhes bya ba ni sems can rnams slu ba'o—/ /dbang po zla ba chu lha dang / /ba ra dh+wa dza skye dgu'i bdag /ces pa ni gnod sbyin gyi ded dpon sum cu rtsa gnyis su gnas shing / /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ba dag go/ /mi ①ldan pa dang kun du lta④/ /mngon shes gangs can rdzogs pa dang / /zhes bya ba ni de rnams la ④yang de'i sder dhibacas shing /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten kyi khams ⑤rgyu ba'o/ /tsan+dan dang ni 'dod mchog dang //mgul pa mdzes dang mgul nges rjodang / /zhes bya ba ni de rnams kyis kyang sems can rmi don byas shing / rig sngags la gus pa'o/ /skye dgu'i bla mar gyur pa 3dang / /lha las byung ba'i ma ldan dang / /zhes bya ba ni gnod sbyin gyi tshan de dang der ldan zhing / nam mkha' dang / sa steng sa ⑤'og tu rgyu ba'o/ /dri za sna tshogs sde ⑨dang ni/ /mi rgyal rgyal ba khyu mchog dang / /zhes bya ba ni sde bo cher grags shing stobs dang ldan pa'o/ /de bzhin phud bu ⑩lnga zhes bya/ /g.yer ma dang ni nyi zer dang / /zhes bya ba ni nyi ma'i 'od dang ldan pa/ yud tsam gyis stong gsum khyab pa'o/ /nya lcibs dang ni ral gyi ⑪bu/ /kun kyi 4 bshes dang grags 'dzin dang / /zhes bya ba ni 'byung po sde tshan de dang ldan pa/ral gri bzhin du rno ba'o/ /'brog gnas dang ni yid bzangs dang / /khab rna ⑫dang ni ri sul kha④/ /zhes bya ba ni sde bo che nyi shu rtsa gnyis dang ldan pa/de rnams yang gzugs sna tshogs dang ldan pa'o/ /lnga spyo'adzin dang ni khab bzangs dag /sde dang dpung dang bzhon par bcas⑩/ /zhes bya ba ni stobs dang ldan pa sde bo cher grags pa'o/ /lha dang klu dang dri za dang / /gnod sbyin 'byung po lha ma yin/ /zhes bya ba ni gdon rigs mi gcig pa lha'i 36—1024

gdon la sogs pa stong phrag brgyad cu'o/ /nyin gsum pa yi thru byed dang / /de bzhin bzhi pa'i rims dag dang / /zhes bya ba ni nad sna tshogs gtong zhing smyo bar byed pa rnams yin te/ de rnams yang gzhan kyis mi thub pa stobs dang ldan pa'o/ /'jig rten 'tshe ①ba gang yin pa/ /gnod sbyin 'byung po ma rungs rnams/ /zhes bya ba ni stong gsum kyi stong chen po'i ②'jig rten kyi khams skad cig yud tsam thang cig gis rgyu ba/ sems can rnams la 'tshe bar byed pa'o/ /phyogs bzhi nas ni bkug nas su/ /bcing ba lnga yis bsdams pa rnams—/ /zhes bya ba ni ma rungs pa'i 'byung po rnams la/ ye shes lnga'i zhags pas bcings pa'o/ /'jig rten mgon po'i spyan snga ⑦ru/ /thal mo sbyar nas 'di skad smras/ /zhes bya ba ni 'byung po de rnams kyis kyang yang dag par sdogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rjospyan sngar/ gus par byas nas zhus pa'o/ /phyag 'tshal skyes bu dpa' khyod la/ /phyag 'tshal skyes bu mchog khyod la/ /zhes bya ba ni bdud bzhi 'joms pa la dpa' ba/ skyes bu chen po'i bumatshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang ldan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu bupos sku la brgyan pa/sems can rnams la mnyam pa nyid du lta ba/ snying rje dang byams pas khyab pa/thal mo sbyar nas phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rgyal khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bya ba ni 'byung po de rnams kyis ⑦zhabs la gus par phyag 'tshal te/ stong gsum gye stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams la/ chos kyi rgyal srid mdzad pa'o/ /de dag gi ni mdun ⑧rgyug pa/ /'byung po gnod sbyin lus po che/ /zhes bya ba ni che ba ri rab dang mnyam pa/ chung ba ba ⑨spu'i rtse mo tsam/ de dang der ldan pa'i 'byung po rnams rgyu ba'o/ /lag pa bzhi pa ma rungs pa/ /rkang mangs 36—1025

dang ni rkang gcig pa/ /zhes bya ba ni mda' dang gzhu dang ral gri mdung rnams thogs pa/ stong tsho gcig gi rkang pa yod pa/ rkang gcig ni gnyis stel nas rgyu ba'o/ /rkang bzhi pa dang rkang gnyis dang / /rkang pa bgreng la spyi'u tshugs kyedang / /zhes bya ba ni ma rungs pa'i 'byung po yang spyi bo'i gtsug gis 'gro zhing /sems can rnams 'jigs par byed pa'o/ /de bzhin du rkang bzhi rkang gnyis kyang 'jigs par byed pa'o/ /lus mang ④mgo bo gcig pa dang / /lus gcig pa la mgo bzhi dang / /zhes bya ba ni gzugs che zhing 'jigs su rung ba bzhin mi sdug pa rnams so/ /mig mang ①po la lus phyed dang / /mig gcig lto ni bcu gnyis dang / /zhes bya ba ni rkang gcig lag gcig lus su snang zhing /lus de la mig mang po yod pa ste/ 'byung po gzhan yang lto ba ri bo lta bur gnas pa/ mang po bsdebs pa mig gcig tu snang ba'o/ /bong bu rnga mo glang chen mgo/ /lag pa bgreng la mgo btud dudang / /zhes bya ba ni gzugs mi'i gzugs la mgo bo sna tshogs su snang ba/ rkang pa dang lag pa sgreng bar byed pa'o//mtshon cha'i so dang mtshon cha'i lag /mtshon cha'i rkang pa srin po rnams/ /zhes bya ba ni de kun gyi yan lag dang ral gri dang / mda' gzhu dang mdung la sogs par snang ba'o/ /zangs kyi skra dang zangs kyi so/ /zangs kyi mig dang zangs kyi lag /ces bya ba ni shin tu dmar ba 'jigs su rung ba ste/ mtshon cha bzhin du snang ba'o/ /zangs kyi tho ba rkang ⑤pa dang / /zangs kyi sna dang zangs kyi kha/ /zhes bya ba ni mtshon cha mi 'jigs pa 'dzin pa/ rkang pa yang tho ba'i tshul du gnas pa'o/ /de bzhin du kha la sogs pa yang zangs kyi skra bzhin du snang ba'o/ /rkang lag kun du 'bar ba dang / /mi yi lus su gnas 36—1026

pa rnams/ /zhes bya ba ni me bzhin du 'bar te/ des kyang mi la zhe sdang la sogs pa 'bar bar byed pa'o/ /sgur zhar lba ①ba gsum yod pa/ /mig mi sdug la kha glal ②ba/ /zhes bya ba ni bong thung zhing lus po sgur te/ de'i ske la lba ba gsum yod pa/ lus po zha zhing kha gdangs pa/ mchu sngon por snang ba 'jigs pa'o/ /chu srin stag gi gzugs dang ni/ /gzugs mi sdug dang kha ral po/ /zhes bya ba ni mi'i lus la mgo brnyan du yod pa/ kha gdangs shing mi sdug pa'o/ /mchu 'phyang po dang so yon po/ /rab tu sdug pa'i khro gnyer ①can / / zhes bya ba ni rjogadong pa yo ba/ de bzhin du mchu dang so yo ba'o /khro bar gnas shing sems can la 'jigs par byed pa'o/ /gsus po che dang bum sna po/ /rna 'phyangs po dang rna ba med/ /ces bya ba ni gsus pa ri rab dhitsam snang brjo/ rna ba gos su gon pa/ rna ba bcad ④pa'i 'byung po rnams so//lag ring ⑧dang ni rna ba ring / /sna yi rtse dang lag rtse ring / /zhes bya ba ni lag pa brkyang bas dpag tshad brgyar slebs te/ snas lus khebs te glang po che'i sna dang 'dra ba/ de bzhin ⑨sor mo yang ring ba'o/ /lus skams ⑩lus ni ring ba dang / /skra ring ⑩rab tu brgyan pa dang / /zhes bya ba ni shin tu nag pa/ shing lpags skams pa dang 'dra ba⑫/ ring ba ni ring ba bas kyang ches ring ba lus rnams kyang skra ring bas ⑫brgyan pa'o/ /rkang pa mid pa phra ba dang / /dri nga ba dang bum lto po④/ /zhes bya ba ni yan lag gi tshigs spyordog por yod pa/ rkang pa phra bas te/ dri mi zhim pa mnam ⑩pa/ gsus pa ri bo tsamayod pa'o/ /yan lag chu srin 'dra ba dang / /gtun shing tho ba 'dra ba'i lto—/ /zhes bya ba ni lag pa dang rkang pa yang chu srin 'dra ste/ gzugs ring ba/36—1027

—rked pa nyag pa/ nag por ①snang ba'o/ /gnam lto ba dang sna ②bo che/ /gyen du badze+es skra rab tu dmar/ /zhes bya ba ni sna yar 'khyil pa glang po che'i sna 'dra ba/ khab kyi rtse mo dang 'dra ba'i skra dmar zhing ne+e'abar ba'o/ /mgo bo che la gzhu mgrin po/ /rked pa sgur po bum lto bo/ /zhes bya ba ni 'byung po la la ni gzhu bzhin du ske dusgur bas te/ de bzhin du yan lag dang lus po rnams kyang sgur ba'o/ /ri rab rtse mo bsgul ⑤nas su/ /me mdag dugi ni char pa 'be+ebs—/ /zhes bya ba ni gzi brjid dang / stobs dang ldan zhing / ri rab dang sa g.yo bar byed pa ma rungs pa'i char 'be+ebs pa'o/ /ljon shing ri dang rdo ba ⑦dang / /sprin gyi tshogs kyi mdog 'dra ba/ /zhes bya ba ni la la gzugs bzang bar gnas pa/ gzhan rnams yang bzhin mi sdug pa'o/ /dung dang rnga chen rdza rnga dang / /grul bum rnga bran rnams kyi sgra/ /zhes bya ba ni sgra dang rol mo la dga' ba gar sna tshogs dang ldan pa'o/ /'jigs pa'i sgra ni rab tu 'byin/ /mid po che la bong bu'i sgra/ /zhes bya ba ni ri rab kyi rtse mo nas gling bzhir thos pa'i sgra/ sgra des sems can 'jigs pa'o/ /nag po sngon po ser po dang / /dmar ser me ltar dmar ser dang / /zhes bya ba ni bzhin mi sdug pa gzugs sna tshogs su snang ba/ bskal pa'i me'i 'od dang 'dra ba'i 'od zer snang ba'o/ /khab 'dra'i spu dang ral gri'i ⑧skra/ /dmar po'i khrag gis bskus pa rnams/ /zhes bya ba ni shin tu rno ba lus dang mgo rnams la khyab pa/kha yang khrag gis bskus pa'o/ /mi ro dag ni khyer nas su/ /za bzhin du ni rnam par rgyug /ces bya ba ni mi rnams la 'tshe bar byed cing srog 'phrog pa rnams yin te/ glags tshol zhing 'phrang kha bsgugs ⑨pa rnams yin no/ /so 36—1028

rnon lag pa dmar po dang / /mchu ni khrag gis bskus pa dang / /zhes bya ba rgo mche ba ring ba mtshon 'dra ba ste/ sems can rnams kyi ①lag pa dmar por snang ba/ khrag 'thung ba la dga' ba'o/ /lus phyed dag ni zos pa dang / /mkhal ma snying dang nang grol kyis/ /zhes bya ba ni sems can rnams la 'tshe bar byed pas/ sha dang khrag la dga' ba dang / /don snying lnga la dga' ba'o/ /snyim ②pa shin tu bkang ba dang / /byis 1pa dag ni za bzhin du/ /zhes bya ba ni mi rnams kyi rjoni srog 'phrogs ⑤nas don snying rnam rjopa lnga phyung nas za bar byed pa'o/ /mer mer po dang srog chags kyi/ /rkang lag rnams kyi stobs kyang 'phrog /ces bya ba ni byang chub sems chags su mi ster bar za ba ma'i mngal nas gzi brjid 'phrog pa'o/ /keng rus kyi ni lus kyis su/ /skye bo mang po skrag par byed/ /ces bya ba ni pags ⑦pa dang sha med pa dang rus par snang ste/ de lta bu'i gzugs kyis kyang 'tshe bar byed pa'o/ /khrag gis rab tu bkang ba yi/ /mi yi pags pa thogs nas su/ /zhes bya ba ni sems can rnams kyi khrag 'jib cing / mi yi pags pa gon pa'o/ /mi bzad skedug gis kun bskus ⑨te/ /phyogs phyogs dag tu rnam par rgyug⑩ /ces bya ba ni bsam pa dang / mthong ba dang reg ⑪pa dang / mche ⑫ba'i dug rnams kyis ⑫bskus pa—/ stong gsum gyi stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams su ④rgyug pa'o/ /grong khyer rnams kyi sgo rnams dang / /khyim nas khyim du rnam par 'thor/ /⑫zhes bya ba ni sems can rnams la glags tshol ⑩ba/ grong dang grong khyer grong rdal du ⑩rgyu ba'orka/ /rlung dang bad kan mkhris pa rnams/ /phyogs bzhi dag tu 'khrug par byed—/ /ces bya ba ni 'byung po rnams kyi mdze dang phol mig la sogs pa nad 36—1029

bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi gtong ba'i bdag po'o/ /de ltar de na ①rgyal po yi/ /gdon dang 'jigs pa chen po rnams/ /②zhes bya ba ni rgyal po chen po bzhis kyang 'byung po'i gdon de rnams 'dul ba'o/ /lhags pa de dag thams cad kyang / /rig sngags zhags pas rab tu bsdams①/ /zhes bya ba ni stong chen mo'i rig sngags kyis/ 'byung po rnams rang dbang med par bkug pa'o/ /phyag 'tshal skyes bu dpa' khyod la/ /phyag 'tshal skyes bu mchog khyod la/ /zhes bya ba ni ma rig bupa la sogs pa nyon mongs pa 'dul ba la dpa' ba'o/ /skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu ⑤rtsa gnyis dang / dpe ⑦byad bzang pos sku la brgyan pa/'jig rten gyi ⑦khams kyi sems can thams cad la mnyam pa nyid du byed pa'o/ /thal mo sbyar nas phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rgyal khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bya ba ni 'byung po rnams kyis kyang gus ⑧par phyag 'tshal te/ stong gsum gyi chos kyi rgyal srid mdzad pa'o/ /grong khyer grong dang yul 'khor dang / /pho brang 'khor du rgyu ba dang / /zhes bya ba ni 'byung po rgyu ba'i dus tshod ni snga dro shar kyi phyogs nas stirgyu/ nyi ma phyed na lho nas ⑩rgyu/ nyi ma smyur nas nub kyi phyogs su rgyu—/ nyi ma smyur nas ma nub bar du byang gi phyogs nas rgyu/ nyi ma nub nas sa sros bar du shar lho mtshams su rgyu/ srod 'khor nam phyed bar du srin po'i phyogs nas rgyu/ nam byed skya rengs tshun chad nub byang phyogs nas rgyu/ skya rengs shar nas nam langs tshun chad byang shar mtshams nas rgyu/ de dag dus rgyu ba ni/ mchod phyir lhags kyang 'tshe ba mod/ /tshes grangs dag la rgyu ba rnams—/ /de dag mi la 'tshe bar byed/ /tshes gcig dang ni bcu gcig la shar gyi phyogs nas chu tshod bzhi'i bar du rgyu/ tshes gnyis dang bcu gsum la 36—1030

lho'i phyogs nas chu tshod brgyad rgyu/ tshes gsum dang bcu gnyis la chu tshod bcu'i bar du nub kyi phyogs nas ①rgyu/ srod 'khor tsam tshes bzhi dang bcu bzhi la nam phyed nas chu tshod drug byang gi phyogs nas rgyu/ tshes lnga dang bcu drug la ni nyi ma dros nas shar lho mtshalas nas chu tshod bdun rgyu'o②/ /tshes drug dang dgu la chu tshod sum cu tham pa lho nub mtshams nas snga dro nas rgyu'o/ /tshes bdun dang bcu tham pa'i dus su nub byang mtshams nas snga dro nas chu tshod bco lnga la rgyu'o/ /tshes brgyad dang gnam stong la byang shar nas snga dro nas chu tshod bcu gnyis bar du rgyu'o/ /de dag ni 'byung po rgyu ba'i dus bstan pa'o/ /gnod sbyin ma rungs mdangs 'phrog pa/ /snying rje med cing khrag 'thung ba/ /zhes bya ba ni sems can rnams la 'tshe bar byed cing srog 'phrog pa ste/ 'byung po de rnams sha dang khrag la dga' ba'o/ /lus chen 'jigs pa chen po ste/ /stobs po che la sgra yang che/ /zhes bya ba ni lus ni ri rab dang mnyam pa/ stobs kyis ni ri rab bsgul ④ba/ skad kyang drag po'i tshul du snang ba'o/ /mgrin bcu po la mig stong porjo/ /gdon chen mig ni dmar po rnams/ /zhes bya ba ni mgo re re la mig brgya brgya yod pa ste/ mig de yang dmar por snang zhing 'jigs su rung ba'o/ /'khor ni mang po rnams btang ste/ /lag na mtshon thogs rab tu 'jigs—/ /zhes bya ba ni gnod sbyin ma rungs pa mang por snang zhing / ral gri la sogs pa'i mtshon cha mang po thogs pa'o/ /sbrul gyi pags pa thogs pa dang //lag bzhi lag na sgon me thogs/ /zhes bya ba ni dug sbrul gyi pags pa gon pa/mi gsal ba gsal bar byed pa kha nas me 'bar zhing 'jigs par byed pa'o/ /lag na mtshon dang ⑤dbyig pa thogs/ /rdo rje'i mdung rtse lag na thogs/ /36—1031

zhes bya ba ni 'byung po ma rungs pa rnams kyang / lag na mtshon sna tshogs pa /—thogs shing 'jigs su rung ba'o②/ /rab tu drag pa'i dmag brgal dze+enas/ /phyogs bcu kun du skrag par byed/ /ces bya ba ni dpung mang po dang ldan zhing phyogs bcu dag tu 'khod pa ste/ de dag gis kyang sems can rnams la 'jigs pa dang skrag par byed pa'o/ /sdang ba'i gnas na 'khod pa yi/ /gsang ba po ni dad kun yang / /zhes bya ba ni sems can rnams la sdang ba/rgya cher gnod pa skyel ba'o/ /mi yi 'jig rten 'di dag tu/ /skyes pa bud med gzhan yang 'dzin/ /zhes bya ba ni stong gsum gyi mi rnams la 'byung po de rnams kyis 'tshe bar byas ba'o/ /sha khrag dron mor bcas pa la/ /rnam par 'khrul zhing dhi'adod pa'i gzugs/ /zhes bya ba ni mi rnams kyi ⑤srog gcod cing sha dang khrag la dga' ba'o/ /seng ge dang ni stag dang rta/ /ma he ba glang bong bu rnga/ /zhes bya ba ni gzugs mi gcig pa byol song rnams kyi gzugs su sprul pa'o—/ /glang po che yi gzugs 'dra dang / /dom dang gzig rjodang spyang ki nyu dang / /zhes bya ba ni de dang der ldan pa'i gzugs su snang zhing / sems can rnams la 'tshe bar byed pa'o/ /khyi dang wa dang ra dag dang / /byi la byi ba spre'u'i gzugs/ /zhes bya ba ni gnod pa skyel ba'i dus su gcan gzan gye gzugs su sprul pa'o/ /bse dang phag dang sre ⑧mong dang / /nya dang rus sbal dag gi gzugs/ /zhes bya ba ni gzugs kyang sna tshogs su snang ba/ rmi lam yang de bzhin du snang ba'o/ /kha cig dag ni sram gyi gzugs/ /khwa dang 'ug pa khu byug dang / /zhes bya ba ni de lta bu'i gzugs su snang zhing gnod pa cher skyel ba'o/ /bya rgod khra dang nya mid bcas/ /rma bya ngang pa thi ba dang / /36—1032

zhes bya ba ni de'i gzugs su ston cing / skad mi gcig pa mang po 'don pa'o/ /khrung khrung dang ni bya rnams dang / /kha cig bya gag gzugs rnams su/ /zhes bya ba ni 'jigs su rung ba ma rungs pa rnams yin te/ ltas dang rmi lam ngan par byed pa'o/ /gnod sbyin rnams ni mi yis mthong / /'dab bzangs ①bya yi tshul kyis kyang / /zhes bya ba ni 'jigs su rung ba'i gzugs ston pa/sems can rnams la skrag par byed pa'o/ /skye bo mang po skrag ④byed cing / /zhes ①bya ba ni skyes pa bud med byis pa rnams la skrag par byed pa'o/ /kha cig ④mi yi mgo can la/ /lus ni bya gag bong bu rjo'adra/ /zhes bya ba ni 'jigs su rung ba'i 'byung po rnams kyang / mi'i mgo can la byol song gi lus so/ /kha cig mtshon gyis rab tu 'tshe/ /lus dang bral ba nyid du snang / /zhes bya ba ni sna tshogs mtshon gyis 'tshe zhing / khrag khrug la dga' ba'o/ /rnam par 'khrugs shing 'dod la mos/ /rgyu ma'i phreng rjobs rab tu dkris/ /zhes bya ba ni 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la dga' zhing sems 'khrugs par byed pa ste/ yan lag mi'i rgyu ma'i phreng bas brgyan pa'o/ /rtse gsum mdung gis rab 'debs shing / /srog chags rnams la gnod par byed/ /ces bya ba ni 'jigs su rung ba'i 'byung po de dag kyang snying rje dang bral ba'o/ /mi bzad ⑦pa yi dbugs 'byin cing / /skye dgu 'di dag skrag par byed/ /ces bya ba ni ske ba che zhing skad che ba ste/ sgra des sems can rnams skrag ④pa'o/ /srog chags rgyud rnams ji snyed par/ /sna tshogs kyi ni gzugs su snang / /zhes bya ba ni nya la sogs pa'i sems can gyi gzugs su snang zhing / gzugs mi gcig pa mang po snang ba'o/ /kha cig dag ni ri yang thogs/ /la la ral gri 'khor lo thogs//36—1033

zhes bya ba ni stobs dang ldan zhing ri rab theg ①par nus pa/ mtshon rnon pos 'tshe bar byed pa'o/ /grangs ni brgya phrag stong rnams te/ /dbyug pas bsdigs shing kha drag pa④/ /zhes bya ba ni 'byung po rnams sde chen por gnas shing sems can rnams la chad pa chen po gcod pa'o/ /mig chung ba la bzhin mi sdug /srin po'i so ni rno ba dang / /zhes bya ba ni bzhin mi sdug pa kha dang so rnams yo ba'odze+e—/ /sna dang rna ba bcad rjopa dang / /lce bcad ⑤gdong ni gnyer ma can//zhes bya ba ni gzugs ngan par snang zhing / dbang po rnams ma tshang ba'o/ /rkang lag dag ni gtubs ⑥pa dang / /mgo bo bcad ⑦pa'i srin po ⑧rnams/ /zhes bya ba ni mgo bo med par brang nas gdong pa snang bas te/ tshigs rnams la yang gdong pa snang ba'o/ /skabs ni rab tu tshol bar byed/ /ldig pa can rnams gzi brjid 'phrog /ces bya ba ni sems can rnams la glags tshol zhing /sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ sems can gyi dpal 'phrog pa'o/ /mi yi lus rnams dag la ni/ /rab tu phra ba'i gdon du snang / /zhes bya ba ni mi'i lus la zhugs nas mi dga' ba'i ⑨sems dang / lceb pa'i sems dang ldan par byed pa'o/ /spu yi bar dang nad rnams dang / /de bzhin rma yi kha rnams su/ /zhes bya ba ni ba spu'i bar du 'dzin cing / rma med pa rma yod par byas te/rma'i nang rul bar byas nas/ phyi subs ⑩nas nang na tsha chen po dang ldan par byed do/ /lhags pa de dag thams cad kyang / /rig sngags zhags pas rab tu drangs/ /zhes bya ba ni rig sngags kyi dmod mo'i zhags pas ma rungs pa'i 'byung po rnams bcings pa'o/ / phyag 'tshal skyes bu dpa' khyod la/ /⑪phyag 'tshal skyes bu mchog khrod la/ /zhes bya ba ni de dang der ldan pa'i 'byung po 36—1034

rnams kyis kyang / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la gus par phyag 'tshal ba'o①/ /thal mo sbyar nas phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rgyal khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bya ba ni stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi ②khams chos srid du mdzad cing / stong gsum gyi chos kyi ①rgyal por snang ba'o/ /ri yi rgyal po ri rab dang / /zhes bya ba ni 'dod pa'i khams ni rjo'adod yon lnga la spyod pa bzhin/ 'byung po rnams kyang 'dod pa'i yon tan lngas spyod do/ /ji ltar spyod ce na/ gzugs mthong bas mdangs 'phrog pa dang / sgra snyan po thos nas 'dzin pa dang / dri zhim po tshor nas 'dzin pa dang / ro zhim po myangs nas 'dzin pa dang / lus reg pas 'dzin pa dang / de dag kyang gang na gnas she na/ ri rab khor ⑤yug la gnas nas 'dzin pa'o/ /de bzhin kho ra khor rjoyug dang / /bya rgod phung po gshol mda' ⑦'dzin/ /zhes bya ba ni dbus kyi ri bo mchog rab nas/ phyi'i kho ra khor ⑧yug la thug pa'i ri bo chen po la gnas pa'i 'byung po rnams so/ /de bzhin du bya rgod phung po dang / ri bdun la sogs pa'o/ /spos ngad ldan dang gangs kyi ri/ /sna tshogs sde dang baṇ+ḍa pā⑨/ /zhes bya ba ni de yang 'dzam bu'i gling na gnas pa'i ri rnams so/ /na la dā spyoyi ri gnyis dang / /dpal gyi ri yi rtse mo ni/ /zhes bya ba ni 'dzam bu'i gling gi lho phyogs na gnas pa'o/ /gang dag shin tu mthor ⑪'phags dang //ri bo de dag kun la yang / /zhes bya ba ni lha dang lha ma yin rnams 'tshogs ⑫shing / 'byung po'i tshogs rnams 'dul ba'o/ /lha dang drang srong gang gnas pa—/ /de dag thams cad mi dga' zhing / /zhes bya ba ni stong chen mo ⑫rab tu 'joms ma'i gzi brjid kyis/ ri rab de rnams na gnas pa'i 'byung po 36—1035

rnams yid mi dga' ba'o/ /'jigs pa'i yid kyis mya ngan byed/ /bye ba stong gi lha dag dang / /bye ba phrag brgya'i lha rnams ①dang / /zhes bya ba ni rig sngags kyi gzi brjid kyis/ 'dar zhing kyi hud ces sgra 'byin pa'o/ /lha yi bu mo skal chen dag /thal mo rab tu sbyor bar byed/ /ces bya ba ni rig sngags kyi dmod mos 'jigs pas gus par sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thags shubazangs ris dang sgra gcan dang / /tshim par byed pa'ang der phyin to/ /zhes bya ba ni lha ma yin gyi dbang po la sogs pa yang / rig sngags kyi dmod mos bkug ste/ gus par sangs rgyas la 'dud pa'o/ /lha min bye ba phrag stong dang / /lha min bye ba phrag brgya dang / /zhes bya ba ni de yang lha ma yin rmi grangs/'byung po la gtogs pa rnams so/ /de dag bu mo 'phrul ldan pa/ /mang po kun kyang thal mo sbyar/ /zhes bya ba ni lha ma yin gyi dbang po'i bu mo la sogs pa yang / rig sngags kyi gzi brjid kyis/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar 'khod pa'o/ /rab tu gnas dang rgya mtsho dang / /zhes bya ba ni phyi'i rgya mtsho la gnas pa dang /sa 'og dang nam mkha' la rgyu zhing / ma rungs pa'i klu dang sa bdag rnams dang /rigs bzhir gnas shing phyogs bcu dag tu 'khod pa'o/ /klu yi rgyal po gzi can dang / /zhes bya ba ni sa rim pa bdun gyi 'og na gnas pa ste/ de'i 'khor sha za dang 'byung po rnams yod de/ mi'i dri tshor ba tsam gyis mdangs 'phrog pa'o/ /klu'i gnod pa'i mtshan nyid bstan pa'o/ /klu yi rgyal po ma dros dang / /dga' bo nye thudaga' gnyis po dang / /zhes bya ba ni sngar bshad pa bzhin du klu'i rgyal po ④rnams kyis kyang sangs rgyas kyi drung du 'khod pa'o/ /rdo rje blo gros pak+ṣu dang / /gaṅgā rjodaga' bo sin+tu ⑦mtsho/ /zhes bya ba ni de rnams 36—1036

kyang mtsho ma dros ①pa la gnas shing / gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas par rgyu ba'o/ /bya yi rgyal po 'dab bzangs dang / /rgya mtsho chen po 'khrugs byed dang / /zhes bya ba ni de yang ④rgya mtsho gting na gnas pa rnams yin te/ de rnams sangs rgyas kyi drung du 'khod pa'o/ /stong phrag bye ba'i klu rnams dang / /bye ba brgya yi klu dag dang / /zhes bya ba ni de rnams kyi 'khor du bcas pa sa bdag klu dang bcas pa rnams so/ /de dag bu mo skal chen rnams/ /thal mo rab tu sbyor ①bar byed/ /ces bya ba ni klu'i bu mo de yang grangs de dang ldan par gnas shing / sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar 'khod pa'o/ /nyi ma zla ba gnyi ga yang //skar ma'i 'khor gyis yongs su bskor/ /zhes bya ba ni de yang bar snang du rgyu zhing / rig sngags kyi dmod mos 'khod pa'o/ /gser kyi me tog yan lag na/ /ma ga dhā rjon 'jigs byed pa/ /zhes bya ba ni de yang gnod sbyin 'byung po rnams/'dzam bu'i gling na gnas shing / rig sngags kyi dmod mos 'khod pa'o/ / gso ba'i mtha' bun mi thod can/ /ko sa la na rab tu dkar/ /zhes bya ba ni yul ma ga dhā rjon gnas shing / stong gsum rgyu ba'o/ /bzang po'i yul na kha sru can/ /gyad kyi yul na grags pa 'dzin/ /zhes bya ba ni de yang 'dzam bu'i gling gi nub phyogs su gnas shing / sems can rnams la 'tshe bar byed pa'o—/ /lnga ⑦'dzin pa na ⑧skrag byed pa/ /rta ⑨skye ba na mig dmar gnas/ /zhes bya ba ni 'byung po'i gnas de dang ldan pa ni/ sems can la gnod par byed par grags pa'o/ /srung byed pa na ser skya ste/ /sems pa ⑩na ni mig ser po/ /zhes bya ba ni gnod sbyin gyi ded dpon gnas de na gnas shing /skad cig mas thams cad rgyu ba'o/ /be+e'u la phan ⑪bum pa'i lto/ /dga' ba'i yul 36—1037

na ring por skyes/ /zhes bya ba ni gnas de dang ldan zhing gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa la rgyu ba'o/ /ba lang 'dzin na rab tu 'joms/ /dung yul na ni nyi ma'i grogs/ /zhes bya ba ni gnas de dang ldan zhing sangs rgyas kyi sbyan sngar 'khod pa'o/ /ljongs chen rnams kyi gnod sbyin ni/ /brjod pa bcu drug de dag dang / /①zhes bya ba ni 'byung po gnas can du gnas pa/ grags pa dang ldan pa/ rig sngags kyi zhags pas 'dren pa'o/ /lag na rdo rje gnod sbyin che/ /chos skyong rab tu dkar ba dang / /zhes bya ba ni ri rab rtse mo la gnas shing sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung ④ba'o/ /ser skya rab mdzes khyab 'jug dang / /bum lto gsus pa zlum ①po dang / /zhes bya ba ni gnod sbyin de rnams yang ri rab kyi khong seng lho pyangos na gnas shing / dge ba'i rtsa ba la gnod par byed pa'o//chu srin bden pa 'chang ba dang / /lnga ⑤ldan rgyal ba khyu mchog dang / /zhes bya ba ni de rnams kyang lho'i 'dzam bu'i gling na gnas shing / gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas par rgyu ba'o/ /gnod sbyin chen po dbang phyug che/ /lag pa bzhi can stobs po che/ /zhes bya ba ni ti se'i gangs la gnas shing / sems can rnams kyis ⑥mchod par 'os pa'o/ /sde pa rab tu 'dul ⑦ba ni/ /mthu bo che la stobs po che/ /zhes bya ba ni 'byung po de dang der ldan pa ni/ stong gsum rgyu ste ④rig sngags kyi zhags pas 'dren pa'o/ /gshin rje gshin rje'i pho nya dang / /bdud rnams sde dang bcas pa dang / /zhes bya ba ni ma rungs pa'i gshin rje'i pho nya mo dang / bdud kyi lha rnams yang 'dren pa'o/ /gnod sbyin bye ba'i g.yog 'chang ba/ /gnod sbyin de ming 'phrog po yin/ /zhes bya ba ni 'jig rten gyi mi rnams la gnod pa skyel zhing gzi brjid dang 'od 'phrog pa'o/ /36—1038

sha ①ri ta ni sder bcas dang / /ri yi bu mo gnod sbyin ma/ /zhes bya ba ni de yang gzi ②brjid che zhing sa la gnas pa'o/ /gzi brjid chen mo 'jigs pa'i gzugs—/ /'phrog ma zhes kyang grags pa dang / /zhes bya ba ni gnod sbyin srin mor grags pa dang / ma'i mngal nas bu 'phrog pa'o/ /gdol pa mo ni gtum mo yang / /bu rnams lnga brgyas bskor ba dang / /zhes bya ba ni ma rungs pa'i 'byung po rnams bu lnga brgya dang ldan pa'o/ /mi sdug nag mo karka ti①/ /pad+ma dang ni pad+ma can/ /zhes bya ba ni gnod sbyin mo de rnams yang / rig sngags kyi dmod mos sdod par mi nus te/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar 'khod pa'o//me tog so dang sa ga dang / /srin mo bong bu'i sna can dang / /zhes bya ba ni srin mo de rnams lho phyogs na gnas shing sems can rnams la gnod pa byed pa'o//tsan+dan dang ni khyab 'jug len/ /seng ge ser skya dmar ser po/ /zhes bya ba ni de dag ni gnod sbyin kyi ded dpon du gnas pa/ byis pa'i gdon bco lnga'i gtso bo rnams so/ /glang po klu yi so can dang / /ri bshes ④drag po'i mche ba can—/ /zhes bya ba ni de dang de ldan zhing sems can rnams la gnod par byed pa'o—/ /srin mo so bzang ⑤yod pa dang / /tshangs pa spyolen dang khyab 'jug len—/ /zhes bya ba ni ming der grags pa sems can la gnod pa/ skad cig mas gling bzhir rgyu ba'o/ /gnod sbyin ha la ha la dang / /gnod sbyin rnam pa'i mchu can dag /ces bya ba ni gnod sbyin 'di dag kyang / lcang lo can kyi pho brang du gnas shing / rnam thos kyi bu'i 'khor du gnas pa'o/ /mdung dang mda' gzhu kun thogs shing / /mi rta ba lang ri dwags rnams/ /④zhes bya ba ni mtshon sna tshogs thogs shing / sems can rnams la gnod pa byed pa'o//36—1039

za zhing 'tshe ba de dag ni/ /phyogs rnams kun du rgyug cing 'dong / /zhes bya ba ni sems can rnams la glags tshol zhing srog 'phrog pa rnams so/ /sa 'di rab tu g.yo bar byed/ /nags tshal rnams kyang rab tu skems/ /zhes bya ba ni ri rab 'gul bar byed cing / rgya mtsho yang skems par byed pa'o/ /ri rnams kun nas ①g.yo bar byed/ /skye dgu 'di dag 'tshe byed cing / /zhes bya ba ni tshe'i bar chod byed/ sems can rnams la 'jigs skrag byed pa'o/ /phan tshun nas ni 'du ba ②dag /rig sngags kyis ni drangs nas lhags/ /zhes bya ba ni de dang der ldan pa'i 'byung po rnams la/ rig sngags kyi bcing ba lnga'i dmod mo'i zhags pas bsdams pa'o/ /phyag 'tshal skyes bu dpa' khyod la/ /phyag 'tshal skyes bu mchog khyod la/ /zhes bya ba ni 'byung po de rnams kyis kyang /'jig rten mgon po'i spyan snga ru/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal nas bstod pa'o/ /thal mo sbyar nas phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rgyal khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bya ba ni stong gsum kyi stong chen po'i chos kyi ①srid mdzad cing / dam pa'i chos kyi tram̐rgyal po la gus par phyag 'tshal lo⑤/ /'jig rten mgon po'i spyan snga ru/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod pa'o/ /zhes bya ba ni 'byung po rnams kyis rjoso so rang rang gi sgo nas/ chos kyi rgyal po la zhu ba phul ba'o/ /de nas zhes bya ba ni 'byung pos smras pa'i don de nas ⑦so/ /rgyal po chen po rnam thos bus/ /'jig rten mgon la 'di skad gsol/ /zhes bya ba ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras kyis zhus pa'o/ /bdag gi phyogs cha byang phyogs su/ /rgyal po'i gnas su sprul pa ni/ /zhes bya ba ni ri rab kyi byang phyogs na mnga' mdzad cing / byang phyogs skyong bar byed 36—1040

pa'orka/ /lcang lor ①ldan pa yid du mchi/ /de bas bdag ni ①lcang lo'i bdag/zhes bya ba ni lta na sdug cing mdzes par snang ba ④yid du 'ong bar gnas so/ /rgyal po'i pho brang lcang lo can/ /lha rnams kun gyis bsam par gyur/ /buzhes bya ba ni las kyi rjolhas byin gyis brlabs pa/ rin po che'i gzhal yas khang du snang ba'o/ /phyi ra shin tu mthon po can/ /rin chen kun gyis brgyan pa lags—/ /zhes bya ba ni rin po che sna rjobadun las byas pa/ rgya phibs dang ldan pa/bdun thog yod pa'o/ /'phang du dpag tshad bcu drug ste/ /gser gyi rgyu las bgyis pa lags/ /zhes bya ba ni thog re re la dpag tshad bcu drug bcu drug ste/rin po che sna bdun gyis phra ④byas pa'o/ /phyogs bzhi spyog ni re re la'ang /gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje dag /ces bya ba ni sgo bzhi dang ldan pa phyogs re re nas srung mar snang ba'o/ /kun nas rab tu gnas par gyur⑧/ /lag na mtshon cha legs ⑨par sprul/ /zhes bya ba ni gnod sbyin pho mo mang po gnas shing /mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pa'o/ /rgyal po'i pho brang de yi sgo/ /bzhi pa gtod par ṅkubagyis pa ni/ /zhes bya ba ni ka ba brgyad kyis mdzes pa/ rgyan rnam ⑪bzhis lta na sdug pa'o/ /gcig ni gser las bgyis pa'i sgo/ /gnyis pa dngul las bgyis pa lags/ /zhes bya ba ni thog re re la yang sgo bzhi bzhi dang ldan pa'o/ /gsum pa shel gyi sgo mo lags/ /bzhi pa gser kyis rnam par spras/ /zhes bya ba ni rim pa bzhin du rin po che rnams kyis byas pa'o/ /grong khyer de yi nang dag na/ /skyed ⑫mos tshal gyi me tog rgyas/ /zhes bya ba ni rdzing bu dang /me tog gi ra ba chu las skyes pa dang / thang las skyes pas brgyan pa'o/ /de yi nang na gzhal med khang / /rin chen sna bdun sna tshogs mchis/ /zhes bya ba 36—1041

ni gnod sbyin pho rnams spyod pa byed pa'i gzhal yas khang snang ba'o/ /rin chen sna tshogs ljon shing dang / /bya bran sna tshogs skad kyang 'byin/ /zhes bya ba ni de'i skyed mos tshal dang rdzing bur/ khrung khrung dang khu byug la sogs pa bya sna tshogs kyi skad kyis mdzes pa'o/ /me tog sna tshogs legs par bkram/ /sna tshogs spos kyis byugs pa lagasasde/ /zhes bya ba ni chu dang thang las skyes pa'i me tog ku mu ta dang puṇ+ḍa rī ⑤ka la sogs pas brgyan pa/ yan lag brgyad dang sbyar ba'i pog phor dang ldan pa'o/ /gnod sbyin mo ni 'joms ma dang / /glu dang rol mos rab tu brgyan/ /zhes bya ba ni lta na sdug pa rgyags ma dang ldan pa she dag ④rnams kyis/ rol mo sna tshogs la spyod pa'o/ /dpal gyi dam pa nyams su myong / /der ni 'byung po'i dkyil 'khor der/ /zhes bya ba ni 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga phun sum tshogs pa de rnams la spyod pa'o/ /gang dag 'khor zhing mchis pa dag /rnam dupa'i mchog kun ldan pa ste/ /zhes bya ba ni yid bzhin nor bu bzhin du 'dod pa gang yang 'byung ba'o/ /chos 'tshal pa dang chos spyod pa/ /zhes bya ba ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i bka' nyan nas/mi la sogs pa sems can gang la yang gnod pa mi skyel zhing dhisdom pa gsum la gnas pa'o/ /srog 3chags rnams la 'tshe mi bgyid/ /zas dang skom gyis mi byel ④te/ /zhes bya ba ni 'jig rten gyi sems can rnams la dga' zhing byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa'o/ /skye dgu mi bzad ⑨gzhan dag ni/ /longs spyod chen po tshol tsobakyid cing / /zhes bya ba ni mi'i tshogs rnams la phrad par dga' zhing / phun sum ⑪tshogs par byas nas skyong bar byed pa'o/ /phyogs bzhi kun du rnam par lta/ /grong khyer sgo yi gom yo ⑫dang / /zhes bya ba ni 36—1042

mi'i grong khyer kyi phyogs bzhi nas srung zhing / de rnams mtho bar dga' ba'o/ /bza' ①shing ra ba nags tshal na/ /gnod sbyin srin po 'byung po'i tshogs/ /zhes bya ba ni gang dag gang du gnas pa'i 'byung po rnams la rig sngags 'di'i dmod mos 'khod pa'o/ /bye ba stong phrag brgya mchis pa/ /de dag thams cad mdo sde yi/ /zhags pas drangs te brlag ②par bgyi/ /zhes bya ba ni gang yang rung ba gnod pa rnams la/ rig sngags kyi dmod mo'i zhags pas 'dul bar byed pa'o/ /rgyal po'i pho brang dbus na ni/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i gnas gyur pa①/ /zhes bya ba ni rgyal po chen po bzhi'i dbus su/ dmigs pa med pa'i pho brang snang ba'o—/ /bsil ba'i rdzing bus bskor ba ste/ /tsan+dan nags kyis 'khor ba lags—/ /zhes bya ba ni sems can rnams la bsil bar byed pa'i ye shes kyis bskor zhing / byams pa dang snying rje'i nags tshal gyis bskor ba'o/ /kun nas dpag tshad drug cu ste/ /khang pa brtsegs pa sprul pa dag /ces bya ba ni sems can kyi gzhal rjoyas khang du snang zhing yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'o/ /gcig ni gser las bgyis pa ste/ /gnyis ni dngul las bgyis rjopa lags/ /zhes bya ba ni phyi nang gnyis su med par rin po che gser dngul las byas pa'o/ /gsum pa bai ḍūr+ya las bgyisarjo/ /bzhi pa gtsang dang shel kyi rgyu/ /zhes bya ba ni chos mi 'gyur bar snang bas bai ḍūr+ya ste/ phyi nang gnyis su med par gsal ba ni shel lta bu'o/ /lnga pa mu tig dmar po ste/ /drug pa rdo yi snying po lags/ /zhes bya ba ni rdo rje pha lam las byas pa'i seng ge'i khar ④mu tig gi ridra ba'i phreng bas te/ de yang mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa'o/ /bdun pa spug las bgyis pa stene+e/ /brgyad pa rin chen 36—1043

bdun las bkyis/ /zhes bya ba ni rin chen dra ba dang dra ba'i yon tan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /bud med stong phrag brgya dag kyang ①/ /de dag re re kun na gnas—/ /zhes bya ba ni shes rab kyi rang bzhin gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dang ldan pa'o/ /lhab lhub sna tshogs mchog dag dang / /cha byad sna tshogs mang pos brgyan/ /zhes bya ba ni tshad med pa bzhi'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing mdzes pa'o//glu dang rol mo sna tshogs dang / /bzo yi gnas la mkhas pa mchis/ /zhes bya ba ni zag pa zad pa'i ye shes dang ldan zhing / sems can rnams kyi las 'joms par byed pa la mkhas pa'o/ /de lta'i rab tu dga' ba yis bde zhing tshim pa'i yid du gyur/ /①zhes bya ba ni yang dag pa'i ye shes dang ldan zhing bde bar gnas pa'o/ /de na bdag ni rgun skyems dang / /'dod pa dag ⑦gis rab myos pas/ /④zhes bya ba ni de yang 'byung po la sogs pa'i 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la spyod cing / 'dod pa'i zhags pas bcings pa'o/ /bdag gi 'khor rnams 'phyan bgyid cing / /phyogs bcu dag tu 'jigs pa skyed//ces bya ba ni rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu'i 'khor tshan gcig kyang / sdig la dga' bas sems can la 'jigs skrag byed pa'o/ /bud med dag dang skyes pa dang / /de bzhin sgo dang ⑤bu mo dang / /zhes bya ba ni gzi brjid 'phrog pa she dag go/ /mngal na gnas pa 'jigs par byedarjo/ /dud 'gro'i skye gnas gtogs pa la'ang 'tshe/ /zhes bya ba ni mer mer po dang nur nur po rnams 'phrog cing dud 'gro rnams kyi srog 'phrog pa'o/ /skar ma dag dang nyi zla dang / /gtum ④pa'i gza' rnams gnod par bgyid/ /ces bya ba ni zla ba nyi ma mi snang bar byas shing / bza' ba dang btung ba rnams 'phrog pa'o/ /lo thog sa bon 36byed1044

'bras bu dang / /me tog sman dang zas ①skom dang / /zhes bya ba ni 'byung po de rnams kyis kyang dus ma yin pa'i rlung dang ser ba gtong ba'o/ /mi rnams kyi no dpal 'phrog cing / /mthon po rnams kyang dma' bar bgyid/ /ces bya ba ni gzi brjid dang ④phun sum tshogs pa 'phrog par byed pa/ phyug po ltogs por gtong ba dag go/ /'jig rten dag la ①nongs pa rnams/ /dmag dang 'thab mo shar gnyer rjodang / /zhes bya ba ni khrag khrug la dga' bar byed pa'am/mi'i 'jig rten gyi sems rnam par byed pa'o/ /tshig gam zhig gam gsad rjobya ba / /de kun 'byung po'i durnam par gyur/ /④zhes bya ba ni khrag khrug la sman ma byas shing / mi rnams kyi srog 'phrog pa'o/ /sbed cing stor bar bgyid pa dang / /zlog ④par bgyid cing rgod par byed/ /ces bya ba ni 'byung po de rnams bzung nas/ zas dang skom yang mi 'ju zhing bzlog ste⑨/ sbed pa ni nad sna tshogs gtong zhing sems yang stor bar byed pa'o/ /res 'ga' yang sems smyo ⑩bar byed pa'o/ /byed pa rgod pa'o/ /'jigs par byed cing lta bar bgyid/ /dgrar 'gyur ba yang ston par bgyid/ /ces bya ba ni skyes pa bud med khye'u bu mo rnams la rims dang yams nad kyis btab cing /'jigs skrag byed cing bla 'chol smra ba'o⑪/ /lta ba ni dran pa stor zhing nam mkha' dang sa gzhi la lta ba rnams te/ sems mi dga' bar byas nas ngu ba'i sgra 'byin pa'o/ /sdig pa'i rmi lam mthong bar bgyid/ /nyal ba dag la gnod par bgyid/ /ces bya ba ni shin tu 'jigs pa'i rmi lam dang / mi dge ba'i ltas ston te/ skyes pa la mor sgyur cing gnod la/ bud med la phor sgyur cing gnod pa'o/ /sgo nas se gol ⑫sgra 'byung zhing / /mi dran brjed ⑫de za 36—1045

bar bgyid/ /ces bya ba ni grong dang grong khyer du rgyu zhing / se gol tsam gyis khrag khrug byed do/ /khrag khrug gi sman mas za ba dang 'thung bar byed pa'o/ /mdza' bo gnyen bshes gzugs dag tu/ /dga' zhing bka' ①mchid smra bar bgyid—/ /ces bya ba ni tshe 'di dang phyi ma yang / mdza' bo dang gnyen bshes ②su skyes shing mi de la gnod par byed pa'o/ /bu mo sdu ⑦gu'i gzugs dag tu/ /'dod la spyod pa dga' bar bkyid/ /ces bya ba ni mdzes sdug pa 3bu mo'i gzugs su byas nas/ byang chub sems dang tshe 'phrog ma'o/ /nyi ma skar ma'i gzugs dang ni/ /zla ba'i gzugs su gda' bar bgyid/ /ces bya ba ni rmi lam dang ltas la yang de lta bu'i rmi lam ⑤rmi ba'o/ /rlung dang skar mda'i lce rjogazugs su/ /tshe ④la gnod par de dag gda'/ /zhes bya ba ni phyugs chen por gyur cing / nam mkha' nas 'brug sgra dang glog babs te/bar snang la 'od chen po snang ba'o/ /skar ma'i tshogs dang 'dra ba dag /'jigs par bgyid pa wa dang khyi/ /zhes bya ba ni dngos po dang rmi lam la yang /gcan gzan kyi gzugs su sprul nas gnod pa'o/ /rnam par sprul nas ljon shing dang / /mchod rten dag gi gnas na gda'/ /zhes bya ba ni gnas de dag tu gnas shing / sems can rnams la gnod par byed pa'o/ /skyes pa gzhon nu'i gzugs mdzes pas/ /'bar zhing shing rta'i sgra yang 'byen/ /zhes bya ba ni 'byung po de rnams kyis khye'u dang bu mor skyes nas/ pha ma dag la gnod par byed pa'o/ /shing rta'i sgra ni skad sna tshogs su 'byung ba'o/ /gnas rnams dang ni shul dag tu/ /rnam pa sna tshogs rjes kyang ston/ /zhes bya ba ni gzugs dang 'od dang rdzu 'phrul ston pa'o/ /grong khyer dag dang khyim rnams kyi//36—1046

sgo yang gnod sbyin ①de dag ②'byed/ /ces bya ba ni 'byung po de rnams kyi phyir 'brang zhing / grong dang grong khyer rnams la gnod par byed de/ sgo phug dang 'phrang kar bsdad cing 'dzin pa'o/ /srog dang lus kyang blang bgyis shing / /lam ngan ①kun du bskor bar bgyid/ /ces bya ba ni lus la na tsha drag por byas shing / srog 'bral bar bgyid pa'o/ /bskal pa bdun kyi bar du yang rjes snyag dupa'o/ /rnam pa sna tshogs gzugs dag dang rjo/ /rnam pa sna tshogs sgra rnams dang / /zhes bya ba ni gzugs sna tshogs su sgyur buzhing / kha dog sna tshogs sprul pa'o/ /rnam pa sna tshogs nad rnams kyis⑦/ /lus la na bar gnas par ston/ /zhes bya ba ni mdze dang lhog pa phol mig la sogs pa'i nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi ston pa dag go/ /nad rnams kun gyi mtshan nyid kyang / /phyin ci log tu ston ⑧par byed/ /ces bya ba ni rlung dang bad kan mkhris par ston cing / bad kan rlung dang mkhris par ston te rtsa 'khrug par snang ba'o/ /ji snyed 'jig rten rang bzhin dag /thams cad log par ⑨de dag ston/ /zhes bya ba ni stong gsum gyi ⑫stong chen po'i ⑪'jig rten gyi khams skad cig thang cig ⑫yud tsam gyis ⑫rgyu zhing / sems can rnams la 'tshe ba phyin ci log par ston pa'o/ /rig sngags zhags pas drangs pas na/ /de dag kun kyang 'dir mchis so/ /zhes bya ba ni stong chen mo rab tu 'joms ma'i dmod mo'i zhags pas ma rungs pa'i 'byung po rnams bcings pa'o/ /de nas zhes bya ba ni/'byung po bshad pa'i de nas so/ /rgyal po chen po rnam thos bu/ /zhes bya ba ni byang phyogs kyi gdon gnod par byed pa rnams la chad pa gcod pa'o/ /langs te thal mo rab sbyar nas/ /zhes bya ba ni 'khor gyi nang nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan 36—1047

sngar langs so/ /zhabs la 'khor lo'i mtshan mnga' ba/ /gser gyi mchod sdong 'bar ba bzhin①/ /zhes bya ba ni mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang ldan zhing /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa/ chos kyi phung po'i rang bzhin kyi sku'o//'jig rten snang bar mdzad pa po②/ /thub pa chen po me dang 'dra/ /zhes bya ba ni stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i ④'jig rten gyi khams na chos kyi rgyal por snang ba bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od do/ /stong phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi ni/ /gnod sbyin gsang sngags mi bzad ④can/ /zhes bya ba ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis stong chen mo'i rig sngags zhal nas gsungs pas/ gnod sbyin gyi gdon rnams brlag ⑤par byed pa'o/ /byang phyogs cha yi phyogs cha gnas/ /byang phyogs dag tu gnod par bgyid/ /ces bya ba ni gnod sbyin 'byung po ma rungs pa rnams so/ /'jig rten mgon po'i spyan sngar ni/ /de dag chad rjopa bdag gis bshad④/ /ces bya ba ni stong chen mo'i rig sngags kyi chad pas khyegacod pa'o/ / s+thād ya the dan ⑨zhes bya ba ni/ 'di lta ste/ gang la zhe na rig sngags 'di'o/ /byang phyogs su bdag bde legs su gyur cig ces bya ba ni bdag nye bar mtshon pa'o/ /bde legs ni sems can thams cad phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig pa'o/ /de dag ni rgyal po bzhi dang phyogs skyong ba bcu'i chad pa sgres pa ste/ tshangs pa dang ni brgya byin dang / /'jig rten skyong ba dbang phyug che/ /zhes bya ba ni tshangs pa la sogs pa gzugs khams kyi lha rnams dang / brgya byin la sogs pa 'dod ⑩khams kyi lha rnams dang /'jig rten skyong ba bcu po dang / gnas gtsang ma dang dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa'i lha rnams dang / gnod sbyin ded dpon thams cad dang / /36—1048

'phrog ma'i ①bu dang bcas pa dang / /zhes bya ba ni mthu bo che sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / gnod sbyin gyi ded dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / gnod sbyin gyi ded dpon lngas ④rtsen dang / 'phrog ma'i bu lnga brgya'o/ /bdag gi me tog spos dag dang / /sbyin sreg 'di ni blang bar gyis/ /zhes bya ba ni rgyal chen rnam thos kyi bus/ sems can kyi don du de dag 'bul ba'o/ /de dag gi ni brtson 'grus dang / /gzi brjid dbang phyug stobs kyis kyang / /zhes bya ba ni lha de dag gi mthu'i nus pa'o/ /nad rnams thams cad bcom par gyur/ /④zhes bya ba ni/rlung mkhris ༷bad kan la sogs pa nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi 'joms pa'o /bdag 'jigs pa dang / gnod pa thams cad las bde legs su gyur cig swā hā zhes bya ba ni/ gang zag rjo'adi la gus par byed pa nad dang 'jigs pa las thar ba'o/ /phyag 'tshal skyes bu dpa' khyod la/ / phyag 'tshal skyes bu mchog khyod la/ /dhizhes bya ba ni rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bus kyang /mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus sku la brgyan pa'i sprul pa'i sku la gus pas dze+ephyag 'tshal lo/ /thal mo sbyar te phyag 'tshal lo /chos rgyal khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bya ba ni stong gsum gyi ⑧stong 'jig rten kyi khams chos kyi rgyal srid mdzad cing / chos kyi rang bzhin gyis khyab ste/ de la sku gsung thugs kyis gus par phyag 'tshal ba'o/ /rgyal chen yul 'khor srung ba yang / /langs te thal mo sbyar btud nas/ /zhes bya ba ni 'jig rten mgon gyi spyan sngar gus par ⑨'dud pa'o/ /me tog lta bur rgyas gyur cig /ka la piṅka'i ⑩sgra dbyangs can/ /zhes bya ba ni zhal pad+ma rgyas pa dang 'dra ba/dbyangs gsal ba ⑪la phra ba'o/ /khu byug dang ni rma bya'i sgra/ /rnga dang 'brug 36byed1049

gi sgra sgogs pa/ /zhes bya ba ni sgra gsal ba yid du 'ong ba① rol mo'i tshogs dang ldan pa'o/ /thub chen gnod sbyin ④srin po dang / /dri za stong phrag drug cu bzhi/ /zhes bya ba ni shar phyogs na 'khod pa'i 'byung po rnams so/ /shar gyi phyogs cha'i phyogs na gnas/ /shar phyogs pa la gnod par bgyid/ /ces bya ba ni ma rungs pa de rnams la rig sngags kyi dmod mos chad pa gcod 4pa'o—/ /'jig rten mgon gyi spyan sngar ni/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bshad—/ /ces bya ba ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i spyan sngar/ rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung gis zhus pa'o/ /gang zhus na/ dri za la sogs pa'i srog snying rig sngags snying pos zhus pa'o/ /gsang sngags ni 'di lta ste/ dhā ④ra ṇi la sogs pa'o/ /shar phyogs su bdag bde legs su gyur cig swā hā zhes bya ba ni gang dag 'di la gus pa rjoshar phyogs su gnod pa dang / 'jigs pa mi 'byung ba'o/ /'di yang yul 'khor srung gis gsungs pa ste/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin la sogs pa ni/ gong du bshad pa bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /de dag gi gzi brjid dang mthu'i dbang gis/gang zag nad dang 'jigs pa las thar ba'o/ /phyag 'tshal skyes bu dpa' khyod la sogs pa ni gong du bshad pa bzhin bya'o/ /rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes porjo/ /thal mo sbyar te de nas langs/ /zhes bya ba ni 'jig rten mgon gyi spyan sngar gus pas thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /thams cad mkhyen pa thams cad gzigs/ / smra ba ⑦thams cad rab 'joms ⑤ pa/ /zhes bya ba ni rin po che rang gi lag mthil du ⑨snang ba dang 'dra ba 'jig rten gyi khams thugs rjes lta ba/ rnam par rtog pa'i ngo bo bdud bzhi 'joms pa'o/ /the tshom thams cad gcod mdzad pa/ /36—1050

'jig rten thams cad rnam 'dren pa/ /zhes bya ba ni ma rig ①pa'i ngo bo nyid nyon mongs pa rnams 'joms pa'o/ /ye shes kyi 'od zer gyis 'jig rten gyi ②sems can mtho ris su 'dren pa'o/ /grul bum yi dwags srul po dag /stong phrag drug cu ①rtsa bzhi rnams/ /zhes bya ba ni ma rungs pa'i grul bum la sogs pa rig sngags kyi chad pas gcod pa'o/ /lho phyogs cha yi phyogs na gnas/ /de dag byung rjol gnod par bgyid/ /ces bya ba ni lho phyogs na 'khod cing gnod par byed pa'o/ /'jig rten mgon gyi spyan sngar ni/ /de dag chad ⑤pa bdag gis bshad/ /ces bya ba ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes pos zhus pa'o/ /gang zhus she na/ grul bum la sogs pa'i srog snying rjorig sngags kyi las kyi snying po'o/ /gsang sngags ni 'di lta ste/ shārnyi shārnyi la sogs pa'o/ /lho phyogs su bdag bde legs su gyur cig swā hā zhes bya ba ni/ gang zag 'di la gus pa la lho phyogs kyi nad dang dze+e'ajigs pa mi 'byung ba'o/ /tshangs pa la sogs pa ④zhes bya ba ni/ sngar bshad pa bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /de dag gi gzi brjid dang dbang phyug gis gang zag gi nad dang 'jigs pa dang bral ba'o/ /phyag 'tshal skyes bu dpa' khyod la/ /sogs pa ni/ gong du bshad pa bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /rgyal po mig mi bzang ba yang / /thal mo sbyar ba byas nas langs/ /zhes bya ba ni 'jig rten mgon po'i spyan sngar gus par 'dud pa'o/ /sprin chen seng ge chen po pa⑨/ /che ba'i che ba ⑩rgya mtsho che/ /zhes bya ba ni 'jigs pa med pa seng ge bzhin du spyod pa sems can sprin gyi char bzhin don byed pa'o/ /rgya mtsho bzhin du bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ /gsung ba chen po dpa' chen po/ /g.yul chen 36—1051

rab tu 'joms mdzad pa/ /zhes bya ba ni smra ba'i seng ge stobs dang ldan pa nyon mongs pa'i g.yul chen po 'joms pa'o/ /klu dang 'dab bzangs gsang ba po①/ /stong phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi dag /ces bya ba ni ma rungs pa'i ②klu'i gdon la sogs pa rig sngags kyi dmod mo'i chad pas gcod pa'o/ /nub kyi phyogs cha'i phyogs na gnas/ /de nas byung nas gnod par bgyid/ /ces bya ba ni nub ngos nas 'khod nas de dag nas byung ba'o/ /'jig rten mgon kyi spyan sngar ni/ /de dag chad pa bdag ①gis bshad/ /ces bya ba ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar rgyal po chen po spyan mi bzang gis zhus pa'o—/ /gang zhus she na/ klu rnams kyi snying po'o/ /rig sngags kyi las kyi snying po'o/ /gsang sngags ni 'di lta ste/ ba tri dub ra tri la sogs pa'o/ /nub phyogs su bdag bde legs su gyur cig swā hā zhes bya ba ni/ gang dag nub phyogs kyi 'jigs pa dang / nad la sogs pa dang bral ba'o tshangs pa la sogs pa ni sngar bshad pa bzhin no/ /de dag gi mthu dang gzi brjid kyis kyang gang zag gi nad dang 'jigs pa dang bral ba'o/ /phyag 'tshal skyes bu dpa' khyod la sogs pa ni/ gong bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /de nas ni tshig gi bar gyi de nas so/ /tshangs pa dang ni tshangs chen yang / /thal mo sbyar ba byas nas langs—/ /zhes bya ba ni mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pas kyang 'jig rten mgon po'i spyan sngar /'u'adud pa'o/ /tshangs pas bkrus pa medag pa'o/ /rig byed kun gyi pha rol zhes bya ba ni/ mi dge ba bcu spangs shing dge ba bcu dang du blangs te/ tshad med pa bzhi'i sgo nas sems can gyi don mdzad pa'o/ /skye bo dga' mdzad sman pa'i rje/ /'jig rten thams cad gso mdzad pa/ /36—1052

zhes bya ba ni 'jig rten gyi khams kyi mes por mdzad pas ①de'i don mdzad pas dbang du bsdu ba'o②/ /gnod sbyin srin po gang gi rnams/ /phyogs dang phyogs mtshams gnas pa rnams/ /zhes bya ba ni phyogs bcu na bsdad pa'i 'byung po rnams rig sngags kyi dmod mos chad ①pa gcod pa'o/ /sa yi 'og dang sa yi steng / /nam mkha' dag la gnas pa'i gdon/ /zhes rjobya ba ni sa bdag tu gnas pa bar snang la rgyu ba ma rungs pa'i 'byung po rnams so/ /'jig rten mgon po'i spyan sngar ni/ /de dag chad pa dubadag gis bshad/ /ces bya ba ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pas zhus pa'o/ /gang zhus she na/ 'byung po rnams kyi gnyen po rig sngags kyi las kyi rjosnying po'o/ /gsang sngags ni 'di lta ste/ blu me bh+ra ma go ṣe ⑦la sogs pa'o/ /phyogs bcu dag tu bdag bde legs su gyur cig swā hā zhes bya ba ni/ gang zag 'di la gus pa la phyogs thams cad kyi 'jigs pa mi 'byung ba'o—/ /tshangs pa dang ni brgya byin la sogs pa zhes bya ba ni/ /gong du bshad pa bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /de dag kun gyi mthu'i nus pas gang zag la 'jigs pa dang / nad thams cad dang bral ba'o/ /rlung las gyur dang mkhris las gyur/ /bad kan las gyur 'dus las gyur/ /zhes bya ba ni 'di'i rkyen gyis mdze nad bco brgyad du 'byung ste/ de rnams kyis kyang 'jigs pa dang bral ba'o/ /nad rnams thams cad bcom par gyur/ /④bdag 'jigs pa dang gnod pa thams cad las bde legs su gyur cig swā hā zhes bya ba ni—/ gang zag gang yang 'di'i nus pas nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi dang 'jigs pa brgyad dang bral ba'o/ /phyag 'tshal skyes bu dpa' khyod la sogs pa ni gong 36—1053

bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /de yan chad ni 'byung po'i gnas skabs bshad pa ste bzhi pa'o// //de nas zhes bya ba ni/ 'byung po'i ①cho ga bshad pa'i de nas so/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te zhes bya ba ni/ grong khyer yangs pa can gyi sems can kyi ④don la snyoms par zhugs te/ yang na thugs rjes gzigs nas 'gro ba rigs ①drug gi sems can la don rjobya sems pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni zhes bya ba ni/ gaṅgā'i duklung gi bye ma snyed tsam mo/ /yang 'di nas sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs dang / gtsug tor can dang /thams cad skyob dang / log par dad sel ba rjodang / gser thub dang /'od srungs dang / shākya seng ge rnams zhes bya ba ni/ rgyal srid ni bcom ldan 'das kyis sems can gyi don la dgongs nas chos kyi rgyal srid byed pa'o/ /ci'i ⑦phyir 'jig rten du byung khrub ma yin zhes bya ba ni/ shākya seng ge'i bstan pa las byung ⑨ba ni ma yin no/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/ sngon du song ba'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis byas pa'i phyir zhes pa'o⑩/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams rgo zhes bya ba ni/ 'das pa dang da ltar bzhugs pa dang / ma byon pa rnams so/ /grong khyer ni zhes bya ba ni/ sa gcig tu bshad pa la bya/ grong rdal ni che ba'i phyir ro/ /ljongs ni lcags ri dang bcas pa'o/ /grong dang zhes bya ba ni chung ba la sogs pa'o/ /khyim na zhes bya ba ni/ sems can no/ /sems can gcig gi bar gyi don gyi phyir/ 'jig rten du byung ba ma yin ⑩zhes bya ba ni sangs rgyas rnams byung ba'o⑫/ /gang gi phyir byung zhe na/ 'jig rten 36—1054

gyi lha dang bcas ①nas byung ba'i phyir ro/ /bcas nas byung zhes pa ni/ 'gro ba rigs ②drug gi sems can gyi don du byung ba'o/ /bdud dang bcas pa tshangs pa dang bcas pa/ dge sbyong dang bram zer bcas pa'i skye dgu dang /lha dang mi dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i don du zhes bya ba ni/ 'jig rten mi la gang yang 'byung ba'i phyir/ de'i don du sangs rgyas rnams kyis ①thugs rje'i sprun gyis lta ba'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni zhes bya ba ni/sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i dhiklung gi bye ma snyed tsam mo/ /'jig rten du byung rjoste zhes pa ni—/ /gcig gi don du ma yin no/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis lung bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /de ni zhes bya ba ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das so—/ /dper na zhes bya ba ni/ sman pa mkhas pa'i dpe'o/ /rjosman pa mkhas pa mchog tu phyin pa zhes bya ba ni/ gcig gi don du ni ma yin no/ /gang gi phyir zhe na sems can gyi don byed pa'i phyir ro/ /gso ba la brtson pa zhes bya ba ni/ yon tan dang ldan pa'o/ /sman pas shes par bya ba bzhin du bslab ⑦pa zhes bya ba ni/ yon tan ni rig pa bslabs pa'o/ /rgyal po gcig gi don du byung ⑧ba ma yin zhes bya ba ni/ rgyal po'i don du ma yin no/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis rgyal srid byed pa'i phyir ro//yang na sems can kyi don byed do/ /yul gcig gi don du byung ⑨ba ma yin pa nas ⑩zhes bya ba ni/ grong dang grong khyen dang grong rdal dang / ljongs rnams su rgyu ba'o/ /sems can gcig gi ⑪zhes bya ba ni/ grong khyer yangs pa can no//rab tu byung zhes bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'o/ /ma yin pa dang 'dra'o zhes bya ba ni/ theg pa chung ngu ma yin pas/ theg pa chen po yin pa'i 36—1055

phyir ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na zhes bya ba ni/ byang chub kyi sems kyis 'khor ba la gnas pa'i sems can rnams 'don pa'o/ /phyogs gang na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams zhes bya ba ni/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams so/ /bzhugs pa'i phyogs de zhes bya ba ni/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na bzhugs pa'o/ /de dag tu zhes bya ba ni/ sems can kyi don no/ /mi rnams dang / mi ma yin pa dag kyang rnam par 'tshe bar mi bya bar sems kyis zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi sems kyis dgongs nas/grong khyer yangs pa can ①gyi don du bzhengs so/ /gang gi phyir zhe na/ mun nag byung ba'i phyir ro/ /nga yang zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'o/ /yangs pa can kyi grong khyer chen po zhes bya ba ni/ zheng dang chu ru dpag tshad lnga bcu'o—/ /rgya che ba yangs pa skye bo mang po'i tshogs 'du ④ba/ 'obs rim ①pa bdun gyis bskor ④ba/ shing ljon pa rnams phyogs phyogs na yod pa/ skyed mos tshal phyogs nas dubargyan pa/ skyed mos tshal re re yang rdzing bu re re dang bcas pa/ rdzing bu'i nang na me tog pad+ma dang / puṇ+ḍa rī buka dang / a la dang / ku mu da la sogs te/ dri zhim po'i me tog skye ba/ chu de yang tsan+dan la sogs pa'i dri zhim pa skye ba/ rdzing bu de rnams kyi nang na/ bya'i tshogs yod pa/ ngang pa dang / ngur pa dang / khrung khrung dang / sa ra sa ⑦la sogs pa yod pa/ skyed 2mos tshal de rnams na ⑨thang las skyes pa'i me tog dri zhim pa dzā ti'i me tog dang ku mu da dang / tsam ⑫pa ka dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po dang / sngon po dang / mthing ga dang /le brgan la sogs pa'i dri zhim po skye ba/ skyed mos tshal gyi 'gram nas 'bras bu 36—1056

can gyi shing skyes pa/ a 'bras kyi shing dang / 'jam 'bras kyi shing dang / star ga ①dang / u nu'i shing dang / se ba dang / rgya'i se ba dang / shug pa dang / rgya shug dang / shing bal po se'u dang / u dusmra ra dang / rgor 'go'i shing ④la sogs pa'i shing yod do/ /grong khyer ①yangs pa can gyi rjophyogs phyogs na mchod rten gyis bskor ba/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos dar ba/ dge slong ngam dge slong ma'am⑤/ dge bsnyen nam dge bsnyen ma'am—/ de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa de bzhin srung ba/ bram ze'am—/ bram ze mo'am/ rgyal bo'am/ rgyal mo'am/ btsun mo'am/rjobatsan mo'am/ rje rigs sam/ dmangs ⑦rigs la sogs pa'am/ skye bo mang po 'dus pa'am/ byol song ngam/ phyugs la sogs pa mang po yod pa/grong khyer chen po yangs pa can no/ /ga la ba der zhes bya ba ni grong gi nang du'o//yangs pa can gyi grong khyer chen po'i skye bo'i tshogs zhes bya ba ni/ lits+tsha bī ⑧la sogs pa'i bram ze'o/ /phal po che'i don yang byas par 'gyur ro zhes bya ba ni/grags pa chen po byung ba'o/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/ mun nag chen po byung ba dang /myu ge ⑫byung ba dang / nad sna tshogs byung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi ⑩mdzad pa yang byas par 'gyur ro zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi don yin no/ /mnyam du dgongs te zhes bya ba ni/ sems can thams cad mnyam pa nyid du bsgom pa'orka/ /de nas zhes bya ba ni mnyam pa nyid du bsgoms pa'i rting ⑪la'o/ /bcom ldan 'das snga dro'i dus kyi tshe zhes bya ba ni nyi ma shar ba'i dus so/ /chos gos dang / sham thabs dang / lhung bzed bsnams te zhes bya ba ni/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das stan las langs te gsil ⑫byed dang lhung bzed 36—1057

thogs nas bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri las ①babs nas grong khyer yangs pa can la kha bltas ②pa'o/ /dge slong nyis brgya lnga bcu dang thabs cig tu zhes bya ba ni/bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa'o/ /bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri las shod du gshegs pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ lha dang lha ma yin la sogs pas ①mchod pa byed pa'o—/ /mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pas lha'i gdugs lnga brgya tsam blangs te zhes bya ba ni lha'i rdzas dang / me tog dang mchod pa la sogs pa 'bul te lha'i bu tshangs pa dang tshangs chen dang / dga' ldan kyi lha'i bu la sogs pas ༄ mchod pa byed pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das la g.yas rol nas phul lo zhes bya ba ni lha dang mi la sogs pa gus pa byas nas 'bul ba'o/ /yang na ni bcom ldan 'das gar gshegs pa'i sar/ lha'i za 'og dang / dar dang / sa gzhi la bting ⑤nas gshegs pa'o/ /phul nas bcom ldan 'das la rdul yab kyis g.yob cing 'dug par gyur to zhes bya ba ni/ dga' ldan kyi lha'i bu dang /tshangs pa dang tshangs chen la sogs pas/ lha rdzas kyi me tog dang dri la sogs pa'i char 'be+ebs pa'o/ /lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis kyang gdugs lnga brgya tsam blangs te zhes bya ba ni/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin nam/ lha'i bu dbang phyug chen po'am/ khyab 'jug gam 'khor dang bcas pas bcom ldan 'das la phul ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das la g.yon rol nas phul lo zhes bya ba ni/sum cu rtsa gsum lha'i bu dang / bu mo rnams kyis kyang phul lo/ /phul nas bcom ldan 'das la rdul yab kyis g.yob cing 'dug par gyur to rjozhes bya ba ni/lha'i za 'og dang dar la sogs pa dog sa la bting ba'o/ /rgyal po chen po bzhis kyang re re zhing lha'i gdugs lnga brgya tsam blangs te zhes bya ba ni/ rgyal 36—1058

chen gyi lha rnams dang lha'i bu mo re re blangs nas phul ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das la snam ①logs nas phul zhes bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi mdun du yin te/me tog gi char phab pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das la rdul yab kyis g.yob cing 'khod par gyur to zhes bya ba ni/ rgyal chen bzhi'i lha'i bu dang ④bu mos lha'i za 'og dang / dar la sogs pa dog sa la bting ba'o/ /lha'i bu dbang phyug dze+echen po la sogs pa buso so nas lha'i gdugs dang zhes bya ba ni/ lha dang lha mo dang gnod sbyin dang gnod sbyin mo la sogs pas so so'i lag nas phul ba'o/ /nyan thos rnams la phul nas zhes bya ba ni sngon du bcom ldan 'das la phul nas/nyan thos rnams la yang bkur ste byas pa'o/ /de lta bu'i grags pa dang bkur ste dang brnyes rjopar bya ba brnyes rjonas zhes bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la'o/ /bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig tu bya rgod phung po'i ri las shod du babs te zhes bya ba ni grong khyer yangs pa can gyi sems can kyi don du'o/ /yangs pa can gyi grong khyer chen po ga la ba der gshegs pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ yangs pa can gyi mi rnams kyis mthong nas/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang rol mo'i tshogs kyis—/ bcom ldan 'das rnams la srun du zhu'o⑦/ /grong khyer yangs pa can gye grong dang / grong bar dang / grong gi phyi rol dang / ba dan dang /rgyal mtshan dang / gdugs dang / me tog gi phreng ba dang / mu tig dang /myu tig gi phreng ba dang / dra ba dang / dra ba phyed pa dang / bsil yab dang / rnga ma ⑧dang / rnga ma ⑨dkar po dang / dar dpyangs dang / bla re dang / dog sa la za 'og dang / dar bting ba dang / grong bar du zur 36—1059

zur ①bkra shis bum pa gang ba yang dag par gzhag sdepa'o/ /yangs pa can gye lits+tsha bī ④rnams kyis zhes bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das shin tu byon pa dga' nas lits+tsha bu'am lipa'i dhichung ma 'am lipa'i pyabu'am bu mo'am/ lipa'i ⑦'khor pho'am—/ 'khor mo'am/ nye bar rnams la dga' ba'i sems dang ldan no/ /sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral ba ni/ dper na mi cig btson du bzung ba dang btson ⑧thon nas sdug bsngal dang bral ba lta bu'o/ /bcom ldan 'das shin tu mdzes pa zhes bya ba ni/ dper na bu mo gzhon nu ma bag mar 'gro ba bcas pa lta bu ste yang na dbyar ka'i nam mkha' la nyi zla shar ba lta bu'o/ /skar ma rnams ni nyan thos la sogs pa lta bu ste/ de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das la mdzes pa'o/ /dad par 'os pa zhes bya ba ni/ dper na bu gces pa tshong la song nas/ yun ring por lon nas ma dang phrad pa lta bu'o/ /dbang po zhi ba zhes bya ba ni/ mu stegs shin tu nga rgyal che ba bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal mthong nas dad pa skyes pa dang 'dra ste/ yang na ni 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang bral ba'o—/ /thugs zhi ba zhes bya ba ni sems mi 'phro ba lta bu'o/ /dbang po dul ba zhes bya ba ni gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya dang bral ba'o/ /thugs dul ba zhes bya ba ni/ brnab sems gnod sems log par lta ba las bral ba'o/ /dul ba dang zhi gnas kyis zhes pa ⑨ni/ nyan thos kyi tshul du ⑩gnas pa'o/ /dam pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa brnyes pa zhes bya ba ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa bcu ste de la sbyin pa ni sems can rnams yongs su 'dzin pa ste de la yang gsum/ zas skom dang nor bu dang / 'bru la sogs pas sems can rnams tshim par byas te/mgu bar byed pa dang / phan skyabs dang dpung gnyen gyis sems can 36—1060

rnams 'jigs skrag las dbugs phyung ste mgu bar byed pa dang don dang yi ge dang brda'i sgo nas sems can rnams nyon mongs pa las grol bar byas te mgu bar byed pa'o/ /tshal khrims ni de dag la mi gnod cing phan par sems pa ste/de la gsum bcas pa dang rang bzhin gtso bo'i sgo nas gzhan las gnod pa las ldog par dam bcas pa'i sems can thams cad dang / pha rol tu phyin pa bcu la sogs pa'i sgo nas dka' bar byed pa'i dam bcas pa'i sems bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la sogs pas ①sems can gyi don byed par dam bcas pa'i sems brtan pa'o/ /bzod pa ni bsran sdebya'i dngos po la mi skrag cing sran tshugs pa sems pa'o/ /de la yang gsum ste/ chos la sems pa'i phyir rtag tu sdug bsngal ba la sran tshugs pa dang / gzhan gyi ①gnod pa byas pa la mi skrag byung sran tshugs pa'i shes pa dang chos nyid stong pa nyid spros rjobral don la mi skrag cing sran tshugs pa'o/ /brtson 'grus ni dge ba la spro ba'i shes pa'o/ /de la yang gsum ste/ bsgrub bya'i dngos po de ltar sgrub par ⑤dam bcas pa'i sems pa rjodang / de nyid nyams su len pa'i sems pa dang / bsgrub bya de nyid mthar ma phyin par mi gtong ba'i sems pa'o/ /bsam gtan ni dmigs pa la rtse gcig pa'o/ /de la yang gsum ste/ mi mthun phyogs kyi bying rgod dngos por yang ma byung la dogs ⑦pa yang yod pa'i tshe spong ba'i sems mnyam pa nyid la rgyun du gzhag⑧ /blan te bzhag pa'i sgo nas mngon par shes pa la sogs pa'i yon tan khyad par can sgrub pa dang / bying rgod byung gi ⑨dogs pa yang yod kyang / dngos su ma byung ba'i sems rnal du ⑩zhugs pa'i skabs dang / bying rgod sems byung yang ma byung gi ⑪dogs pa yang med pa'i sems lhun kyis grub 36—1061

pa'i skabs na lus kyi 'byor pa stod nas me byung smad nas chu brub ①pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas sems can don byed pa'o/ /shes rab ni chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'o/ /de la yang gsum ste/ sgra thos nas rtogs pa dang / rig pa nges pa'i shes rab kyis sgra don la spyad pas don rtogs pa ②de lta bu'i don bsgoms pas blo phul du ①byung ba skyes pa'o/ /thabs ni dge ba chung ngu byas pa yang mi zad par chen por byed pa ste/ rang gi skyon dge ba chen po chung ngur 'gro ba dang / mi zad pa zad par 'gyur ba spong ba dang rang gi dge ba la sems 'jug pa'i thabs shes pa dang / rang gi dge ba'i 'bras bu myur du smin pa'i thabs shes pa'o/ /smon lam ni 'dod pa'i gnas su rang gi dge ba stobs pa'oske/ /de la yang gsum ste/ rang gi dge ba de phyi ma la sogs pa la durgyun mi 'chad par smon cing de yang sems can thams cad kyi don du bsngo ⑤ba dang /bdag gang du skye ba der sems can rnams 'dod chags med pa zhe sdang med par gyur cig ces sems spyong ba dang bdag gang du skye ba der ma btab pa'i lo thog skye ba rjosman dang me tog phun sum tshogs pa'i zhing khams rnam par dag pa thob par gyur cig ces smon lam gdab pa'o/ /stobs ni mi mthun pa'i phyogs zil kyis gnon pa'o/ /de la yang gsum ste/ mi dge ba'i las kyi dbang du mi 'go zhing zil gyis gnon par mi nus shing phar la zil kyis gnon pa dang /bdud dang rgol ba rnams kyis tshur zil gyis gnon ⑦par mi nus la phar ⑧zil gyis gnon pa'o/ /ye shes ni dngos po de shes pa'o/ /de la yang gsum ste/gnyis su snang khyayang mi snang la zhen pa med pa dang snang ni snang la zhen pa med pa dang / nyan thos la sogs pa gang gis 'dul ba dang / de dang der ston pa'o//36—1062
