'du shes kyi phung po/ me'i khams/ lce'i skye mched/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin/mtshon byed ni thabs/ mtshon bya ni shes rab/ de gnyis su med pa'i rang bzhin no/ /de lta bu'i lha mo la gus par ①gyur na/ gang zag de la srung bar byed cing sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /sba ba zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni/ sngar bshad pa bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /tar+ya thā zhes bya ba ni 'di lta ste/ 'og tu blta'o/ /gang blta zhe sden/ klu rnams kyi snying po rig sngags kyi gsang sngags ni/ be+e du ri be+e ④du ri zhes bya ba la sogs pa'o/ /kun dga' bo zhes bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa'o/ /byang phyogs na gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po rnam rjothos kyi bu zhes bya ba ni/ byang phyogs kyi rgyal po lus ngan po yin te/ ri rab kyi rtse mo'i byang phyogs kyi spyog la bzhugs te/byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams skyong ba'o/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa sku mdog ljang gu/ phyag g.yas na ral gri/ g.yon na ne+e'u le'i rkyal dupa bsnams pa'o—/ /rgyan thams cad rin po ches brgyan pa/ pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o—/ /gsus pa che zhing stod chung ba khro bor bzhugs dhipa'o/ / gnod sbyin thams cad kyi bdag po 'khor ⑦gnod sbyin 'bum phrag du ma yod pa zhes bya ba ni/rgyal po chen po lus ngan po gnod sbyin thams cad kyi ⑧ded dpon kyi 'khor rnams so/ /'khor de dag gis btab pa'i mtshan ma ni/ phyi ⑨phyir ldog cing 'jigs par 'gyur/ /smra bar 'gyur zhing tu)khro bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin gnyid kyang log ⑪par 'gyur/ /yang na shin tu khro bar 'gyur/ /rtag ⑫tu gyen du lta bar 'gyur/ /skar ma dag la snyegs par bkyid⑫/ /nub mo shin tu dga' bar 'gyur/ /rtag tu 'dar zhing sgra yang 'byin/ /gnod sbyin gyi 36—1286

rang bzhin yang de ①bzhin no/ /gnod sbyin rnams la dbang byed du 'jug pa gnas te zhes bya ba ni/ gnod sbyin 'bum phrag du ma gnas pa rnams la mnga' mdzad pa/ byang phyogs skyong ba'o/ /gang byang phyogs srung zhing yongs su skyong bar byed pa de yang skezhes bya ba ni/ sa dang po thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten gyi khams byang phyogs skyong bar byed pa/ sems can rnams la gnod par mi byed pa'o/ /bu dang bcas zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni rgyal po lus ngan po bu la sogs pa dang / 'khor rnams kyi bu la sogs pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'dis bdag la srung ba gyis shig ces bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'di yang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ sku mdog ljang gu phyag g.yas na ral gri/ g.yon na rma bya'i sgro bsnams pa'o/ /las kyi rigs bya ba nan tan gyi ④ye shes/ 'du byed kyi phung po rlung gi khams yid kyi skye mched ye shes lnga'i ngo bo nyid/ sangs rgyas lnga'i dbu rgyan can/ spyan gsum pa rgyan thams cad rin po ches brgyan pa/ nyi ma'i gdan dang nyi ma'i 'od dang ldan pa/ de'i 'og na pad+ma'o/ /zhabs phyed krung du bzhugs pa/khro bor bzhugs pa'o/ /gang zag 'di la dad par gyur na/ srung bar 'gyur zhing ma bushi bar bde bar gnas pa'o/ /sba ba la sogs pa zhes bya ba ni/sngar bshad pa bzhin no/ /tar+ya thā zhes bya ba ni 'di lta ste/ gang lta ⑤zhe na 'og tu blta rjob ni gnod sbyin gyi snying po dze+erig sngags kyi gsang sngags ni/ sau ri sau ⑧ri la sogs pa'o/ /shar phyogs na ni yul 'khor srung / /zhes bya ba ni 'bum phrag du ma dri za dang bcas shing / shar phyogs skyong ba'o/ /lho phyogs na ni 'phags skyes po/ /zhes bya ba ni/ grul bum gyi 'khor 'bum phrag du ma 36—1287

dang bcas shing / lho phyogs srung ba'o/ /nub phyogs na ni mig mi bzang / /zhes bya ba ni klu'i 'khor rnams 'bum phrag du ma dang bcas shing / nub phyogs skyong ba'o/ /byang phyogs na ni lus ngan po/ /zhes bya ba ni gnod sbyin gyi 'khor 'bum phrag du ma dang bcas nas byang phyogs srung ba'o/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo ①rma bya chen mo la gus par byed cing srung ba btags na/ rgyal po chen po bzhi 'khor dang bcas nas srung lab dang sba ba la sogs pa byed par 'gyur ro//rgyal po chen po 'di bzhi dag /ces bya ba ni 'khor rgyal po chen po bzhis byas shing / rig sngags kyi rgyal mo gtso bor byas pa'o/ /dog sa sa gzhi ①bzang po la/ /me long rjodabyebs bzhin mkhas pas byas/ /de steng tshon lngas bri ba la//mdzes par byas nas yang dag bri/ /gru bzhi sgo bzhi twa ran bzhi/ /dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma la/ /rig sngags ⑤rgyal mo yang dag bzhugs/ /sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab bzhi la/ /rgyal po bzhi yang bzhugs pa'o/ /de bzhin gser gyi pad+ma la/ /mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi yang dgod/ /sgo bzhi dang ni zur rnams la/ /phyogs skyong bcu yang dgod par bya/ /rdo rje ra ba'i phyi rim la/ /rgyal chen bzhi yi 'khor rnams dgod/ /de bzhin 'byung po la sogs dang / /mkhas pas yang dag bri bar bya/ /rgyal po bzhi'i rjodakyil 'khor gyi bya thabs so/ /de nas bum pa'i bya thabs ni/ /mtshan ma legs pa mgrin pa ring / /nag po ra ri spangs pa dang / /mchu 'phyang lto ba che ba dang / /dar ram ras sam gang yang rung / /mgrin pa yangs par ④bcing bar bya/ /rin chen lnga dang 'bru lnga dang / /sman lnga dri lnga snying po lnga/ /chu gtsang gis ni legs par dgang / /gdugs dang ba dan rgyal mtshan dang / /lo ma lnga dang ldan pa dang / /bkra shis brgyad 36—1288

dang yang dag ldan/ /de rnams kyis ni brgyan nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su yang dag gzhag① /snying po'am nye ba'i snying po 'am/ /de'i sngags kyis bum pa lhag par byed pa'i cho ga byas la/ dkyil 'khor bskyed par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor bskyed pa yang phyis bshad pa bzhin du bya'o/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi'i 'khor gyis/ nad kyis btab pa de sngar bshad pa'i snying po'i sngags kyis bsrung bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du srung ②ba byas na/ rgyal po chen po bzhis kyang 'jig rten skyong zhing nad pa yang skyong bar 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten skyong ba ①grags dang ldan/ /zhes bya ba ni gling bzhi'i ri rab dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams na grags pa'o/ /phyogs bzhi dag ni skyong bar byed/ /ces bya ba ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi rjochos skyong ba byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang po thob nas sems can rnams kyi don mdzad pa'o/ /sde bo che la stobs po che/ /zhes bya ba ni dri za dang grul bum dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / de rnams kyi ded dpon te/ de rnams la che bar mdzad cing 'jig rten la grags pa'i stobs dang ldan pa'o/ /pha rol dgra rnams rab tu 'joms—/ /zhes bya ba ni lha dang lha ma yin gyi yul la pha rol 'dul ba'o/ /gzhan gyis mi thub thub par rjodaka'/ /zhes bya ba ni gzhan 'jig rten gyi lha rnams kyis mi thub pa stobs che ba dang ldan pa'o/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan—/ /zhes bya ba ni stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i rjo'ajig rten gyi khams skad cig mas khyab cing sems can rnams kyi don mdzad pa'o/ /de bzhin du/ kha dog ldan zhing grags dang ldan/ /zhes bya ba ni so so ⑦rang gi kha dog dang dze+eldan zhing / de bzhin grags pa yang yin no/ /rdzu 'phrul che zhing lha min dang / /36—1289

lha yi yul yang myong bar byed/ /ces bya ba ni lha dang lha ma yin kyi spyod pa la yang rtsod par nus shing / pha rol gyi dgra rnams 'dul ba'o/ /de dag gis kyang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'dis bdag la srung ba ①gyis shig ces bya ba ni rgyal po chen po bzhi 'khor bcas dang / gang zag bdag la srung bar byed pa'o—/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'di/ mtshon bya ni shes rab ste tshu mtshon byed ni thabs so/ /rgyal mo bdag nyid do/ /rin po che'i rigs mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ tshor ba'i phung po chu'i khams/ sna'i skye mched ye shes lnga'i ngo bo nyid/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ sku mdog ser mo/ g.yas mthing ga /g.yon dmar ba zhal dang po sgeg snepa/ g.yas khro brjo/ g.yon 'dzum pa/zhal re re la spyan gsum dang ldan pa'o/ /sangs rgyas lnga'i dbu rgyan/ dbu la rin po che'i rdo rjes brgyan pa/ rgyan thams cad rin po ches brgyan pa'o/ /phyag g.yas dang po ral gri/ 'og ma na rdo rje rin po che/ g.yon dang po 'khor lo/ 'og ma na rma bya'i sgro tha ma gnyis na mda' gzhu 'gengs pa'obu/ /zhabs rdo rje skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du zla ba'i gdan/nyi ma bdun dang ldan pa'i 'od mnga' ba/ bcu drug lon pa'i cha byad can thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa gang zag dag dugis gus par byed pa'o/ /sba ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ sdug bsngal thams cad sba ba'o/ /yongs su bskyab pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las bskyab ⑦pa'o/ /yongs su gzung blab dang zhes bya ba ni mi dge ⑨bcu spangs nas dge ba bcu la gzud pa'o⑪//yongs su bskyang ba dang zhes bya ba ni ma rig pa bcom nas yon tan skyong ⑩ba'o/ /zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal zhi 36—1290

bar 'gyur te/ yang dag pa'i don thob nas mtho ris kyi ngo bo nyid thob pa'o /chad pa spang ba dang zhes bya ba ni bdud bzhi rnams kyi chad pa spangs nas ye shes shar ba'o/ /mtshon cha spang ba ①dang zhes bya ba ni dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal ⑧mtshon cha spang ba'o/ /dug gzhil ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ dug lnga shar ba la des bsil bar byed pa'o/ /dug gsad ①pa dang zhes bya ba ni ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyis dug lnga gsad dupa'o/ /mtshams gcad rjopa dang zhes bya ba ni/ ma rig pa'i ngo bo bsad nas/ ye shes kyi ngo bo la 'jug pa'o/ /sa bcing ba gyis shig ces bya ba ni/ sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dge ba la 'jug pa'o—/ /lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig ces bya ba ni/ rig sngags 'di'i gzi brjid kyis nad med cing shi ba'i dus kyis mi gos rjopa'o/ /ston brgya mthong bar shog shig ces bya ba ni/ ye shes des sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad pa'o / /tar+ya thā zhes bya ba ni/ 'di lta ste gang lta ⑦zhe na rig sngags kyi gsang sngags bsam gyis mi khyab pa blta'o/ /rig sngags kyi gsang sngags ni/ e ⑧le me le la sogs pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo'i rgyal po bzhi'i cho ga'i gnas skabs te brgyad pa'o // //⑨kun dga' bo zhes bya ba ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas kun dga' bo la yang nas yang du bka' stsal pa'o/ /khyod kyis gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po rnams kyi ming zung shig ces bya ba ni/ lus ngan po'i bu bzhi po'i ⑩ming brjod cing / sems can rnams la yang dag par bsrung ste/'di'i nus pas gnod sbyin chen po de rnams kyis kyang gang dang gang du srung bar 36—1291

byed pa'o/ /'di lta ste zhes bya ba ni 'og tu blta'o①/ /'og tu gang blta zhe na/gnod sbyin gyi ded dpon chen po lnga po ⑤blta ba'o/ /lus ngan gyi ni ①bu thu bo/ /zhes bya ba ni mergyal po chen po lus ngan pa'i rjobu chen po lnga po de dag sterjo/ gzi brjid che zhing stobs dang ldan/ grags pa dang ⑦ldan pa/ kha dog dang ldan pa—/ lha dang lha min kyi g.yul yang bkye ⑧ba'o/ /kun du rgyal ba mi la zhon/ /phrugs su ldan na gnas pa ste/ /lha yi stibaden pa gsol ba'o/ /zhes bya ba ni de'i kha dog ni dkar po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / lngang gu dang / nag po dang / de rnams ni zhal re re phyag gnyis gnyis so/ /phyag g.yas rnams na 'khor lo dang mdung dang dgra sta dang / rtse gcig dang lcags kyu bsnams pa'o/ /phyag g.yon pa rnams na rin po che'i myu gu bsnams pa/gnod sbyin de rnams ⑩ni sems can gyi don mdzad cing / srog chags rnams la gnod pa mi byed pa'o/ /kun du rgyal ba dang / mi la zhon pa gnyis ni shar dang lho skyong ba'o/ /phrugs su ldan na gnas pa ste/ lcang lo can gyi pho brang na gnas pa lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyi bka' las mi 'da' ba yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi bstan pa srung ba/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'di / rjes su dran zhing rig sngags la gus par byas pa'o/ /kun du rgyal dang mi la zhon gnyis kyis kyang nub phyogs dang byang phyogs skyong ba'o/ /sor mo lnga pas ni lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyi pho brang skyong ba'o/ /des kyang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'dis bdag la srung ⑪ba gyis shig ces bya ba ni/ srung ⑫/ba dang / rjes su yi rang ba dang / klog pa dang / kha don byed pa dang /rgya cher spel ba dang / gus par byas nas 'chang ba dang / bsgom pa dang /36—1292

tshig gcig kyang 'don par gyur na/ tshe 'dir ①yang gnod sbyin de rnams kyis srung ④bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe phyi ma la yang srung snebar 'gyur ro/ /'di'i gnyen po'i rig sngags ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ sgu mdog ljang gu las kyi rigs bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes 'du byed kyi phung po rlung gi khams lus kyi rjoskye mched/ye shes lnga'i ngo bo nyid spyan gsum pa cud zad khro ba rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan can yan lag thams cad sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ g.yas na sna tshogs rdo rje bsnams pa⑤/g.yon pa na rma bya'i sgro bsnams pa'o/ /rma bya la zhon pa'orjo/ /de lta bu'i rig sngags la gang zag gis dze+egus par byas na gnod sbyin de rnams kyis kyang skyong ba'o//sba ba la sogs pa zhes bya ba ni snga ma bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /tar+ya thā zhes bya ba ni 'di lta ste/ rig sngags kyi gsang sngags gnod sbyin kyi snying po ni/ ba le ba le ⑧la sogs pa'o/ /skya snar bu na 'khor ba 'jig /ces bya ba ni gnas ni skya snar bu/ gnod sbyin ni 'khor ba 'jig go/ /de yang 'dzam bu'i gling gi lho phyogs na gnas so/ /phyag gnyis pa sku mdog dkar po g.yas 'khor lo—/ g.yon sdigs mdzub ⑨bo/ /gzhan gyis mi thub dka' ⑩ba na/ /zhes bya ba ni yul ni rgya gar gyi nub phyogs yin te/ gnod sbyin gzhan gyis mi thub pa ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ sku mdog ser po/ g.yas ral gri g.yon thod pa'o/ /grong khyer bzang na gnod sbyin brag /ces bya ba ni de ni gnas yin te/ gnod sbyin gyi sku mdog ni mthing nag /g.yas g.yon gnyis ni ⑪gri gug dang thod pa bsnams pa'o/ /shed kyi bu ni byang phyogs na/ /zhes bya ba ni ri rab kyi byang phyogs na sgra mi snyan na gnas pa stobs dang ldan pa/ gzi brjid che ba'o/ /de'i kha dog ni/ gser dang 'dra ba/ g.yas na dbyug to g.yon 36—1293

na pad+ma bsnams pa'o/ /lag na rdo rje rgyal po'i khab/ /ces bya ba rgo rgya gar gyi yul grong khyer dbus na rgyal po'i khab kyi lho phyogs na gnas pa'o/ /sku mdog mthing ga /g.yas ①rdo rje g.yon sdigs ⑤mdzub bo/ /bya rgod phung por rduganas bcas pa/ /zhes bya ba ni gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje ni/ pho brang bya rgod phung por byas nas khams gsum du skad cig mas rgyu ba'o/ /rgya mtsho'i mtha' yi bar kyi sar/ /lan gsum bar du 'go byed pa/ /zhes bya ba ni rgya rjomatsho dang bya rgod phung po gnyis la/ lan gsum gsum rgyu ba'o/ /skad cig mas 'dzam bu'i gling bar nas rgyu rjoba'o/ /stobs che zhing ni gzi brjid che/ /dpag tshad bcur ⑥ni rnam par gnon/ /zhes bya ba ni gzhan gyi stobs dang 'gran ⑦par mi nus pa/ gzi brjid kyang de bzhin no/ /lus kyi tshad ni dpag tshad bcur sprul pa'o/ /gnod sbyin mkha' lding rgyas pa naske/ /zhes bya ba ni rgyu ba ni nam mkha' la rgyu ba ste/ gnas pa ⑨ni ma la ya'i ⑩rtse mo na'o/ /gzugs bya dang 'dra ba lus ser po gshog pa nag po/ mjug ma yang nag po/ mchu sngon po ring ba/ lag pa dang rkang pa sder mo ring ba mig ser ba/ g.yas g.yon gnyis na ⑪sbrul za ba'o/ /skad cig mas ⑫dpag tshad ⑫lnga brgyar 'phur nus pa'o—/ /sna tshogs sbed pa gnas sgo na/ /zhes bya ba ni de yang 'dzam bu gling gi lho phyogs na gnas sgo zhes bya ba'i yul na'o/ /gnod sbyin de'i sku mdog ni/shin tu dmar ba/ khro ba'i ④tshul du yod pa/ phyag g.yas g.yon gnyis na mda' gzhu bsnams pa'o/ /gnod sbyin ba ku la'i ⑫rgyal khab na/ /zhes bya ba ni gnas ni rgyal po'i khab kyi dbus na'o/ /sku mdog ni ljang gu'o/ /bzhin mi sdug pa/ gzugs thung ba/ phyag g.yas g.yon gnyis na nor gye ⑩rkyal pa 36—1294

'dzin pa'o/ /sde bo che la stobs po che/ /zhes bya ba ni ba ku la ni 'khor mang po yod pa/ gzi brjid dang ldan pa/ kha dog dang ldan pa'o/ /gnod sbyin nag po nye nag po/ /ser skya yi ni gnas na gnas/ /zhes bya ba ni chu bo gaṅgā'i 'gram shar phyogs na gnas pa'o/ /gnod sbyin nag po nye nag po/ /de bas kyang nag pas nye nag po/ /gnod sbyin de gnyis kyang phyag gnyis gnyis/g.yas pa na rin po che 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon ne+e'u le'i rkyal pa bsnams pa'o/ /thub pa chen po shākya'i tog① /sangs rgyas thub pa gar bltams ②par/ /zhes bya ba ni rgya gar yul rmi dbus chu bo gaṅgā'i lho phyogs na/ der sangs rgyas gnas pa'o—/ /phyag gnyis sku mdog gser kyi mdog can rab tu byung ba'i gzugs su bzhugs pa'o/ /rkang bkra bo ni dgra can la/ /zhes bya ba ni rgya gar gyi yul kyi dbus / lho nub kyi mtshams na'o/ /gnod sbyin de'i sku mdog dang phyag mdzan ni/ sku mdog mthing ga /g.yas g.yon gnyis rtse gcig dang / dung bsnams ①pa'o/ / tsi ra rjota na dbang phyug che/ /zhes bya ba ni 'dzam bu gling gi nub phyogs na gnas te/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ sku mdog sngo skya phyag g.yas pa gnyis na phreng ba dang bum pa/ g.yon pa gnyis na tri byu dhil dang a 'bras bsnams pa'o/ /spyan gsum pa ral pa'i thor tshugs can no/ /mnyan yod na ni phur bu'o/ /zhes bya ba ni rgya gar yul gyi dbus kyi grong khyer na/rgyal bu mgon med mdun duna'o/ /gnod sbyin phur bu ni/ sku mdog dkar po/g.yas g.yon gnyis na mda' gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /gnas bcas na ④ni rgya mtsho ④gnas—/ /zhes bya ba ni gnod sbyin rgya mtsho ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis te/ sku mdog dkar po sbrul gyi zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /yangs pa can na rdo rje mtshon//④36—1295

zhes bya ba ni rgya gar yul gyi dbus kyi grong khyer na gnas pa'o/ /sku mdog ser po rin po che'i phreng ba 'dzin pa'o/ /spre'u ltar dmar ser gyod ①yul na/ /zhes bya ba ni rgya gar kyi phyogs ④ngos na yin te/ gnod sbyin de ni sku mdog dmar po/ phyag na gtun shing 'dzin pa'o/ / wā rā ṇa sīr ④nag po che/ /zhes bya ba ni de yang 'dzam bu'i rjogling gi dbus rjochu bo gaṅgā'i 'gram na'o/ /gnod sbyin nag po chen po ni zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ sku mdog mthing nag spyan gsum pa'o/ /g.yas pa gsum na ral gri gri gug rtse gsum mo/ /g.yon pa gsum na tsan+dan gyi be+e con dang thod pa zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /blta na sdug pa tsam pa na zhes bya ba na rjoni/ rgya gar yul shar phyogs na shin tu byad mtshar ba gnod sbyin blta na sdug gi gnas so/ /sku mdog dkar po phyag na pad+ma bsnams pa'o/ /gnod sbyin khyab 'jug sgo can na/ /zhes bya ba ni phyi'i rgya mtsho'i 'gram mo/ /sku mdog ljang nag phyag bzhi pa g.yas pa gnyis na/'khor lo dang / a 'bras/ g.yon pa gnyis dbyug to dang / dung bsnams pa'o/ /'dzin pa po ni sgo drung ⑦na/ /zhes bya ba ni de yang rgya mtsho'i 'gram na yin te/ sku mdog ser po phyag g.yas g.yon gnyis na/ ut+pa la'i phreng ba 'dzin pa'o/ /'jigs byed zangs kyi 'dab ma canasge/ /zhes bya ba ni lho nub kyi mtshams rgya mtsho'i 'gram na'o/ /sku mdog dmar skya g.yas ral gri/g.yon sdigs mdzub ⑨bo/ /brang gis ⑩'gro na 'joms pa po/ /zhes bya ba yin te⑪/ rgya gar gyi byang ngos na'o/ /gnod sbyin dmar skya phyag na rtse gsum bsnams pa'o/ /'brog na gnod sbyin 'brog gnas po⑫/ /zhes bya ba ni 'dzam bu'i ⑫gling gi thang stong rnams la gnas pa/ sku mdog nag po phyag 36—1296

g.yas na ral gri/ g.yon na zhags pa'o/ /ser skya bo ①ni 'bru mangs na/ /zhes bya ba ni de yang rgya gar yul gyi dbus su/ gnod sbyin mdog ser skya/phyag na dbyug to bsnams pa'o/ /'phags rgyal na ni nor srung ba/ /zhes bya ba ni 'dzam bu'i ①gling gi dbus su'o/ /gnod sbyin sku mdog ser po phyag drug pa g.yas pa gsum ni phyag 'tshal ba dang / nor gyi snye ma dang / mchod sbyin no / /g.yon pa gsum na po ti dang / 'bras kyi snye ma dang bum pa'o/ /srung byed na ni nor 'byor pa/ /zhes bya ba ni yul de'i lho phyogs na'o/ / gnod sbyin ④sku mdog ser po g.yas na rin po che'i bum pa bsnams parjo/g.yon na gser ⑤gyi bum pa bsnams pa'o/ /gso ba'i mtha' na gso ba parjo/ /zhes bya ba ni nub kyi phyogs na gnas te/ gnod sbyin gso ba po ni/ sku mdog ljang gu phyag na ne+e'u le bsnams pa'o/ /dga' bo nye dga' grong khyer gnas—/ /zhes bya ba ni yul dbus na'o/ /de gnyis kyang sku mdog ser po/sbrul gyi zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /phreng ba 'dzin pa khyu ⑦mchog na/ /zhes bya ba ni de yang 'dzam bu'i ⑧gling gi dbus na gnas te/ gnod sbyin gyi kha dog ni dmar po phyag na gser gyi phreng ba 'dzin pa'o/ /kun dga' ⑨'chi med sa zhag na6/—/ /zhes bya ba ni 'dzam bu'i gling gi shar phyogs na'o/ /sku mdog ser po phyag na rdo rje bsnams pa'o/ /mche ba dkar ba dngos ⑪bzang na/ /zhes bya ba ni ri rab kyi shar phyogs na gnod sbyin mche ba can gnas te/ sku mdog dkar po/ phyag g.yas ⑫na 'khor lo bsnams pa'o/ / me brtan ⑫pa ni gzi can na④/ /zhes bya ba ni rgya mtsho'i bar na gnas pa ste/ gnod sbyin gyi kha dog ni mthing nag tu yod pa/ phyag na lcags kyu bsnams pa'o/ /rin chen 36—1297

ri ldan grong khyer na/ /zhes bya ba ni ri bo chen po'i bar na grong khyer blta ①na sdug gi dbus na/ rnam par rgyal ba'i gzhal yas khang gi srung ma'o/ /gnod sbyin de ni stobs dang ldan pa/ gzi brjid che ba'o/ /de'i sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni sku mdog nag po/ g.yas na gri gug g.yon na thod pa bsnams pa'o/ /nor gyi bu ni phyogs mtshams gnas④/ /zhes bya ba ni gnod sbyin rnam ①thos kyi bu yin te ri rab kyi phyogs mtshams na gnas pa'o/ /sku mdog ser po/g.yas na rin po che'i myu gu/ g.yon na bum pa bsnams pa'o/ /smin drug bu ni gzhon nu zhes/ /'jig rten grags pa skye yod na/ /zhes bya ba ni gnod sbyin de ni sku mdog dmar po'o/ /g.yas na rtse gcig /g.yon duphreng ba 'dzin pa'o/ /de'i 'og ma'i gnod sbyin ni thal ba'i mdog can lcags kyu 'dzin pa'o/ /'od ⑤ma'i 'gram na lag brgya pa/ /zhes bya ba ni rdo rje gdan gyi lho phyogs nags gseb na'o/ /gnod sbyin shin tu 'jigs pa sku mdog dmar skya/ phyag na dgra sta bsnams pa'o/ /ka liṅka na shing rta che/ /zhes bya ba ni rgya gar yul gyi lho phyogs so/ /gnod sbyin de'i sku mdog ni dkar po phyag na rtse gsum bsnams pa'o/ /thul bar dka' ni 'gro 'joms na/ /zhes bya ba ni de yang dbus kyi nub phyogs su'orjo/ /kha dog ser po phyag na bum pa dang (7 bil ba bsnams pa'o/ /srid sgrub nags na srid sgrub pa/ /zhes bya ba ni dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal gyi nags na'o/ /gnod sbyin de'i sku mdog ni sngo skya phyag na dbyug to bsnams pa'o/ /gnod sbyin 'joms pa 'dun sgekhang na/ /zhes bya ba ni rgya gar yul gyi byang shar mtshams na gnas so/ /gnod sbyin gyi sku mdog ni ser skya ste/ gser gyi rgyal ⑨bu 'dzin pa'o/ /phreng ba srung na ri brtsegs( 36—1298

pa—/ /zhes bya ba ni gser gyi ri rab kyi steng gi byang phyogs na gnas pa'o/ /gnod sbyin mdog ser po lag na phreng ba 'dzin pa'o/ /rta dmar na rgo bzang po pa / /zhes bya ba ni de yang dar cig gi yul yin te/ gnod sbyin ①sku mdog dmar po phyag na lcags kyu dang zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /ma rdzogs pa ni thams cad bzang / /zhes bya ba ni yul de yang rgya nag po'i byang phyogs na mi nyag ces bya'osne—/ /de na gnod sbyin de gnas te/ /gnod sbyin de'i sku mdog phyag mtshan ni g.yas na 'bras kyi snye ma 'dzin pa/ g.yon na nor kyi rkyal pa 'dzin pa'o—/ /snyems pa can na skyong ba po/ /zhes bya ba ni ①rgya nag po'i shar phyogs na gnas te/ de yang khri stan gyi yul na'o/ /de na gnas pa'i gnod sbyin gyi phyag mtshan ni/ g.yas na ral gri 'dzin pa/ g.yon na nor kyi bum pa bsnams pa'o/ /ded dpon nor gyi dbang phyug go/ /zhes bya ba ni gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon ni rnam thos ④sras yin te/ nor gyi dbang gis rnam thos kyi yang ded dpon no/ /ma rgyal rgyal na mche ba gcigs/ /zhes bya ba ni rgya nag po'i yul na gnas pa ste/ de ni rgya nag po'i srung mar 'gyur zhing khrims rnams gnod sbyin des byas pa'o/ /de'i sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/ g.yas dbyug to g.yon na ⑤zhags pa'o/ /kha dog ni dmar nag go/ /gnas bcas na ni nor bzang po/ /zhes bya ba ni de yang lcang lo can gyi gnas na gnas la/gnod sbyin de'i sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/ sku mdog dkar po g.yas na rin po che'i snod/ g.yon na gser gyi myu gu'o/ /zhi ba zhi ba'i grong len na/ /zhes bya ba ni de ni bal yul gyi gnas yin no/ /gnod sbyin ni zhal bzhi pa/phyag brgyad pa sku mdog dkar po dang sngo skya dang ljang gu dang mthing nag tu gnas 36—1299

pa'o—/ /phyag g.yas g.yon gnyis na phreng ba dang skyabs sbyin/ yang g.yas g.yon gnyis na rtse gsum dang phreng ba/ de'i 'og gnyis na 'khor lo dang dbyug to'o①/ /tha ma gnyis na rtse gsum dang thod pa'o/ /zhi ba bzang po 'jigs byed na④/ /zhes bya ba ni mtsho ma dros ⑧kyi byang ngos na'o/ /gangs kyi ri na yod pa ste/ gnod sbyin de ni yab yum du bcas pa sku dumadog ser po/g.yas kyi phyag na tri shu bul/ g.yon na phreng ba bsnams pa'o/ /yum gyi phyag na a la bsnams pa'o/ /gnod sbyin dbang po dbang rjogrong na/ /zhes bya ba ni ri rab kyi rtse mo pho brang blta ⑦na sdug pa na'o/ /gnod sbyin de ni rdo rje 'dzin pa/sku mdog ser po'o/ /me tog tog ni rdo grong na⑧/ /zhes bya ba ni de ni 4dpal gyi ri na gnas te/ gnod sbyin de ni gzi brjid che zhing stobs dang ldan pa'o—/ /phyag g.yas na phreng ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon na bum pa bsnams pa'o/ /kha dog dkar po'o/ /shing pa shing gi gong khyer na/ /zhes bya ba ni de yang ri ma la ya na yod pa ste/ de ni tsan+dan kyi shing gi bsung ba'o⑩/ /gnod sbyin de'i sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/ mdog sngo bsangs su yod pa/ phyag g.yas na ral gri yod pa/ g.yon na phreng ba bsnams pa'o/ /kha dog can ni ser skyar gnas/ /zhes bya ba ni yul bod yul na bzhugs te⑪/ bod yul dbus na'o/ /gnod sbyin de ni g.yas na 'khor lo/ g.yon na gshol mda' 'dzin pa'o/ /sku mdog ljang gur gnas pa'o/ /nor bu bzang dang gang ba bzang / /zhes bya ba ni rnam thos sras kyi 'khor pho brang lcang lo can na gnas pa'o/ /de gnyis kyi ⑫sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni kha dog ser po dang /dkar po'o/ /g.yas rnams na rin po che'i myu gu dang nor gyis gang ba'i bum 36—1300

pa'o—/ /g.yon rnams na nor gyi rkyal pa dang 'bru sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa'o/ /srun gnyis tshangs pa ldan pa'o/ /①zhes bya ba ni nor bu bzang khrudang gang ba bzang ①gnyis te/ gzi brjid che zhing nor phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /ba lang 'dzin na 'joms pa po/ /zhes bya ba ni gnas bal yul gyi byang ngos yin te/ gnod sbyin de ni shin tu khro zhing gdug pha'orjo/ /phyag g.yas g.yon gnyis na tri shu mel dang dgra sta 'dzin pa/ kha dog nag po'o//rab tu 'joms pa rdo 'jog narjo/ /zhes bya ba ni de'i lho phyogs na yod de/shin tu stobs che zhing sems can rnams la gnod pa byed pa'o/ /de'i kha dog ni ljang gur yod pa/ bzhin mi sdug pa/ g.yas ral gri g.yon zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /gnod sbyin chen po bod srung ⑦sel/ /zhes bya ba ni bod yul du ༄she/gnas te/ gnod sbyin de yang srung ma la dga' zhing gnas pa g.yas na dgra ⑨sta g.yon na ⑩zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /kha dog thal ba'i mdog can no/ /sgyugs pa yi ni ri la gnas/ /zhes bya ba ni 'dzam bu'i ⑪gling gi lho phyogs na gnas pa stobs po che la gzi brjid ldan de'i kha dog phyag mtshan ni/ kha dog dmar po gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /gsum sbas 'gram pa ldan dogs ⑫na—/ /zhes bya ba ni laṅka'i lho phyogs na rgya mtsho'i 'gram na'o/ /gnod sbyin de ni gdong dmar po spre'u'i gzugs su yod pa'o/ /g.yas pa khu tshur g.yon sdigs ⑫mdzub bo/ /ho ⑫nu na ni 'od byed pa/ /zhes bya ba ni laṅka'i nub phyogs na rgya mtsho'i bar na'o/ /gnod sbyin mdog ser po/ g.yas na a so ka'i shing thogs pa/ g.yon na zhags pa thogs pa'o/ /dga' ba can dang 'phel byed pa/ /zhes bya ba ni yul ma ga dhā'i ⑫lho nub mtshams na gnas pa'o/ /36—1301

gnod sbyin de ni rdo rje 'dzin cing kha dog mthing gar gnas pa'o/ /dga' ba 'phel byed gong khyer na/ /zhes bya ba ni de'i shar phyogs na gnod sbyin zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas na nor gyi rkyal bu ①bsnams pa g.yon na sbrul gyi zhags pa/ kha dog ljang gu'o/ /rlung gi sa na rlung ldan pa/ /zhes bya ba ni 'dzam bu gling gi chu klung gang na yod pa'i sa na yod de/ skad cig mas khyab cing chu klung gang na yod par mnga' mdzad pa/ de'i sku mdog phyag mtshan ni/phyag g.yas na dbyug to 'dzin pa/ g.yon sdigs mdzub po/ /kha dog khra bor yod pa/ smad sbrul du yod pa'o/ /'phyang bar gyur ⑤na 'thab dga' ba/ /zhes bya ba ni de yang rgya nag po'i ④nub phyogs na grong khyer rtsod ka na'o/ /gnod sbyin zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa sku mdog dmar po g.yas na ral gri g.yon zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /'og ma gnyis na mda' gzhu 'gengs pa'o/ /gnod sbyin des skad cig mas khyab nas/ rtsod pa'i sems dang ldan par byed pa'o—/ /bcom brlag na ni bong rjobu pa/ /zhes bya ba ni yul laṅka ni ⑤rgya mtsho'i 'gram na yod pa/ shin tu 'jigs pa'i tshul can sems can la gnod cing ⑥sha khrag za ba/ de'i kha dog ni dmar nag go/ /phyag na sbrul gyi zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /laṅka na ni bum pa'i lto/ /zhes bya ba ni 'dzam bu gling gi lho nub mtshams yin te/ gzugs ni dpag tshad bcu yod pa/ shin tu gnag la 'jigs ⑦ pa laṅka'i bdag po'i nu bo/ske phyag brgyad yod pa g.yas na ral gri/bar pa gnyis 'khor lo dang shat+ta/ tha ma na mda'/ g.yon dang po na zhags pa 'phang ⑨mdung dgra sta rtse gsum mo/ /gnod sbyin de ni stobs che ba ri rab tsam sgul ⑩ba'o/ /gnod sbyin nyi 'od rab nyams na/ /zhes bya ba ni nam 36—1302

mkha' la rgyu ba nyi ma'i 'od bzhin du/ 'jig rten gyi khams khyab pa gzi brjid che ba/ de'i kha dog ni dmar po/ phyag g.yas g.yon na dung dang pad+ma dmar po bsnams pa'o/ /skad cig mas 'jig rten gyi khams rgyu ba'o/ /ko sa la ni ri mgo bo/ /zhes bya ba ni yul ma ga dhā'i ①lho phyogs na gnod sbyin stobs ldan yod de/ 'od nyi ma shar ba dang 'dra ba/ shin tu dmar ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ba'o/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas 'khor lo g.yon ②zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /rnam par rgyal dang rnam rgyal ldan/ /zhes bya ba ni gnod sbyin de yang pham par mi 'gyur zhing / gzhan rnams kyis mi thub pa'o/ /dkar po bcom brlag yul na gnas/ /zhes bya ba ni gnod sbyin de ni srun lnga gnas te/ dpag tshad ring dang 'jigs pa dang rna ba can dang gzugs can dang bum sna loske/ de rnams kyi kha dog ni dkar po dang / nag po dang /ser po dang / dmar po dang / ljang gu'o/ /phyag mtshan rgo 'khor lo dang /dbyug to dang / mda' gzhu dang / 'phang mdung dang / mdung rings burnams so/ /gnod sbyin gang ba ma la yar/ /zhes bya ba ni ma ga dhā'i rjolho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram na ri bo ma la ya na de'i mnga' bdag tu mdzad pa kha dog dkar po/ phyag na tsan+dan gyi be+e con 'dzin pa'o/ /ti se dugangs na mi 'am ci /zhes bya ba ni mda' stod na gnas te gnod sbyin rta mgo can gnas pa/ kha dog dmar po dbyug to 'dzin pa'ospyo/ /sprin gyi phreng can podh+wa ⑤na/ /zhes bya ba ni li yul na gnas pa ste/ gnod sbyin sprin gyi mgo can/ phyag na nyi ma dang zla ba bsnams pa'o/ /rab tu gnas na dum ⑨bu pa/ /zhes bya ba ni de yang u rgyan na gnas pa ste/ gnod sbyin de'i kha dog ni dkar po phyag g.yas g.yon 36—1303

gnyis na gri gug dang thod pa bsnams pa'o/ /pi taṅka l+yar ①yang dag byed/ /ces bya ba ni bod yul dbus ④chu shar nas nub tu 'bab pa'i sa na gnas te/gnod sbyin de ni kha dog dmar nag /lag pa gnyis na tsan+dan gyi be+e con 'dzin pa'o—/ /de'i sa phyogs kyi srung ④mar grags pa'o/ /rlabs dang ldan na bde byed pa/ /zhes bya ba ni gnod sbyin de sems can rnams kyis bsgrubs par gyur na—/ mthu dang ldan zhing dngos grub ster ba'o/ /sna nas byung na rjoganod sbyin mdzes—/ /zhes bya ba ni bod yul dbus chu shar phyogs su 'bab pa'i sa chu klung byang nas lhor 'bab pa ⑤de'i mdo na gnas pa'o/ /skad cig mas 'jig rten khams rgyu nus pa/ dang po shar phyogs nas byung nas/ rab tu byung ba'i tshul du gnas pa/ de ni sems can rnams la gnod pa drag po byed pa ste/gnas de'i srung rjomar gnas pa'o/ /gso ba'i mtha' na ma chags pa/ /zhes bya ba ni de'i byang ngos na gnod sbyin kha dog dkar po can yod de/ de yang sa bdag gi tshul du yod pa/ de bas kyang skad cig mas 'jig rten khams rgyu nus paske/ kha dog dkar po sbrul zhags 'dzin pa'o/ /dga' byed de ni pha dga' ba—/ /zhes bya ba ni de ni khams kyi yul na gnas te/ de yang pha spad ④du yod pa/ sems can rnams la phan 'dogs pa/ de grub par gyur na phyug por 'gyur ro/ /de gnyis kyi kha dog ni sgenag po dang ser po gnyis kas nor gyi rkyal pa bsnams pa'o/ /dpa' dang gser kyi lag pa dang / /zhes bya ba ni rgya gar gyi yul lho phyogs na gnas pa'o/ /shin tu stobs dang ldan pa/ gzhan rnams kyis mi thub/ gser gyi mdog can gser gyi bum pa gang ba bsnams pa'o//ka liṅka na lto 'phyang po/ /zhes bya ba ni de yang rgya gar yul gyi dbus kyi lho phyogs 36—1304

na gnod sbyin kha dog nag po phyag na 'khor lo bsnams pa'o/ /ko sa la na nag po che/ /zhes bya ba ni yul ma ga dhā ①na yin te/ gnod sbyin nag po chen po yin te de yang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa sku mdog nag po g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa bsnams ④pa'o/ /dge ba dge ba'i pho brang na/ /zhes bya ba ni de yang rgya gar gyi dbus na'o/ /gnod sbyin dge ba ni sems can rnams la gnod pa mi byed sdig pa mi byed cing dge ba la gnas pa'o/ /de ni dge ba'i sems kyis me tog gi snod 'dzin pa kha dog dkar po'o/ /wā rā ṇa sīr ④skyong ba po/ /zhes bya ba ni rgya gar yul kyi dbus wā rā ṇa sī dhin gnod sbyin kha dog dmar po dbyug to dang zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /'gram ldan phung por rna ba bzang / /zhes bya ba ni bod yul rtsang rjon gnas pa ste/ gnod sbyin de yang rna ba che ba bum 0lto kha dog nag pa⑦/ g.yas na nor gyi bum pa/ g.yon na ne+e'u le'i rkyal pa bsnams pa'o/ /grong khyer drug na nor gzhan po/ /zhes bya ba ni grong khyer yangs pa can dang ka liṅka dang / rgyal po'i khab dang / mnyan yod dang / wā rā ṇa sī ⑧dang / tsam pa ka dang drug la skad cig mas rgyu ba'o/ /shin tu stobs dang ldan zhing yul de'i srung mar gyur pa/ kha dog gser gyi kha dog can g.yas na rin po che'i myu gu/ g.yon na bum pa bsnams pa'o⑨/ /gnod sbyin stobs can mtha' ma na/ /zhes bya ba ni de yang bal yul gyi mtha' khob ⑫na gnas te/ sems can la gnod pa byed pa kha dog nag po sbrul gyi zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /srung ⑪ba can na mthong dga' ba/ /zhes bya ba ni 'brog gnas thang stong rnams la gnas te/ sems can la dga' bar byed pa'o/ /kha dog sngo bsangs su yod pa/ phyag na bum pa bsnams pa'o/ /ba lang 'joms na 36—1305

gtsug ①phud can/ /zhes bya ba ni ri rab kyi nub phyogs kyi gling na gnas pa'o/ /kha dog dmar po pad+ma dang nor gyi rkyal pa 'dzin pa'o/ /phyogs mtshalas na ni thal mo dga'/ /zhes bya ba ni gling bar bzhi na gnas pa ste/ gnod sbyin de yang skad cig mas rgyu zhing gling rnams khyab pa'o/ /de ni mdog nag pa ②'khor lo mda' gzhu bsnams pa'o/ /gdugs 'dra na ni dkris pa po①/ /zhes bya ba ni de yang yul dbus na'o/ /gnod sbyin kha dog dkar po phyag na gdugs bsnams pa'o/ /grong khyer gsum na chu srin 'dul/ /zhes bya ba ni yangs pa can dang / mnyan yod dang rgyal po'i khab dang rjogasum mo/ /de la res rgyu zhing stobs dang ldan pa'o/ /zhal gsum phyag drug pa sku mdog nag po/g.yas pa rnams na gri gug dang ral gri rtse gsum mo/ /g.yon rnams na thod pa zhags pa dgra sta'o/ /de gsum ni ⑤grong khyer gyi rjosrung ma'o/ /tshang tshing gcig ⑦na mig yangs pa/ /zhes bya ba ni bal yul gyi mthil na gnas pa ste gnod sbyin mig gcig tu gnas pa sa bdag gi rigs kha dog nag ⑧po zhags pa nag po dang sbrul zhags bsnams pa'o/ /u dusmra rar ⑨sgo nga'i 'od/ /ces bya ba ni rgya gar shar phyogs na'o/ /gnod sbyin de ni mdog dkar po me tog pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /kau shāshrī ⑩na lhun kyis grub/ /ces bya ba ni gong khyer chen po lho phyogs na gnod sbyin kha dog ser po phyag g.yas na shing thog g.yon rgo'u le bsnams pa'o/ /rnam par snang byed zhing ldan na/ /zhes bya ba ni shar phyogs kyi gling na gnas pa gnod sbyin de mdog dkar po 'khor lo 'dzin pa'o/ /sbrul kyi gdugs na dga' ba po/ /zhes bya ba ni rgya gar yul gyi nub ngos na ⑪sbrul yul na gnod sbyin de yang sbrul gyi gdong pa can yul de'i khrims mdzad pa'o/ /36—1306

g.yo ba 'dzin na ser skya'o/ /zhes bya ba ni yul de'i lho ngos na gnod sbyin kha dog ser skya gnas pa'o/ /de'i phyag na bum pa dang sbrul zhags bsnams pa'o/ /gyen du 'gro na ba ku la/ /zhes bya ba ni shar phyogs ko la ha ri'i dur khrod na/gnod sbyin ba ku la ni sku mdog shin tu 'jigs pa'o/ /gnas der mtshan mo 'gror mi btub①/ phyag bzhi pa g.yas g.yon gnyis ni mi'i pags lapa 'phyar ba'o—/ /de'i 'og gnyis na gri gug dang thod pa bsnams pa'o/ /gang po snying po thob gabyed na/ /zhes bya ba ni dur khrod de'i phyogs na ked rus bya ba'i dur khrod do/ /gnod sbyin ha la ha la zhes pa gnas so/ /de'i sku mdog mthing ga/be con dang thod pa bsnams pa'o/ /grong rdal tshol ba rnga mong rjon/ /zhes bya ba ni stag gzig gi yul yin te/ gnod sbyin rnga mo'i mgo can/ mdog ljang gu dgra sta dang zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /glang chen brjod pa 'dul ba mchog /ces bya ba ni rgya gar yul kyi shar phyogs bhang ga la na/ glang chen kyi go can gnod sbyin kha dog dkar po/ dgra sta dang phreng ba 'dzin pa'o/ /chu lha'i yul na gzhu brtan po/ /zhes bya ba ni rgya mtsho'i nang na gnas pa ste/ gnod sbyin de ni kha dog dkar zhing dung bsnams pa'o/ /g.yul 'gyed ldan pa grong khyen rgyal—/ /zhes bya ba rjoni ma ga dhā'i rjogong khyer so mtshams na/ gnod sbyin de yang gzhan kyis mi thub pa/ stobs dang ldan pa/ kha dog dang ldan pa/phyag g.yas g.yon mtshon sna tshogs bsnams pa'o/ /sgra ngan zhing na gnod sbyin rgyal / /zhes bya ba ni rgya gar gyi yul nub phyogs na gnod sbyin len pa/ de la byin par gyur pa na/ nyung bar byin yang 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i kha dog ni shin tu dkar ba gser gyi snod ⑦'dzin pa'o/ /gnyi dang rgyal ④ngan 36—1307

rgyal gnyi na/ /zhes bya ba di de'i byang phyogs na yod de gnod sbyin gyi ded dpon du ①grags pa/ de'i kha dog ni nag mo/ g.yas na rin po che g.yon na nor gyi rkyal bu'o④/ /gnod sbyin mor grags de nyid na/ /zhes bya ba ni de gnod sbyin mo spun bzhi gnas te/ chen mo ni bal yul na gnas la ①'bring mo gnyis ni mang yul dang 'gram na gnas te/ chung thag ni bod yul dbus na gnas so/ /de rnams kyi kha dog ni nag mo/ ser mo dmar mo/ ljang gu'o/ /de rnams kyi phyag mtshan ni/ gri gug dang / thod pa dang / dgra sta dang /rtse gsum mo/ /g.yon pa rnams na kha ṭ+wāṃ rjog bsnams pa'o/ /gtum chen gser gyi 'og phag ⑤can/ /zhes bya ba ni spun de bzhi ka yang khro mor gnas pa/gser gyi 'od dang ldan pa'o/ /gnod par byed dang don grub dang / /zhes bya ba ni gtsang gi yul na gnas te de ni spun gnyis yin te gnod pa dang phan pa byed pa kha dog ni dkar po dang / nag po phyag g.yas na gri gug dang thod pa/g.yon dbyug to bsnams pa'o/ /'byung bar byed pa nags na gnas/ /zhes bya ba ni rgya mtsho'i 'gram zangs gling gi nags gseb na'o/ /kha dog nag po phyag g.yas rjon ral gri bsnams pa'o/ /'gro ba drug pa ⑦'gro 'joms sken/ /zhes bya ba ni ma ga dhā'i yul ⑨gnod sbyin rkang drug pa yod pa/ de'i kha dog ni dmar po g.yas na 'khor lo g.yon zhags pa'o/ /ka ba na ⑩ni ka ba nyid/ /ces bya ba ni de'i byang phyogs na gzugs che la nag pa ⑪dgra sta dang thod pa bsnams pa'o/ /seng ge'i stobs na gnod sbyin gang / /zhes bya ba ni phyi'i rgya mtsho'i tshal na/ seng ge'i yul na gnod sbyin seng ge'i gdong can gnas pa/phyag bzhi pa sku mdog dkar po/ g.yas gnyis na 'khor lo ⑫dang a 'bras 36—1308

'dzin pa①/ g.yon gnyis dbyug to dang dung bsnams pa'o/ /seng ge stag stobs med byed gnyis/ /zhes bya ba ni seng ge'i gling dpag tshad lnga brgya'i lho phyogs na/ stag gdong can gyi gling na gnod sbyin stag ces bya ba④/ gnod spyin thams cad stag gi gdong pa can/ phyag bzhi bzhi/ g.yas pa rnams ni dbyug to dang lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis na gri gug dang thod pa bsnams pa'o/ /bye ba 'bab na sde bo che/ /zhes bya ba ni de'i byang phyogs dpag tshad lnga brgya na/khye ling zhes bya ba ①gnod sbyin gyi gdong can gnas pa'o/ /de'i mdog nag pa phyag na dgra sta bsnams pa'o/ /de bzhin gzhan gyi grong las rgyal/ /zhes bya ba ni 'dzam bu gling na 'khor zhing rgya gar dbus su gnas pa kha dog dmar po phyag na gtun shing bsnams pa'o/ /me tog so ni tsam rjopa na/ /zhes bya ba ni de yang rgya gar yul gyi shar phyogs na/ gnod sbyin kha dog dkar po phyag na dgra sta bsnams pa'o/ /mnyam dga' ba ni ri mangs na/ /zhes bya ba ni ri nag po dang ma la ya dang dpal kyi ri dang bya rgod phung po'i ri la sogs pa skad cig mas rgyu zhing ri'i rtse mo rnams la 'dug papya/ stobs dang ldan zhing gzi brjid che ba'o—/ /nam mkha'i mdog can phyag na zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /ba lang spyor na gnod sbyin ri/ /zhes bya ba ni nub phyogs ba lang spyod kyi ri 0mtshams na/gnod sbyin kha dog nag pa⑦/ yul de'i srung ⑧mar gyur pa/ g.yas g.yon gnyis na bum pa bsnams pa'o/ /grong khyer na ni sde bzang po⑨/ /zhes bya ba ni ma ga jo'i (kyegrong khyer yangs pa can na/ 'khor g.yog mang po yod pa/stobs dang ldan pa/ kha dog ser ba/ g.yas na rin po che bsnams pa/g.yon bum pa bsnams pa'o/ /gnas dang bcas na lag pa dpa'/ /zhes bya 36—1309

ba ni chu bo gaṅgā'i 'gram shar phyogs na ri bo la gnas pa/ wa kim zhes bya bar grags pa'o/ /de'i srung mar gyur cing stobs dang ldan pa/ kha dog dmar po phyag na dbyug to bsnams pa'o/ /kha la sbyin na bde byed pa/ /zhes bya ba ni chu bo gaṅgā'i 'gram na/ mo 'ge ri zhes bya ba'i yul na/ gnod sbyin mdog nag la be+e con 'dzin pa'o/ /kau shāsbyi ①na tshegs med pa/ /zhes bya ba ni rgya gar yul gyi so mtshams na/ gnod sbyin kha dog ljang ②nag go/ /g.yas na tri shu ⑧ la g.yon kha ṭ+wāṃ ④ga bsnams pa'o/ /bzang po can na bzang po pa/ /zhes bya ba ni ri rab kyi byang phyogs sgra mi snyan na/ gnod sbyin kha dog ser po g.yas ral gri g.yon bum pa bsnams pa'o/ /skya snar ⑤can kyi bu na ni/ /gnod sbyan 'byung po'i gdong zhes bya⑦/ /zhes bya ba ni 'dzam bu gling gi dbus na me tog gi ra ba na/ gnod sbyin me tog can yod pa'o/ /sku mdog ser po phyag na at+pa la sngon po bsnams pa'o/ /mching ⑦bu na ni mya ngan med/ /ces bya ba ni de'i shar phyogs na me tog a sho ka'i ra ba la gnod sbyin kha dog nag po/ phyag na rdo rje 'dzin pa'o/ /ma la gnas na ⑧sha thang ba/ /zhes bya ba — ri ma la ya'i lho phyogs tsan+dan gyi nags gseb na sku mdog dmar skyar gnas pa/ phyag na rtse gcig pa bsnams pa'o/ /tshang tshing gcig na don grub pa/ /zhes bya ba ni/ bal yul gyi lho phyogs ko ba ya ga na/ gnod sbyin glang po che'i mgo can phyag bzhi pa sku mdog dkar po/ g.yas gnyis na dgra sta dang zhags pa/g.yon gnyis na tri shu ⑨la dang lcags kyu'o/ /ma rgyal rgyal na dman pa ⑩po/ /zhes bya ba ni dur khrod dhe'u ta ko tra ⑪na/ gnod sbyin sku mdog dmar po sha khrag la dga' zhing thod pa bsnams pa ste/ 'jig rten mkha' 'gro rnams kyi 36—1310

srung ma'o/ /chu mchog na ni musgo'i mas/ /zhes bya ba ni laṅka'i phyogs na spre'u rnams kyi grong khyer na gnod sbyin stobs ldan gnas pa'o/ /de'i sku mdog phyag mtshan ni/ a sho ka'i shing bsnams pa/ kha dog dmar po'o/ /sen da pa na nor bu'i gnas/ /zhes bya ba ni rgya gar yul gyi u traṇ+ḍa ②pu ri na/ gnod sbyin bai ḍūr+ya'i mdog canakhru/ phyag na nor bu bsnams pa'o/ /gnod sbyin mi bzad rjo'agro ldan dag⑤ /ces bya ba ni rgya gar yul gyi lho nub mtshams na gnas te/ gnod sbyin de yang mche ba gatshigs pa/ 'jigs su rung ba/sku mdog dmar nag /g.yas na dbyug to g.yon zhags pa'o/ /ser skya yi ni gnas na gnas/ /zhes bya ba ni de'i lho phyogs kyi gnas na gnod sbyin ser skya'i mdog can/ g.yas g.yon gnyis na nor gyi rkyal pa bsnams pa'o/ /ba lang 'dzin dang gzhan brnyas dang / /zhes bya ba ni gaṅgā'i chu 'gram na/ gnod sbyin ba lang mgo can/ mdog nag po phyag g.yas na dgra sta/ g.yon sdigs rjomadzub bsnams pa'o/ /sgo ba gnas can rtag pa dang / /zhes bya ba ni phyi'i rgya mtsho'i 'gram na khyab 'jug gi yul na gnod sbyin gyi ded dpon kha dog thal ba'i mdog can/ g.yas na be+e con/ g.yon ⑦'bras kyi snye ma bsnams pa'o/ /dbu ma pa yi ⑧gnod sbyin dag /ces bya ba ni 'dzam bu gling gi dbus na gnas pa—/ sems can rnams la gnod pa mi byed pa/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la dga' ba/ gnod sbyin blta na sdug pa kha dog gser gyi mdog can ⑨rtag tu mchod ⑩byed rnams la'o/ /grags pa chen po bzang mdzes na/ /zhes bya ba ni ri bo rtse lnga na 'jam dpal gyi spyan snga naspyo/ gnod sbyin nyi ma grags pa de'i kha dog ser po/ phyag na dbyug to mig ⑫can 'dzin pa/ 'jam dpal gyi srung 36—1311

ma'o—/ /grong khyer snying por dgras dogs ①pa/ /zhes bya ba ni rgya gar yul gyi shar phyogs na gnas te/ gnod sbyin bai ḍūr+ya'i mgo ②can/ phyag gnyis na me tog ku mu ta 'dzin pa'o/ /mya ngan sa na rmongs byed pa/ /zhes bya ba ni rgya gar yul gyi ba len+d+ra na gnas pa'o/ /gnod sbyin de ni mdog sngo skya rin po che'i phreng ba 'dzin pa'o/ /khyus 'gro na ni gnod sbyin grags/ /zhes bya ba ni 'gro la dga' zhing skad cig mas khyab pa'o/ /de bzhin du gnod sbyin bsam gyis mi khyab pa gnas pa/ sku mdog sna tshogs can/ mtshon cha snesna tshogs 'dzin pa'o//ma rungs pa yang de bzhin te/ /zhes bya ba ni gnod sbyin de yang snga ma bshad pa bzhin no/ /nga rgyal bral dang lha rtse dub/ /zhes bya ba ni 'dzam bu'i rjogling na rgyu zhing / sems can rnams la nga rgyal byed pa de nyid dukyi kha dog ni ser po dang ljang gu'o/ /phyag mtshan ni rin po che dang ral gri'o/ /'jigs sbyin na ni yid 'jigs pa/ /zhes bya ba ni 'dzam bu'i ⑦gling gi zur gyi lho phyogs na/gnod sbyin chen po stobs ldan pa de'i kha dog ni nag po ste/ ma rig ⑧pa'i dbang gis gnod sbyin gyi kha stini srid pa tsam yod pa de ni srin po las kyi gshin rje zhes bya'o⑫/ /kha che'i yul na 'od byed pa/ /zhes bya ba ni de ni gnod sbyin dbyangs ldan te/ de'i sku mdog ni gser kyi mdog 'dra ba/ spyan gsum pa phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas pa gnyis na po ⑪ti dang mchod sbyin/ g.yon pa gnyis na phreng ba dang bum pa spyi blugs so/ /blo dman pa rnams stod ⑫par byed pa'o/ /gtum po ral pa can grong na/ /zhes bya ba ni phyi'i rgya mtsho'i 'gram na laṅka mgrin bcu'i srung ma ⑫ral pa can zhes bya ba④/ sku mdog mthing nag /zhal gsum phyag brgyad pa g.yas rnams na ral gri gri gug /dgra sta rtse gsum mo/ /36—1312

g.yon rnams na sdogs ①mdzub thod pa/ zhags pa lcags kyu'o/ /skad cig mas dpag tshad lnga brgya tsam rgyu ba'o/ /kha che'i sneyul gyi so mtshams na/ /zhes bya ba ni mnga' ris dang kha che'i yul gnyis kyi mtshalas na'o/ /gnod sbyin dbang chen dbyangs ldan pa de'i sku mdog ni dmar ser/ phyag g.yas na po ①ti/g.yon phreng ba bsnams dupa'o/ /lngas rtsen zhes ni bya ba gnas/ /zhes bya ba ni 'phrog ma bu lnga brgya dang / de'i yab ni pañji ka'o⑤/ /'phrog ma'i bu lnga brgya ni dga' ba la sogs pa'o/ /de la bu ni lnga brgya ste/ /zhes bya ba ni kha dog sna tshogs su gnas pa/ mtshon rjocha sna tshogs bsnams pa'o/ /sde bo che la stobs po che/ /zhes bya ba ni gzhan gyis mi thub gzi brjid ldan/ 'khor g.yog mang po dang ldan pa'o/ /lngas spyortsen gyi ni bu thu bo⑧/ /zhes bya ba ni bu chen po de ni rgya nag na gnas pa/ rgya nag po'i pho brang na gnas pa/ srung ⑨ma der mdzad pa'o/ /sku mdog ser po/ g.yas na rin po che'i ⑩myu gu 'dzin pa/g.yon na bum pa gang ⑪ba bsnams pa'o/ /rgya yul kyi ni sa la ⑫gnas/ /zhes bya ba ni gnod sbyin chen po de ni rgya nag po'i yul na gnas pa'o/ /phrag pa'i mig ces bya ba ni/ mdzod ldan na ni spun dang bcas⑫/ /zhes bya ba ni rgya mtsho'i dbus na gnas pa spun gnyis sa bdag gi tshul du gnas pa'o/ /de gnyis kha dog ni nag po dang dmar po ste/ de gnyis kyi g.yas ④na 'khor lo dang / dbyug to⑫/ g.yon na sbrul zhags bsnams pa'o/ /ka liṅka na mche ba rkang / /zhes bya ba ni phyi'i rgya mtsho'i 'gram lho phyogs na pho brang gser yul gyi dbus na/ 'jigs su rung ba'i gnod sbyin dmar skya'o/ /g.yas na ral gri g.yon na mi mgo bsnams pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor stan na ⑩dkyil 'khor ro/ /36—1313

zhes bya ba ni 'dzam bu'i ①gling gi dbus na gnod sbyin dkyil 'khor can gnas pa/de yang sku mdog dkar po g.yas g.yon gnyis na pad+ma bsnams pa'o/ /ga bu sha na laṅka'i bdag /ces bya ba ni 'dzam bu'i gling gi lho nub mtshams na gnas pa'o—/ /gnod sbyin de ni mgrin pa bcu pa/ zhal gcig ni rta mchog gi dbu lta bu'o/ /phyag brgyad pa sku mdog mthing ga /g.yas rnams na ral gri mda' 'khor lo/ g.yon na zhags pa gzhu/ tha ma gnyis na pi wang bsgyur ⑤ba'o/ /'od can dga' ba'i tshang tshing na/ /zhes bya ba ni bal yul gyi lho phyogs na ko ri na ④ya ka'i shar phyogs kyi nags dun gnod sbyin ma sku mdog dkar mokhru /g.yas na ut+pa la g.yon na nor kyi rkyal bu bsnams pa'o/ /nam mkha' srung na chos skyong ba/ /zhes bya ba ni rgya gar yul rmi lho phyogs gser yul na phyi'i rgya mtsho'i 'gram na gnas pa/ g.yas na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po dhiti/g.yon na me tog pad+ma bsnams pa'o/ /lag pa chen po ngan pa na/ /zhes bya ba ni de'i byang phyogs na gnod ⑦sbyin kha dog dmar po g.yas pad+ma dmar po g.yon bum pa ⑤gang ba bsnams pa'o/ /rnam thos bu yi bu dpal ldan/ /rgyal ba khyu mchog rgyal po'i bu/ /zhes bya ba ni gzhan gyis ⑨mi thub pa/ gnod sbyin rnams kyi rgyal po byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams skyong ba sems can rnams kyi don byed 1pa pho brang lcang lo can la mnga' mdzad pa/ phyag gnyis pa sku mdog gser kyi mdog can/ g.yas na rin po che sna ⑪bdun gyi myu gu/ g.yon na bum pa nor gyis gang ba/ rin po che sna bdun gyi khri la bzhugs pa'o/ /gnod sbyin bye bas yongs ⑫bskor zhing / /tho gar kyi ni yul na gnas/ /zhes bya ba ni lcang lo can gyi pho brang na dpal ldan rnam thos sras ni gnod sbyin kyi 36—1314

rigs mi gcig pa rnams kyis yongs su bskor zhing / nam mkha' la nyi zla skar mas bskor ba bzhin du'o/ /'gror bcas ri dang gangs can dag /ces bya ba ni yul wā rā ṇa sī'i ①nub phyogs na/ chu bo gaṅgā dang sirtse gnyis 'dus pa'i sa na gnod sbyin chen po de gnas so/ /de'i kha dog ni sngo skya zhal gcig phyag drug pa g.yas g.yon gnyis thal mo sbyar ba/ de'i ④'og gnyis na rtse gsum dang mchod sbyin g.yon gnyis na phreng ba dang bum pa spyi blugs bsnams pa'o/ /spyan gsum pa glang la zhon pa'o/ /sin+tu yi ni rgya mtshor gnas/ /zhes bya ba ni shar phyogs kyi phyi'i rgya mtsho'i nang na gnas pa gnod sbyin de'i kha dog ni dkar po sbrul gyi zhags pa dang rin po che'i ④myu gu bsnams pa'o/ /grong khyer gsum na rtse gsum lag /ces bya ba ni sa 'og sa steng sa bla gsum na gnas pa gnod sbyin legs ldan thal ba'i mdog can phyag g.yas na rtse gsum g.yon ④phreng ba bsnams pa'o—/ /ka liṅka na rab 'joms pa/ /zhes bya ba ni rgya gar dbus na gnod sbyin kha dog nag po gri gug dang thod pa bsnams pa'o/ /tshigs lnga ser po 'gro lding na/ /zhes bya ba ni rdo rje gdan kyi lho phyogs na gnod sbyin sgu mdog ser po phyag na bum pa gser gyis bkang ba bsnams pa'o/ / sing ha la bun nor gyi bdag /ces bya ba ni sing ga'i gshol mda'i yul phyi'i rgya mtsho'i tshal na gnod sbyin de gnas pa kha dog gur gum gyi mdog can/ phyag g.yas na rin po che'i snod dang / gser gyi rkyal bu bsnams pa'o/ /ne+e pa'i rjobazhin ni 'brog na steg/zhes bya ba ni rdo rje ⑧gdan kyi nags tshal chen po na gnod sbyin kha dog dmar nag phyag na ral gri zhags pa bsnams ⑨pa'o/ /'gro 'am ci ni 'og na gnas/ /zhes bya ba ni gnas ni sa 'og /'gro 'am ci ni ming / kha dog ni sngo bsangs 36—1315

phyag g.yas na sbrul zhags g.yon dung bsnams pa'o/ /smad sbrul lo/ /pad+ma dkar po'i 'od gsal ba/ /zhes bya ba ni de ni gzugs khams na gnas pa ste/de'i kha dog ni dkar po/ g.yas na phreng ba/ g.yon na bum pa spyi blugs bsnams pa'o/ /grong khyer che na ①brtse ba can/ /zhes bya ba ni sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas na gnod sbyin chen po gnas pa'o/ /kha dog ser po/ g.yas na skyabs sbyin g.yon na rdo rje bsnams pa'o/ /'jigs pa sbyin na rab 'jigs pa—/ /zhes bya ba ni lho nub kyi mtshams phyi'i rgya mtsho'i 'gram laṅka pu ri na khyeganod sbyin thal ba'i mdog can g.yas ral gri g.yon zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /chu dang ldan na dmar ser gnas/ /zhes bya ba ni ma dros kyi mtsho 'gram na gnod sbyin chen po gnas pa ni sku mdog dkar po phyag na sbrul gyi zhags pa dang pad+ma bsnams pa'o/ / basba da bskyed basba ḍaX/ /zhes bya ba ni bal yul gyi byang phyogs na chu dgas dukyi nags gseb na gnod sbyin kha dog ljang nag phyag bzhi pa g.yas gnyis na 'khor lo dang a 'bras/ /g.yon gnyis na dbyug to dang dung bsnams pa'o/ /'dod pa sbyin na ma dang ldan/ /dhizhes bya ba ni sum cu rtsa gsum gyi byang phyogs na/ gnod sbyin 'dod bupa zhes bya ba gnas te/'dod pa'i lha mo lnga dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas na 'dod pa'i mda' lnga bsnams pa—/ g.yon ⑦me tog gi gzhu bsnams pa'o/ /nya'i rgyal mtshan dang / chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan dang ldan pa'o/ /bu mo 'jug na rab sad ④pa/ /zhes bya ba ni wā rā ṇa sī'i ⑨shar phyogs na seng ge lha'i yul du gnas pa'i gnod sbyin seng ge gnas pa'o/ /gzugs ni seng ge'i gzugs su snang ba'o/ /ka ⑩bu sha na nal ku bar/ /zhes bya ba ni de'i shar phyogs bal yul dang / rgya gar gyi so 36—1316

mtshams na gnod sbyin chen po khyi'i gzugs su snang ba'o/ /pha rol mtha' ①med rngul chu na/ /zhes bya ba ni rgya nag po'i shar phyogs gshin rje'i 'dam gseb na / gnod sbyin kha dog dmar po phyag na me sgron dang zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /nus pa'i gnas na zhi byed pa/ /zhes bya ba ni yul ma ga dhā'i ①byang phyogs na gnod sbyin gdong zhes bya ba'i gnas ni ④gnod sbyin chen po kha dog nag po dbyug to dang zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /pa lha ba na thags ④bzangs ris/ /zhes bya ba ni ri rab kyi byang phyogs na/ gnod sbyin lha ma yin bya ba gnas te kha dog dmar nag phyag na 'khor lo dang dbyug to bsnams pa'o/ /ka ta ka na dmar ser po/ /zhes bya ba ni sing ga la'i shar phyogs na/ gnod sbyin kha dog gur gum 'dra ba'obu/ /phyag na rtse gcig dang zhags pa bsnams rjopa'o/ /'phral ris 'phel na bzhin rgyas pa/ /zhes bya ba ni nub phyogs kyi rgya mtsho'i 'gram na gnod sbyin mgon po zhes bya ba gnas pa'o⑦/ /zhal bcu gcig pa thal ba'i mdog can phyag bcu gnyis pa/ dang po gnyis na mda' gzhu/ de 'og g.yas pa rnams na 'khor lo dang dbyug to dang thod pa dang dgra sta dang rtse gsum pa/ g.yon pa rnams na zhags pa dang rin po che dang / pad+ma dang ⑧aX la dang dung bsnams pa'o/ /u rgyan yul na ma rungs pa/ /zhes bya ba ni rgya gar gyi dbus kyi nub phyogs na gnod sbyin chen po kha dog mthing nag /gri gug dang thod pa bsnams pa'o/ /thong gshol ngan na bum lto bo/ /zhes bya ba ni ma ga jo'i ⑨shar phyogs na/ gnod sbyin bum pa'i lto can bzhin mi sdug pa/dud ka'i mdog can phyag na lcags kyu dang zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan mya ngan na/ /⑩zhes bya ba ni ma ga dhā'i ⑩sa mtshams na 'dod chen 36—1317

zhes bya ba'i gnod sbyin gnas te/ sku mdog thal ba'i mdog can/ phyag gnyis na mda' gzhu bsnams pa'o/ /sna tshogs sde ni po ka ①na/ /zhes bya ba ni lho nub mtshams na gnod sbyin kha dog ljang gu/ phyag gnyis na 'khor lo dang dbyug to bsnams pa'o/ /dga' dang ldan na sgra sgogs bu/ /zhes bya ba ni rgya gar gyi yul byang shar mtshams na/ gnod sbyin thos grags ni sku mdog ser po phyag na mda' gzhu bsnams pa'o/ /phung po'i bdag por ②dmar ser po/ /zhes bya ba ni shar phyogs ka ma rū ④na gnas pa ste/ gnod sbyin kha dog dkar po phyag g.yas na phreng ba bsnams pa'o/ /g.yon na bum pa spyi blugs bsnams pa'o—/ /chung ma can na mthong dga' bo/ /zhes bya ba ni yul ko ka na'i shar phyogs na gnod sbyin bustobs ldan gnas pa ni/ kha dog dmar po phyag na 'khor lo bsnams pa'o/ /gnod sbyin chu srin rgyal po'i ⑤khab/ /zhes bya ba ni rgyal po'i khab kyi lho ngos na/ gnod sbyin chu srin gyi mgo can gnas te/ sa bdag gi tshul du yod pa/ sbrul gyi zhags pa dang / sdigs mdzub bsnams pa'o—/ / yangs pa ⑥na ni gnas pa ste/ /'bum phrag dag ni mang po yi/ /zhes bya ba ni gnod sbyin 'du ba mang po gnas pa 'jig rten gyi khams rnams khyab pa'o—/ /gnod sbyin rnams kyis bsnyen bkur byas/ /④zhes bya ba ni rgyal po chen po rnam 2thos sras la gnod sbyin rnams kyis bsnyen bkur byas te/ rgyal po chen po'i bka' las mi 'da' ba'o/ /ba lang skyong ba sbrul gdug can⑨/ /zhes bya ba ni rgya gar kyi nub ngos na sbrul gyi yul na gnas pa gnod sbyin ba lang gi mgo can/ phyag na dbyug to dang zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /lcang lo'i grong na lcang lo pa/ /zhes bya ba ni rnam thos sras kyi grong na lus ngan po gnas te/ skya 36—1318

mdog ljang gu g.yas na ral gri g.yon na bum pa bsnams pa'o/ /dga' ba'i grong na dga' ba can/ /zhes bya ba ni lcang lo can gyi pho brang na 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la longs spyod pa ni gang zhe na/ rgyal po chen po rnam ①thos kyi bu gnod sbyin ma rnams kyis ②bsnyen bkur byed pa'o/ /grong gi lhas ni stobs can gnas//zhes sgebya ba ni lcang lo can gyi gnas na lha dzam+bha ④la gnas pa sku mdog ser po g.yas na bī dza pū rjor/ g.yon na ne+e'u le'i rkyal pa bsnams pa'o/ /lha las bab bun rnam thos bu/ /rang gi sde ⑦ni yongs su skyong / /zhes bya ba ni rang gi khyem srung zhing gnod sbyin byu ded dpon du mar gnas pa/ de rnams skyong zhing dbang mdzad pa'o/ /lcang lo can na gnas pa ste/ /gnod sbyin bye bas kun nas bskor/ /zhes bya ba ni rgyal po chen po rnam ④thos kyi bu yang gnod sbyin thams cad kyi ded dpon pho brang lcang lo can la gnod sbyin du ma bye ba mang pos bskor te/ rgyal po'i bka' las mi 'da' ba sngar bshad pa'i gnod sbyin rnams/rnam thos kyi bu'i 'khor du gnas pa'o/ /gnod sbyin de dag rdzu 'phrad che ba zhes bya ba ni/ sa 'og sa steng ⑨sa bla gsum du skad cig mas rgyu ⑩ba'o/ /sde che ba zhes bya ba ni/ gnod sbyin mi gcig pa mang po 'dus pas te/ de rnams kyang mi mthun pa med pa'o/ /stobs che ba zhes bya ba ni/ ri rab bdun kyang sgul ⑪nus pa'o/ /pha rol gyi dgra rab tu 'joms pa zhes bya ba ni/ stobs che ba dgra rnams kyis mi thub pa/ lha ma yin gyi grong khyer rlag par byed pa'o/ /thub par dka' zhing gzhan gyis mi thub pa zhes bya ba ni/ mthu che ba rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs dang ldan pa che bar sprul pa'i dus su ri rab bas che bar sprul pa/chung ba ni rdul phra rab tsam du sprul nus pa'o/ /rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa zhes bya ba 36—1319

ni—/ de lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul dang ldan te/ skad cig thang cig gis stong gsum gyi 'jig rten gyi khams khyab pa/ gnod byed dang phan byed byas pa'o/ /'od dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni/ so so'i kha dog gis 'jig rten gyi khams snang ba'o/ /kha dog dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni/ nag po dkar po ser po ①dmar po ljang gu la sogs pa'o/ /rang rang gi rigs kyi kha dog snang ba'o/ /grags pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni/ 'jig rten gyi khams na grags pa'o/ /lha dang lha ma yin gyi g.yul dag kyang myong bar byed pa zhes bya ba ni/ rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyis/lha dang lha ma yin gyi g.yul 'gyed de/ la la lha ma yin kyi ngos nas/ la la lha yi phyogs nas so/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po dag ste zhes bya ba ni/ gzugs sna tshogs su sprul pa/ lha dang lha ma yin kyi yul na rtsod pa ⑤byed pa/ mi'i yul na yang de bzhin no/ /de dag gis kyang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'dis bdag la srung ①ba gyis shig ces bya ba rjoni/ rig sngags 'di la mos pa'i gang zag ni/ gnod sbyin chen po de dag gis kyang bsrung ba dang bskyab ⑤par byas shing / phyi ma la yang bsrung bar 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags kyi ngo bo ni/mtshon bya ⑥dang mtshon byed gnyis dang ldan zhes mtshon pa ni shes rab ste mtshon byed spyoni rig sngags so/ /de gnyis su ⑧med pa'i rig pa nam mkha' lta bur gnas pa stong par snang ba'o/ /stong pa'i nang na me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bu/'jig rten khams sgyu ma lta bu'o/ /de'i ngo bo nyid ⑨kyis snying rje dang byams pas khyab pa'o/ /de'i rang bzhin rig sngags ni zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ sku mdog mthing ga zhal dang po khro mo/ g.yas dkar ba ni zhi ba/ g.yon dmar ba 'dzum pa/ rgyab ser po ⑩ni sgeg pa'i tshul lo/ /zhal re re la thod pa lnga 36—1320

lngas brgyan pa/ spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar ba/ dbu la rdo rjes mtshan ①pa/ ye shes lnga dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas pa rnams naske/ral gri dang / rdo rje dang / mdung shing ①/ lcags kyu dang / rtse gsum dang / 'khor lo bsnams pa'orjo/ /g.yon pa rnams na/ zhags pa/ rma bya'i sgo/ dgra sta/ rin po che/ pad+ma/ sna tshogs rdo rje bsnams pa'o/ /zhabs g.yas pa brkyang ba/ g.yon bskum pas mnan pa ni/ gnod sbyin pho mo mnan pa/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i 'od dang ldan pa'o/ /sba ba dang zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni/ sngar bshad pa bzhin no/ /tar+ya thā zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags de'i snying ga nas/ hūṃ gi yi ges 'od zer 'phros te/ de'i 'od zer gyis 'jig rten gyi khams khyab pa stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad bcom nas/ gnod byed rnams gsang sngags re res 'joms te/ sngags re re dang 'od zer re res khro rjobo bcur sprul pa'o/ /khro bo bcu ni hūṃ mdzad dang dbyug pa sngon po dang / gshin rje gshed rjopo/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ rta mgrin dang / mi g.yo mgon po/bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang / rnam par rgyal ba dang khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba dang / stobs po che'o/ /'di lta ste ni 'og ma bzhin du'o/ /'og ma'i sngags kyis khro bo dkar po dang / nag po dang / dmar po dang / ser po dang / mthing nag dang / dmar po dang / sngo skya dang / ljang gu dang /ljang nag dang / mthing gar ④gnas pa'o/ /de'i phyag mtshan ni/ g.yas rdo rje tho ba g.yon phur bu bsnams pa'o/ /zhabs sgephur ba'i rang bzhin du yod pa/de bzhin du nam mkha'i khams su spros pa'o/ /shar phyogs kyi khro bo'i sngags ni a 36—1321

ka ṭi hūṃ)bi ka ṭi ⑤la sogs pa'o/ /bdag gi ④mi mdza' ba rnams zhes bya ba ni/'khor lo bcur bris la/ drag po'i sbyin sreg gis bsreg rjopar bya'o/ /'khor lo'i nang du gang mi mdza' ba'i ming rus bris la/ ha na ha na bcu po rtsibs la bkod la/ gzhan gsang sngags mu khyud la dgod par bya'o/ /'khor lo de dril khye/la gnyan pa'i sar mnan no/ /des grub par 'gyur ro/ /bdag la mi phan par 'dod pa rnams zhes bya ba ni/ ras sam shing shun larjo/ ming rus bris la bsreg par bya'o/ /sngags ni da ha da ha la sogs pa gdon ④par bya'o/ /'di ni shar phyogs kyi khro bo'i sngags ⑧yin no/ /bdag la phyir rgol ba rnams zhes bya ba ni 'byung po 'am gang yang rung ba la 'khor lo rtsibs bcu tham pa bris la—/ rtsibs re re la pa tsa pa tsa zhes bya ba bris la/ dbus su ming rus ste tsabha ya btags la bri'o/ /mu khyud la sngar bshad pa'i sngags bris la/ lam rgya gram mam mchod rten chen po'am dur khrod du mnan par bya'o/ /sngags kyang pa tsa pa tsa la sogs pa'o/ /de ni byang shar mtshams kyi khro bo'i sngags so/ /gzhan yang mi mthun pa'am 'byung po bskrad ⑩par 'dod na ⑪snga ma bzhin du 'khor lo bris nas sgo rtsar mnan te 'byung po'i sar ro/ /'khor lo'i sngags bskrad tsapa'i sngags ni u tsa ta ya dhu dhu la sogs pa'o/ /lho'i 'o/ /bdag la mi phan par 'dod pa rnams zhes bya ba ni brgya rtsa brgyad drag po'i sbyin sreg byas la/'byung po dang dgra bo rnams la thun mong gi dzas rnams gtor la bsreg ⑩par bya'o//sngags ni ha ha zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni lho nub kyi'o/ /dza ṭi dza ṭi ⑫zhes bya ba ni nub kyi khro bo'o/ /bdag gi dgra bo rnams zhes bya ba ni dgra bo dang 'byung po rnams liṅga bris nas bsreg pa'o/ /nā sha ya zhes bya ba ni dgra bo'i ⑫gzi brjid 36—1322

'phrog pa'o/ /tsu lu tsu lu zhes bya ba ni nub byang gi'o/ /hi li hi li zhes bya ba ni byang gi'o/ /mi li mi li ①la sogs pa ni byang shar gyi'o/ /phu ru phu ru la sogs pa ni 'og gi'o/ /tsi ṭi tsi ṭi ②la sogs pas ①ni steng rjobacing bar bya'o//bdag gi dgra bo rnams nā sha ya zhes bya ba ni 'byung po dang dgra bo rnams bsregs nas/ sngags de rnams kyis bskrad par byas nas ming ⑤rus btags nas brdungs pa'i gsang sngags so/ /'dis kyang nad thams cad sel ba'o/ / hik+ki mik+ki rjol sogs pa ni/ rig sngags kyi snying po'o/ /gzhan thams cad la bsrung bar bya'o/ /bdag la srung ④ba gyis shig ces bya ba la sogs pa ni/gang zag 'di la ⑧gus par byas na rig sngags kyi gzi brjid kyis gnod sbyin de rnams kyis kyang srung bar byed de/ dam ma nyams ⑨na grogs kyang byed par 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo'i gnod sbyin gyi gnas skabs dang 'byung po rnams 'dul ba'i gnas skabs te dgu pa'o// //kun dga' bo zhes bya ba ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas sems can gyi don la bka' (spyi pa'o/ /khyod kyis gang dag phyogs bcu srung ⑫zhing yongs su skyong bar byed pa gnod sbyin gyi ded dpon chen po nyi shu rtsa brgyad po de ⑪dag gi ming zung shig ces bya ba ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ⑫bsrung ba gzi brjid che ba stobs dang ldan pa/ grags pa dang kha dog tu ldan pa/rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa/ lha dang lha ma yin gyi g.yul yang myong bar byed pa'o/ /kun dga' bo zhes bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kun dga' bo la bka' pa pa'o/ /shar phyogs na gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po gang dag shar phyogs 36—1323

srung ①zhing yongs su skyong bar byed pa bzhi gnas te zhes bya ba ni/ gang zag gang gis gus par byed pa'am/ yi ge gcig tsam yod par gyur na/ shar phyogs kyi gnod sbyin de rnams kyis bsrung ④bar 'gyur ro/ /'di lta ste zhes bya ba ni/ gnod sbyin rnams lta ba'o/ /ring po dang / mig mi bzang dang / gang ba bzang po dang dhi/ ser skya'o zhes bya ba ni/ de rnams kyi kha dog dang phyag mtshan ni dkar po dang / nag po dang / ser po dang / dmar po'o/ /phyag mtshan ni rdo rje dang / 'khor lo dang / rin po che dang / pad+ma'o/ /g.yon na yang rim pa bzhin du mdung ⑤dang / zhags pa dang / dgra sta dang /rtse gsum mo/ /gnod sbyin bzhi po de rnams ni/ zhi ba'i tshul du gnas pa/gzhan gyis mi thub pa'o/ /de dag gis kyang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo khye'adis bdag la srung ba kyis shig ces bya ba ni/ rjes su yi rang zhing bton ⑦pa tsam gyis kyang / nad thams cad dang ④bral zhing 'jigs pa thams cad med par 'gyur ro/ /sba ba la sogs pa zhes bya ba ni/ gong bzhin du shes par bya'o—/ /kun dga' bo zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyis kun dga' bo la gsungs pa'o/ /lho phyogs na gnod sbyin gyi ded dpon chen po/ gang dag lho phyogs skyong zhing srung bar byed pa bzhi gnas te zhes bya ba ni/ gnod sbyin chen po bzhi po de dag kyang gzi brjid che ba/ stobs dang ldan pa/ grags pa dang ldan pa/ kha dog dang ldan pa/ rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa/ lha dang lha ma yin gyi g.yul myong bar byed pa'o/ /'di lta ste zhes bya ba ni gnod sbyin bzhi po blta'o⑨//seng ge dang nye ba'i seng ge dang / dung can dang / dga' bo zhes bya ba ni gnod sbyin bzhi po de ni/ mthu che ba/ rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba 36—1324

ste—/ de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/ ser po dang / nag po dang / dmar po dang / ljang gu'o/ /de'i phyag mtshan ni ①rin po che dang /rdo rje dang / pad+ma dang ral gri'o/ /g.yon rnams ni/ mda' gzhu dang /gtun shing dang lcags kyu dang / 'khor lo bsnams pa'o/ /gnod sbyin de dag ni bzhin mi sdug pa'i gzugs su gnas pa/ khro bor snang ba'o/ /de dag gis kyang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo ②'dis bdag la srung ④ba gyis shig ces bya ba ni/ gang zag dag dhigis rgya cher bstan pa dang / 'chang ba dang /yi ge gcig tsam klog par gyur pas kyang gnod sbyin bzhi pos lho phyogs su skyong ba dang / srung ⑤bar 'gyur ro/ /sba ba la sogs pa zhes bya ba ni/ sngar bshad pa bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /kun dga' bo zhes bya ba ni/ dge slong sa ri'i dudon dang sems can rnams kyi ⑦don la bka' stsal pa'o/ /nub phyogs na gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po gang dag nub phyogs srung zhing yongs su skyong bar byed pa bzhi gnas te zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung ne+eb/gzi brjid che ba stobs dang ldan pa/ grags pa dang ldan pa/ kha dog dang ldan pa/ rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa/ lha dang lha ma yin gyi g.yul myong bar byed pa'o—/ /'di lta ste zhes bya ba ni/ gnod sbyin bzhi po nub kyi ngos kyi bzhi blta'o⑨—/ /seng ge dang / seng ge'i ral pa dang / bla ma dang / ser skye'o zhes bya ba ni/ gnod sbyin bzhi po de dag ni rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba ste/ de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/ dmar po dang /nag po dang / dkar po dang ⑩/ ljang gu'o/ /g.yas rnams na/ pad+ma dang / rdo rje dang / 'khor lo dang / ral gri'o/ /g.yon ⑪rnams na rtse ⑫36—1325

gcig dang / to ma ra dang / 'phang mdung dang mdung rings ①bsnams pa'o//gnod sbyin de rnams ni mthu che zhing cung zad khro bor ④gnas pa'o/ /de dag gis kyang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'dis ①bdag la srung ④ba gyis shig ces bya ba ni/ gang zag gang gis lus ngag yid kyis dumos par byas nas/sa bubadag gi nad mdze la sogs pa med par 'gyur ro/ /bsgom ⑦pa dang /kha ton rjobyed pa la sogs pa byas par gyur na/ nad de da ltar yang mi 'byung ste/tshe phyi ma yang de bzhin no/ /sba ba la sogs pa zhes bya ba ni/ gnod sbyin bzhi po dag gis kyang srung ⑨ba dang / skyob par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang bshad pa ni gong nas shes pa'o/ /kun dga' bo zhes bya ba ni bcom ldan 'das kyis sems can gyi don du gsungs pa'o/ /byang phyogs na gnod sbyin kyi ded dpon chen po gang dag byang phyogs skyong zhing yongs su srung bar byed pa bzhi gnas te zhes bya ba ni bzhi po de dag gis kyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung zhing gnas pa⑫/gzi brjid che ba/ stobs dang ldan pa/ grags pa dang ldan pa/ 'od zer dang ldan pa/ kha dog dang ⑪ldan pa/ rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa/ lha dang lha ma yin gyi g.yul yang myong bar byed pa'o/ /de dag ⑫dang ldan pa'i gnod sbyin chen po rnams kyis ⑫rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba'o/ /'di lta ste zhes bya ba ni/ gnod sbyin chen po bzhi po dag byang ngos nas blta'ospyo/ /'dzin pa dang / 'dzin dga' kyedang / brtson skyong dang / khyab 'jug go ⑩zhes bya ba ni/ gnod sbyin chen po bzhi po de dag ni/ mthu chen po dang ldan pa/de dag gi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni ljang nag dang / nag po dang / ser po dang / dkar po'o/ /g.yas rnams na ⑫ral gri dang / rdo rje dang /36—1326

rin po che dang / 'khor lo'o/ /g.yon pa rnams ni ①zhags pa dang / dgra sta dang / rtse gsum dang ④/ mda' gzhu bsnams pa'o/ /gnod sbyin chen po de dag ni khro bor gnas pa gsus pa che ba sems can rnams kyi don mdzad pa'o/ /de dag gis kyang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'dis bdag la srung ①ba gyis shig ces dubya ba ni gang zag gis gus par byas na sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur te/ yi ge gcig tsam klog par gyur rjon gus pa dang bcas pas mtshan nas brjod par bya ste/ gnod sbyin chen po de dag gis kyang da ltar yang srung bar byed pa dang / tshe phyi ma la yang srung bar byed pa'o/ /sba ba dang zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni sngar bshad pa bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /kun dga' bo zhes bya ba ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis sems can kyi don du bka' sprul pa'o/ /gnod sbyin gyi ded dpon chen po gang dag phyogs mtshams na gnas te zhes bya ba ni shar lho dang / lho nub dang / nub byang dang /byang shar mtshams na gnas pa'o/ /gang dag phyogs mtshams srung buzhing yongs su skyong bar byed pa bzhi po 'di dag ste zhes bya ba ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi bstan pa srung ④ba ste/ sems can rnams kyi don byed pa ste/ gnod sbyin de dag ni/ rdzu 'phrul che ba/ stobs dang ldan pa/grags pa dang ldan pa/ kha dog dang ldan pa/ lha dang lha ma yin gyi sgegayul yang myong bar byed pa'o/ /'di lta ste zhes bya ba ni/ gnod sbyin bzhi po de dag phyogs mtshams na blta'o⑨/ /lnga spyod dang tshigs lnga ser po dang / ri mnyam dang / gser can no zhes bya ba dang / gnod sbyin de dag gis kyang rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' zhing / mthu chen po dang ldan pa de dag gi 36—1327

sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni dkar po dang / nag po dang / dmar po dang /ljang gu'o/ /phyag g.yas rnams na pad+ma dkar po dang / ut+pa la ser po dang /pad+ma dmar po dang / /ut+pa la sngon po'o/ /g.yon rnams na 'khor lo dang /rdo rje dang / dbyug to dang / ral gri rnams so/ /gnod sbyin bzhi po de yang rim bzhin du zhi ba'i tshul dang ldan pa/ drag po'i tshul dang ldan pa/dregs pa ①dang ldan pa/ khro ba ④dang ldan pa'o/ /de dag gis kyang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'dis bdag la srung ①ba gyis shig ces bya ba ni/gang zag gang gis 'di la gus par byed na/ rjes su yi rang ba tsam dang /lus ngag yid kyis gus pa tsam gyis kyang / gnod sbyin gyi ded dpon de rnams kyis yang dag par srung meb dang skyob par 'gyur ro/ /sba ba la sogs pa zhes bya ba ni/ gnod sbyin de rnams kyis 'jigs pa la sogs pa sbed pa'o/ /de rnams kyis 0bshad pa ni snga ma bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /kun dga' bo zhes bya ba ni bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa'o/ /gnod sbyin gyi ded budapon chen po gang dag sa la gnas te/ gang dag sa ⑦srung zhing yongs su skyob par byed pa bzhi po 'di dag ste zhes bya ba ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ⑧ba/ sems can thams cad kyi don byed pa/ gnod sbyin chen po de dag ni gzi brjid che ba/ stobs dang ldan pa/ grags pa dang ldan pa—/ 'od zer dang ldan pa dang ⑨/ kha dog dang ldan pa dang ⑩/ rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa/ lha dang lha ma yin gyi g.yul ⑩yang myong bar ⑫byed pa dag go—/ /'di lta ste zhes bya ba ni gnod sbyin bzhi po sa la gnas pa ltar ro/ /sa pa dang / shin tu sa pa dang / nag po dang / nye nag po'o ⑫zhes bya ba ni de 36—1328

rnams kyis kyang rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' zhing 'og nas srung bar byed pa'o—/ /de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni ser po dang / dmar po dang / nag po dang / dmar nag gi mdog go/ /g.yas rnams na rin po che dang / pad+ma dang / rdo rje dang / ral gri'o/ /g.yon rnams na mdung dang / zhags pa dang / 'khor lo dang / dgra sta rnams so/ /bzhi po 'di dag gis kyang sa yongs su srung ①zhing / sems can rnams la don byed pa'o—/ /de dag gis kyang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'dis bdag la srung khrub kyis shig ces bya ba ni/ gang zag gang dag gis 'di skel mos shing chos byed pa dang / srung ba btags pa dang / kha don byed pa dang /yongs su gzung rjobar gyur na/ sa g.yo ba'i 'jigs pa dang / mu ge'i 'jigs pa dang / sa bdag rnams kyi 'jigs pa la sogs pa yang dag par srung zhing ⑤/ da ltar dang phyi dhimar yang srung bar 'gyur ro/ /sba ba la sogs pa zhes bya ba ni/ gsang ba la sogs pa'i tshul gyis srung bar 'gyur te/ de rnams kyi bshad pa ni gong ma bzhin no/ /kun dga' bo zhes bya ba ni/sems can gyi don la thugs rje chen pos bka' stsal pa'o/ /gnod sbyin gyi ded ④dpon chen po gang dag bar snang la gnas te ⑧zhes bya ba ni/ yang dag par sdogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi bstan pa srung ⑨ba/ steng gi ngos na gnas pa'o//gang dag bar snang srung ⑩zhing yongs su skyong bar byed pa bzhi po 'di dag ste zhes bya ba ni/ gzi brjid che ba/ grags pa dang ⑪ldan pa/ 'od dang ldan pa/kha dog dang ldan pa/ rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa/ lha dang lha ma yin gyi g.yul yang myong bar byed pa'o/ /'di lta ste zhes bya ba ni/ gnod sbyin chen po bzhi 36—1329

po 'di dag bar snang la blta'o/ /nyi ma dang / zla ba dang / me dang /rlung ngo zhes bya ba ni mthu che ba/ rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba/ de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/ dmar po dang / dkar po dang /sngon po dang / dmar nag gi mdog go/ /phyag g.yas rnams na pad+ma dmar po pad+ma dkar po ba dan dang me sbar ba bsnams pa'o/ /g.yon rnams na 'khor lo/dgra sta rtse gsum pa rtse gcig pa bsnams pa'o/ /gnod sbyin de dag bar snang kye yongs su srung ④zhing / sems can rnams kyi don byed pa'o/ /de dag gis kyang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'dis kyang bdag la srung ba gyis shig ces bya ba ni/ gang gis rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'di la gus par byas na—/ lce 'bab pa'i 'jigs pa dang / ser ba la sogs pa yang yul der 'bab par mi 'gyur te/ 'jigs pa gzhan yang mi 'byung ba'o/ /sba ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ 'jigs pa dang nad thams cad las thar bar byas pa'o/ /yongs su skyong ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ mngal nas btsas ka dang / btsas ma thag tu skyes nas kyang ma shi bar du skyong ba'o/ /yongs su bskyab pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ ma rungs pa'i 'byung bo dang / nad rnams dang / sdug bsngal rnams las bskyab thupas so/ /yongs su gzung rjob dang zhes bya ba ni ma rig thu pa'i mun pa spangs nas/ dge ba la sbyor ba'o/ /zhi ba dang zhes bya ba ni drag po'i tshul du gnas pa'i 'byung po rnams kyang zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /bde legs su 'gyur ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ lus ngag yid bde ba ste/ 'di'i bunus pas lus ngag yid bde bar byed pa'o/ /chad pa spang ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ rgyal po dang 'byung po la sogs pas ④chad pa spang ba'o/ /mtshon cha spang ba dang zhes 36—1330

bya ba ni/ yul gyi dbus sam/ rkun ma 'am/ chom rkun nam/ de rnams kyi mtshon cha spang ba'o/ /dug gzhil ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ bsdad pa'i dug dang / 'gro ba'i dug dang / byed pa'i dug gsum gzhil ba'o/ /dug gsad ①pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ dug gsum po de dag kyang rig sngags kyi gzi brjid kyis/ lus la zhugs pa thams cad kyang 'joms par byed pa'o/ /mtshams gcad ②pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ gsang sngags dang rig sngags kyi gsang sngags kyis bcing ba'i sar/ gzhan rnams kyis rgol dze+ebar mi nus so/ /sa bcing ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ des bcing ba'i sar sa g.yo ba drag po byung na yang bu'agul mi nus te de na yod pa'i 'byung po rnams kyis kyang gnod par mi nus so/ /lo brgya lon pa dang buzhes bya ba ni/ nad thams cad dang bral ④zhing bcud len gyi rang bzhin du rgas pa med pa'o/ /ston brgya mthong ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ nor phun sum tshogs pa ste/ rig sngags kyi gzi brjid kyis tshe ring zhing nad rnams dang bral te/ za ba dang 'thung ba dang ldan pa'o/ /kun dga' bo zhes bya ba ni/ dge slong sa ri mche ba'i dug gis zin pa'i gnod pa dang / sems can thams cad mche ba'i dug gis zin pa'i don la'o/ /khyod kyis zhes bya ba ni kun dga' bo la'o/ /rgyal po rnam dze+ethos kyi chos kyi spun gnod sbyin gyi ded dpon sde bo che rnams zhes bya ba ni/ mthu bo che sum cu rtsa gnyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung ⑧ba la gzi brjid che ba stobs che ba/grags pa dang ldan pa/ kha dog dang ldan pa④/ 'od dang ldan pa/ rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa/ lha dang lha ma yin gyi g.yul yang myong bar byed pa'o/ /gnod sbyin de rnams kyang bye ba 'bum phrag gnod sbyin 'khor du ma dang ldan pa'o//36—1331

gang dag sems can rnams srung ①zhing yongs su skyong bar byed pa zhes bya ba ni/sems can thams cad mthong ba dang dga' bas te/ de la gnod par mi byed cing / snying rje'i sems kyis khyab pa'o/ /'jig rten gyi yams kyi nad dang /gnod pa dang 'khrugs ②pa rnams med par byed pa zhes bya ba ni/ stong gsum gyi stong gi rngu'ajig rten gyi khams skad cig mas khyab ste/ gnod sbyin mthu bo che rnams kyis kyang nad thams cad bcom zhing sems can rnams la byams pa dang snying rje'i stobs kyis sems can rnams skyong ba'o/ /'jig rten la phan gdags pa'i phyir/ 'jig rten na rgyu ba rnams kyi ming zung shig ces bya ba ni/ mthu chen gnod sbyin gyi ded dpon sum cu rtsa ⑤gnyis/ 'jig rten gyi khams stong ༅ gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi ⑦sems can ma lus pa la phan par mdzad pa rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'di la rjes su yi rang zhing gus par byed pa'o—/ /'di lta ste zhes bya ba ni/ gnod sbyin gyi ded dpon mthu bo che sum cu rtsa gnyis blta'o④/ /dbang po dang zla ba dang chu lha dang skye dgu'i bdag po dang / ba ⑨ra dh+wa dza dang zhes bya ba ni stobs che la mthu che ba/ de rnams kyi sku ⑩mdog dang phyag mtshan ni ser po dang / dkar po dang / dkar ser dang /dmar po dang / nag po'o⑪/ /g.yas rnams na rdo rje dang / ri bong gi pags pa dang / sbrul kyi zhags pa dang / pad+ma dang / ral gri'o/ /g.yon rnams na mdung dang / zhags pa dang / lcags kyu dang / rtse gcig pa ⑫dang / dgra sta rnams so/ /dbang ldan dang / tsan+dan dang / 'dod pa'i gtso bo dang / mgrin ngan dang / mgul nges dang zhes bya ba ni/ gnod sbyin gyi ded dpon mthu chen de rnams rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba 36—1332

sems can rnams kyi don byed pa'o/ /de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/thal ba'i mdog dang mthing nag dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang /dkar po'o/ /g.yas pa rnams na rtse gsum dang tsan+dan gyi be+e con dang /mda' gzhu dang / dbyug to dmig ①can dang 'khor lo bsnams pa'o/ /g.yon rnams na phreng ba dang / bum pa dang / ne+e'u le'i rkyal snepa dang /rin po che dang / nor gyi rkyal pa'o④/ / ba ḍi dudang / nor bu dang / nor bu spyod pa ⑤dang / sgra rab dang / nye lnga po dang zhes bya ba ni/ de rnams kyis kyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ⑥ba dang / sems can rnams kyi don byed pa'o/ /de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/ ljang gu dang /sngo skya dang / dmar ser dang / mthing nag dang / dkar po'o/ /g.yas rnams na 'phang mdung dang / chu gri dang / to ma ⑦ra dang / rtse gcig dang /ral gri'o/ /g.yon rnams na ⑧me tog nā ga puṣ+pe ⑨dang / ut+pal dang /pad+ma dang / puṇ+ḍa rī ka dang / kun+da ⑩bsnams pa'o/ /ri mnyam dang /gser can dang / gang po dang / seng sdeng ba ⑪dang / g.yon can dang zhes bya ba ni mthu chen po de rnams kyis kyang rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba sems can gyi don byed pa'o/ /de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni dkar po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / nag po dang / ljang gu'o//g.yas rnams na rdo rje dang / rin po che dang / pad+ma dmar po dang / ral gri dang / rtse gcig bsnams pa'o/ /g.yon rnams na nor gyi rkyal pa dang /bum pa gang ba dang / rin chen gyi snod dang / 'bras kyi snye ma dang / rin chen snye ma bsnams pa'o⑫/ /gnod sbyin ba lang skyong dang / 'brog gnas 36—1333

dang / mi'i rgyal po dang / rgyal ba'i khyu mchog dang / tshigs lnga ser stipo dang zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi ②bstan pa srung ①ba/ sems can rnams la mi 'tshe ba'o/ /de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/ mthing nag dang /dmar nag dang / sngo bsangs dang / ljang nag dang / dkar ser ro /g.yas rnams na mda' gzhu dang / mdung dang / zhags pa dang / 'khor lo dang / dgra sta bsnams pa'o/ /g.yon rnams na mdung dudang a 'bras dang / bum pa spyi rjoblugs dang / bī dza pū rjor ka dang me tog gi phreng ba'o⑦//bzhin bzangs dang / gnod sbyin ring po 'khor dang bcas pa dang / dri sna tshogs dang / 'bras bu gsum pa dang / mgul ⑧gsum pa dang lcags mdung ring po dang / mi ⑨ldan pa ste zhes bya ba ste⑩/ de rnams kyis kyang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo'i bka' las mi 'da' ba'o/ /sems can rnams kyi don byed pa/ de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni dkar po dang / nag po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / ljang gu dang / sngo skya dang /dmar nag go/ /de rnams kyi g.yas na mdung rings ⑪dang / ral gri dang /'phang mdung dang rtse gsum dang rtse gcig dang gtun shing dang / to ma ra'o⑫//g.yon rnams na nor gyi rkyal ⑫pa dang / rin chen myu gu dang / 'bras kyi snye ma dang / rin chen snye ma dang / bum pa nor gyis gang ba dang / ne+e'u le'i rkyal pa dang / rin chen phreng ba'o/ /gnod sbyin de dag ni gnod sbyin chen po'o ⑫zhes bya ba ni/ sems can la 'tshe ba mi byed pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ⑫ba rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba'o/ /sde ⑩rnams kyi yongs su 'dren pa zhes bya ba ni/ lha dang lha ma yin rnams kyis ⑩rtsod pa las/ bye ba 36—1334
