dung phyur rnams kyi sde bo che gzhan rnams kyis mi thub pa/ rgyal ba rnam par rgyal ba gnod sbyin rnams kyi gtso bor 'gyur ba'o/ /rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni—/ stong gsum kyi ①stong gi 'jig rten kyi khams ri rab dang bcas pa skad cig thang cig yud tsam kyis 'khor ba'o/ /'od dang ②ldan pa zhes bya ba ni/rang gi kha dog gis rang gsal te/ 'jig rten khams gsal bar byed pa'o/ /kha dog dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni/ rang gi kha dog dang ldan pa kha dog de bkrag dang ldan pa'o/ /grags pa dang ldan pa ste zhes bya ba ni/ mthu chen sum cu rtsa gnyis / rgyal ba rnam par rgyal ba stong gsum kyi stong gi ①'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can rnams kyi don byed pa rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya duchen mo'i bka' las mi 'da' bar grags pa'o/ /rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu'i spun te zhes bya ba ni/ gnod sbyin de rnams dang / rdo rje spun rjodu grags pa/ de gnyis sangs rgyas kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba'o/ /rgyal po chen po rnam rjothos kyi bus/gnod sbyin 'di ni nga la rnam par 'tshe ba'o zhes bya ba ni/ gzhan yang dri za'i gdon nam/ grul bum gyi gdon nam/ klu'i gdon nam/ gnod sbyin gyi gdon la sogs pas glags ⑦tshol ba'o/ /gnod sbyin 'di ni ④mi gtong ngo zhes ⑨gang dag la go bar byed pa 'di dag ni zhes bya ba ni/ gzhan gnod par 'dod pa'i gnod sbyin rnams/ gnod pa mi ster ⑩bar rten kyi gang zag la srung ⑪ba grogs byed pa'o/ /rgyal po chen po rnam ⑫thos kyi bu'i spun te zhes bya ba ni/sems can la 'tshe bar mi sems pa/ mthu chen ⑫sum cu rtsa gnyis/ sde chen po gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po rnam thos sras kyi rdo rje spun no/ /de dag gis kyang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'dis bdag la srung ④ba gyis shig ces bya 36—1335

ba ni/ gang nas gang du rig sngags kyi rgyal mo ①la gus par byed ②na/ kha don byed pa dang / klog pa dang / mchod pa byed pa dang / bsnyen bkur byed pa dang / rgya cher spel ba dang / cho ga byed pa dang / srung ba byed pa dang / 'chang ba dang / bla mar byed pa dang / mchod pa ①byed pa rnams gnod sbyin gyi ded dpon rnams kyis gang zag de la srung rjobar 'gyur ro/ /sba ba la sogs ⑤zhes bya ba ni/ gnod sbyin de rnams kyis sba ba la sogs pa byed pa'o—/ /'thab pa dang / rtsod pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ dgra bo dang g.yul 'gyed pa dang / gzhan yang sems mi bde ba dang / the tshom med pa dang /nang 'thab pa dang / de rnams la yang gnod sbyin de rnams kyis srung rjob dang skyob par 'gyur ro/ /mtshang 'bru ba dang / 'thab mo dang zhes bya ba ni/gzhan rnams kyis sems mi bde zhing mtshang ⑦'bru bas te/ de rnams kyis mtshang ske'abrur mi ster te srung ⑨ba dang skyob par 'gyur te/ 'thab pa la yang de bzhin du srung ⑩bar 'gyur ro/ /'gyed pa las yongs su skyobs shig ces bya ba ni/ glo bur gyi bgegs rnams dang / bdud rnams kyis ⑪'tshe bar byed pa la yang srung ba dang skyob ⑫par byed pa'o/ /mi'i gdon dang zhes bya ba ni/rgyal po 'am chom rkun la sogs pa'o/ /mi ma yin pa'i gdon dang zhes bya ba ni/bdud rnams glags tshol ba'o/ /lha'i gdon dang zhes bya ba ni/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin la sogs pa 'dod lha rigs ⑫drug gi lha rnams so/ /klu'i gdon dang zhes bya ba ni/ klu'i rgyal po dga' bo la sogs pa rigs brgyad kyi klu rnams so—/ /lha ma yin gyi gdon rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ lha ma yin gyi rgyal po thags ④bzangs ris bye ba 'bum phrag dung phyur tsam lha ma yin rnams so/ /36—1336

rlung lha'i gdon dang zhes bya ba ni/ rlung lha'i rgyal po rnam par dga' byed la sogs pa rlung gi gdon bdun dang / bye ba khrag khrig dung phyur tsam mo/ /nam mkha' lding gi gdon dang zhes bya ba ni/ nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po gser mig la sogs pa bya khyung ①rigs lnga dang / de la sogs pa'i bye ba dung phyur tsam mo/ /dri za'i gdon dang zhes bya ba ni/ dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa la sogs pa de yang bye ba ②dung phyur tsam mo/ /mi'am ci'i gdon dang zhes bya ba ni/mi'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pa la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ /lto 'phye chen po'i gdon dang zhes bya ba ni/ lto 'bye'i rgyal po bzang po la sogs pa bye ba dung phyur tsam mo/ /gnod sbyin gyi gdon dang zhes bya ba ni/ gnod sbyin chen po lngas ①rtsen la sogs pa 'phrog ma'i bu lnga brgya dang bcas pa'o/ /srin po'i gdon dang zhes bya ba ni/ srin po'i rgyal po 'jigs pa 'khor dang bcas pa bye ba dung phyur tsam gnas pa'o/ /yi dwags kyi gdon dang rjozhes bya ba ni/ yi dwags 'gul 'joms la sogs pa bsam kyis mi khyab pa'o/ /sha za'i gdon dang zhes bya ba ni/ sha za gang la sogs pa du mar gnas pa'o/ /'byung po'i gdon dang zhes bya ba ni/ 'byung po lnga ldan la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o//grul bum gyi gdon dang zhes bya ba ni/ grul bum 'dzin mig la sogs pa du mar gnas pa'o/ /srul po'i gdon dang zhes bya ba ni/ srul po rab bzangs ④la sogs pa bye ba khrag khrig tsam gnas pa'o/ /lus srul po'i gdon dang zhes bya ba ni—/ rab bzangs rjochen po la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ /skem byed kyi gdon dang zhes bya ba ni/ skem byed mchu rings la sogs pa 'bum phrag bdun cur ⑦gnas pa'o/ /smyo byed kyi gdon dang zhes bya ba ni/ smyo byed nyi shu 36—1337

rtsa gnyis te/ sba ba sum 'gyur la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ /grib gnon gyi gdon dang zhes bya ba ni/ grib gnon 'bum la sogs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong tsam mo/ /brjed byed kyi gdon dang zhes bya ba ni/ nye ba'i bum pa la sogs pa bye ba du mar gnas pa'o/ /gnon po'i gdon dang zhes bya ba ni/gnon po mig mi bzang ①la sogs pa bye ba ②dung phyur tsam mo/ /rgyu skar gyi gdon dang zhes bya ba ni/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad de smin drug la sogs pa brjod kyis mi lang ba'o/ /byug pa'i gdon dang zhes bya ba ni/ byug pa dri la dga' ba ste gser thub la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab par gnas pa'o/ /de yang mi dang mi ma yin pa dang / lha dang klu dang / lha ma yin dang ④/ rlung dang / nam mkha' lding dang / dri za dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / gnod sbyin dang srin po dang / 'byung po dang / sha za dang /srul po dang / lus srul po dang / brjed ④byed dang / smyo byed dang /grib gnon dang / skem byed dang / gnon po dang / skar ma dang / byug 5pa'i gdon no rjo/ /de rnams gtso bor gyur pa stong phrag ⑦brgyad cur gnas te/nam mkha' la rgyu ba'i dus su ni ngang pa'i rgyal po bzhin no/ /sa steng ⑧la rgyu ba ni ⑨nyi ma'i rta bdun bzhin du skad cig mas gling bzhi khyab pa'o/ /sa 'og tu 'dzul ba ni byi ba bzhin du'o/ /de lta bu'i gdon sa bdag la sogs pa rgyu ba'i dus su sa bdag bzhin no/ /de bzhin du lha'i gdon la sogs pa thams cad sna tshogs kyi gzugs su bstan nas rgyu ba'o/ /yongs su skyobs thig ces bya ba ni/rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo'i gzi brjid kyis/ mthu chen sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis kyang lha'i gdon la sogs pa srung ⑩ba dang / skyob par byed pa'o/ /36—1338

gzi brjid 'phrog pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ gdon de rnams kyis ①gzi brjid 'phrog pa ste/ gdon gzhan yang 'od 'phrog pa lnga ⑧la sogs pa bsam gyis ①mi khyab pa'o/ /zas su mngal la rjoza ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ ser skya mo ste yi dwags so/ /de yang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ /zas su sha za ba dang zhes bya ba ni—/ srin mo pad+ma ste/ de la sogs pa bsam kyis mi khyab pa'o/ /zas su khrag 'thung ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ sha za mo ma he mo la sogs pa ste bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ /zas su zhag za ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ sa srin mo sdang mo du mar gnas pa'o/ /zas su tshil za ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ srin mo 'jigs can bye ba tsam du gnas pa'o/ /zas su rkang za ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ gnod sbyin me 'bar ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ /zas su btsas pa za ba dang zhes bya ba ni/sha za gtum mo bsam gyis rjomi khyab pa'o/ /srog 'phrog pa dang zhes bya ba ni/brjed byed ma bum pa can la sogs pa bye ba dung phyur gnas pa'o/ /zas su gtor ma za ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ gnod sbyin dri med la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ /zas su phreng ba za ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ lha mo nag mo bye ba dung phyur tsam mo/ /zas su dri za ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ dri za mo nag mo seng ge la sogs pa bye ba 'bum phrag du ma gnas pa'o/ /zas su bdug pa za ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ sa srin mo nag mo snang zhes bya ba rjol sogs pa bsam gyis ⑦mi khyab pa'o/ /zas su me tog za ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ klu mo 'od zer can zhes bya ba la sogs pa 'bum phrag khri tsam gnas pa'o/ /zas su 'bras bu za ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ sa bdag chu mo zhes bya ba ⑧la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o//zas su lo tog za ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ srin mo stobs can mo la sogs pa'o/ /36—1339

zas su bsreg ①bya za ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ sha za nag mo la sogs pa 'bum phrag khrir gnas pa'o/ /zas su rnag 'thung ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ sa srin mo glang chen mo la sogs pa brgya stong tsam gnas pa'o/ /zas su phyi sa za ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ sa srin mo sra ba mo la sogs pa ste ④bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ /zas su gcin 'thung ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ 'byung po mo gal sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ /zas su mchil ma 'thung ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ ro langs mo tiṅga dhil sogs pa brgyad khri 'bum du gnas pa'o/ /zas su ngar snabs za ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ ro langs chen mo dmar ser mo la sogs pa 'bum du gnas pa'o—/ /zas su snabs za ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ grul bum mo tshig ⑤pa la sogs pa bye ba dung phyur du rjoganas pa'o/ /zas su skyugs pa za ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ gnod sbyin mo gtum ⑦mo la sogs pa brgyad khrir gnas pa'o/ /zas su stor ⑧khung nas 'bab pa 'thung ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ gnon po grul bum nag mo la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ /za ba de rnams kyang stong phrag brgyad cur gnas pa/ chung ba ni yud tsam che ba ni dpag tshad lnga brgyar gzugs sprul pa'o/ /de rnams kyang rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa/ sems can rnams la gnod par byed pa'o/ /srung ba gyis shig ces bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo la gus pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams mthu chen sum cu rtsa gnyis gnod sbyin gyi ded dpon rnams kyis kyang srung ba dang skyob par 'gyur ro/ /sba ba la sogs pa zhes bya ba ni/ gong bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /gshed byed dang bsgyur ba'i las dang zhes bya ba ni/ 'byung po rnams kyis ⑨dbugs dang bral bar byed pa ste/ de gshed 'phrog pa'i 'jigs pa'o/ /lus ngag yid kyi 36—1340

las sgyur ①ba ste/ de las sgyur ②ba'i 'jigs pa lus mi bde ba/ ngag mi bde ba yid mi bde ba'o④/ /byad dang g.yengs byed dang zhes bya ba ni/ sngon gyi las dang da ltar byas pa ste/ las kyi dbang gis ma rig pa'i sems kyis byas pa'i byad rjodo/ /de'i dbang gis 'dar bar byed pa'i nad kyang 'byung po rnams kyis gtang rjoba'o zhes bya ba ni ma tshang ba dang / lhag pa dang / nor ba dang / 'joms pa dang / pho nya dang zhes bya ba ni/ gzhan rnams kyi nus pas gtang dhiba'o/ /'joms pa ni de 'joms pa'o/ /ro langs dang sems sgyur ⑦ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ sngags kyi ④nus pas ro langs par 'gyur ba ste/ de ma thul ba'o/ /rig pa'i sems ma rig pas bsgyur ba'o/ /sbod gtong ⑨dang / bza' nyes dang zhes bya ba ni/ gshin rje'am/ ma mo'am/'jig rten gzhan yang bsten par ⑩byas nas dmod mo byas pa'o/ /skar ma 'am/gza' 'am/ tshes ⑪grangs sam/ skad cig ma 'am/ ma mthun pa dang /chu tshod dang / dbyu ⑫gu dang / thun tshod ma 'dzom pa'o/ /gza' rang la sogs pa sems mi mthun pa'o/ /skyugs ⑫nyes dang zhes bya ba ni/ bad kan dang mkhris pa dang / rlung gi dbang gis ④ma zhu ba dang mi ⑫mthun pa ste/ de skyugs ⑩na nyes pa'o/ /yang na 'byung po'i dbang gis sman ma zhu zhing skyug par byed pa ste/ skyug pa ma thon pa dang / 'gags na skyugs ⑩nyes pa'o/ /gnod sgrib dang zhes bya ba ni/ de ltar ma rig pa'i dbang gis sgrib par 'gyur te—/ grib ma de gnod pas gnod sgrib po/ /de'i sdig mi mthong bar byed pa sgrib pa'o/ /gnod bltas spyodang zhes bya ba ni/ ma smin pa la smin par byas nas blta ba ste/ gnyan pa lta ba de gnod bltas so/ /bri nyes dang zhes bya ba 36—1341

ni—/ dkyil 'khor la sogs pa sgra ma mthun pa nyes pa'o/ /bsgom nyes dang zhes bya ba ni/ ye shes bzhag nas ma rig pa bsgoms te/ yang na log min tshodu go nas ma tshang bar bsgom sdepa'o/ /smad pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ gzhan rnams kyis zhe sdang gi dbang gis smad pa'o/ /skrag pa dang zhes bya ba ni/'jigs pas sems sgyur ①ba ste/ de yang g.yengs pa'o/ /rgyal po'i 'jigs pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ rang dbang med cing nor dang zhing la sogs pa 'phrog pa'o—/ /chom rkun kyi 'jigs pa dang / glang po che'i 'jigs pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ nor dang grogs la 'jigs pa ste/ de bzhin du glang po che'i 'jigs pa'o—/ /me'i 'jigs pa dang / chu'i 'jigs pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ rang gi khyim dang / gzhan rnams kyis 'ongs pa ste/ gru log pa dang / rab ma thar pa dang / de la sogs pa me dang chu'i 'jigs pa dang bral ba'o/ /pha rol gyi dmag tshogs kyi du'ajigs pa dang / mu ge'i 'jigs pa dang zhes bya ba ni—/ rgyal po'am gzhan pha rol gyi dgra bo sterjo/ de rnams kyi 'jigs pa dang / de rnams kyi lo tog 'joms pa dang / char mi 'bab pa che bar 'bab pa dang / byi ba dang / ne+e tsho rjodang / bung ba dang / ri bong dang /mchil pa dang / ser ba dang / lhags pa'i 'jigs pa la sogs pa'o/ /dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i ⑦'jigs pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba bcu drug go/ /seng ge dang / glang po che dang / rwa can la sogs pa dang / mtshon dang / chu dang / me dang / rims dang / 'byung po dang /thog mda' ⑧dang / thibs 'og dang / chom rkun dang / klu dang /bcon ⑨dang / dug dang / gza' dang / g.yengs pa'o/ /sa g.yo bas 36—1342

'jigs pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ stong gsum kyi stong 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sa ①dus gcig tu ②g.yo ba ste/ de 'byung ba'i dbang gis sa g.yo bar byed pa'o/ /gcan gzan khro bo'i 'jigs ④pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ seng ge dang / stag dang / dom dang / dred dang / chu srin la sogs pa'o/ /mi mdza' ba'i 'jigs pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ rogs shes dang / grogs dang / nye ba la sogs pa'o/ /'chi ba'i 'jigs pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ nad kyis thebs pa ste/gshin rje'i thag rjopas bcings pa'i dus su'o/ /'jigs pa thams cad las bdag la srung dhib gyis shig ces bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo'i gzi brjid kyis/ gnod sbyin gyi ded dpon dang / mthu bo che sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis srung ba rjodang / skyob par 'gyur ro/ /shu ba dang / g.ya' ba dang / mdze dang / 'brum bu phra mo dang / mtshan par rdol ba dang /phol mig dang / g.yan pa dang / me dbal dang / lhog pa dang zhes bya ba ni—/ de la sogs pa ⑦mdze rigs mi gcig pa bco brgyad de/ rlung dang bad kan dang / mkhris pa dang / chu ser las byung ba'o/ /shu ba ni chu ser sha dang pags pa las 'bab pa'o/ /g.ya' ba ni rlung dang ⑧chu ser pags pa las 'bab pa'o/ /mdze ni ⑨rlung dang mkhris pa dang bad kan la babs pa'o /'phrum ⑩bu phra mo ni tshad pa nang du shor nas mkhris pa las byung ba'o/ /mtshan ⑪par rdol ba ni rlung dang chu ser las byung ba'o/ /phol mig ni grang ba bzhin du 'byung ste rlung dang chu ser mkhris pa las byung ba'o/ /g.yan pa ni bad kan dang rlung las byung ba'o/ /me dbal ni mkhris pa las byung ba'o/ /lhog pa ni mkhris ⑫pa dang chu ser dang rlung las byung ba'o/ /gzhan yang 'bras dang dmu ⑫36—1343

chu dang sha bkra dang / lba ba la sogs pa yod desti/ mkhris pa dang / chu ser dang rlung las byung ba'o/ /'jigs pa las srung ②ba gyis shig ces bya ba ni/rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo'i gzi brjid dang stobs kyis/ gnod sbyin gyi ded dpon de rnams las kyang / srung ba dang skyob par 'gyur ro/ /klad pa na ba dang zhes bya ba la sogs pa ①ni/ rlung bad kan mkhris pa gsum gyis na ba'o/ /mgo lji zhing na ba ni rlung yin te/ yang zhing g.yo ba ni bad kan yin no/ /tsha zhing na ba ni mkhris pa'o/ /yang zhing stong sob pa ni rlung ngo / /lci zhing 'grib pa ni bad kan no/ /tsha zhing sto ba ni mkhris pa'o/ /de bzhin du nad gzhan la sogs pa yang shes par bya'o/ /rims nad med par gyis shig ces bya ba ni/ tshad pa las byung ba ste/ tshad pa de yang rlung las byung ba dang /bad kan las byung ba dang / mkhris pa las byung ba'o/ /nyin gcig pa dang /nyin gnyis pa dang / nyin gsum pa dang / nyin bzhi pa dang / nyin bdun pa dang / zla ba phyed pa dang / zla ba gcig pa dang / zla ba gnyis pa dang /yud tsam ④dang zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo'i bden pas/ rig sngags de rnams kyang rjomi snang bar 'gyur te/ ded dpon de rnams kyang srung ba dang skyob par 'gyur ro/ /rtag pa'i rims dang zhes bya ba ni/ bad kan dang rlung 'dom pa'o/ /rims ldang dub pa ④zhes bya ba ni/ tshad pa dang rlung shas che ba'o/ /'byung po'i rims dang zhes bya ba ni tshad pa ⑦drag por byung zhing rtsa rtsub pa'o/ /rlung las gyur pa dang / bad kan las gyur pa dang /mkhris pa las gyur pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ rlung ni g.yo bar byed pa'o/ /bad kan ni lci bar byed pa'o/ /mkhris pa ni tsha bar byed pa'o/ /'dus pa las 36—1344

gyur pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ de gsum 'dus pas na ①'dus pa'o/ /ldan pa ni gnyis gnyis ldan pas na ldan pa'o/ /rims thams cad dang / nad thams cad dang ②zhes bya ba ni/ tshad pa'i rigs ④mi gcig pa bcu gnyis so/ /nad ni nad rigs mi gcig pa bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'o/ /gdon thams cad dang zhes bya ba ni/ lha'i gdon la sogs pa stong phrag brgyad cu'o/ /dug thams cad dang zhes bya ba ni/ nang gi dug gsum phyi'i dug gsum mo/ /sdig pa thams cad dang zhes bya ba ni/ las dang bag chags shes bya'i sgrib pa'o/ /sdug bsngal thams cad dang zhes bya ba ni/ nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong dang / 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la sogs pa'o/ /'jigs pa thams cad bdag la med par kyis shig ces bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo'i gzi brjid kyis—/ gnod sbyin gyi ded dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / mthu bo che sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / sangs rgyas kyi rjobastan pa srung bub/ rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba/ srung rjob sems can gyi don byed pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo'i/ gnod sbyin gyi ded dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / mthu bo che sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi gnas ⑦skabs te bcu pa'o// //kun dga' bo zhes bya ba ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas bka' 6) pa'o/ /sha za chen mo bcu gnyis po 'di dag ni zhes bya ba ni 'jig rten gyi khams la dbang mdzad cing / mthu dang stobs dang ldan pa ste/yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ⑧bstan pa srung ⑨zhing rig sngags kyi ⑩bka' las mi 'da' ba'o/ /gang dag byang chub sems dpa' ⑪ma'i rum du 36—1345

zhugs pa na yang srung ①zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di'i gzi brjid kyis—/ mi chags pa chags par byed pa ste/ chags nas mer mer ba'i ④dus su srung ①ba/ skyes ma thag tu yang srung rjoba'o/ /btsa' kha dang btsas pa na yang bsrung ba dag go zhes bya ba ni/ ma skyes pa'i gong dang skyes ma thag tu yin te—/ rig sngags kyi ⑤gzi brjid kyis sha za mo chen mo bcu gnyis kyis srung bar byed do/ /bcu gnyis ni gang zhe rjon zhes bya ba ni/ sngon gyi las kyi 3 'phros sha za mor skyes shing / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ba'o/ /'di lta ste zhes bya ba ni/ sha za mo chen mo bcu gnyis blta'o⑧/ /phreng ma dang / rnam par phreng ma dang / rab tu phreng ma ⑨dang / kun du phreng ma dang / 'phrog ma dang / seng ge'i ral pa dang / spre'u ltar dmar ser dang / nag mo dang / mi bzad ma dang / dung mgrin ma dang / bya rog ma dang / bum bu'i ⑩lto ste zhes bya ba ni/ de bcu gnyis po ni/ shin tu mthu che zhing stobs dang ldan pa'o/ /de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/ dkar mo dang /nag mo dang / ser mo dang / dmar mo dang / ljang gu dang / dkar ser dang / dmar ser dang / mthing ga dang / dmar nag dang /dkar mo dang / sngo bsangs dang / dmar ser mo'o⑪/ /g.yas rnams na 'khor lo dang / rdo rje dang / rin po che dang / pad+ma dang / ral gri dang /me long dang / ut+pa la ser po dang / ut+pa la ⑫dmar po dang / ut+pa la sngon po dang / dung dang / lhung bzed dang / bum pa bsnams pa'o/ /g.yon rnams na zhags pa dang / ba dan dang / thod pa dang / dril bu dang / rtse gsum dang / dgra sta dang / lcags kyu dang / thod pa dang /36—1346

ral gri dang / mda' gzhu dang / phreng ba dang / dbyug pa gsum bsnams pa'o / /sha za chen mo 'di dag rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni/ stobs chen mo bcu gnyis ni/ sa 'og sa steng sa bla rnams rgyu ba ni/ skad cig mas rgyu ba'o/ /'od dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni/ rang gi 'od kyis rang gsal ba'o/ /kha dog dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni/ rang rang gi kha dog dkar po la sogs pas 1 mdzes par ldan pa'o/ /grags pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni/ 'jig rten gyi khams na grags pa'o/ /rdzu 'phrul che zhes bya ba ni/ nam mkha' la bya bzhin du rgyu ste/ chu la nya bzhin te/ sa la byi ba bzhin du 'dzul ba'o/ /lha dang lha ma yin gyi g.yul dag kyang myong bar byed pa dag go zhes bya ba ni/ lha dang lha ma yin 'thab rtsod la sde bo cher grags nas/ gang ②gi ngos nas grogs byas na rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /de dag gis kyang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'dis bdag la srung ④ba gyis shig ces bya ba ni gang zag 'di la gus par byed pa sha za chen mo bcu gnyis kyis kyang srung bar byed pa dag go/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di ni zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ sku mdog dkar mo/ g.yas mthing ga /g.yon dmar ba/ spyan gsum pa/ sangs rgyas lnga'i dbu rgyan can/dbu la 'khor los mtshan pa/ phyag g.yas rnams na gshol dang / gseg ④shang dang / 'khor lo'o/ /g.yon rma bya'i sgo dang / lhung bzed dang /zhags pa bsnams ⑤pa'o/ /rdo rje'i burigs ma/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs ma'o/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi spyoye shes gzugs kyi phung po'o/ /zhabs g.yas brgyang ④ba/ g.yon bskum pa'o/ /zla ba'i gdan la nyi ma'i 'od zer dang ldan pa/ thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa'i ngo bo nyid do/ /sba ba zhes 36—1347

bya ba ni/ 'byung po rnams kyis glags tshol ba las sba ba'o/ /yongs su bskyab pa dang ①zhes bya ba ni 'byung pos 'jigs pa rnams las bskyab pa'o/ /yongs su gzung ④ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ 'byung po rnams kyis gzung snebar 'dod pa mi snang bar mdzad pa'o/ /yongs su bskyang ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ rdo rje'i phung po btags nas gzhan rnams kyis glags mi rnyed pa'o/ /zhi ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ ma rungs pa'i 'byung po dang / yi dwags rnams zhi bas dbang du sdud pa'orjo—/ /bde legs su 'gyur ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ bkra shis shing phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /chad pa spang ba dang zhes bya ba ni 'byung po rnams kyi chad pa spang ba'o/ /mtshon cha spang ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ mtshon ⑤sna tshogs kyi dbus nas kyang mi tshugs pa'o/ /dug gzhil ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ 'od du ma bcug par sngar nas bkag pa'o/ /dug gsad rjopa dang zhes bya ba ni/'khor na yod pa nus pas gsad ⑦pa'o/ /mtshams gcad ⑧pa dang zhes bya ba ni/dpag tshad lnga brgya'i bar man chod bcad pa'o/ /sa bcing ba dang zhes bya ba ni 'og tu rlung gi dkyil 'khor yan chad do/ /lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig ces bya ba ni na tsha dang bral zhing gzhon nu'i tshul du gnas pa'o/ /ston brgya mthong bar shog shig ⑨ces bya ba ni⑩/ 'khor dang bu la sogs pa mang po mthong ba'o/ /de la sngags kyi ⑪tshig ni 'di rnams yin no zhes bya ba ni sha za bcu gnyis kyi srog snying rig sngags kyi rgyal mo'i las kyi snying po'o/ /tar+ya thā zhes bya ba ni rig sngags kyi gsang sngags 'og tu blta ⑫ste/ sngags ni/ ha re/ kha re la sogs pa'o/ /kun dga' bo zhes bya ba ni/ byang chub sems dpas bka' 6) pa'o/ /sha za chen mo brgyad po 'di dag ni zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi 36—1348

bstan pa srung ①ba dang / sems can rnams la phan par byed pa/ 'jig rten ②khams na grags pa'o/ /gang dag byang chub sems dpa' ma'i rum du zhugs pa na yang srung zhes bya ba ni/ 'di'i gzhung gis srung bar byed na sha za brgyad po dag ④gis srung bar byed do/ /btsa' kha dang btsas pa na rjoyang srung ba dag go zhes bya ba ni/ gzhan rnams bya ba'i gdon gyi dbang du mi 'gyur bar rig sngags kyi rgyal mo'i gzi brjid kyis srung bar byed pa'o/ /de dag kyang gang zhe na zhes bya ba ni/ brgyad pa ⑤dag stobs dang ldan pa/ mthu che ba dang ldan pa'o—/ /'di lta ste zhes bya ba ni brgyad pa rjodag 'og tu blta'o⑦/ /rgyags pa dang rgyags byed ma dang rgyags byed ⑧ma'i shas chen ma dang / nye rgyags ma dang /yi dwags mo dang / gzi byin 'phrog ma dang / za ba mo dang / 'cha' ba mo ste zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ba la gnas pa/ rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da'o/ /de'i sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni ser mo dang /dmar ser ⑨dang / dkar ser dang / sngo bsangs dang / ljang ser dang /dkar mo dang / dmar mo dang / nag mo'o/ /g.yas rnams na me long dang /dri'i phor ba dang / rin po che'i phreng ba dang / pi wang dang / gling bu dang /rnga dang rnga rked nyag dang / rnga rings so/ /g.yon rnams na lhung bzed bsnams pa'o/ /sha za mo brgyad po 'di dag ni rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni rdzu 'phrul che zhing 'jig rten khams na rgyu ba'o/ /'od dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni 'od zer gyis ⑩snang ba ste/ 'od des gzhan yang khyab pa'o/ /kha dog dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni/ rang gi kha dog dang ⑩ldan pa'o/ /grags pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni/ khams gsum tsam yang grags pas khyab pa'o/ /rdzu 'phrul che 36—1349

ba dang ldan ①zhes bya ba ni/ sa 'og sa steng sa bla skad cig mas rgyu ba'o/ /lha dang lha ma yin gyi g.yul dag kyang myong bar byed pa dag go zhes bya ba ni lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / lha ma yin gyi rgyal po thags bzangs ②ris kyi 'thab rtsod dang / grogs byed par snang ba'o/ /de dag gis kyang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'dis/ srung ①ba gyis shig ces bya ba ni gang zag dag gis rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di la gus par rjobyas shing rjes su yi rang ste/ de'i yon tan gyis ⑤sha za chen mo brgyad po dag gis kyang srung rjobar bgyid pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo ni zhal gsum phyag drug pa sku mdog ser mo⑦/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi dbu rgyan can spyan gsum pa dbu la rin po ches brgyan pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /g.yas pa gsum na rin po che dang / gtun shing dang / dgra sta bsnams pa'o/ /g.yon gsum na/rma bya'i sgo/ rtse gsum dang / lcags kyu bsnams pa'o/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi rang bzhin tshor ba'i phung po rin po che'i rigs thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa g.yas brkyang ba g.yon bskum pa'o/ /zla ba'i gdan la nyi ma'i 'od dang ldan pa'o/ /sba ba la sogs pa zhes bya ba ni/ gong du bshad pa bzhin no/ /tar+ya ④thā zhes bya ba ni 'di lta ste/ sha za mo brgyad po'i srog snying dang rig sngags las kyi snying po blta'o⑨/ /rig sngags kyi gsang sngags ni/ ha re/kha re la sogs pa'o/ /kun dga' bo ⑩zhes bya ba ni/ thugs rje chen pos kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa'o/ /sha za chen mo sha dang ⑩khrag za ba mi dag ⑫la rnam par 'tshe ba bdun po 'di dag ni zhes bya ba ni 'jig rten khams rgyu zhing /skyes pa dang bud med la gnod pa byed ba ste/ 'thab rtsod la dga' bar byed pa 36—1350

ste—/ pho mo lceb pa'i sems su byed pa'am/ byes pa rnams la gnod pa ste/de bzhin du sems can rnams la glags tshol ba'o/ /de bzhin du glags ①tshol zhing khrag la dga' ba'o/ /gang dag byang chub sems dpa' ma'i rum du zhugs pa na yang srung ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo'i dbang gis 'dus pa ste/ sha za bdun po de dag kyang de dag gi rig sngags kyi gzi brjid kyis srung bar byed pa'o/ /btsa' kha ②dang btsas pa na yang srung bar byed pa dag go zhes bya ba ni gzhan gyi dbang du mi 'gyur bar sha za mo de rnams kyis srung ④ba'o/ /de dag kyang gang zhe na ༷zhes bya ba ni sha za mo bdun po mthu che zhing rjostobs dang ldan pa/ bzhin mi sdug pa khro mo nad thams cad gtong ba/ sems can rnams 'jigs par byed pa'o/ /'di lta ste zhes bya ba ni 'og tu blta'o/ /rab 'char ldan dang / srung ba mo dang rjo/ sha za phra ⑦mo dang / gang ba bzang mo ⑧dang / me srung ma dang / mdza' mo nag mo dang drang srong srung ⑨ma ste zhes bya ba ni de rnams kyis kyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung ba dang /rig sngags kyi ⑩bka' las 'da' mi nus pa'o/ /de rnams kyi ⑪sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni dmar po dang ljang nag dang / sngon mo dang / dmar nag dang /mthing nag dang / nag mo dang / thal ba'i mdog can no/ /g.yas rnams na gri gug dang / rtse gsum dang / dgra sta dang / zhags pa dang /lcags kyu dang / snying dang / sbrul gyi zhags pa bsnams pa/ g.yon rnams na thod pa khrag gis gang ba bsnams pa'o/ /sha za chen mo bdun po 'di dag ni rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni/ gzhan rnams gnod pa skyel ba'i phyir gzugs che bar bstan te/ ri rab tsam bstan no/ /chung ba ni ba sru'i rtse mo 36—1351

tsam ①bstan te/ de lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa'o/ /'od dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni/ de'i 'od kyis sems can gyis lta mi nus pa'o/ /kha dog dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni/ kha dog drag pos te/ me'i tshul du snang ba'o/ /grags pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni gnod sbyin 'jig rten gyi khams su grags pa'o/ /rdzu 'phrul che ba ⑤zhes bya ba ni/ skad cig mas phyi'i rgya mtsho dang / ri rab kyi rtse mo la rgyu ba'o/ /lha dang lha ma yin gyi g.yul dag kyang myong bar byed pa dag go zhes bya ba ni/ drag po'i tshul gyis lha dang lha ma yin la grogs byed pa dag go/ /de dag gis kyang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'dis bdag la srung ba gyis shig ces bya ba ni/ gang zag 'di la gus pa dang srung bar byed na/ de rnams kyis gnod mi nus shing glags ①tshol bar mi nus pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo ④ni zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ sku mdog dmar mo cung zad khro ba/g.yas dkar g.yon mthing ga dbu la rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan can pad+mas dbu la mtshan pa/ rgyan thams cad rin po ches brgyan pa/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes pad+ma'i rigs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa/ zla ba'i gdan la nyi ma'i 'od dang ldan pa/ thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa'o/ /sba ba la sogs pa zhes bya ba ni—/ sngar bshad pa bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /tar+ya thā zhes bya ba ni/ 'di lta ste/ gang blta zhe snyen/ sha za mo rnams kyi srog snying dang / rig sngags kyi 6las kyi snying po'o/ /rig sngags kyi gsang sngags ni/ ha re/ kha re la sogs pa'o—/ /kun dga' bo zhes bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa'o//srin po chen po sha dang khrag za ba mi dag la rnam par 'tshe ba lnga po 'di dag ni zhes bya ba ni/ phyi'i rgya mtsho'i 'gram du grong khyer laṅka ⑦na srin po lnga po stobs 36—1352

dang ldan pa/ mthu che ba skad cig mas gling bzhir ①rgyu ba/ skyes pa pho mo la gnod pa/ sha khrag la dga' ba/ sems can thams cad la gnod pa ④byed pa'o—/ /gang dag byang chub sems dpa' ma'i rum du zhugs pa na yang srung ④zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo'i gzi brjid dang / stobs dang mthu'i nus pas srin po de dag gis kyang rig sngags kyi bka' las 'da' bar mi nus pa de'i nus pas budang po yang srung ba/ bar du yang srung ba/ tha mar yang srung ba'o—/ /btsa' kha dang btsas pa na yang srung bar byed ces dhibya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi bka'i nus pas skye ba la yang dag par srung ste/ skyes nas kyang tshe ma zad kyi dhibar du srung ba'o/ /lnga po de dag kyang gang zhe na zhes bya ba ni gzugs che zhing bzhin mi sdug pa sems can la 'jigs pa dang / skrag par byed pa rmi lam na yang sdig par rmi ba de dag lnga po'o// //'di lta ste zhes bya ba ni srin mo ⑦lnga po blta'o/ /gtum mo skedang /des gtum mo ⑨dang / dga' mo ⑩dang / khyab 'jug len dang / ser skya mo ⑫ste zhes bya ba ni gsus pa che ba/ mig dmar ba/ skra gzings pa⑩/ de rnams kyi kha dog dang / phyag mtshan ni dkar po dang / nag po dang /ser po dang / dmar mo ⑫dang / ljang gu'o/ /g.yas rnams na sbrul gyi zhags pa dang / bdud kyi zhags pa dang / gri khyer dang ⑫/ lcags kyu dang /ral gri bsnams pa/ g.yon rnams na thod pa dang / mi mgo dang / thal ba'i snod dang / snying dang mi'i pags spyopa bsnams pa'o/ /srin mo ⑩lnga po 'di dag ni/ rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni nye ba'am bu'am bu mo'i ⑪gzugs su byas nas gnod pa skyel te/ la la bya'i gzugs sam/ khyi'i ⑫36—1353

gzugs sam/ rma bya dang / khrung khrung gi gzugs su byas nas rdzu 'phrul du sprul pa'o/ /'od dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni/ gzhan gyis kyang 'di ①drag po mthong ste/ 'od de yang me lce 'bar ba'i 'od dang 'dra ba'o/ /kha dog dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni so so ⑧rang rang gi kha dog dang ldan pa'o/ /grags pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni/ 'jig rten gyi khams su grags pa'o/ /rdzu 'phrul che ba zhes bya ba ni/ skad cig mas gling la rgyu nus pa'o①/ /lha dang lha ma yin gyi g.yul dag kyang myong bar byed pa rjozhes bya ba ni/ drag po'i tshul gyis g.yul las bzlog nus te/ 'thab rtsod byed pa la rem pa'o/ /de dag gis kyang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'dis bdag la srung ba kyis shig ces bya ba ni/gang zag gis 'di la rjogus par bsrung dhib dang skyabs su gsol na/ srin po de dag gis kyang mi tshugs pa/ rig sngags kyi ngo bo nyid thob pa'o rig sngags kyi ngo bo gang zhe na/ thabs dang shes rab kyi rang bzhin te/ thabs kyi ngo bo ni/ sku mdog ⑦dang phyag mtshan bstan pa/ shes rab kyi ngo bo ni bya ba nan tan kyi ye shes so/ /zhal gsum pa phyag drug pa/ sku mdog ljang gu'o/ /g.yas dkar ba/ g.yon dmar ba/ spyan gsum pa/ dbu la rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan can/ spyi bo'i ⑧gtsug na sna tshogs rdo rjes brgyan pa/ las kyi rigs 'du byed kyi phung po'o/ /g.yas rnams na ral gri dang / sna tshogs rdo rje dang / gtun shing bsnams pa/ g.yon rnams na rma bya'i sgo dang /zhags pa dang / lcags kyu bsnams pa'o/ /rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /g.yas brkyang ba g.yon bskum pa zla ba'i gdan dang nyi ma'i 'od zer dang ldan pa/thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa'o/ /sba ba la sogs pa zhes bya ba ni/ de lta 36—1354

bu'i rig sngags kyi rang bzhin te①/ srung ba dang skyob pa dang skyong ba la sogs pa byed pa'o/ /tar+ya thā zhes bya ba ni ④'di lta ste de rnams kyi srog snying dang rig sngags kyi ①las kyi snying por blta'orjo/ /rig sngags kyi gsang sngags ni/ ha re/kha re la sogs pa'o/ /kun dga' bo zhes bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa'o/ /srin po chen po sha ⑤dang khrag za ba/ mi rnams la rnam par 'tshe ba brgyad po 'di dag ni zhes bya ba ni/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgyu zhing glags tshol ba ste/ sbyo ba dang / lceb dupa dang / khro ba dang / gtum ⑦pa dang /'thab pa dang / rtsod pa dang / g.yul du zhugs shing / mi rnams la 'tshe bar byed pa ste/ rims nad dang / khrag nad gtong bar byed pa dag go/ /gang dag byang chub sems dpa' ma'i rum du zhugs pa na yang srung zhes bya ba ni/rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo'i gzi brjid kyis 'di la gus par byed pa tsam la/ gnod pa bcings pa ste/ gang zag gi thog ma dang / tha ma bar du bsrung ⑧ba'o/ /btsa' kha dang btsas pa na yang srung ba dag go zhes bya ba ni skyes pa'i dus ⑨nas rgas pa'i bar du bsrung ste/ glo bur kyi rkyen yang mi gtong ba'o—/ /de dag kyang gang zhe na zhes bya ba ni gzugs che zhing bzhin mi sdug pa gsus pa che ba/ mgo che ba/ mig kyang glog dang 'dra ba/ smin ma khro gnyer can skra kham nag gyen du ⑩gzings pa/ skad che ba sbom pa/ sems can rnams la 'jigs pa dang / skrag par byed pa'o/ /'di lta ste zhes bya ba ni/'jigs pa dang skrag par byed pa brgyad pa'o/ /blta ba'o/ /glen ma ⑪dang /mtshams bzang ma ⑫dang / ku sha lta bu'i mig can ma dang / skra can dang /kam po dzi ⑫dang / rab mdzes ma sprestedang / mig dmar mo sprenyedang / mi 36—1355

bzad ma ①ste zhes bya ba ni/ mthu che zhing stobs dang ldan pa ste/ mi rnams la 'tshe ba la dga' ba'o/ /de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni nag po dang /sngo bsangs dang / ljang nag dang / mthing nag dang / dmar nag dang /thal ba'i mdog can dang / sngo skya dang / ljang gu'o/ /g.yas rnams na mdung dang / 'phang mdung dang / rtse gcig dang / tom ra ⑤dang /gtun shing dang 1/ 'khor lo dang mda' gzhu dang / rtse gsum bsnams ④pa'o—/ /g.yon rnams na zhags pa dang / sbrul dang mi snying dang / mi mgo dang / mi'i pags ⑤pa dang / rgyu zhags dang / thod pa dang / mi ro bsnams pa'o/ /dri mi zhim pa sbrul kyis brgyan pa'o/ /gcer bur gnas pa/mi'i zhing lpags gon pa'o/ /de dag ni sha dang khrag za ba zhes bya ba ni/ mdza' ba ⑥mi mdza' bar bya ste/ 'thab rtsod kyi sems bcug nas mtshon kyis mtshon 'gyed par byed pa nye ba dang dme ⑦'khrug par byed pa la dga' ba'o/ /skyes pa dang bud med dang / sgo dang / bu mo dag kyang 'phrog pa zhes bya ba ni/de rnams dang phrad glags med pa/ gal te phrad par gyur na/ srog 'phrog pa gong ngam/ grong khyer ram/ ljongs sam/ grong rdal lam/ pho brang dag la rgyu ba sems can rnams la 'tshe bar byed cing / srog 'phrog pa/ khye'u bu mo mngal na yod pa yang 'phrog pa ste/ de sha khrag rnag la dga' ba'o/ /grong ⑧du zhugs pa'i khyim bdag ⑨dang / khang stong la brten pa zhes bya ba ni/ shin tu rang gi rigs sdang ba la srung ⑩ba/ stong pa'i nang du gzugs mi snang bar 'dod pa/ yang na gzugs kyi rang bzhin ma yin te/ yid kyi rang bzhin du yod pa/ gzugs mi snang ba'o/ /mun pa'i 'od 'gro ba rjes su 'gro ba/ sgra 36—1356

'byin pa zhes bya ba ni/ dur khrod dam/ lam rgya gram mam/ sum mdo 'am/pho brang ngam de rnams mun pa la rgyu zhing / 'jigs pa dang / skrag par byed pa ste/ de bzhin du mi rnams la gnod pa ①byed pa'o/ /mi 'di rnams kyi mdangs 'phrog par byed pa che ba'o zhes bya ba ni/ mi rnams kyi gzi brjid 'phrog pa/ sems can rnams ②la 'tshe bar grags pa/ shu ba dang / g.ya' ba ①dang / mdze dang / phol mig dang / sha bkra dang / 'bras dang /g.yan ④pa dang / dmu buchu dang / de la sogs pa'i nad rnams gtong bar byed pa dag go/ /de dag ni snying rje med cing/ mi'i rjoskye dgu skrag par byed pa ste zhes bya ba ni srin mo spyobargyad po de dag kyang sems can rnams la rtag tu 'tshe ba ste/ shan pa bzhin du sems can la byas pa ste/ sha khrag la de bzhin du dga' ba ste/ srin mo ⑧de dag ni 'jigs par snang ngo / /srin mo ⑨chen po brgyad po de dag ni rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni/ tshan gcig la ⑩'tshe ba'i dus su gzugs che bar bstan te/ tshan gcig ba spu'i bu ga nas ⑪bzung nas gnod pa ⑫byed pa'o/ /'od dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni/ me dpung 'bar ba'i 'od zer dang ldan pa/ de dag gi ⑫'od zer kha dog drug dang ldan pa'o/ /kha dog dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni/ so so (sngerang rang gi kha dog dang ldan pa/de'i kha dog gis mdzes par snang ba'o/ /grags pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni/'jig rten gyi khams kyi nang na grags pa'o/ /rdzu 'phrul che ba zhes bya ba ni/skad cig mas gling bzhir ⑫rgyu ba'o/ /lha dang lha ma yin gyi g.yul dag kyang myong bar byed pa dag go zhes bya ba ni/ de gnyis 'thab pa'i dus su yang de rnams kyis ⑩'thab rtsod byed pa ste/ shin tu stobs dang ldan pa/ mthu che bar 36—1357

—grags pa'o/ /de dag gis kyang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'dis bdag la ①srung ba gyis shig ces bya ba ni/ gang zag gis 'di la gus par byed pa'i sems can brgyad po de dag gis srung bar byed de/ gnod pa drag pos gnod par mi nus pa/ rig sngags kyi bka' las 'da' bar mi nus pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi ngo bo ni mtshon bya ni me long lta bu'i ye shes te/ shes rab lta bu'o/ /mtshon byed ni gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ rig sngags kyi rgyal ②mo'i bdag nyid do//de yang rdo rje'i rigs rnam par shes pa'i phung po'o/ /ye shes lnga'i ngo bo nyid zhal gsum phyag drug pa sku mdog mthing gar bzhugs pa'o/ /zhal gsum du snang ba ni sku gsung thugs kyi rnam par dag pa'o/ /sku mdog mazing gar snang ba ni—/ byams pa yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /spyan gsum du snang ba ni ye shes gsum du rnam par dag pa'o/ /khro bor snang ba ni ma lus sems can yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'o/ /thod pa lnga'i dbu rgyan ni/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga bor nas ye shes lngar ①shar ba'o/ /dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar ba ni theg pa sna tshogs bstan pa'o/ /dbu la rdo rjes mtshan ⑦pa ni rdo rje'i rigs kyi rnam par dag pa'o/ /khro gnyer du bstan pa ni theg pa gsum dang ldan pa'o/ /mche ba gatshigs pa ni/ kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i rang bzhin bstan pa'o/ /sbrul gyis yan lag brgyan pa ni nang gi dug dang phyi'i dug bcom pa'o/ /phyag drug dang ldan pa ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa'o/ /g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa ni mya ngan dang srid pas ma gos pa'o/ /zla ba'i gdan la nyi ma'i 'od dang ldan pa ni thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa'i brda bstan pa'o/ /pad+ma brgyad pa'i gdan ni rnam par thar pa brgyad do/ /phyag g.yas na ral gri 36—1358

bsnams pa ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rnam par dag pa'o/ /de'i 'og rdo rje bsnams pa ni①/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin dag pa'o/ /tha ma gtun shing bsnams pa ni/ theg pa du ma rnam par dag pa'o/ /g.yon rma bya'i sgro bsnams pa ni dug gsum rnam par 'joms pa'o/ /bar ma na zhags pa bsnams pa ni/bdud bzhi bcing ba'o①/ /tha ma na rtse gsum bsnams pa ni/ srid gsum rnam par 'joms pa'o/ /ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin rnam par bstan pa ni/rig sngags kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid du bstan pa'o/ /me long lta bu'i ye shes ni 'jig rten gyi khams me long lta bu ste/ sgyu ma lta bu ①snang ba rnam par dag pa'o / /de lta bu'i rig sngags la gang zag dag gis mos par gyur na/brgyad po de dag gis gnod par mi nus te/ de rnams kyis kyang mchod par 'os pa'o/ /sba ba la sogs pa zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo de'i rjogazi brjid kyis sba ba la sogs pa'o/ /tar+ya thā zhes bya ba ni 'di lta ste/brgyad po'i srog snying dang rig sngags kyi las kyi snying po'o/ /rig sngags kyi gsang sngags ni/ ha rjore/ kha re la sogs pa'o/ /kun dga' bo zhes bya ba ni go ta mas bka' stsal pa'o/ /srin mo chen mo bcu po 'di dag ni zhes bya ba ni/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung rjozhing / rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba/sems can rnams kyi don byed pa'o/ /gang dag byang chub sems dpa' ma'i rum du zhugs ⑦na yang srung sgezhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' bar byang chub sems dpa'i rgyu can sems can ma'i ⑨sa bon srung ba'o/ /btsa' kha dang btsas pa na yang bsrung ba ⑩dag go zhes bya ba ni/ rgyu'i byang chub sems dpa'i ⑫phung po lnga'i rang bzhin rgyu'i sems dpas bsrung ba'o/ /de dag 36—1359

kyang gang zhe na zhes bya ba ni/ bcu po srin mo'i rang bzhin rnam par byun pa hūṃlas byung ba sems can kyi don mdzad pa'o/ /'di lta ste zhes bya ba ni/srin mo bcu por blta'o du/ /srin mo 'phrog ma dang / srin mo dga' mo dang /srin mo dmar ser mo dang / srin mo dung can ma ①dang / srin mo lus las byung ④ma dang / srin mo lha bshos ma rjodang / srin mo bum pa ma dang /srin mo me tog kun+da'i ⑥mche ba can dang / srin mo 'phyang ma dang / srin mo me ste ⑦zhes bya ba ni/ de rnams ni stobs che zhing mthu che ba ste/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung ba ste/ sems can kyi don mdzad pa'o/ /de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/ ser mo dang / nag mo dang / dmar ser ma dang / dkar mo dang / sngo skya dang / dmar mo dang / ljang gu dang / dkar ser dang / mthing ga dang / gser kyi mdog can ma'o/ /g.yas rnams na ut+pal dang / pad+ma dang / pad+ma dmar po dang / dung dang 'khor lo dang / kun+da dang me tog sun+da 0dang puṇ+ḍa rī ⑨ka dang / ut+pal ser po bsnams pa'o/ /g.yon rnams na lhung bzed bsnams ⑩pa'o/ /srin mo chen mo bcu gnyis po 'di dag ni rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni/ gong nas gong ⑪du 'gro ba skad cig mas slebs te/ char dang me 'bar bar nus so//'od zer dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni/ rang gi 'od zer kyis dpag tshad lnga brgya yang gsal lo/ /de bzhin du gzhan yang gsal lo/ /kha dog dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni/ rang rang gi kha dog mdzes pa dang ldan pa'o/ /grags pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni/ 'jig rten gyi khams su dge bar ⑫grags pa'o/ /rdzu 'phrul che ba zhes bya ba ni/ khams gsum du skad cig mas rgyu ba ste/ sems 36—1360

can gyi don la rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa'o/ /lha dang lha ma yin gyi g.yul dag kyang myong bar byed pa dag go zhes bya ba ni/ lha dang lha ma yin gyi 'thab rtsod la stobs dang ldan zhing mthu dang ldan pa'o/ /de dag gis kyang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'dis bdag la srung ①ba gyis shig ces bya ba ni/ gang zag gang gis rig sngags kyi rgyal mo la gus par byas te/ de'i gzi brjid kyis srin mo bcu gnyis po 'di ②dag gis srung ba dang skyob par byed pa'o/ /rig sngags rgo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ①pa/ sku mdog dkar mo sa'i khams kyi rang bzhin/dbu la 'khor los mtshan rjopa/ spyan gsum pa rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan can/ ye shes lnga dang ldan pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ g.yas pa gnyis na 'khor lo dang me long bsnams pa⑤/ g.yon gnyis na rma bya'i sgo dang rin po che bsnams pa'o/ /zhabs g.yas pa brkyang ba g.yon pa bskum pa/ zla ba'i gdan la nyi ma'i 'od dang ldan pa'o/ /sba ba la sogs pa zhes bya ba ni gong bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /tar+ya thā zhes bya ba ni 'di lta ste de rnams kyi srog snying dang rig sngags kyi snying por blta'orjo/ /rig sngags kyi gsang ⑦sngags ni/ ha re—/ kha re la sogs pa'o/ /kun dga' bo zhes bya ba ni shākya seng ge'i thugs rjes dgongs nas bka' stsal pa'o/ /srin mo chen mo bcu gnyis po 'di dag ni zhes bya ba ni de dag gis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung ⑧ba sems can gyi don mdzad pa'o/ /gang dag byang chub sems dpa' ⑨ma'i rum du zhugs pa na yang srung ⑫zhes bya ba ni rgyu'i sems dpa' mngal na srung ste/ de yang bar du srung ⑪/tha mar yang srung ba'o/ /btsa' kha dang btsas pa na yang srung ba dag go zhes bya ba ni ma btsas pa nas bsrung ste⑫/ skyes nas ⑫lo brgya bcu gnyis bar du 36—1361

bsrung ba'o①/ /de dag kyang gang zhe na zhes bya ba ni byang chub sems dang ldan pa/srin mo bcu gnyis stobs dang ldan pa mthu che ba dag go/ /'di lta ste zhes bya ba ni srin mo rnams blta'o②/ /srin mo mgon ①med ma dang / srin mo rgya mtsho ma dang / srin mo drag mo dang / srin mo srog 'phrog ma dang / srin mo rig ma dang / srin mo gzhu 'dzin ma dang / srin mo mda' 'dzin ma dang / srin mo ral gri 'dzin ma dang / srin mo gshol 'dzin ma dang / srin mo 'khor lo 'dzin ma dang / srin mo khor yug dang / srin mo 'jigs byed ma ste rjozhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung ⑤zhing sems can gyi don byed pa byang chub sems ma'i rang bzhin no/ /de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/mthing ga dang / dkar mo dang / sngo bsangs dang / dmar mo dang /ser mo dang / sngon mo dang / ljang gu dang / dmar ser dang / dkar ser dang / dud ka dang / ljang nag dang / nag mo'o/ /g.yas rnams na bum pa dang / ral gri dang / bum pa'i spyi blugs dang / phreng ba dang /dung dang / gzhu dang / mda' dang / ral gri dang / gshol dang /'khor lo dang / mdung rtse gsum dang / dgra sta bsnams pa'o/ /g.yon rnams na rin po che'i myu gu bsnams pa'o/ /srin mo chen mo bcu gnyis po 'di dag ni/ rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni gzugs sna tshogs sprul zhing /rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs byed pa'o/ /'od dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni rang gi 'od kyis 'ugasal ba'o/ /kha dog dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni rang gi ⑦kha dog dang mdzes par ⑧ldan pa'o/ /grags pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni 'jig rten gyi khams na grags pa'o/ /rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni/ skad cig mas gang du 36—1362

yang 'khor ba'o/ /lha dang lha ma yin kyi g.yul ①yang myong bar byed pa dag go zhes bya ba ni lha dang lha ma yin 'thabs ②pa'i dus su yang rdzu 'phrul snang ba'o/ /de dag gis kyang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'dis bdag la srung ①ba gyis shig ces bya ba ni/ gang zag gis rig sngags 'di la gus par byas na/ rig sngags kyi gzi brjid kyis de rnams kyis srung ba dag go/ /rig sngags ni zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ sku mdog ser mo chu'i khams/ sangs rgyas lnga'i dbu rgyan can/ spyan gsum pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa dbu la rin po ches mtshan pa/ ye shes lnga dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas pa gnyis na/ rdo rje dang ut+pal ser po bsnams pa/ g.yon pa gnyis na rma bya'i sgro dang dung ser po bsnams pa'o/ /g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa/ zla ba'i gdan la nyi ma'i 'od dang ldan pa/ thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa'o/ /sba ba dang zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni/ gong bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /tar+ya thā zhes bya ba rgo 'di lta ste/ srin mo bcu gnyis kyi srog sngags dang rig sngags kyi snying po'o/ /rig sngags kyi gsang sngags ni/ ha re/ kha re la sogs pa'o/ /kun dga' bo zhes bya ba ni bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa'o/ /ma mo bcu gnyis po zhes bya ba 'di dag rjoni/ lha dang lha ma yin gyi khrag khrug dus su phyung zhing /lha ma yin rnams 'dul bar byed pa/ da ltar mi'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi gnod byed dang phan dubyed pa'o/ /gang dag byang chub sems dpa' ma'i rum du zhugs pa na yang srung zhes bya ba ni/ 'jig rten gyi mar grags shing dbang phyug mar 'gyur te/ de rnams kyis kyang rgyu'i byang chub sems dpa' srung ba'o/ /btsa' kha dang btsas pa na yang srung zhing zhes bya ba ni/ dang po skye khar srung ste/36—1363

bar ma skyes nas kyang srung ngo ①/ /tha ma rgas ka na yang srung ba'o/ /gang dag sems can la gnod par byed pa rngu/skrag par byed pa rnam ①par 'tshe ba dag go zhes bya ba ni khams gsum tsam la skad cig mas rgyu zhing bcu gnyis po de dag gis kyang / sha khrag la dga' zhing 'jig rten tsam la gnod byed dang dhiphan byed pa'o/ /de dag kyang gang zhe na zhes bya ba ni/ 'jig rten gyi ma mo bcu gnyis mthu dang stobs dang ldan pa'o/ /'di lta ste zhes bya ba ni/ ma mo bcu gnyis por blta'o⑤/ /tshangs pa'i chung ma dang / drag po'i chung ma dang /gzhon nu'i chung ma dang / khyab 'jug gi chung ma dang / phag gi chung ma dang /dbang po'i chung ma dang / lus ngan gyi chung ma dang / rlung lha'i chung ma dang /gshin rje'i chung ma dang / rlung gi chung ma dang / me'i chung ma dang / nag ⑥mo chen mo ste zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung ba dang / rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba'o/ /de rnams kyi phyag mtshan dang sku mdog ni zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa'o/ /tshangs pa mo la sogs pa rim bzhin du g.yas rnams na phyag 'tshal ba dang / bum pa dang / rtse gsum dang / ⑦a 'bras dang / rtse gcig dang / phreng ba dang / 'khor lo dang / a 'bras kyi snying po'o/ /rdo rje dang / thod pa dang / nya dang / dgra sta dang / rin po che dang / nor gyi rkyal ⑤pa dang / sbrul kyi zhags pa dang / dung dkar po dang / be+e con dang / gri gug dang / rlung 'khril ⑨dang / rtse gsum dang / rtse gcig dang / phreng ba dang / gri gug dang / rtse gsum mo/ /g.yon rnams na rim pa bzhin du/ dbyu ⑩gu gsum dang phreng ba byeng ba ⑩dang /thod pa dang ⑫/ phreng ba dang rma bya'i sgo'o/ /dbyug to dang dung ngo / /gri 36—1364

gug dang thod pa'i nang na sman phud do/ /gri gug dang thod pa'o/ /'bras kyi snye ma dang ne+e'u le'i rkyal pa'o/ /bum pa dang zhags pa'o/ /sdigs mdzub dang mi mgo'o/ /ba dan dang zhags pa'o/ /phreng ba dang rtse gcig go/ /zhags pa dang thod pa'o/ /sku mdog ni rim pa bzhin du/ dkar mo ①dang / sngo skya dang / dmar mo dang / ljang gu dang / ser mo dang / dmar mo dang /dmar ser dang / dkar ser dang / mthing ga dang / dud ka dang /dmar nag dang / nag po'o/ /de dag gis kyang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'dis bdag la srung ba gyis shig ces bya ba ni/ 'jig rten dbang phyug ma bcu gnyis kyis kyang / gang zag gis 'di la gus par gyur na ma mo bcu gnyis kyis kyang srung ba dang / skyob par ②byed pa'o/ /sba ba la sogs pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa sneni gong ④bzhin no/ /ma mo de dag ni rdzu 'phrul dang ldan zhing kha dog dang ldan pa/ grags pa dang ldan pa/ rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pasarjo/lha dang lha ma yin gyi g.yul dag kyang myong bar byed pa dag go/ /de dag dang ldan pa'i rjom mo bcu gnyis po rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba'o/ /rig sngags kyi ngo bo ni/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ sku mdog dmar mo me'i khams/sangs rgyas lnga'i dbu rgyan can/ spyan gsum pa dbu la pad+mas mtshan pa/ ye shes lnga dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas pa gnyis na pad+ma dang 'khor lo/ g.yon pa ⑦gnyis na rma bya dang lhung bzed bsnams pa'o/ /rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/g.yas brkyang ba g.yon bskum ⑧pa/ zla ba'i gdan la nyi ma'i 'od dang ldan pa/thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa'o/ /tar+ya thā zhes bya ba ni 'di lta ste/ ma mo'i srog snying dang rig sngags kyi las kyi snying por ⑨blta'o/ /rig sngags kyi 36—1365

gsang sngags ni/ ha re/ kha re la sogs pa'o/ /kun dga' bo zhes bya ba ni/sems can gyi don la thugs rje chen pos bka' stsal pa'o/ /srin po'i chung ma sha za chen mo ral pa gcig ma zhes bya ba ni/ srin po'i rgyal po laṅka mgrin bcu'i chung ma chen mo ste/ des sems can rnams la gnod pa byed pa'o/ /rgya mtsho'i ngos la gnas pa gang dag khrag gi dri tshor na zhes bya ba ni/ lho'i 'dzam bu gling gi lho nub mtshams na/ phyi'i rgya mtsho'i tshal na/ yul laṅka'i ①grong khyer na sha za chen mos sha khrag gi dri tshor na mi srun pa'o/ /mtshan gcig la dpag tshad brgyad khrir 'gro ba ④yod de zhes bya ba ni sha khrag gi dri'i rnam ①pa tshor na mtshan gcig la gang na yod pa yang len nus so/ /de bzhin du sems can rnams la gnod pa byed pa'o/ /de yang byang chub sems dpa' ma'i rum du zhugs pa na yang srung zhes bya ba ni/ de yang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo'i gzi brjid kyis srung bar byed pa'o/ /btsa' kha dang btsas pa na yang srung ba'o zhes bya ba ni/thog ma bar dang tha ma gsum srung rjoste/ gzi brjid che ba/ grags pa dang ldan pa 'od zer dang ldan pa/ kha dog dang ldan pa/ rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa/lha dang lha ma yin gyi g.yul yang myong bar byed pa dag go/ /de'i ⑤kha dog dang phyag mtshan ni zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ sku mdog nag po'o/ /ral pa gcig tu yod pa/ bzhin mi sdug pa/ g.yas gnyis na gri gug dang rtse gsum g.yon gnyis na zhags pa dang thod pa bsnams pa'o/ /des kyang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'dis bdag la srung dub kyis shig ces bya ba ni/ gang zag gang gis ⑦rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen ⑧mo la gus par byas na sha za chen mo des kyang srung ba dang skyob par bgyid pa'o/ /rig sngags ni zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/36—1366

sku mdog ljang gu rlung gi khams spyan gsum pa/ rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan gyis brgyan ①pa/ dbu la sna tshogs rdo rjes brgyan pa/ ye shes lnga dang ldan pa/rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ g.yas gnyis na ④ut+pa la sngon po dang /pad+ma'o—/ /g.yon gnyis na pad+ma'i sgro dang gos sna tshogs pa'o/ /g.yas brkyang ba—/ g.yon bskum pa'o/ /zla ba'i gdan la nyi ma'i 'od dang ldan pa'o/ /thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa'o/ /sba ba la sogs pa zhes bya ba rgo/ sngar bshad pa bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /tar+ya thā zhes bya ba ni 'di lta ste/ sha za chen mo'i srog snying dang / rig sngags kyi bka' ①las kyi snying po'o/ /rig sngags kyi las kyi snying po lta ba'o/ /rig sngags kyi gsang sngags ni/ ha re/kha re la sogs pa'o/ /kun dga' bo zhes bya ba ni/ thams cad mkhyen pas sems can gyi don la yang nas yang du bsrung ba'odhi/ /khyod kyis srin mo rnams kyi ming zung shig ces bya ba ni sngon yang byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi dus su/ zangs gling gi rgyal khams na srin mo lnga brgya yod do/ /de yang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo za ma tog gi mdo ⑤las shes par bya'o—/ /da ltar yang srin mo bdun cu tham pa mthu dang stobs dang ldan pa sangs rgyas dang rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba'o/ /'di lta ste zhes bya ba ni/ srin mo bdun cur blta'o0/ /srin mo ser skya ma zhes bya ba dang /srin mo pad+ma zhes bya ba dang / srin mo ma he mo zhes bya ba dang / srin mo dkar mo zhes bya ba dang / srin mo spu gu dze+ecan zhes bya ba dang / srin mo 'bar ma zhes bya ba dang / srin mo gdung ma zhes bya ba dang / srin mo bum pa can zhes bya ba dang / srin mo dri med ces bya ba dang / srin mo sa zhes bya ba ⑧36—1367

dang zhes bya ba ni mthu dang ldan pa/ rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba'o/ /de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/ dmar ser dang / nag po dang /thal ba'i mdog dang / dmar po ①dang / dkar po dang / ser po dang /sngo bsangs dang / dmar ser dang / mthing ga dang / ljang gu'o/ /g.yas rnams na 'khor bo dang / pad+ma dang / rin po che dang / rdo rje dang /ral gri dang / mdung dang / zhags pa dang / dgra sta dang / rtse gsum dang / gtun shing bsnams ②pa'o/ /g.yon rnams na thod pa khrag gis bkang ba bsnams pa'o/ /de rnams kyis kyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ①ba'o/ /srin mo seng ge'i zla ba zhes bya ba dang / srin mo snar ma zhes bya ba dang /srin mo 'od zer ma ④dang / srin mo bsreg bya za ma dang / srin mo chu lha'i chung ma dang / srin mo nag mo dang / srin mo glang chen mo dang / srin mo stobs can ma dang / srin mo za ba mo dang / srin mo lag ⑤'gro ma dang zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo'i bka' las mi 'da' zhing sems can rnams kyi don byed pa'o/ /de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/ dkar mo dang /dmar mo dang / dmar ser ma dang / dmar nag gi mdog dang / dkar mo dang / nag mo dang / sngo skya dang / ljang gu dang / ser mo dang /dmar ser mo'o6/ /g.yas rnams na rdo rje dang / rin po che dang / 'khor lo dang / zhags pa dang / sbrul gyi zhags pa dang / gri gug dang /mdung dang / 'phang mdung dang / dgra sta dang / rtse gsum mo/ /g.yon rnams na pad+ma bsnams pa'o/ /srin mo de rnams kyang sems can rnams la srung ⑦ba dang / skyob par byed pa/ rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba'o/ /36—1368

srin mo ma ①tang gi dang / srin mo dmar ser mo dang / srin mo thigs ②pa 'dzin dang / srin mo gtum mo ma dang ④/ srin mo ri 'dzin ma dang /srin mo grul bum ma dang / srin mo tshon ngan ma rjodang / srin mo zlog dubyed ma dang / srin mo rgyags ma dang / srin mo mngal za ba dudang zhes bya ba ni/de rnams kyis kyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ⑦ste/ sems can rnams la phan pa mdzad pa'o/ /de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/ mthing ga dang / dmar ser dang / khra bo dang / nag mo dang / dkar po ④dang /ljang gu dang / dmar po dang / ser po dang / sngo bsangs dang / ljang nag go⑨/ /g.yas rnams na mdung dang / 'phang mdung dang / to mar dang / gtun shing dang / zhags pa dang / sbrul gyi zhags pa dang / bum pa dang / mda' gzhu dang / mdung rings ⑩dang / rtse gcig bsnams pa'o//g.yon rnams na ut+pa la bsnams pa'o/ /de rnams kyis rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' bar gang zag srung bar byed pa'o/ /srin mo khrag za ma dang /srin mo so sto ⑪ma dang / srin mo dngangs ⑫byed ma dang / srin mo tshangs pa ma dang / srin mo lteng ka skyong ma dang / srin mo rdo rje 'dzin pa dang / srin mo skem ⑫byed ma dang / srin mo mun pa dang / srin mo char 'be+ebs ma dang /srin mo 'brug sgrogs ma dang zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung zhing sems can gyi ⑫don byed pa'o/ /de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/dmar po dang / dkar po dang / nag po spyodang / ser mo dang / ljang gu ⑫dang / mthing ga dang / dmar ser ma ⑩dang / sngo skya ma dang /dkar ser ma spyodang / dud ka ma'o/ /de rnams kyi g.yas na gri gug dang /36—1369

rtse gsum dang / mi mgo dang / bum pa dang / dgra sta dang / rdo rje dang /'khor lo dang / mdung rtse gsum dang / ral gri dang / rtse gcig bsnams pa'o—/ /g.yon rnams na thod pa khrag gis bkang ba bsnams pa'o/ /de rnams kyang rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' zhing / gang zag dag la srung bar byed pa'o/ /srin mo 'gegs ma dang / srin mo snang byed ma dang /srin mo 'gro ba ①ma dang / srin mo sgron ma kha dang / srin mo nor 'dzin ma dang / srin mo mtshan mo nag mo dang / srin mo gshin rje'i ②pho nya mo dang / srin mo mche ba ma dang / srin mo yā ma dang /① srin mo dri med ma dang /srin mo stobs bzang rjom dang / srin mo ral pa 'greng dang zhes bya ba ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung rjozhing / sems can gyi rjodon byed pa'o/ /de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/ nam mkha'i mdog dang / ser mo dang /ljang gu dang / dmar ser dang / dkar ser dang / nag mo dang /mthing ga dang / dmar mo dang / sngo skya dang / ljang nag go/ /g.yas rnams na nor gyi rkyal bu dang / me sbar dang / dbyug to dang / thod pa dang / rin po che'i snye ma dang / gri gug dang / be+e con dang / mdung dang / dgra sta dang / rtse gsum bsnams pa'o/ /g.yon rnams na zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /srin mo mgo brgya ma dang / srin mo lag dze+ebargya ma dang /srin mo mig ④brgya ma dang / srin mo gnod byed ma dang / srin mo 'joms ma dang / srin mo bye la ma ⑫dang / srin mo zla ba ma ⑩dang / srin mo mtshan mo rgyu ba dang / srin mo nyin mo rgyu ba'o⑪/ /srin mo zhags pa ⑫dang zhes bya ba ni/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ba/ sems can rnams kyi don byed pa'o/ /mgo 36—1370

brgya dang lag brgya mig brgya gsum po ni/ de bzhin du yod pa lus kyang khra bor gnas pa'o/ /de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/ nag mo dang / ser mo dang / dkar mo dang / dmar mo dang / sngo skya mo dang / dmar nag mo dang / ljang gu'o/ /de bzhin du gsum po rnams kyang dhisna tshogs kyi mtshon bsnams lapa/ stobs dang ldan pa'o/ /bdun po de dag gi g.yas na 'khor lo dang mda' gzhu dang / zhags pa dang / bum pa dang / mdung rtse gsum pa dang / dgra sta dang / rtse gcig pa bsnams pa'o/ /g.yon rnams ④bum pa bsnams pa'o/ /srin mo khro mo dang / srin mo rnam par 'tshe dang / srin mo ral gri dang / srin mo gtun shing 'dzin dang / srin mo lag na rtse gsum dang / srin mo so brong ma dang / srin mo yid du 'ong rjom dang / srin mo des ma dang / srin mo gtum mo dang / srin mo so dang / srin mo 'gro 'khrug ma dang / srin mo sngon mo dang / srin mo khra ⑤mo zhes bya ba ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ba/ sems can rnams kyi don byed pa'o/ /de rnams kyi sku mdog dang rjophyag mtshan ni/ nag mo dang / dmar mo dang / sngo bsangs ma dang / dkar ser dang / dmar ser dang / mthing ga dang /dkar mo dang / nag mo dang / dkar mo dang / dmar nag gi mdog dang /sngon mo dang / khra mo'o/ /g.yas rnams na dgra sta dang / rtse gcig rnams dang / rtse gsum dang / mche ba dang / ut+pa la dang / pad+ma dang / gri gug dang / ral gri dang / dung dang / mdung rings ⑦dang / 'khor lo bsnams pa'o/ /g.yon rnams na gtun shing bsnams pa'o/ /srin mo chen mo de dag ni rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba ⑧gang zag dag la srung bar byed 36—1371

do①—/ /srin mo chen mo bdun cu po 'di dag ni zhes bya ba ni/ zangs gling gi rgyal khams na 'khyams shing ①/ mi'i 'jig rten gyi khams la gnod par byed pa/bdun cu ①po de dag ni lnga brgya'i gtso mo'o/ /da ltar yang 'jig rten dbang phyug gis srin mo lnga brgya btul nas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi bstan pa srung ba ste/rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo'i bka' las 'da' mi nus so/ /rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni/ rgya mtsho'i nang du me dang rlung la sogs pa gtong bar nus pa/ bud med kyi gzugs sna tshogs sprul zhing sems can la gnod pa'o//'od dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni/ rang gi 'od kyis rang gsal zhing / gzhan yang gsal ba'o/ /yang na de'i gzi brjid kyis gzhan rnams zil kyis gnon pa'o—/ /kha dog dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni/ rang rang gi kha dog gis bdun cu mdzes par snang ba'o/ /grags pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni/ zangs gling gi srin mo lnga brgya 'jig rten du grags pa'o/ /rdzu 'phrul dang zhes bya ba ni zangs gling gi rgyal khams na gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas par rjorgyu ba'o/ /lha dang lha ma yin gyi g.yul dag kyang myong bar byed pa dag go zhes bya ba ni/ lha dang phyelha min gnyis kyi 'thab rtsod la grogs byed nus pa'o/ /de dag gis kyang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'dis bdag la srung ba gyis shig ces bya ba ni/gang zag gis rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'di la gus par byas na 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral zhing / srin mo de rnams kyis srung dubar 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags kyi ngo bo ni zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa ⑦sku mdog nag mo/nam mkha'i khams dang ldan pa/ spyan gsum/ rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan can/dbu la rdo rjes mtshan skepa/ ye shes lnga dang ldan pa/ g.yas gnyis na rdo rje 36—1372

dang mchod rten/ g.yon gnyis na rma bya'i sgo dang 'khor lo bsnams pa/g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa/ zla ba'i gdan la nyi ma'i 'od dang ldan pa/thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa'o/ /sba ba dang zhes bya ba ni gshin rje'i 'jigs pa las sba ba'o/ /yongs su bskyab pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ 'khor ba'i snyug bsngal las bskyab pa'o/ /yongs su gzung ①ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ sdug bsngal kyis bzung ba las thar ba'o/ /yongs su bskyang ba dang zhes bya ba ni/sdug bsngal bor nas dge ba la bskyang ②ba'o/ /zhi ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ nyon mongs pa ①rnams las thar nas dge ba la gnas pa'o/ /bde legs su 'gyur ba rjodang zhes bya ba ni/ lus ngag yid bde ba ste/ stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin bstan pa'o/ /chad pa spang ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ skye ba dang mya ngan gyi rjochad pa spang ba ste/ de ltar yang mi gnas pa'o/ /mtshon cha spang ba dang zhes bya ba ni—/ dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad bcom pa'o/ /dug gzhil ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ 'jig rten gyi dug gsum gyis mi tshugs pa'o/ /dug gsad rjopa dang zhes bya ba ni ye shes kyi rang bzhin gyis dug lnga bsad pa'o/ /lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig ces bya ba ni/ tha ma thog ma da ltar med pa'o/ /ston brgya mthong bar shog shig ces bya ba ni/ sems can rnams byang chub la 'god par blta ⑦ba'o/ /tar+ya thā zhes bya ba ni/ 'di lta ste/ 'byung po'am 'jig rten ④phyogs skyong ba'am/ rgyal po la sogs pa'am/ rig sngags kyi snying po blta ⑨ba'o—/ /rig sngags kyi gsang sngags ni/ hi li nyi li la sogs pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo'i ma mo rnams kyi ⑩gnas skabs te bcu gcig pa'o—/ / //36—1373

sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo swā hā zhes bya ba ni/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rabs ①bdun la sogs pa bsam kyis mi khyab pa'o/ /ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas byams pa la sogs pa ste/ da ltar bzhugs pa shākya seng ge'o/ /de rnams la phyag 'tshal ba'o/ /gang gis phyag 'tshal zhe na/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i gang zag gis phyag 'tshal ba'o/ /swā hā ni gang gi rten cing 'brel ba'i dngos grub ni/ de la sogs pa gsang sngags bsam gyis mi khyab pa gnas pa'o//rig sngags chen mo dang zhes bya ba ni phyi'i rig pa dang nang gi rig pa ste/ phyi'i rig pa ni rig pa rnam pa lnga'o/ /de ni lha bsnyen ②dang / dbyangs dang /sman dang / bzo dang / sgra'o/ /lha bsnyen ①ni/ rgyud la sogs pa'i bye brag /sngags dang / rgyud dang / 'khrul 'khor dang / sbyin sreg dang /dkyil 'khor dang / slob ma lhag par gnas par byed pa la sogs pa'o/ /dbyangs ④ni ring po ⑤dang thung ba dang / drag po dang / mthug po dang /sgra chung ngu dang / de rnams byung ba ni rig byed bzhi las byung ba'o/ /de la rte mkhas pas na dbyangs so/ /sman ni kha dog brtag pa dang / rtsa brtag pa dang / 'byung ba brtag pa dang / dus brtag pa dang / nyi ma brtag pa dang / de'i bye brag gis/ sems can rnams la gso ba byed pa ste/ dus bzung nas sman la brtag pa ste/ de bzhin du rlung dang / bad kan dang /mkhris pa la sogs pa'o/ /zas kyi bye brag dang / rtsa'i bye brag dang / phyi'i kha dog gi bye brag dang / chu/ dri ma/ mig /dbugs/ lce la brtag pa'o//de la brtag pas na sman no/ /bzo ni 'jig rten gyi bya ba thams cad la mkhas 36—1374

pa'o—/ /sgra ni tshad ma'i rang bzhin gyi ①srang la gzhal rjob dang / gcig mthong bas mang po smra ba dang / gcig gis gcig smra ba ste/ gcig gis gnyis smra ba dang / gcig gis gsum smra ba dang / gcig gis mang po smra ba'o//de yang mtshan brgyad du byung ①ste/ mtshan brgyad pa rjode yang / rig pa'i sgra/byu ka ra ṇa'i sgra'i gnas brgyad do/ /de la mkhas pas ⑤sgra'o/ /nang gi rig pa ni brjod du med pa kha dog dang bral ba/ gzugs dang bral ba/ mtshan nyid med pa/ gzhi med cing ngo bo nyid dang bral ba'o/ /sngags ni ma man+t+ra ste—/ srung ba dang skyob par byed pa/ sngags de yang sgyu ma lta bu'i rang bzhin/phyogs rnams dang bral ba'o/ /chen mo ni nam mkha' bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams rnams khyab ste/ de yang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rang bzhin no/ /gsang sngags chen mo dang zhes bya ba ni/ tshig tu brjod pa'i gsang sngags dang /ting nge 'dzin gyi gsal dub dang / ting nge 'dzin rang yang dang po'i rnal 'byor tshogs sogs ⑦pa/ gnyis pa rnal 'byor chen po ste/ dam tshig ⑧sems dpa' dang / ye shes sems dpa'i ④rang bzhin rtogs ⑩pa'o/ /sdogs pa'i rnal 'byor ye shes gtso bor bzung nas rtag chad dang bral ba de'i ngo bo nyid rtogs pas na gsang ba'o/ /sngags ni sems can thams cad la phan par byed pa'o/ /de nyid gzung ⑪bas na gzungs sngags so/ /chen mo ni ⑩bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ /so sor 'brang ma chen mo dang zhes bya ba ni thabs shes rab gnyis su med de/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa gnyis su med do—/ /so so ni 'gro ba rigs drug /'brang ma ni chos sku/ chos sku la yang brjod bya'i rang bzhin dper na mda' la sgro btags pa lta bu'o/ /ma ni sgyu ma'i 36—1375

rang bzhin no/ /de bas na so sor 'brang ma'o/ /chen mo de lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ /srung ba chen mo 'di dag gis zhes bya ba ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs so sor 'brang ma dang / rdo rje'i rigs stong chen mo rab tu 'joms ma dang / rin po che'i rigs rma bya chen mo dang / pad+ma'i rigs gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin ma dang / las kyi rigs bsil ba'i tshal dang lnga'o//lnga po de yang ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rnams so/ /sku mdog kyang dkar po dang / nag po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang /ljang gu'o/ /phyag mtshan yang rim pa bzhin du/ 'khor lo dang / rdo rje dang /rin po che dang / pad+ma dang / sna tshogs rdo rje'o/ /g.yon rnams na rim pa bzhin du dung dang / zhags pa dang / rma bya'i sgo dang / bum pa'i steng na rdo rje dang / skyabs sbyin no/ /gzugs kyang zhi ba dang / khro bo dang /rgyags pa dang / cung zad khro ba dang / bzhin 'dzum pa dang ngo / /de rnams la yang sangs rgyas lnga'i dbu rgyan ①can spyan gsum pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ 'khor lo dang / rdo rje dang / rin po che dang / pad+ma dang / sna tshogs rdo rjes ②rim pa bzhin du dbu la brgyan pa'o/ /zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ zla ba'i gdan dang nyi ma'i 'od dang ldan pa'o/ /chen mo ni ye shes lnga bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ /'di dag gis ni srung ba lnga'i dam tshig go/ /bdag la srungs ①shig swā hā zhes bya ba ni/ rten gyi gang zag dang / sems can thams cad do/ /swā hā ni de gyur cig ces pa'o/ /gshed byed rnams bcom mo zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo de rnams kyis rnam par rtog pa'i las bcom pa'o/ /bsgyur ba'i las rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/36—1376

da ①ltar rkyen gyis bsgyur ba'i las rnams so/ /byad dang zhes bya ba ni/ sngon gyi ②las 'phro'o/ /g.yengs byed rnams dang zhes bya ba rgo/ dran pa g.yengs pa las byung ste/ de bzhin du rtsub par byed pa'o/ /ro langs rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ sngags kyis langs pa dang / yi dwags kyi rang bzhin gyis langs pa dang / sbod gtong gi ①nus pas langs pa'o/ /sems bsgyur rjob rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ rig pa'i sems bzhag nas ma rig pa'i sems su bsgyur ba rnams so/ /sbod gtong rnams bcom mo zhes bya ba ni ma rig pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ dmod mo'i rang bzhin btang ba/ drang rjosrong la sogs pa'o/ /de bcom pa ni rig sngags kyis bcom pa'o/ /skem 0byed rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/sngangs shing 'gyur bar byed pa'o/ /smyo byed dang zhes bya ba ni/ ma rig pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ sngags dang / sman dang / yi dwags rnams kyis stso bar byed pa'o/ /grib gnon rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ grib ma la bzung nas gzugs kyi phung po la gnod par byed pa'o/ /brjed ⑦byed rnams bcom mo zhes bya ba ni glo bur du byung zhing sems can rnams la gnod pa'o/ /de yang rig pas bcom pa'o/ /skem ⑧byed rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ gcong ⑨gi nad bzhin du yun ring po'o⑩/ /skrag pa rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ 'jigs ⑪par byed cing sems can la 'tshe bar byed pa'o/ /dbyig dug rnams dang zhes bya ba ni—/ nor ⑫bu dang rin po che las byas pa'o/ /dug rnams bcom mo zhes bya ba ni—/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo'i gzi brjid kyis phyi'i dug dang / nang gi dug bcom pa'o/ /bza' nyes rnams dang zhes bya ba ni nye ba la sogs pa'o/ /skyug nyes rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ sman dug tu song ba'o/ /gnod sgrib ⑫36—1377

rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ lta ba log par byed pa'o/ /gnod ltas rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ lta ba log pa rnams kyis lta ①ba'o/ /bri nyes rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ phyin ci log tu bris pa'o/ /bsgom dze+enyes rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ma rig pa bsgom pa'o/ /smad pa rnams bcom mo zhes bya ba ni/ ma rig pa'i pho nya byed pa rnams rig sngags kyi gzi brjid kyis bcom pa'o/ /rims nyin gcig pa rnams dang zhes bya ba rgo/ nyin gcig gis rdzogs pa long med pa rnams so/ /nyin gnyis pa rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ de bas ring ba ste nyin gnyis kyis rdzogs pa rnams so/ /nyin gsum pa rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/nyin mo gsum par ④rdzogs pa rnams te/ de gsod rjopar byed pa'o/ /nyin bzhi pa rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ nyin bzhi lon nas phan pa med pa'o/ /nyin bdun pa rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ rims tshad pa rjoste drug ma bzlog bun bdun pa la 'chi ba'o⑦/ /zla ba byed pa rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ gzhan tshes grangs rnams ma bzlog ⑧na dus der 'chi ba'o⑨/ /zla ba gcig pa rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ rims nar ma ste/ dus gzhan la ma bzlog ⑩na/ zla ba gabyug lon nas 'chi ba'o⑪/ /nyin mo pa rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ snga dro nas dgongs ka la phan med par 'gro ba'o/ /yud tsam pa rnams dang zhes bya ba ni / glo bur gyi nad gang gis kyang phan med pa'o/ /rtag pa'i rims rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ lo nas lor 'gor ba ste gzhi ⑫tshad pas ma btang ba'o/ /rims ldang dub pa rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ gso ba dka' ba res 'byung zhing res drag pa'o/ /rlung las gyur pa rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ rlung las gyur pa bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'o/ /mkhris pa las gyur pa rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/36—1378

mkhyes pa la ①nad mi gcig pa bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'o/ /bad kan las gyur pa rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ bad kan las gyur pa bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'o/ /'dus pa las gyur pa rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ de gsum 'dus pa ste/ 'dus pa'i nad rigs mi gcig pa yang bzhi brgya rtsa bzhir gnas so/ /mi'i rigs rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ rkun ma'am rgyal po'am de la 'jigs skrag gi rkyen kyis byung bas na mi'i rigs so/ /mi ma yin pa'i rims bcom mo zhes bya ba ni/ ma rungs pa'i 'byung po rnams kyis kyang rlung bad kan du bstan/ bad kan rlung du bstan/ mkhris pa bad kan du bstan te/ phyin ci log par bstan pa ni/mi ma yin pa'i rims so/ /rims thams cad bcom mo zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi gsang sngags kyi nus pas ②de dag gi rims rnams ni 'byung bar mi nus pa'o④/ /shu ba dang / g.ya' ba rjodang / 'brum bu phra mo dang /mdze dang / phol mig dang / g.yan pa dang / me dbal dang / lhog pa rnams bcom mo zhes bya ba ni/ ma rungs pa'i nad de rnams la sogs pa bco brgyad de⑤/ de yang rig sngags kyi gzi brjid kyis bcom pa'o/ /klad pa na ba dang zhes bya ba la sogs pa nirjo/ rlung dang bad kan mkhris pa gsum de gsum gyis bsgyur nas yan lag na ba nyi shu rtsa bzhi ste/ de yang de la sogs pa nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi bcom mo/ /gdon thams cad dang zhes bya ba ni/ lha'i gdon la sogs pa bgegs rigs mi gcig pa stong phrag brgyad cu'o/ /dug thams cad dang zhes bya ba ni/ phyi'i dug gsum dang nang gi dug gsum phyi'i bsdad pa dang 'go ba ⑦dang byed pa'o/ /bsdad pa ni btsan dug la sogs pa rtswa dang lo ma'i dug go/ /'gro ba la yang bsam pa reg pa mthong ba kha rlangs so/ /36—1379

byed pa yang dbyig dug la sogs pa bsam kyis mi khyab pa'o/ /nad thams cad dang zhes bya ba ni/ nad rigs mi gcig pa brgya rtsa bzhi rig sngags kyi gsang sngags kyis bcom pa'o/ /bdag la bde legs su gyur cig ces bya ba ni/gang zag gang ①dag dang sems can rnams la bde legs su 'gyur ro/ /mtshan mo bde legs nyin bde legs/ /zhes bya ba ni rig sngags kyi gzi brjid kyis—/ lus ngag yid mi bde ba'i ①rkyen byed pa mtshan mo dang nyin mo bde bar 'gyur ro①/ /nyi ma'i gung gis bde legs dang / /zhes bya ba ni nyi ma phyed na yang mi bde bar mi gnas pa'o/ /nyin mtshan kun gyi bde legs dag /ces bya ba ni nyin mo dang mtshan mo'i bar nas rtag tu bde ba ste/ rgas nas ma shi ba'i ④bar du yang bde ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kun byus bdag la sprul/ /⑤zhes bya ba ni gang zag dag rjogis 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar ba rnams la phyag ⑦'tshal ba'o/ /sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal byang chub phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bya ba ni sangs rgyas ni snga ma bzhin du bshad pa rnams te/ gzhi ma grub rkyen kyis ma gos pa rnams la phyag 'tshal ba'o/ /byang chub ni sems can rnams kyi don byed pa/ sa bcu la ni 'thob pa ste/ /de rnams la ni phyag 'tshal lo/ /gol gyur ④phyag 'tshal grol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bya ba ni grol gyur ⑨ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams te/ grol ba ni sangs rgyas kyi bden pas rig sngags kyi bka' las grol ba'o/ /zhi gyur ⑩phyag 'tshal zhi ⑪la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bya ba ni zhi gyur ⑫ni yang dag pa'i don mi 'gyur te/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las grol nas nam mkha' lta bu'o/ /zhi la ni sprul pa'i sku'i rang bzhin/ shākya thub pa lta bur stong gsum gyi stong chen por snying rjes khyab pa'o/ /rnam grol phyag 36—1380

'tshal ①grol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bya ba ni rnam grol ni 'grol byed de rnam par grol bar byed pa ni rig sngags kyi rgyal mo'o/ /'grol ba ni 'khor ba las 'grol ba'o/ /bram ze gang dag snyig pa'i chos bsal ②bar gyur pa de dag la yang phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi rgyal po ①bram ze dag yin te/des sdig bor nas dge ba la gnas pa de la sogs pa rjosdig pa thams cad sel ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de dag gis kyang bdag la srung ba gyis shig ces bya ba ni/ gang zag rig sngags la gus par byed pa dag la gang yang de rnams kyis srung bar byed pa dag go/ /pha bde legs su gyur cig ces bya ba ni/ bskyed pa'i sa bon gtong ba'i pha'o/ /ma bde legs su gyur cig ces bya ba ni/ skyes pa'i ma lan gyis mi 'khor ba'o/ /mngal ⑤bde legs su gyur cig ces bya ba ni—/ ma'i mngal na yod pa yang bde ba'o/ /rkang gnyis pa rnams bde legs su gyur cig ces bya ba ni/ sems can mi la sogs pa'o/ /rkang bzhi pa rnams bde legs su gyur cig ces pa ni/ stag dang seng ge la sogs pa'o/ /rkang med rnams bde legs su gyur cig ces bya ba ni/ sems can sbrul la sogs pa'o/ /srid pa gsum du gtogs pa'i sems can thams cad bde legs su gyur cig ces bya ba ni/ sa 'og sa steng sa bla rnams kyi sems can thams cad bde legs pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo'i sngags bshad pa'i gnas skabs te bcu gnyis pa'o// //kun dga' bo zhes bya ba ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa'o/ /khyod kyis klu'i rgyal po rnams kyi ming zung 36—1381

shig ces bya ba ni/ byang chub sems dang ldan pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung zhing rigs ①kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba'o/ /'di lta ste zhes bya ba ni klu'i rgyal po rnams blta ba'o/ /klu'i rgyal po de rnams kyang rigs skebazhi dug bzhi dus bzhir gnas pa ste④/ rigs bzhi la yang bram ze/ rgyal po/ rje'u rigs/dmangs rjorigs so/ /rigs bzhi las byung ba ni ⑤de'i 'og ma ni/ bram ze'i bram ze/ rgyal po'i rgyal po/ rje'u'i rje'u/ dmangs rigs kyi dmangs snerigs—/ de ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ /dug bzhi la bsams pa las tshor ba byung ngo / /mthong ba la ④yang gnyis te/ mngon shes kyis mthong ba dang /mig gis mthong ba'o/ /reg pa yang gnyis te/ reg pa'i rang bzhin dang /gzung ④ba'o/ /kha rlangs la gnyis te/ kha rlangs dbugs las byung ba dang /mche ba'i dug go/ /rigs kyang de bzhin du yin te/ 'phral yang sems can dug bzhi yod pa'o/ /dus ⑨bzhi la yang snga dro dang / nyi ma phyed dang / phyi dro dang / dgongs mo'o/ /nub mo la srod dang nam phyed dang / phyed yol dang / tho rangs so/ /de bzhin du klu yang ⑩dus bzhi la rgyu ba'o/ /de dang ldan pa'i klu'i rgyal po rnams la zung shig go/ /klu'i rgyal po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang klu'i rgyal po tshangs pa dang / klu'i rgyal po tshangs chen dang /klu'i rgyal po dbang po dang / klu'i rgyal po nye ba'i dbang po dang zhes bya ba ni byang chub sems dpa'i rigs sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun la skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba'o/ /de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi gser gyi ⑪mdog dang / dkar po dang / dkar ser dang / dmar po dang / dmar ser ro/ /zhal gcig 36—1382

phyag gnyis pa/ blta ①na sdug paske/ lha'i cha byad can/ dbu la sbrul gyi ne+egadengs ka dang bcas pa/ sbrul gyi mdud pa'i steng na bzhugs pa'o/ /g.yas rnams sa gnon gyi rjophyag rgya mdzad pa dang / phreng ba dang / bum pa spyi blugs dang / rdo rje dang / 'khor lo bsnams pa'o/ /g.yon rnams na sbrul gyi zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /de rnams ni sems can la 'tshe ba mi byed pa'o/ /klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho dang / klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho'i bu dang / klu'i rgyal po dug med bcas dang / klu'i rgyal po mtsho chen dang / klu'i rgyal po mtsho chen bu dang zhes bya ba ni/ klu'i rgyal po de rnams kyang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ⑤ba/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs dhisu 'gro ba'o/ /de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/ ser po dang / dkar po dang / dkar ser dang / dmar ser dang / dung gi mdog go/ /de rnams kyang zhi ba'i tshul du gnas pa/ dbu la sbrul gyi ④gdengs ka dang bcas pa/ sbrul kyi mdud pa'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /g.yas rnams na rin po che dang / bum pa dang /rin po che myu gu dang / rin po che'i skephreng ba dang / me tog ku mu ta'o/ /g.yon rnams na sbrul gyi zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /de rnams sems can la gnod pa mi byed pa'o/ /klu'i rgyal po chu srin dang / klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang / klu'i rgyal po nye dga' bo dang / klu'i rgyal po mi zhum pa dang / klu'i rgyal po nye bar mi zhum pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ klu'i rgyal po de rnams kyang /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ⑨ba dang / dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'o—/ /de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/ nag po dang / ser po dang / dkar po dang / ljang gu dang / dmar po'o/ /g.yas rnams na/36—1383

shing thog bī dza pū ①ra ka dang / ut+pa la dang / nā ga puju dang / rin chen phreng ba dang / me tog man+d+ra ra ba'o④/ /g.yon rnams na sbrul gyi zhags pa dang / dbu la sbrul gyi gdengs ka can/ sbrul gyi mdud pa'i steng na bzhugs pa'o—/ /blta na sdug pa mi'i cha byad du yod pa/ rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba/ sems can gyi don byed pa'o/ /klu'i rgyal po lta na mdzes dang /klu'i rgyal po nor rgyas kyi bu dang / klu'i rgyal po 'jog po dang / klu'i rgyal po skya rengs dang / klu'i rgyal po chu lha dang / klu'i rgyal po paṇ+ḍa ka dang / klu'i rgyal po sor mo drug pa dang / klu'i rgyal po snying por 'go dang zhes bya ba ni/klu'i rgyal po de rnams kyis kyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ①ba/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/gser mdog dang / dkar po dang / sngo skya dang / sna tshogs mdog can dang ④/ dmar po dang / dkar ser dang / dkar po dang / ljang gu'o//g.yas rnams na me long dang / ut+pa la ser po dang / a sho ⑤ka'i lo ma dang /rin po che 'bar ba/ rin po che dang / me tog ut+pa la sngon po dang / pad+ma dang / ku mu ta'o/ /g.yon rnams na sbrul gyi zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba/ sems can kyi don byed pa'o/ /de rnams ni cung zad khro bor gnas pa'o/ /dbu la sbrul gyi gdengs ka dang bcas pa/sbrul gyi mdud pa'i steng na bzhugs pa/ gnod sbyin gyi tshul du gnas pa/bram ze'i rigs bsam pa'i dug can snga dro'i dus can no/ /klu'i rgyal po de rnams kyang sbrul kyi gdengs ka bco lnga bco lnga yod pa/ bram ze bram ze'i rigs la ni/ sbrul gyi gdengs ka dang / g.yon rnams na gnas pa'i sbrul gyi zhags 36—1384
