pa ni dkar po'o/ /klu'i rgyal po bram ze bram ze'i ①rigs nyi shu rtsa gsum po 'di dag ni/ gzhan yang gang dag sa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir dus dus su 'brug sgrogs ②pa/ dus dus su lo tog smin pa/ dus dus su char 'bebs pa④/dus dus su lo tog sgrub pa/ sangs rgyas mthong ba/ bslab pa'i gzhi gzung ④ba—/ gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'am/ nam mkha' lding gi 'jigs pa med pa/me dang bye ma'i 'jigs pa med pa/ rgyal po'i ⑤las kyi 'jigs pa las thar ba/sa 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i gzhal med khang chen po na gnas pa/ tshe ring ba/bskal par gnas pa/ dbang che bar grags pa/ longs spyod che ba/rjo rdzu 'phrul che ba/ ⑦'khor phal ⑧che ba/ dgra dpung rab tu 'joms pa rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa/ 'od dang ldan pa/ kha dog dang ldan pa/ grags pa dang ldan pa/ lha dang lha ma yin gyi g.yul dag kyang myong bar byed pa dag go/ /klu'i rgyal po de dag ni chung ma dang bcas pa/ bu dang bcas pa/ tsha bo dang bcas pa/ srun dang bcas pa/ blon po dang bcas pa/ ded dpon dang bcas pa/ pho nya dang bcas pa/ mngag pa dang bcas pa/ g.yog dang bcas pa/ 'khor dang bcas pa de dag ni shar phyogs na gnas pa'o/ /klu'i rgyal po dpal ldan dang / klu'i rgyal po dpal mgrin dang / klu'i rgyal po dpal 'phel dang / klu'i rgyal po dpal bzangs ⑨dang / klu'i rgyal po stobs bzangs dang zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ⑫ba/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba/ de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/ ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po dang / ljang gu dang / sngon po'o/ /g.yas rnams na dpal be+e'u dang / gdugs dang / 'khor lo dang / dung 36—1385

dang bum pa'o/ /g.yon rnams na sbrul zhags bsnams pa'o/ /klu'i rgyal po de rnams kyang lha'i cha byad du bzhugs pa/ dbu la sbrul kyi gdengs ka dang bcas paske/ sbrul gyi mdud pa'i steng na bzhugs pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba/ sems can gyi don byed pa'o/ /klu'i rgyal po chu skyes dang /klu'i rgyal po stag ①re dang / klu'i rgyal po lag bzangs dang / klu'i rgyal po ri rab dang / klu'i rgyal po nyi ⑧'od dang zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ne+eb/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba/ de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/ nag po dang / ser po dang / dmar ser dang /dmar po dang / mthing ga'orjo/ /g.yas rnams na dgra sta dang / lcags kyu dang / ral gri dang / 'khor lo dang / rtse gsum bsnams pa ⑤g.yon rnams na sbrul gyi zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /klu'i rgyal po de rnams ni dbu la sbrul gyi gdengs ka dang bcas pa/ sbrul gyi mdud pa'i steng na bzhugs pa/ dri za'i cha byad du yod pa/ rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba/ sems can gyi don byed pa'o/ /klu'i rgyal po zla 'od dang / klu'i rgyal po bzang sdug dang /klu'i rgyal po ngar pa dang / klu'i rgyal po 'brug sgogs dang / klu'i rgyal po glog 'byin dang zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung rjob/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba/ de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/dkar po dang / ser po dang / dmar ser dang / sprin gyi mdog dang /sngo skya'o/ /g.yas rnams na pad+ma dkar po dang / bum pa gang ba dang /tsan+dan gyi be+e con dang / dbyug to dang / me long ngo / /g.yon rnams na sbrul kyi zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /klu'i rgyal po de rnams ni dbu la sbrul gyi 36—1386

gdengs ka dang bcas pa/ sbrul kyi mdud pa'i steng na bzhugs pa/ mi'i cha byad can no/ /rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba/ sems can gyi don byed pa'o/ /klu'i rgyal po rgyas ①byed dang / klu'i rgyal po char 'be+ebs dang /klu'i rgyal po dri med dang / klu'i rgyal po stobs can mgo dang / klu'i rgyal po lcang lo can kyi mgo dang / klu'i rgyal po rta sdemago can dang ①zhes bya ba ni/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung rjob/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba/de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/ sngon po dang / ser po dang /dmar po dang / dkar po dang / ljang gu dang / nag po'o/ /g.yas rnams na 'khor lo dang / rin po che dang / puṇ+ḍa rī ⑤ka dang / ral gri dang / rdo rje dang / gos sna tshogs pa bsnams rjopa'o/ /g.yon rnams na sbrul gyi zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba/ sems can gyi don byed pa'o/ /mthong ba'i ⑦dug can/ rgyal po'i rgyal rigs/dus nyi ma phyed na rgyu ba/ sbrul kyi gdengs ka dang bcas pa/ sbrul kyi steng na bzhugs pa/ sbrul de yang sbrul mgo bcu gsum bcu gsum du yod pa/ sbrul gyi kha dog ser por gnas pa/ g.yon kyi phyag na bsnams pa'i sbrul yang ser po'o—/ /klu'i rgyal po nyi shu rtsa gcig lho phyogs na gnas pa'o/ /klu'i rgyal po de rnams kyis kyang gzhan yang gang dag sa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ dus dus su 'brug sgra sgogs pa/ dus dus su lo tog smin pa/ dus dus su char 'be+ebs pa—/ dus dus su lo thog sgrub pa/ sangs rgyas mthong ba/ bslab pa'i gzhi gzung ⑧ba/ gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba/ nam mkha' lding gi 'jigs pa dang / me dang bye ma'i 'jigs pa dang bral ba/ rgyal po'i ⑨las kyi 'jigs 36—1387

pa las thar ba/ sa 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i gzhal yas khang chen por gnas pa—/ tshe ring ba/ bskal par gnas pa/ dbang che bar grags pa/ rdzu 'phrul che ba/ longs spyod che ba/ 'khor phal che ba/ dgra dpung rab tu 'joms pa/ rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa/ 'od zer dang ldan pa/ kha dog dang ldan pa/ grags pa dang ldan pa/ rdzu 'phrul che ba/ lha dang lha ma yin gyi g.yul dag kyang ①myong bar byed pa dag go/ /klu'i rgyal po de rnams kyang chung ma dang bcas pa/ bu dang bcas pa/ tsha bo dang bcas pa/ spun dang bcas pa—/ blon po dang bcas pa/ ded dpon dang bcas pa/ pho nya dang bcas pa—/ mngag pa dang bcas pa/ g.yog dang bcas pa/ de dag ni lho phyogs na gnas pa'o/ /klu'i rgyal po ba lang mgo dang / klu'i rgyal po ri dwags mgo dang / klu'i rgyal po glang po che'i mgo dang / klu'i rgyal po rlan ①stobs can dang / klu'i rgyal po skye bo 'tshe dang zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ④ba/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba/ de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni dmar po dang / ser po dang / dmar ser dang /dkar po dang / ljang gu'o/ /g.yas rnams na rdo rje dbyug to dang / pad+ma'i dbyug to dang / rdo rje'i tho ba dang / rdo rje lcags kyu dang / rdo rje'i dgra sta'o / /g.yon rnams na sbrul zhags bsnams pa'o/ /lha'i cha byad du bzhugs so—/ /dbu la sbrul gyi gdengs ka dang bcas pa'o/ /sbrul gyi mdud pa'i steng du bzhugs pa'o④/ /rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba/ sems can kyi don byed pa'o/ /klu'i rgyal po ris bkra dang / klu'i rgyal po mig bkra dang / klu'i rgyal po sna tshogs sde dang / klu'i rgyal po mi gtong ba dang /36—1388

klu'i rgyal po gtong ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ①ba/dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba/ de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/ dmar ser dang / ljang gu dang / ljang nag dang / dkar po dang / ser po'o/ /g.yas rnams na pad+ma dmar po dang / pad+ma dkar po dang / at+pa la dkar po dang / ut+pa la ser po dang / nā ga put+pa sdebasnams pa'o—/ /g.yon rnams na sbrul zhags so/ /dri za'i cha byad du bzhugs pa/dbu la sbrul gyi gdengs ka dang bcas pa/ sbrul gyi mdud pa'i steng na bzhugs pa'o—/ /rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba/ sems can gyi don byed pa'o//klu'i rgyal po btang bzung dang / klu'i rgyal po sgra sgrogs kyi bu dang / klu'i rgyal po rtogs pa'i bu dang / klu'i rgyal po dpal dang / klu'i rgyal po dpal can dang zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ①ba/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro brjo/ de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni dmar po dang / ser po dang / ljang gu dang / sngo skya dang / dkar po'o/ /g.yas rnams na pad+ma dmar po dang / puṇ+ḍa rī rjoka dang / rin po che dang /a la dang / me tog ku mu ta bsnams rjoso/ /g.yon rnams na sbrul gyi zhags pa'o—/ /mi'i cha byad du bzhugs pa/ dbu la sbrul gyi gdengs ka dang bcas pa—/ sbrul kyi mdud pa'i steng na bzhugs pa/ rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba/ sems can kyi don byed pa'o/ /klu'i rgyal po 'phyang ba dang /klu'i rgyal po srin bu dang / klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas dang / klu'i rgyal po gser dang / klu'i rgyal po glang po'i rtsal dang / klu'i rgyal po dga' ⑦gsal dang zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ⑧ba/ dkon mchog gsum 36—1389

la skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/ dkar po dang / dmar po dang / ser po dang / nag po dang / ljang gu dang / dung gi mdog ①go/ /g.yas rnams na ut+pa la dang ②/ pad+ma dkar po dang ①/nā ga pube+e ④dang / a so ka'i lo ma dang / tsam pa ka'i me tog dang / me tog kun+da bsnams pa'o/ /g.yon rnams na sbrul zhags bsnams pa'o/ /gnod sbyin gyi cha byad du bzhugs pa'o/ dbu la sbrul gyi gdengs ka dang ldan pa'o/ /sbrul gyi mdud pa'i khri la bzhugs pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba/sems can gyi don byed pa'o/ /sbrul bcu gcig bcu gcig tu ⑤gnas pa/sbrul dmar por gnas pa/ g.yon na bsnams pa yang dmar po'o/ /klu'i rgyal po de rnams ni rjorje'u rigs kyi ⑦rje'u rigs/ reg pa'i dug can/ dus phya phyi dro na rgyu ba'o⑨/ /klu'i rgyal po de rnams kyis kyang gzhan dag ⑩sa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir dus dus su 'brug sgra sgogs pa/ dus dus su lo tog min pa/dus dus su char 'be+ebs pa/ dus dus su lo tog sgrub pa/ sangs rgyas mthong ba/ bslab pa'i gzhi gzung ⑩ba/ gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba/ nam mkha' 0lding gi 'jigs pa dang / me dang bye ⑫ma'i 'jigs pa dang / rgyal po'i ⑨las kyi 'jigs pa las thar pa'o/ /sa 'dzin pa rin po che'i gzhal yas khang chen po na gnas pa tshe ring ba bskal par gnas pa/ dbang che bar grags pa—/ rdzu 'phrul che ba/ longs spyod che ba/ 'khor 'phel ba/ dgra'i dpung rab tu 'joms pa/ rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa/ 'od dang ldan pa/ kha dog dang ldan pa/ grags pa dang ldan pa/ rdzu 'phrul che ba lha dang lha ma yin kyi g.yul dag kyang myong bar byed pa dag go/ /klu'i rgyal po de rnams ni chung ma 36—1390

dang bu dang ①bcas pa/ tsha bo dang bcas pa/ spun dang bcas pa/ blon po dang bcas pa/ ded dpon dang bcas pa/ pho nya dang bcas pa/mngag pa dang bcas pa/ g.yog dang bcas pa/ 'khor dang bcas pa de dag ni nub phyogs na gnas pa'o/ /klu'i rgyal po ser skya dang / klu'i rgyal po e la'i 'dab dang / klu'i rgyal po dkar po dang / klu'i rgyal po dung ④dang /klu'i rgyal po sog ma med dang zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi ①bstan pa srung rjob/dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni ljang gu dang / ser po dang / mthing nag dang / dmar po dang /ljang nag go/ /g.yas rnams na ral gri dang / sna tshogs kyi rdo rje dang / sna tshogs kyi gos dang / rin po che dang / 'khor lo bsnams pa'o/ /g.yon rnams na sbrul zhags so/ /lha'i cha byad du snang ba'o/ /sbrul gyi gdengs ka dang ldan pa/ sbrul gyi mdud pa'i steng na bzhugs pa/ rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba/ sems can gyi don byed pa'o/ /klu'i rgyal po nag po dang /klu'i rgyal po nye nag po dang / klu'i rgyal po stobs lha dang / klu'i rgyal po sred med kyi bu dang / klu'i rgyal po la ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ⑤ba/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dag go/ /de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni nag po dang mthing ga dang / ljang nag dang /sngo skya dang / dmar nag gi mdog dang ngo / /g.yas rnams na phreng ba dang /bum pa spyi blugs rjodang / bum pa gang ba dang / rin po che dang / dung bsnams pa⑦/ g.yon rnams na sbrul zhags so/ /dri za'i tshul du bzhugs pa/dbu la sbrul gyi gdengs ka dang bcas pa/ sbrul gyi mdud pa'i steng na bzhugs 36—1391

pa'o—/ /rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba①/ sems can gyi don byed pa'o—/ /klu'i rgyal po skrag byed dang / klu'i rgyal po srin po dang / klu'i rgyal po brag lag dang / klu'i rgyal po gaṅgā ②dang / klu'i rgyal po sin+tu dang zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ①ba/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/ dmar po dang /ser po dang / dmar nag dang / ljang nag dang / mthing kha'o/ /g.yas rnams pyadabyug to dang / be+e con dang / dbyug to dmig ⑤can dang / rdo rje tho ba dang / ral gri'o/ /g.yon rnams na sbrul zhags so/ /mi'i cha byad du bzhugs pa/ dbu la sbrul gyi gdengs ka dang bcas pa/ sbrul gyi mdud pa'i steng na bzhugs pa/ rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba0/ sems can kyi don byed pa'o/ /klu'i rgyal po pakyu dang / klu'i rgyal po sī ⑦ta dang /klu'i rgyal po bkra shis dang / klu'i rgyal po ma dros pa dang / klu'i rgyal po rab brtan dang / klu'i rgyal po sa srung gi bu zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ⑧ba/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/ sngo skya dang / dkar po dang / ser po dang /dmar po dang / sngon po dang / nag po'o/ /g.yas rnams na rin po che dang / bum pa gang ba dang / rin po che 'bar ba dang / ut+pa la dang /nā ga pube+e ⑨dang / pad+ma dkar po dang ngo / /g.yon rnams na sbrul zhags bsnams pa'o/ /de rnams gnod sbyin gyi cha byad can no/ /dbu la sbrul gyi gdengs ka dang ldan no/ /sbrul gyi mdud pa'i steng na bzhugs pa/ rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba⑩/ sems can gyi don byed pa'o/ /dmangs ⑪36—1392

rigs kyi dmangs ①rigs/ kha rlangs kyi dug /dus dgongs ka rgyu ba/sbrul gyi gdengs ka ni dgu dgur gnas pa'o/ /sbrul de yang ljang gur gnas pa/g.yon gyi sbrul yang ljang gu'o/ /gzhan yang gang dag sa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/dus dus su 'brug sgra sgrogs pa②/ dus dus su lo tog smin pa/ dus dus su char 'be+ebs pa/ dus dus su lo tog sgrub pa/ bslab pa'i gzhi bzung ba/sangs rgyas mthong ba/ gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba/ nam mkha' lding gi 'jigs pa dang / me dang bye ma'i 'jigs pa dang / rgyal po'i ①las kyi 'jigs pa las thar ba/ sa 'dzin pa rin po che'i gzhal yas khang chen po na gnas pa/ tshe ring ba bskal par gnas pa/ dbang che bar grags pa/ rdzu 'phrul che ba/ longs spyod che ba/ 'khor phal che ba/ dgra'i dpung rab tu 'joms pa/ rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa/ 'od dang ldan pa/ kha dog dang ldan pa—/ grags pa dang ldan pa/ lha dang lha ma yin gyi g.yul dag kyang myong bar byed pa dag go/ /klu'i rgyal po de rnams ni chung ma dang bcas pa/ bu dang bcas pa/ tsha bo dang bcas pa/ spun dang bcas pa/ blon po dang bcas pa—/ ded dpon dang bcas pa/ pho nya dang bcas pa/ mngag pa dang bcas pa/ g.yog dang bcas pa/ 'khor dang bcas pa/ de dag ni byang phyogs na gnas pa'o/ /klu'i rgyal po sa 'dzin dang / klu'i rgyal po mu khyud 'dzin dang / klu'i rgyal po mdog 'dzin dang / klu'i rgyal po bzang po dang /klu'i rgyal po rab tu bzang dang zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung rjob/dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba/ de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/ ser po dang / dmar po dang / nag po dang / dkar po dang /36—1393

ljang gu'o/ /g.yas rnams na phreng ①ba dang / bum pa spyi blugs dang / bum pa gang ba dang / rtse gsum dang / nor bu rin po che'o/ /g.yon rnams na sbrul zhags bsnams pa'o/ /gzugs lha'i cha byad du bzhugs pa/ dbu la sbrul gyi gdengs ka dang ldan pa/ sbrul gyi mdud pa'i steng na bzhugs pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba⑤/ sems can kyi don byed pa'o/ /klu'i rgyal po nor bzangs dang / klu'i rgyal po stobs bzangs ①dang / klu'i rgyal po nor bu dang / klu'i rgyal po nor bu mgul rjodang / klu'i rgyal po nag po gnyis dang zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ⑤ba/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba/ de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/ser po dang / dkar po dang / ljang gu dang / dmar po dang / nag po'o//g.yas rnams na nor bu rin po che dang / a 'bras kyi snying po dang / bum pa gang ba dang / rin po che'i snod dang / nor rmi rkyal pa bsnams pa'o/ /g.yon rnams na sbrul gyi zhags pa'o/ /dri za'i cha byad dang / sbrul kyi gdengs ka dang / sbrul gyi mdud pa'i steng na bzhugs pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba⑥/ sems can gyi don byed pa'o/ /klu'i rgyal po ser po gnyis dang / klu'i rgyal po dmar po gnyis dang / klu'i rgyal po dkar po gnyis dang / klu'i rgyal po phreng ldan dang / klu'i rgyal po dmar phreng can dang zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ⑦ba/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/ nag po dang /ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po dang / mthing nag go/ /g.yas rnams na dgra sta dang / rtse gcig dang / rtse gsum dang / 'khor lo dang /36—1394

rin po che'i phreng ba bsnams pa'o/ /g.yon rnams na sbrul gyi zhags pa'o/ /mi'i cha byad du gnas pa①/ dbu la sbrul gyi gdengs ka dang ldan pa/ sbrul gyi mdud pa'i steng na bzhugs pa/ rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba ②sems can gyi don byed pa'o/ /klu'i rgyal po be+e'u dang / klu'i rgyal po khrums stod dang / klu'i rgyal po rnga dang / klu'i rgyal po nye rnga dang / klu'i rgyal po a mra myu stegs dang / klu'i rgyal po nor bu'i bu dang zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ⑦ba/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/ dmar po dang / dmar ser dang / ser po dang / dkar po dang / nag po dang / ljang gu'o/ /g.yas rnams na me tog rjophreng ba dang / ut+pa la dmar po dang / rin chen gyi ⑤snod dang /rnga rked nyag dang / rke rings rjodang / me tog tsam pa ka bsnams pa'o/ /g.yon rnams na sbrul gyi zhags pa'o/ /gnod sbyin gyi tshul du bzhugs pa/dbu la sbrul gyi gdengs ka dang bcas pa/ sbrul gyi mdud pa'i steng na bzhugs pa'o—/ /rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba⑦/ sems can gyi don byed pa'o—/ /bram ze'i rigs tshor ba'i dug can srod la rgyu ba'o/ /sbrul gyi gdengs ka dgu dgur gnas pa④/ mdog dmar por gnas pa/ g.yon byu zhags pa yang dmar po'o⑨/ /klu'i rgyal po de rnams kyis/ gzhan yang gang dag sa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir dus dus su 'brug sgra sgogs pa/ dus dus su lo tog smin pa/ dus dus su char 'bebs ⑩pa/ dus dus su lo tog sgrub pa/sangs rgyas mthong ba/ bslab pa'i gzhi gzung ⑪ba/ gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba—/ nam mkha' lding gi 'jigs pa dang / me dang bye ma'i 'jigs pa dang /36—1395

rgyal po'i ①las kyi 'jigs pa las thar ba'o⑤/ /sa 'dzin pa rin po che'i gzhal yas khang chen po na bzhugs pa/ tshe ring ba bskal par gnas pa/dbang che bar grags pa/ rdzu 'phrul che ba/ longs spyod che ba/ 'khor phal ༄ che ba/ dgra dpung rab tu 'joms pa/ rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa/ 'od dang ldan pa/ kha dog dang ldan pa/ grags pa dang ldan pa/ lha dang lha ma yin gyi g.yul yang myong bar byed pa dag go/ /klu'i rgyal po de rnams ni chung ma dang bcas pa/ bu dang bcas pa/ tsha bo dang bcas pa/ spun dang bcas pa/blon po dang bcas pa/ ded dpon dang bcas pa/ pho nya dang bcas pa/mngag pa dang bcas pa/ g.yog dang bcas pa/ 'khor dang bcas pa/klu'i rgyal po de rnams ni shar lho mtshams na bzhugs pa'o/ /klu'i rgyal po yul 'khor srung dang / klu'i rgyal po 'phags skyes po dang / klu'i rgyal po mig mi bzang dang / klu'i rgyal po rnam thos kyi bu dang / klu'i rgyal po shing rta'i ④bzhin dang zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ⑤ba/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/dkar po dang / mthing ga dang / dmar po dang / ljang gu dang / ser po'o—/ /g.yas rnams na pi wang dang / dbyug to dang / dung dang /bum pa dang / ral gri'o/ /g.yon rnams na sbrul zhags sorjo/ /lha'i cha byad du bzhugs pa/ dbu la sbrul gyi gdengs ka dang bcas pa/ sbrul kyi mdud pa'i steng na bzhugs pa/ rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba④/ sems can gyi don byed pa'o/ /klu'i rgyal po tsam par skyes dang / klu'i rgyal po go ta ma dang / klu'i rgyal po lnga len dang / klu'i rgyal po gtsug phud lnga dang /36—1396

klu'i rgyal po bdud ①dang zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ②ba/dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba/ de'i sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/dkar ser dang / ser po dang / kha dog drug dang / dkar po dang /dmar po rnams so①/ /g.yas rnams na phreng ba dang / dbyug pa gsum dang /bum pa dang / rin po che dang / zhags pa rnams so/ /g.yon rnams na sbrul gyi zhags pa'o/ /dri za'i cha byad du bzhugs pa/ dbu la sbrul gyi gdengs ka dang bcas pa/ sbrul kyi mdud pa'i khri la bzhugs pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' brjo/ sems can gyi don byed pa'o/ /klu'i rgyal po thigs pa dang / klu'i rgyal po nye ba'i thigs pa dang / klu'i rgyal po bum pa dang / klu'i rgyal po dus las byung ba dang / klu'i rgyal po stobs can dang zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung rjob/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/ dkar po dang / dmar po dang / ser po dang / nag po dang / ljang gu'o/ /g.yas rnams na a 'bras dang / nor bu rin po che dang / pad+ma dang /ut+pa la dang / nā ga put+pa 'o/ /g.yon rnams na sbrul zhags bsnams pa'o/ /mi'i cha byad du bzhugs pa'o/ /dbu la sbrul gyi gdengs ka dang bcas pa/sbrul kyi mdud pa'i khri la bzhugs pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' brjo/sems can gyi don byed pa'o/ /klu'i rgyal po chung zad dang / klu'i rgyal po tshim pa ka ⑦dang / klu'i rgyal po go ta ma nag po dang / klu'i rgyal po yid bzang dang / klu'i rgyal po me skedang zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ⑫ba/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba/ de rnams kyi sku mdog 36—1397

dang phyag mtshan ni/ dmar nag dang / dud ka dang / mthing kha dang /dkar ser dang / dmar ser dang / dmar po dang ngo / /g.yas rnams na ral gri dang / rdo rje dang / 'khor lo dang / rin po che dang / pad+ma dang /dgra sta'o/ /g.yon rnams na sbrul gyi zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /gnod sbyin gyi cha byad du bzhugs pa'o/ /dbu la sbrul gyi gdengs ka dang bcas pa/ sbrul gyi mdud pa la ①bzhugs pa/ rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba②/ sems can gyi don byed pa'o/ /'di mngon pa'i dus ①can/ rgyal rigs nam phyed na rgyu ba'o/ /sbrul mgo dgu pa dang bcas pa/ sbrul gyi kha dog kyang dud kar gnas pa/ sbrul zhags kyang dud ka'o/ /klu'i rgyal po rnams kyis gang dag sa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir dus dus su 'brug sgra sgrogs ༷pa/ dus dus su lo tog smin pa/ dus dus su char 'be+ebs pa/ dus dus su lo tog sgrub pa/sangs rgyas mthong ba/ bslab pa'i gzhi gzung ༷ba/ gsum la skyabs su 'gro brjo—/ nam mkha' lding gi 'jigs pa dang / me dang bye ma'i 'jigs pa dang /rgyal po las kyi 'jigs pa las thar ba/ sa 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i gzhal yas khang chen por gnas pa tshe ring ba bskal par gnas pa/ dbang che bar grags pa/ rdzu 'phrul che ba/ longs spyod che ba/ 'khor phal che ba/dgra'i dpung rab tu 'joms pa⑦/ rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa/ 'od dang ldan pa/kha dog dang ldan pa/ grags pa dang ⑧ldan pa/ lha dang lha ma yin gyi g.yul dag kyang myong bar byed pa dag go/ /klu'i rgyal po de rnams ni chung ma dang bcas pa/ bu dang bcas pa/ tsha bo dang bcas pa/ spun dang bcas pa/blon po dang bcas pa/ ded dpon dang bcas pa/ pho nya dang bcas pa/36—1398

mngag pa dang bcas pa/ g.yog dang bcas pa/ 'khor dang bcas pa'o/ /klu'i rgyal po de rnams ni lho nub mtshams na bzhugs pa'o/ /klu'i rgyal po mi'i rtsa ba dang / klu'i rgyal po mi'i ①bla ma dang / klu'i rgyal po glang po che dang /klu'i rgyal po mi ma yin dang / klu'i rgyal po gzings dang zhes bya ba ni/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ⑤ba/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/ sngon po dang / sngo bsangs dang /ser po dang / dmar po dang / ljang gu'o/ /g.yas rnams ④na rtse gsum dang / ba dan dang / rlung 'khril rjodang / rin po che dang / a 'bras snying po'o/ /g.yon rnams na sbrul kyi zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /lha'i cha byad du bzhugs pa/ dbu la sbrul gyi gdengs ka dang bcas pa/ sbrul gyi mdud pa'i steng na bzhugs pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' babu/ sems can gyi don byed pa'o/ /klu'i rgyal po mchog dang / klu'i rgyal po ba lu buka dang /klu'i rgyal po a lu ka dang / klu'i rgyal po hu lu ka dang / klu'i rgyal po e la dang zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ⑦ba/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni nag po dang /dkar po dang / ljang nag dang / dkar ser dang / sngon po'o/ /g.yas rnams na dgra sta dang / ral gri dang / rtse gcig dang / phreng ④ba dang /bum pa dang / g.yon rnams na sbrul zhags bsnams pa⑨/ dri za'i cha byad du bzhugs pa/ dbu la sbrul gyi gdengs ka can/ sbrul gyi mdud pa'i khri la ⑩bzhugs pa/ rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba⑪/ sems can kyi don byed pa'o/ /klu'i rgyal po e la'i lo ma dang / klu'i rgyal po 'gro sgra dang /36—1399

klu'i rgyal po 'chi sgra dang / klu'i rgyal po gzi can dang / klu'i rgyal po stobs can dang zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ①ba/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/dmar po dang / sngon po dang / ljang gu dang / dmar ser dang / dkar por ②gnas pa'o/ /g.yas rnams na rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang /gdugs dang / dung dang / rin po che bsnams pa'o/ /g.yon rnams na kyesbrul gyi zhags pa'o/ /mi'i cha byad du bzhugs pa/ dbu la sbrul kyi gdengs ka dang ldan pa/ sbrul kyi mdud pa'i steng na bzhugs pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' badhi/ sems can byu don byed pa'o/ /klu'i rgyal po ser skya dang / klu'i rgyal po zhi ba 'dzin dang / klu'i rgyal po me tog at+pa la dang /klu'i rgyal po sen mo rjocan dang / klu'i rgyal po 'phel dub dang / klu'i rgyal po thar pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung spyob/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/klu'i rgyal po de rnams ni khra bor gnas pa'o/ /g.yas rnams ni bum pa dang /rgyal mtshan dang / gdugs dang / dung dang / 'khor lo dang / pad+ma dang ngo / /g.yon rnams na sbrul zhags bsnams pa'o/ /gnod sbyin gyi cha byad du bzhugs pa'o/ /dbu la sbrul gyi gdengs ka dang bcas pa'o/ /sbrul gyi mdud pa'i steng na bzhugs pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba.a+yo/sems can gyi don byed pa'o/ /rje'u rigs 'dzin pa'i dug dus nam phyed yol na rgyu ba'o/ /sbrul de yang lnga lngar gnas pa/ sbrul de yang khro bor gnas pa/g.yon na gnas pa'i sbrul de yang khra bor ⑨gnas pa'o/ /klu'i rgyal po de rnams 36—1400

kyis kyang gzhan yang gang dag sa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir dus dus su 'brug sgra sgogs pa/ dus dus su lo tog smin pa/ dus dus su char 'bebs pa/dus dus su lo tog sgrub pa/ sangs rgyas mthong ba/ bslab pa'i gzhi bzung ba—/ gsum la skyabs su 'go ba/ nam mkha' lding gi 'jigs pa dang /me dang bye ma'i 'jigs pa dang / rgyal po'i ①las kyi 'jigs pa las thar pa'o//sa 'dzin pa rin po che'i gzhal yas khang na gnas pa/ tshe ring ba/ bskal par gnas pa/ dbang che bar grags pa/ rdzu 'phrul che ba/ longs spyod che ba—/ 'khor phal che ba/ dgra'i dpung rab tu 'joms pa/ rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa/ 'od dang ldan pa/ kha dog dang ldan pa/ grags pa dang ldan pa/lha dang lha ma yin gyi g.yul dag kyang myong bar byed pa dag go/ /klu'i rgyal po de rnams ni chung ma dang bcas pa/ bu dang bcas pa/ tsha bo dang bcas pa/spun dang bcas pa/ blon po dang bcas pa/ ded dpon dang bcas pa/pho nya dang bcas pa/ mngag pa dang bcas pa/ g.yog dang bcas pa/'khor dang bcas pa/ klu'i rgyal po de rnams ni nub byang mtshalas na gnas pa'o//klu'i rgyal po blo can dang / klu'i rgyal po rab thar dang / klu'i rgyal po la ā+oṃb dang / klu'i rgyal po mgyogs rab dga' dang / klu'i rgyal po e la dang zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ①ba/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/ sngon po dang /dmar po dang / ser po dang / ljang gu dang / nag po'o/ /g.yas rnams na nā ga puju dang / phreng ba dang / pad+ma dang / kun+da dang / uX la sngon po'o—/ /g.yon rnams na sbrul gyi zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /lha'i cha byad du 36—1401

bzhugs pa/ dbu la sbrul kyi gdengs ka dang bcas pa/ sbrul kyi mdud pa'i steng na bzhugs pa/ rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba①/ sems can gyi don byed pa'o/ /klu'i rgyal po 'dus pa dang / klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang / klu'i rgyal po nye dga' bo dang /sde klu'i rgyal po gsal ba can dang / klu'i rgyal po lta mdzes chen po dang zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ①ba/dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/ dkar po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / nag po dang /ljang gu'o/ /g.yas rnams na dung dang / puṇ+ḍa rī dhika dang / rin po che dang /a 'bras dang / rin po che 'bar ba dang ngo / /g.yon rnams na sbrul zhags bsnams pa'o/ /dri za'i cha byad can du bzhugs pa/ dbu la sbrul gyi gdengs ka dang bcas pa/ sbrul gyi mdud pa'i steng na bzhugs pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba⑤/ sems can gyi don byed pa'o/ /klu'i rgyal po mchog can dang / klu'i rgyal po mchog ldan 'gro ma dang / klu'i rgyal po bzhin bzangs ⑥dang / klu'i rgyal po me long gdong ⑦dang / klu'i rgyal po dri 'dzin dang zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ⑧ba/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/ nag po ⑨dang / sngon po dang / ljang nag dang / dmar nag dang / mthing gar gnas pa'o/ /g.yas rnams na dgra sta dang / rtse gcig dang / 'khor lo dang / rtse gsum dang / mdung bsnams pa'o/ /g.yon rnams na sbrul gyi zhags pa'o/ /mi'i cha byad du bzhugs pa/ dbu la sbrul gyi gdengs ka dang bcas pa/ sbrul kyi mdud pa'i steng na bzhugs pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi bka' 36—1402

las mi 'da' ba①/ sems can gyi don byed pa'o/ /klu'i rgyal po seng ge 'dzin dang / klu'i rgyal po 'gro lding dang / klu'i rgyal po nag po gnyis dang /klu'i rgyal po dkar po gnyis dang / klu'i rgyal po nye dkar gnyis dang / klu'i rgyal po nye nag gnyis dang zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung sdeb/dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/ ser po dang / dmar po dang / sngon ①po dang / dkar po dang / dkar ser dang / mthing ga'o/ /g.yas rnams na rin po che dang / pad+ma dkar po dang / nā ga put+pa dang / a 'bras kyi snying po dang /me tog tsam pa ka dang / a la sngon po dang / g.yon rnams na sbrul zhags rjobasnams pa'o/ /gnod sbyin gyi cha byad du gnas pa'o/ /dbu la sbrul gyi gdings rjoka dang bcas pa'o/ /sgrul gyi mdud pa'i steng na bzhugs pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' brjo/ sems can gyi don byed pa'o/ /gdol pa'i rigs mche ba'i dug dus tho rangs rgyu ba'o/ /sbrul gyi gdengs ka gsum dang ldan pa/ sbrul nag por snang ba/ zhags pa yang nag po'o/ /klu'i rgyal po de dag dang / gzhan yang gang dag sa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir dus dus su 'brug sgra sgrogs ⑦pa/ dus dus su glog 'byin pa/ dus dus su char 'bebs pa/ dus dus su lo tog sgrub pa/ sangs rgyas mthong ba/ bslab pa'i gzhi gzung ⑧ba/ gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba/ nam mkha' lding gi 'jigs pa dang / me dang bye ma'i 'jigs pa dang / rgyal po'i ⑨las kyi 'jigs pa las thar ba/ sa 'dzin pa rin po che'i gzhal yas khang chen po na gnas pa/ tshe ring ba ⑩bskal par gnas pa/ dbang che bar grags pa/ rdzu 36—1403

'phrul che ba/ longs spyod che ba/ 'khor phal che ba/ dgra'i dpung rab tu 'joms pa/ rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa/ 'od dang ldan pa/ kha dog dang ldan pa—/ grags pa dang ldan pa/ lha dang lha ma yin gyi g.yul dag kyang myong bar byed pa dag go/ /klu'i rgyal po de rnams kyang bu dang bcas pa/ chung ma dang bcas pa/ tsha bo dang bcas pa/ spun dang bcas pa/ blon po dang bcas pa—/ ded dpon dang bcas pa/ pho nya dang bcas pa/ mngag pa dang bcas pa/ g.yog dang bcas pa/ 'khor dang bcas pa'o/ /klu'i rgyal po de rnams ni/ phyogs re re na yang rigs bzhi bzhi dang ldan pa/ de bzhin du dug dang / dus rnams kyang yin no/ /gzhan yang gang dag sa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir dus dus su 'brug sgra sgrogs ①pa zhes bya ba ni/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams sam/ 'dzam bu'i ②gling 'dir yang dus dus su 'brug sgra sgrogs ①pa'o/ /dus dus su glog 'byin pa zhes bya ba ni/klu'i rgyal po de rnams kyis kyang nam mkha' la glog yang dag par 'byin pa'o/ /dus dus su char 'be+ebs pa zhes bya ba ni/ dbyar dgun yang char 'be+ebs par byed pa'o/ /dus dus su lo tog sgrub pa zhes bya ba ni/ ma smin pa smin par byed pa ste/ sems can gyi don la lo legs par byed pa'o/ /sangs rgyas mthong ba 4zhes bya ba ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam ⑤par gzigs la sogs pa'idu/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang yang zhal mjal te—/ ma 'ongs pa'i ⑦byams pa la sogs pa rnams kyang mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /da ltar shākya thub pa dang zhal mjal nas skyabs su 'go ba'o/ /bslab pa'i gzhi bzung ba zhes bya ba ni/ tshes brgyad dam/ bcu bzhi'am/ nya la sogs 36—1404

pa'i sdom pa rtag tu yang dag par bzung ba'o/ /gsum ①la skyabs su song ba zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog dang / chos dkon mchog dang /dge 'dun dkon mchog dang gsum la skyabs su song ba'o/ /nam mkha' lding gi 'jigs pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ gzhan klu rnams la nam mkha' lding gi 'jigs pa yod de/ klu'i rgyal po de rnams la mi tshugs so/ /me dang bye ma'i 'jigs pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ klu gzhan gyi yul na me dang bye ma'i 'jigs pa yod de/ de rnams la des mi tshugs pa'o/ /rgyal po'i skelas kyi 'jigs pa las thar ba zhes bya ba ni/ rgyal po rnams kyis sa rko ④ba'am/ sha rul pas 'jigs pa'am/ khrag la sogs pa rul ba'amarjo/ sman mi rnyed pa'am/ de rnams kyi 'jigs pa las thar ba'o/ /sa 'dzin pa'am zhes bya ba ni/ klu de rnams gar bsdad pa'i sar lo legs pa'am/ char che ba'am/ chu bzang ba'am—/ mu ges tshugs par mi 'gyur te/ sems can rnams la dpal 'phel ba'am/ klu'i 'jigs pas tshugs par mi 'gyur ro/ /rin po che'i gzhal med khang chen po na gnas pa zhes bya ba ni/ shar phyogs na gnas pa'i gzhal yas khang ni gzhi dngul las byas nas rin po che sna bdun la sogs pas dhibyas pa'o/ /lho phyogs kyi gzhal yas khang ni gzhi gser las byas te/ rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'o/ /nub phyogs kyi gzhal yas khang ni gzhi pad+ma rjorā ga las byas pa ste/ rin po che sna bdun la sogs pas brgyan pa'o/ /byang phyogs kyi gzhal yas khang ni/ gzhi ma ra ka tas byas pa las rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'o/ /mtshams bzhi yang phyogs bzhi dang mthun pa'o/ /blta na sdug pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang na bzhugs pa'o/ /tshe ring ba bskal 36—1405

bar gnas pa zhes bya ba ni/ bar gyi bskal pa gcig tu ①gnas pa'o/ /dbang che bar grags pa zhes bya ba ni/ gzhan klu rnams kyang dbang che ba ste/'jig rten khams na grags pa'o/ /rdzu 'phrul che ba zhes bya ba ni/ sa 'og sa steng sa bla rnams na gzugs sna tshogs sprul zhing / gong nas gong ②du rgyu ba'o/ /longs spyod che ba zhes bya ba ni/ lha'i longs spyod yod pa ji bzhin du de rnams kyang longs spyod pa'o/ /'khor phal che ba zhes bya ba ni/ sa srin nam sa bdag gam/ klu ④btsan nam/ klu la sogs pa'i 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab pa gnas pa'o/ /dgra'i dpung rab tu 'joms pa zhes bya ba ni/ de rnams ni gzhan gyes ④mi thub ste/ gang du 'gro ba na yang rgyal ba rnam par rgyal ba'o/ /rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni/ skad cig mas stong gsum khyab pa'o/ /'od dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni/ de'i 'od kyis rjorang gi yul khyab pa rang rang gi 'od kyis rang gsal bar byed pa'o/ /yang na rin po che sna bdun gyi 'od kyis tshukhyab pa'o/ /kha dog dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni/ rang rang gi kha dog blta ④na sdug pa mdzes pa'o/ /grags pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni/ klu byang chub sems dpa' sems can gyi don byed par grags pa'o/ /lha dang lha ma yin kyi g.yul dag kyang stsong bar byed pa dag ste zhes bya ba ni/ klu'i rgyal po de rnams kyis kyang blta bar nus shing / lha dang lha ma yin gyi g.yul bkye ba'i rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa'o/ /klu'i rgyal po chung ma dang bcas pa zhes bya ba ni/klu'i rgyal po de rnams re re la chung ma brgya brgya dang ldan pa/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la longs spyod pa'o/ /klu mo de rnams kyang skye legs pa blta na sdug pa/rigs ji bzhin du klu mo rnams kyang de bzhin no/ /bu dang bcas pa tsha bo dang 36—1406

bcas pa zhes bya ba ni/ de rnams la bu dang tsha bo yang brgya brgya yod de/longs spyod la sogs pa yang de bzhin no/ /spun dang bcas pa zhes bya ba ni/de bzhin du spun brgya brgya yod de rgyal po rnams kyi gcung po'o/ /longs spyod la sogs pa yang gong bzhin no/ /blon po dang bcas pa zhes bya ba ni/ blon po yang de bzhin no/ /ded dpon dang bcas pa zhes bya ba ni/ 'khrug pa'i dus yang ded dpon de rnams kyis lag tu len pa'o/ /pho nya dang bcas pa zhes bya ba ni/ klu'i rgyal po re re la pho nya re re yod de/ pho nya'i dus su pho nya gtong ba'o / /mngag pa dang bcas pa zhes bya ba ni/ klu'i rgyal po de rnams kyi 'phrin no/ /g.yog dang bcas pa zhes bya ba ni/ de rnams ni nang na yod pa ste—/ g.yog brgya brgya dang ldan pa'o/ /'khor dang bcas pa zhes bya ba ni/nang 'khor phyi ①'khor gnyis yin te/ de yang bsam kyis mi khyab par ④gnas pa'o—/ /'khor dang g.yog dang mngag pa dang / de rnams ni mi'i cha byad la smad sbrul du 'dug pa'o/ /sems can la gnod pa skyel ba nad sna tshogs gtong ba'o—/ /de dag gis kyang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'dis bdag la srung ba gyis shig ces bya ba ni/ thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa'i rang bzhin sgo 'dogs ①med pa gnyug ma'i rang bzhin ngo bo nyid dang bral ba/ de lta bu'i rig sngags la gang zag gang dang gang gis gus par byed par gyur na/ klu'i rgyal po de rnams kyis kyang srung rjob dang skyob par 'gyur ro/ /sba ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ 'jigs pa las sba ba'o/ /yongs su skyob pa dang zhes bya ba ni/klu'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa'o/ /yongs su gzung ⑤ba dang zhes bya ba ni/'jigs pa las yongs su gzung dhiba'o/ /yongs su bskyang ba dang zhes bya ba ni/36—1407

'jigs pa las thar nas bskyang ba'o/ /zhi ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ klu nad thams cad zhi ba'o/ /bde legs su gyur pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ klu'i nad kyi sdug bsngal las thar nas bde ba'o①/ /chad pa spang ba dang zhes bya ba rgo/ klu rnams kyi chad pas mi tshugs pa'o/ /mtshon cha spang ba ④dang zhes bya ba ni/klu'i rgyal po de rnams kyis kyang mtshon cha'i 'jigs pa spong skebar byed pa'o/ /dug gzhil ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ dug bzhi spang rjoba'o/ /dug gsod ⑤pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ klu'i dug bzhi rtsa ba nas med pa'o/ /mtshams gcad pa dang buzhes bya ba ni/ de'i nus pas mtshams las 'gal mi nus pa'o/ /sa bcing ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ sa de ni ④gnod mi nus pa'o/ /lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig ces bya ba ni/ rgas pa med cing nad thams cad dang bral ba'o/ /ston brgya mthong bar shog shig ⑧ces bya ba ni/ bu dang tsha bo thams cad mthong ba—/ tshe ring bar gnas pa'o/ /gtsang sbra ma byas pa dang / gtsang sbra phya byas pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ gtsang sbra ma byas pa ni chos nyid yin te/ de yang rig pa'i rang bzhin no/ /gtsang sbra byas pa ni kṛ ⑩ya'i tshul gyis gnas pa ste/de ni gtsang sbra la brten pa'i rig pa'o/ /myos pa dang / rab tu myos pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ dran pa stor ba ste/ rab tu myos pa ni de bas kyang dran pa stor ba'o—/ /'gro ba dang 'greng ba zhes bya ba ni/ thag ring ba dang / thung ba dang / bsdad pa'o/ /'greng ba ni dran pa mi rnyed cing 'gro mi shes pa'o/ /'dug pa dang nyal ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ ldang bar mi nus par nad kyis thebs pa'o—/ /nyal ba ni de bzhin du nad kyis thebs pa'o/ /mi nyal ba dang 'ongs pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ 'dug snying mi 'dod cing / ma rig pa'i sems dang 36—1408

ldan pa'o/ /ma 'ongs pa dge bar gyur cig ces bya ba ni/ de la sogs pa rig sngags kyi gzi brjid kyis bde bar gnas pa'o/ /rgyal po'i 'jigs pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ srog dang nor shor ba las thar ba'o/ /chos rkun gyi 'jigs pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ lam du zhugs pa dang / khyim du nor stor ba'i 'jigs pa'o/ /me'i ①'jigs pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ rang gi khyim du sdegazhan du 'gro ba'i sar ri la sogs pa tshig pa'o/ /chu'i 'jigs pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ gru dang gzings dang rab kyi dkyil lo/ /mi mdza' ④ba'i 'jigs pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ dgra bo dang phrad pa'o/ /gsod pa'i 'jigs pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ srog dang bral bar byed pa'o/ /phyir rgol ba dang zhes bya ba ni/spyo thung ba gshis ngan pa dang phrad rjopa'o/ /dgra'i 'jigs pa dang zhes bya ba ni/de ni gnod par byed pa 'ba' zhig go/ /'joms pa'i 'jigs pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ rgyal po dang gzhan dbang che ba rnams kyis 'joms pa'o/ /pha rol gyi dgra'i tshogs kyis 'joms rjopa dang zhes bya ba ni/ gzhan yang dpung gis bcom pa'i 'jigs pa'o/ /mu ge'i 'jigs pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ char dkon pa dang char ches pa dang / sems can rnams kyi lo 'joms pa'o/ /dus ma yin pa'i rjo'achi ba'i 'jigs pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ chu dang / me dang /mtshon dang / 'byung po dang / rims dang / thog dang / lhung ba dang /rdib ⑦pa dang / sa g.yo ba'i 'jigs pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ rkyen gyis g.yo ba dang / rnam par smin pas g.yo ba'o/ /gcan gzan khro bo'i 'jigs pa las bdag bde legs su gyur cig ces bya ba ni/ stag dang dom la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa ste/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo'i gzi brjid kyis/ klu'i rgyal po de 36—1409

rnams kyis srung ①ba dang skyob par byed do②/ /lha'i 'jigs pa dang zhes bya ba ni—/ gdon rigs mi gcig pa stong phrag brgyad cu/ lha'i gdon la sogs pa/ gdon rigs stong phrag ④brgyad cu burtsa gnyis so/ /de la sogs pa ngan song bsam gyis mi khyab pa'orjo/ /gnon po'i 'jigs pa las bdag bde legs su gyur cig ces bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi gzi brjid kyis klu'i rgyal po de rnams kyis kyang gdon de rnams kyi 'jigs pa la dubasrung ba dang skyab ⑦par 'gyur ro/ /gshed byed dang bsgyur sdeba'i las la sogs pa zhes bya ba ni/ las bcu bzhi las thar ba ste/ de'i las ni rnam par smin pa dang rkyen gyis byung ba'o/ /smad pa'i 'jigs pa las bde legs su gyur cig ces bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi gzi brjid kyis klu'i rgyal po de rnams kyis kyang gdon de rnams kyi 'jigs pa las srung ⑨ba dang skyob par 'gyur ro/ / shu ba dang ⑩zhes bya ba la sogs padurte /mdze rigs mi mthun pa bco brgyad do/ /lhog pa'i 'jigs pa las bde legs su gyur cig ces bya ba ni/ klu nad de rnams ni rig sngags kyi rgyal mo'i gzi brjid kyis klu'i rgyal po de rnams kyis kyang nad de rnams las srung ⑫ba dang skyob par byed pa'o/ /mtshan mo bde legs nyin bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung gi bde legs dang / /zhes bya ba ni rig sngags kyi gzi brjid kyis dus de gnyis kyang bde bar gnas pa nad thams cad dang bral ba'o/ /nyin mtshan kun gyi bde legs dag⑫ /sangs rgyas kun gyis bdag la sprul/ /zhes bya ba ni dus tho rangs ka dang / phyi dro dang / rig sngags kyi gzi brjid kyis dus rtag tu bde ba'o/ /sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal byang chub phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bya ba ni rten gyi gang zag gis de lta bu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub la phyag 'tshal ba'o/ /36—1410

grol gyur ①phyag 'tshal gol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bya ba ni gzhi ④nas grol ba ste—/ gzhi ni 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal lo/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las grol ①la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhi gyur buphyag 'tshal zhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bya ba ni gzhi ni thun mong ste/ gzhi med pa ni thun mong ⑤ma yin pa'o/ /de gnyis la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam grol phyag 'tshal grol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bya ba ni rnam grol ni gzugs lta bu ste/ grol ba ni sdug bsngal te/ sdug bsngal las bugrol ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bram ze gang dag sdig pa'i chos rnams bsal ⑦bar gyur pa de dag la yang phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba ni/ sdig pas mi gos pa gtsang ba'i rigs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo④/ /de dag gis kyang bdag la bskyang ⑨ba dang srung ba kyis shig swā hā zhes bya ba ni/ gang zag rig sngags kyi rgyal mo la gus par byas nas rjes su yi rang zhing kha ton byed par gyur na srung ⑩ ba dang skyob pa dang / sdug bsngal thams cad las skyob par 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo'i klu'i rgyal po brgya bdun cu'i gnas skabs te bcu gsum pa'o // //⑪kun dga' bo zhes bya ba ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas gsungs pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'di ni zhes bya ba ni—/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma sku mdog ser mo/ zhal g.yas dkar ba g.yon dmar ba/ rgyab mthing ga'o/ /spyan gsum dang ldan pa/sangs rgyas lnga'i dbu rgyan can/ ye shes lnga dang ldan pa phyag g.yas rnams na ⑫ral gri dang 'khor lo dang zhags pa dang ngo / /g.yon rnams na rma bya'i sgro dang /36—1411

dgra sta dang / ①rtse gsum mo/ /tha ma gnyis na mda' gzhu 'gengs pa'o/ /rgyan thams cad kyis ⑦brgyan pa/ dbu la rdo rjes mtshan pa/ thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa zhabs phyed skyil du bzhugs pa/ pad+ma sna tshogs kyi gdan dang /zla ba'i gdan la nyi ma'i 'od dang bcas pa'o/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs kyis gsungs pa'o zhes bya ba ni/ nam mkha'i rang bzhin dang 'dra ba sku gsung thugs rnam par dag pa de lta bu'i rig sngags yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs kyis gsungs pa'o/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs ni sku mdog gser dang 'dra ba/zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas g.yon gnyis chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya mdzad pa rdo rje'i skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ zla ba'i gdan dang nyi ma'i 'od dang ldan pa'o/ /tar+ya thā zhes bya ba ni 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs kyis gsungs pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi gsang sngags blta ba'o/ /rig sngags kyi gsang sngags ni a ra ḍi ka ra ḍi ma de ①la sogs pa'o/ /kun dga' bo zhes bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' sprul pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'di ni zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo zhal rjobazhi phyag brgyad pa/sku mdog ser mo g.yas mthing ga /g.yon dmar ba rgyab dkar ba'o/ /spyan gsum pa/ rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan canarjo/ ye shes lnga dang ldan pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ g.yas pa gsum na ral gri dang / rdo rje dang /'khor lo dang ngo rjo/ /g.yon pa gsum na rma bya'i sgro dang / zhags pa dang /dgra sta bsnams pa'o/ /tha ma gnyis na mda' gzhu 'gengs pa'o/ /zhabs phyed skyil du bzhugs pa/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang / zla ba'i gdan la nyi ma'i 'od 36—1412

dang bcas pa'o/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa/ dbu la 'khor los mtshan pa'o/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gtsug tor can gyis gsungs pa'o zhes bya ba ni/ stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin nam mkha' lta bu shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ngo bo nyid/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo de lta bu gsungs so—/ /sangs rgyas gtsug tor can ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ sku mdog 'dzam bu'i gling gi gser 'dra ba/ phyag mnyam gzhag tu mdzad pa/ zla ba'i gdan la nyi ma'i 'od dang ldan pa'o/ /tar+ya thā zhes bya ba ni/ 'di lta ste/sangs rgyas gtsug tor can gyis gsungs pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi gsang sngags blta ba'o/ /rig sngags kyi gsang sngags ni/ ir+bhe mi r+bhe la sogs pa'o/ /kun dga' bo zhes bya ba ni/ byang chub chen pos bka' stsal pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'di ni zhes bya ba ni/ zhal bzhi phyag brgyad pa/sku mdog gur kum gyi mdog go/ /g.yas dkar ba/ g.yon ljang gu/ rgyab dmar ba/ sangs rgyas lnga'i dbu rgyan can/ spyan gsum pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ ye shes lnga dang ldan pa/ g.yas rnams na ral gri dang / rdo rje dang / rin po che'o/ /g.yon gsum na rma bya'i sgo dang / rtse gsum dang /zhags pa'o/ /tha ma gnyis na mda' gzhu 'gengs pa'o/ /zhabs phyed skyil du bzhugs pa'o/ /zla ba'i gdan dang / nyi ma'i 'od dang ldan pa'o/ /thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa'o/ /dbu la rin po ches brgyan pa'o/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad skyob kyis gsungs pa'o zhes bya ba ni/thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa mi dmigs pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin de de lta bu'i rigs kyi rang bzhin ni sangs rgyas thams cad skyob pas gsungs pa'o/ /36—1413

sangs rgyas thams cad skyob pa ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa sku mdog ljang gu g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon mnyam gzhag go/ /zhabs rdo rje'i ①skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ zla ba'i gdan la nyi ma'i 'od dang ldan pa'o/ /tar+ya thā zhes bya ba ni/ 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas thams cad skyob pas gsungs pa'i rig sngags kyi ②gsang sngags blta ba'o/ /rig sngags kyi gsang sngags ni/ mo ri mo ri la sogs pa'o/ /kun dga' bo zhes bya ba ni/ thugs rje chen po go ta mas gsungs pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'di ni zhes bya ba ni rig sngags ni zhal bzhi phyag brgyad pa/ sku mdog ser po zhal g.yas dkar g.yon dmar rgyab ljang gu'o/ /spyan gsum pa/ rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan can/g.yas gsum na ral gri pad+ma/ rdo rje'o/ /g.yon gsum na rma bya'i sgo/lcags kyu/ dgra sta'o/ /tha ma gnyis na gamada' gzhu 'gengs pa'o/ /ye shes lnga dang ldan pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs phyed skyil du bzhugs pa/ sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan dang zla ba'i gdan dang / nyi ma'i 'od dang ldan pa/ thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa/ dbu la pad+mas brgyan pa'o/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig gis gsungs pa'o zhes bya ba ni/ yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa'i ngo bo nyid dang bral ba/ de lta bu'i rig sngags sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig ④gis gsungs pa'o/ /sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig rjoni zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa sku mdog dmar ser/ phyag gnyis ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ zla ba'i gdan la nyi ma'i 'od dang ldan pa'o/ /tar+ya thā zhes bya ba ni/ 'di lta ste/sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig rjogis gsungs pa/ rig sngags kyi gsang sngags 36—1414

blta'o—/ /①rig sngags kyi gsang sngags ni/ hi ḍi mi ḍi ④la sogs pa'o/ /kun dga' bo zhes bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ①bka' stsal pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'di ni zhes bya ba ni/ zhal bzhi phyag brgyad sku mdog dkar ser/ g.yas mthing ga /g.yon dmar ba/ rgyab ljang gu'o//spyan gsum pa/ rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan can/ ye shes lnga dang ldan pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ g.yas gsum na ral gri dang / sna tshogs rdo rje dang / 'khor lo'o/ /g.yon gsum na rma bya'i sgo dang / dgra sta dang /rtse gsum bsnams pa'o/ /tha ma gnyis na dumada' gzhu 'gengs pa'o/ /zhabs phyed krung du bzhugs pa'o/ /pad+ma sna tshogs kyi steng du zla ba'i gdan la nyi ma'i 'od dang ldan pa'o/ /thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa'o/ /dbu la sna tshogs kyi durdo rjes mtshan pa'o/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gser thub kyis gsungs pa'o zhes bya ba ni/ kun rdzob dang don dam pa gnyis kyi rang bzhin ye shes rnam par dag pa/ nam mkha'i ngo bo de lta bu'i rig sngags sangs rgyas gser thub kyis gsungs pa'o/ /sangs rgyas gser thub ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ sku mdog gser gyi mdog can/ g.yas pa skyabs rjosbyin/g.yon pa ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya zla ba'i gdan la nyi ma'i 'od dang ldan pa'o/ /tadu thā zhes bya ba ni 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas gser thub kyis gsungs pa'i rig sngags kyi gsang sngags blta ⑦ba'o/ /rig sngags kyi gsang sngags ni 'di lta ste/ta ta le ta ta le la sogs pa'o/ /kun dga' bo zhes bya ba ni/ byang chub chen pos bka' stsal pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'di ni zhes bya ba ni/zhal bzhi phyag brgyad pa sku mdog ser po g.yas dkar g.yon dmar/ rgyab 36—1415

mthing ga /rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan srun gsum pa/ ye shes lnga dang ldan pa/rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ g.yas pa gsum na ral gri dang / rdo rje dang 'khor lo'o/ /g.yon gsum na rma bya'i sgro dang / dgra sta dang / zhags pa bsnams pa tha ma gnyis mda' gzhu 'gengs pa'o/ /zhabs phyed skyil du bzhugs pa—/ pad+ma sna tshogs kyi steng na zla ba'i gdan la nyi ma'i 'od dang ldan pa/thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa'i dbu la mchod sbyin gyis brgyan pa'o/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyis gsungs pa'o zhes bya ba ni/rig pa'i rang bzhin nam mkha' lta bu 'jig rten gyi khams khyab pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ngo bo nyid do/ /de lta bu'i rig sngags sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyis gsungs pa'o/ /sangs rgyas 'od srungs ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa sku mdog ser po phyag gnyis chos kyi dbyings kyi phyag rgya'o/ /zla ba'i gdan la nyi ma'i 'od dang ldan pa'o/ /tar+ya thā zhes bya ba ni/ 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyis ①gsungs pa/ rig sngags kyi gsang sngags blta ba'o/ /rig sngags kyi gsang sngags ni aṇ+ḍa re paṇ+ḍa re la sogs pa'o/ /kun dga' bo zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pas bka' stsal pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'di ni zhes bya ba ni/ mtshon pa ②mtshon byed dang ldan pa/mtshon pa ni ye shes so/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so/ /mtshon byed ni rig sngags kyi rgyal mo bdag nyid de/ de ni thabs kyi rang bzhin no/ /de ni gnyis su med par bstan pa ni kun rdzob dang don dam pa gnyis su med par rnam par dag pa'o/ /zhal bzhir skebastan pa ni tshad med pa bzhi rnam par dag pa'o//zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa ni/ ye shes gsum gyi rang bzhin no//36—1416

sangs rgyas lnga'i dbu rgyan ni rigs ①lnga rnam par dag pa'o/ /ye shes lnga dang ldan pa ni/ stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin bstan pa'o/ /zhal ser po dang /dkar po dang / dmar po dang / mthing gar bstan pa ni/ las bzhi rnam par dag pa'o/ /sku mdog gser du snang ba ni dug bzhi bcom pa'o/ /phyag brgyad du snang ba ni/ rnam par thar pa brgyad rnam par dag pa'o/ /phyag g.yas na ral gri ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu ④phyin pa'i ngo bo nyid rnam par dag pa'o/ /de'i 'og rdo rje bsnams pa ni/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'o/ de'i 'og 'khor lo bsnams pa ni/ ma rig pa'i rang bzhin 'khor ba rnam par 'joms pa'o/ /g.yon dang po rma bya'i sgo bsnams pa ni dug bzhi rnam par 'joms pa'o/ /de 'og zhags pa bsnams pa ni ma rig pa'i bdud bzhi bcings pa'o/ /de 'og rtse gsum bsnams pa ni srid pa gsum rnam par 'joms pa'o/ /tha ma gnyis na mda' gzhu 'gengs pa ni/ thabs shes rab gnyis su med par rnam par dag pa'o/ /rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa ni theg pa sna tshogs bstan pa'o/ /sku la na bza' gsol ba ni/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga spong ba'o/ /zhabs phyed skyil du bzhugs pa ni/ sems can 'dul ①ba'i ngo bor bstan pa'o/ /sna tshogs pad+ma kha dog drug dang ldan pa ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa'o/ /zla ba'i gdan la nyi ma'i 'od dang ldan pa ni/kun sdob dang don dam par dag pa'o/ /thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa ni/ye shes kyi rang bzhin chos kyi sku'i ngo bo rnam par dag pa'o/ /dbu la rdo rjes mtshan pa ni/ nam mkha'i rang bzhin stong pa nyid du dag pa'o/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa nas duzhes bya ba ni/ chos sku longs sku 36—1417

sprul pa'i sku la de gsum tha mi dad pa'i rang bzhin stong gsum kyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams khyab pa/ nam mkha' bzhin du rnam par dag pa sprul pa'i sku'i rang bzhin sems can gyi don byed pa sangs rgyas shākya thub pa ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ sku mdog 'dzam bu gling gi gser dang 'dra ba/ g.yas sa gnon gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yon mnyam bzhag ①go/ /mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang ldan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa/ dbu reg khyegatsug tor dang ldan pa/ sham thabs dang chos gos sku la gsol ba/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ smin ma mdzod spus brgyan pa/ pad+ma'i gdan dang zla ba'i gdan dang / rdo rje seng ge'i khri la bzhugs pa/ nyi ma'i 'od dang ldan pa'o/ /sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs la sogs pa ni sangs rgyas shākya thub pa ji bzhin no/ /sems can la phan pa'i phyir da ltar bshad pa'o zhes bya ba ni/ de lta bu dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas/ dge slong sa ri dang / mtha' yas kyi sems can gyi don la dug bzhi rnam par sel ba'i phyir rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo sems can rnams la thugs rje che ba dug dang bdud dang 'byung po rnams kyi gnyen po nad thams cad sel ba 'byung po thams cad 'joms pa/ sku gsung snethugs kyi rang bzhin rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi ngo bo nyid rig sngags kyi rgyal mo de/ sangs rgyas shākya seng ges rig sngags gsungs pa'o/ /t+yad buthā zhes bya ba ni 'di lta ste/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin rig sngags kyi gsang sngags blta ba'o/ /rig sngags kyi gsang sngags ni/hi li mi li ki li mi li me.i li la sogs pa'o/ /ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pas bstan cing rjes su yi rangs rjonas zhes bya ba ni/ gzhan gyis ⑦mi thub pa rnam 36—1418

par rgyal ba sems can thams cad la bkra shis pa/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi ngo bo nyid do/ /de lta bu'i rig sngags ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas da ltar gsungs pa'o/ /dge slong kun dga' bos dge slong sa ri la bde legs su 'gyur bar byas pa de bzhin du bdag la srung ba gyis shig ces bya ba ni/ kha rlangs mche ba'i dug gis zin pa ste/ klu gdol pa'i rigs kyi rang bzhin de'i dug sel ba dang / sems can rnams la phan par byed pa dang / de bzhin du bdag gis kyang de ltar gyis shig ces gsungs pa'o① /de lta bu'i rig sngags sems can rnams la phan par byed pa dug gi nad thams cad bcom pa'o/ /sba ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ dug gi 'jigs pa las sba ba'o//yongs su bskyab pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ dug gsum kyi 'jigs pa las bskyab ②pa'oske/ /yongs su gzung ④ba dang zhes bya ba ni mi dge ba bcu bor nas/dge ba la gzud pa ste/ nang gi gsum dang / phyi'i dug gsum spangs pa'orjo/yongs su bskyang ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ 'jigs pa thams cad bcom nas/dge ba la bskyang ba'o/ /zhi ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ dug la sogs pa'i nad thams cad zhi ba'o/ /bde legs su 'gyur zhes bya ba ni/ lus ngag yid bde bar byed pa'o/ /chad pa spang ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ klu gdol pa'i rigs kyi chad pa yang spang ba'o/ /mtshon cha spang ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ mtshon gyi rigs su gtogs pa rnams yang dag par spang ④ba'o/ /dug gzhil ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ dug gi rigs kyang dpag tshad brgyad cu'i bubar nas zhi ba'o/ /dug gsad ⑦pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ bsdad pa dang ⑧'gro ba dang byed ⑨pa'i dug gsum yang dag par 'joms pa'o/ /mtshams gcad ⑩pa dang zhes bya ba ni/36—1419

rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba'o/ /sa bcing ba gyis shig ces bya ba ni/rdo rje'i sa'i rang bzhin no/ /lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig ces bya ba ni/ de'i nus pas nad med tshe ring ba'o/ /ston brgya mthong bar shog cig ces bya ba ni/dge ba'i rtsa ba la brtson zhing phun sum yang dag par rdzogs pa'o/ /kun dga' bos nyu zhes bya ba ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis yang nas yang du gsungs pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'di ni zhes bya ba ni/zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ sku mdog ljang gu/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar ba—/ spyan gsum pa ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ dbu la rgyan dang bcas pa/sham thabs sku 'gag dang bcas pa/ g.yas pa na po ⑤ti dang / phreng ba dang /bum pa bsnams pa/ g.yon pa rnams na rma bya'i sgro dang / bum pa ①spyi blugs dang / skyabs sbyin no/ /rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ ye shes lnga dang ldan pa/ bzhengs nas bzhugs pa/ thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa/ zla ba'i gdan la nyi ma'i 'od dang ldan pa/ dbu la mchod rten kyis mtshan pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' byams pas ④brjod cing rjes su yi rang ba'o zhes bya ba ni/byams pa dang / snying rje dang / dga' ba ⑤ dang / btang snyoms kyi rjorang bzhin sems can thams cad de lta bus khyab pa'i rang bzhin te/ de lta bu'i rang bzhin rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo/ /byang chub sems dpa' byams pas gsungs pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' byams pa ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa sku mdog ser po ral pa'i thor tshugs can dbu la mchod rten kyis mtshan pa'o//g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon bum pa spyi blugs bsnams pa'o/ /phrag pa na kṛṣ+ṭa sa le'i pags ④pa yod pa/ sham thabs dang sku aṅga ⑧rag gis sku la brgyan pa/36—1420

me tog nā ga put+pas phrag pa gnyis la mdzes par brgyan pa/ de lta bu'i mdzes rgyud ldan pa'i byams pas kyang gsungs pa'o/ /tar+ya thā zhes bya ba ni 'di lta ste/byang chub sems dpa' byams pas gsungs pa rjes su yi rang ba rig sngags kyi gsang sngags blta ba'o/ /rig sngags kyi gsang sngags ni/ shi ri shi ri la sogs pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo las 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar yod pa rnams kyis gsungs shing ①rjes su yi rang ba'i gnas skabs te bcu bzhi pa'o// //kun dga' bo zhes bya ba ni/ sems can gyi don du yang nas yang du gsungs pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'di ni zhes bya ba ni/zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa sku mdog dkar mo spyan gsum pa ral pa'i thor tshugs can rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /g.yas gnyis na phreng ba dang dung bsnams pa/ g.yon gnyis na rma bya'i sgo dang / sbrul bsnams pa'o/ /bzhengs nas bzhugs pa/ zla ba'i gdan la nyi ma'i ②'od dang ldan pa/thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa'o①/ /mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pas smras shing rjes su yi rang ba'o zhes bya ba ni/ thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa nam mkha'i rang bzhin rig pa mthar thug pa de'i rang bzhin mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pas gsungs pa'o/ /mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa ni zhal bzhi phyag brgyad pa sku mdog dkar po/ spyan gsum pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can/tshangs par spyod pa'i rang bzhin can/ phyag g.yas pa rnams na phyag 'tshal ba dang / phreng ba dang / bum pa dang / mchog sbyin du mdzad pa'o/ /g.yon 36—1421

rnams ni ①po ti dang / dbyu ④gu gsum pa dang / bum pa spyi blugs dang /mnyam gzhag go/ /zhabs pad+ma'i skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /tar+ya thā zhes bya ba ni 'di lta ste/ mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pas smras shing ①rjes su yi rang ba'i rig sngags kyi gsang sngags blta ba'o/ /rig sngags kyi gsang sngags ni nyi li hi li mi rjoli la sogs pa'o/ /dug bcom mo dug ⑤nges par bcom mo zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi gsang sngags kyi gzi brjid kyis nang gi dug gsum dang / phyi'i dug gsum bcom mo/ /nang gi dug gsum ni gti mug zhe sdang 'dod chags so/ /phyi'i dug gsum ni bsdad pa dang 'gro ba dang / byas pa'i dug go/ /gti mug ni glo bur kyi rkyen gyis shes pa bkag nas ye shes mi 'char ba ste/ des gti mug yin no/ /de nye bar gzhag ⑥pas gti mug gi rkyen kyis zhe sdang drag po 'byung ngo / /zhe sdang gi rkyen kyis khams gsum 'dod pa'i rang bzhin gyis 'dod chags drag po byung ste/'dod chags des yang nas yang du dmyal ba dang byol song dang yi dwags su skye ba'o—/ /de ni nang gi dug gsum mo/ /phyi'i dug gsum ni bsdad pa'i dug yin te/ btsan dug la sogs pa'i dug gis gsod pa dang / brgyal ba dang /smyo ba dang / 'gas ⑦pa dang / chu bur dang / long ba dang / lce lkugs pa dang / 'on pa dang / rengs pa la sogs pa'o/ /'gro ba'i dug ni/bsams pa dang / reg pa dang / kha rlangs so/ /des ni rlung ⑧dang /bad kan dang ⑨/ mkhris pa dang ⑩/ chu ser bzhi gtong bar nus so/ /dngos po yod pa'i dug ni reg pa dang / kha rlangs dang / mche ba'i dug go/ /des kyang shi ba dang / rgas pa dang / rengs pa dang / chu bur dang / lce 36—1422

lkugs pa dang / mig mi mthong ba dang / 'on pa dang / lus rengs pa dang / de la sogs pa gtong nus pa'o/ /dngos po med pa'i dug ni bsam pa dang mthong ba'i dug yin te/ bsam pas gnod pa ni stong phrag brgyad khri tsam kyi bar nas kyang gnod pa skyel nus pa'o/ /mthong ba'i dug ni dpag tshad lnga nas kyang mthong ngo / /de gnyis kyang rlung bad kan mkhris ①pa chu ser gyi rang bzhin du yod pa de yang sa bdag gi nad mjo rigs mi gcig pa bco brgyad gtong nus pa'o/ / de rnams ②kyang shu ba dang / g.ya' ba dang / mdze dang / phol mig dang / g.yan pa dang / me dbal dang / lhog pa dang /dmu chu dang / chu bur dang / 'brum bu dang / sha bkra dang / mdzer pa dang / skrangs pa dang / glo dang / gcong dang / lba ①ba dang / mig tshags rjodang / ling thog dang / gag pa dang ngo / /de yang de rnams kyis gtong ⑤ngo / /gzhan gyi nad kyang rjoklad pa na ba la sogs pa nad rigs mi gcig pa nyi shu rtsa bzhi gtong ⑦nus pa'o/ /rims la yang de bzhin no/ /dug ⑧des kyang shi ba dang / gas pa dang / rengs pa dang / long ba dang / lce lkugs pa dang / 'on pa dang / rkang lag zha ba dang / de rnams la sogs pa lus kyi na tsha drag po 'byung ba'o/ /bsam pa'i dug can dang / mthong ba'i dug can gyis ni lo bdun bar du phyir 'phang ngo / /de ni dngos su med pa'i dug go/ /de la byed pa'i dug ni/ phyi ⑨dug nag po dang / rin po che dbyig dug dang / bdud rtsi las byung ba'i dug la sogs pa'o/ /sbyor ba'i dug de ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ /phyi dug nag po ni/ dngul chu dang spu dug las byung ba'o/ /rin po che dbyig ⑩dug ni gser dngul zangs las byung 36—1423

ba'o / /bdud rtsi ①dug ni sbrang rtsi dang / mar dang / 'khar ba las byung ba'o—/ /des kyang mdze dang phol mig la sogs pa gtong nus pa/ tsha ba dang /grang ba dang / tshigs gzhi na ba dang / phyi na ba dang / nang na na ②ba dang /shi ba dang / sbyo ba dang / rengs pa dang / long ba dang / 'on pa dang /lce lkugs pa dang / mkhris pa'i rang bzhin du 'dar ba dang / pho ba la sogs pa na nus pa'o/ /rig sngags des ni de lta bu'i dug bcom mo/ /sangs rgyas kyi ①gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo zhes bya ba ni/ rgyu med pa'i rang bzhin ngo bo nyid dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bu'o/ /de lta bu'i ngo bo nyid kyis me long gi gzugs brnyan dang / smig ⑦rgyu dang chu'i zla ba bzhin du gnas so/ /de'i ngang las 'jig rten khams su khyab pa las dang bag chags zhes bya ba bcom nas—/ sems can rnams la nam mkha' bzhin du khyab pa ste/ lus ngag yid gsum sangs rgyas nas bdud bzhi bcom pa'o/ /de lta bu'i gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi ⑤gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo zhes bya ba ni—/ rang sangs rgyas kyi gzi brjid ni lhag mthong gnyis yinarjo/ lhag ma ni stong pa nyid du bsgom pa mthong ba ni lus kyi ④bya ba bstan nas sems can rnams la bstan pa'o/ /de gnyis kyi bden pa'i gzi brjid kyis rang sangs rgyas kyis ru dug bcom mo/ /dgra bcom pa'i gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo zhes bya ba ni/dgra ni bdud bzhi ste/ bdud bzhi ni ma rig pa'o/ /ma rig pa ni 'khor ba'o//de lta bu'i 'khor ba'i dgra bcom ste/ de'i gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo/ /phyir mi 'ong ba'i gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo zhes bya ba ni rang gi don la gzhan gyi don mi ⑨byed pa ni phyir mi ldog pa rnams so/ /de rnams ni 'gog 36—1424

pa'i rang bzhin/ de'i gzi brjid kyis dug bcom pa'o①/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo zhes bya ba ni/ cung zad tsam sems can gyi don byed pa ste/ bag chags kyi sgrib pa bcom nas shes bya tsam gnas pa'o—/ /de lta bu'i gzi brjid kyis kyang dug bcom mo/ /rgyun du zhugs pa'i gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo zhes bya ba ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i rang bzhin sems can rnams kyi don byed pa mi dmigs pa'i snying rje skye ba'o/ /de lta bu'i gzi brjid kyis ②dug bcom pa'osne/ /bden par smra ba'i gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo zhes bya ba ni/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang ma 'ongs pa rnams dang / da ltar byung ba rnams kyis kyang bka' bden par smra ba gzhan yang 'jig rten pa drang srong rnams kyi bka' bden pa'o/ /de'i gzi brjid kyis kyang dug bcom pa'o/ /tshangs pa'i be+e con kyi gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo zhes bya ba ni/ tshangs pa'i be+e con ni dbyu tshugu gsum yin te dbyu ⑤ gu gcig ni sku brtag pa/ gnyis pa gsung brtag pa/ gsum pa ni yid brtag rjopa'o/ /de gsum ni khams gsum gyi rang bzhin de lta bu'i bden pa'i gzi brjid kyis dug bcom pa'o/ /dbang po'i rdo rje'i gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo zhes bya ba ni dbang po'i rdo rje ni gang la 'phangs pa'i sar dgra rnams 'dul zhing slar rang gi lag tu ④'ong ba'o/ /de lta bu'i gzi brjid kyis kyang dug bcom pa'o /khyab 'jug gi 'khor los dug bcom mo ⑧zhes bya ba ni/ sa 'og sa steng sa bla gsum la 'phangs pa tsam gyis 'khor lo des dbang mdzad de/ 'jig rten gsum kyi dbang phyug tu grags pa'o/ /de lta bu'i gzi brjid kyis dug bcom pa'o—/ /me dbal gyi dug bcom mo zhes bya ba ni/ me ni tsha ba dang sreg par 36—1425

nus pa/ des kyang 'jig rten kyi khams sreg par nus pa de lta bu'i gzi brjid kyis kyang dug bcom pa'o/ /chu lha'i zhags pas dug bcom mo zhes bya ba ni chu lha'i zhags pa ni sbrul zhags yin te de ni klu rigs bzhi'i rang bzhin dug bzhi'i gnas pa bcing bar nus pa dug gis dug bcom pa'o/ /lha ma yin gyi sgyus dug bcom mo zhes bya ba ni lha ma yin re res bye ba dung phyur tsam du sprul nus so/ /ji ltar sprul zhe na/ glang po che dang rta dang de la sogs pa gzugs sna tshogs ston nus pa①/ 'jig rten khams la sgyu ma byas pa'o/ /klu'i rig pas dug bcom mo zhes bya ba ni/ phan bya rjodang gnod byed do shes pa tshe phyi ma la skye ba bdun du rig pa dran pa'o/ /drag po'i mdung rtses dug bcom mo zhes bya ba ni de yang rtse gsum du gnas pas te de khams kyi rang bzhin srid pa'i klu'i rig pas dug bcom mo/ /pyaskem byed kyi mdung thung gis dug bcom mo zhes bya ba ni de ni mdung rtse gsum yin te/ de 'phangs pa rjotsam kyis 'jig rten khams tsam 'jig par byed pa'o/ /des kyang dug nges par bcom mo/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mos dug bcom mo zhes bya ba ni phyi'i rig sngags dang / nang gi rig sngags so/ /phyi'i rig sngags ni kun rdzob kyi rang bzhin thabs lta bu'o/ /nang gi rig pa ni ye shes kyi rang bzhin nam mkha' lta bu'o/ /sngags ni sems can rnams la phan par byed cing srung ba dang skyob par byed pa'o/ /de lta bu yang sgyu ma lta bu ste/ 'jig rten khams mi rtag par gnas pa'o/ /de ni dug thams cad kyi gnyen po 'byung po thams cad kyi gtso mo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi yum du gnas pa'o/ /de lta bu'i gzi brjid kyis kyang dug bcom pa'o⑦/ /dug nges par bcom mo zhes bya ba ni/ yang 36—1426

dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi bden pa dang / rig sngags kyi gsang sngags kyi gzi brjid kyis dug kyang nges par bcom mo/ /dug sa'i nang du song shig ces ①bya ba ni sa ni yum lta bu ste/ dug gi 'byung ba ni sa yin te sa des kyang dug sel ba dug gi nus pa med par byed pa'o/ /bdag dug thams cad dang zhes bya ba ni bdag dang sems can thams cad la gzi brjid de rnams kyis dug bcom mo/ /dug nges par bcom mo/ /be+e'u lta bu'i lte ba'i dug dang zhes bya ba ni de la gnyis yod de nag po mi srun pa'i sdig pa dang / rgyal po lta bu'i sdig pa'o①/ /nag po mi srun pa'i sdig pa ni mjug ma dang lte ba la yod pa'o / /rgyal po lta bu'i ①sdig pa'i dug ni reg pa'i dug bzhin du lus thams cad dug tu na ba'o/ /de gnyis kyang lo gcig lon nas mdud pa re rer skye ba'o//de gnyis kyi mdog kyang dmar po dang / nag por snang ba'o/ /ha la ha la'i dug dang zhes bya ba ni/ de ni 'jig rten gyi lha rnams kyi dug yin te/ de yang mthong ba'am reg pa tsam gyis me'ajig rten gyi khams sreg ⑤nus pa'o/ /nag po brtsegs pa'i dug dang zhes bya ba ni/ de la gnyis su rjoyod de/ nang gi dug gsum brtsegs pa dang / phyi'i dug gsum brtsegs ⑦pa'o/ /nang gi dug brtsegs pa ni gti mug dang 'dod chags dang zhe sdang ngo / /de'i ngang las ④ser sna dang / phrag dog kyang brtsegs pa'o/ /phyi'i dug ni bsdad pa dang /'gro ba dang / byed pa'i dug brtsegs pa'o/ /yang na nag po brtsegs pa'i dug ni 'jig rten pa'i lha rnams kyis mi thub pa lha dang lha ma yin la sogs pa las byung ba/ klu'i rgyal po spyan mi bzang gi mig las btang ba mig long bar gyur te/ des na spyan mi bzang du btags pa'o/ /dbang phyug chen po'i lhas 36—1427

rna rgyan du btags ①pa'o/ /de bas na tri kan tha btags dze+epa'o/ /mche ba'i dug dang zhes bya ba ni/ klu'i kha rlangs kyi dug sbrul la sogs pa'i sems can las byung ba ④ste/ de yang rigs bzhi la gtogs pa'o/ /rtsa ba'i dug dang zhes bya ba ni btsan dug la sogs pa las byung ba ste/ de ni bsdad rjopa'i dug go//de yang rtsa ba la sogs pa'i dug go/ /nag po dang / dkar po dang dmar po la sogs pa bsam gyis ⑤mi khyab pa'o/ /phye ma'i dug dang zhes bya ba ni de sbyor ba'i dug las byung ba ⑥ste/ de yang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ /lta ba'i dug dang zhes bya ba ni de ni dbang phyug chen po'am klu rnams sam/ 'byung po'am gzhan drang srong la sogs pa sems can phal la yod pa'o/ /glog gi dug dang zhes bya ba ni/ des kyang sems can rnams la 'jigs pa dang skrag par byed pa ste—/ des shi ba dang / brgyal ba dang / snying phyung ba dang / na bar nus pa'o—/ /sprin gyi dug dang zhes bya ba ni/ lce 'bab pa dang / ser ba 'bab pa dang / thog 'bab pa dang / 'brug gis ⑦'jigs pa dang / de rnams kyis sems can la gnod par byed pa'o/ /sbrul dang zhes bya ba ni sbrul gyi rigs kyang rigs bzhi las byung ste/ sbrul nag po ni gdol pa'i rigs/ sngon po dmangs porigs/ dmar po ⑨rje'u rigs te⑩/ dmar skya rje'u ⑪rigs so/ /ser po rgyal po'i rigs te/ ser skya ⑫rgyal rigs so/ /dkar po bram ze'i rigs te/ dkar ser ni ⑫bram ze'i rigs so/ /de yang dug bzhi tshang ba'o/ /byi ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ mche ba'i dug yin te/ de yang dug bzhir 'dzin pa/dug bzhir gnas pa'o/ /srin bu ki ta ④dang zhes bya ba ni/ sems can mchu ring ba phra mo'i rigs de yang mche ba'i dug can no/ /lu ta dang zhes bya ba ni 36—1428

sbrang po che de ni mjug ①ma dang lte ba'i dug can reg pa'i dug la gtogs pa'o/ /ka na bha ba ②dang zhes bya ba ni/ de yang chu la gnas pa kusnyi ra dang / chu srin la sogs pa'i kha rlangs dang mche ba'i dug go/ /sbal pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ mjug rings ④dang / sbal pa sbrul mgo can dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po dang / nag po'i rigs kyang yod de/ de yang dus bzhi dug bzhi la gnas pa'orjo/ /sbrang bu dang zhes bya ba ni chu'i sbrang bu dang sbrang bu ser po dang de yang dus kyi khyad par kyis sbrang rtsi las byung ba'i dug dang /sbrang dubu'i mjug ma las byung ba dang / des kyang rengs pa dang / shi ba dang /rgas par nus pa'o/ /bung ba zhes bya ba ni bung ba las byung ba'i sbrang rgod la sogs pa'o/ /ba ta ri dudang zhes bya ba ni byang ba nag po'o/ / tre ma ⑦bu ka dang zhes bya ba ni de ni sems can sre mo'o/ /tre+e dhil ta'i dug dang zhes bya ba ni mche ba'i dug can la khyi ⑨dang spyang ki dang / stag dang dom la sogs pa las byung ba'o/ /mi'i dug dang zhes bya ba ni/ rig pa'i nus pas sbod gtong dang ma mo la sogs pa'i mthus rengs pa dang shi ba dang / smod pa la sogs pa'i ⑩nus pa'o/ /sdig pa'i dug dang zhes bya ba ni sems can sdig pa dang / mi dge ba'i sdig pa'o/ /mi ma yin pa'i dug dang zhes bya ba ni/ mi ma yin pa'i rigs dang / 'byung po la sogs pa dang / bsam pa dang / mthong ba dang /reg pa dang / kha rlangs kyi dug can no/ /dogs pa'i dug dang zhes bya ba ni de yang rnam par rtog pa'i dug ste/ 'jigs pa dang 'tshe ba dang / yid ⑪'phrig pa'o/ /sman pa'i dug dang zhes bya ba ni drod btang ba bsil du song ste bsil spyob drod du song ba'o/ /yang na rtse'u chung la sogs pa rtsa la lag ⑫nyes 36—1429

su song ba'o/ /rig sngags kyi dug las bde legs su gyur cig ces bya ba ni/sngags dang 'khrul 'khor dang / gshin rje dang / ma mo la sogs pa'i rig pa'i dmod mo las byung ba'o/ /bde legs ni rig sngags kyi rgyal mo'i gzi brjid kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi dug nad ①thams cad bcom pa/sdug bsngal thams cad las bde ba'o/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di ni stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can rnams la sman par grags pa'o/ /dug thams cad las bdag ④bde legs su gyur cig ces bya ba ni dug rigs mi gcig pa sum cu rtsa gnyis las thar ba dang / phyi'i dug dang /nang gi dug thams cad kyang sa las byung zhing sa la song ba'o/ /kun dga' bo zhes bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' sprul pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'di ni zhes bya ba ④ni zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa sku mdog ljang gu spyan gsum pa rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan can/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ye shes lnga dang ldan pa g.yas gnyis na rdo rje dang ral gri'o/ /g.yon gnyis na rma bya'i sgo dang / sbrul bsnams pa'o/ /zhabs rdo rje rjokhrus krung du bzhugs pa/zla ba'i gdan la nyi ma'i 'od dang ldan pa'o/ /thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa dbu la rdo rje rgya gram gyis mtshan pa'o/ /lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis smras shing rjes su yi rang ba'o zhes bya ba ni gzi brjid che zhing mthu dang ldan pa'o//dug nad khruthams cad bcom pa las dang bag chags shes bya'i sgrib pa sel ba/ma rig pa thams cad las rgyal ba de lta bu'i rig sngags ni lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis rjes su yi rang zhing gus par byas pa'o/ /lha'i dbang po brgya byin ni zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa sku mdog ser po spyan gsum pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis 36—1430

brgyan pa/ g.yas gnyis na ①rdo rje dang mdung rtse gsum pa'o/ /g.yon gnyis na gdugs dang zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /glang po che la zhon pa'o/ /tar+ya thā zhes bya ba ni 'di lta ste/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis rig sngags kyi gsang sngags rjes su yi rang zhing gsungs pa la blta'o④/ /rig sngags kyi gsang sngags ni/ dza khā dzan ①tu le la sogs pa'o/ /kun dga' bo zhes bya ba ni/yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas gsungs pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'di rjoni zhes bya ba ni/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa sku mdog dkar mo ⑤spyan gsum pa rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan can ye shes lnga dang ldan pa/rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ g.yas na 'khor lo g.yon na rma bya'i sgro bsnams pa'o/ /zhabs phyed skyil rjodu bzhugs so⑦/ /zla ba'i gdan la nyi ma'i 'od dang ldan pa'o/ /thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa dbu la 'khor los mtshan pa'o/ /rgyal po chen po bzhis smras shing rjes su yi rang ba'o zhes bya ba ni/nad rigs mi gcig pa bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi bcom pa/ bgegs rigs ⑧mi gcig pa stong phrag brgyad cu/ de'i gnyen po thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa stong pa nyid nam mkha' lta bu'o/ /de lta bu'i rig sngags ni ⑨rgyal po chen po bzhis gsungs pa'o/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi'i sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni zhal gcig phyag bzhi bzhir gnas pa sku mdog ni dkar po dang / ser po dang / dmarapo dang / ljang gu'o/ /phyag g.yas pa rnams na go rims bzhin du 'khor lo dang / mda' dang / dbyug to dang / mda' dang / sbrul zhags dang /mda' dang / ral gri dang / mda' dang g.yon rnams na pi wang dang gzhu⑩/rin po che dang gzhu/ pad+ma dang gzhu/ bum pa dang gzhu bsnams pa'o/ /36—1431

shar phyogs zhi bar gnas pa nub phyogs cung zad khro ba lho dang byang ni khro bas te bzhin mi sdug pa pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /de rnams kyang rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /dbu la rim pa bzhin du 'khor lo dang rin po che dang pad+ma dang sna tshogs rdo rje'o/ /tar+ya thā zhes bya ba ni 'di lta ste/ rig sngags kyi gsang sngags ni rgyal po chen po bzhis gsungs pa blta ①ba'o/ /rig sngags kyi gsang sngags ni dz+wa la dz+wa la na ②la sogs pa'o/ /sbod gtong dang zhes bya ba ni/ 'jig rten dang ①'jig rten las 'das pa'i dmod mo'o/ /gshin rje'i ④pho nya dang zhes bya ba ni dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i glo bur gyi rjo'ajigs pa'o/ /mtshan mo nag mo dang zhes bya ba ni bdud kyi zhags pa'i rang bzhin ma mo'i rigs so—/ /dus kyi zhags pa dang zhes bya ba ni bdud kyi rang bzhin rjodus las 'dren pa'o/ /'chi bdag gi chad pa dang zhes bya ba ni 'chi bdag gi bdud ni dbang phyug chen po ste de'i chad pa'o/ /tshangs pa'i chad pa dang zhes bya ba ni phung po'i bdud ni tshangs pa ste de'i chad pa'o/ /dbang po'i chad pa dang zhes bya ba ni lha'i bu'i bdud de ⑦de'i chad pa'o/ /khyab 'jug gi chad pa dang zhes bya ba ni nyon mongs pa'i bdud de ⑧de'i chad pa'o/ /drang srong gi chad pa dang zhes bya ba ni drang srong ni mngon par shes shing rdzu 'phrul dang ldan te de'i dmod mo'i chad pa'o/ /lha'i chad pa la sogs pa ni lha'i gdon pa ⑨la sogs pa gdon rigs mi gcig pa rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa/ rdzu 'phrul che ba nad rigs mi gcig pa stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi nyi shu rtsa bzhi phrag gi chad pa'o/ /rgyal po'i chad pa dang zhes bya ba ni rgyal po'i chad pa nor dang srog dang yan lag bcad nas chad pa gcod pa'i 'jigs pa'o/ /chom rkun gyi chad pa dang zhes bya ba ni nor dang 36—1432

srog gi chad pa'o/ /me'i chad pa dang zhes bya ba ni rang gi yul dang gzhan gyi yul du 'gro ba'i bar du mes 'jigs pa'o/ /chu'i chad pa dang zhes bya ba ni gzings dang rab la sogs pa'o/ /chad pa thams cad las bdag la srung ①ba gyis shig ces bya ba ni chad pa lnga bcu rtsa gnyis kyi 'jigs pa las thar bar gyis shig /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo'i gzi brjid kyis ④chad pa de rnams kyi 'jigs pa dang bral ba/ bdag dang sems can rnams sdug bsngal las thar ba'o—/ /rig sngags 'di yi gzi brjid kyis/ /bsam pa'i dug dang mthong ba'i dug /reg pa'i dug dang kha rlangs dug /de ④ni de bzhin dhiklu yi dug⑤ /de ni 'jig rten phyi yi dug /'gro ba'i dug tu grags pa'o/ /rtsa ba dang ni lo ma dang / /'jig rten phyi yi bsdad pa'i dug /sbyor ba yang dag sman sbyor ba/ /'jig rten phyin ci log pa ste/ /de ni sbyor ba'i dug tu grags/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum/ /rig sngags gzi brjid yang dag gis/ /dug ni gsum po 'joms byed pa/ /dug ni pha dang ma yin no/ /dug ni sa la 'gro bar 'gyur/ /rig sngags burgyal mo rma bya chen mo las/ rig sngags kyi gzi brjid dang ⑦dug gi mtshan nyid bshad pa'i gnas skabs te bco lnga pa'o// //kun dga' bo zhes bya ba ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'o/ /khyod kyis ①klung gi rgyal po ⑨rnams kyi ming zung shig ces bya ba ni—/ khams gsum la gnas pa/ klung gi rgyal po'i gtso bo bzhi bcu rtsa gasbug tu gnas pa'o/ /'di lta ste zhes bya ba ni/ klung gi rgyal po rnams kyi ming blta ba'o/ /klung gi rgyal po gaṅgā dang zhes bya ba ni/ shar phyogs nas 36—1433

glang po che'i kha nas 'bab ste/ 'di ni mtsho chen po'i chu zhes bya ba/ g.yas phyogs su bskor nas/ klung lnga brgya dang lhan cig tu shar phyogs kyi rgya mtsho chen por 'gro'o/ /klung gi rgyal po sin+tu dang zhes bya ba ni/ lho phyogs khyu mchog gi kha nas 'bab ste/ de ni mtsho chen po'i chu zhes bya ba g.yas phyogs nas bskor nas/ klung lnga brgya dang lhan cig tu lho phyogs kyi rgya mtsho chen por 'gro'o/ /klung gi rgyal po pak+ṣu dang zhes bya ba ni nub phyogs nas rta'i kha nas 'bab ste/de ni mtshan dhichu zhes bya ba g.yas su bskor nas/ klung lnga brgya dang lhan cig tu nub phyogs su rgya mtsho chen por 'gro'o/ /klung gi rgyal po sī ②ta dang zhes bya ba ni—/ byang phyogs nas seng ge'i kha nas 'bab po/ /de ni rgya mtsho chen po'i chu zhes bya ba ni①/ g.yas phyogs su bskor nas klung lnga brgya dang lhan cig tu byang phyogs kyi rgya mtsho chen por 'gro'o/ /byang phyogs kha gur gyur pa yi/ /chu mtsho yod de gzhan dag kyang / /de ni mtsho chen chu zhes bya/ /tha dad rgyu rnams byung nas yod/ /chu klung gaṅgā sin+tu pakyu dang / / sī ta dba' rlabs dbu duba'i phreng ba can/ /'bab cing thams cad gsal rjoba'i chu yin te/ /phyogs bzhi kho ra khor duyug dag nas 'byung / /chu klung rab mchog bzhi po 'di dag ni/ /mchog tu bzang zhing so sor 'bab pa ste/ /re re zhing yang lnga brgyar khyer nas ni//chu yi rgyun rnams rgya mtsho chen por 'gro/ /zhes bya'o/ /klung gi rgyal po mda' 'byung dang / klung gi rgyal po khyim ldan dang / klung gi rgyal po gshin rje sel dang / klung gi rgyal po gya gyu dang zhes bya ba ni/ lho'i 'dzam bu'i ⑦gling bzhin du—/ nub kyi ba lang spyod la yang chu bo chen po bzhi 'bab ste/ rim pa bzhin du shar dang / lho dang / nub dang / byang phyogs so/ /g.yas su bskor 36—1434
