nas shar gyi rgya mtshor 'bab pa'o de bzhin du lho la sogs pa yang / lho'i rgya mtshor dang / nub kyi rgya mtshor dang / byang gi rgya mtshor 'bab pa'o/ /'dzam bu'i ①gling bzhin du chu klung lnga brgya lnga brgyar khrid pa'o/ /klung gi rgyal po rgyas 'bab dang / ④klung gi rgyal po zhags bral dang / klung gi rgyal po zhi ba 'dzin dang /④ klung gi rgyal po sa ldan dang zhes bya ba ni/ nub kyi ba lang spyod bzhin du/ byang gi sgra mi snyan la yang mtsho chen por yod de/ de la yang chu chen po phyogs bzhir 'bab ste/ shar dang lho dang / nub dang / byang du'o—/ /de g.yas phyogs su bskor nas/ rim pa bzhin du shar gyi rgya mtsho dang / lho'i rgya mtsho dang / nub kyi rgya mtsho dang / byang gi rgya mtsho'i/ /chu klung de yang lnga brgya lnga brgya bukhrid nas 'bab pa'o/ /klung gi rgyal po zla ba'i cha dang / klung gi rgyal po dbyangs chen dang / klung gi rgyal po rus rjosbal can dang / klung gi rgyal po chu dron can dang zhes bya ba ni/ byang gi sgra mi snyan bzhin du shar gyi lus 'phags gling na yang mtsho chen po duyod de/ mtsho de la yang chu klung chen po bzhir 'bab pa/ de yang shar dang lho dang nub dang byang gi ngos su 'bab pa'o/ /de yang g.yas phyogs su bskor nas shar gyi rgya mtsho dang /lho'i rgya mtsho dang / nub kyi rgya mtsho dang / byang gi rgya mtsho'i⑦/ /chu klung chen po de bzhis kyang / chu klung lnga brgya lnga brgya khrid nas 'bab pa'o/ /klung gi rgyal po chu mchog can ⑧dang / klung gi rgyal po zangs 'dab ⑨dang zhes bya ba ni—/ lho'i 'dzam bu'i ⑩gling gi g.yas ngos na yod pa/ gling phran rnga yab ⑪ces bya ba yod de/ mtsho de la yang chu klung gnyis 'bab ste/ shar dang nub nas bab nas/ shar gyi rgya mtsho dang / nub kyi rgya mtshor 'bab ⑫pa'o /36—1435

klung gi rgyal po sbrang rtsi can dang / klung gi rgyal po dpa' ①ldan dang zhes bya ba ni—/ lho'i 'dzam bu'i ②gling gi g.yon na/ gling phran rnga yab gzhan zhes bya ba ni—/ snga ma bzhin du mtsho chen po yod de/ mtsho chen po de la yang byang dang lhor 'bab ste/ de yang ①lho'i rgya mtsho dang byang gi rgya mtshor 'bab pa'o /klung gi rgyal po bu ram shing ldan dang / klung gi rgyal po ba lang ldan dang zhes bya ba ni/ ba lang spyod kyi shar na/ gling phran g.yo ldan gnas te/ de la yang snga ma bzhin du mtsho chen po 0gnas pa/ mtsho chen po'i kha nas yang / chu klung chen po shar dang nub nas 'bab po/ /chu klung chen po de yang / shar gyi rgya mtsho dang / nub kyi rgya mtshor 'bab po/ /klung gi rgyal po 'phags bupa can dang / klung gi rgyal po rtse 'byin dang zhes bya ba ni/ ba lang spyod kyi g.yon na gling phran nye ba'i g.yo buldan yod de/ snga ma bzhin du mtsho chen po yod de/mtsho chen po'i kha nas yang chu klung chen po gnyis 'bab ste/ de yang lho dang byang phyogs su 'bab ste/ lho'i rgya mtsho dang / byang gi rgya mtshor 'bab pa'o/ /klung gi rgyal po mdza' bzangs dang / klung gi rgyal po kun gyi ⑦bshes dang zhes bya ba ni/ byang gi sgra mi snyan gyi g.yas na/ gling phran sgra mi snyan gnas te/de la yang snga ma bzhin du mtsho chen po ④gnas te/ mtsho chen po de'i kha nas yang chu klung chen po shar nas nub tu 'bab pa'o/ /chu klung chen po de yang shar gyi rgya mtsho dang / nub kyi rgya mtshor 'go ba'o/ /klung gi rgyal po 'chi med dang /klung gi rgyal po me tog pad+ma dang zhes bya ba ni/ sgra mi snyan gyi g.yon na/ gling phran sgra mi snyan gyi zla ba rnams gnas te/ de la yang snga ma bzhin du mtsho chen po sheganas pa/ mtsho de'i kha nas yang chu klung chen po lho dang byang nas 'bab pa'o/ /36—1436

chu klung chen po de yang lho'i rgya mtsho dang / byang gi rgya mtshor 'gro ba'o/ /klung gi rgyal po lnga len dang / klung gi rgyal po ngos ①bzangs dang zhes bya ba ni/lus 'phags po'i gling g.yas na/ gling phran lus dang bya ba gnas te/ de la snga ma bzhin du mtsho chen po gnas so/ /mtsho chen po de la yang chu klung chen po gnyis gnas te/ shar dang nub nas 'bab ste/ shar gyi rgya mtsho dang nub kyi rgya mtshor 'gro ba'o/ /klung gi rgyal po dka' thub sbyin dang / klung gi rgyal po dri bral dang zhes bya ba ni/ lus 'phags kyi g.yon na/ gling phran lus 'phags gnas te/ de la yang snga ma bzhin du mtsho chen bo ④gnas te/ mtsho de la yang lho dang byang du 'bab pa/ chu klung chen po de yang lho'i rgya mtsho dang byang gi rgya mtshor 'gro'o④/ /klung gi rgyal po skyon bral dang / klung gi rgyal po klung chen dang /rjo klung gi rgyal po gser ldan dang / klung gi rgyal po ba lang sbyin mchog dang zhes bya ba ni/ 'og klu'i yul ni 'dzam bu'i ⑤gling ji bzhin du/mtsho chen po yod de/ klu rnams longs spyod byed pa/ mtsho de'i kha nas chu klung chen po bzhi 'bab pa/ de yang shar dang lho dang nub dang byang du 'bab ste/chu de yang rigs bzhi'i klu'i mtsho'i nang du 'bab podhi/ /klung gi rgyal po gsang srung dang / klung gi rgyal po ba lang can dang / klung gi rgyal po dri ma med pa dang / klung gi rgyal po 'od gsal dang zhes bya ba ni ri rab kyi steng na sum cu rtsa gsum na gnas te/ de yang 'dzam bu gling gi ma dros bzhin du mtsho chen por gnas pa/ mtsho chen po'i kha nas chu klung chen po 'bab pa/ chu klung de yang g.yas phyogs nas bskor nas/ shar dang lho dang nub dang byang dang / rdzing bu chen por 'gro ba'o/ /shar phyogs kyi rim ④pa bzhin du lho dang nub dang /36—1437

byang yang shes par bya'o/ /klung gi rgyal po 'dul med dag ces bya ba ni/lho'i 'dzam bu'i ①gling na rdo rje gdan gyi lho phyogs na gnas te/ mtsho chen po de'i byang phyogs nas 'bab pa/ rdo rje gdan gyi 'og nas bab nas chu bo gaṅgā la 'gro ba'o/ /chu de yang kha'i ngos nas med pa 'og tu 'dzul te/ des na chu chen po ne+e rañja na zhes bya'o/ /mtsho chen po bco lnga po de ni srid pa gsum la gnas pa'o/ /ri'i rgyal po spos ngad ldan nas/ de nas dpag tshad bcu'i tshu rol na mtsho chen chu zhes bya ba yod de/ ma dros pa zhes kyang bya'o/ /mtsho chen de'i tshad ni/ chur dpag tshad lnga bcu zheng du dpag tshad lnga bcu/ mthar skor du dpag tshad nyis brgya/ 'phang du dpag tshad phyed dang gnyis yod pa/dbyibs legs shing blta na sdug ②la/ mdzes pa/ chu bsel ba/ sbrang rtsi lta bus gang ba/ mtsho de'i nang du me tog pad+ma dang / puṇ+ḍa rī ①ka dang / ku mu ta dang /rjo ut+pa la sngon po la sogs pa/ chu las skyes pa'i me tog sna tshogs yod pa'o/ /chu de'i nang du yang bya sna tshogs yod deme/ khrung khrung dang /ngang skya dang / chu bya nag po dang / chu bya rke ⑥rings dang / ngang ser dang /ngang skya dang / ngang skya'i rgyal po dang / de la sogs pa chu bya sna tshogs pa gnas pa'o/ /mtsho chen po ma dros pa bzhin du gzhan yang de bzhin du gnas pa'o / /de dag dang gzhan yang gang dag sa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir 'bab pa'i chu klung de dag thams cad la zhes bya ba ni/ srid pa gsum na gnas pa'i chu klung gi rgyal po bzhi bcu rtsa gcig la gnas pa'o/ /gang dag rgyun du gnas pa zhes bya ba ni/ chu la gnas pa/ lha dang lha ma yin/ gnod sbyin 'byung po ma rungs pa la sogs pa'o/ /gzugs tha dad pa zhes bya ba ni/ rkang mangs 36—1438

dang / rkang gnyis rkang bzhi rkang drug rkang brgyad la sogs pa'o/ /gzugs mi sdug pa zhes bya ba ni bzhin mi sdug cing / sbrul dang / sbal pa dang / nya dang / bya dang / khyi dang / wa dang / spyang ki dang / chu srin dang /kusto ra la sogs pa'i mgo brnyan no/ /gzugs mang ba zhes bya ba ni/ sems can la la chu srin gyi gzugs su yod pa/ rta'i gzugs su yod pa/ phag gi gzugs su yod pa/ glang po che'i gzugs su yod pa/ sbrul gyi gzugs la sogs pa/ sems can gzugs mi gcig ①pa mang po yod pa'o/ /gzugs mtha' yas pa'o zhes bya ba ni/ chung ba dang / che ba dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pa'o/ /'dod dgur sgyur ②ba'i gzugs can gzugs sna tshogs pa'i skelha rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ srid pa gsum na gnas pa'i lha la sogs pa'i 'byung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'o/ /zas su gzi brjid 'phrog pa rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ zas su gzi brjid 'phrog rjopa nas/ rigs mi gcig pa sum cu rtsa gcig /srid pa gsum na ⑤gnas pa'i chu klung chen po gnas pa'o/ /de yang gzugs mi gcig pa mang por gnas pa/ srid tshugasum skad cig rgyu ba'o/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'dis bdag la srung ba kyis shig ces bya ba ni/ gang zag gang gis rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di la gus par byas par gyur na/ chu klung chen po de rnams la yod pa rnams kyis kyang yang dag par srung ba dang skyob par 'gyur ro/ /sbra ⑦ba la sogs pa dang zhes bya ba ni—/ 'byung po de rnams kyis kyang snga ma bshad pa bzhin du byas pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo las chu klung bshad pa'i gnas skabs te bcu drug pa'o—/ / //36—1439

kun dga' bo zhes bya ba ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas gsungs pa'o/ /khyod kyis ri'i rgyal po rnams kyi ming zung shig ces bya ba ni/ srid pa chags pa'i dus su chags pa/ ri rab la sogs pa ri'i rgyal po chen po lnga bcu rtsa bzhi'i ming zung shig ces pa'o①/ /'di lta ste zhes bya ba ni ri'i rgyal po rnams kyi ming blta ba'o/ /ri'i rgyal po ri rab dang zhes bya ba ni/dpag tshad brgyad khri ni thur du gser gyi sa gzhi la brten to/ /dpag tshad brgyad khri ni chu las gyen du 'phags pa'o/ / 'phang du ④dpag tshad 'bum drug khri yod do/ /rngams su dpag tshad brgyad khri/ zheng du dpag tshad brgyad khri yod pa/ mtha' skor du dpag tshad sum 'bum nyi khri'o/ /dbyibs legs shing blta zhun sdug la mdzes pa rin po che sna bdun ④las grub pa/ de la sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams gnas so/ /ri'i rgyal po ri rab kyi ngos bzhi ni/shar phyogs ni shel las grub pa/ lho phyogs ni bai ḍūr+ya las grub pa/ nub phyogs sprini dngul las grub pa/ byang phyogs kyi ngos ni gser las grub pa'o/ /ri'i rgyal po ri rab la rtse mo bzhi yod de/ shar phyogs kyi rtse mo ni chur dpag tshad brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga/ zheng du dpag tshad brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga/ mtha' skor du dpag tshad lnga brgya yod pa/ dpag tshad phyed dang lnga ni ri'i rgyal po ri rab las gyen du 'phags te/ dbyibs legs shing blta rjon sdug ⑦la/ mdzes pa shel las grub pa/ de na gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje rnams gnas so/ /lho phyogs kyi rtse mo ni/ chur dpag tshad brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga zheng du dpag tshad brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga mtha' skor du dpag tshad lnga brgya yod pa/ dpag tshad phyed dang lnga ni ri'i rgyal 36—1440

po ri rab las 'phags te/ dbyibs legs shing blta ①na sdug la mdzes pa/bai ḍūr+ya las grub pa/ de na gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje gnas so/ /de bzhin du gnyis po la yang shes par bya'o/ /dngul las grub pa dang / gser las grub pa'o/ /ri'i rgyal po ri rab ni/ bang rim bzhi yod de/ bang rim dang po ni chur las dpag tshad khris gyen du 'phags pa la ri'i rgyal po ri rab las dpag tshad khri drug stong phyir 'phags te/ dbyibs legs shing blta ②na sdug la mdzes pa/ rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa/ de ni lag na yol go thogs kyi lha rnams ④so/ /bang rim gnyis pa ni/ bang rim dang po las dpag tshad khris ④gyen du 'phags pa/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab las dpag tshad brgyad dustong phyir 'phags te/ dbyibs legs shing blta rjon sdug la mdzes pa/ rin po che sna ⑦bzhi las grub pa/ de na phreng thogs kyi lha rnams gnas so/ /bang rim gsum pa ni/ bang rim gnyis pa las/ dpag tshad khri gyen du 'phags pa/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab las dpag tshad bzhi stong phyir 'phags te/ dbyebs legs shing blta na sdug la mdzes pa/ rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa/ de ni rtag tu myos pa'i lha rnams gnas so/ /bang rim bzhi pa ni/ bang rim gsum pa las/dpag tshad khri gyen du 'phags la/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab las dpag tshad nyis stong phyir 'phags te/ dbyibs legs shing blta na sdug la mdzes shing /rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa/ de'i phyogs bzhi na rgyal po bzhi rnams gnas so//ri'i rgyal po gangs can ⑧dang zhes bya ba ni/ sgra mi snyan nas ri nag po dgu 'das pa'i byang phyogs na ri'i rgyal po gangs zhes bya ba yod de⑨/ ri'i rgyal po spos kyi ngad ldang dang zhes bya ba ni/ ri nag po dgu 'das pa'i pha rol na yod 36—1441

do—/ /ri'i rgyal po rtse brgya pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ phyi'i rgya mtsho'i 'gram gyi dpag tshad lnga na srin po'i yul gyi byang ngos na rtse mo brgya yod pa/ zheng du dpag tshad sum brgya yod pa/ dpangs su dpag tshad ①brgya yod pa/ rtse mo de rnams kyang dpag tshad gsum gsum mo/ /ri'i rgyal po seng ldeng can zhes bya ba ni/ gshol mda' 'dzin nas dpag tshad nyi khri bor te/ dpag tshad brgyad khri ni chu'i 'og gser gyi sa gzhi chen po la brten/ dpag tshad khri ni chu las gyen du 'phags so/ /zheng du yang de dang 'dra ste/ dbyibs legs shing blta ④na sdug la mdzes pa/ gser las grub pa/ de na rgyal chen bzhi'i lha rnams kyi grong dang grong khyer ljongs gnas so/ /ci'i phyir ri'i rgyal po seng ldeng can zhes bya zhe na④/ ri'i rgyal po seng ldeng rjocan gyi phyogs de dang de dag na/ji ltar gser gyi seng ldeng yod pa bzhin du gzhan la med de/ de'i phyir na ri'i rgyal po seng ldeng can zhes bya'o/ /ri'i rgyal po gser logs dang zhes bya ba ni/'dzam bu'i gling gi byang ngos kyi cha na ri'i rgyar dpag tshad gsum/ dpangs su dpag tshad gnyis pa/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can gyi gser de na gnas so//ri'i rgyal po 'od 'dzin dang zhes bya ba ni/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi lho ⑤phyogs na dpal gyi ri zhes bya ba yin tebu/ de la ⑦mtha' skor du dpag tshad lnga brgya yod do—/ /dpangs su dpag tshad phyed dang sum brgya dze+ede'i gnas na yang dngos grub can thams cad gnas pa'o/ /ri'i rgyal po mu khyud 'dzin dang zhes bya ba ni—/ ri'i rgyal po rnam ⑨'dud nas dpag tshad stong nyis brgya lnga bcu bor te/dpag tshad brgyad khri chu'i 'og gser kyi sa gzhi chen po la brten pa/ dpag tshad drug brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga ni chu las gyen du 'phags pa'o/ /dpangs su yang de 36—1442

dang 'dra ste/ dbyibs legs shing blta stin sdug la mdzes te/ gser las grub pa/ de na ②rgyal chen bzhi'i grong dang ①grong khyer dang ljongs gnas so/ /ci'i phyir mu khyud 'dzin zhes bya rjozhe na/ ri'i rgyal po mu khyud 'dzin gyi rtse mo/dbyibs legs shing blta rjon sdug la mdzes pa ni/ dper na shing rta'i mu khyud bzhin te/ de bas na ri'i rgyal po mu khyud 'dzin zhes bya'o/ /ri'i rgyal po 'khor yug dang zhes bya ba ni/ phyi'i rgya mtsho dubor te/ dpag tshad brgyad khri ni chu'i 'og gser gyi sa gzhi chen po la brten/ dpag tshad sum brgya rtsa phyed dang bcu gsum ni chu las gyen du 'phags so/ /rngams su yang de dang 'dra ste/dbyibs legs shing blta ⑦na sdug la mdzes pa/ lcags las grub pa/ de na gnod sbyin gos sngon po can rnams gnas so/ /ci'i phyir ri'i rgyal po 'khor yug ri zhes bya zhe na/ ri'i rgyal po 'khor yug ri de dang de dag na/ ji ltar gser gyi 'khor lo yod pa bzhin du/ ri gzhan dag la med pa dang / gzhan yang ri'i rgyal po 'khor yug ris gling bzhi pa 'di 'khor lo'i tshul du bskor te/de'i phyir ri'i rgyal po 'khor yug ri zhes bya'o/ /ri'i rgyal po 'khor yug chen po dang zhes bya ba ni stong gsum gyi ⑧stong 'jig rten khams rnams bskor ba/'og ni gser gyi sa gzhi yan chod yod pa/ steng ni tshangs pa'i 'jig rten man chad yod pa'o/ /gzhi ni lcags las byas pa/ des bskor ba ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i zhing khams su shes par bya'o/ /khyab pa che bas na 'khor yug chen por btags ⑨so/ /ri'i rgyal po dbang po'i brag dang zhes bya ba ni/ ri rab kyi steng gi sa gzhi na sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i grong khyen blta na sdug ces bya ba/ chur dpag tshad nyis stong lnga brgya/ rgyar yang de dang 'dra 36—1443

ste—/ mthar skor ①du khri yod pa/ gser kyi ra bas bskor ba ste②/ ra ba de la 'phang du dpag tshad phyed pa ste/ rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa'i spyog bzhi yod de/ lha'i grong khyer de na sgo dgu brgya dgu bcu rtsa dgu yod do/ /sgo re re rgya la 'phang du dpag tshad phyed dang gsum zheng du phyed dang gnyis pa/ sgo re re rngul rin po che sna bzhi las byas pa'i gzer skar ma'i gzugs su byas pa thubazhi bzhi yod do/ /sgo re re la sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i srung ma go cha gon zhing mtshon cha thogs pa lnga brgya lnga brgya bkod do/ /grong khyer de'i dbus na lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyi khang bzangs rnam par rgyal byed ces bya ba/ chur dpag tshad nyis brgya lnga bcu/ rgyar yang de dang 'dra ste/ mtha' skor du stong yod pa/lha'i grong khyer las dpag tshad phyed dang lnga gyen du 'phags so/ /rmang brten du yang rin po che sna bzhi las byas pa/ de'i phyir dbang po'i brag ces bya'o/ /ri'i rgyal po tshangs pa ldan dang zhes bya ba ni/ de yang bsam gtan dang po la gnas te/ tshangs pa gang na gnas pa na tshangs ldan no/ /ri'i rgyal po dpal ldan dang zhes bya ba ni/ 'dzam bu'i bugling na gnas te/ dpal gyi ri'i byang phyogs na rgyar ⑦dpag tshad sum brgya yod de/ dpangs su yang sum brgya'o/ /de'i sa gzhi ni dpal dang ldan pas na dpal ldan no/ /ri'i rgyal po blta ④na sdug dang zhes bya ba ni/ ri'i rgyal po seng ldeng can nas dpag tshad khri bor te/dpag tshad brgyad khri ni chu'i 'og gser kyi sa gzhi chen po la brten te/ dpag tshad lnga stong ni chu las gyen du 'phags so/ /zheng du yang de dang 'dra'o/ /dbyibs legs shing blta spu na sdug la mdzes pa/ gser las grub pa de na rgyal chen bzhi'i grong dang grong khyer dang ljongs ⑩gnas so/ /ci'i phyir ri'i rgyal po 36—1444

blta ①na sdug ces bya zhe ⑤na/ ri'i rgyal po blta ①na sdug gi rtse mo ji ltar dbyibs legs shing blta rjon sdug la mdzes pa bzhin du ri gzhan dag med de de'i phyir na ri'i rgyal po blta ④na sdug ces bya'o/ /ri'i rgyal po shin tu rgyas dang zhes bya ba ni/ rgya gar yul dang bod yul bar na ri'i rgyar dpag tshad gsum yod pa/ dpangs su yang de bzhin te/ sa'i rir grags rjopa/mtha' skor du gling bzhir bskor ba'o/ /ri'i rgyal po rin chen 'byung gnas dang zhes bya ba ni/ zangs kyi gling dang rin chen gling gi bar na gnas te/rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa/ rgya mtsho chen po'i dbus na yod pa/ mtha' skor du dpag tshad lnga brgya yod pa/ dpangs ⑦su dpag tshad sum brgya/ rgya mtsho'i rin po che thams cad kyang de nas byung ngo / /ri'i rgyal po srin bu can dang zhes bya ba ni/ rgya gar dang bal yul gyi bar na yod de/ mtha' skor ⑧du dpag tshad sum brgya/ dpangs su dpag tshad lnga'o⑨/ /sems can thams cad gnas pa'i phyir na srin bu can zhes btags so/ /ri'i rgyal po nor bu'i rdza ⑩dang zhes bya ba ni/ byang gi (spesgra mi snyan gyi gling gi (gebyang ngos na yod de/mtha' skor du dpag tshad drug brgya/ dpangs su bzhi brgya'o/ /de'i sa na yid bzhin gyi nor bu bzhin du yod pas na nor bu'i rdza spyozhes bya'o/ /ri'i rgyal po thags bzangs ris dang zhes bya ba ni/ ri rab kyi steng gi byang ngos na/lha ma yin gyi gnas kyi dbus na lha ma yin kyi rgyal po thags bzangs ⑫ris kyi bzhugs sa/ de bzhugs pa'i phyir na thags bzangs ⑫ris zhes bya'o/ /ri'i rgyal po rdo rje 'byung gnas dang zhes bya ba ni/ bal yul gyi nub ngos na spre'u'i rgyal po ha lu ma dha'i ⑩lag gi bar nas shor ba'i ri/ de la mtha' skor la 36—1445

dpag tshad lnga/ 'phang du dpag tshad gnyis/ brag rdo rje lta bu ①yod pa'i phyir na/ rdo rje'i brag ces bya'o/ /ri'i rgyal po 'gram ldan dang zhes bya ba ni/bal yul kyi shar phyogs na spre'u'i rgyal po ha lu ma dhas ⑧bor ba/ mtha' skor la dpag tshad lnga bcu/ 'phang ②du dpag tshad drug go/ /'gram pa bzhin du snang ba'i phyir na 'gram ldan zhes bya'o/ /ri'i rgyal po lha min 'bab rjodang zhes bya ba ni/ ri spos kyi ngad ldan de'i byang phyogs dpag tshad nyi shu na/ gser gyi brag bya skyibs lha ma yin kyi ngos bya skyibs zhes bya ba yod de/ chur dpag tshad lnga bcu/ zheng du dpag tshad lnga bcu/ mtha' skor du dpag tshad nyis brgyaspyo/ 'phang du dpag tshad phyed dang bzhi yod pa/ dbyibs legs shing blta ⑤na sdug la mdzes pa'o/ /ri'i rgyal po glog rjo'od dang zhes bya ba ni/nub phyogs ba lang spyod kyi shar phyogs dpag tshad lnga brgya'i bar na ri bo yod de/mtha' skor du dpag tshad sum brgya/ 'phang du dpag tshad nyis brgya/ rgyu gser las byas pa/ glog gi 'od bzhin lhan ne+e lhang nge yod pas glog ces bya'o//ri'i rgyal po khyab ④gnas dang zhes bya ba ni/ lho'i 'dzam bu'i ④gling bskor ba mtha' skor du 'dzam bu'i gling tsam yod de/ 'phang du dpag tshad khri yod pa/rgya che bas spu khyab gnas zhes bya'o/ /ri'i rgyal ⑩zla 'od dang zhes bya ba ni/shar gyi lus 'phags kyi nub/ dpag tshad lnga brgya na shel las grub pa'i ri yod de / mtha' skor du dpag tshad khri yod pa/ 'phang du dpag tshad lnga stong ngo //zla ba ⑪bzhin du bsil bas na zla 'od ces bya'o/ /ri'i rgyal po brag bzangs 6dang zhes bya ba ni/ rgya gar kyi nub byang mtshams na ka liṅga'i ⑫'gram na gnod sbyin ku be+e ④ra'i gnas yin te/ rin po che sna bdun las grub pa'i mtha' skor 36—1446

dpag tshad lnga brgya/ 'phang du sum brgya/ gzhan bas bzang ba'i phyir na brag bzangs ①zhes bya'o/ /ri'i rgyal po nyi ma mdzes dang zhes bya ba ni/gnya' shing 'dzin yang zer ri'i rgyal po ri rab nas dpag tshad brgyad khri bor te/dpag tshad brgyad khri ni chu'i 'og gser gyi sa gzhi la brten te②/ dpag tshad bzhi khri ni chu las gyen du 'phags so/ /zheng du yang de dang 'dra ste/dbyibs legs shing blta 1na sdug la mdzes pa/ gser las grub pa ste/ de na rgyal chen bzhi'i grong dang grong khyer dang ljongs gnas so/ /ri'i rgyal po thigs pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ zangs gling gi mdun na ri bo chen po yod de/srin mo'am srin po rgyu ba/ mtha' skor du dpag tshad brgyad pa/ 'phang du dpag tshad lnga yod pa/ thigs pa bzhin du snang bas na thigs pa zhes bya'o/ /ri'i rgyal po 'bigs byed dang zhes bya ba ni/ de yang gser gling na yod de phyi'i rgya mtsho'i 'gram mtha' skor du dpag tshad phyed dang nyis brgya yod de/ 'phang du dpag tshad brgya'o/ /ri de ni mtshon bzhin du yod de/ de'i phyir 'bigs byed ces bya'o/ /ri'i rgyal po zla ba'i brag dang zhes bya ba ni/ o ḍān gyi yul kyi shar phyogs dpag tshad gsum na/ ri de'i mtha' ④skor du dpag tshad drug yod de/ 'phang du dpag tshad phyed dang gnyis so/ /de'i rtse mo la zla ba bzhin du gnas pa zla ba'i brag ces bya'o/ /ri'i rgyal po sna tshogs brtsegs dang zhes bya ba ni/ rgya nag po'i ngos na ri bo rtse lnga pa mtha' skor du dpag tshad lnga brgya pa/ 'phang du dpag tshad phyed dang sum brgya/ dkar po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / sngon po dang / kha dog mdzes shing snang bas na sna tshogs mdzes zhes bya'o/ /ri'i rgyal po ma la ya dang zhes bya ba ni/ zangs 36—1447

gling gi lho ngos na tsan+dan gyi nags gseb yod de/ mtha' skor du dpag tshad brgya—/ 'phang du dpag tshad brgya'o/ /de'i lho phyogs na bya khyung yod pa ste/shin tu drang ba'i phyir na ma la yar btags ①so/ /ri'i rgyal po gser gyi rtse mo dang zhes bya ba ni/ gshol mda' 'dzin zhes bya ba'o④/ /ri'i rgyal po gnya' shing 'dzin las dpag tshad bzhi khri bor te/ dpag tshad brgyad khri ni chu'i 'og gser kyi sa gzhi la brten/ dpag tshad nyi khri chu las gyen du 'phags so/ /zheng du yang de dang 'dra'o/ /dbyibs legs shing blta 1na sdug la mdzes pa/gser las grub ste/ de na burgyal chen bzhi pa'i grong dang grong khyer dang ljongs gnas so/ /ci'i phyir ri'i rgyal po gshol mda' 'dzin zhes bya ba ni/ ri'i rgyal po gshol mda' 'dzin gyi rtse mo dbyibs legs shing blta bun sdug la mdzes pa/dper na gshol mda' bzhin te/ de'i phyir na gshol mda' 'dzin zhes bya'o/ /ri'i rgyal po kun nas 'gro dang zhes bya ba ni/ ti se gangs kyi ri'i byang ngos na/tha mal pa'i yul gyi so mtshams/ mtha' skor du dpag tshad lnga brgya/ 'phang ⑫ du dpag tshad lnga'o/ /'dzam bu'i gling du ④khyab pa'i phyir na kun nas 'gro zhes bya'odu —/ /ri'i rgyal po lag bzangs dang zhes bya ba ni/ gser kyi ri ste rgya mtsho'i dbus na gnas te/ 'og gser gyi sa gzhi la thug pa/ chu las 'phags pa ni dpag tshad brgyad stong 'phags so/ /lag pa bzhin du gnas pas na lag bzangs zhes bya'o/ /ri'i rgyal po nor bu ldan dang zhes bya ba ni/sgra mi snyan gyi shar phyogs na nor bu rin po che sna tshogs yod pa/ mtha' skor du dpag tshad lnga brgya/ 'phang du dpag tshad ⑨lnga brgya'o/ /nor bu rin po che thams cad de la ldan te/ de lta bas ⑩na nor bu ldan zhes bya'o⑫/ /ri'i rgyal 36—1448

po sde bzangs dang zhes bya ba ni/ ba lang spyod kyi nub ngos na/ dpag tshad khri mtha' skor du yod pa/ dpag tshad lnga stong 'phang du'o/ /shin tu dbyibs legs pa blta ①na sdug pa'i phyir na/ sde bzangs su btags pa'o/ /ri'i rgyal po tshangs pa'i mchu dang zhes bya ba ni/ chu gaṅgā'i ②'gram ga ya zhes bya ba na/ri bo rked sum nyag yod de/ mtha' skor dpag tshad brgyad ①yod do/ /rked nyag la dpag tshad re re/ 'phang du yang lnga bcu'o/ /de na tshangs pa gnas pa'i phyir/ tshangs pa'i mchu zhes bya'o/ /ri'i rgyal po rig dubyed srung dang zhes bya ba ni/ de yang de'i rtsa ⑤na yod de/ dbyibs dang rgya dang 'phang yang de bzhin no/ /de la tshangs pa gnas shing rig byed bzhi gnas de nas byung bas na rig byed ldan zhes bya'o/ /ri'i rgyal po ba lang sna dang zhes bya ba rgo/ bal yul gyi byang ngos na khyab 'jug gi lha gnas pa/ dpag tshad bzhi ni mtha' rjoskor 'phang du ni gsum mo/ /ba lang gi sna bzhin du rtse mo yod pa'i phyir na ba lang sna zhes bya'o/ /ri'i rgyal po sna tshogs phreng dang zhes bya ba ni/ 'dzam bu gling gi byang ngos na ⑦rgya nag po'i byang shar mtshams na gnas pa/ mtha' skor du dpag tshad khri yod pa/ 'phang du dpag tshad lnga stong yod pa/ rtse mo la phreng ba bzhin du gnas pas na sna tshogs phreng zhes bya'o/ /ri'i rgyal po mi 'jigs sna tshogs dang zhes bya ba ni/ de ni nub kyi ba lang spyod kyi nub ngos na gnas te/ mtha' skor ni dpag tshad lnga brgya/ 'phang du dpag tshad phyed dang sum brgya'o/ /gzhi lcags las ⑧grub pa/ de la ⑨gnas pa'i sems can rnams la 'jigs pa med pas na mi 'jigs sna tshogs zhes bya'o/ /ri'i rgyal po ral gri dang zhes bya ba ni/ 'dzam bu'i ⑩gling gi lho ngos na/ yul spyi bo gtsug 36—1449

na ri ral gri'i dbyibs su yod pa/ mtha' skor du dpag tshad brgya/ 'phang du nyis brgya'o/ /ral gri bzhin du rtse mo rno bas na/ ral gri zhes bya'o/ /ri'i rgyal po gdung ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi dbus na yod de/dbyibs tho ba dang 'dra ba/ mtha' skor du dpag tshad drug yod pa/ 'phang du dpag tshad brgyad do/ /gdung ba'i tshul du yod pa'i phyir na gdung ba zhes bya'o—/ /ri'i rgyal po mig bsku ①dang zhes bya ba ni/ sgra mi snyan gyi shar phyogs na ri chen po mig bsku ②zhes bya bar grags pa/ mtha' skor du dpag tshad brgya pa—/ 'phang du dpag tshad sum brgya'o/ /mi ①mi thar ba/ mi ma yin gnas pa'oske/ /ri'i rgyal po muñja dang zhes bya ba ni/ mnga' ris bukyi shar ngos gangs kyi ri rtse gcig tu yod pa/ mtha' skor du dpag tshad lnga brgya yod pa/'phang du dpag tshad sum brgya gnas pa/ rtse mo rno ba'o/ /de na gnas pa ni dbang phyug chen po'i bu gzhon nu gdong drug gnas so/ /ri'i rgyal po ri dwags can dang zhes bya ba ni/ bal yul gyi byang ngos na gnas te/ dbyibs ri dwags shar na ⑤ bzhin du gnas te/ mtha' skor du dpag tshad lnga pa/ 'phang du dpag tshad gsum mo/ /ri dwags bzhin du yod pas na ri dwags can zhes bya'o—/ /ri'i rgyal po 'joms rjobyed dang zhes bya ba ni/ bal yul dang rgya gar gyi mtshams na/ mtha' ⑦skor du dpag tshad bzhi yod pa/ 'phang du gnyis so/ /ri'i rgyal po ti ⑧se dang zhes bya ba ni/ gangs kyi ri yin te/de yang rtse gsum du yod pa/ lha ma hā de ba yod pa/ mtha' skor dpag tshad lnga brgya yod pa/ 'phang du yang lnga brgya'o/ /ri'i rgyal po mi mjed dang zhes bya ba ni/ ti se'i byang ngos na dpag tshad lnga yod pa'i bar na/ mtha' skor 36—1450

du ①dpag tshad brgya/ 'phang du dpag tshad sum cu'o/ /ri'i rgyal po tsan+dan phreng dang zhes bya ba ni/ ma la ya'i shar phyogs kyi bar na dpag tshad lnga yod de/tsan+dan gyi nags gseb rdzul gdug ②pa can yod pa/ mtha' skor du dpag tshad brgya yod pa①/ 'phang du yang brgya'o/ /ri'i rgyal po stobs 'dzin khyam ④dang zhes bya ba ni/ rgya nag po na gnas te/ mtha' skor du dpag tshad khri yod pa/'phang du dpag tshad lnga brgya yod pa/ ri'i rgyal po dhidabang chen dang zhes bya ba ni/ rgya bod kyi bar na ri bo chen po/ mtha' skor du dpag tshad brgya/'phang du dpag tshad lnga bcu'o/ /ri'i rgyal po dus 'bri byed dang zhes bya ba ni/bal yul dang rgya gar 'khor nas yod pa/ mtha' skor du dpag tshad khri yod pa/'phang du lnga brgya'o/ /ri'i rgyal po skem byed rjodang zhes bya ba ni/ dus 'bri byed kyi byang ngos dpag tshad gcig na/ mtha' skor yang de bzhin no/ /'phang du dpag tshad drug brgya'o/ /ri'i rgyal po ba lang srung zhes bya ba ni/bal yul kyi nub ngos na/ dbang phyug chen po'i lha gnas pa/ dpag tshad lnga mtha' skor ro/ /'phang du dpag tshad gsum mo/ /ri'i rgyal po bya rog sgra can ⑦dang zhes bya ba ni/ zlum pa ⑤rgya che ba mtha' skor du dpag tshad bcu pa/'phang du dpag tshad bcu'o/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi zhing khams su grags pa'o/ /ri'i rgyal po brten ⑨pa 'dzin dang zhes bya ba ni/ rgya mtsho'i nang na gnas pa/rgya che ba gser gyi sa gzhi la thug pa/ rgyu yang gser las byas pa'o/ /ri'i rgyal po rta rna ri dang zhes bya ba ni/ ri blta ⑩na sdug pa dpag tshad lnga stong bor te—/ dpag tshad brgyad khri ni chu'i 'og gser gyi sa gzhi chen po la brten te/dpag tshad nyis stong lnga brgya chu las gyen du 'phags te/ zheng du yang de dang 36—1451

'dra ste/ dbyibs legs shing blta ①na sdug la mdzes pa/ de na rgyal chen bzhi'i lha rnams kyi grong dang ④grong khyer dang ljongs gnas so/ /ci'i phyir ri'i rgyal po rta rna ri zhes bya na①/ ri'i rgyal po rta rna ri'i rtse mo dbyibs legs shing blta na sdug la mdzes pa ni/ dper na rta'i rna ba bzhin te/ de'i phyir ri'i rgyal po rta rna ri zhes bya'o/ /ri'i rgyal po rnam rjo'adud dang zhes bya ba ni/ri'i rgyal po rta rna ri nas dudapag tshad nyis stong lnga brgya bor nas/ dpag tshad brgyad khri chu'i 'og nas gser gyi sa gzhi chen po la brten te/ dpag tshad stong nyis brgya lnga bcu ni chu las gyen du 'phags so/ /rngams su yang de dang 'dra ste/dbyibs legs shing blta rjon sdug la mdzes pa/ gser las grub pa/ de na rgyal chen bzhi pa'i lha rnams kyi grong dang grong khyer dang ljongs ⑦gnas so/ /ci'i phyir ri'i rgyal po rnam ⑧'dud ces bya ba zhe na/ ri'i rgyal po rnam par 'dud kye kyi rtse mo dma' zhing 'dud pa ni/ dper na gnyan ru bzhin te/de'i phyir na ri'i rgyal po rnam par 'dud ces bya'o/ /sa'i dkyil 'khor 'di na/ri'i rgyal po 'di dag ⑩dang zhes bya ba ni/ ri'i rgyal po de rnams la sogs pas gtso ⑪bo byas pa'o/ /gzhan dag kyang yod pa de la lha rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams la gnas pa'i ri'i rgyal po la sogs pa rnams so/ /lha la sogs pa'i 'byung bo stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi/bgegs rigs mi gcig pa ri de rnams la gnas so/ /rig sngags 'chang grub pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ ri de rnams la gnas pa'i rig sngags 'chang gi rgyal po la sogs pa bsam gyis mi ⑫khyab pa gnas pa'o/ /rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa gang dag rgyun du gnas pa zhes bya ba ni/ rgyal po bzhi yang ri de rnams la rgyu'o//36—1452

gzhan yang rgyal po rnams kyang ①ri de la rgyu ste/ de'i 'khor rnams kyang de la rgyu'o—/ /ri de rnams la yang gzugs sna tshogs pa dang / gzugs tha dad pa dang /④ 'dod pa'i gzugs dang / gzugs mngon pa dag ①ri de rnams la gnas pa'o/ /de dag gis kyang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'dis bdag la bsrung ༷ba kyis shig ces bya ba ni/ gang zag gang yang rung ba 'di la gus par byas na/ ri'i rgyal po de rnams la yod pa'i lha la sogs pa srung rjozhing skyob par 'gyur ro/ /sba ba la sogs pa zhes bya ba ni/ snga ma gong du song ba bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /sdig pa thams cad sol cig /dge ba rnams la snang bar gyur cig ces bya ba ni/ sdig pa ni mi dge ba bcu ste/ mi dge ba bcu ni/lus la gsum/ ngag la bzhi/ yid la gsum mo/ /lus la gsum ni srog rjogacod pa/ ma byin par len pa/ mi tshangs par spyod pa'o/ /ngag gi bzhi ni/brdzun ⑦dang / ngag 'khyal dang / tshig rtsub mo dang / 'phra ma'o/ /yid kyi gsum ni brnab ⑧sems dang / gnod sems dang / log par lta ba gsum mo/ /gzhan yang las dang / bag chags dang zhes bya ba la sogs pa sel ba'o/ /yang na mtshams med pa lnga byas kyang sel ba'o/ /de rnams las log pas na sdig pa thams cad sel ba'o/ /mi dge ba sol cig /don rnams la snang bar gyur ⑨ces bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di'i gzi brjid kyis sdig pa de dag thams cad sol cig /don rnams la snang bar gyur cig ni/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i dngos grub snang ba'o/ /thun mong yang las bzhi la sogs pa'am—/ gzhan yang tshangs pa la sogs pa'i dngos grub bo/ /yang na srid pa gsum la sbyor ⑩ba'i sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa'i dngos grub bo/ /thun 36—1453

mong ma yin pa'i dngos grub ni/ rig sngags kyi ngo bo nyid nam mkha' lta bu ste/rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin thob pa'o/ /gnod pa rnams sol cig ces bya ba ni/ma rig pa'i dbang gis/ mi dge ba bcu las ①bdud bzhi 'byung ②ngo / /bdud bzhi las kyang galha'i gdon la sogs pa bgegs rnams byung ba/ lus kyi na tsha rims dhil sogs pa 'byung ⑤ba'o/ /de rnams rig sngags kyi gzi brjid kyis sel ba'o/ /mtshan mo bde legs nyin bde legs/ /zhes bya ba ni/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshu yum—/ de'i gzi brjid kyis bde ba'o/ /nyi ma'i gung gi bde legs dang / /zhes bya ba ni/ stong gsum kyi stong chen po'i ⑦'jig rten gyi khams kyi lha dang lha ma yin la sogs pa 'byung po rnams kyi gnyen po rig sngags 'di'i stobs kyis bde ba'o/ /nyin mtshan kun kyi bde legs dag /ces bya ba ni/ ri'i rgyal po de rnams kyis kyang / rig sngags 'di'i stobs dang byin gyi rlabs ⑧kyis 'byung po la sogs pa de rnams kyis kyang srung ba dang skyob par byed pa'o/ /yang na bde bar 'gyur ba ni 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal spangs nas rig sngags kyi ngo bo thob pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis bdag la sprul/ /zhes bya ba ni/ rnam par gzigs dang / thams cad skyob dang / log par dad sel dang / gser thub dang / 'od srungs la sogs pa 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o—/ /ma 'ongs pa byams pa la sogs pa yang ⑨bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ /da ltar shākya thub pas bde legs byin pa'o/ /swā hā zhes bya ba ni bde bar 'gyur ba'o/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo las ri'i rgyal po rnams bshad pa'i gnas skabs te bcu bdun pa'o// //36—1454

kun dga' bo zhes bya ba ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'o/ /khyod kyis rgyu skar gang dag nam mkha' la rgyu zhing snang bar byed pa rnams kyi ming zung shig ces bya ba ni/ dge ba dang mi dge bar ①byed pa/bde ba dang mi bde bar byed pa/ lo legs pa dang lo nyes par byed pa/ tshe ring ba dang tshe thung bar byed pa/ spro ring ba dang spro thung bar byed pa/ phyug pa dang ltogs par byed pa/ na ba dang mi na bar byed pa/ bzhin sdug pa dang mi sdug par byed pa/ gzugs bzang ba dang ngan par byed pa/ de rnams ni nam mkha' la rgyu zhing / 'jig rten gyi khams tsam la ②gnas pa'i lha mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad do/ /'di lta ste zhes bya ba ni/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad blta ba'o—/ /rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa ④brgyad kyi lus kyi tshad bstan pa/ che ba la ni rgyang grags bco brgyad chung ba la rgyang grags gsum mo/ /phal cher ni rgyang grags ④bcu gnyis so/ /smin drug dang ⑤zhes bya ba ni/ de las duskyes pa'i mtshan ma ni 'di lags so/ /de yi gdong gi sor bzhi na/ /g.yas phyogs na ni sme ba yod pa/ /spu can nag la ⑦mdog kyang dmar/ /longs spyod che zhing grags ⑧dang ldan/ /mkhas shing rab tu dpal 'bar te/ /smin drug la ni skyes pa'i mtshan ma de yin no/ /snar ma dang zhes bya ba ni/ /gang zhig brla yi sor bzhi na—/ /smre ba 'di nyid gda' ba ste/ /snar ma las ⑨ni skyes pa ste/ /shes shing rtag tu chos la dga'/ /mkhas la longs spyod phun sum tshogs/ /rnam pa kun du mdzes dang ldan/ /dpa' zhing rgyal ba phun sum tshogs/ /dgra rnams rtag tu rab tu 'joms/ /mgo dang zhes bya ba ni/ /mgul pa yi ni mdzub 36—1455

phyed na/ /gang la tshig pa 'dra ba yod/ /de ni mgo las ①skyes pa ste/ /dpa' zhing longs spyod ldan pa ste①/ /lag dang zhes bya ba ni/ mdzub kyi phyed po gnyis pa la/ /g.yon na sme ba gang yod pa/ /lag las ④skyes pa khro ba ste/ /de ni blun zhing nab 0so dang / /zhes bya ba ni/ mchan khung g.yon na sme nag yod—/ / nab so las duni skyes pa ste/ /nor dang 'bru rnams 'byor bar 'gyur / /de ni dhishes pa rgya yang chung / /rgyal ni bkra shis phun sum tshogs/ /zhes bya ba ni/ mtshan mchog dag ni rab tu dga'/ /phyag gi mthil la 'khor lo ni/ /nyi ma lta bur rab tu mdzes/ /dbu skra dag ni thams cad kyang / /gyen du g.yas 'khyil legs par yod/ /sku ni chu zheng gab pa ste/ /'dren pas khyod kyi nyon mongs thul/ /de ni rgyal las ⑦skyes pa'o/ /de bzhin skag phyaste bdun pa yin/ /zhes bya ba ni/ tshig 'dra ⑨gang gi snying gar ⑩mchis/ /skag las ⑫skyes te 'thab la dga'/ /tshul khrims 'chal zhing 'grogs mi bde/ /de ni g.yem la dga' ba'o/ /de ltar rgyu skar bdun po ⑫dag ni shar phyogs kyi sgo na gnas pa dag ste/ skar ma bdun po de dag ni chos kyi dbang du byas na/sa'i khams su gyur pa ⑫ste/ /lha mo'i gzugs su snang ba'o/ /smin drug ni dmar mo ste/ me'i dbyug to thogs pa/ me la zhon pa/ snar ma sngo skya/lug r+ṣathogs pa nya la zhon pa'o/ /mgo ljang gu lag na ut+pa la thogs pa/ kha sha la zhon pa'o/ /lag dkar po lag na sbrul thogs pa/ sbrul la zhon pa'o/ /nab ⑫so ser mo lag na rdo rje dril bu thogs pa/ lug la zhon pa'o/ /rgyal dmar po lag na dbyug pa thogs pa⑩/ gdan bum pa la 'dug pa'o/ /skag sngon mo lag na lcags kyu thogs pa/ bya rog la zhon pa'o/ /rgyan thams cad 36—1456

kyis brgyan pa/ dbyebs legs shing blta ①na sdug pa'o/ /gang dag shar phyogs srung zhing yongs su skyong bar byed pa dag go zhes bya ba ni/ yang dag par sdogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bka' las mi 'da' zhing / rig sngags kyi byin gyi rlabs ②kyis khyab pa'o/ /de dag gis kyang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'dis bdag la bsrung sneb kyis shig ces bya ba ni/ gang zag gang gis de la gus par byed pa de la/ shar gyi skar ma bdun po dag gis kyang srung rjozhing skyob ste—/ shar phyogs kyi 'jigs pa thams cad las skyob par byed pa'o/ /sba ba la sogs pa zhes bya ba ni/ snga ma bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /mchu ni mi mdza' ⑤'joms pa dang / /zhes bya ba ni/ 'og gam brang ngam rgyab cig na/ /gang la byi dusran 'dra ba yod/ /mchu las ⑦skyes te nor dang ldan/ /btsun zhing chos dang ldan pa'i mi/ /de bzhin gre skedang zhes bya ba ni/ lte ba'i g.yas g.yon gnyis ka na/ /gang la rma 'dra yod pa de/ /de ni gre las ⑨skyes pa ste/ /ser sna che zhing tshe yang thung / /dbo ⑩gnyis dang zhes bya ba ni/ lte ba man chad sor bzhi na/ /gang la sme ⑪ba rab yod pa/ /dbo las ⑫skyes te longs spyod che/ /khrims ldan shi 'phos mtho ris 'gro/ me bzhi zhes bya ba ni/ sme ba dmar po chu so na/ /rku zhing g.yo ngan sgyu ma ste/ /bsod nams chung zhing shes pa zhan/ /me bzhi las ⑫ni skyes pa'o/ /nag pa zhes bya ba ni/ mtshan ma la ni sme ba yod/ /'da' bar gyur par ④nges pa yang / /nag pa las ⑫ni de skyes te/ /'dod chags glu gar rtag tu dga'/ /sa ri dang zhes bya ba ni/mtshan ma'i 'og gam steng na ni/ /sme ba ser po rab tu gda'/ /mi mkhas skam zhing mang po sdang ⑩/ /sa ri las ⑩ni skyes pa'o/ /sa ga la ste bdun pa 36—1457

zhes bya ba ni/ brla gnyis kyi ni mdzub gang na/ /sme ①ba dmar po de bzhin te/ /sa ga las ②skyes shar pa mchog /skyes pa bud med rnams kyis bskor/ /mkhas shing dpa' la dgra yang thul/ /rtag tu bde la gnas pa ste/ /ngo tsha shes shing brtan ④dang ldan/ /shi 'phos nas ni mtho ris skye/ /de ltar rgyu skar bdun po 'di dag ni/ /lho phyogs kyi sgo na gnas pa dag ste zhes bya ba ni/skar ma bdun po de dag ni chu'i khams su gnas pa'o/ /lha mo'i tshul du gnas pa ste/ /lho ngos dag na gnas pa'o/ /de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni—/ mchu dkar po gri gug thogs pa ④glang la zhon pa/ gre ⑤ser po pad+ma thogs pa gdan rdo/ dbo dkar mo lag na rdo rje thogs pa glang po che la zhon pa'opya //me bzhi sngon mo lag na rma bya'i sgro thogs pa rma bya la zhon pa/ nag pa ser mo lag na rin po che'i phreng ba 'dzin pa ba la zhon pa/ sa ri mdog dmar skya lag na 'phang mdung 'dzin pa thag pa'i gdan la zhugs dze+epa/ sa ga dud ka dgra sta thogs pa mi'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /gang dag lho phyogs srung zhing yongs su skyong bar byed pa dag go zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung zhing /sems can rnams kyi don byed pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' bar/lho phyogs yongs su skyong ba'o/ /de dag gis kyang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'dis bdag la bsrung ⑧ba gyis shig ces bya ba ni/ gang zag gang gis kyang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di la gus shing 'chang ba de/ srung ba dang skyob par byed do/ /lho phyogs kyi 'jigs pa thams cad las skyob pa'o/ /sba ba la sogs pa zhes bya ba ni/ snga ma bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /lha mtshams gzi brjid chen mo ⑨dang / /zhes bya ba ni/ brla gnyis kyi ni ⑩mdzub do na/ /36—1458

gang la byi sran 'dra ba yod/ /lha mtshams las ①skyes tshul khrims can/ /chos dang longs spyod ldan pa'o/ /de bzhin spyon ②dang zhes bya ba ni/ gang gi brla 'og gnyis na ni/ /sme ba yod pa spyon las ④skyes/ /mi sdug tshe thung tshul dzams 'chal/ /dbul zhing snying rje ④ma mchis so/ /snrubs dang zhes bya ba ni/pus mo gnyis kyi gong na ni/ /gang la sme chung yod pa ste/ /snrubs las ⑤skyes pa dbang thang can/ /myur du bdag khyim 'jig rjopar byed/ /chu stod dang zhes bya ba ni/ sme ba pus mo'i lha nga na/ /sbyin pa bgyid cing chos lam shes/ /shi 'phos nas ni mtho ris 'gro/ /chu stod las ⑦ni skyes pa'o/ /chu smad dang ⑧zhes bya ba ni/ /dku ⑨do la ni sme ba yod/ /de ltar 'dug pa shes dang ldan/ /longs spyod ldan zhing sems can byams/ /chu smad las ⑫ni skyes pa'o/ /de ltar byi bzhin ⑪zhes bya ba ni/ srin po laṅka ⑫mgrin bcu'i skar ma yin te/lha rnams la ⑫gnod pas sbas nas 'dir ma bshad do/ /rtsis las ma bshad/rgyu skar la bshad pa'o/ /gro bzhin no zhes bya ba ni/ gro bzhin las ④skyes longs spyod rtag /de bzhin nad med sems can byams/ /sme ba gnyis po yod pa ni//shi 'phos nas ni mtho ris 'gro/ /de ltar rgyu skar bdun po de t+pa dag ni/ nub phyogs kyi sgo na gnas pa dag ces bya ba ni/ rgyu skar bdun po de dag ni/nub phyogs na gnas pa/ lha mo'i tshul du snang ba/ me'i khams so/ /de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/ lha mtshams chen mo ⑩mdog dkar mo/lag na ngang pa dkar po 'dzin pa'o/ /ngang ⑩skya la zhon pa/ sgon dmar mo lag na tri shu ⑫la thogs pa/ rus ⑪sbal gyi gdan la yod pa/ snrubs dkar mo lag na la phug thogs pa/ gdan la phug la 'dug pa/ chu stod ljang gu 36—1459

lag na me tog gi phreng ba thogs pa'o①/ /gdan rdo rje la 'dug pa/ chu smad mthing ga /lag na pad+ma thogs pa/ gdan rdo rje las ④byas pa/ bye bzhin nag mo lag na zhags pa thogs pa/ bya khyung las ①gdan byas pa/ gro bzhin ser mo lag na rdo rje thogs pa/ seng ge la zhon pa gang dag nub phyogs srung zhing yongs su skyong bar byed pa dag go zhes bya ba ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi bstan pa bsrung rjob/ rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' bar sems can gyi don byed pa'o/ /de dag gis kyang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'dis bdag la bsrung ba dugyis shig ces bya ba ni/ gang zag gang gis kyang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di la gus par byas na/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad po 'di dag gis kyang / nub phyogs kyi 'jigs pa thams cad las srung 4 ba dang skyob par byed do/ /sba ba zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni/ sngar bshad pa bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /mon gru dang zhes bya ba ni/ smre ba nag po rje ngar la yod pa/ mon gru las ⑦skyes pa ste/ de ni khro zhing 'dod chags chung / /longs spyod ma mchis shes rab ldan/ /mon gre ⑧dang zhes bya ba ni/ /rje ngar la ni mdzub do na/ /sme ba nag po yod pa ste⑨/ /mon gre las ⑩skyes blun po ste//de ni chu yis 'chi bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin khrums stod ces bya ba ni/ rje ngar 'og gi mdzub gang na/ /rma 'dra yod pa khrums stod la/ /blun zhing gzhan la gnod pa byed/ /de na dbul zhing rkun mo byed/ /khrums smad dang zhes bya ba ni—/ gang la sme ba mdzub gang yod⑪/ /khrums smad las ⑫ni skyes pa ste/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims ldan pa ste⑫/ /shes rab 'jigs med snying rje can④/ /nam gru dang zhes bya ba ni/ /gang gi rkang pa gnyis ka la/ /sme ba phra mo yod pa 36—1460

ni—/ /nam gru las ①skyes ma rabs te/ /'dreg mkhan du yang 'gyur ba lags/ /tha skar dang zhes bya ba ni/ /gang gi mthe bong bar na yang / /sme ba sngon po yod pa ni/ /rtag tu stobs ldan nad ma mchis/ /tha skar las sdeni skyes pa'o/ /bra nye ste bdun pa yin zhes bya ba ni/ rkang mthil sme ba yod pa ni/ /bra nye las skyes snying rje med/ /gsod pa'i gshed ma'i ngang tshul can/ /shi 'phos nas ni dmyal bar 'gro/ /de ltar rgyu skar bdun po 'di dag ni/ byang phyogs kyi sgo na gnas pa dag ste/ rgyu skar bdun po de dag ni byang phyogs na gnas pa/lha mo'i tshul du snang ba/ rlung gi khams so/ /de rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/ mon gru ser mo 'bras kyi snye ma thogs pa/ gdan bye la 'dug pa/mon gre ser ①mo lag na tri shu ④la thogs pa/ gdan glang las ⑤byas pa/khrums stod ser mo/ lag na pad+ma thogs pa/ pad+ma'i gdan la 'dug pa/khrums smad sngon mo lag na at+pa la thogs pa/ gdan pad+ma la gzhugs bupa nam gru dkar mo lag na 'khor lo thogs pa/ gdan 'khor lo la bzhugs pa/ tha skar ljang gu lag na phreng ba thogs pa/ gdan rta la bzhugs pa/ bra nye dud ka lag na ral gri thogs pa/ gdan ri dwags las ⑦byas pa'o/ /gang dag byang phyogs srung zhing yongs su skyong bar byed pa dag go zhes bya ba ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi ⑧bstan pa bsrung ⑨ba/ rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' bar sems can gyi don byed pa'o/ /de dag gis ⑩kyang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'dis bdag la bsrung ⑩ba gyis shig ces bya ba ni—/ gang zag gang dang gang gis kyang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di la gus par byas na/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad po 'dis kyang srung zhing skyob par byed de/36—1461

byang phyogs kyi 'jigs pa thams cad las skyob par byed pa'o/ /sba ba dang zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni sngar bshad pa bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /rgyu skar rnams kyi gnas gang yin/ gang zla ba dang nyi ma la brten zhing / rjes su rgyu ba'i rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad brjod pa de dag go/ /de la mdzub ni sor brgyad kyi tshad do//mdzub de'i tshad kyis lus la srid du/ mdzub bcu gnyis mchis ①so/ /glad pa'i spyi bo la mdzub gang dang / rkang pa'i mthil du mdzub gang ste/ mdzub bcu bzhi ni skar ma rnams kyi gnas bshad pa'o/ /de nas dpyid zla ra ba'i tshes gcig la ni/ skar ma byi bzhin no/ /gnyis la gro bzhin/ gsum la mon gre3/bzhi la mon gru'o/ /lnga la khrums 1stod/ drug la khrums rjosmad do/ /bdun la nam gru'o/ /brgyad la tha skar ro/ /dgu la bra nye'o/ /bcu la smin drug /bcu gcig la snar ma/ bcu gnyis la mgo/ bcu gsum la lag /bcu bzhi la nab ⑤so/ bco lnga la rgyal lome/ /bcu drug la skag /bcu bdun la mchu—/ bco brgyad la gre/ bcu dgu la dbo/ nyi shu la me bzhi/ nyi shu gcig la nag pa/ nyi shu gnyis la sa ri/ nyi shu gsum la sa ga /nyi shu bzhi la lha mtshams/ nyi shu lnga la sbyon/ nyi shu drug la snrubs⑦/ nyi shu bdun la chu stod—/ nyi shu brgyad la chu smad/ nyi shu dgu la byi bzhin/ gnam stong la gro bzhin no/ /dpyid zla 'bring po'i tshes gcig la mon gru/ gnyis la mon grekhru /gsum la khrums stod/ bzhi la khrums smad/ lnga la nam gru/ drug la tha skar/bdun la bra nye/ brgyad la smin drug /dgu la snar ma/ bcu la mgo/bcu gcig la lag /bcu gnyis la nab ⑨so/ bcu gsum la rgyal/ bcu bzhi la skag /bco lnga la mchu/ bcu drug la gre/ bcu bdun la dbo/36—1462

bco brgyad la me bzhi/ bcu dgu la nag pa/ nyi shu la sa ri/ nyi shu gcig la sa ga /nyi shu gnyis la lha mtshams/ nyi shu gsum la sgon/ nyi shu bzhi la snrubs—/ nyi shu lnga la chu stod/ nyi shu drug la chu smad/ nyi shu bdun la byi bzhinaske/ nyi shu brgyad la gro ①bzhin/ nyi shu dgu la mon gru/ gnam stong la mon gre'o②/ /dpyid zla tha chungs kyi tshes gcig la khrums stod/ gnyis la khrums smad/ gsum la nam gru/ bzhi la dbyu ①gu/ lnga la bra nye/ drug la smin drug /bdun la snar ma/ brgyad la mgo/ dgu la lag /bcu la nab dhiso/ bcu gcig la rgyal/ bcu gnyis la skag /bcu gsum la mchu/bcu bzhi la ⑤gre/ bco lnga la dbo/ bcu drug la me bzhi/ bcu bdun la nag rjopa/ bco brgyad la sa ri/ bcu dgu la sa ga /nyi shu la lha mtshams/nyi shu gcig la spyon/ nyi shu gnyis la snrubs/ nyi shu gsum la chu stod/ nyi shu bzhi la chu smad/ nyi shu lnga la gro bzhin/ nyi shu drug la byi bzhin/ nyi shu bdun la mon gru/ nyi shu brgyad la mon gre⑦/ nyi shu dgu la khrums stod/gnam stong la khrum smad do/ /dbyar zla ra ba'i tshes gcig la nam gru/ tshes gnyis la dbyu ⑧gu/ tshes gsum la bra nye'o/ /bzhi la smin drug /lnga la snar ma—/ tshes drug la mgo/ tshes bdun la lag /tshes brgyad la nab ⑨so/tshes dgu la rgyal/ tshes bcu la skag /tshes bcu gcig la mchu/ tshes bcu gnyis la gre/ tshes bcu gsum la dbo/ bcu bzhi la me bzhi/ bco lnga la nag pa/ bcu drug la sa ri/ bcu bdun la sa ga /bco brgyad la lha mtshams—/ bcu dgu la sgron/ nyi shu la snrubs/ nyi shu gcig la chu stod/nyi shu gnyis la chu smad/ nyi shu gsum la byi bzhin/ nyi shu bzhi la gro bzhin/36—1463

nyi shu lnga la mon gru/ nyi shu drug la mon gre①/ nyi shu bdun la khrums stod/nyi shu brgyad la khrums ④smad/ nyi shu dgu la nam gru/ gnam stong la dbyu skegu/dbyar zla 'bring po'i tshes gcig la bra nye/ gnyis la smin drug /gsum la bi rdzi/ bzhi la mgo/ lnga la lag /drug la nab rjoso/ bdun la rgyal/brgyad la ⑤skag /dgu la mchu/ bcu la gre/ bcu gcig la dbo/ bcu gnyis la me bzhi/ bcu gsum la nag pa/ bcu bzhi la sa ri/ bco lnga la sa ga /bcu drug la lha mtshams/ bcu bdun la spyon/ bco brgyad la snrubs/bcu dgu la chu stod/ tshes nyi shu la chu smad/ nyi shu gcig la byi bzhin/ nyi shu gnyis la gro bzhin/ nyi shu gsum la mon gru/ nyi shu bzhi la mon grerjo/ nyi shu lnga la khrums stod/ nyi shu drug la khrums smad/ nyi shu bdun la nam gru/nyi shu brgyad la tha skar/ nyi shu dgu la bra nye/ gnam stong la smin drug go/ /dbyar zla tha chungs kyi tshes gcig la snar ma/ tshes gnyis la mgo/ tshes gsum la lag /tshes bzhi la nab ④so/ tshes lnga la rgyal/ tshes drug la skag/tshes bdun la mchu/ tshes brgyad la gre/ tshes dgu la dbo/ tshes bcu la me bzhi/ tshes bcu gcig la nag pa/ tshes bcu gnyis la sa ri tshes bcu gsum la sa ga /tshes bcu bzhi la lha mtshams/ tshes bco lnga la sbyon/ tshes bcu drug la snubs④/ tshes bcu bdun la chu stod/ tshes bco brgyad la chu smad/tshes bcu dgu la byi bzhin/ tshes ⑨nyi shu la gro bzhin/ nyi shu gcig la mon gru/nyi shu gnyis la mon gre⑩/ nyi shu gsum la khrums stod/ nyi shu bzhi la khrums smad—/ nyi shu lnga la nam gru/ nyi shu drug la dbyu ⑪gu/ nyi shu bdun la bra nye/nyi shu brgyad la smin drug /nyi shu dgu la snar ma/ gnam stong la mgo'o/ /36—1464

ston zla ra ba'i tshes gcig la lag /gnyis la nab ①so/ gsum la rgyal/bzhi la skag /lnga la mchu/ drug la gre/ bdun la dbo/ brgyad la me bzhi/ dgu la nag pa/ bcu la sa ri/ bcu gcig la sa ga /bcu gnyis la lha mtshams/ bcu gsum la spyon/ bcu bzhi la snrubs/ bco lnga la chu stod/ bcu drug la chu smad/ bcu bdun la byi bzhin/ bco brgyad la gro bzhin/ bcu dgu la mon gru/ nyi shu la mon gre/ nyi shu gcig la khrums stod—/ nyi shu gnyis la khrums smad/ nyi shu gsum la nam gru/ nyi shu bzhi la dbyu ②gu/ nyi shu lnga la bra nye/ nyi shu drug la smin drug /nyi shu bdun la snar ma—/ nyi shu brgyad la mgo/ nyi shu dgu la lag /gnam stong la nab ④so/ston zla 'bring po'i tshes gcig la rgyal/ gnyis la skag /gsum la mchu/bzhi la gre/ lnga la dbo/ drug la me bzhi/ bdun la nag pa/ brgyad la sa ri/ dgu la sa ga /bcu la lha mtshams/ bcu gcig la spyon/ bcu gnyis la snrubs/ bcu gsum la chu stod/ bcu bzhi la ④chu smad/ bco lnga la byi bzhin/ bcu drug la gro bzhin/ bcu bdun la mon gru/ bco brgyad la mon gre⑤/ bcu dgu la khrums stod/ nyi shu la khrums smad/ nyi shu gcig la nam gru/ nyi shu gnyis la tha skar/ nyi shu gsum la bra nye/ nyi shu bzhi la smin drug /nyi shu lnga la snar ma/ nyi shu drug la mgo/ nyi shu bdun la lag /nyi shu brgyad la nab meso/ nyi shu dgu la rgyal/ gnam stong la skag go/ /ston zla tha chungs kyi ④tshes gcig la mchu/ gnyis la gre/ gsum la dbo/ bzhi la me bzhi/ lnga la nag pa/ drug la sa ri/ bdun la sa ga /brgyad la lha mtshams—/ dgu la spyon/ bcu la snrubs/ bcu gcig la chu stod/ bcu 36—1465

gnyis la chu smad/ bcu gsum la byi bzhin/ bcu bzhi la gro bzhin/ bco lnga la mon gru/ bcu drug la mon gre/ bcu bdun la khrums stod①/ bco brgyad la khrums smad/ bcu dgu la nam gru/ nyi shu la tha skar/ nyi shu gcig la bra nye—/ nyi shu gnyis la smin drug /nyi shu gsum la snar ma/ nyi shu bzhi la mgo—/ nyi shu lnga la lag /nyi shu drug la nab ④so/ nyi shu bdun la rgyal/nyi shu brgyad la skag /nyi shu dgu la mchu/ gnam stong la gre/ dgun zla ra ba'i tshes gcig la sa ri/ gnyis la sa ga /gsum la lha mtshams/ bzhi la sgron—/ lnga la snrubs/ drug la chu stod/ bdun la chu smad/ brgyad la byi bzhin—/ dgu la gro ④bzhin/ bcu la mon gru/ bcu gcig la mon gre④ /bcu gnyis la khrums stod/ bcu gsum la khrums smad/ bcu bzhi la nam gru/bco lnga la tha skar/ bcu drug la bra nye/ bcu bdun la smin drug /bco brgyad la snar ma/ bcu dgu la mgo/ nyi shu la lag /nyi shu gcig la nab phye so—/ nyi shu gnyis la rgyal/ nyi shu gsum la skag /nyi shu bzhi la mchu/ nyi shu lnga la gre/ nyi shu drug la dbo/ nyi shu bdun la me bzhi/ nyi shu brgyad la nag pa/ nyi shu dgu la sa ri/ gnam stong la sa ga'o/ /dgun zla 'bring po'i tshes gcig la lha mtshams/ gnyis la sgon/ gsum la snrubs/ bzhi la chu stod/ lnga la chu smad/ drug la byi bzhin/ bdun la gro rjobazhin/ brgyad la mon gru/ dgu la mon gre⑦ / bcu la khrums stod/ bcu gcig la khrums smadaske/ bcu gnyis la nam gru/ bcu gsum la dbyu ⑧gu/ bcu bzhi la bra nye/bco lnga la smin drug /bcu drug la snar ma/ bcu bdun la mgo/ bco brgyad la lag /bcu dgu la nab ⑨so/ nyi shu la rgyal/ nyi shu gcig la skag/36—1466

nyi shu gnyis la mchu/ nyi shu gsum la gre/ nyi shu bzhi la dbo/ nyi shu lnga la me bzhi—/ nyi shu drug la nag pa/ nyi shu bdun la sa ri/ nyi shu brgyad la sa ga/nyi shu dgu la lha mtshams/ gnam stong la sgon/ dgun zla tha chungs kyi tshes gcig la snrubs/ tshes gnyis la chu stod/ tshes gsum la chu smad/ tshes bzhi la byi bzhin/ lnga la gro ①bzhin/ drug la mon gru/ bdun la mon gre⑤/brgyad la khrums stod/ dgu la khrums smad/ bcu la nam gru/ bcu gcig la dbyu ①gu/ bcu gnyis la bra nye/ bcu gsum la smin drug /bcu bzhi la snar ma/ bco lnga la mgo/ bcu drug la lag /bcu bdun la nab ④so/bco brgyad la rgyal/ bcu dgu la skag /nyi shu la mchu/ nyi shu gcig la gre/nyi shu gnyis la dbo/ nyi shu gsum la me bzhi/ nyi shu bzhi la nag pa/ nyi shu lnga la sa ri/ nyi shu drug la sa ga /nyi shu bdun la lha mtshams/ nyi shu brgyad la spyon/ nyi shu dgu la snrubs/ gnam stong la chu stodarjo/ nyin mtshan re re la chu tshod drug cu drug cu yod do/ /dpyid zla ra ba la nyin mo duchu tshod nyi shu rtsa bzhi—/ mtshan mo sum cu rtsa drug go④/ /dpyid zla 'bring po la nyin mo nyi shu rtsa drug /mtshan mo sum cu rtsa bzhi'o/ /dpyid zla tha chungs la nyin mo chu tshod nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ nub mo sum cu rtsa gnyis so/ /dbyar zla ra ba la nyin mtshan gnyis la chu tshod sum cu sum cu mnyam mo/ /dbyar zla 'bring po la nyin mo chu tshod sum cu rtsa gnyis/ nub mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad do/ /dbyar zla tha chungs la nyin mo chu tshod sum cu rtsa bzhi/ nub mo nyi shu rtsa drug go⑧/ /ston zla ra ba la nyin mo chu tshod sum cu rtsa drug /nub mo nyi shu rtsa bzhi'o/ /ston zla 'bring po la nyin mo chu tshod sum cu rtsa bzhi'o/ /nub mo la chu tshod nyi shu rtsa drug go/ /ston 36—1467

zla tha chungs la nyin mo chu tshod sum cu ①rtsa gnyis/ nub mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad do/ /dgun zla ra ba la nyin mtshan gnyis ka la chu tshod sum cu sum cu'o/ /dgun zla 'bring po la nyin mo chu tshod nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ mtshan mo sum cu rtsa gnyis1/dgun zla tha chungs 3la nyin mo nyi shu rtsa drug /nub mo chu tshod sum cu rtsa bzhi'o de bzhin du dus tshod bcu gnyis so/ /de yang dpyid zla ra ba la ④rgyal mtshan no//dpyid zla 'bring po la seng ge'o/ /dpyid zla tha chungs la khyi'o/ /dbyar zla ra ba la glang / dbyar zla 'bring po la rus rjosbal/ dbyar zla tha chungs la bong blubu'o—/ /ston zla ra ba la ④chu srin/ ston zla ⑧'bring po la dung / ston zla tha chungs la rnga mo'o/ /dgun zla ra ba la gzhu/ dgun zla 'bring po la mda'/dgun zla tha chungs la glang po che'o/ /dpyid zla ra ba la tshes gcig nas gnam stong man chad kyedu/ nyi ma re re la chu tshod nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ dus tshod bcu gnyis la/ nyi ma shar nas bcu gnyis cha gcig la rgyal mtshan gyi dus so/ /cha gnyis la ⑩seng ge'i dus so/ /cha gsum la khyi'i dus so⑪/ /cha bzhi pa glang gi dus/ cha lnga pa rus ⑫sbal gyi dus/ cha drug pa bong ⑫bu'i dus/ cha bdun pa chu srin gyi dus/ cha brgyad pa la ⑩dung gi dus/ cha dgu pa rnga mo'i dus—/ cha bcu pa gzhu'i dus/ cha bcu gcig pa mda'i dus/ cha bcu gnyis pa glang po che'o/ /la la lug zer ro/ /nyi ma gcig la chu tshod nyi shu rtsa bzhi yod pa la/ dus tshod re re la ⑫chu tshod gnyis gnyis kun la shes par bya'o/ /dpyid zla ra ba'i tshes gcig yan chod nas gnam stong man chad ⑩kyi nub re re la/dus tshod bcu gnyis bcu gnyis yod la⑩/ rgyal mtshan dang glang po che'i bar du dus tshod kyi rgyu lugs ni snga ma bzhin no/ /dus ⑫re re la chu tshod gsum 36—1468

gsum du shes par bya'o/ /dpyid zla 'bring po'i tshes gcig nas gnam stong man chad du/ nyi ma re re la dus tshod bcu gnyis bcu gnyis yod pa la/ nyi ma gcig gi bcu gnyis cha gcig la seng ge rgyu ba'i dus/ cha gnyis la ①khyi'i dus—/ cha gsum pa glang gi dus/ cha bzhi pa rus sbal gyi ⑤dus/ cha lnga pa la bong ①bu'i dus/ cha drug pa la buchu srin gyi ⑤dus/ cha bdun pa la ⑥dung gi dus/ cha brgyad pa la ⑦rnga mo'i dus/ cha dgu pa gzhu'i dus/ cha bcu pa mda'i dus/ cha bcu gcig pa glang po che'i dus/ cha bcu gnyis pa skergyal mtshan gyi dus so/ /de la chu tshod nyi shu rtsa drug yod pa la/ dus tshod re re la chu tshod gnyis gnyis dang / skad cig ma brgya lnga bcu'o/ /seng ge la sogs pa'i dus tshod bcu gnyis ni/ nyin mo dang 'dra/ dus tshod stibacu gnyis po de la/ chu tshod sum cu rtsa bzhi yod pa la/ dus tshod re re la chu tshod gsum du skad cig ma ⑩brgya lnga bcur ma tshang bar dus bcu gnyis po kun la shes par bya'o/ /dpyid zla tha chungs kyi tshes gcig nas gnam stong gi bar du/ nyi ma re re la dus tshod bcu gnyis bcu gnyis yod de/ nyi ma shar nas cha gcig la khyi'i dus/ cha gnyis la glang / cha gsum la rus sbal/ cha bzhi la bong ⑪bu'i dus/ cha lnga la chu srin gyi dus/ cha drug la dung gi dus/ cha bdun la rnga mo'i dus/ cha brgyad la gzhu'i dus/ cha dgu la mda'i dus⑫/ cha bcu pa la glang po che'i dus/ cha bcu gcig pa la rgyal mtshan kyi dus/ cha bcu gnyis pa la seng ge'i dus so/ /nyi ma re re la chu tshod nyi shu rtsa brgyad yod pa la/dus tshod re re la chu tshod gnyis gnyis yod pa la/ skad cig ma sum brgya sum brgya yod do/ /dpyid zla tha chungs kyi nub mo re re la khyi la sogs pa seng ge'i 36—1469

bar du/ dus tshod kyi grangs snga ma bzhin no/ /chu tshod sum cu rtsa gnyis yod pa la①/ dus tshod re re la chu tshod gsum gsum du skad byug ma sum brgya sum brgya ma ldang ngo ⑤/ /dbyar zla ra ba'i tshes gcig nas gnam stong gi bar du nyi ma re re la/ dus tshod bcu gnyis bcu gnyis yod de/ nyi ma shar nas cha gcig la glang gi dus/ cha gnyis la rus sbal gyi dus/① cha gsum la bong thubu'i dus/ cha bzhi pa chu srin gyi dus/ cha lnga pa dung gi dus/ cha drug pa rnga mo'i dus/ cha bdun pa ⑤gzhu'i dus/ cha brgyad pa rjomada'i dus/ cha dgu pa ④glang po che'i dus/ cha bcu pa rgyal mtshan gyi dus/ cha bcu gcig pa la seng ge'i dus/ cha bcu gnyis pa la khyi'i dus so/ /dus tshod bcu gnyis la/chu tshod sum cu yod do/ /de la dus tshod re re la chu tshod phyed dang gsum gsum yod do/ /nub mo la yang glang nas khyi'i bar ⑧dus tshod bcu gnyis nyin mo bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /chu tshod kyang phyed dang gsum gsum du shes par bya'o//dbyar zla 'bring po'i tshes gcig nas gnam stong gi bar du/ nyi ma re re la dus tshod bcu gnyis bcu gnyis yod de/ nyi ma shar nas cha gcig la rus sbal kyi dus—/ cha gnyis la bong ⑨bu'i dus/ cha gsum la chu srin gyi dus/ cha bzhi pa dung gi dus/ cha lnga pa rnga mo'i dus/ cha drug pa gzhu'i dus/ cha bdun pa mda'i dus/ cha brgyad pa glang po che'i dus/ cha dgu pa rgyal mtshan gyi dus/cha bcu pa seng ge'i dus/ cha bcu gcig pa khyi'i dus/ cha bcu ⑩gnyis pa glang gi dus so/ /dus bcu gnyis kyi nyi ma re re la chu tshod sum cu rtsa gnyis yod pa la/ dus tshod re re la chu tshod phyed dang gsum gsum dang / skad cig ma brgya lnga bcu lnga bcu yod do/ /dbyar zla 'bring po'i tshes gcig nas gnam stong 36—1470

gi bar du nub re re la dus tshod bcu gnyis bcu gnyis yod do/ /nyi ma nub nas cha dang po rus sbal gyi dus nas/ glang gi bar du bcu gnyis po'i nyin mo'i dus tshod bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /de'i dus tshod re re la chu tshod gnyis gnyis dang / skad cig ma sum brgya sum brgya yod do①/ /dbyar zla tha chungs kyi tshes gcig nas gnam stong gi bar du/ nyi ma re re la dus tshod bcu gnyis bcu gnyis yod pa la/ nyi ma shar nas cha gcig gi bar du bong ②bu'i dus/ cha gnyis pa chu srin kyi dus/ cha gsum pa dung gi dus/ cha bzhi pa rnga mo'i dus/cha lnga pa gzhu'i dus/ cha drug pa mda'i dus/ cha bdun pa glang po che'i dus/cha brgyad pa rgyal mtshan gyi dus/ cha dgu pa seng ge'i dus/ cha bcu pa khyi'i dus—/ cha bcu gcig pa glang gi dus/ cha bcu gnyis pa rus sbal gyi dus④/nyi ma re re la chu tshod sum cu rtsa bzhi rtsa bzhi yod pa la/ dus tshod re re la chu tshod gsum gsum du skad cig ma sum brgya sum brgya rjom ldang ngo / /dbyar zla tha chungs kyi tshes gcig nas gnam stong gi bar du/ nyi ma nub nas bong bu nas rus rjosbal yan chad kyi dus bcu gnyis nyin mo'i rjobazhin shes par bya'o/ /nub re re la chu tshod nyi shu rtsa drug yod pa la/ dus tshod re re ⑦chu tshod gnyis gnyis dang / skad cig ma brgya lnga bcu brgya lnga bcu yod do/ /ston zla ra ba'i tshes gcig nas gnam stong gi bar du/ nyi ma re re la dus tshod bcu gnyis bcu gnyis yod pa/ nyi ma shar nas cha gcig pa chu srin gyi dus/ cha gnyis pa dung gi dus/ cha gsum pa rnga mo'i dus/ cha bzhi pa gzhu'i dus/ cha lnga pa mda'i dus/ cha drug pa glang po'i dus/ cha bdun pa rgyal mtshan gyi dus/cha brgyad pa seng ge'i dus/ cha dgu pa khyi'i dus/ cha bcu pa glang gi dus/36—1471

cha bcu gcig pa rus sbal gyi dus/ cha bcu gnyis pa bong ①bu'i dus so/ /nyi ma re re la chu tshod bcu gnyis bcu gnyis yod pa la/ dus tshod re re la chu tshod gsum gsum yod do/ /nub mo la yang nyi ma nub nas chu srin nas bong bu'i bar du dus tshod bcu gnyis nyin mo bzhin shes par bya'o/ /nub mo chu tshod nyi shu rtsa bzhi yod pa lal/ dus tshod re re la yang chu tshod bcu gnyis bcu gnyis su shes par bya'o/ /ston zla 'bring po'i tshes gcig nas gnam stong gi bar du/nyi ma re re la dus tshod bcu gnyis bcu gnyis yod pa la/ nyi ma shar nas cha gcig la dung gi dus/ cha gnyis la rnga mo'i dus/ cha gsum pa gzhu'i dus/cha bzhi pa mda'i dus/ cha lnga pa glang po che'i dus/ cha drug pa rgyal mtshan gyi dus—/ cha bdun pa seng ge'i dus/ cha brgyad pa khyi'i dus/ cha dgu pa glang gi dus/ cha bcu pa rus zusbal gyi dus/ cha bcu gcig pa bong ④bu'i dus/cha bcu gnyis pa chu srin gyi dus so/ /nyi ma re re la yang dus tshod bcu gnyis bcu gnyis yod de/ dus tshod re re la yang chu tshod gsum gsum du skad cig ma sum brgya sum brgya ma ldang ba'o/ /nub re re la yang dus tshod bcu gnyis yod pa la/ nyi ma nub nas dung nas chu srin gyi bar du/ dus tshod bcu gnyis nyin mo bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /nub re re la ⑤chu tshod nyi shu rtsa drug rtsa drug yod pa khyel/ dus tshod re re la yang chu tshod byed dang gsum gsum yod pa/ston zla tha chungs kyi tshes gcig nas gnam stong gi bar du/ nyi ma re re la dus tshod bcu gnyis bcu gnyis yod pa la/ nyi ma shar nas bcu gnyis kyi cha dang po rnga mo'i dus/ cha gnyis pa gzhu'i dus/ cha gsum pa mda'i dus/ cha bzhi pa glang po che'i dus/ cha lnga pa rgyal mtshan gyi dus/ cha drug pa seng ge'i dus/36—1472

cha bdun pa khyi'i dus/ cha brgyad pa glang gi dus/ cha dgu pa rus sbal gyi dus/cha bcu pa bong bu'i dus/ cha bcu gcig pa chu srin gyi dus/ cha bcu gnyis pa dung gi dus so/ /nyi ma re re la chu tshod sum cu rtsa gnyis rtsa gnyis yod pa la/dus tshod re re la chu tshod phyed dang gsum gsum dang / skad cig ma brgya lnga bcu lnga bcu yod do/ /nyi ma nub nas rnga mo nas dung gi ①bar du/ dus tshod nyin mo bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /chu ②tshod nyi shu rtsa brgyad yod pa la/ dus tshod re re la chu tshod gnyis dang / skad cig ma sum brgya sum brgya yod do/ /dgun zla ra ba'i tshes gcig nas gnam stong gi bar du/ nyi ma re re la dus tshod bcu gnyis yod pa la/ nyi ma shar nas bcu gnyis kyi cha gcig gzhu'i dus/cha gnyis pa mda'i dus/ cha gsum pa glang po che'i dus/ cha bzhi pa rgyal mtshan gyi dus/ cha lnga pa seng ge'i dus/ cha drug pa ④khyi'i dus/ cha bdun pa glang gi dus/ cha brgyad pa rus sbal gyi dus/ cha dgu pa bong ④bu'i dus/cha bcu pa chu srin gyi dus/ cha bcu gcig pa dung gi dus/ cha bcu gnyis pa rnga mo'i dus so/ /nyi ma re re la dus tshod bcu gnyis bcu gnyis yod pa la/dus tshod re re la chu tshod phyed dang gsum gsum yod do/ /dgun zla ra ba'i tshes gcig nas gnam stong gi bar du/ nub ④re la dus tshod bcu gnyis yod pa la/ nyi ma nub nas cha gcig pa gzhu nas rnga mo'i bar du/ dus tshod ni nyin mo bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /nub re re la chu tshod sum cu sum cu yod pa la/dus tshod re re la chu tshod phyed dang gsum gsum yod do/ /dgun zla 'bring po'i tshes gcig nas gnam stong gi bar du/ nyin mo dhire la chu tshod bcu gnyis bcu gnyis yod pa la/ nyi ma shar nas bcu gnyis kyi cha dang po mda'i ⑦dus/ cha 36—1473

gnyis pa glang po che'i dus/ cha gsum pa rgyal mtshan gyi dus/ cha bzhi pa seng ge'i dus/ cha lnga pa khyi'i dus/ cha drug pa glang gi dus/ cha bdun pa rus sbal gyi dus/ cha brgyad pa bong ①bu'i dus/ dgu pa chu srin gyi dus/ bcu pa dung gi dus/ bcu gcig pa rnga mo'i dus/ cha bcu gnyis pa gzhu'i dus so/ /nyi ma re re la dus tshod bcu gnyis bcu gnyis yod pa la/ dus tshod re re la yang chu tshod phyed dang gsum gsum du/ skad cig ma brgya lnga bcu lnga bcu ma ldang ba yod do/ /dgun zla 'bring po'i tshes gcig nas gnam stong gi bar du/ nyi ma nub nas mda' nas gzhu'i bar du/ dus tshod bcu gnyis ni nyin mo bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /dus tshod re re la chu tshod phyed dang gsum gsum dang /skad cig ma brgya lnga bcu lnga bcu yod do/ /dgun zla tha chungs kyi tshes gcig nas gnam stong gi bar du/ nyi ma re re la dus tshod bcu gnyis bcu gnyis yod pa la/ nyi ma shar nas bcu gnyis cha dang po la glang po che'i dus/ cha gnyis pa rgyal mtshan gyi dus/ cha gsum pa seng ge'i dus/ cha bzhi pa la khyi'i dus/cha lnga pa glang gi dus/ cha drug pa ②rus sbal gyi dus/ cha bdun pa bong bu'i dus—/ cha brgyad pa chu srin gyi dus/ cha dgu pa dung gi dus/ cha bcu pa rnga mo'i dus/ cha bcu gcig pa gzhu'i dus/ cha bcu gnyis pa mda'i dus so/ /nyi ma re re la dus tshod ༄1bcu gnyis bcu gnyis yod pa la/ dus tshod re re la chu tshod gnyis gnyis dang skad cig ma brgya lnga bcu lnga bcu yod do/ /dgun zla tha chungs kyi tshes gcig nas gnam stong gi bar du/ nyi ma nub nas dus ④tshod bcu gnyis yod pa la/ glang po che nas mda'i bar du/ chu tshod sum cu rtsa bzhi yod pa la/ dus tshod re re la yang chu tshod phyed dang gsum gsum dang /36—1474

skad cig ma sum brgya sum brgya yod do/ /de bzhin du lo dang zla ba dang /dus tshod kun la shes par bya'o/ /rgyal mtshan ni 'jig rten gyi khams su ni ①grags pa'o/ /seng ge ni gcan gzan thams cad la mi 'jigs ②pa'o/ /khye ni snying nye ba'o/ /glang ni blun pa'o/ /rus ④sbal ni theg pa che ba'o/ /bong bu ni 'jig rten gyi khams su ngan par grags pa'o/ /chu srin ni nye bar grub pa'o/ /dung ni brtan pa ste mi 'gyur ba'o/ /rnga mo ni las la ngan pa'o—/ /gzhu ni 'khrul la bzang ba'o/ /mda' ni 'bigs pa'o/ /glang po che ni 'dod chags la dga' ba'o/ /de bzhin du sa dhiri bcu gnyis brtsi bar bya'o// //kun dga' bo zhes bya ba ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'o/ /khyod kyi 0gza' gang dag rgyu skar rnams kyi khrod nas rjorgyu zhing zhes bya ba ni/ byang shar mtshams na bra nye dang smin drug gnas te/ shar drang po ni snar ma dang mgo dang lag dang nab ④so dang rgyal gnas so/ /shar lho mtshams na skag dang mchu gnas so/ /lho phyogs na bre dang me bzhi dang dbo dang nag pa dang ne+es ri gnas so⑨/ /lho nub mtshams na sa ga dang lha mtshams gnas so/ /nub phyogs na spyon dang snrubs dang chu stod dang ⑩chu smad dang ⑩byi bzhin gnas so⑩/ /nub byang mtshams na gro bzhin dang mon gru gnas so/ /byang phyogs na mon gre ⑫dang khrums stod dang khrums smad dang ④nam gru dang tha skar gnas so/ /de bzhin du gza' bdun po yang gnas so/ /dpyid zla ra ba'i tshes gcig la nyi ma'o/ /tshes gnyis la zla ba/ tshes gsum la mig dmar/tshes bzhi la pa ba sangs/ tshes lnga la phur bu/ tshes drug la spen pa/ tshes 36—1475

bdun la gza' lag go/ /tshes brgyad la nyi ma/ tshes dgu la zla ba/ tshes bcu la mig dmar/ tshes bcu gcig la pa ba sangs/ tshes bcu gnyis la phur bu'o/ /tshes bcu gsum la spen pa/ tshes bcu bzhi la gza' lag go/ /bco lnga la nyi ma/ bcu drug la zla ba/ bcu bdun la mig dmar/ tshes bco brgyad la pa ba sangs/ tshes bcu dgu la phur bu/ tshes ①nyi shu la spen pa/nyi shu gcig la lag pa/ nyi shu gnyis la nyi ma/ nyi shu gsum la zla ba/ nyi shu bzhi la mig dmar/ nyi shu lnga la pa ba sangs/ nyi shu drug la phur bu/ nyi shu bdun la spen pa/ nyi shu brgyad la lag pa/ nyi shu dgu la nyi ma/ gnam stong la zla ba'o/ /dpyid zla 'bring po'i tshes gcig la mig dmar/ gnyis pa 'u la pa ba sangs/ gsum pa 1la phur bu/ bzhi pa rjol spen pa/ lnga pa rjol lag pa/ drug la nyi ma/ bdun la zla ba/ brgyad la mig dmar/ dgu la pa ba sangs/ bcu la phur bu/ bcu gcig la spen pa/ bcu gnyis la lag pa / bcu gsum la nyi ma/ bcu bzhi la zla ba/ bco lnga la mig dmar/bcu drug la pa ba sangs/ bcu bdun la phur bu/ bco brgyad la spen pa/bcu dgu la lag pa/ nyi shu la nyi ma/ nyi shu gcig la zla ba/ nyi shu gnyis la mig dmar/ nyi shu gsum la pa ba sangs/ nyi shu bzhi la phur bu/ nyi shu lnga la spen pa/ nyi shu drug la lag pa/ nyi shu bdun la nyi ma/ nyi shu brgyad la zla ba—/ nyi shu dgu la mig dmar/ gnam stong la pa ba sangs so/ /dpyid zla tha chungs kyi tshes gcig la phur bu/ gnyis la spen pa/ gsum la lag pa/bzhi la nyi ma/ lnga la zla ba/ drug la mig dmar/ bdun la pa ba sangs/brgyad la phur bu/ dgu la spen pa/ bcu la lag pa rjo/ bcu gcig la nyi ma/36—1476

bcu gnyis la zla ba/ bcu gsum la mig dmar/ bcu bzhi la pa ba sangs/bco lnga la phur bu/ bcu drug la spen pa/ bcu bdun la lag pa①/ bco brgyad la nyi ma/ bcu dgu la zla ba/ nyi shu la mig dmar/ nyi shu gcig la pa ba sangs/ nyi shu gnyis la phur bu/ nyi shu gsum la spen pa/ nyi shu bzhi la lag pa/ nyi shu lnga la nyi ma/ nyi shu drug la zla ba/ nyi shu bdun la mig dmar—/ nyi shu brgyad la pa ba sangs/ nyi shu dgu la phur bu/ gnam stong la spen pa'o/ /dbyar zla ra ba'i tshes gcig la lag pa/ gnyis la nyi ma/gsum la zla ba/ bzhi la mig dmar/ lnga la pa ba sangs/ drug la phur bu/bdun la spen pa/ brgyad la lag pa⑤/ dgu la nyi ma/ bcu la zla ba/bcu gcig la mig dmar/ bcu gnyis la pa ba sangs/ bcu gsum la phur bu—/ bcu bzhi la spen pa/ bco lnga la lag pa/ bcu drug la nyi ma/ bcu bdun la zla ba/ bco brgyad la mig dmar/ bcu dgu la pa ba sangs nyi shu la phur bu/ nyi shu gcig la spen pa/ nyi shu gnyis la lag pa/ nyi shu gsum la nyi ma/ nyi shu bzhi la zla ba/ nyi shu lnga la mig dmar/ nyi shu drug la pa ba sangs/ nyi shu bdun la phur bu/ nyi shu brgyad la spen pa/ nyi shu dgu la lag pa/ gnam stong la nyi ma'o/ /dbyar zla 'bring po'i tshes gcig la zla ba/gnyis la mig dmar/ gsum la pa ba sangs/ bzhi la phur bu/ lnga la spen paske/ drug la lag pa/ bdun la nyi ma/ brgyad la zla ba/ dgu la mig dmar—/ bcu la pa ba sangs/ bcu gcig la phur bu/ bcu gnyis la spen pa—/ bcu gsum la lag pa/ bcu bzhi la nyi ma/ bco lnga la zla ba/ bcu drug la mig dmar/ bcu bdun la pa ba sangs/ bco brgyad la phur bu/36—1477

bcu dgu la spen pa/ nyi shu la lag pa/ nyi shu gcig la nyi ma/ nyi shu gnyis la zla ba/ nyi shu gsum la mig dmar/ nyi shu bzhi la pa ba sangs/ nyi shu lnga la phur bu/ nyi shu drug la spen pa/ nyi shu bdun la lag pa①/ nyi shu brgyad la nyi ma/ nyi shu dgu la zla ba/ gnam stong la mig dmar ro/ /dbyar zla tha chungs kyi tshes gcig la pa ba sangs/ gnyis la phur bu/ gsum la spen pa/bzhi la lag pa/ lnga la nyi ma/ drug la zla ba/ bdun la mig dmar/brgyad la pa ba sangs/ dgu la phur bu/ bcu la spen pa/ bcu gcig la lag pa/ bcu gnyis la nyi ma/ bcu gsum la zla ba/ bcu bzhi la mig dmar—/ bco lnga la pa ba sangs/ bcu drug la phur bu/ bcu bdun la spen pa/ bco brgyad la lag pa/ bcu dgu la nyi ma/ nyi shu la zla ba/ nyi shu gcig la mig dmar/ nyi shu gnyis la pa ba sangs/ nyi shu gsum la phur bu/nyi shu bzhi la spen pa/ nyi shu lnga la lag pa/ nyi shu drug la nyi ma/ nyi shu bdun la zla ba/ nyi shu brgyad la mig dmar/ nyi shu dgu la pa ba sangs/gnam stong la phur bu'o②/ /ston zla ra ba'i tshes gcig la spen pa/ gnyis la lag pa/ gsum la nyi ma/ bzhi la zla ba/ lnga la mig dmar/ drug la pa ba sangs/ bdun la phur bu/ brgyad la spen pa/ dgu la lag pa/ bcu la nyi ma/ bcu gcig la zla ba/ bcu gnyis la mig dmar/ bcu gsum la pa ba sangs/ bcu bzhi la phur bu/ bco lnga la spen pa/ bcu drug la lag pa/bcu bdun la nyi ma/ bco brgyad la zla ba/ bcu dgu la mig dmar/ nyi shu la pa ba sangs/ nyi shu gcig la phur bu/ nyi shu gnyis la spen pa/ nyi shu gsum la lag pa/ nyi shu bzhi la nyi ma/ nyi shu lnga la zla ba/ nyi shu drug la 36—1478

mig dmar/ nyi shu bdun la pa ba sangs/ nyi shu brgyad la phur bu/ nyi shu dgu la spen pa/ gnam stong la lag pa'o/ /ston zla 'bring po'i tshes gcig la nyi ma/ tshes gnyis la zla ba/ gsum la mig dmar/ bzhi la pa ba sangs/lnga la phur bu/ drug la spen pa/ bdun la lag pa/ brgyad la nyi ma/ dgu la zla ba/ bcu la mig dmar/ bcu gcig la pa ba sangs/ bcu gnyis la phur bu/ bcu gsum la spen pa/ bcu bzhi la lag pa/ bco lnga la nyi ma/bcu drug la zla ba/ bcu bdun la mig dmar/ bco brgyad la pa ba sangs/bcu dgu la phur bu/ nyi shu la spen pa/ nyi shu gcig la lag pa/ nyi shu gnyis la nyi ma/ nyi shu gsum la zla ba/ nyi shu bzhi la mig dmar/ nyi shu lnga la pa ba sangs/ nyi shu drug la phur bu/ nyi shu bdun la spen pa/ nyi shu brgyad la lag pa/ nyi shu dgu la nyi ma/ gnam stong la zla ba'o/ /ston zla tha chungs kyi tshes gcig la mig dmar/ gnyis la pa ba sangs/ gsum la phur bu—/ bzhi la spen pa/ lnga la lag pa/ drug la nyi ma/ bdun la zla ba/brgyad la mig dmar/ dgu la pa ba sangs/ bcu la phur bu/ bcu gcig la spen pa/ bcu gnyis la lag pa/ bcu gsum la nyi ma/ bcu bzhi la zla ba/bco lnga la mig dmar/ bcu drug la pa ba sangs/ bcu bdun la phur bu/bco brgyad la spen pa/ bcu dgu la lag pa①/ nyi shu la nyi ma/ nyi shu gcig la zla ba/ nyi shu gnyis la mig dmar/ nyi shu gsum la pa ba sangs/ nyi shu bzhi la phur bu/ nyi shu lnga la spen pa/ nyi shu drug la lag pa/ nyi shu bdun la nyi ma/ nyi shu brgyad la zla ba/ nyi shu dgu la mig dmar/ gnam stong la pa ba sangs so/ /dgun zla ra ba'i tshes gcig la phur bu/ gnyis la spen pa/36—1479

gsum la lag pa/ bzhi la nyi ma/ lnga la zla ba/ drug la mig dmar/bdun la pa ba sangs/ brgyad la phur bu/ dgu la spen pa/ bcu la lag pa/bcu gcig la nyi ma/ bcu gnyis la zla ba/ bcu gsum la mig dmar/bcu bzhi la pa ba sangs/ bco lnga la phur bu/ bcu drug la spen pa/ bcu bdun la lag pa/ bco brgyad la nyi ma/ bcu dgu la zla ba/ nyi shu la mig dmar—/ nyi shu gcig la pa ba sangs/ nyi shu gnyis la phur bu/ nyi shu gsum la spen pa/ nyi shu bzhi la lag pa/ nyi shu lnga la nyi ma/ nyi shu drug la zla ba/ nyi shu bdun la mig dmar/ nyi shu brgyad la pa ba sangs/ nyi shu dgu la phur bu/ gnam stong la spen pa'o/ /dgun zla 'bring po'i tshes gcig la lag pa/ tshes gnyis la nyi ma/ ①gsum la zla ba/ bzhi la mig dmar/lnga la pa ba sangs/ drug la phur bu/ bdun la spen pa/ brgyad la lag pa/dgu la nyi ma/ bcu la zla ba/ bcu gcig la mig dmar/ bcu gnyis la pa ba sangs/ bcu gsum la phur bu/ bcu bzhi la spen pa/ bco lnga la lag pa/bcu drug la nyi ma/ bcu bdun la zla ba/ bco brgyad la mig dmar/ bcu dgu la pa ba sangs/ nyi shu la phur bu/ nyi shu gcig la spen pa/ nyi shu gnyis la lag pa/ nyi shu gsum la nyi ma/ nyi shu bzhi la zla ba/ nyi shu lnga la mig dmar/ nyi shu drug la pa ba sangs/ nyi shu bdun la phur bu/ nyi shu brgyad la spen pa/ nyi shu dgu la lag pa/ gnam stong la nyi ma'o/ /dgun zla tha chungs kyi tshes gcig la zla ba/ gnyis la mig dmar/ gsum la pa ba sangs—/ bzhi la phur bu/ lnga la spen pa/ drug la lag pa/ bdun la nyi ma—/ brgyad la zla ba/ dgu la mig dmar/ bcu la pa ba sangs bcu 36—1480

gcig la phur bu/ bcu gnyis la spen pa/ bcu gsum la lag pa/ bcu bzhi la nyi ma/ bco lnga la zla ba/ bcu drug la mig dmar/ bcu bdun la pa ba sangs/ bco brgyad la phur bu/ bcu dgu la spen pa/ nyi shu la lag pa/nyi shu gcig la nyi ma/ nyi shu gnyis la zla ba/ nyi shu gsum la mig dmar/nyi shu bzhi la pa ba sangs/ nyi shu lnga la phur bu/ nyi shu drug la spen pa/ nyi shu bdun la lag pa/ nyi shu brgyad la nyi ma/ nyi shu dgu la zla ba/ gnam stong la mig dmar ro/ /tshes grangs kyis zla ba mi thub ste/ zla bas skar ma mi thub—/ de bzhin du gza' rnams kyang lhag ste/ de bas na lo lnga lnga na zla ba re re bsnan ①pa'o/ /de'i khongs su brtsis na/ zla ba dang tshes grangs dang /skar ma dang / gza' tshang ba'o/ /'grib pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ gza' dang skar ma tshes grangs la rgyu ste/ de gsum gyi bye brag gis/ bzang ba dang ngan pas 'grib pa'o/ /'phel ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ de bzhin du gza' dang skar ma gsum kyis bzang ngan gyis 'phel ba'o/ /bde ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ de la yang gsum ka 'dzom pa'i dus su/ skyes par gyur na bde ba phun sum tshogs pa'o—/ /snyug bsngal ba sdedang zhes bya ba ni/ skyes pa'i tshes grangs kyi khyad par yin te/ de yang gza' dang ④skar ma'i khyad par ro/ /lo legs pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ gza' dang skar ma lo dang zla ba bzang po'i khyad par gyis so/ /lo nyes pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ de bzhin du gza' dang skar ma lo zla ba ste/ de ngan pa'i skyon gyis de bas lo nyes pa dang / tshe thung ba dang / ltogs pa dang /nad mod pa dang / 'gro mi shes pa dang / de la sogs pa byung ba'o/ /de bzhin du bzang ba la meyang shes par bya'o/ /dag kyang ston pa rnams kyi ming 36—1481

zung shig ces bya ba ni/ gza' chen po dgu dang / rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / lo bcu gnyis dang / zla ba bcu gnyis dang / dus drug dang /ra shi bcu gnyis dang / de rnams kyi khyad par gyis legs nyes ston pa'o/ /'di lta ste zhes bya ba ni/ gza' dgu po lta ba'o/ /gza' nyi ma dang zhes bya ba ni—/ me'i khams yin te/ de'i sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ sku mdog dmar po/ g.yas na sba lcag /g.yon na pad+ma dmar po thogs pa'o/ /rta la zhon pa go cha gon pa'o/ /gza' zla ba zhes bya ba ni—/ chu'i khams te/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dkar po/ go cha gon pa g.yas na pad+ma dkar po/ g.yon na ri bong gi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ngang skya la zhon pa'o/ /gza' mig dmar zhes bya ba ni/ sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas na dbyug to mig can/ g.yon mi mgo dang sdigs mdzub/ ra dmar po la zhon pa/ me'i khams so/ /gza' pa ba sangs zhes bya ba ni/ sa'i khams sku mdog ser po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa—/ g.yas na bum pa/ g.yon na rin po che'i phreng ba'o/ /pad+ma la bzhugs pa'o/ /gza' phur bu dang zhes bya ba ni/ shing gi khams so/ /sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas g.yon mda' gzhu thogs pa/glang po che la zhon pa'o/ /gza' spen pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ chu'i khams so/ /sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas na puste①/ g.yon na bum pa—/ rdo'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /gza' lag pa dang zhes bya ba ni/lcags kyi khams so/ /sku mdog ljang nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas ral gri/ g.yon sdigs ④mdzub rus sbal la zhon pa'o/ /rā hu la dang zhes bya 36—1482

ba ni/ khams lnga ka'o/ /mdog nag po/ smad sbrul du 'dug pa/ dbu skra ser po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ nyi ma dang zla ba phyag gnyis na bsnams pa—/ sprin gyi gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /gza' du ba mjug rings①/ dang zhes bya ba ni/ mdog dud ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas na ral gri bsnams pa/ g.yon na zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /khams lnga ka la gnas pa'o—/ /gza' de rnams kyi dus su rig pa slob ⑤par 'dod na bzang ngan gyi khyad par brtags la bya'o/ /chos dang slob ⑦ma 'dzin pa borjo/ /slob dpon 'dzin pa de bzhin no/ /gza' chen phur bu'i dus su ni/ /dbu 'dzugs de ni bzang ba yin/ /de bzhin rig ⑤pa gzhan la yang / /de yi dus su bzang bar bshad/ /skra mdud gos ni gsar rjopa 'am/ /zas dang gsar pa gang byed pa/ /de yi dus su bzang bar bshad/ /skra 'jar ⑦sen mo 'byeg pa dang / /de bzhin gos bzo byed pa dang / /rta dang glang po sogs pa'i nor/ /de yi dus su phyir mi gtang ⑧/ /gal te btang bar gyur na ni/ /khar ce log par 'gyur ba'o/ /nyi ma spen pa'i gza' gnyis la/ /mgo 'dzugs de ni 'bring por bshad/ /dmag dang 'khrug pa gang byed pa/ /de yi dus su 'dren pa na/ /rab tu yang dag bshad par bya/ /skra dang sen mo gos la sogs/ /de yi dus su byas na ni/ /nad dang rims la sogs pa 'byung / /shi ba'i dus la bab ⑨pa'o—/ /lam 'gro dbang bskur la sogs dang / /nyi ma'i dus su bzang bar bshad—/ /spen pa'i dus su de byas na/ /shin tu ngan par de bshad do/ /gal te de dus byas na ni/ /nad 'byung khar ce log par 'gyur/ /mig dmar dang ni lag pa la/ /rig pa gang gi mgo 'dzugs pa/ /slob ma slob 36—1483
