'dod ①na/ de dang de'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung ste/ de bzhin du bsgom pa dang bzlas pa byas par gyur na yang tshe 'di la yang bde bar 'gyur te/ tshe phyi ma la yang bde'o/ /de bas na chos 'di la mi 'chad pa 'am 'phro gcad ④par mi bya ste/ yi ge gcig kyang ma nor bar bri ba dang bklag ①par bya'o/ /kun dga' bo khyod kyis zhes bya ba ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'o/ /khyod kyis rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'di rjozung shig ces bya ba ni/ lus ngag yid kyis gus par gzung ⑤zhing gzhan rnams la rgya cher spel ba'o/ /kun dga' bos bzung ba'i rig sngags ni/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ sku mdog lngang gu las kyi rjorigs la gtogs pa spyan gsum pa/rigs ⑦lnga'i dbu rgyan can dbu la rdo rjes mtshan pa/ phyag g.yas na ral gri/g.yon na rma bya'i sgo bsnams pa'o/ /yan lag thams cad sbrul gyis brgyan pa/g.yas brkyang ba/ g.yon bskum pa/ thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa/ nyi ma'i gdan la nyi ma'i 'od dang ldan pa'o/ /'khor bzhi po zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i bstan pa bsrung ⑧ba'i rig sngags 'dis kyang srung ba dang skyob par 'gyur ro/ /tar+ya thā zhes bya ba ni 'di lta ste/ rig sngags kyi las kyi snying po blta ba'o/ /rig sngags kyi gsang sngags ni/ ya brnyi ⑨la sogs pa'o/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams—/ /'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste/ /zhes bya ba ni 'dod pa'i dbang gis zhe sdang skyes so/ /zhe sdang drag po des 'jig rten gyi khams gti mug tu mthong ngo / /de ni ma rig pa'i rang bzhin te/ ma rig pa des 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las mi thar ba'o/ /'khor ba 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ yang 36—1534

nas ①yang du 'khor bar lhung ste/ byol song yi dwags dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal lo//de gsum la yang phyi'i dug gsum bcom pa'o/ /de bas na 'jig rten gyi dug gsum bcom pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan dug med pa/ /sangs rgyas bden pas dug bcom mo/ /zhes bya ba ni/ gzhan phyi'i dug gsum ni/sangs rgyas kyi gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo/ /rig sngags 'dis kyang nges par bcom mo/ /nang gi 'jig rten dug gsum ni gzhan gyis 'joms mi nus so—/ /rang rang gi 'od gsal gyi ye shes kyis/ rang rang las byung ba'i gti mug gi rang bzhin dug gsum bcom mo/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams//de dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste/ /zhes bya ba ni/ 'jig rten las grags pa'i dug ni/ gsum yin te/ dug gsum po des sdug bsngal drag po myong bar byed pa'o/ /bcom ldan chos ni dug med pa/ /chos kyi bden pas dug bcom mo/ /zhes bya ba ni/ phyi'i dug gsum po ni/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mos kyang bcom ste/ nang gi dug gsum ni rang rang gis gzhom pa ma yin pa/ gzhan gyis gzhom mi nus pa/ de bas na nang gi dug ces bya'o/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams/ /'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste/ /zhes bya ba ni nang gi dug gsum ni/ bltas na mi snang ste/ spyad na 'bras bu 'byung zhing sdug bsngal gyi phung po/ 'dod chags kyis zhe sdang / zhe sdang gis gti mug /gti mug gis ser sna/ ser snas phrag dog go/ /de'i 'bras bu ngan song gsum du yang nas yang du 'gro ba'o/ /de bas na nang gi dug gsum spang bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan dge 'dun dug med pa/ /dge 'dun bden pas dug bcom mo/ /zhes bya ba ni/ phyi'i dug ni 'gro ba dang / mi 'gro ba/36—1535

sbyor ba dang gsum yin te/ 'gro ba ni bsam pa mthong ba ①reg pa kha rlangs so//mi 'go ba ni btsan dug bong dug ra dug la sogs pa'o/ /byed pa'i dug ni sbrang rtsi dang mar las byung ba bzhin du sbyor ba las byung ba'o/ /dug de gsum po ni/ 'jig rten na ①phyi'i dug gsum ste/ de'i dug ni dge 'dun kyi gzi brjid kyis bcom pa'o/ /nang gi dug gsum ni/ gzhan gyis 'joms mi nus shing / rang rang gi ye shes kyis 'joms pa'o/ /nang gi ye shes ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo/ bla ma'i gdams ngag gis bcom pa'o//sangs rgyas kun gyi stobs gang dang / /dgra bcom rnams kyi grags pa dang / /zhes bya ba ni/ 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis ④gzi brjid dang stobs kyis dug bcom mo/ /de bzhin du shā ri'i bu la sogs pa'i stobs dang gzi brjid kyis dug bcom pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs kyi gzi brjid kyisadhi/ /zhes bya ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa yang 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar yod pa ste/ bye ba khrag rjokhrig brgya stong 'bum phrag gi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo/ /ngas ni bde legs 'gyur bar bya/ /zhes bya ba ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya seng ges dge slong sa ri'i don la stong gsum gyi stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can rnams kyi don la bde bar byas pa'o/ /kun dga' bo zhes bya ba ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis bka' stsal pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mos dug bcom mo zhes bya ba ni/ sdod pa'i dug dang / 'gro ba'i dug dang / byed pa'i dug gsum bcom zhing de bzhin du nang gi dug gsum bcom pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo las/36—1536

nang gi dug gsum bshad pa'i gnas skabs te nyi shu rtsa drug pa'o// //dge slong sa ri dge bar gyur cig ces bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i bkas/ rig sngags kyi gzi brjid kyis/ dge slong sa ri mche ba'i dug gis zin pa bde ba'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun ①dga' bos bcom ldan 'das la legs so zhes gsol te bya ba ni/ dge slong sa ri ni mche ba'i dug gis zin cing dran pa ma rnyed par yod pa/ lus kyang kha dog 'gyur zhing kha nas dbugs ④kyang mi thon pa/ kha nas dbu ④ba 'dzag pa/ lus rengs shing mig dkar log gis song ba mthong nas/ snying rje skyes nas sangs rgyas la dris pa ste/de'i thabs bsrung ba'i phyir na/ sangs rgyas la bde legs phul ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar nyan nas zhes bya ba nirjo/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo'i rig sngags kyi gsang sngags/ sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa bzhin du lus ngag yid kyis bzung ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑤zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ lan gsum bskor ba byas nas/ dga' ba'i sems byas nas sangs rgyas kyi bka' la rjonyan nas/ dge slong sa ri'i don du rkang pa phyir bor te/ dge slong sa ri la kha bltas pa'o/ /dge slong sa ri ga la ba der song ste—/ phyin pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ yul mnyan yod rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na/ dge 'dun gyi bsro khang bgyi ba'i slad du shing gshegs pas shing rul ba'i sa kha na ⑦dge slong sa ri nad kyis thebs pa'o—/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'dis/ dge slong sa ri la chad pa spang ba bya ste zhes bya ba ni/ thog ma dang tha ma dang da ltar med pa'i rang bzhin⑧/36—1537

rig sngags kyi gtso mor gyur pa/ thugs rje can gyi rig sngags kyi gsang sngags la—/ klu'i kha rlangs ①kyi dug las byung ba mche ba'i dug gis chad pa spang ba'o/ /yongs su bskyab pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ dug las skyabs ②te/ gzhan bar chad byung ba la yang bskyab pa'o/ /yongs su gzung ⑦ba dang zhes bya ba ni/dug gi bzung ba las phral te/ dug des mi ④tshugs pa'o/ /yongs su bskyang ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ dug dang gzhan gyi 'jigs pa rnams dang phral te bskyang ba'o—/ /zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ dug nad de rnams ⑤las zhi ba ste/ de'i nad kun bor nas lus kyi na tsha med par bde ba'o//chad pa spang ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ dug gi chad pa spang ba'o/ /mtshon cha spang ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ 'byung po rnams kyi mtshon cha spang ba'o/ /dug gzhil ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ mche ba'i dug gzhil ba'o/ /dug gsad pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ dug byung ba gsad pas dug gzhan 'ong bar mi nus pa'o/ /mtshalas gcad pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags rjokyis gzhan gyi bar chod byung ba las bsrung ba'o/ /sa bcing ba byas te zhes bya ba ni/ de bzhin du sa gzhi ⑦yang bsrung ba'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bsrung ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ byams pa dang snying rje'i stobs kyis dge slong sa ri la sangs rgyas kyi bka' bzhin du bsrung ba'o/ /bde legs su 'gyur bar byas pas zhes bya ba ni/tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos dge slong sa ri la/ dug gi nad las bde bar byas pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa dge slong sa ri nad de las sos skeso zhes bya ba ni/tshe dang ldan pa dge slong sa ri la dug gi nad kyi rkyen byung ste/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' dang rig sngags kyi gzi brjid kyis kun dga' bo'i las kyis ⑨bde ba'o/ /36—1538

de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dang / tshe dang ldan pa dge slong sa ri bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas zhes bya ba ni/ de gnyis ni lus ngag yid bde ba sangs rgyas kyi thabs bsam gyis mi khyab la/ ye shes dang gzi brjid kyang de bzhin te/ chos de'i nus pas sems can thams cad la bde ba'o/ /de'i phyi nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te zhes bya ba ni/ gus par byas nas lan gsum bskor ba byas te/ mgo bos phyag 'tshal ba'o/ /ji ltar gyur pa thams cad bcom ldan 'das la gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang ste/phyogs gcig tu 'khod do zhes bya ba ni/ mche ba'i dug gis zin pa'i lo rgyus ni/bcom ldan 'das la zhu ba phul nas/ kun dga' bo dang dge slong sa ri gnyis/bcom ldan 'das kyi mdun du 'khod pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo las/ dge slong sa ri sbrul nag pos zin pa'i gnas skabs zhes bya ba ste/nyi shu rtsa bdun pa'o// //de nas zhes bya ba ni/ dge slong sa ri bde ba'i de nas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' 20 pa zhes bya ba ni/sems can gyi don la kun dga' bo la yang nas yang du bka' 6) pa'o/ /kun dga' bo zhes bya ba ni/ 'khor bzhi dang sems can gyi don la bka' zad pa'o//rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen po ①'di'i mthu mthong ngam zhes bya ba ni/ sde snod bzhi'i rang bzhin/ kun brtags rnam par dag pa/ thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa/ na man tra'i rang bzhin sgyu ma lta bu ste/ gzi brjid dang ②36—1539

stobs dang mthu dang ldan pa ste/ nam mkha' bzhin du khyab pa/ sems can rnams la gnyis su med par don byed pa'o/ /kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gsungs pa de la phyag 'tshal nas zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi mtshan nyid de gsungs pas①/ mgu ba'i sems kyis lus ngag yid kyis sangs rgyas la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas lan gsum bskor ba byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das la zhu ba phul ba'o/ /'di skad ces gsol to zhes bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das la kun dga' bos zhu ba phul ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du ma 'tshal zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di'i nus pa gang zhig yod ces pa'o—/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa zhes bya ba ni/ sems can gyi don la bka' stsal pa'o/ /kun dga' bo zhes bya ba ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'o/ /'di ltar rgya mtsho chen po bzhi ni skam yang srid ces bya ba ni/ rgya mtsho ni thar pa med cing rgya che ba ste/ de yang me bdun kyi dus su bskams te/ de yang rtag pa med pa'o/ /sa ni nam mkha' la 'phar yang srid ces bya ba ni/ bskal pa chen po'i dus su bskal pa'i mes sa rnams bsreg ④pa'o/ /zla ba dang nyi ma ni sa la lhung yang srid ces bya ba ni/da ltar nyi ma dang zla ba snang bar 'gyur te/ de'i dus su yang nyi ma dang zla ba gnyis mes bsregs nas/ nyi zla gnyis mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /klung ni rgyun nas ldog kyang srid kyi zhes bya ba ni rkyen gyi rang bzhin gyis klung de yang med par 'gyur te/ de bzhin du sa dang rlung dang me dang chu la sogs pa/ 'jig rten kyi khams kyi snang ba 'di yang med pa ste/ sgyu ma dang rmi lam lta bu'i rang bzhin no—/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' ni gzhan du 'gyur mi srid do zhes bya ba ni/36—1540

'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ /ma 'ongs pa rnams kyang de bzhin te/ da ltar shākya seng ges bstan pa'i bden pa 'di bstan pa'o//de nas zhes bya ba ni/ bden pa'i tshig gi de nas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' 6) pa zhes bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis yang nas yang du gsungs pa'o/ /kun dga' bo de lta bas na zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo'i yon tan ni/ bsam gyis mi khyab cing brjod du med pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo ①'di la zhes bya ba ni/thugs rje che zhing sems can rnams kyi don byed pa'o/ /'khor bzhi bo zhes bya ba ni—/ nye ba'i 'khor dang nang gi 'khor dang phyi'i 'khor rnams so/ /nye ba'i 'khor ni byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'o/ /nang gi 'khor ni nyan thos dgra bcom pa nyis brgya lnga bcu/ de la sogs pa dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/② dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma'o④/ /phyi'i 'khor ni lha dang mi la sogs pa'o/ /dge slong ma zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni/rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'dis rjosrung ba dang skyob par byed pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das la legs so zhes gsol te rjozhes bya ba ni/ kun dga' bo/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' pa pas⑥/mgu nas legs so zhes ④zhu ba phul ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar mnyan nas zhes bya ba ni/ sdud pa po kun dga' bo 'khor ④bzhi la bka' pa pa'o/ /'khor bzhi po zhes bya ba ni/ byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying po la sogs pa/bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag brgyad cu'o/ /shā ri'i bu la sogs pa nyan thos nyis brgya lnga bcu'o/ /dge slong dang zhes bya ba ni/ dge slong sa ri la sogs pa/36—1541

rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba'i dge slong tsam ①mo—/ /dge slong ma dang zhes bya ba ni/ sgra gcan 'dzin gyi ma shākya 'dzin la sogs pa brgya bco brgyad dang ngo / /dge bsnyen dang zhes bya ba ni/ tshong dpon mgon med la sogs pa dge bsnyen mang po'o/ /dge bsnyen ma rnams kyis rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'di la gus par byas so zhes bya ba ni/rgya cher spel lo/ /rjes su yi rang ngo / /klog par byas so/ /'chang du gzhug go—/ /mchod par byas so/ /bla mar byas so/ /bsgom ②par byas so/ /de bzhin du de'i yon tan gyis sems can thams cad ni sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral zhing bde bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo'i chos kun dga' bo la gtad do zhes bya ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dang zhes bya ba ni/kun dga' bo la sogs pa nyan thos nyis brgya lnga bcu'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sa ri dang zhes bya ba ni de bzhin nyan thos la sogs pa'o/ /lha dang zhes bya ba ni lha'i dbang po la sogs pa gzugs khams dang 'dod pa'i khams kyi lha rnams du ma 'dus pa'o/ /mi dang zhes bya ba ni mi'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra la sogs pa'o①/ /du ma gnas pa'i lha ma yin dang zhes bya ba ni rjolha ma yin gyi rgyal po thags bzangs ris dhil sogs pa grangs med par gnas pa'o/ /rlung lha dang zhes bya ba ni rlung lha'i rgyal po grangs 'dzin la sogs pa grangs med pa du ma gnas pa'o/ /nam mkha' lding dang zhes bya ba ni nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po gser mig can la sogs pa nam mkha' lding grangs med pa'o/ /dri za dang zhes bya ba ni dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa la sogs pa grangs med pa'o/ /mi'am dhici dang zhes bya 36—1542

ba ni mi 'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pa la sogs pa grangs med pa'o/ /lto 'phye dhichen po dang zhes bya ba ni lto 'bye'i rgyal po yon tan grags la sogs pa du mar gnas pa'o//gnod sbyin dang zhes bya ba ni gnod sbyin kyi rgyal po ku be ra la sogs pa mang por gnas pa'o/ /srin po dang zhes bya ba ni srin po'i rgyal po 'jigs pa la sogs pa mang por gnas pa'o/ /mi dang mi ma yin pa gang dag 'khor der 'dus te 'khod pa de dag thams cad yi rangs te ④zhes bya ba ni rgyal bu ④rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na/ de dag thams cad bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar gnas te/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo la gus par rjes su yi rang ba'o—/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do zhes bya ba ni chos 'di bsam kyis mi khyab pa de dag thams cad kyi drung du/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rjobaden par bka' stsal pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo las rjes su yi rang ba'i gnas skabs te nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa'o// //rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo las brtag pa lnga pa rdzogs so// //rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo'i 'bum 'grel⑤/ rgya gar gyi slob dpon chen po las kyi rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas pa chen po a mo gha badz+ras rang 'gyur du mdzad pa'o// //36—1543

༄ga /gsang sngags chen mo rjes su 'dze+en ma'i mdo'i 'bum 'grel/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā mas+thā nu dhā ra ni shu t+t+waṃ ti sa ha ra ṣa ṭī ②kā/ bod skad du/ gsang sngags chen mo rjes su 'dzin ma'i mdo'i 'bum 'grel—/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin ma chen mo la ①phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag ye shes snang bar ldan/ /rtag tu sems can don byed pa/ /de bzhin yon tan yang dag ldan/ /'jig rten gsum mgon phyag 'tshal nas/ /rab rib kyis ni mi shes pa'i/ /de yi gti mug sel byed pa—/ /yang dag bsams ④la yang dag dgrol/ /bdag gis 'bum 'grel bshad par bya/ /'di skad bdag gis ⑪thos pa'i dus gcig na zhes bya ba ni/'di skad ces bya ba ni sgro skur dang bral ba'o/ /bdag gis thos pa zhes bya ba ni kun dga' bas ④so/ /grogs med dam zhe na/ nyan thos la sogs pa dang thabs cig tu thos pa'o/ /su la thos na bcom ldan 'das la'o/ /gang thos na rig 36—1578

sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin ma'i mdo 'di thos pa'o/ /sus thos na kun dga' bos thos pa'o/ /dus gcig na zhes bya ba'i sgra ni don gnyis la 'jug ste/ sdud pa po shes rab che bar go ba dang / dam pa'i chos 'byung bar dkon pa'i don to/ /ston pa ni bcom ldan 'das so/ /bcom ldan 'das zhes bya ba ni/ bcom pa ni bzhi bcom/ bzhi ni dgra ste dgra ni bdud bzhi'o/ /bdud bzhi ni phung po'i bdud dang / nyon mongs pa'i bdud dang / 'chi bdag gi bdud dang / lha'i bu'i bdud do/ /gang gi dus na bcom zhe na/ rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs pa'i dus na'o/ /ldan pa zhes bya ba ni/ skal ba dang ldan pas bcom ldan 'das so/ /'das pa ni mya ngan las 'das ①pa'o/ /'das pa ni gang gi dus she na/ dpyid zla ra ba'i gnam stong gi nub mo'o/ /'dam bu'i khrod na gzigs pa'i 'dug gnas na bzhugs te zhes pa ni/ grong khyer yangs pa can gyi dbus su lha dang lha ma yin dang /mi ma yin pa rnams kyis byas pa'i gzhal yas khang yod de/ phyogs re re la dpag tshad lnga lnga yod pa gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ nang gi ka ba brgyad dang /phyi'i ka ba brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ sgo re re la seng ge gnyis ④gnyis kyis brgyan pa ste/ de bzhin du twa ra nas kyang brgyan pa'o/ /ka ba dang / skar khung dang / sgo logs dang / ya them dang / ma them dang / sgo 'gram la sogs pa rin po che rnams las byas pa yin te/ ka rten ni ma ra ka ta ①ljang gu'o—/ /ka zhu ni in+d+ra nī bul ste/ ka ba ni gser las rjobyas pa ste/ 'phra ni byu ru la sogs pas byas pa'o/ /de bzhin du gdung yang gser las byas pa ste/phyam la sogs pa ni dngul las byas pa'o/ /rtsig pa ni rin po che sna bdun las 36—1579

byas pa/ phyi logs dang nang logs ①gnyis ka ri mo mkhas pas bris pa bzhin du snang ba'o/ /sa gzhi ni rin po che pad+ma rā ga las byas pa ste/ ra ba ni be+e ḍūr+ya las byas pa'o/ /sgo bzhi ni rin po che sna bdun las byas pa/ de yang gser dang / dngul dang / in+d+ra bhā la dang / ma ra ka ta ②dang / pad+ma rā ga dang / bai ḍūr+ya dang / shel dang bdun no/ /seng ge brgyad kyang rgyu shel las byas shing / gnya' ral la sogs pa ni in+d+ra nī la dang / byu ru las byas pa'o/ /mig dang kha ni in+d+ra nī la dang pad+ma rā gas mdzes shing / so dang mche ba ni dngul las byas pa'o/ /rgya phibs dang ldan zhing / rgya phibs kyi rten ni rin po che sna bdun las byas shing sna tshogs kyi gzugs su snang ba'o/ /dra ba dang / dra ba phyed pas brgyan zhing / gdugs dang ba dan dang rgyal mtshan gyis phyogs phyogs su brgyan zhing / rin po che la sogs pa mar la 'phyang zhing / dril bu dang / dril bu g.yer ka dang / rlung gis btab pas skad sna tshogs 'byung ste/ dper na rol mo mkhas pas yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i rol mo byas pas skad sna tshogs 'byung ba bzhin no/ /de'i phyogs bzhi na rin po che sna bdun las byas pa'i lcags ri gcig gis bskor ba'i nang na skyed mos tshal bzhi yod de/ skyed mos tshal re re la yang rdzing bu re re yod pa'o/ /skyed mos tshal de'i ming yang thu/ dga' ba dang / mchog tu dga' ba dang /kun du dga' ba dang / rnam par dga' ba dang / rnam pa bzhi yin no/ /de bzhin du sprung bu'i ming yang yin no/ /rdzing bu'i 'og ni bai ḍūr+ya las byas pabu/logs dang / skas ka ⑤ni rin po che sna bdun las byas pa'o/ /rdzing bu de'i chu yang shel chags pa bzhin du dngas la gsal ba/ 'thungs na yang ba/ lta 36—1580

na yid du 'ong ba/ tsan+dan dang / ga pur la sogs pa dri dang ldan pa/rdzing bu de'i nang na rang bzhin kyis chu las skyes pa'i me tog sna tshogs yod de/de bzhin du kha dog sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ pad+ma dang / pad+ma dkar po dang /puṇ+ḍa rī ①ka dang / puṇ+ḍa rī ④ka chen po dang / at+pa la dang / ut+pa la sngon po dang / ku mu ta dang / ku mu ta chen po la sogs pa/ dri sna tshogs dang ldan zhing / so so'i kha dog dang ldan pa/ lta na mdzes pa'o/ /rdzing bu de'i nang na bya'i tshogs sna tshogs yod de/ khrung khrung dang / bya ngang pa dkar po dang / bya ngang pa'i rgyal po dkar po dang / ngang pa ser po dang / sa ra sa la sogs pa'i bya'i skad sna tshogs 'byung bas mdzes shing mnyan pa'o/ /de bzhin du skyed mos tshal gyi nang na yang thang las skyes pa'i me tog gi shing nags tshal yod de/ tsam pa ka'i me tog gi shing dang / kun+ta'i ①me tog gi shing dang /dzā ti'i me tog gi shing dang / kak+ko la'i me tog gi shing dang / klu'i me tog gi shing dang / a ru ra'i shing dang / ba ru ra'i shing dang / sgyu ru ra'i shing dang / ta la dang / ta la chen bo'i shing dang / tsan+dan gyi shing la sogs pa rang bzhin gyis shing sna tshogs skyes te/ shing de'i me tog dang 'bras bus kyang sems can thams cad la phan 'dogs shing bde bar gnas pa'o/ /skyed mos tshal dang / rdzing bu la yang / dge slong ngam/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma'am/ lha dang / mi rnams kyis kyang sgom zhing / tshogs sogs pa'i sa dang / de na gnas pa'i byes pa rnams kyang zhe sdang med cing chos dang mthun par gnas pa'o/ /de lta bu'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su rdo rje ④seng ge'i khri sa ya dang bcas pa yod de/ rdo rje sa la pad+ma sna tshogs dang bcas pa/36—1581

rdo rje rin po che'i sa ya sna bdun dang bcas pa/ rgyan rnam ①bzhi twa ra na dang ldan pa/ rdo rje rin po che sna bzhi'i ②bya khyung gi twa ra na dang ldan pa/ rdo rje rin po che'i mu tig dang / byi ru dang / mu men la sogs pas gser gyi rgyu las ①'phra byas shing / klu'i zhags pa bya khyung twa ra nas khar bcug pa'o/ /ri dwags shwa bur na ni rin po che sna bzhi las byas pa ste/ mdzes shing blta ⑤na sdug pa'o—/ /de'i 'og tu shang shang na ra na yin te/ rdo rje rin po che sna bzhi las byas shing g.yas g.yon gnyis nas mdzes par brgyan pa'o/ /chu srin twa ra na ni khyerdo rje rin po che sna bdun las byas shing mjug ⑦ma pa tra sna tshogs su 'khyil zhing blta ⑧na sdug pa'o/ /rdo rje seng ge'i pad+ma chen po'i khri ni/ mnan na ne+ems ⑨byed pa/ bzhag na mtho ⑩ba/ reg na 'jam pa/ lta na mdzes pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang ⑪dang / seng ge'i khri de ni rang bzhin du yod cing sngon gyi smon lam gyi stobs las byung ba'o/ /de bzhin du ⑫gdung g.yogs dang / bla re dang rdo rje rin po che'i mu tig gi phreng ba'i dra bas brgyan pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i rigs mi gcig pa brgya stong 'bum gyi 'khor dang bcas shing /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par mthu chen po ⑫thob pa/ rdo rje chen po'i rnam par thar pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing du rnam par sprul pa dang / cho 'phrul kun du ston pa dang /sems kyi skad cig thang cig yud tsam gcig la sems can thams cad kyi sems dang spyod pa'i rjes su 'jug pa'i chos bstan pa sna tshogs mnyam pa nyid du mnyam zhing rgya che la ④zab pa dang / spobs pa dang / cho 'phrul dang ldan pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing du mar de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa chen po'i sprin gyis ⑫mchod 36—1582

pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo dang / gzungs dang / ting nge 'dzin dang /dbang dang / mngon par shes pa dang / ma 'dres pa dang / byang chub kyi yan lag dang / lam dang / sa dang / pha rol tu ①phyin pa dang /thabs la mkhas pa dang / bsdu ba'i dngos po dang / byams pa dang / snying rje dang / dga' ba dang / btang snyoms dang / byams pa'i stobs dang /dbe+en pa dang / yongs su byas pa'i sems kyi rgyun dang ldan pa sha stag go/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje dang / rdo rje gtum po dang / rdo rje sems dpa' dang / lag na rdo rje mda' gzhu dang / rdo rje byin gyis brlabs ②pa dang / rdo rje'i rgyan dang / rdo rje'i 'od dang / spyan ras gzigs dang / kun du bzang po dang / kun du gzigs pa dang / rdo rje dpal dang / pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / zhal rnam par mche ba gcigs pa'i rdo rje dang / pad+ma snying po dang / pad+ma'i spyan dang / 'jam dpal dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang thabs cig go/ /nyan thos chen po rab tu mang po thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa/ zag pa zad pa/ srid par kun du sbyor ba chad pa/ yang dag pa'i shes pas sems shin tu rnam par grol ba/ rdzu 'phrul kyi stobs dang / cho 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnam par 'phrul ba'i mthu chen po thob pa/ lta ba chags pa med pa/ thams cad kyang dri ma zhudang bral ba/kun nas nyon mongs pa'i bag chags kyi sa bon bsregs pa sha stag la/ 'di lta ste—/ tshe dang ldan pa shā buri'i bu dang / tshe dang ldan pa byams ma'i bu gang po dang / tshe dang ldan pa ka pi na dang / tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor dang / tshe 36—1583

dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po dang / tshe dang ldan pa skul byed dang / tshe dang ldan pa dga' byed dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'od srungs dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'od srungs chen po dang / tshe dang ldan pa lteng rgyas 'od srungs dang /de dag la sogs pa nyan thos chen po rab tu mang po dang / dge slong dang /dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma'am①/ lha dang / mi dang / 'khor du ma 'dus pa'i nang du bcom ldan 'das kyis ④'khor lo shin tu bskor/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa ni shin tu mthar phyin/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs ni shin tu rdzogs/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi byang chub chen po'i phyir pha rol tu phyin pa dang / sa brnyes ④pa shin tu yongs su bzung /spyi ④gtsug ni sems can thams cad kyis blta bar mi mthong / bdud kyi las thams cad las ni nges par rgyal/ de kho na thams cad mkhyen pa ni thugs su chud—/ spyan lnga ni mnga'/ rnam ⑤pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ni ldan/thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang ni ldan/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad ni ldan / bdud dang phas kyi rgol ba'i tshogs thams cad ni bcom/ dgra dang khye las ni 'phags/ khyu mchog dang seng ge'i sgra ni sgrogs⑦/ ma rig pa'i mun pa ni kun du bsal/ bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag grangs med pa dpag tu med pa'i sbyin pa dang / tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang / shes rab dang / thabs dang /stobs dang / smon lam dang / ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / dka' ba spyad pas/ mngon par 'grub ⑧pa'i skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa'i sku mdzes shing /36—1584

rin po che rdo rje chen po'i pad+ma'i snying po seng ge'i khri la bzhugs te/ gser gyi ri bo'i rgyal po ltar dpal ni 'bar/ sa phyogs ni nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od zer kyi dkyil 'khor gyis rnam par brgyan/ zla ba nya gang ba ltar 'jig rten thams cad la ni sdug par snang / dpag bsam gyi shing ljon pa chen po ltar sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ni shin tu rgyas shing chos ston te/ tshangs par spyod pa/thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba/ tha mar dge ba/ don bzang po ①tshig 'bru bzang po/ ma 'dres pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ yongs su dag pa/yongs su byang ba/ yang dag par rab tu bstan rjoto/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin pa'i gnas dang / 'khor phun sum tshogs pa'i skabs te ①gnas skabs dang po'o // //rjode nas zhes bya ba ni/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa'i de nas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dutshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' sprul pa zhes bya ba ni/bcom ldan 'das kyis yud tsam cig ci yang ma smras par/ smin mtshams dang ⑪ /ba sru'i bu ga thams cad nas 'od zer kyi dra ba 'phros te/ de bzhin du yang nas yang du spros nas stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i ④'jig rten gyi khams su khyab ste—/ slar log nas 'od zer gyi dra ba de smin mtshams dang / ba spu'i bu ga thams cad du thim mo/ /de nas kun dga' bo stan las langs te/ bcom ldan 'das la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bskor ④ba lan gsum byas nas/pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ thal mo sbyar nas bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das 'od zer dra ba 'di ni rgyu dang rkyen ci lags/36—1585

don med par 'od zer gyi dra ba mi 'gyed na zhes zhus so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' sprul pa/ grong khyer yangs pa can gyi nang na/ ma rungs par byed pa/ lha'i gdon dang / klu'i gdon dang / lha ma yin gyi gdon dang / nam mkha' lding gi gdon dang / rlung lha'i gdon dang / dri za'i gdon dang / mi'am ci'i gdon dang / lto 'phye chen po'i gdon dang /gnod sbyin kyi gdon dang / srin po'i gdon dang / 'byung po'i gdon dang /yi dwags kyi gdon dang / grul bum gyi gdon dang / srul po'i gdon dang /lus srul po'i gdon dang / brjed ①byed kyi gdon dang / sbyo byed kyi gdon dang / grib gnon kyi ④gdon dang / gnon po'i gdon dang / de la sogs pa mkha' 'gro dang / bgegs dang / logs 'dren dang / ma rungs par byed ba gzhan gyi srog ①'phrog par byed pa dang / gzi brjid 'phrog pa dang / zas su sha za ba rnams ④dang / gzhan yang ma rungs par 5 byed pa'i yi dwags dang / 'byung po rnams kyis kyang yul der phyin nas/yams kyi nad dang / rims dang / tsha ba dang / 'dus pa dang / rlung dang / bad kan dang / mkhris pa dang / shu ba dang / g.yan pa dang /mdze dang / phol mig dang / lhog pa dang / 'brum bu dang / sha bkra dang / 'bras dang / me dbal dang / de la sogs pa'i nad thams cad 'byung ste/ yul der mu ge dang / klu'i tshad pas kyang mi tshugs te/ grong khyer yangs pa can gyi chos thams cad dar zhing / chos kyi gzi brjid 'phrog cing chos kyi nus pa yang med par gyur to/ /de bzhin du mi nad dang /phyugs nad dang / grong khyer yangs pa can du ma rungs pa thams cad byung ste/36—1586

'jigs su rung ba byung nas sems can thams cad la 'tshe bar byas so/ /de'i phyir na 'od zer gyi dra ba 'gyed ①pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' sprul to zhes gsungs so/ /kun dga' bo zhes bya ba ni bcom ldan 'das kyis kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa'o/ /yangs pa'i grong khyer du byon nas/ yangs pa'i grong khyer ga la ba der dong ngo zhes bya ba ni yangs pa can gyi grong khyer ni dpag tshad brgya lnga bcu yod pa/ dbyibs legs pa/ lta na mdzes pa/phyogs bzhi'i srang bar nas/ rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / gdugs la sogs pas brgyan pa/ tshong dus mi gcig pa brgya rtsa brgyad yod pa/ de bzhin du 'dod pa dang / 'dod par byed pa rnams kyis ②nyo ba dang / len pa dang / ra ba gcig gis bskor zhing / sman gyi shing dang / me tog gi shing sna tshogs kyis bskor zhing / de bzhin du skyed mos tshal dang rdzing bu bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba'o/ /rdzing bu dang / skyed mos tshal de dag la thang las skyes pa dang / chu las skyes pa'i me tog sna ①tshogs dang / bya rigs mi gcig pa sna tshogs dang / ri dwags kyi tshogs rnams yod de/ de lta bu'i grong khyer kyi nang du rjo'agro ba sems can gyi don la bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' sprul to—/ /btsun pa de ltar bgyi zhes gsol nas zhes bya ba ni/ kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa mnyan te/ sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad pa la bka' stsal pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan༄ pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar mnyan to zhes bya ba ni/ grong khyer yangs pa can kyi don la sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral ba'i phyir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas/ snying rje la gnas nas yang dag pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo ma nor bar 36—1587

bskor ro/ /de'i phyir na kun dga' bos kyang legs par gsan pa'o/ /de nas zhes bya ba ni/ kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa de nas so/ /bcom ldan 'das yul bri dzir yul rgyu zhing gshegs zhes bya ba ni/ grong khyer yangs pa can gyi dbus su sems can thams cad 'dus pa'i sa/ de bzhin du 'byung po rnams kyang 'du ba'i sa yin no/ /gser gyi sa gzhi la rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdo rje'i gdan/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa/ ma rungs par byed pa'i 'byung po thams cad 'dul ba'i sa yin no/ /yangs pa'i grong khyer du byon nas zhes bya ba ni/byang chub sems dpa' dang / nyan thos dang / lha la sogs pa 'khor rnam bzhi dang bcas nas/ grong khyer yangs pa can du zhabs kyis bcags so/ /de nas gnas stigatsang ma'i lha dang / tshangs pa la sogs pa'i lha'i me tog bzang pos sel mar bkram ste/ spos dang / dri dang / rgyal mtshan dang /ba dan dang / gdugs la sogs pa bcom ldan 'das la 'bul zhing / lha'i rol mo sna tshogs kyis mchod par byas so/ /bcom ldan 'das gar gshegs pa'i sa nas kyang lha'i dar la sogs pas bting nas/ lha'i me tog man+da ra ba dang / man+da 3ra ba chen po la sogs pa me tog gi char 'be+ebs so de bzhin du grong khyer yangs pa can gyi sems can thams cad kyis kyang bla na med pa'i mchod pa byas so/ /yangs pa'i grong khyer ①kyi a mra srung rjoba'i tshal na bzhugs so zhes bya ba ni/ yangs pa can kyi grong khyer gyi dbus na sems can thams cad 'du ba'i gnas a 'bras kyi shing gis bskor ba/ skyed mos tshal dang / sprung bu dang / wa chu 'dren pa'i sa dang / rdo rje'i khri'am/ pad+ma 36—1588

chen po'i gdan la bzhugs so/ /de nas zhes bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das a mra'i ①tshal na bzhugs pa'i de nas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa zhes bya ba ni/ grong khyer yangs pa can gyi sems can kyi don la gdon ma rungs pa rnams 'dul ba'i phyir na/ kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa'o/ /kun dga' bo yangs pa'i grong khyer du song la/ phyi nas sgo'i them ②pa la rkang pa zhog ste ①zhes bya ba ni/ grong khyer yangs pa can kyi dbus su yul lha'i thog tu dbang po'i dus su rkang pa g.yas pa bzhag la/ seng ge'i sgra bsgrags dul/ khyu mchog dang ⑤bcas shing gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin ma chen mo/ yams kyi nad dang / gdon ma rungs pa thams cad 'dul ba'i phyir ro/ /gsang sngags tshigs su bcad pa smras pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin ma'i/ gsang sngags gzhi 'di dag dang / tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smros shig ces bya ba ni/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin nad thams cad dang / gdon thams cad rlag par byed pa/mtshon pa ni so sor rtog ⑥pa'i ye shes te/ mtshon byed ni rig sngags kyi rgyal mo gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin ma'o/ /rigs ni pad+ma'i rigs so/ /phung po ni 'du shes kyi phung po/ khams ni me'i khams/ skye mched ni ro'i skye mched do/ /rig sngags de'i sku mdog dang / phyag mtshan ni gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/zhal gsum pa/ phyag bcu gnyis pa/ sku mdog dkar mo/ g.yas ser ba/g.yon dmar ba spyan gsum pa/ sangs rgyas lnga'i dbu rgyan can/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ rdo rje ④skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ pad+ma'i steng na zla ba'i gdan la nyi ma'i 'od dang bcas pa'o/ /phyag g.yas g.yon gnyis kyis chos kyi 36—1589

'khor lo'i phyag rgya'o/ /de'i 'og ma gnyis ni mnyam gzhag ①go/ /g.yas pa'i gsum pa ni ⑤ral gri/ bzhi pa na rdo rje/ lnga pa na 'khor lo/ drug pas mchog sbyin no/ /g.yon pa'i gsum pa ni rin po che'i steng na rdo rje'o/ /bzhi pa na pad+ma/ lnga pa na bum pa'i steng na rdo rje/ drug pa na lcags kyu/ oṃ yig 'bras ①bu sems can thams cad kyi don byed pa'o/ /rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas kyis dbu la brgyan pa ni ye shes lnga rnam par dag pa'o/ /spyan gsum ni sku gsung thugs rnam par dag pa'o/ /zhal gsum ni ting nge 'dzin gsum rnam par dag pa'o/ /rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug rnam par dag pa'o/ /phyag bcu gnyis ni rten 'byel bcu gnyis rnam par dag pa'o/ /rdo rje skyil krung du bzhugs pa ni mi shigs pa rdo rje'i gdan rnam par dag pa'o/ /zla ba dang nyi ma'i 'od ni/ thabs shes rab zung du 'brel ba'o/ /chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya mdzad pa ni sangs rgyas dang sems can gnyis su med pa'o/ /mnyam gzhag ni/ rdo rje'i rang bzhin ting nge 'dzin rnam par dag pa'o/ /ral gri ni shes rab rnam par dag pa'o/ /rdo rje ni stong pa nyid rnam par dag pa'o—/ /'khor lo ni 'khor ba gcod ④pa'o/ /mchod sbyin ni sbyin ⑦pa rnam par dag pa'o/ /rdo rje dang rin po che ni thabs shes rab rnam par dag pa'o/ /pad+ma ni rigs rnam par dag pa'o/ /bum pa dang rdo rje ni nang gi dug dang /phyi'i dug rnam par dag pa'o/ /lcags kyu ni ma rig pa'i sems can rnams yar la 'dren pa'o/ /de lta bu'i rig sngags tshigs su bcad pa smras shing / ma rig pa thams cad bcom ste/ mun pa'i nags tshal bsal rjobar byed cing /rig sngags kyi tshigs su bcad pa smras pa'o/ /bi sa ra bi sa ra bi sa ra ta la 36—1590

sogs pa'o/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten la ①thugs brtse ba can gyis bka' stsal to zhes bya ba ni/ thugs rje che zhing yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya seng ges/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams la sprul pa'i skus khyab cing / sems can gyi don la gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin pa bka' sprul pa'o—/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyis ⑤dgongs pa zhes bya ba ni/ bye ba khrag khrig brgyad cu rtsa bzhis gaṅgā'i ①klung gi bye ma snyed kyi 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyang jes su yi rang ba'i phyag rgyas btab pa'o/ /ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar byung bas de bzhin no/ /rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsam pa zhes bya ba ni/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gis kyang sku'i sgo nas chos bstan te/ de rnams kyis kyang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin ma rang bzhin gyis rjongo bor gnas pa'o/ /dgra bcom pa thams cad kyi bsam pa zhes bya ba ni/'jig rten nas yang dag par song ba dang / yang dag par zhugs pa dang /phyir mi ldog pa dang / lan cig phyir mi rjoldog pa rnams yin te/ de'i sgom rjopa ni dbugs 'byung ba dang / dbugs rngub pa rnams yin te/ sems dran pa med cing bum pa gang ba bzhin du 'gog pa'i rang bzhin gyis lus be+ems ⑦po'i rang bzhin du gyur pa ni ting nge 'dzin yin te/ de bzhin du rig sngags kyi rgyal mo gsang sngags ⑧rjes su 'dzin ma de'i ngo bo nyid kyis kyang bsams pa'o /nyan thos thams cad kyis bsams ⑨pa zhes bya ba ni/ ngag gi sgo nas bstan pa'i chos 'di rtags mngon du byas nas/ de bzhin du mi rtag par bsgoms te/lta ba ni 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi 'dzin zhing ⑩/ de bzhin du ngo bo nyid 'dzin pas kyang / rig sngags kyi lam gyi ngo bo nyid yin no/ /bden pa'i 36—1591

tshig dang ldan pa thams cad kyis bsams pa zhes bya ba ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' ①rnams dang dgra bcom pa rnams yin te de rnams kyis kyang rjes su yi rang zhing phyag 'tshal te/phyag rgya'i rgyas btab pa'o/ /chos kyis bsams ②pa zhes bya ba ni/ kun rdzob dang / don dam pa gnyis yin te/ kun rdzob kyang log pa'i sgyu ne+em mi dmigs pa dang / yang dag pa'i sgyu ma'i don byed nus pa gnyis so/ /don dam pa'i ngo bo nyid dang bral zhing dmigs pa med pa/ gnas pa med pa sdog pa dang / dge ba dang bral ba yang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo gsang sngags kyi rjes su 'dzin pa'i gnas yin no/ /tshangs pas bsam pa zhes bya ba ni/ bsam gtan dang po dang / gnyis pa dang / gsum pa yin te/ tshangs par spyod pa'i ngo bo nyid 'dzin zhing / lus po be+ems por btang rjonas/ mi dmigs pa bsgoms te/ de yang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo gsang sngags rjorjes su 'dzin ma'i ngo bo nyid kyi ngo bo yin no/ /tshangs pas ⑥so sor bsams ④pa zhes bya ba ni tshangs rigs ④kyi lha rnams dang / gnas gtsang ma'i lha rnams kyi 'bras bu dang / bsam gtan bzhi'i lha rnams yin te/ tshangs pa chen po'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ sems bkag nas be+ems ⑨por gnas te/ mi dmigs pa'i ting nge 'dzin du ⑫gnas so/ /de yang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo gnas pa yin no/ /'dod pa'i dbang phyug gis bsams ⑪pa zhes bya ba ni/ khams gsum tsam la dbang mdzad de/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lngas sems can la dbang mdzad de/de yang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo'i lam nas ⑩yin no/ /dbang pos bsams ⑫pa zhes bya ba ni/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams la 36—1592

dbang mdzad pa ni/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo gsang sngags kyi rjes su 'dzin ma ngo bo nyid kyis thob pa'o/ /lhas bsams pa zhes bya ba ni rigs bzhi dang /rigs bdun gyi rnam pa yin te/ 'dod pa thams cad la spyod cing bde ba la ①gnas te/ de yang rig sngags kyis ②bde bar gnas pa'o/ /lha ma yin gyi dbang pos ④bsams pa zhes bya ba ni/ thag bzangs rjoris yin te/ sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad cing / byang chub kyi sems bskyed de/ khams gsum tsam la dbang mdzad cing / lha rnams kyis kyang mi thub byung rig sngags grub pa'o/ /lha ma yin thams cad kyis bsams pa zhes bya ba ni/ lha ma yin rnams ni zhe sdang skyes shing / lha rnams kyi rtsod ⑤pa ni/ rig sngags kyi stobs kyis rtsod pa'o/ /lha ma yin gyi mngag gzhug pas bsams zhes bya ba ni—/ sangs rgyas rjosgra gcan 'dzin rnams yin te/ nyi ma dang zla ba 'dzin nus shing / 'jig rten gyi bya ba la stobs dang ldan pa 'jig rten pas thub pa tsam med de/ de yang rig sngags kyi stobs kyis byas pa'o/ /'byung po thams cad kyis ⑦bsams pa zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun la dga' ba rnams yin te/ de'i stobs dang / gzi brjid dang ldan pa ni/ rig sngags kyi lam nas yin no/ /gzhan yang 'byung po rnams kyis rig sngags kyi bka' las 'da' mi nus so/ /gal te bka' las 'da' bar gyur na/ mgo bo ardza ka ⑧bzhin du tshal pa brgyar 'gas ⑨te/ lhog pa dang /sha bkra dang / 'bras rnams kyi nad kyis btab cing / rig sngags kyi dmod mos sems can dmyal bar skye bar 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags kyi tshig ni yang nas yang du bklag ⑩cing phyir rbad par bya'o/ /de yang bi sa ra ta la sogs pa smras 36—1593

pa'o—/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten la thugs brtse ba can gyis ①bka' stsal pa zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi zhal nas sprul te/ de yang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ sku mdog dmar mo/ khro mo spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar ba/ kha gdangs pa/ mche ba gcigs pa/ yan lag sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang pa/ g.yas bskum pas/ klu gtum po'i rigs mnan pa/ phyag g.yas pa na pad+ma dbyug to ⑤can bsnams pa/ g.yon na zhags pa dang sdigs mdzub bsnams te/ gdug ①pa thams cad rlag par byed cing / so sor rtog rjopa'i ye shes mtshon zhing / mtshon byed ni rig sngags so/ /me'i khams kyi ngo bo nyid dang ldan zhing / dbang ni lce la byas pa'o—/ /ye shes lnga'i ngo bo nyid dang ldan zhing / nam mkha' bzhin du thams cad la khyab pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi tshig ni muñca ⑤ta la sogs pa'o/ /yams kyi nad phyir song cig buces bya ba ni/ ma rungs par byed pa'i gdon dang 'byung po rnams dang / gong du bshad pa'i nad rnams phyir bskrad cing / rig sngags kyi dmod mos 'dug par mi tshugs shing gnod byed rnams phyir dbyung ⑦ba'o—/ /phyir bskrad pa'i tshigs su bcad pa ni/ nir gats+tsha ④ta la sogs pa'o—/ /sangs rgyas lha chen po lha'i yang ⑨lha'i bla ma gshegs shing zhes bya ba ni/sangs rgyas lha chen ni shākya thub pa'i zhal nas gsungs pa/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo gsang sngags kyi ⑩rjes su 'dzin ma⑪/ yams kyi nad dang / rims kyi nad la sogs pas mi tshugs te/ gzhan yang ma rungs par byed pa/ sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa dang ⑫/ drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa dang / gzhan gyi srog 'phrog pa rnams dang / 'tshe bar 36—1594

byed pa'i 'byung po dang / nad thams cad 'joms par byed pa'o/ /lha chen po'i tshogs ni 'byung po'i tshogs yin te/ de yang phan gnod byed pa'i phyir na/rig sngags kyi rgyal mo'i gzi brjid kyis phyin te/ gnod byed ①gang zhe na/lha chen po'i 'khor la bgegs rnams kyi bdag po 'byung po'i tshogs kyi ④rgyal bo dbang ldan gyi mtshams na gnas pa'o/ /skyer mi ster zhing ma'i mngal nas ④gnod par byed pa ni/ 'di rnams yin no/ /ri dwags rgyal dang skem byed dang / /brjed byed dang ni khu tshur can/ /nam gru srul po dza mi ka /'dod pa can dang ma rjodaga' byed/ /bzhin rgyal can dang gnya' lag can/ /bya gzugs mi 'chang 'joms pa mo/ /ma mo ⑤dang / de rnams 'byung po gnod byed pa/ /lo grangs bcu gnyis bar du ni/ /byes pa rnams la 'jigs par byed—/ /gzhan yang gang gis mi mthong ba/ /de rnams 'byung po sa la rgyu/ /lha yi lha ni gnyis yod do/ /'jig rten dang dhi'ajig rten las 'das pa ste/'jig rten las 'das pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas so/ /'jig rten pa ni lha'i dbang po brgya byin no/ /de yang shar gyi phyogs na gnas te/phan pa dang / gnod pa byed cing gnas pa'o/ /gnod byed ni/ dbang phyug chen po bisngu dang / z-ing ⑦gi ri ti dga' byed dbang / gzhon nu smin drug tshogs kyi bdag /stobs dbyangs ⑧legs ldan de bzhin no/ /de rnams shar phyogs na phan par byed pa dang / 'tshe bar byed pa rnams yin no/ /lha'i bla ma ni gnyis te/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i ⑨sangs rgyas dang / dpa' ba bzang yin no/ /de yang 'jig rten dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bla ma'o/ /gnod par byed pa dang / phan par byed pa dang / lo 36—1595

legs par byed pa dang / lo nyes par byed pa rnams ni/ nyi ma dang ni ①zla ba dang / /phur bu dang ni pa ba sangs/ /spen pa dang ni lag dang ni/ /sgra gcan 'dzin dang mjug ④rings dang / rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad rnams kyis ①de bzhin du/ bzang ba dang / ngan pa dang / tshes grangs 'dzin zhing /bkra shis pa dang / mi shis par byed pa'o/ /dbang po dang bcas pa'i lha rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ rgyal po bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa yin te/ de yang shar phyogs dang / lho phyogs dang / nub phyogs dang / byang phyogs su 'khod cing gnod par byed pa rnams ni phyir khyer cig ces pa'o/ /rgyal po bzhi po 'phags ④skyes po dang / yul 'khor srung dang / mig mi bzang dang /lus ngan po rnams yin te/ de'i 'khor ni/ dri za nor bu bzang dang / dri za gang ba bzang dang / dri za me tog dang / 'dor ru rnams yin te/grul bum gtum mo dang / nyes gtum mo dang / grul bum rgan mo dang /khyab 'jug len dang / grul bum zhe ⑤rgan mo rnams yin no/ /klu'i rgya mtsho dang / rgya mtsho'i bu dang / dug med dang / mtsho chen rnams so/ /gnod sbyin gyi dbang po la ba dang / /chu lha dang ni skye dgu'i bdag /ba ra dh+wa dza dbang ldan dang / /tsan+dan 'dod pa'i gtso bo dang / /mgrin ngan dang ni mgul nyes dang / /pi ḍi dang ni nor bu spyod/ /gra rab nyer lnga'i mnyam pa rjodang / /gser can gang po son te ba/ /g.yon can nor 'dzin ba lang skyong //'brog gnas mi yi ⑦ rgyal po dang / /rgyal ba khyu mchog tshogs lnga ser/ /mgrin bzangs ring po ④'khor bcas dang / /dri za sna tshogs sde dang ni/ /'bras bu gsum pa mgul gsum pa/ /lcags mdung ring po ma ldan dang / /36—1596

gnod sbyin ded dpon de rnams kyis/ /byang phyogs na ni gnas pa'o/ /dbang ldan dang bcas pa rnams zhes bya ba ni/ mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa nas—/ tshangs ris kyi lha dang / tshangs chen dang / tshangs pa'i 'khor rnams yin te/ de dag kyang steng na gnas pa'o/ /dbang bdag dang bcas pa rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ gnas gtsang ma'i lha rnams yin te/ lha'i bu dbang ldan dang / dbang chen dang / dbang grags rnams yin no/ /byang shar mtshams na gnas pa'o/ /skye dgu'i bdag po dang bcas pa rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ 'gro ba dang / 'dug pa dang / byed pa'i bdag po yin te/lha dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / mi dang / dud 'gro'i 'gro ba mtho ris dang / dmyal ba dang / bzang ba dang / ngan pa'i phyogs shes shing / khams gsum gyi bya ba shes pa'o/ /skye dgu'i bdag po tshangs pa dang /a tre ya dang / me dang / nyi ma dang / mi dang / bzang po la sogs pa yin te/ de dag gis kyang mngon par shes pa'o/ /'jig rten skyong ba bzhi po dag kyang ngo zhes bya ba ni/ me dang bden bral dang / rlung dang / gshin rje'o①rka/ /me'i 'khor rnams ni/ me zhing ②dang ni nag pa dang / /yang dag shes dang mdun bdar dang / /gya gyu gyur mid a gur dang / /g.yo 'dod dang ni shar lho gnas/ /lang ka mgrin bcu me dang / bum pa mgrin rna ④bum sna dang / gzigs shing gsod byed la sogs lho nub mtshams na gnas/sum rtse dang ni rab shim dang / /lho min he ron rjoke ru dang / /kun du sna tshogs la sogs nub byang mtshams na gnas/ rdo rje gzhon nu ma dang ni/ /36—1597

nam gru dang ni nag mo dang / /rdo rje lu gu rgyud sogs dang / /lho yi phyogs na gnas pa'o/ /lha 'bum phrag du ma dag dang / lha ma yin gyi dbang po rnams dang / lha ma yin 'bum phrag du ma rnams kyang 'ong zhes bya ba ni/ 'dod pa'i khams kyi lha ris drug dang / gzugs khams kyi lha ris bco brgyad kyang dad pa skyes nas byung ste/ gnod sbyin rnams song shig ces pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das la mngon par dad pa'i 'byung po 'bum phrag kyang / sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir 'ong ste zhes bya ba ni/ lha dang / klu dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lalding dang / rlung lha dang / dri za dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po ②dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang /'byung po rnams dang / yi dwags dang / sha za dang / grul bum dang /srul po dang / lus srul po dang / brjed byed dang / smyo byed dang /grib gnon dang / gnod byed dang / gnon po ①rnams yin te/ gzhan yang mdangs 'phrog pa dang / lo tog za ba rnams yod de/ de ⑦la sogs pa 'byung po'i rigs mi gcig pa stong phrag nyi shu yod de/ de rnams kyang dad pa skyes nas 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /de dag khyed rnams ⑤la gnod pa chen por ⑦byed par 'gyur du 'ong gis zhes bya ba ni/ de lta bu'i rigs kyis kyang gnod pa ⑦byas te/ des mi tshugs par bya ba'i phyir rig sngags kyi tshigs su bcad pa gdon par bya'o/ /rig sngags ni nir gats+tsha ⑧ta la sogs pa'o/ /myur du byer cig ⑨ces bya ba ni/ snying rje'i sems dang ldan pa dang sdang ⑩ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams so sor song cig⑪ /bzang ba dang / ngan pa ma 'grogs shig⑫ /rig sngags kyi dmod mos ngan byed rnams mgo tshal pa tshal par 'gas shing /36—1598

sems can dmyal bar 'gro ba'o/ /khyed cag la gang dag sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa de dag ni phung bar gyur cig ces bya ba ni/ gzhan yang srog 'phrog par 'dod pa dang / sdig pa'i sems dang ldan zhing / drag shul byed 'dod pa ste/rig sngags kyi dmod mo'i mtshon kyis①/ dum bu dum bur brlag cing rig sngags kyi mes thal bar btang ba'o/ /gang dag byams pa'i sems dang ldan zhing / nyes par mi 'dod la/ srung bar 'jug par 'dod pa de dag kyang ①khyed cag ces bya ba ni/ 'jig rten skyong ba dang / chos skyong ba rnams yin te/lha dang mi dang lha ma yin dang / gnod sbyin ded dpon chen po la sogs pas kyang / rig sngags kyi rgyal mo ①gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin ma'i gzi brjid dang / stobs kyis srung zhing skyob pa'o/ /lus la yang 'jug par kyis shig ces bya ba ni/ sku dang gsung dhidang / thugs rnams srung ste/ sku srung ba ni/tshon skud sna tshogs la mdud pa brgya rtsa brgyad bor zhing lus la btags pa'o/ /yang na dar ram/ shing shun nam/ gro ga la gi waṃ rjongam/ gur gum la sogs pas bris na/ gzhan ngan byed thams cad dang / glo dubur gyi sdig pas mi tshugs pa'o/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten la thugs brtse ba can kyis ④bka' 6) pa zhes bya ba ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i thugs ka nas sprul te/ gzi brjid dang ldan zhing / stobs che ba/nam mkhas khyab pa bzhin du/ grags pa yang de bzhin no/ /ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin sangs rgyas lnga'i dbu rgyan can/ cung zad khro bske/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ sku mdog nag mo/ spyan gsum pa zhabs phyed skyil du bzhugs pa/phyag g.yas na rdo rje g.yon na sdigs ⑨mdzub dang zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /zla 36—1599

ba'i gdan la nyi ma'i 'od dang bcas pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o①/ /sems can thams cad grol bar byed pa'i rig sngags kyi tshig ni gang zhe na/'di lta ste/ su mu su mu la sogs pa'o/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten la thugs brtse ba can zhes bya ba ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas/spyi bo gtsug nas sprul te/ rig sngags sku'i rang bzhin zhal gcig pa phyag gnyis pa/ sku mdog dkar mo ⑤zhi ba'i tshul du bzhugs pa/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin/ sangs rgyas lngas dbu la brgyan pa/ sbyan gsum pa/ phyag g.yas na 'khor lo/ g.yon pa na zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /zla ba'i gdan la zla ba'i 'od dang bcas shing / rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /sems can thams cad la phan par lhag pa/ dgongs pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni/'gro ba ris drug gi sems can la dgongs te/ rig sngags 'di'i gzi brjid kyis—/ dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa la ①gsod pa dang / sreg pa dang / rdeg pa dang / dum bur gtub rjopa dang / tshig pa dang / rengs pa'i sdug bsngal las/ yongs su thar ba'o/ /dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal ni/bya dang ce ⑤spyang la sogs pa rnams kyis gcig la gcig za ba'obu rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'dis/ de lta bu'i 'gro ba las thar bar byas shing / gcig la gcig za ba'i sdug bsngal dang bral ba'o/ /yi dwags kyi sdug bsngal ni/btung ba dang / bza' ④ba med pa'i sdug bsngal yin te/ mthong ma thag tu zhe sdang gis gcig la gcig phrag dog byed cing 'thab rtsod byed pa'o/ /de yang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di'i gzi brjid kyis btung ba dang / bza' ba med pa'i sdug bsngal 'joms pa'o/ /lha ma yin kyi sdug bsngal ni/ phrag dog gis 36—1600

spyod pa zhe sdang gi sems skye ste ①ser sna'i rang bzhin gyis 'dod pa la ma mthun nas—/ de yang g.yul 'gyed pa'i sdug bsngal lo/ /de'i sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar byed pa ni/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo'i dpung ⑤gis 'joms pa'o/ /lha'i sdug bsngal ni/ 'chi 'pho'i sdug bsngal yin te/ byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams zad ①pa dang lha'i bu rnams kyis kyang de'i 'chi rjo'apho ba tshor te/dper na sngon gyi dus su lha'i bu dga' byed ces bya ba/ sum cu rtsa gsum nas mar la ltung ba tshor te/ gar 'pho ba tshor zhe rjon/ yul bā rā ṇa sīr ④phag pa'i phru gur skye bar tshor ro/ /de tshor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis ⑦lha'i bu de yang ngu zhing / lha'i me tog gam lha'i rdzas la sogs pa la lta zhing yang nas yang du sdug bsngal skye'o/ /lus las kyang dri ma 'byung ste/ me tog de kun yang skams so/ /lha'i grogs ⑧po rnams kyis bor te/ 'od kyang med do/ /zhag bdun bar du lha'i longs spyod bor nas/ mi gtsang ba za'o snyam nas yang nas ⑨yang du sdug bsngal dran zhing ngu'o/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin skyed mos tshal du rtsed ⑫mo la 'ongs pas skad mi snyan pa thos te/ de nas de'i rtsar phyin nas/ de nas ⑪lha'i bu de la dris pa dang / lha'i bus smras pa/ lha'i lha zhag bdun pa 'dzam bu'i gling ⑫dbus su/ grong khyer bā rā ṇa sīr ⑫bdag zhag bdun na phag pa'i phru gur skye'o zhes smras so/ /brgya byin kyis smras pa/ lha'i bu dga' ba khyod kyis/ sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun la skyabs su 'gro ba gyis shig /des phan par 'ong ste/ gzhan gyi thabs ni med do zhes gsungs so/ /lha'i bu des de'i gdams ④ngag thos pa dang / skyabs su 'gro ba nyin mtshan med du byas pa dang / zhag bdun gyi nang par gnas gtsang ma'i 36—1601

lhar skyes so/ /lha'i longs spyod dang ldan zhing lha'i bu gser 'od ces bya bar skyes so/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin skyed ①mos tshal du lha'i longs spyod la 'ongs te/ lha'i bu de dran nas lha'i spyan gyis 'dzam bu'i gling du bltas pas/der yang ma mthong ngo / /dmyal ba dang / byol song dang / yi dwags dang /gzhan yang mi'i yul shar lus 'phags po dang / ba lang spyod dang / sgra mi snyan du bltas pa dang / de rnams su yang ma mthong ngo / /de nas rang gi yul dang / lha ma yin dang / rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i lha'i yul dang / ri bdun gyi lha la sogs pa rnams su bltas te/ de rnams na yang ma mthong ngo de nas de rnams su yang nas yang du bltas kyang ma mthong ste/ de ngo mtshar che bas/lho'i 'dzam bu'i gling gi ⑤dbus su/ grong khyer mnyan yod na/ rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin dhigyi kun dga' ra ba na/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya seng ge bzhugs te/ de'i tshe lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis/ lha'i me tog dang / lha'i spos dang / lha rdzas kyi mchod pa khyad par 'phags pa khyer nas/ bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das la lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das lha'i bu dga' ba zhes bya ba 'chi 'phos bunas phag pa'i phru gur skyer 'gro ba'i dus su/ngas gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba byen te/ de'i byin rlabs rjokyis gar skyes cha med pas bdag gis dbang tshad la bltas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau rjoshi ka khyod kyis mthong bar mi 'gyur te/ khyod kyis longs spyod pas ⑦mtho ba'i gnas gtsang ma'i lha'i bu gser 'od ces bya bar skyes so/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin ④gyis bcom ldan 'das la/ lha rdzas kyi mchod pa 36—1602

yang nas yang du byas nas/ yid ches shing ngo mtshar che bar yang nas yang du skyabs su 'gro ba ①byas so/ /de bzhin du rig sngags kyi rgyal mos lha'i 'chi 'pho ba'i sdug bsngal yang 'joms pa'o/ /mi'i sdug bsngal ni/ skye ba dang /rgas pa dang / na ba dang / 'chi ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal yin te/ de yang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo gsang sngags kyi rjes su 'dzin ma'i gzi brjid dang stobs kyis/ 'di 'chang ba tsam kyis sdug bsngal thams cad las bral bar 'gyur ro/ /'gro ba rigs ②drug gi sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal thams cad ④'joms pa'i phyir na/ thugs rjes bskyab pa zhes bya'o/ /byams pa la gnas pa/ thugs rje dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni/ 'gro ba rigs budrug gi sems can la bu gcig pa lta bur byas nas/ de la bsnyen bkur byed cing 'tshe ba'i sems mi skye zhing / khams gsum gyi sems can la de lta bu'i sems bzhag cing byams pa ste/ de bzhin du 'khor ba la gnas pa'i sems can la snying rjes khyab ste/ de ⑤'dod pa'i sems nye bar bzhag pa snying rje'o/ /dga' ba la gnas pa/ btang rjosnyoms la gnas pa'o/ /gshegs kyis zhes bya ba ni/dge ba'i rtsa ba la dga' ba ste/ 'gro ba rigs ⑦drug gi sems can yar la thon pa dang / mun pa mun nag bcom pas dga' ste/ de bzhin du mnyam pa nyid dang / bsgom zhing sems can thams cad la khyad ⑧par med pas na/ btang snyoms so/ /ye shes kyi mchog dang / chos nyid kyis ⑨lha thams cad dang zhes bya ba ni/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin rdo rje lta bu yin te/gang la yod ce ⑩na/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi lta ba'o⑪/ /de'i ye shes ni rig pa'i lha rnams yin te/ rig pa'i lha rnams ni gang zhe na/36—1603

stong chen mo rab tu 'joms ma dang / rma bya chen mo dang / bsil ba'i tshal dang / so sor 'brang ma dang / gsang sngags kyi rjes su 'dzin ma rnams yin no—/ /mtshon pa ni ye shes rnams yin no/ /mtshon byed ni rig ①pa'i lha mo rnams so/ /so so'i ye shes ni/ me long lta bu'i ye shes dang / mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / bya ba nan tan kyi ye shes dang / chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes dang / so sor rtog rjopa'i ye shes dang lnga'o/ /rigs ni rdo rje sdedang /rin po che dang / las dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dang / pad+mo'i 0rigs so—/ /phung po ni rnam ⑤shes dang / tshor ba dang / 'du byed dang /gzugs dang / 'du shes so/ /khams ni nam mkha' dang / chu dang /rlung dang / sa dang / me'o/ /skye mched ni/ rna ba dang / sna dang /lus dang / mig dang / lce'i rang bzhin te/ yid kyi rang bzhin ni stong chen mo rab tu 'joms ma'o/ /zhal gsum gsum/ phyag drug drug /sangs rgyas lnga'i dbu rgyan can/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum pa/ g.yon brkyang bsazhu /pad+ma'i steng na zla ba'i stan la nyi ma'i 'od zer dang bcas pa'o/ /zhal rnams ni khro ba dang / sgeg pa dang / 'dzum pa dang / zhi ba dang / cung zad khro ba'o / /sku mdog ni/ nag po dang / ser po dang / ljang gu dang /dkar po dang / dmar po'o/ /g.yas pa'i zhal rnams ni/ dkar po dang /mthing ga dang / dkar po dang /⑦ dkar ba'o/ /g.yon pa'i zhal rnams ni/dmar po dang / ljang gu dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / mthing ga'o/ /dang po'i phyag gnyis na rdo rje 'dzin zhing / g.yon pa na dril bu dkur brten 36—1604

pa'o—/ /g.yas pa gnyis na ral gri ste/ gsum pa na mda' bsnams pa'o/ /g.yon pa gnyis ①na/ sdigs mdzub zhags pa ste/ gsum pa na gzhu bsnams pa'o—/ /lha mo rnams ni ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du ldan pa ste/ chos nyid ni stong pa nyid do/ /lha mo ni dngos po'i rang bzhin thabs so/ /'byung po thams cad la bka' sprul pa'i gsang sngags kyi bzhi ⑤'di dag ni grub pa'o zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo gsang sngags kyi rjes su 'dzin ma 'di 'byung po thams cad kyi bdag mo/ /gsang sngags kyi tshig gis khams gsum tsam yang 'dar bar byed de/ 'byung po rnams kyis ④mi tshugs so/ /'jig rten dang /'jig rten las 'das pa'i bya ba grub ste/ gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di grub na yang dag pa'i ye shes thob pa'o/ /tshigs su bcad ④pa 'di dag ni grub pa'o zhes bya ba ni/ tshe 'di la yang bkra shis te/ phyi ma yang de bzhin no/ /de bzhin gang bsgrub par 'dod pa yang 'grub ste/ rgyal ba rnams kyis gsungs te the tshom med do/ /gang la ser sna rnam ④chags pa/ /rnam bcom budri ma sel mdzad cing / /zhes bya ba ni/ nga rgyal spangs ④shing 'tshe bar mi byed pa ste/yang dag pa'i ye shes shar nas/ dri ma de yang spong byed pa/ /gang yang grub ste the tshom med/ /thugs zhi ④gnod pa mi mnga' ste/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba ni/ nga rgyal spangs shing 'tshe bar mi byed pa ste—/ de'i sems nye bar bzhag na/ rig sngags 'di ni 'grub ste/ gnyis pa'i sems med pas na/ phum sum tshogs shing bkra shis 'di 'grub pa'o⑨/ /'dren pa gang zhig 'gro ba rnams/ /thar pa'i lam du 'dzud byed cing / /zhes bya ba ni/ theg pa yang dag par bstan pa ste/ mun pa mun nag la ye 36—1605

shes kyi mar me bstan pa'o/ /mtho ris thar pa'i lam 'di ni rgyal ba rnams kyis gsungs pa 'di la ser sna la sogs pa gang yang med do/ /chos rnams thams cad ston pa ste/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba ni/rig sngags 'di ni bstan pas na/ grub par 'gyur te/ gnyis pa'i sems spangs shing gzhi dad pa'i sems kyis 'dir ni bkra shis te the tshom med do/ /ston pa 'gro ba rnams kyis bsten/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /zhes bya ba ni/ gang yang sangs rgyas kyi chos la mos pa skyes na/ byams pa dang /snying rje'i ①sems ni rtag tu bzhag pa ste/ rig sngags 'di la gzhi dad pa bskyed na 'khor ba'i dra ba gcod pa'o/ /gang gis bde ba mnga' mdzad de/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba ni/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'di bor la dge ba'i sems ni yongs su bzung la/ bde ba yang dag thob ste/ gnyis pa'i sems ni mi 'dzin pa/ /bkra shis 'di ni yang dag par thob pa'o/ /skyob pa gang zhig byams pa yi/ /thugs kyi 'gro ba 'di dag kun/ /zhes bya ba ni/ 'khor ba'i sems can la/ de'i sems nye bar bzhag ste/snying rjes ni thams cad la khyab ste/ mun pa'i mun nag bcom pa'o bu gcig bzhin du rtag bskyangs des/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba ni/ 'gro ba ris drug ni mnyam par bzhag ste/ byams pa'i stobs kyis ④skyob pa'i sems bzhag ④nas/ rtag tu sems can la snying rje'i sems dang ldan na/ tshe 'di la bkra shis par 'gyur ro/ /gang zhig 'khor bar 'khor ba yi④/ /sems can kun gyi rten gyur cing / /zhes bya ba ni/ 'khor ba ni ma rig pa ste/ 'khor ba'i ⑤byed pa ni gti mug gis 'khor te/ gti 36—1606

mug gi steng du ser snas bcings te/ ser sna'i steng du zhe sdang byung ngo / /zhe sdang la 'dod chags 'khor ro/ /de'i rting ①la ma rig pa'i snying rje skyes te②/des na 'khor ba'i ④'khor ba zhes brtags rjopa'o/ /de brten ⑤pa/ gcod par byed pa ni/ rig pa ste/ rig pa ni yang dag pa'i ye shes so/ /ye shes de ni rig sngags kyi rgyal mo gsang sngags kyi rjorjes su 'dzin ma'i ngo bo nyid yin te/des 'khor ba rnams 'joms pa'o/ /gling dang dpung gnyen gyur pa ste/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba ni/ de bzhin du de la bsnyen ⑦zhing grub pa ste/ gzhan la snying rje yang dag par skeskye ste/ tshe 'di la bkra shis par 'gyur te/ yang dag par grub pa'o/ /gang zhig chos kun mngon sum gyur/ /gtsang zhing slu ba mi mnga' la/ /zhes bya ba ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i ⑨sangs rgyas rnams kyi bden pa ⑩'di la/ chos la the tshom med de/ lus dang / ngag dang / yid kyi the tshom med pa'i sems ni bzhag par gyur na/ chos kyi rtsa ba yang dag par thob pa'o/ /gsum gtsang gtsang bar mdzad pa ste⑪/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba ni/ brdzun dang / phra ma dang / ngag 'khyal pa dang / tshig rtsub pa dang / gzhan kyi rna bar mi snyan pa'i ngag mi smra ba'o/ /yang na ngag 'khyal pa spangs shing / gzhan la dga' ba'i gtam byin te/ mi dge ba spangs shing dge ba 'di byas na/ tshe 'di la yang bkra shis par 'gyur/ dpa' bo chen po gang skyes pas/ /phun sum tshogs don 'byor 'gyur zhing / /zhes bya ba ni/bdud dang / bdud kyi ris bcom ⑫pa la/ chos skyong ba la ni dpa' ba'i sems dang / brtson 'grus ni yang dag par skye ste/ de bzhin du/ sbyin pa 36—1607

dang / tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang / bsam gtan dang / shes rab kyi phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /don7grub tshogs kyang grub pa ste/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba ni/ de la de bzhin du byas par gyur na/ rig pa 'di yang 'grub ste/ don 'grub cing 'di la the tshom med de/gang yang bkra shis 'di las 'byung ngo / /gang zhig skyes pas sa rnams ni/ /nags tshal bcas pa ①rab g.yos shing / /zhes bya ba ni/ 'di'i chos kyis nyams su myong ba thob pas na/ sa rnams thams cad g.yo zhing 'dar te/de'i gzi brjid kyis sems can thams cad kyang dga' bar 'gyur ro / /khya sems can thams cad dga' ba des①/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur//zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo gsang sngags kyi rjes su 'dzin ma 'di sgrub /na—/ dga' ba smos ci dgos te/ yang dag pa'i byang chub thob pa'o/ /bkra shis shing chos grub par 'gyur ba ste/ tshe 'di dang / phyi ma la yang de bzhin no/ /byang chub snying por gang dag gis/ /sa dag rnam dudrug g.yos gyur cing / /zhes bya ba ni/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten kyi khams kyang 'dar ba ste/ de yang 'di 'grub dupas/ bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pas na/ sa ni de bzhin du g.yo ba'i phyir ro/ /bdud yid mi bder gyur pa des/ /byed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba ni/sangs rgyas rnams kyi byang chub kyi sa gzhi la bzhugs pa'i dus su/ gti mug dang / 'khor bar 'khor ba rnams yid mi dga' ste/ de yang de'i nus pas/mi dga' ba rnams gcod pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi gzi brjid kyis ⑦bkra shis shing bde bar gnas pa'o/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na/ /'phags pa'i 36—1608

bden pa rnams gsung ba/ /①zhes bya ba ni/ yang dag pa'i bden pa bdar te chos kyi 'khor lo lan bdun bskor zhing / de yang gsum du 'dus te/sku'i bden pa dang / gsung gi bden pa dang / thugs kyi bden pa dang /de bzhin du 'dul ba'i ngo bo nyid ④yin te/ de yang 'phags pa rnams kyi lam yin no/ /de yang bden pas na bkra shis par 'gyur te/ the tshom med do/ /'di la gang yang grub pa'o/ /thub pa'i mnyan pa gang byung de①/ /khyed la bde legs byed par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba ni/ yang dag pa'i chos yin te/ chos ni rig sngags kyi rgyal mo de'i phyag rgyas rgyas btab ste/ 'di yis gzi brjid gang byed pa de rjoni bkra shis/ phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /yid rjo'aphrog gang gis mu stegs byed/ /thams cad chos kyis pham mdzad cing / /zhes bya ba ni/lta ba mi gcig pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod de/ de rnams kyang / rtag par lta ba dang / chad par lta ba la bsnyu'o/ /de rnams gang du yang mi gnas shing /chos kyi rang bzhin gsal la bzhag pa'o/ /de yis de 'dul bar byed pas na/mu stegs kyi chos kyang pham par 'gyur ro/ /tshogs kun dbang du mdzad pa de/ /༷da la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba ni/ 'di'i nus pa dang /gzi brjid kyi chos kyi nyams stsong yang dag par skyes te/ de yis de kun 'dul ba'i phyir ro/ /de'i gzi brjid kyis 'dir ni/ bkra bushis shing phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /sangs rgyas khyed la bde legs mdzad/ /brgya byin lhar bcas bde legs dang / /zhes bya ba ni/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can la/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las thar bar byed pa'i bde ba chen po skye bar byed pa ste/ yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi mar me phye bzhin ⑦36—1609

bkra shis par byed do①/ /yang dag pa'i byang chub la 'god ②pa'o/ /de bzhin du lha'i sems can rnams kyang bkra shis par 'gyur te/ lha rnams kyi zhultung ba'i sdug bsngal dang bral ba'o/ /'byung po kun kyang bde legs ni/ /khyed la rtag tu sbyin gyur cig /ces bya ba ni/ rtsang ba med pas sems can la 'tshe ba med de/ 'di'i nus pas 'tshe bar mi byed cing / rtag tu bza' ba dang / btung ba rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /bza' ba la lcags kyi thu lum du mthong ba rnams dang / btung ba la zangs kyi khu bar mthong ba rnams ni④/de dag gis kyang rtag tu mchod pa chen po thob par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu dag dang / /lha rnams kyis ni bsam pa yis/ /zhes bya ba ni/ bsod nams kyi tshogs dang / ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis yin te/bsod nams kyi tshogs ni shākya thub pa bzhin du/ sngon gyi smon lam gyi stobs kyis ⑤yang dag pa'i ye shes thob pa'o/ /ye shes kyi tshogs ni/ ngo bo dang bral zhing / ngag gi brjod du med pa'o/ /de gnyis gzi brjid kyis kyang bkra shis shing bde ba ste/ 'jig rten dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa rnams kyis kyang de bzhin no/ /spyod rnams 'dod don gang yin pa/ /don de de ring grub gyur cig /ces bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo gsang sngags merjes su 'dzin ma 'dis/ dngos grub ⑦thams cad 'grub ④ste/ lha dang / mi dang /'byung po'i tshogs rnams kyang 'di las don grub pa'o/ /rkang gnyis khyed cag bde legs shog /rkang bzhi khyed cag bde legs shog /ces bya ba ni/ mi dang / bya dang / lha dang / 'byung po rkang gnyis pa la sogs pa ste/'dir ni bkra shis shing sdug bsngal dang bral ⑨ba'o/ /rkang bzhi ni/ byol 36—1610

song gi rigs las gyur pa dang / yi dwags dang 'byung po dang / lha rnams yin te/ rig sngags kyi gzi brjid kyis/ de bzhin du bkra shis pa'o/ /khyed cag lam 'gro bde legs shog /phyir 'ong dag kyang bde legs shog /ces bya ba ni/ gang yang lha dang mi dang / 'byung po la sogs pa 'gro ba'i dus su yang bkra shis te/ phyir ldog pa'i dus su yang bkra shis pa'i phyir ro/ /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung la bde legs shog /ces bya ba ni/ nad rnams med cing sdug bsngal dang 'bral ①ba ste/ rmi lam ngan pa dang / ltas ngan pa rnams mi ①mthong zhing / srog dang mi 'bral bar bde zhing bkra shis te/ tshe phyi ma yang de bzhin no/ /khyed cag kun du bde legs shog /khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /ces bya ba ni stong gsum kyi stong chen po ①'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can thams cad kyang bkra shis shing bde ba ste/ rig sngags 'di yang grub pa'o/ /sdig pa thams cad dang bral zhing sngon gyi dus dang / da ltar dang / shes pa dang / mi shes pa 'joms pa'o—/ /sems can kun dang srog chags kun/ /zhes bya ba ni/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can dang / srog chags bde bar 'gyur zhing / yang dag pa'i byang chub thob pa ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan gyi sems can yang de bzhin no/ /'byung po kun dang khyed cag kun / /bde ba 'ba' zhig ldan gyur cig /ces bya ba ni/ 'byung po ni sngon gyi las kyis bde ④ba cung zad kyang med pa dang / bde ba bag tsam yod pa dang / mchog par 'os pa ste/ de bzhin du khyed cag kun kyang / sems can mi gtogs te/ de bzhin du rab 'bring tha ma gsum la gnas nasarjo/36—1611

de kun yang bkra shis shing bde bar gnas te/ yang dag pa'i bde ba thob pa'o//thams cad nad rnams med par shog /kun gyis bzang rnams mthong gyur cig/ces bya ba ni/ 'di la nad rnams kyis mi tshugs te/ nad ①thams cad bcom zhing / bde ba 'ba' zhig la gnas te/ yang na bde ba yang dang yang du thob pa'o/ /gang yang sdig par ma gyur cig /ces bya ba ni/ sngon du byas pa dang / da ltar byas pa'i sdig pa ci byas kyang / 'dir ni mthol lo bshags so zhes bya ba'o/ /'byung po ④gang dag 'dir ni lhags ①gyur cing / /sa dang bar snang dag la gnas pa rnams/ /zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo'i chos 'di la yang byon zhing / sems can la 'tshe bar ni rjomi byed do/ /de bzhin du gang dang gang la gnas pa'i 'byung po rnams kyang sangs rgyas kyi bka' las mi 'das pa'o⑤/ /skye dgu rnams la rtag tu byams byed shog /nyin dang mtshan du chos kyang spyod gyur sbug /ces bya ba ni/ byams pa dang /snying rje dang / dga' ba dang / btang snyoms la 'god pa ste/ gzhan dang byang chub kyi snying po dang / yang dag pa'i ye shes thob par 'gyur te/ de bzhin du shel bzhin du gsal ba ste/ bag chags dang / shes bya'i dri mas ma gos pa/ yang dag par sdogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas 'di dhigasungs pa/gang dang gang du yang 'jig rten kyi khams la spyod cing dar bar shog cig ces pa'o—/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo gsang sngags kyi ⑦rjes su 'dzin pa'i⑧/ grong khyer yangs pa can la 'jug pa'i gnas skabs te gnyis pa'o// //de nas zhes bya ba ni/ grong khyer yangs pa can la 'jug pa'i de nas so/ /36—1612

mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa tshangs ris kyi lha rnams dang bcas pa dang ①zhes bya ba ni/ bsam gtan dang po'i lha ④dang bcas pa rnams byung ste/ tshangs ris dang / tshangs pa mdun na 'don dang / tshangs lha ④nye phan dang /tshangs pa chen po dang bzhi'o/ /de ni bsam gtan dang po'o/ /bsam gtan gnyis pa'i lha rnams byung ste/ 'od chung dang / tshad med 'od dang / 'od gsal dang gsum mo/ /de ni bsam gtan gnyis pa'o/ /bsam gtan gsum pa'i lha rnams kyang byung ste/ dge chung dang / tshad med dge dang /dge rgyas so/ /de ni bsam gtan gsum pa'o/ /bsam gtan bzhi pa'i lha rnams kyang gnas te/ sprin med dang / bsod nams skyes dang / 'bras bu che ba'o/ /de gsum ni bsam gtan bzhi pa'o/ /de yang de'i gnas su 'du shes med pa'i lha gnas so/ /gnas gtsang ma'i lha rnams kyang byung ste/de yang mi che ba dang / mi gdung ba dang / gya nom snang ba dang / shin tu mthong ba dang / 'og min dang lnga'o/ /de yang bsam gtan bzhi pa la gtogs te gzugs kyi khams kyi lha rnams kyang / bcom ldan 'das la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas/ bskor ba lan gsum byas te/ mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pas dbu byas shing phyogs gcig tu bsdad pa'o/ /lha'i dbang po brgya byen sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams dang bcas pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ 'thab bral dang / dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed dang / sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams dang / brgya byin la sogs pa dang thabs cig tu'o/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi rgyal chen bzhi'i lha rnams dang bcas pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ gshol mda' 'dzin dang / gnya' shing 'dzin dang /36—1613

phreng thogs kyi lha rnams dang / lha ma yin la sogs pa/ rgyal chen rigs ①bzhi'i lha dang / shar phyogs kyi rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung dang / lho phyogs kyi rgyal po chen po ⑤'phags skyes po dang / nub phyogs kyi rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang dang / byang phyogs kyi rgyal po lus ngan po la sogs pas dbu mdzad pa dang thabs cig tu'o/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po ①nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang zhes bya ba ni/ dbang po dang / zla ba dang / chu lha la sogs pa'i gnod sbyin kyi ded ④dpon chen po rnams dang thabs cig tu'o/ /'phrog ma bu dang bcas g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa rnams bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste/ lhags nas zhes bya ba ni/ lngas rjortsen dang 'phrog ma'i bu dga' byed la sogs pa brgya dang ngo / /'phrog ma'i bu mtha' ltag rjodabang phyug la sogs pa brgya dang ngo / /'phrog ma'i bu dbu ma khyab 'jug lan ④la sogs pa brgya dang ngo / /'phrog ma'i bu gang ba dang 'og la sogs pa brgya dang ngo / /'phrog ma'i bu skye dgu dag la sogs pa brgya ste lnga brgya dang bcas pa thabs cig go/ /nag po dang / nag mo dang / grul bum dang / dung la sogs pa so so'i 'khor dang bcas te/ grong khyer yangs pa can gyi a 'bras kyi tshal na so so'i kha dog bstan zhing rdzu 'phrul yang de bzhin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te zhes bya ba ni/ lan gsum ④bskor ba bya ba ⑨nas/lha so so'i mchod rdzas bla na med pas ⑩bcom ldan 'das la mchod par byas te/bcom ldan 'das dang 'khor phun sum tshogs pa'i mdun du thabs cig tu bzhugs pa'o/ /phyogs gcig 'khod de zhes bya ba ni/ so sor mi smra zhing mgrin pa gcig gis smras pa'o/ /phyogs gcig tu 'khod nas mi mjed kyi 36—1614

bdag po tshangs pas zhes bya ba ni/ mi mjed kyi bdag po yin te/ stong spyi phud kyi bdag po 'khor de rnams kyi dbu byas shing bcom ldan 'das la zhu ba phul ba'o—/ /bcom ldan ①ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de zhes bya ba ni—/ mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pas gus par byas shing / bcom ldan 'das kyi mdun du'o/ /bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to zhes bya ba ni/ de rnams kyis ④phyogs gcig tu smras te/ phyogs gcig tu skad cig tu tshangs pas smras pa'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag ni zhes bya ba ni/gzugs kyi khams dang / 'dod pa'i khams dang / bgegs kyi bdag po rnams yin te/ de bzhin bdag cag bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar mchis so zhes pa'o/ /stong gi 'jig rten kyi khams rnams su zhes bya ba ni/ bsam gtan bzhi pa stong / bsam gtan gsum pa stong / bsam gtan gnyis pa stong / bsam gtan dang po stong / de bzhin du so sor bgrangs pa ④stong stong brtsi ste/ de ni gzugs kyi khams kyi rtsi lugs so/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed stong / 'phrul dga' stong /rjo 'thab bral stong / sum cu rtsa gsum stong / rgyal chen rigs bzhi stong / rim pa bzhin du lha'i rigs ⑤drug ni 'dod pa'i khams la de bzhin du stong stong brtsi bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du ri rab kyang yin te/ nyi ma dang / zla ba dang / skar ma la sogs pa'o/ /shar gyi lus 'phags stong / lho'i 'dzam bu gling stong / nub kyi ba lang spyod stong /byang gi sgra mi snyan stong / de bzhin rjotsha ba'i dmyal ba dang / grang ba'i dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dwags rnams yin te/ de ni 'dod pa'i khams kyi stong rtsi lugs so/ /gzugs med kyi khams kyang de bzhin du yin no/ /36—1615

dbang phyug chen po la dbang bgyid pa lags te zhes bya ba ni/ stong spyi phud kyi khams la dbang mdzad pa'o/ /yang na de ni stong spyi phud kyi 'jig rten gyi khams yin te/ mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa chen po dbang sdud mdzad pa'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag ni 'tshal na/ stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams rnams su srung bar bgyid ces bya ba ni/ tshangs pas dbu mdzad cing / lha dang / 'byung po rnams kyis kyang phan par byed pa dang / gnod par byed pa'i nges tshig bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar tshig zhus pa'o/ /srung bar bgyid ces pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba'o/ /yongs su skyob par bgyid cing ①/ yongs su gzung ba dang / zhi ba dang / bde legs su 'gyur bar bgyid lags so zhes bya ba ni/ bkra shis shing sems can thams cad la bde bar gnas par byas pa'o/ /btsun pa zhes bya ba ni/'dod pa'i yon tan lnga spangs shing / tshul khrims la sogs pa bsrungs ⑤te/sems can thams cad kyi don la sprul pa'i skus khyab pa'o/ /bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi mnga' bdag ces bya ba ni/ bag chags kyi sgrib pa dang / shes bya'i sgrib pas ma gos te/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis mi gos shing / lus dang ngag dang / yid bde ba ste/ de bzhin du gti mug dang / zhe sdang dang /'dod chags dang / ser sna dang / phrag dog rnams kyis mi tshugs shing bde bar gshegs te/ lus pa med pas na bde bar gshegs pa ste/ de bas na c-ichos rang bzhin ni dngos po med cing rnyog pa med pa ste/ rang bzhin med cing / rtag chad gnyis dang bral te/ brjod pas kyang mi khyab pa ste/ nam mkha' bzhin du sems can thams cad la khyab pas na/ dbang phyug ces bya'o/ /36byed1616

bcom ldan 'das ni stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams rnams su dbang phyug la mnga' mdzad pa lags te zhes bya ba ni/ bzhi bcom skal ba ①dang ldan pa ste/ ri rab la sogs pa 'jig rten gyi khams 'di stong stong brtsi ste/de ni stong spyi phud kyi 'jig rten gyi khams yin no/ /de bzhin du nyis 'gyur du brtsis ⑤pa ni stong bar ma'o/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams ni/ de de'i sum 'gyur du brtsis pa ni stong gsum mo/ /chen po ni sems can thams cad bsam gyis ①mi khyab pa'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams ni mnyam por gzigs shing mnyam por bsten ④te/ dge sdig la sogs pa gnas shing sems can gnas pa'o/ /de la sprul pa'i skus khyab ste/ sems can rigs pyami gcig pa'i phyir na rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs bstan pa'o/ /yang na sems can gyi don la der dbang mdzad de/ theg pa sna tshogs bstan zhing yang dag pa'i byang chub kyi lam bstan pa'o/ /de ni tshangs pa'i tshig dhigo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyang bzhed na zhes bya ba ni byams pa dang / snying rje dang / dga' ba dang / btang snyoms bsgom zhing sems can rnams kyi don mdzad pa'o/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams rnams su zhes bya ba ni/ sprul pa'i skus kyang skad cig thang cig yud tsam gyis kyang / sems can gyi don mdzad pa'o/ /bsrung ba dang / yongs su bskyab pa dang / yongs su gzung ④ba dang / zhi ba dang / bde legs su 'gyur bar mdzad pa lags na zhes bya ba ni/ mi dge ba bcu la 'gro bar bluyang srung ste mtho ris kyi lam bstan pa'o/ /'khor ba'i 'jigs pa dang / 'jig rten dang da ltar byung ba rnams kyi ⑨'tshe ba dang / ngan song gsum las 'thon ⑩par byed pa'o/ /mi dge ba bcu la 36—1617

'gro ba yang bzung ste/ de las ldog ①nas dge ba bcu la ②'jug pa'o/ /dper na shing skam po 'gugs te/ khengs pa'i rang bzhin thabs kyis 'gugs pa bzhin du/ khengs pa khro bo'i rigs kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi gzi brjid kyis kyang 'dul bar byed pa'o/ /yang na zhi ba ni bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun gyi byin rlabs ①kyis zhi bar byed pa'o/ /sdug bsngal dang bral zhing / bde ba la bkod de/ yang dag pa'i ye shes thob par byed pa'o—/ /yang na 'jig rten gyi khams 'di larjo/ lus dang / ngag dang /yid bde zhing phun sum tshogs pa ⑤yi dwags rnams kyis kyang 'tshe bar mi byed pa'o//mdzad lags na zhes bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das la tshangs pas yang nas yang du zhus pa'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das zhes bya ba ni/ lan gcig mngon lcedu zhugs te/ lan gnyis pa ni da ltar zhu ste⑦/ phyi ma yang zhus pa'o/ /lan gcig lan gnyis lan gsum du/ tshangs pa rnams kyis sgeyang dang yang du zhus pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa la cang mi gsung bas kyeganang ngo zhes bya ba ni/ de nas ni tshangs pas smras pa'i de nas so/ /sems can rnams la dmigs nas rig sngags kyi rgyal mo gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin ma zhal nas byung ste/ saṃ gyi ⑩yi ge'i rang bzhin las nam mkha' bzhin du khyab pa/ 'od zer sna tshogs pa 'phros nas⑪/ 'gro ba rigs ⑩drug gi sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal dang bral ⑫ba dang / stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa/ ngo bo dang bral zhing gang gis brjod du med pa de ni bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i zhal nas byung ngo / /zhal bzhi pa/ phyag brgyad pa/ sku mdog dmar mo/ gzhon nu'i cha byad can/36—1618
