phyed kyis mdzes pa la/ /mu tig phreng bcas rnam ①par brgyan/ /rin chen lnga yi gzhal sneyas khang / /mdzes pa de ni mkhas pas bri/ /dang po nam mkha' rlung chags pa/ /me dang chu dang sa chags te/ /de bzhin ri rab rtse mo la /pad+ma'i steng du rgya gram ste/ /'og dang steng dang logs rnams su/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i gur du bsam/ /de ④phyir rdo rje'i ra rjob la/ /rlung dang me sa'i yul du 'khyam/ /phyi rgya kho ra khor yug dang / /de rtsar mda' yi dra ba 'bar /de phyir 'og dang steng dag dang rjo/ /phyogs bzhi mtshams su me yis bskor/ /'og ni rdo rje'i sa gzhi ste/ /de steng rdo rje bla res brgyan/ /de 'og rdo rje sa gzhi la/ /gzhal yas khang gi ④dbus su shes/ /dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma ste/ /phyir ni 'khor lo ⑦rtsibs brgyad do/ /de phyir lha snam zlum po ⑧ste/ /gza' dang rgyu skar gnas pa'o/ /phyi rol lha snam ⑨gru bzhi la/ /phyogs skyong yang ni der gnas so/ /shar dang lho dang nub dang ni/ /byang gi sgo bzhi dang po la/ /rgyal po bzhi yang der bzhugs so/ /dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma la/ /ye shes lha mo lnga yang bzhugs/ /mtshams bzhi pad+ma stong pa la/ /mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi gnas so/ /dbus su lte ba zla ba'i gdan/ /gsang sngags 'dzin ma der bzhugs so/ /dkyil 'khor gyi bya thabs so/ /rig sngags bum pa lnga po ste/ /mtshan ⑩ma ldan zhing nag po med/ /rtsa ba yangs pa mchu 'phyang ⑪ba/ /dbyibs ni legs shing lto ba che/ /de lta bu yi mtshan ldan la/ /a ka ru 'am gu gul bdug par bya/ /rin chen lnga dang 'bru lnga dang / /dri lnga sman lnga de bzhin te/ /'bras bu can gyi shing lnga yi/ /lo mas kha la rnam par brgyan/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang snying po lnga/ /de bzhin mgul chings gdugs kyis brgyan/ /36—1669

rim bzhin dkyil 'khor dgod par bya/ /yan lag dang ni gtor ma dang / /bdag gis 'dir ni ma bshad de/ /gzhan la ltos la shes par gyis/ /rdo rje slob dpon dge slong gis/ /kha zas dkar po bsten ①nas su/ /cho ga yang dag bsam par kyis/ /khengs pa sped cing nga rgyal spang ⑧/ /nyon mongs shas ni mi che zhing / /byams dang ①snying rje dga' ba dang / /btang snyoms la ni yang dag 'jug /yi ge bzhi pa'i sngags kyis ni/ /dgug bupa gzhug pa bcing ba dang / /ye shes lha ni dgyes par 'gyur/ /srom mkhan la sogs bsang rjogator bya/ /bsnyen pa cho ga yang dag bzung ༷/ /mchod bstod ⑦la sogs byas nas su/ /thun gtor la sogs gtang bar bya/ /phyogs skyong bcu dang rgyal po dang / /gza' dang skar ma 'byung po rnams/ /rjes mthun gtor ma byin nas su/ /de la mchod pa bstod pa bya/ /rdo rje slob dpon bka' drin gyis—/ /nad pa yul 'khor yang dag bsrung / /sems can la ni snying rje'i phyir—/ /rim gro'i cho ga yang dag bshad/ /de ni dkyil 'khor byed pa'i khruthabs so/ /'khor lo rim pa bcu bris la/ /sngar bshad las kyi snying po dgod//phyi rol 'khor lo'i ra ba la/ /phyag mtshan phyag rgya dgod pa ste⑨/ /mnyam gzhag byang chub mchog dang ni/ /chos 'chad skyab ⑩sbyin mchog sbyin dang / /sa gnon chos sbyin phyag skor ba/ /bum rten rdo rje rin chen dang / /ral gri'i steng na rdo rje dang / /de bzhin pad+ma de bzhin no/ /'khor lo lcags kyu rdo rje dang / /de bzhin 'khor lo'i phyag rgyas bskor/ /pad+ma'i steng na phyag mtshan gnas—/ /sdong bu dar gyis bcings pa la/ /rgyas par yang ni bri bar bya/ /'khor lo gnyis po ⑪zlum po la/ /pad+ma rdo rje yang dag bri/ /bde bar gsang 36—1670

sngags yi ge dgod par bya/ /de nang gsum po mu khyud la/ /sngar bshad sngags kyis bskor bar bya①/ /de nang mu khyud gcig pu la/ /'khor lo'i rim pa de bzhin shes/ /'khor lo'i nang du mu khyud de/ /sngar bshad sngags ni bri ba'ol—/ /de yi nang na 'khor lo la/ /pad+ma'i ra ba shes pa'o/ /'khor lo'i lte 1bar mu khyud dang / /snying po yi ni sngags bzhin no/ /lte sngags yi ge bri ba sterka/ /blo dang ldan pas bri bar bya/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo gsang sngags kyi rjes su 'dzin pa'i rjodakyil 'khor dang / srung ba'i 'khor lo bshad pa'i gnas skabs te bdun pa'o // //rjoyongs su bskyab pa dang zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bka' dang / rig sngags kyi bden pa dang / srung ba de rnams kyis kyang / sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral zhing bde bar gnas te/srung ba des yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa'o/ /'byung po thams cad bzlog par bya'o zhes bya ba ni bden pa 'dis lha'i gdon la sogs pa thams cad kyis mi tshugs shing / bde bar buganas shing 'jigs pa med par gnas pa'o—/ /gzi brjid 'phrog pa rnams bzlog par bya'o zhes bya ba ni/ ma rungs pa'i byis pa'i gdon rnams yin te/ ma'i mngal nas 'dzin zhing /skyes nas lo bcu gnyis bar du 'dzin pa'o/ /de'i phyir na sems can la gzi byin ⑦'phrog pa yin te/ bden pa de yis bde bar gnas shing / mngal na yang 'di lta ste/ skyes nas kyang bde ba'o/ /lo bcu gnyis nas kyang bde bar 'gyur ro/ / bden pa dang ⑧bden pa'i tshig ces bya ba ni/ yang dag par 36—1671

rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bka' dang / rig sngags kyi bden pas bde bar gnas te the tshom med de①/ gang gis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes bya ba ni/ 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams yin te/'das pa rnams ni mar me mdzad la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ ma ②'ongs pa rnams kyang de bzhin du byams pa la sogs pa'o/ /da ltar yod pa'i shākya thub pas kyang bdud bzhi bcom nas ston par byas pa'o/ /ngas 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug zad par bya ba'i phyir ni pezhes bya ba ni/'dod chags ni phung po'i bdud de/ zhe sdang ni nyon mongs pa'i bdud do/ /gti mug ni 'chi bdag gi bdud yin te/ de 'joms pa ni lha'i bu'i bdud do//sangs rgyas rnams kyis bdud bzhi bcom zhing / 'khor ba ma lus par bcom zhing chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'o/ /chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong bstan pa dang zhes bya ba'i ④bdud bzhi bcom nas/ sems can gyi don la/ sprul pa'i skus khyab nas chos ston pa'o/ /bshad pa dang brjod pa'i zhes bya ba ni/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong bstan nas/ sku mya ngan las 'das pa'o/ /de yang sems can gyi don la yin no/ /bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig des ming 'di zhes bya ba'i nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zad par gyur cig ces bya ba ni/ de bzhin du de'i bden pas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad bde bar 'gyur zhing / nad thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /nad med par gyur cig /zhi bar gyur cig /rab tu zhi bar gyur cig ces bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin pa 'dis/ nad thams cad 'joms ⑤par byas 36—1672

teske/ gdon thams cad brlag par byas nas/ rlung dang / bad kan dang /mkhris pa dang / 'dus pa dang ldan pa la sogs pa'i nad rigs mi gcig pa bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi bcom nas/ nad pa rnams la ①bde bar gnas par byed pa'o//bden pa sde'adi yis kyang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ①'bras bu thob pa'o—/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin ma'i bden pa'i tshig gis nad pa gso ba'i gnas skabs te brgyad pa'o // //rjode skad ces bka' stsal nas zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rjogasang sngags rjes su 'dzin ma'i tshig 'di bka' 6) pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos/ btsun pa de bzhin bgyi'o zhes bya ba gsol to zhes bya ba ni/kun dga' bos thugs su chud nas/ gro ga 'am/ shing shun nam/ ras la bris nas rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags te zhes bya ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar mnyan nas/ yangs pa'i grong khyer du song ste zhes bya ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos sems can thams cad dang / yangs pa can gyi sems can rnams kyi/ mi nad dang / phyugs nad dang / mu ge dang / chos rnams kyang bshad du mi rjobatub cing / ma rungs pa 'byung po rnams kyis khyer ba'i phyir ro/ /sgo yi them pa la rkang pa bzhag nas zhes bya ba ni/ grong khyer yangs pa can gyi dbus su yul lha'i them pa la gnas ④nas/ rig sngags kyi nga rgyal byas nas/ rgyal mtshan lag na thogs nas/ seng ge'i sgra bsgrags ⑧so/ /gsang sngags kyi gzhi 'di dag dang / tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag kyang smras so zhes bya ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo'i zhal nas/ nyi ma ⑨stong phrag brgya 36—1673

shar ba bzhin du/ 'od zer ①re res rig sngags kyi rgyal mo gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin ma khro bo'i ⑤tshul gyis bsam gyis ①mi khyab pa 'phros te/ grong khyer yangs pa can du zhugs pa'i lha 'dre rnams de'i 'od zer gyi khro bos lha 'dre rnams phyir phyung ste/ rig sngags kyi dmod mos mi theg rjopas gzugs sna tshogs ston cing bros so/ /rig rjosngags kyi tshig ni/ bi sa ra ta/ bi sa ra ta/ zhes pa la sogs pa las so⑥/ /de'i sngags yungs kar bsres la ⑦phyogs bzhir gtor bas lha 'dre thams cad kyis mi tshugs so/ / nir gats+tsha ta nir gats+tsha ④ta la sogs pa'i sngags kyis/ seng ldeng gi me phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhir sbar la mtshams bzhi nas blangs la/ yungs kar dang / skye tshe dang / shing tsher ma can bsres la me'i nang du gtor ro/ /phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhi nas chu gtor ro⑨—/ /de na zhugs ⑩pa'i 'byung po rnams kyis ⑫mi tshugs shing ⑫'byung ngo / /sum su la sogs pa'i sngags kyis srung skud sna lnga bsngags shing mdud pa bor te/de bsrung ⑫bar byas na nad thams cad kyis mi tshugs shing / 'byung po rnams kyang 'bros so/ /su mu ru su mu ru zhes bya ba'i sngags ni rig sngags kyi snying po bstan to/ /de yang pad+ma'i rigs kyi lam ④rigs so/ /mtshon pa ni bya ba nan tan kyi ye shes sospyo/ /mtshon byed ni rig sngags kyi bdag nyid do/ /phung po ni 'du byed kyi phung po ste/ khams ni rlung ⑩gi khams so/ /skye mched ni lus kyi skye mched do/ /ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin/ sangs rgyas lnga'i dbu ⑩rgyan can/spyan gsum pa sku mdog ljang gu/ zhal gsum pa/ phyag drug pa/ zhal g.yas dkar ba/ g.yon dmar ba'o/ /phyag g.yas pa gsum na/ ral gri dang / rdo rje rgya gram dang / skyabs sbyin no/ /g.yon gsum na bsnams pa ni/36—1674

'khor lo dang / zhags pa dang / rdo rje'o/ /zhabs g.yas brkyang ba/g.yon bskum pa/ pad+ma'i steng na zla ba'i gdan la nyi ma'i 'od dang ldan pa/'dzum pa'i zhal dang ldan par bzhugs so/ /rig sngags kyi rigs ni gang zhe na/'di lta ste/ su mu ru su mu ru la sogs pa'o/ /de dag sngags rnams grub par 'gyur—/ /zhes bya ba ni/ gsang sngags kyi bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa la sogs pa'o/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin rlabs ①dang / rig sngags gsang sngags rnams kyis skebyin brlabs pa①/ rnam par dag pa 'di 'das pa dang /ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar yod pa rnams kyi bka' dang / rig sngags kyi chos rjobaden pas/ grong khyer yangs pa can srung zhing skyob pa dang / sba ba dang /zhi ba dang / bde legs su 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin ma bka' 6) to rjozhes bya ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dang zhes bya ba ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje la sogs pa/bye ba khrag khrig stong phrag brgyad dodhi/ /nyan thos kyang de bzhin du ④shā ri'i bu la sogs pa nyis brgya lnga bcu dang ngo / /gzhan yang dge slong pha'am/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen ⑧pha'am/ dge bsnyen ⑨ma la sogs pa mang po dang thabs cig tu'o/ /mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ tshangs ris kyi lha rnams dang / gzugs kyi khams kyi lha rnams dang thabs cig go/ /lha dang zhes bya ba ni/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin sum cu rtsa gsum kyi lha rnams dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / rgyal chen bzhi'i lha rnams dang zhes bya ba ni—/ lha ma yin gyi rgyal po thags zangs ⑫ris la sogs pa lha ma yin mang po 36—1675

dang / gnod sbyin kyi ded ①dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang ②/ dri zar bcas pa'i zhes bya ba ni/ dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa g.yog du ma dang bcas pa dang 'phrog ma bu dang bcas pa/ g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang ①/'jig rten yi rangs te zhes bya ba ni/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do zhes bya ba ni/ byang chub sems dpa' dang / nyan thos dang / dge slong pha dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen pha dang / dge bsnyen ma dang /lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin la sogs pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin ma'i grong khyer yangs pa can na zhugs pa'i 'byung po rnams phyir btang ba'i phyir buganas skabs te dgu pa'o// //pad+ma'i rigs lnga bstan pa'i brtags rjopa ste gnyis pa rdzogs so // //rjorig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo ⑦gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin ma'i mdo'i 'bum 'grel ④slob dpon chen po las kyi rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rig sngags kyi rgyal mo gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin ma'i mdo'i 'bum 'grel paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas pa chen po mi mnyam rdo rje'i sras/ paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rjes/jo mo sgol mas zhabs kyis bcags pa/ tshangs pa'i 'byung gnas rdo lung dgon par rang 'gyur mdzad pa'o// //⑨'di bsgyur bsod nams gang thob pa⑩/ /de yis khams ⑩srid gsum du ni/ /gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin ma yi⑫/ /dngos grub go 'phang myur thob ⑪shog/ //36—1676

〈〈snar 〉〉bcom/1673 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wal/ ②〈〈pe〉sko〈snar 〉〉 ni/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉kyis/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉// me〈〈snar 〉〉po/du〈〈snar 〉〉bang / ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉panan/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉gsags/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉pa'i/1674 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉sngagazer/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ba'i/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉wagyis/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉thegs/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉〉rigs/ du〈〈pe 〉dze'adir 〉〉sga'o/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉〈/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉nirgats+tsha ta nirgats+tsha/ ⑨〈〈snar 〉〉waro/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bzhugs/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉kyi/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉 phyir/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉sung /④〈〈pe〉〉〈snar 〉〉〉mo/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉te/ ⑩〈〈snar 〉〉rgyang / ⑫〈〈snar 〉〉bu/1675 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉kyi byin brlabs/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉nyakyi/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanang / du〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉 kyis / ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉yo/ bu〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉brgya dang ngo / ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉no/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sten/ ⑨〈〈snar 〉〉snyen/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉thag zangs/ 〈〈snar 〉〉thag bzangs/1676 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉sde/ ②②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉 ngo// du〈〈pe〉྾〈snar 〉〉waphyir/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉brtagadu〈〈pe 〉ska/ // 〈〈snar 〉ska / ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wachen mo/ ⑧〈〈snar 〉torabrel/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stadza//⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pas/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pakhas/ tu)〈〈snar 〉stanas/ tuge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉du/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1527)36wa 1685

༄ga /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo bathal ba'i tshal gyi mdo'i 'bum 'grel zhes bya ba/①༄tsho/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā shī ta ba ti bibyā ②rā dza sru t+t+waṃ ti ⑧sa ha ra ṣa ṭī kā nā ma/ bod skad du/ rig dhisngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo ⑤bsil ba'i tshal kyi mdo'i 'bum 'grel rjozhes bya ba/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo bsil ba'i tshal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bder gshegs yang dag rdzogs pa'i sku/ /skyon gyis ma gos yongs rdzogs pa/ /gzhan yang sems can don mdzad de/ /thub pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsil ba'i tshal gyi mdo sde 'di/ /yang dag bsams la ston byed pa/ /rab rib kyis ni mi shes pa'i/ /bdag gi ⑦bsams la yang dag bshad/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na zhes bya ba ni/ 'di skad ces bya ba ni/ sgo skur dang bral ba'o/ /bdag gis thos pa zhes bya ba ni kun dga' bos so/ /grogs med dam zhe na/ nyan thos la sogs pa dang thabs cig tu thos pa'o/ /su la thos na/ bcom ldan 36—1686

'das la'o/ /gang thos na bsil ba'i tshal gyi mdo 'di thos pa'o/ /sus thos na kun dga' bos thos pa'o/ /dus gcig na zhes bya ba'i sgra ni don gnyis la 'jug ste/ sdud pa po shes rab che bar go ba dang / dam pa'i chos 'byung ba dkon pa'i don to/ /ston pa ni bcom ldan 'das so/ /bcom ldan 'das zhes bya ba ni/ bcom pa ni bzhi bcom/ bzhi ni dgra'o/ /dgra ni bdud bzhi'o—/ /bdud bzhi ni phung po'i bdud dang / nyon mongs pa'i bdud dang /'chi bdag gi bdud dang / lha'i bu'i bdud dang stibazhi'o/ /gang gi dus na bcom zhe ②na/ rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs pa'i dus so/ /ldan pa zhes bya ba ni/ skal ba ④dang ldan pas na/ bcom ldan no/ /'das zhes bya ba ni/ mya ngan las 'das pa'o/ /'das pa ni gang gi dus she na/ dpyid zla ra ba'i gnam stong gi nub mo'o/ /rgyal po'i khab ces bya ba ni/ dan ta ka'i grong khyer dang / ka ling ka'i grong khyer dang / ma ga ta'i megrong khyer dang gsum po ④yod pa las/ ma ga ta'i bugrong khyer na/ drang srong sgom chen gcig dze+eyod pa las—/ byis pa gcig ⑧gis gnod pa byas pas/ drang srong gi kha nas me byung bas—/ grong khyer gsum po tshig pas dur khrod gsum du gyur/ de'i tshe lha'i bu shed las skyes dang / shed bu grogs gnyis byung ste/ 'jig rten gyi mi rnams byung ste/ dang po sa'i bcud za/ gnyis pa bdud rtsi'i zhag za/gsum pa myu gu za/ bzhi pa 'bras sā ⑨lu'i ljang pa za ba la/ sems can de rnams ma mthun nas/ sems can de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag cag tshogs shing 'dus pa la/ bdag cag gi nang nas sems can lhag par gzugs bzang ba/ lhag par lta na sdug pa/ lhag par mdzes pa/ lhag 36—1687

par bsod nams che bar grags ①pa gang yin pa de ni/ bdag cag gi zhing rnams kyi bdag por bskos ②dang / des bdag cag chad pa gcad gapar bya ba ni chad pas gcod par 'gyur/ phan gdags par bya ba rnams la phan 'dogasaske/ bdag cag gi zhing dag las 'khrungs pa gang yin pa de las/ de /4 chos bzhin du thog shas sbyin par bya'o zer nas/ de rnams kyi nang nas lhag par gzugs bzang ba/ lhag par mdzes pa/ lhag par bsod nams che bar grags pa gang yin pa de zhing rnams kyi bdag por bskos te/ 'di skad ces kye sems can khyod tshur shog /kho bo cag las chad pa ⑤gcad par 'os pa rnams la chad pa chod cig phan gdags par bya ba rnams la ni phan thogs shig /kho bo cag gi zhing dag las 'khrungs pa gang yin pa de las/ khyod la kho bo cag gis chos bzhin du thog shas sbyin no/ /des de rnams la chad pa gcod rjopar bya ba la ni chad pa gcod/ phan gdags par bya ba rnams la ni phan 'dogs par byed cing de la de rnams kyi zhing dag las 'khrungs pa gang yin pa de las/ chos bzhin du thog shas 'bul te/ skye bo'i tshogs chen pos bkur zhing / skye bo'i tshogs chen po mang ⑦pos bkur bas mang pos bkur ba zhes grags so/ /zhing de rnams kyi bdag por gyur pa na/ nyams pa las skyo bar ④byed pas rgyal rigs rgyal rigs zhes bya bar grags so/ /chos kyis mgu bar byed cing /tshul khrims nyams su blangs te gnas/ shes rab nyams su blangs te gnas pas/rgyal po rgyal po zhes bya bar grags so/ /mi rnams ni ⑨bsod nams rtag ⑩par bya ba'i phyir/ 'bras sā lu ⑪ljang pa dgos ⑫so/ /'jag ma'i spyil bo la me mi gtang ⑫ba'i khrims bcas so/ /de nas dus nam zhig na rgyal po'i btsun mos 36—1688

me shor bas rgyal po na re rang gi khrims rang gis bshig tu mi btub pas/ bya rgod phung po'i ri'i nub phyogs su nga'i khyim cig rtsigs shig gsungs so①/ /de nas brtsigs pas/ nyin mo brtsigs pa nub mo zhig pa la/ rgyal po'i zhal nas nga bsod nams khyad par du 'phags pa yin pas/ phyogs bzhir rgyal po'i khab yin no/ /bris shig gsungs pas/ phyogs bzhir rgyal po'i khab yin no zhes bris pas/ mi ma yin gyi gnod pa zhi'o/ /de nas pho brang bai ḍūr+ya zhes ④bya bar kyang grags so/ /rgyal po'i khab kyi tshad ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /bya rgod phung po'i ri zhes bya ba ni/ gzhal yas khang ngo / /ci'i phyir gzhal yas khang zhe na/ sangs rgyas rabs bdun bzhugs nas chos gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /bya rgod phung po'i ri ni brtsegs pa'o/ /ci'i phyir brtsegs she na/ rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa'i phyir ro/ /gser dang / dngul dang / pad+ma rā ga dang / in+d+ra nī la'o/ /ri rab de de bzhin du brgyan pas gzhal yas khang ngo //ri rab de'i tshad ni 'di lta ste/ mtho ba zlum pa/ gnam 'phang ④dang /rgyar yangs pa/ lo tog thams cad kyi ④sa 'dzin me tog dang / phreng ba dang /spos rnam pa sna tshogs dang ldan pa'o/ /dge slong nyis brgya lnga bcu'i dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang zhes bya ba ni/ nyan thos chen po rab tu mang po thams cad dgra bcom pa/ zag pa zad pa/ srid par kun du sbyor ba/ chad pa/yang dag pa'i ye shes sems shin tu rnam par grol ba/ rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs dang /cho 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ rnam par 'phrul pa'i mthu chen po thob pa/lta ba chags pa med pa/ thams cad kyang dri ma dang bral ba/ kun nas nyon mongs pa'i bag chags kyi sa bon bsregs pa sha stag la 'di lta ste/ tshe dang ldan 36—1689

pa shā ri'i bu dang / tshe dang ldan pa byams ma'i bu gang po dang / tshe dang ldan pa ka pi na dang / tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor dang / tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po dang / tshe dang ldan pa skul byed dang / tshe dang ldan pa dga' byed dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'od srungs dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'od srungs chen po dang / tshe dang ldan pa lteng rgyas 'od srungs dang / de dag la sogs pa nyan thos rab tu mang po dang / dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang /dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri za la sogs pa ①mang po 'dus pa'o/ /thabs cig tu zhes bya ba ni/'khor de dag dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams yin te/ byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi thams cad kyang skye ba gcig gis thogs pa/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa mthu chen po thob pa/ rdo rje chen po'i rnam par thar pa dang /ting nge 'dzin gyis ②sangs rgyas kyi zhing du rnam par 'phrul ①pa dang / cho 'phrul chen po kun du ston pa dang / sems kyis skad cig thang cig yud tsam cig la sems can thams cad kyi sems dang / spyod pa'i rjorjes su 'jug pa'i chos bstan pa sna tshogs mnyam pa nyid mnyam zhing rgya che la zab pa dang / spobs pa dang / cho 'phrul dang ldan pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing du mar de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa chen po'i sprin gyis mchod pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo dang /gzungs dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / dbang dang / mngon par shes pa dang / ma 'dres pa dang / byang chub kyi rjoyan lag dang / lam dang /sa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsdu ba'i dngos po dang / byams pa 36—1690

dang / snying rje dang dga' ba dang / btang snyoms dang / byams pa'i stobs dang / dbe+en pa dang / yongs su byang ba'i sems kyi rgyun dang ldan pa sha stag la 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa'i snying po dang / nam mkha'i snying po dang / phyag na rdo rje dang / 'jig rten dbang phyug/ dang / sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba dang / kun du bzang po dang / nyi ma grags pa dang / zla ba'i grags pa dang / rdo rje'i snying po dang /rdo rje grags dang / 'jam dpal grags dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa la sogs pa bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi dang thabs cig tu'o/ /bzhugs te zhes bya ba ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya seng ges 'dir chos kyi 'khor lo shin tu bskor ba dang /sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa shin tu yongs su rdzogs par mthar phyin pa dang /bsod nams dang / ye shes kyi tshogs ni shin tu yongs su rdzogs①/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi byang chub chen po'i phyir pha rol tu phyin pa dang / sa mnyes pa ni shin tu yongs su gzung ⑤/ rin po che rdo rje ①pad+ma'i snying po seng ge'i khri la ni bzhugs te/ seng ge'i khri ni gang zhe na/ sngon kyi smon lam gyi stobs kyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang du gshegs pa'i sa na yod pa'o/ /rin po che dang / rdo rje pad+ma'i khri bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri mdzes pa dang / rin po che dang / mu tig dang / dril bu g.yer ka'i dra ba du ma si li si dhili'i sgra 'byung badhi/ rdo rje dang / rin po che du ma'i stegs bu la/ rtsa ba bulegs par brten pa/ rdo rje dang / rin po che du ma'i chu srin gyi kha nas byung ba'i mu tig dmar po'i phreng ba dang / 'dab ma'i rnam rten bcug pa/ rin po che du 36—1691

ma'i pad+ma'i snying po la chags pa'i rin po che ke ke ru dang / ke ke ru chen po dang /in+d+ra be+e la dang / in+d+ra nī la chen po dang / mdun nas 'od zer chen po bar snang la khyab pas kun du mdzes pa dang / rin po che dang / rdo rje'i thur mas brgyan pa'i gdugs yu bas bstod pa bye ba ①khrag khrig 'bum phrag du mas grib mar bsgribs shing bskyabs pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing du mas brgyan par mdzes pa—/ rdo rje rin po che'i khri bya rgod kyi phung po'i rtse mo la bzhugs te/ gser gyi ri bo'i rgyal po ltar dpal ni 'bar/ sa phyogs ni nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od zer gyi dkyil 'khor gyis rnam par brgyan/ zla ba nya ba ltar 'jig rten thams cad la ni sdug par snang / dpag bsam gyi shing ljon pa chen po ltar sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams shin tu rgyas shing chos ston te/ tshangs par spyod pa/thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba/ tha mar dge ba/ don bzang po/tshig 'bru bzang po/ ma 'dres pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ yongs su byang ba/yang dag par rab tu ston to/ /spyi gtsug ni sems can thams cad kyis blta bar mi mthong rtsi/ bdud kyi las thams cad las ni nges par rgyal/ de kho na thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thugs su chud/ spyan lnga ni mnga'/ rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ni ldan/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang ni ldan/sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad dang ni ldan/ bdud dang phas kyi rgol ba'i tshogs thams cad ni bcom/ grags pa dang / sgra dang tshigs su bcad pa ni 'phags—/ khyu mchog dang seng ge'i sgra ni sgogs/ ma rig ④pa'i mun pa ni kun du bsal/ bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag grangs med pa/ dpag tu med par sbyin pa dang / tshul khrims dang / bzod pa rjodang / brtson 36—1692

'grus dang / bsam gtan dang / shes rab dang / thabs dang /stobs dang / smon lam dang / ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / dka' ba spyad pas mngon par grub pa'i skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus sku brgyan par mdzes shing / rin po che rdo rje chen po'i pad+ma'i snying po seng ge'i khri la bzhugs pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo ①bsil ba'i tshal gyi ②gnas dang / 'khor phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas skabs te dang po'o// //de'i tshe na zhes bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na/ bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri la bzhugs pa'i che'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sgra gcan zin zhes bya ba ni / gzhon nu la rab tu byung ba/ 'dul ba'i bya ba mang po mi shes pa/ nga rgyal gyis ①khengs shing sangs rgyas kyi sras yin sems nas rjochos la ma chud do/ /rgyal po'i khab kyi dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i nags na zhes bya ba ni/ dpag tshad brgya yod pa/ 'jigs su rung ba/ ro dang / ro langs dang / ce ⑤spyang dang / stag dang / sbrul dang / seng ge dang / yi dwags dang /sha za dang / 'byung po rnams kyis ro la ma mthun zhing / phar 'grad tshur 'grad bubyas shing skad rnam pa sna tshogs 'don pa dang / ce ④spyang rnams 'thab pa'i skad 'jigs su rung ba dang / keng ⑧rus dang / mgo dang / pags ⑨pa dang / lag pa'i sor mo dang / rkang pa'i dum bu dang / ro'i dum bu dang / gsal ⑩shing la bskyon ⑪pa dang / shing la btags nas mgo gzhug zlog ⑫pa'i ro dang / man mkhal lcags kyus phigs ⑫nas shing la bka' ba'i ④36—1693

ro dang / mtshon gyis dum bur byas shing / kha yo ba dang / mig yar la bltas shing shi ba dang / ro mi gcig ①pa sna tshogs kyis khengs te/ dur khrod shar na ba tra'i nags tshal yod de/ nags tshal gyi nang na ②lha'i gdon ma rungs pa thams cad gnas pa'o/ /lho phyogs na ka ①rañja ka'i nags tshal yod de—/ gshin rje dang / grul bum dang / mkha' 'gro gnas te/ nub phyogs na la da'i nags tshal yin te/ 'dab chags bya dang / nam mkha' lding dang / klu'i gdon gnas pa'o/ /byang phyogs na brang ki ṭī'i rjonags tshal yod de/ nags tshal de'i nang na/ gnod sbyin dang / sha za dang /gdon ma rungs pa thams cad gnas pa'o/ /shar lho mtshams na tsu ta'i nags tshal yod de/ me lha dang / brjed byed dang / smyo byed la sogs pa'i gdon rnams gnas pa'o/ /lho nub mtshams na u dusmra rjora'i nags tshal yod de/de'i nang na srin po'i gdon dang / ma mo'i gdon la sogs pa'o/ /nub byang gi mtshams na n+ya ⑥gro dha'i nags tshal la rlung gi gdon dang / lha ma yin la sogs pa gnas pa'o/ /byang shar gyi mtshams na ta la'i nags tshal yod de/de'i nang na dbang ldan gyi gdon dang / 'byung po thams cad gnas pa'o/ /de bzhin du de dag la sogs pa shing sna tshogs kyis ⑦khengs shing 'byung po dang /sha za dang / ro langs dang / bar snang la rgyu ba'i bya dang / bya rog dang /'ug pa dang / bya rgod dang / khrung khrung dang / de bzhin du ka raṇ+ḍa ⑧la sogs pa yang / rtag tu 'gyur zhing ro la rgod de/ gzhan yang bya la sogs pa skad sna tshogs 'don pas 'jigs su rung ste/ sa srin dang / sa bdag la sogs pa yang de bzhin te/ dngos grub thob pa dang / rnal 'byor pa'i 36—1694

tshogs mang po dang / ro la ①rgod cing za 'dod pa'i tshogs dang / dngos grub 'dod pas sgom ④pa yang sha stag go/ /yi dwags dang / sha za dang /bya dang / rnal 'byor pa'i tshogs kyis hūṃ dang phaṭa kyi sgra sgrogs shing / nyi nyi dang ha ha dang / tī li tī li'i sgra sgogs shing / 'jigs su rung ba dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal na 'byung po rnams gnas so/ /de nas dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal gyi shar phyogs na/ de nas dpag tshad lnga na/ na len+d+ra'i grong khyer chen po'o④/ /de'i lho phyogs dpag tshad gnyis na/ grong khyer yangs pa can gnas pa'o/ /de'i nub phyogs dpag tshad phyed dang gnyis na ka liṅka'i rjogrong khyer gnas pa'o/ /de'i byang phyogs na/ dpag tshad gcig la bya rgod kyi phung po dang / rgyal po'i khab na ⑤gnas pa'o/ /bya rgod phung po dang / rgyal po'i khab kyi bar na rgyang grags gcig go/ /de bzhin du grong dang grong rdal dang /grong khyer dang / ljongs darngas / gzhan yang mang po'o/ /bud shing chen po su'i phyogs na 'dug go zhes bya ba ni/ nga rgyal che zhing nyan rjothos tsam la 'gran te—/ nga yang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sras yin sems nas/thos pa mi byed cing / bcom ldan 'das la zhu ba mi 'bul zhing / rang mthong gi nga rgyal gyis/ ngas ni dgra bcom pa grub par bya yi snyam nas dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal du phyin to/ /der 'di lta ste zhes pa ni/ bsgom mo snyam nas bsdad pa dang / ma rungs pa'i 'byung po rnams kyis 'tshe ⑦bar byas so/ /lha'i gdon ⑧dang / lha ma yin gyi gdon rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ lha dang drang srong gang gnas pa/ /de dag thams cad mi bzad cing / /'jigs pa'i sems kyis nyan byed pa/ /bye ba stong gi lha dag dang / /bye ba phrag brgya'i lha 36—1695

rnams dang / /lha yi bu mo skal ①chen dang / /thags ④bzangs ris dang sgra gcan ④dang / /lha min bye ba phrag stong dang / /lha min bye ba phrag brgya rjodang //de dag bu mo 'phrul ldan pa/ /rnam pa sna tshogs gzugs sprul la/ /de bzhin skad kyang sna tshogs 'don/ /gzhon nu sgra zin rtsar bsdad nas/ /'tshe bar byas te sdig pa rnams/ /lha'i gdon rnams dang / lha ma yin gyi gdon rnams kyis kyang / 'dug ⑤tu mi ster zhing drag rjoshul bstan to/ /klu'i gdon rnams dang / gnod sbyin kyi gdon rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ rab tu gnas na rgya mtsho dang / /klu yi rgyal po gzi can dang / /klu yi rgyal po ma dros dang / /dga' bo nye ④dga' gnyis po dang / /rdo rje blo gros pagru dang / / gaṅgā dga' de bo sin dhu mtsho/ /bya yi rgyal po 'dab bzang ⑨dang / /rgya mtsho chen po 'khrug ⑫ byed dang / /rigs ni klu ni klu bzhi dang / /sa srin sa bdag za byed dang / /ma rungs byed cing khro ba dang / /gdug ⑪pa byed cing 'tshe byed dang / /stong phrag bye ba'i klu yi gdon/ /bye ba brgya yi klu dag dang / /de yi bu mo skal ⑫ chen rnams/ /rtag tu sems can gnod par byed/ /gnod sbyin ma rungs mdangs 'phrog pa/ /snying rje med cing khrag 'thung ba/ /gsus chen 'jigs pa chen po ste/ /stobs po che la sgra yang che/ /mgrin bcu po la mig stong po/ /gdon chen mig ni dmar po rnams/ /'khor ni mang po rnams gtang ⑫ste/ /lag na mtshon thogs rab tu 'jigs/ /sbrul gyi zhags pa thogs pa dang / /lag bzhi lag na sgron ma thogs/ /lag na mtshon dang mi lpags ⑫thogs/ /rdo rje mdung rtse lag na thogs/ /rab tu grags pa'i gtam byabargal nas/ /phyogs kun du ni grags par byed/ /de yi gnas na 'god ⑩pa yi/ /zab mo 36—1696

yi kyeni rtag tu bskyang ②/ /mi yi 'jig rten 'di dag tu/ /skyes pa bud med rnams kyang 'dzin/ /sha khrag dron mor bcas pa la/ /rnam par 'khrul cing 'dod pa'i gzugs/ /gnod sbyin de dag ma rungs pa/ /sems can rnams la 'tshe dze+ebar byed/ /gzhon nu sgra zin bsgom pa la/ /drag meshul gyis ni gnod pa byas/ /klu'i gdon dang gnod sbyin gyi gdon gyis bsgom par mi ster zhing drag rjoshul gyis 'tshe bar byas so zhes bya ba'o/ /srin po'i gdon rnams dang mi 'am ci'i gdon rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ /mi 'am ci dang srin po dang //rnam pa sna tshogs gzugs bstan pa/ /kha cig mtshon gyis rab tu 'tshe/ /lus dang 'bral ba dag tu snang / /rnam par 'khrugs shing 'dod la mos/ /rgyu ma'i phreng ⑥bas kun du dkris⑦/ /rtse gsum mdung gis rab 'debs shing / /srog ⑧chags rnams la gnod par byed/ /mi bzad pa yi dbugs 'byin cing / /skye dgu 'di dag skrag par byed/ /srog chags rgyud ni ji snyed pa/ /sna tshogs kyi spuni gzugs su snang / /kha cig dag ni ri yang thogs/ /la la ral gri 'khor lo thogs/ /bgegs ni brgya phrag stong rnams te/ /dbyug ⑩pas bsdigs shing kha drag po/ /mig phyung ba la bzhin mi sdug⑪ /srin po so ni rno ba dang / /sna dang rna ba bcad ⑫pa dang / /lce bcad ⑫gdong ni gnyer ma can//rkang lag dag ni 'khums pa dang / /mgo bo bcad ④pa'i srin po rnams/ /skabs ni rab tu 'tshol bar byed/ /sdig pa can rnams gzi brjid 'phrog /mi dag gi ni lus rnams la/ /rab tu phra ba'i gdon du snang / /spu yi bar dang gnad rnams dang / /de bzhin rma ⑩yi kha rnams zlum⑩/ /srin po mi'am ⑫ci'i gdon rnams kyis/ /'tshe ba rab tu ⑨byas pa'o/ /srin po dang mi 'am 36—1697

ci'i gdon gyis/ gzhon nu sgra gcan sdezin la rnam pa sna tshogs kyi gzugs bstan zhing gnod pa skyel ba'o/ /lto 'phye chen po'i gdon rnams dang / dri za'i gdon rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ lto 'phye dri za'i gdon rnams kyis/ /snying rje med ⑤cing 'tshe byed pa/ /rnam pa sna tshogs sgra 'byin nas④/ /gzhon nu de la 'tshe bar byed/ /rdza rnga dag ni brdungs nas su/ /la las rnga zlum dag ni brdungs/ /pi wang gling bu 'khar rnga dang / / stobs chen rjornams ni sgra 'byin te/ /rol mo'i dbyangs sgra sna tshogs dang / /glu dang gar rnams byas nas su/ /gzhon nu de la 'tshe bar byed/ /lto 'phye'i gdon rnams dang /dri za'i gdon rnams kyis kyang / gzhon nu sgra gcan duzin la sgra sna tshogs kyi skad kyis 'tshe bar byed pa'o/ /mi ma yin gyi gdon rnams dang / rlung lha'i gdon rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ de yi mdun na 'jug pa yi/ /mi ma yin dang rlung lha'i gdon/ /lag pa bzhi pa ma rungs pa/ /rkang mangs dang ni rkang gcig pa/ /rkang pa bzhi dang rkang pa gnyis/ /rkang pa greng 0la spyi gtsug dang / /lus mangs mgo bo gcig pa dang / /lus gcig pa la mgo bzhi dang / /mig mangs po la lus phyed dang / /mig ⑧gcig lto ba bcu gnyis dang / /bong bu rnga mo glang chen mgo/ /lag pa greng ⑨la mgo btud dang / /mtshon cha'i so dang mtshon cha'i lag /mtshon cha'i rkang pa mi ma yin/ /zangs kyi skra dang zangs kyi ⑫so/ /zangs kyi mig dang zangs kyi lag /zangs kyi sna dang lcags kyi kha/ /rkang lag kun du 'bar ba dang / /mi yi lus su gnas pa rnams—/ /sgur zhar lba ba ⑪gsum yod pa/ /mig mi sdug la kha glal ba/ /chu srin dag gi gzugs dang ni/ /gzugs mi sdug la kha ral po/ / mchu 36—1698

'phyangs ①po dang so yon po/ /rab tu gdug ④pa khro gnyer can/ /gsus po che dang bum sna bo/ /rna ①'phyangs pa dang rna ba med/ /lag rings dang ni rna ba ring / /sna yi rtse dang lag rtse ring / /lus bskams lus ni ring ba dang / /skra ring rjorab tu brgyan pa dang / /rkang pa mid pa phra ba dang / /dri nga ba dang bum sto bo/ /yan lag chu srin 'dra ba dang / /mi ma yin dang rlung lha'i sde⑤/ /mdun la rgyu zhing ltas rjongan bstan/ /sems can thams cad 'tshe byed pa/ /gzhon nus ⑦lus la 'tshe bar byedaske/ /mi ma yin kyi gdon dang rlung lha'i gdon rnams kyis kyang / sna tshogs kyis spugazugs bstan zhing gzhon nu'i lus la 'tshe bar byas so/ /yi dwags kyi gdon rnams dang / 'byung po'i gdon rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ yi dwags 'byung po'i gdon rnams kyis/ /phyogs bzhi la ni gnod ⑩byed pa/ /mi ⑪sdug gzugs ni bstan nas su/ /drag po'i tshul gyis sgra yang 'byin/ /shin tu 'jigs pa'i tshul bstan nas/ /gtun shing tho ba 'dra ba'i lto/ /rnam lto ba la rna bo che/ /gyen du badze+es skra rab tu dmar—/ /mgo bo che la mjug rings po/ /skem po sgrur bo bum lto bo/ /ri rab rtse mo 'gul nas su/ /me mdag ⑫gi ni char pa 'be+ebs/ /ljon shing ri rab rdo ba dang / /sprin gyi tshogs kyi mdog 'dra ba/ /dung dang rnga chen rdza rnga dang / /'byung po yi dwags rnams kyis ⑫rdung / /shin tu mi srun thal mdog 'dra—/ /mgal pa chu la bcug pa'i mdog /khrag la dga' zhing sha la dga'/ /bzhin mi sdug cing gzugs che ba/ /keng ④rus gzugs ni skra rings po/ /mig yo kha yo mgo gnyis pa/ /skyes pa bud med gnod byas nas/ /gzi brjid 'phrog cing srog kyang 'phrog /phyogs bzhi dag nas gnod pa po/ /36—1699

gzhon nu sgra zin 'tshe bar byas/ /yi dwags kyi gdon dang 'byung po'i gdon rnams kyis gzhon nu sgra gcan ①zin la phyogs bzhi nas byas so/ /sha za'i gdon rnams dang grul bum kyi gdon rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ sha za grul bum gdon rnams ni/ /stobs dang ldan zhing lus ngan po/ /gsus po che la mgo bo che//mig zlum sna ni sbrul 'dra ba/ /la la chu srin sna 'dra ste/ /skad cig tsam gyis gar ②yang khyab/ /sa g.yo byed cing ri rab 'gul①/ /ma rungs pa ni 'be+ebs byed pa/ /ske dub che la sgra yang 'byin/ /la la mi lpags thogs nas su/ /sems can rnams la 'tshe bar byed/ /mi yi gzugs la zhugs nas su/ /mdze yi nad rnams gtong ba'i bdag /de bzhin phran tshegs nad gtang ⑤ba/ /sems can rnams la 'tshe bar byed/ /dhigrul bum rnga bran ⑦rnams kyi sgra/ /'jigs pa'i sgra ni rab tu 'byin/ /ming po che la bong ⑧bu'i sgra/ /nag po sngon po ser po dang / /dmar ser me ltar dmar ser dang / khab 'dra'i sru dang ral gri'i skra/ /dmar po khrag gis ⑫bskus pa rnams/ /mi ro dag ni khyer nas su/ /za bzhin du ni rnam par rgyug /so non ⑩lag pa dmar po dang / /mchu rgo khrag gis bskus pa dang / /lus phyed dag ni zos pa dang / /mkhal ma snying dang nang grol gyis/ /snyim pa shin tu gang ba dang / /byin pa dag ni za bzhin du/ /mer mer po dang srog chags kyi⑪/ /rkang lag rnams kyi stobs kyang 'phrogs / /keng ⑪rus kyi ni lus kyis su/ /skye bo mang po skrag par byed/ /khrag gis ⑫rab tu gang ba yi④/ /mi yi pags spyopa thogs nas su/ /mi bzad ⑪dug gis kun bskus te/ /phyogs phyogs dag tu rnam par rgyugs⑫/ /grong khyer rnams kyi sgo dag dang / /khyim nas khyim du rnam par 'thor/ /rlung dang 36—1700

bad kan mkhris pa rnams/ /phyogs bzhi dag tu 'khrug par byed/ /sha za grul bum gdon rnams ni/ /gzhon nu de la gnod par byed/ /sha za grul bum gdon rnams kyis rnam pa sna tshogs kyi nad btang ①la rnam par 'tshe bar byas so//gzig rnams dang / bya rog rnams dang / 'ug pa rnams dang / grog sbur dang / sdig pa rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ rnam par 'khrul zhing 'dod pa'i gzugs—/ /seng ge dang ni stag dang rta/ /ma te ba lang bong bu dang / /glang po che yi gzugs 'dra dang / /dom dang lug ④dang spyang ki ①dang / /khyi dang wa dang ra dag dang / /byi la byi ba spre'u'i bugazugs/ /bse dang phag dang dred mo dang / /nya dang rus busbal dag gi gzugs/ /kha cig dag ni sram gyi gzugs/ /khwa dang 'ug pa khu byug ④dang / /bya rog khra dang nya mid can—/ /rma bya ngang pa thi ba dang / /khrung khrung dang ni bya rnams dang / /kha cig bya gag gzugs rnams su/ /gdon ⑦rnams la ni mi yis mthong /'dab bzangs bya yi tshul kyis kyang / /skye bo mang po skrag par byed/ /kha cig mi yi mgo can la/ /lus ni bya gag bong bu 'dra/ /kha cig mtshon gyis rab tu 'tshe—/ /lus dang bral ba dag tu snang / /sa dang bar snang phyogs dag tu/ /khengs nas sems can byung ba ste/ /gzhon nu'i ⑤lus la rnam par za/ /bsdad pa gang dang gang rnams su/ /sems can rnams kyis 'dug mi ster/ /bar snang tshogs nas byung nas su/ /gzhon nu'i lus la 'tshe bar byas/ /gzhon nu sgra gcan zin la dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal du 'dug mi ster zhing /lus la 'tshe bar byed pa'o/ /gzhan yang mi dang mi ma yin gyi sems can rnams kyis zhes bya ba ni/ zhags pa ral gri 'dzin rnams dang / /mda' gzhu mdung 36—1701

rnams thogs nas su/ /skra 'dzings skra mdud spyi gtsug tu/ /khro bo'i tshul du bstan pa ste/ /zhi ba'i tshul du mi ston to/ /mi rgod mang po der byung nas/ /baspyigs shing 'tshog ①par byed pa ste/ /khrid pa'i tshal ni bstan nas su/ /mtshon gyis brdegs shing ②bsdogs par byed/ /sems can thams cad gnod byed pa/ /mi rgod de rnams sdig pa can/ /lha dang klu dang dri za dang / /gnod sbyin srin po lha ma yin/ /nyin gsum pa yi smyo byed dang / /de bzhin du ni ri dwags ①dang / /'jig rten 'tshe ba gang yin pa/ /gdon rjosbyin srin po ma rungs rnams/ /'dir ni 'khod de gzhon nu la/ /drag shul kyis ni gnod byed do/ /gzhan yang bya rog 'ug pa dang / /bya gag bya la sogs pa yis/ /bar snang dag la 'tshe bar byas/ /rjogadon rnams de rnams dag gis ni/ /log par bstan nas 'tshe byed pa/ /bud med dag dang skyes pa dang / /de bzhin bu pho bu mo dang / /mngal na gnas pa 'ang 'jig rjopar byed/ /dud 'gro'i skye ④gnas gtogs pa'ang 'tshe/ /skar ma dag dang nyi zla dang ske/ /gtum pa'i gza' rnams gnod par bgyid/ /lo tog sa bon 'bras bu dang / /me tog sman dang zas skom dang / /mi rnams kyi ni dpal 'phrog cing / /mthon po rnams ni dma' bar byed/ /'jig rten dag na snang ba ⑨rnams/ /dmag dang 'thab mo sha gnyer dang / /tshig gam gzhig gam gsang bya ba/ /de kun 'byung po'i rnam par sgyur/ /sbed cig ⑩gtong bar byed pa dang / /log par byed cing dgod par 'gyed/ /'jig ⑪par byed cing lta bar bkyid⑩//dgrar 'gyur ba yang ston par bgyid/ /sdig pa'i rmi lam mthong bar bgyid/ /nyal ba dag la gnod par bgyid/ /sgo nas se gol sgra phyung zhing / /mi snyan 36—1702

brjod de za bar bgyid/ /mdza' bo gnyen bshes ①gzugs dag tu/ /dga' zhing dka' ②mchid smra bar bgyid/ /bu mo sdu ①gu'i gzugs dag tu/ /'dod pa ①spyod par dga' bar bgyid/ /nyi ma skar ma'i gzugs dang ni/ /zla ba'i gzugs su gda' bar bkyid/ /rlung dang skar mda' lce gzugs su/ /de la gnod pa ⑤byed par gda'/ /skar ma'i tshogs dang 'dra ba dag /'jigs par bkyid pa wa dang khyir/ /rnam par sprul rjonas ljon shing dang / /mchod rten dag gi gnas na gda'/ /skyes pa gzhon nu'i ⑦gzugs mdzes las⑧/ /'bar zhing shing rta'i ⑨sgra yang 'byin/ /nad ⑩rnams dang ni shul dag tu/ /rnam pa sna tshogs rjes kyang ston/ /grong khyer dag dang khyim rnams kyi⑪/ /sgo yang gdon chen de dag 'byed/ /srog dang lus kyang blangs bkyis ⑫shing / /lam ngan kun du skor ⑫bar bgyid/ /rnam pa sna tshogs gzugs dag dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs sgra rnams dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs nad kyi rnams/ /lus la na ba ④gnas par ston/ /nad rnams kun gyi mtshan nyid kyang / /phyin ci log tu ston par bgyid/ /ji snyed 'jig rten rang bzhin dag /thams cad log par de dag ston/ /de bzhin log par ston ⑫byed pa/ /'jig rten la ni 'jigs par byed/ /'tshe ba sgra zin gzhon nu la/ /phyin ci log cing gnod par byed/ /gzhon nu sgra gcan ⑩zin la gnod pa de rnams kyis/ zhe sdang byas shing 'tshe bar byas so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sgra gcan zin la ni shin tu gtses so zhes bya ba ni/ dug lnga khong du shar bas zhe sdang byas shing nga rgyal che ba dang /ma shes par shes par smra ba/ ma snyan par snyan ⑩par smra ba/ rang gi rig pas bsgrubs pa byas pa/ rang gi rig pas smra zhing gzhan la ston ⑫pa/ bla ma 36—1703

la mi zhu zhing / rang rig gis bstan pa dang / bla ma'i rig pa bzhag cing rang rig smra ba dang / lung ⑨dang bka' la mi brten zhing ④/ rang gi nga rgyal gyis rang bzo byas pa dang / tshe phyi ma la mnar med du skye ste/ tshe 'di la yang gdon de rnams kyis 'tshe bar byed cing srog 'phrog pa'o/ /de bzhin du gzhon nu sgra gcan bluzin yang / skad sna tshogs 'byin cing gzugs sna tshogs ston cing gdon rnams kyis phar 'then tshun 'then rjobyas shing rang gi lus la rang dbang med do/ /gzhon nu sgra gcan zin de 'jigs par byed cing ⑤'dar te/lus la yang na tshas thebs te/ bcom ldan 'das dran zhing skad sna tshogs 'byen zhing kyi hud kyi hud zer zhing sangs rgyas la skyabs su gsol lo/ /chos la skyabs su gsol lo/ /dge 'dun la skyabs su gsol lo/ /de skad ces gsol ba dang / gdon rnams kyis rjolan cig gzhag dze+ego/ /bzhag ma thag tu bsil ba ⑧tshal nas bros te/ bros ma thag tu gdon rnams kyis ded pa dang /gzhon nu sgra gcan ⑨zin mdog shor zhing / ba sru yang gyen la log ste/ hag zad cing 'jigs pa'i sdug bsngal nyams su myong ngo / /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo bsil ba'i tshal gyi gzhon nu sgra gcan zin gdon gyis zin pa'i gnas skabs te gnyis pa'o// //de nas zhes bya ba ni/ gdon gyis ⑩zin pa'i de nas so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa sgra gcan zin/ bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri ga la ba dang bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste/ phyin nas zhes bya ba ni/ gdon thams cad kyis 'tshe bar byas pas/ 'jigs shing mdog kyang shor te/ ba spu rnams gyen du 36—1704

log cing / g.yengs ①te phar lta tshur lta byas shing / gdon rnams kyis phyir 'brang ngo sems so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi ④zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te zhes ①bya ba ni/ bag chags bushes bya'i dri ma thams cad 'joms pa sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad pa/ de kho na nyid kyi ye shes khong du chud pa/sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid ces pa rdo rje'i seng ge pad+ma chen po'i gdan la bzhugs te/ bya rgod phung po'i ri gzhal yas khang gi rang bzhin kyi sa bugazhi la / byang chub sems dpa' dang / dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang /dge bsnyen pha dang / dge bsnyen ma dang /rjo lha dang / mi dang /'khor phun sum tshogs pa'i spyan sngar 'jigs shing lus po thams cad 'dar ⑦ba dang kha nas dbugs kyang 'thon to/ /bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas zhes bya ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sgra gcan zin gdon gyis btab pa'i 'jigs pas bcom ldan 'das la gus par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug ste④/ mchi ma blags so zhes bya ba ni/ gdon kyis btab pa'i yus kyis⑨/ kyi hud kyi hud zer zhing dbyar gyi char bzhin du gdong gi mchi ma mi thub po/ /de nas zhes bya ba ni/ gzhon nu sgra gcan zin yus ⑩che ba de nas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑪tshe dang ldan pa sgra gcan zin la bka' byed pa zhes bya ba ni/ sems can thams cad mnyam pa nyid du bsgom pa'i sems dang ldan pa sngon gyi bya ba dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal gyi lo rgyus thugs kyis mabyed nas—/ sems can thams cad kyi don la tshe dang ldan pa sgra gcan ⑫zin la bka' byed pa'o ⑫zhes sgra gcan 'dzin byed ci'i phyir nga'i mdun du 'dug nas mchi ma blag ④ces bya ba ni/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten kyi bya ba 36—1705

thams cad skad cig mas thugs su chud nas/ des tshig gi gtam dris pa'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal nas zhes bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa sgra gcan ①zin la smras pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa sgra gcan ༄ zin gyis 'di skad ces gsol to zhes bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar des tshig gi gtam smras shing zhus pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab kyi dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal ①na zhes bya ba ni/ bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri dang rgyal po'i khab dang / bsil ba'i tshal gyi bar na dpag tshad gcig yod de/bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri'i lho phyogs na ro thams cad bskyal ba'i sa/ rnam rtog gsum bcom pa'i bsil ba'i tshal lo/ /rnam rtog gsum dang / bsil ba'i tshal rgo nges tshig gang gi phyir zhe na/ bsil ba'i tshal de yang / 'jigs pa'i sgra'i rnam par rtog pa byung ste/ sems can thams cad mnyam pa nyid sgom zhing /byams pa'i stobs kyis 'jigs pa dang bral ba'o/ /rnam par rtog pa de spangs pas 'jigs pa'i rang bzhin de mi 'byung ngo / /ngo tsha'i rnam par rtog pa ni yi dwags dang / ro yang gcer bur gnas te/ de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can yang mi rtag ste/ de'i ngo bor bzhag nas 'jig rten gyi khams sgyu ma lta bu yin te/ de'i rang bzhin gyis ngo ④tsha ba'i rnam rtog dang 'dral ba'o/ /skyugs ⑤bro ba'i rnam rtog ni dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal de la yang 'byung ste/ ro'i rnam pa mi gcig pa dang sha dang khrag dang klad pa la sogs pas khengs pa'i sa gzhi yin te/ de bzhin du rang gi lus las rjornag dang mchil ma dang rgyu ma dang gci ba la sogs pa yang 'byung ste/ de bzhin du mi rtag cing rnam par rtog pa med do/ /bsil ba'i tshal ni rnam par rtog pa gsum ⑦dang 36—1706

bral zhing / yang dag pa'i ye shes de nas de byung ste/ dngos grub thams cad kyis gzhi/ byang chub thob pa'i lam/ sgyu ma thams cad bstan pa/ mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin du bstan pa/ sems can thams cad dug gsum gyi rang bzhin gyi ①rnam par rtog pa dang bral sdebar byed pas na bsil ba'i tshal yin te/ de bzhin du lus ngag yid zhi bar byed pas na/ bsil ba'i tshal yin zhes/yang na bsil ba'i tshal ni rnam par rtog ④pa thams cad dang 'bral ba'i phyir ro//bud shing chen po lta bu'i phyogs na mchis na zhes bya ba ni/ dug lnga'i rang bzhin kyis nga rgyal dang zhe sdang byas te/ de bzhin du gti mug kyang shas che zhing /bcom ldan 'das la mi zhu zhing bdag dgra bcom pa thob par bya snyam nas bsil ba'i tshal du rjomachis so zhes smras so/ /der zhes bya ba ni dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal gyi ⑤dbus su bdag gis rjosdug bsngal thams cad myong ba zhes pa'o/ /lha'i gdon rnams dang lha ma yin gyi gdon rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ lha dang lha ma yin gyi gdon yang gzugs sna tshogs ston cing / lha'i 'khor pho dang lha'i 'khor mo sna tshogs pa bye ba stong gi lha dang / bye ba phrag brgya'i lha rnams dang /de bzhin du lha ma yin gyis kyang 'tshe bar byas so zhes bya ba'o④/ /klu'i gdon rnams dang gnod sbyin gyi gdon rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ klu'i nad thams cad gtong zhing / gnod sbyin gyi gzugs sna tshogs bstan te/ de bzhin du bye ba stong gi klu dang / bye ba stong gi gnod sbyin dang bye ba phrag brgya'i klu'i g.yog dang thabs cig tu 'tshe bar byas so/ /srin po'i gdon rnams dang /mi'am ci'i gdon rnams ④dang zhes bya ba ni/ sha khrag la dga' zhing /gdon de gnyis ni dpon g.yog dang bcas shing / bye ba stong dang bye ba phrag 36—1707

brgya'i gdon rnams kyis kyang bdag la 'tshe bar ①byas so zhes pa'o/ /dri za'i gdon rnams dang / lto 'phye ②chen po'i gdon rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ glu len zhing bro rdung zhing sgra sna tshogs ston te/ gdon de gnyis ni bye ba phrag brgya 'khor g.yog dang bcas pa byung ste/ de bzhin du bdag la gnod pa bskyal zhes bya ba'o/ /mi'i gdon rnams dang / rlung lha'i gdon rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal gyi nang na/ gzugs dang sgra sna tshogs byas shing byung ba ste/ de bzhin du g.yog dang 'khor mang po 'dus shing sgom du mi ster ba'o/ /yi dwags kyi gdon rnams dang 'byung po'i gdon rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ gdon de gnyis kyang bzhin mi sdug cing / mdun du ltar byung ste/gzugs sna tshogs ston cing sgra sna tshogs ston pa'o/ /sha za'i gdon rnams dang /grul bum gyi gdon rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ gsus po ④che la mgo che ba mang po 'dus nas byung ste/ gdon de rnams kyis kyang phyogs bzhi nas 'tshe bar byas pa'o/ /gzig rnams dang bya rog rnams dang 'ug pa rnams dang gog sbur ④rnams dang sdig sbrul rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ sa dang bar snang la rgyu ba'i sems can thams cad kyis kyang lus la 'tshe bar byas shing bdag la na tsha byung ngo zhes pa'o/ /mi dang mi ma yin pa'i sems can rnams kyis/ bdag shin tu gtses pa lags mod kyi zhes bya ba ni/ mi rgod mtshon sna tshogs thogs pa dang /gzhan yang bgegs ma rungs pa rnams kyis kyang / gzhon nu sgra gcan zin la sdug bsngal thams cad myong zhing 'tshe bar byas so zhes pa'o/ /de nas zhes bya ba ni—/ sgra gcan zin gyis smras pa'i de nas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa sgra gcan zin la bka' sprul pa zhes bya ba ni/ sems can thams 36—1708

cad kyi don du ①dmigs la 'khor phun sum tshogs pa'i nang du khyu mchog dang seng ge'i sgra sgogs ②pa'o/ /sgra gcan zin khyod kyis zhes bya ba ni/ gti mug gi rang bzhin gyis nga rgyal dang / phrag dog byas te da yang khyod kyis ma byed cig ces rig sngags kyi rgyal mo bsil ba'i tshal be+e con chen po zhes bya ba ni/rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 1ni chos kyi rjosku ste/ baṅgal ba ni melongs sku'o/ /tshal ni sprul sku ste/ be+e con ni chad pa thams cad dang bral dhibar byed pa'o/ /de bzhin ci'i phyir zhe na/ rig pa ni ⑦stong pa ste/ ngo bo nyid dang bral zhing brjod du med pa'o/ /sngags ni ma man+t+ra ⑧ste skyob pa dang srung ⑨ba'o/ /de yang stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no/ /bsil ba ni sgyu ma lta bu'i rang bzhin te/longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i rang bzhin/ yod pa yang ma yin med ⑩pa yang ma yin⑪—/ gnyis ka yang ma yin no/ /tshal ni sprul sku ste/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten kyi khams la dus gcig tu nam mkhas ⑫khyab pa bzhin du khyab pa'o/ /be+e con gyi lha'i gdon rnams kyi chad pa dang 'jig rten 'di'i rgyal po dang / rkun po ⑫dang chu dang me la sogs pa'i chad pa dang / gzhan yang gshin rje dang 'khor ba na ④'bral te/ de sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral bas na be+e con zhes pa'o⑫/ /yang na bsil ba'i tshal ni lus ngag yid zhi bar byas te/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral ⑩bar byed pa'o/ /gzungs kyi rig sngags zhes bya ba ni/ gzungs ni lus dang ngag dang yid kyi gzungs te/ de yang dag par gzung ⑩zhing / stong pa nyid la sems bzhag nas—/ sems can thams cad la byams pa dang snying rjes khyab pa'o/ /'khor bzhi po zhes bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das gar gshegs pa'i sar 'khor ba'o/ /36—1709

dge slong rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ byang chub sems dpa' dang / dgra bcom pa la sogs pa'o/ /dge slong ma rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ sgra ①gcan zin gyi ma dang / dge slong ma lnga brgya la sogs pa'o/ /dge bsnyen rnams dang / dge bsnyen ma rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ rgyal po chen po ma skyes dgra khrudang / btsun mo la sogs pa'o/ /bsrung ba dang / bskyab pa dang / sba ba dang / yun rings ①po'i don dang phan pa dang bde bar 'gyur ba zung shig 4ces bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di 'chang bar gyur na/ sdug bsngal thams cad dang 'bral zhing bde ba thob pa'o/ /lha dang mis kyang de bzhin du zung shig ⑤ces bya ba ni/ gzugs khams kyi lha dang 'dod khams kyi lha dang /sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun la gus par byed pa'i mi rnams kyis/rig sngags 'di zung shig ⑥ces pa'o/ /rigs ⑦kyi ngo bo nyid gang zhe na shes rab dang thabs yin te/ 'dir ni shes rab kyi ngo bo las/ thabs kyi ngo bor mi snang ngo zhes pa'o/ /slob dpon las kyi rdo rjes gsungs pa ni/ mtshon pa dag ni ye shes te/ /mtshon byed rig sngags rgyal mo la/ /phyag mtshan sku mdog bstan pa ste / /thabs kyi ngo bo de bzhin no/ /de bzhin du bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes mtshon pa ni shes rab po/ /rig sngags nyid sgom ⑨pa ni thabs kyi ngo bo nyid yin te/ de yang mtshon par byed pa'o/ /de'i phyir na thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'o/ /de'i phyag mtshan dang sku mdog ni gang zhe na/zhal gsum pa phyag drug pa sku mdog ljang gu sangs rgyas lnga'i dbu rgyan ⑩can/sbyan gsum pa zhal g.yas dkar po/ g.yon dmar ba lo bcu drug pa'i gzugs su bzhugs pa phyag g.yas pa ⑪gsum na/ ral gri dang / skyabs sbyin dang /36—1710

rin po che'i ①steng na rdo rje'o/ /g.yon pa gsum na bum pa'i steng na rdo rje dang /zhags pa dang lcags kyu'o/ /zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ pad+ma'i steng na zla ba'i gdan la nyi ma'i 'od dang ldan pa'o/ /rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa ye shes lnga'i ngo bo nyid las kyi rigs rlung gi khams lus kyi skye mched tram̐ gi yig 'bru las ye shes lnga 'phros sems can thams cad kyi don byas so/ /rig sngags kyi ngo bo nyid sems can gyi don byed pa'i tshig ni las kyi snying po ste/'di lta ste/ ang gā bang gā r+bha gā ②la sogs pa'o/ /rgyal po dang dbang po dang zhes bya ba ni/ brgya byin yin te/ zhal gcig pa phyag bzhi pa sku mdog ser po/ spyan gsum pa la dpral ba'i mig phred la ④yod pa/ lha'i dbu rgyan la sogs pas brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas pa gnyis na rdo rje dang mda'o/ /g.yon pa gnyis na gdugs dang / gzhu bsnams pa④/ glang po che la zhon pa'o/ /rgyal po gshin rje dang zhes bya ba ni/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa sku mdog nag po khro bo'i tshul du bstan pa dbu duskra thor tshugs can g.yas pa gnyis na ral gri dang be con 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa duganyis na zhags pa dang lcags kyu bsnams pa'o/ /ma he la zhon pa zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa ste/ sku mdog dkar po go cha gyon pa/g.yas g.yon gnyis na pad+ma dkar po bsnams pa/ g.yas pa na ral gri g.yon pa na ri bong gi rgyal mtshan bsnams pa'o/ /rnga mo dkar po'i shing rta la zhon pa'o//rgyal po chu lha dang zhes pa spyoni/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ sku mdog dkar po sbrul gyi gdengs ka dang bcas pa phyag g.yas pa'i dang po na pad+ma dmar po ste/'og ma ni ⑧rin po che'o/ /g.yon pa dang po na sprul gyi zhags pa 'og ma na bum pa bsnams pa ste/ chu srin la zhon pa'o/ /rgyal po dang nyi ma dang zhes bya ba ni/36—1711

zhal gcig sku mdog dmar po phyag bzhi pa g.yas g.yon gnyis na pad+ma dmar po 'dzin pa/ g.yas na ral gri g.yon pa na lcags kyu bsnams pa'o/ /shing rta dang bcas shing nam mkha' la rgyu ba'o/ /rgyal po rlung lha dang ①zhes bya ba ni/zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa sku mdog sngo skya phyag g.yas pa gnyis na ba dan dang lcags kyu bsnams pa g.yon pa gnyis na rlung 'khyil ba dang / bum pa bsnams shing sha ba la zhon pa'o/ /rgyal po gzi can dang zhes bya ba ni/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa ste/ sku mdog ser po phyag g.yas na sbrul zhags 'dzin zhing /g.yon na a 'bras 'dzin pa ku ④be+e ra la zhon pa'o/ /rgyal po sems zhes ①bya ba ni/ pa dub sangs yin te/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa sku mdog dkar po/phyag g.yas na bum pa spyi blugs g.yon pa phreng ba bsnams pa/ pad+ma'i gdan la zhugs rjopa'o/ /rgyal po gshin rje'i dbyug to can zhes bya ba ni/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa sku mdog dmar nag phyag g.yas pa gnyis na/ ral gri dang tho ba bsnams pa/ g.yon pa gnyis na zhags pa dang sdigs mdzub mdzad cing /ro langs la zhon pa'o/ /rgyal po me'i dbyug to rjocan zhes bya ba ni/ me lha'i dbang po yin te/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa sku mdog dmar po/ phyag g.yas pa gnyis na rtse gcig dang bum pa spyi blugs bsnams pa⑦/ g.yon pa me 'bar ba dang phreng ba bsnams pa ra skyes la sdezhon pa'o/ /rgyal po dbyug to ⑨can dang zhes bya ba ni mig dmar yin te/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa sku mdog dmar po khro bo/ g.yas na dbyug to mig can 'dzin pa⑩/ g.yon pa ni mi mgo ⑫sdigs mdzub bsnams pa⑫/ ra dmar po la zhon pa'o/ /rgyal po rgyal ba zhes bya ba ni spen pa yin te/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa sku mdog dkar po phyag 36—1712

g.yas na puste ①bsnams pa/ g.yon na ④bum pa bsnams pa/ brag ①gi gdan la zhugs bupa'o/ /rgyal po rnam par rgyal ba ⑤zhes bya ba ni/ phur bu yin te/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ sku mdog mthing nag phyag g.yas g.yon gnyis kyis mda' gzhu bsnams shing glang po che rjol zhon pa'o/ /rgyal po 'jigs pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ lag pa yin te/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/sku mdog ljang nag phyag g.yas na ral gri g.yon na sdigs mdzub dze+erus sbal la zhon pa/ rgyal po rnam par gzigs dang zhes bya ba ni/ rā hā ④la yin te/zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ sku mdog nag po ro smad med pa phyag g.yas g.yon gnyis na zla ba dang nyi ma bsnams pa/ sprin gyi gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /rgyal po 'byung po zhes bya ba ni/ dbang ldan yin te/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi ⑨pa/thal ba'i mdog can spyan gsum pa phyag g.yas pa gnyis na rtse gsum dang bum pa spyi blugs bsnams pa/ g.yon ⑩gnyis na phreng ba dang / a 'bras bsnams ⑪pa glang la zhon pa'o/ /rgyal po yul 'khor srung zhes ⑫bya ba ni/ dri za'i rgyal po yin te/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ sku mdog dkar po phyag g.yas g.yon gnyis na 'khor lo ⑫dang / mchod rten bsnams pa/ pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /rgyal po 'phags skyes po dang zhes bya ba ni/ grul bum gyi rgyal po yin te zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa sku mdog mthing ga /phyag g.yas pa gnyis na dbyug to ⑫dang tho ba bsnams paske/ g.yon pa gnyis na rin po che dang rtse gsum bsnams pa/ pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /rgyal po mig mi bzang zhes bya ba ni/ klu'i rgyal po yin te/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ sku mdog dmar po phyag g.yas pa na pad+ma/ gnyis pa na ⑩dgra sta/ g.yon dang po na 36—1713

sbrul gyi zhags pa gnyis pa dung bsnams pa/ pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /rgyal po lus ngan po zhes bya ba ni gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po yin te/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi sku mdog ljang gu/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na ral gri/ 'og ma dbyug to/ g.yon pa na ne'u ②le/ 'og ma na bum pa/ pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /rgyal po mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa zhes bya ba ni/ zhal bzhi pa phyag bzhi pa sku mdog ser po/ spyan gsum pa phyag g.yas na dbyu gu rtse /zugasum—/ 'og ma na ④mchod sbyin/ g.yon dang po na phreng ba/ 'og ma na bum pa spyi blugs/ pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rje/ chos kyi rgyal po 'jig rten la thugs brtse ba bla na med pa zhes bya ba ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa rnams yin te/de yang chos sgu dang longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang / sprul sku yin te/ 'dir yang sprul sku'i rang bzhin ni thugs rje che zhing sems can kyi don la bshad de/zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ sku mdog 'dzam bu gling gi gser gyi kha dog 'dra ba/sa gnon gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ rdo rje'i seng ge pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa/rab tu byung ba'i cha byad du bzhugs pa/ dus gcig tu sems can gyi don la snying rjes khyab pa'o/ /bdag dang sems can thams cad la srung du gsol/srung du gsol zhes bya ba ni/ rig pa 'chang ba gang yin pa de ni ⑤'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i 'khor rnams kyis kyang srung zhing sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral te/ bla na med pa yang dag pa'i bde ba thob pa'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang de bzhin no/ /yongs su bskyab pa rjodang yongs su gzung ⑦ba dang yongs su bskyang ba dang zhi ba dang bde legs su gyur pa dang /36—1714

chad pa spang ba dang mtshon ①cha spang ba dang dug bsad pa dang dug gzhil ba dang mtshams bcad ②pa dang sa bcing ba mdzad du gsol zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo bsil ba'i tshal 'di la gus par byas nas/ 'chang ba dang /klog pa dang / sgom pa la sogs pa byas te/ de bzhin du de ni 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang bar bya'o zhes pa'o/ /rig sngags ni gang zhe na/ ye shes lnga dang ldan pa ste/ mtshon pa ni bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes te—/ mtshon byed ni rig sngags kyi rgyal mo'i bdag nyid do/ /de yang thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i rnam par dag pa'o/ /gzhi bstan pa ni rnam par thar pa'i ye shes lnga dang ldan pa ste/ mtshon pa ni bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes te—/ mtshon byed ni rig sngags kyi bdag nyid do/ /de yang thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i rnam pa zhal bzhi bstan pa ni rnam par thar pa'i sgo bzhi'i rnam par ①dag pa'o/ /sangs rgyas lnga'i dbu rgyan ni gti mug la sogs pa dug lnga bcom nas/ ye shes lnga shar ba'i rnam par dag pa'o/ /spyan gsum dang ldan pa ni ye shes kyi spyan gyis mun pa mun nag bcom nas 'khor ba thams cad las thar bar byed pa'o/ /zhal nag po dang dkar po dang dmar po dang ser po bstan pa ni/ mngon spyod dang zhi ba dang dbang dang rgyas pa'i las bzhi bstan pa'o/ /khro bo dang /rjo zhi ba dang / sgeg ⑤pa dang / dgod pa ni sems can mi gcig pa'i theg pa sna tshogs bstan pa'o/ /sku mdog nag po ni byams pa chen po dang buldan pa'i rnam par dag pa'o/ /rgyan thams cad dang ldan pa ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug rnam par ⑦dag pa'o/ /phyag brgyad ni rnam par thar pa brgyad kyi rnam par dag pa'o/ /g.yas dang po na ral gri ni shes 36—1715

rab kyi rang bzhin blo dman pa rnams la blo 'phel bar byed pa'o/ /'og ma na rdo rje rgya gram bsnams pa ni/ sems can ma rig pa'i las las thar bar byed pa'oske/ /de'i 'og ma na dgra sta bsnams pa ni/ 'khor ba rnams la gcod par byed pa'o/ /tha ma na mda' bsnams ①pa ni/ thabs kyi rang bzhin brtan ②pa'o/ /g.yon pa'i dang po na zhags pa bsnams pa ni 'khor ba na gnas pa'i sems can 'dren pa'o/ /de'i 'og mas 'khor lo bsnams pa ni/gti mug la sogs pa'i dug lnga gcod pa'o/ /de'i 'og ma na rtse gsum bsnams pa ni/ srid pa gsum 'joms par byed pa'o/ /tha ma na gzhu bsnams pa ni/shes rab kyi rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'o/ /zhabs phyed skyil du bzhugs pa ni/bdud bzhi rnam par bcom pa'i brda'o/ /pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa ni/ chos de'i nyams myong 'khor ba thams cad las thar ba'o/ /nyi ma'i 'od dang ldan pa ni/ rig sngags kyis ①bya ba bstan nas/ khro bo'i tshul du sems can ma rungs pa rnams 'dul ba'o/ /rig sngags kyi snying po gang zhe na/'di lta ste/ bā la bā ti tsa ra ma ti la sogs pa'o/ /sgra gcan be+e con chen po'i gzungs ④ kyi rig sngags zhes bya ba ni gdon thams cad las thar bar byed pa/chad pa thams cad 'joms pa/ las ⑤thams cad las kyang thar ba ste/ rig sngags 'di ni gzi brjid che zhing stobs che ba/ mthu che zhing dpa' ba/sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rigs ⑥pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /rig sngags 'di bzung na sdug bsngal thams cad las thar bar byed pa'o/ /brgya rtsa brgyad pa 'di skud pa la ⑦btags sam zhes bya ba ni/ skud pa sngon po bram ze'am/ rgyal rigs sam/rje rigs la sogs pa'i bu mo lo brgyad nas bcu gnyis lon pa'i bar gyis gos 36—1716

gtsang ma gon zhing khrus legs par byas te/ kha zas dkar ①po la brten cing kha lho phyogs su bstan la bkal bar bya'o/ /rig sngags re re la mdud pa re re bor te/ rig sngags dang mdud pa ni brgya rtsa brgyad du bya'o/ /de bzhin du byas na①/ gdon thams cad las thar ba dang / sdug bsngal thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /mgul lam lus sam lag pa la btags ①na zhes bya ba ni/gro ga'am/ shing shun nam/ ras sam/ dar la sogs pa la bris nas mgul du btags te/ rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'am/ mchod rten gyi rtse mo'am/rnga la sogs pa la btags pas kyang / thos pa tsam gyis kyang bsrung ④bar 'gyur te mthong ba tsam yang bsrung ngo / /kun nas dpag tshad brgya khor yug tu zhes bya ba ni/ gzhan gyi yul du 'gro na yang rang gi yul gyi srung ba byas pas kyang srung dubar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du rig sngags 'di mthu che zhing gzi brjid che ba ste/ thugs rje che zhing sems can rnams kyi don mdzad pa'o/ /dri'am me tog rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi gsung bzhin du mchod par byas te cho gar byas te/ gzung bubar byas te/ 'chang ba la sogs pa gus par byas na/ de 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /phyag rgya rnams kyis de bsrung ⑦bar byas par 'gyur ro zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo bsil ba'i tshal 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis kyang / tshe 'di dang tshe phyi ma rnams la yang srung bar byed de/ 'di'i lam las yang dag pa'i byang chub thob pa'o/ /de la zhes bya ba ni rig sngags 'di 'chang ba ste/bla na med pa'i byang chub thob cing / da ltar yang chad pa la sogs pa thams cad dang bral ba'o/ /mi dang mi ma yin pa rnams kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur ro zhes 36—1717

bya ba ni/ mi ni rgyal po dang / rkun po dang / mi rgod dang gnyen bshes la sogs pas lto byed pa'i ①chad pa dang gzhan yang 'jigs pa thams cad dang 'bral ba'o/ /mi ma yin pa rnams ni lha'i gdon la sogs pa ma rungs pa rnams yin te/ chu dang me'i 'jigs pa la sogs pa dang bral ba'o/ /mtshon dang dug dang zhes bya ba ni/ g.yul 'gyed pa dang glo bur du 'thab pa ste/ des mi tshugs shing dug rnam pa gsum gyis kyang mi tshugs so/ /nad dang rims rnams dang zhes bya ba ni/ mdze las gyur pa la sogs pa dang bad kan dang mkhris pa dang rlung dang ldan pa dang / 'dus pa la sogs pa'i nad do/ /rims drag po dang zhes bya ba ni bzhi 'dus pa yin te/ de bzhin du rlung shas che zhing gzhu bzhin du gug ste/ mda' btang ba bzhin du rengs nas 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags dang gsang sngags dang zhes bya ba ni/ gzhan gyi sbod gtong btang ba dang / 'jig rten gyi rig pa rbad ④pa dang / de bzhin du gsang sngags gshin rje dang / ma mo dang / 'jig rten gyi ngan sngags kyis kyang mi tshugs pa'o/ /ro longs ①dang / khro dug dang zhes bya ba ni/ rig ④pa mkhan pos ro langs bsgrubs nas btang ste/ de yang de'i khro dug gis kyang mi tshugs so/ /me dang chus 'chi ba'i dus byed par mi 'gyur ro zhes bya ba ni/dus ma yin par 'chi ba rnams yin te/ rig sngags kyi gzi brjid kyis de'i 'jigs pas kyang mi tshugs so/ /rig sngags dang gsang sngags dang / sbyor bas legs par sbyor ba thams cad kyi ma grub pa rnams grub par byed pa'o zhes bya ba ni/ bri nyes dang / smra nyes dang / sgom 0nyes pa dang / gtam nyes pa dang / tshul nyes pa dang / de la sogs pa nyes pa thams cad ni/ rig 36—1718

sngags 'di'i gsang sngags kyis nyes pa thams cad kyang gso bar byas pa'o/ /rig sngags 'di'i gsang sngags kyi tshig tsam gyis bar chod byed pa'o/ /gdon rnams kyis mi tshugs pa'o/ /ma grub pa rnams grub par byed/ /grub pa rnams chud mi za bar byed do/ /gzhan yang dngos grub nyams par gyur na/ rig sngags 'dis 'grub par 'gyur te/ thob pa rnams gzhan la ma btang ste①/glo bur gyi bar chod kyis mi tshugs pa'o/ /pha rol gyi sbyor ba 'ching ba'o zhes bya ba ni/ sngags dang 'jig rten gyi skyon rnams yin te/ de'i 'jigs pas kyang mi tshugs pa'o/ /pha rol gyi ②bcings pa las grol bar byed pa'o zhes bya ba ni—/ gzhan gyis sbyor ba'i sngags btang ste/ des kyang mi tshugs shing bar chod dang bral ①ba'o/ /nad dang mya ngan dang bgegs rnams 'jigs par byed pa'o zhes bya ba ni/ bzhi brgya brgyad cu'i nad rnams dang mya ngan gyis mi phog cing / bgegs kyi rigs stong phrag brgyad cu ④las thar ba'o 'thab pa rab tu zhi bar byed pa'o zhes bya ba ni/ phra ma dang gcugs dang 'thab ⑤rtsod kyi rgyu dhirnams rna bas mi thos shing / bde ba dang dge ba'i gtam thos te/'thab rtsod dang nyag nyog gi sdug bsngal dang bral ba'o/ /gdon thams cad zlog ⑦par byed pa'o zhes bya ba ni/ sgom pa la sgom ⑧du mi ster ba dge ba dang dge ba byed pa de rnams kyang bgegs rigs te/ de rnams kyes mi tshugs shing /rig ⑨pa'i gzi brjid kyis mi tshugs pa'o/ /gdon gang gis mi gtong ba de'i mgo ardza ⑩ka'i dog pa bzhin du mgo tshal pa bdun du 'gas pa'o zhes bya ba ni/rig sngags kyis srung ba dang 'chang ba dang sgom pa dang / kha ton ⑪byed pa la sogs pa la gnod par byed na/ rig sngags kyi ⑫dmod mos mgo tshal pa tshal 36—1719

par 'gyur ro/ /srog dang bral zhing dmyal ba mnar med du skye'o/ /gnod sbyin gyi ded dpon chen po lag na rdo rje yang rdo rje 'bar ba kun du 'bar ba①/kun du rab tu 'bar ba me lce gcig tu gyur pa/ de'i mgo ardza ②ka'i dog pa bzhin du tshal pa bdun du 'gas so zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi bka' las 'das pa dang / rig sngags 'di 'chang ba la bar chod byed pa dang / gzhan yang 'di'i sgo nas dge ba la ①bar chod byed na/ phyag na rdo rje'i bugazi brjid kyis dum bur byas shing / dngos po mi snang bar byed pa'o/ /rgyal po chen po bzhis kyang lcags kyi 'khor lo rjospu gri'i so lta bu'i mtshon gyis phung bar byed do zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi dam las 'das shing / gdon rnams kyis sems can la 'tshe bar byas te/ de'i rig sngags kyi dmod mos rgyal po bzhi rnams kyis kyang lcags kyi 'khor lo me lce 'bar bas dum bu dum bur byas shing /chad pa gcod par 'gyur ro/ /gnod sbyin gyi rjo'ajig rten de nas shi 'phos nas—/ lcang lo can gyi pho brang 'khor du gnas pa mi thob po zhes bya ba ni/rig sngags kyi bka' las 'das pa'i gdon de ⑦shi ba ni rgyal po bzhi'i chad pas shi ste/ gal te 'byung po'i tshogs su skyes na/ lcang lo can gyi pho brang du mi tshud do/ /sgra gcan zin zhes bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gzhon nu la bka' stsal pa'o/ /rgyal po dang mi rgod dang me dang chu dang mtshon dang 'brog dang dgon pa dang / mya ngam du song ba zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo bsil ba'i tshal 'dis chad pa thams cad gcod par byed pa ste/ gzhon nu sgra gcan zin gyis kyang sgoms ⑧shig /yid la zung shig⑨ /mchod par gyis shig/kha ton du bya zhing sems can thams cad la phan par gyis shig ces bya'o/ /de 36—1720

bzhin du byas na de dang de'i 'jigs pa dang bral ①ba'o/ /yang na bdud bzhis mi tshugs te/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad 'joms pa'o/ /gang gi ②be con chen po'i gzungs kyi rig pa 'di lan cig brjod na/ sdig pa thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro zhes bya ba ni/ da ltar byas pa yang dag ④ste/sngon du byas pa yang 'dag pa'o/ /de bzhin du mthu che zhing gzi brjid dang ldan pa/ ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal dang bral rjobar byed pa'o/ /sgra gcan zin zhes bya ba ni/ sgra gcan zin gyi rkyen gyis ⑤sems can gyi don la/bcom ldan 'das kyis yang nas yang du bka' stsal pa'o/ /be+e con chen po'i gzugs kyi rig sngags 'di/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gaṅgā'i klung dgu bcu rtsa gcig gi bye ma snyed kyis gsungs pa zhes bya ba ni/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa rig sngags kyi rgyal mo bsil ba'i tshal 'dis chad pa thams cad 'joms pa/byang chub kyi lam yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams khams bsam gyis mi khyab cing ngo bo nyid dang bral ba'o/ /gsung ba gsung bar dhi'agyur ba zhes bya ba ni/ 'das pa rnams kyis kyang gsungs pa'o/ /ma 'ongs pa rnams kyis kyang gsungs te⑦/ de bzhin du da ltar bzhugs pa rnams kyis kyang gsungs pa'o—/ /phyag 'tshal rjes su yi rang 'di'i lam kyis 'bras bu grub pa'o/ /grub mchog tu grub pa gzhan gyis mi thub pa zhes bya ba ni/ thun mong gi dngos grub pa zhes bya ba ni/ thun mong gi dngos grub kyang 'grub ste/ thun mong ma yin pa yang de bzhin no/ /thun mong gi dngos grub ni/ 'jig rten 'di'i sa la spyod pa dang / nam mkha' la spyod pa dang sa'i 'og na ⑧spyod pa'o/ /de la sogs pa phra mo'i dngos grub kyang yod de/ de yang zhi ba dang rgyas pa dang dbang 36—1721

dang mngon spyod la sogs pa'o/ /thun mong ma yin pa'i dngos grub ni/ sa la spyod pa la sogs pa ni mgo mnyam ste/ nam mkha' 'jig rten gyi khams la khyab pa bzhin du 'khor ba bor zhing / srid pa ma yin 'das pa yang ma yin te/da ltar yod pa yang ma yin no/ /de'i dngos grub thob pa'i phyir na mchog tu grub pa'o/ /gzhan gyis mi thub pa ni 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis mi thub ste/de bzhin du gdon la sogs pas kyang mi thub pa'o/ /lha dang / klu dang /dri za dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang /mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye la sogs pas bstod pa ①zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags 'di la rtag tu rjes su yi rang ste/ mchod par byas shing rig sngags kyi rgyal mo'i bka' las mi 'da'o/ /'byung po'i tshogs thams cad kyis yongs su bzung ba ste zhes bya ba ni/ gnod pa skyel ba'i sems yod pa rnams kyang rig sngags kyi srung ba yod par gyur nas/ gzhan yang de'i rtsar bsdad nas/ de rnams kyang srung ②bar 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu 'byung po rnams kyis phyag 'tshal zhing rjes su yi rang ba'o/ /bdag dang sems can thams cad gnod pa thams cad las bde legs su gyur cig ces bya ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa gzhon nu sgra gcan zin gyis kyang / rig sngags 'di lus la btags par byas so/ /yid la bzung ①zhing kha ton du byas so/ /bsgoms par byas so/ /gzhan gyis mi thub pa rig sngags kyi go cha gon nas gti mug la sogs pa dug lnga bor te/ dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu bsgrub bupar dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal 'jigs su rung ba'i nang du song ngo / /sems can thams cad kyis kyang rjes su yi rang zhing bsrung ⑤ba'o/ /nad med pa dang 'jigs pa med par gyur cig ces bya ba ni/ lha'i gdon 36—1722

rnams dang / lha ma yin gyi gdon rnams dang / klu'i gdon rnams dang /gnod sbyin gyi gdon rnams dang / srin po'i gdon rnams dang / mi'am ci'i gdon rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po'i gdon rnams dang / dri za'i gdon rnams dang / mi ma yin gyi gdon ①rnams dang / rlung lha'i gdon rnams dang / yi dwags kyi gdon ④rnams dang / 'byung po'i gdon rnams dang / sha za'i gdon rnams dang / grul bum kyi gdon rnams dang /gzig rnams dang / bya rog rnams dang / 'ug pa rnams dang / grog sbur rnams dang / sdig sbrul rnams dang / gzhan yang mi dang mi ma yin gyi sems can rnams kyis kyang / tshe dang ldan pa sgra gcan zin la gus par byas te phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod par byas so/ /tshe dang ldan pa gzhon nu sgra gcan zin yang dgra bcom pa yang dag pa thob cing / zag pa zad pa/ rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa/ cho 'phrul ston nus pa'o/ /bkra shis te/ sems can thams cad byang chub kyi lam la sne'ajug pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo bsil ba'i tshal gyisarjo/gzhon nu sgra gcan zin gyi dhigadon 'dul ba'i gnas skabs te gsum pa'o / /④rig sngags kyi snying po brtag ⑦pa dang po rdzogs so// //de nas rgyal po chen po lus ngan po dang / yul 'khor srung dang /mig mi bzang dang / 'phags skyes po bu dang bcas pa zhes bya ba ni/ gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po stong phrag nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / dri za'i rgyal po stong phrag nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / grul bum gyi rgyal po stong phrag nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / klu'i rgyal po stong phrag nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang bcas pa/ de bzhin du bu dang yang bcas pa'o /36—1723

blon po dang bcas pa/ 'khor dang bcas/ mngag gzhug pa dang bcas/pho nya dang bcas/ g.yog 'khor dang bcas zhes bya ba ni/ gnod sbyin dang /dri za dang / grul bum dang / klu stong phrag nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / thabs cig tu ste/ de bzhin du chung ma dang / bu dang bu mo dang / tsha bo dang yang tsha bo la sogs pa dang thabs cig tu'o/ /kha dog 'phags pa dag nam byed na lhags nas/ kros mthun par dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal du dong ste zhes bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyang bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri nas/ sems can gyi don la 'khor bzhi po dag dang bcas shing 'jigs su rung ba bsel ba'i tshal kyi nang du phyin nas zhugs ①so/ /de nas rgyal po chen po bzhi po dag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyang so so rang rang gi gzi brjid dang mthu dang kha dog dang stobs dang rdzu 'phrul dang bcas shing dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal la kha bltas pa'o//rang bzhin gyi kha dog dang mthus 'od chen po snang bar byas nas zhes bya ba ni/gzhan rnams kyi kha dog ma yin te/ rgyal po chen po bzhi ②'khor dang bcas pa'i gzi brjid kyi so so rang rang gi rang bzhin mthu'i kha dog ces bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas zhes bya ba ni/ byang chub sems dpa' dang / nyan thos dang / dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen 2pha dang / dge bsnyen dum dang / lha dang mi dang / 'khor mang po 'dus pa'i nang du/ bcom ldan 'das kyi mdun du'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ lan gsum bskor ba byas te thal mo sbyar te zhes bya ba ni/ rgyal po chen po bzhi dang 'khor de dag rnams dang bcas shing bcom ldan 'das la gus par byas nas so so rang rang gi me tog dang sgos la 36—1724

sogs pas mchod par byas so/ /bcom ldan 'das 'ba' zhig la phyag 'tshal zhing phyogs gcig tu 'khod do zhes bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das la lus ngag yid gsum gyis gus par byas nas/ yang dang yang du phyag 'tshal te①/ de rnams kyang thabs cig tu 'khod pa'o/ /phyogs ②gcig tu 'khod nas/ rgyal po chen po bzhis bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pas bstod pa zhes bya ba ni/de rnams kyis kyang dbyangs gcig ④skad cig tu byas nas bcom ldan 'das la gus par byas pa'o/ /'jig rten mkhas pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /dpa' chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bya ba ni/ chos kyi rang bzhin dbyer med pa/ngo bo nyid dang bral ba'i chos sku dang sgyu ma lta bu'i rang bzhin me long gi gzugs brnyan bzhin du snang ba/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang ldan pa dang ngo / /mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu dang ldan zhing / sems can gyi don la stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams la sprul pa'i skus khyab pa'o/ /sprul pa'i sku de yang dpa' ba dang zhing bdud bzhi bcom pa la stobs dang ldan te/ bag chags dang shes bya'i sgrib pas ma gos shing / nyon mongs pa lnga bcom zhing / 'khor ba'i ming yang med de④/ de bzhin nyid du ldan pa'i sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal zhing 'dud pa'o/ /go ta ma khyod kyis gang mkhyen bupa/ /de ni lha rnams ma 'tshal to/ /zhes bya ba ni/chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong sems can gyi don la thugs la gzung ⑥ba/stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams la skad cig mas khyab pa/sems can lta ba mi gcig pa rnams la so so rang rang gi chos ston pa ste/ de lta bu'i sangs rgyas la 'jig rten dag gis mi 'tshal lo zhes bya ba'o/ /lan gnyis 36—1725

lan gsum du yang rgyal po chen po bzhis/ bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pas bstod pa zhes bya ba ni/ lan dang po 'bul ba ni chos sku'i rang bzhin gnyis su med pa'i sku ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs la dbul ①ba'o/ /lan gnyis pa ni sgyu ma lta bu'i rang bzhin gyi ste/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yin te—/ bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung la 'bul ba'o/ /sems can don la rdzu 'phrul dang cho 'phrul gyi rang bzhin dang ldan te/ stong gsum la skad cig mas sprul pa'i skus khyab ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sku la bstod pa'o/ /'jig rten mkhas pa sdogs sangs rgyas/ /dpa' chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bya ba ni—/ grong khyer ④ser skya'i gzhi'i grong khyer ra ba rim pa bdun dang / 'obs rim pa bdun gyis ④bskor nas grong khyer gyi sgo 'phar lcags las byas shing /sgo 'phar rnams la dril bu shin tu sgra gsal ba btags te sgo bye na de'i sgras dpag tshad gcig khor yug tu grags par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po chen po zas gtsang ma yod de/ byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan nas sgyu pyam chen po'i mngal du zhugs te de skyes nas rab tu byung nas ma ga dhā'i rjodabus su rdo rje gdan la yang dag pa'i byang chub thob par 'gyur ro/ /lha'i bdud la sogs pa bcom zhing / de rnam par rtog pa thams cad dang bral te/ de lta bu'i rang bzhin du shākya'i bu sangs rgyas te/ go ta ma'i rigs su skyes pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya seng ge la phyag 'tshal/ bstod cing 'dud do zhes bya'odu/ /go ta ma byed kyis gang mdon pa/ /de ni lha rnams ma 'tshal to/ /zhes bya ba ni/yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas mdon pa/ lha rnams kyis ci smos zhes te/ rgya mapa'i nang na nor yod pa bzhin du'o/ /rgyal po bzhi la 36—1726

sogs pas bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa'o/ /de nas zhes bya ba ni rgyal po bzhis bstod pa'i de nas so/ /bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po chen po bzhis 'di skad ces gsol te ①zhes bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar zhu ba dbul ④ba'o—/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das yul dang spro lags sam/ 'tsho ba dang ldan lags sam zhes bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khor bzhi po de dag kyang bde bar gnas sam zhes bya ba'o/ / btsun pa ①bcom ldan 'das kyi sku bde lags rjosam/ snyun mi mnga' lags sam/ nyam nga ba ma mchis sam zhes bya ba ni/ bdud bzhi po rnams kyis bar du ma chod dam/ 'jig rten gyi dug gsum po ma shar rjoram zhes bya ba yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi sku la/gnod pa mi mnga' lags sam zhes bya ba ni ma rungs pa bdud bzhi'i rigs kyi dhi'abyung po rnams kyis ⑦chos la bar chod ma byas sam zhes bya ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das la gnod sbyin dang zhes ⑧bya ba la sogs pa ni chos la bar chod byed cing /sems can rnams la gnod par ⑨byed pa rnams yin te/ yid mi bde bar byed pa yang de rnams yin te/ lus la na tsha drag pos thebs par byed pa yang de yin no/ /sems can mngal na 'tshe ba ni/ mi'i khong du zhugs nas/mer mer po dang / nur nur po rnams kyang 'chags su mi ster te/ gal te chags nas kyang ma la na tsha drag pos thebs nas 'chi ba dang shi ro dang skyes nas shi ba dang / der ma nus na glags gar rnyed pa'i dus su gnod pa skyel ba'o/ /mngal du zhugs pa'i dus su yang gzi brjid 'phrog cing / skyes pa dang bud med kyi tshogs kyang 'jigs par byed pa'o/ /chung ba la 'ju ba ⑩ni ba spu'i rtse mo brgya stong tsam gnas zhes bya ba'o/ /che ba ni ri rab bas kyang che ste/36—1727
