stobs btang ①na ri rab ②kyang 'gul lo/ /rgyu ba'i dus khams gsum skad cig mas rgyu'o/ /de lta bu'i 'byung po rnams kyis gnod par ma byas sam zhes bya ba'o//rims drag po dang zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni nad bzhi brgya brgyad cu de las 'du ba yin te/ nad de rnams ④kyang mi mnga' 'am zhes pa'o/ /mi dang mi ma yin pa sdang bar sems pa rjodang zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni/ rkun po dudang mi rgod dang rgyal po la sogs pa yin te/ mi dang mi ma yin pa ni ma rungs pa'i sdig can kyi rigs sems can la 'tshe bar byed pa rnams so/ /de rnams kyis rjokyang gnod pa ma byas sam zhes bya'o④/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang zhes bya ba ni bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po bzhis snyun gsol pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis tsargyal po chen po bzhi la ⑨'di skad ces bka' sprul to ⑩zhes bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po chen po bzhi las snyun gsol ba ni lan bka' stsal pa'o/ /kye rgyal po chen po dag nga la ni thams cad yod de zhes bya ba ni/ rgya mtsho lta bu ste/de'i nang na ⑪rin po che sna tshogs zad mi shes pa yod pa bzhin du nga la yang de bzhin no/ /yul dang yang sprod/ 'tsho ba dang yang ldan/ lus kyang bde/nad kyang med/ nyam nga ba yang med do zhes bya ba ni/ mngon sum du 'khor phun sum tshogs pa yang de bzhin te/ dang po phung po'i bdud bcom pa ste/gnyis pa nyon mongs pa'o/ /de bzhin du gsum pa 'chi bdag gi ⑫bdud bcom pa ste/ bzhi pa lha'i bu'i bdud bcom pa'o/ /de bas nyam mi nga ba she zhes bya ba'o/ /kye rgyal po chen po dag nga'i lus la ni gnod pa yang med do zhes bya ba ni rdo rje phung po'i rang bzhin gyi sku la smos ci dgos te/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis brlabs pa ④yang mi tshugs so/ /kye rgyal po chen po dag 36—1728

ngas ni 'jig rten lha dang bcas pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni sangs rgyas rnams la gnod pa skyel bar 'dod pas kyang gnod pa skyel ba'i skabs ma rnyed cing /gnod pa rnams kyang mi snang ba'o/ /gal te gzhan gyi sems ma ①dad pa skyes par gyur na/ 'jig rten 'di la sdug bsngal drag pos thebs shing ⑤shi nas kyang mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du dmyal bar 'gro'o/ /dmyal ba nas kyang ngan song nas ngan song du mi thar te/ thar pa'i dus kyang mi 'ong ngo / /de bas na bde bar gshegs pa bla ma dang / nyon mongs pa la sogs pa dang / pha ma la sogs pa la yang gnod par mi bya'o/ /de'i phyir na gnod par byed par sems pa geyang dag par ma mthong ngo zhes bya ba'o/ /kye rgyal po chen po dag de lta mod kyi byed kyi rjo'akhor rnams nga'i du'akhor la gnod par byed par sems so zhes bya ba ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis mngon par bltas pas ma rungs pa'i gdon rnams kyis gnod par bya bar sems so/ /de sems ma thag tu yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhal nas ⑥smra ba dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi ⑦byin kyis brlabs pa'o/ /de skad ces bka' byed pa dang zhes bya ba ni / bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po chen po bzhi la bka' byed pa zhes bya ba'o//bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po chen po bzhis 'di skad ces gsol to zhes bya ba ni rgyal po chen po bzhis bcom ldan 'das la zhu ba 'bul ba'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gsol ba mchis te zhes bya ba ni/ rgyal po chen po bzhis sems bcom ldan 'das la gus par byas nas srung ba dang sba ba dang yongs su bskyab pa dang zhi ba dang bde legs kyi tshigs ⑧ni bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa'o//de'i slad du bcom ldan 'das la blta ba pa ⑨dang / phyag bkyi ba dang /36—1729

bsnyen bkur ①bgyi ba dang / bcom ldan 'das nyid la zhu ba'i slad du/bdag cag bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar mchis pa lags so zhes bya ba ni/gnod pa'i sems ni ci mchis te/ /zhes bya ba dang rgyal po chen po bzhi dang 'khor rnams kyang bsrung bar 'dod cing / rig sngags kyi rgyal mo bsil ba'i tshal gyis grags pa thos pa dang / srung ba dang bde bar 'dod pas bcom ldan 'das nyid la gus par byas shing / zhu ba dbul ba'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na zhes bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' ④dang / rig sngags kyi byin gyi rlabs ①kyis sems can thams cad bde bar gnas shing nad med de/ ma rungs pa'i gdon thams cad bcom zhing yang dag pa'i byang chub kyi lam la 'jug pa'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das dgon pa dang bas mtha'i gnas mal ④'di dag na zhes bya ba ni 'jigs su rung ba dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal na ro langs dang ro dang ce ⑤spyang la sogs pa dang / bya'i tshogs mang po 'dus pa'i sa—/ khyi dang ce ④spyang 'thab pa'i sgras 'jigs su rung ste/ de bzhin du ro langs dang yi dwags kyang skad 'don zhing 'jigs su rung ste/ de bas na bas dzomatha'i gnas mal zhes btags ⑧pa'o/ /shin tu sdang ba'i gnod sbyin dang / /zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni⑫/ sa gzhi ⑩der gnas pa'i gdon rnams ni shin tu mi srun zhing ro la dga' ste/ gson pa'i sha khrag la dga' zhing sems can rnams la 'tshe bar byed de/ gzugs sna tshogs ston cing gzi brjid 'phrog pa dang / skad sna tshogs 'don zhing skyes pa dang bud med kyi tshogs la 'jigs par byed pa dang / gdon rigs mi gcig pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa gnas shing 'jig rten gyi khams na sems can la gnod ⑪pa'o/ /rims dang zhes bya ba la 36—1730

sogs pa ni/ nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi de rims de dag la 'dus te/ nad de rnams kyang ma rungs pa'i 'byung po rnams kyis btang zhing sems can rnams la gnod pa blta ba'o/ /mi dang mi ma lags pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni/ sa gzhi der mi rgod la sogs pa 'gyur ①ba ste/ gzhan yang rgyal po la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa dang mi dang mi ma yin pa ma rungs pa'i 'byung po rnams kyis kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' dang / rig sngags kyi byin gyi rlabs ②kyis ma nus pa'o zhes bya ba'o btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos de dag kyang de la gnas lags te zhes bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khor bzhi po yang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo bsil ba'i tshal la sbyor zhing de la gnas pa'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos de dag ni/ srod dang tho rangs la mi nyal bar sbyor ba la brtson ①par gnas so zhes bya ba ni da lta pyabar chod kyi rkyen zlog rjopa dang / tshe phyi ma'i don la byang chub kyi lam bsgoms rjopa dang / de ltar mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin bsgom ste/ nyan thos de rnams kyang rig sngags yid la byed pa'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das gnod sbyin dang srin po nas gnod par bkyid pa'i bar gang dag bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa 'di la dad pa'i sems dang ldan zhing cung zad cig mchis par bas so zhes bya ba ni/ gzhan yang sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal mthong ma thag tu dge ba'i sems la brtson zhing sems can gzhan rnams la yang sdang ba dang sdog pa'i sems dang mi ldan zhing byams pa dang snying rje la brtson zhing chos kyi sems dang ldan te/ sems can rnams la 'tshe bar mi byed pa'o/ /de'i yon tan gyis ni cung zad cig mchis bas so zhes bya ba'o/ /gang dag bcom ldan 'das kyi 36—1731

bstan pa ①'di la ⑤ma dad pa'i sems dang ldan pa ni/ ches mang lags te zhes bya ba ni/ gang dang gang dag sems can rnams ni dge ba la ④mi brtson zhing sdig la brtson par 'gyur ro/ /sdig pa'i sems dang sdang ba'i sems dang gcig gis gcig la 'tshe bar byed pa'i sems dang ldan pa'o/ /byams pa dang snying rje'i sems dang ldan zhing chos la rtsom pa nyung ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis nyon mongs pa 'phral du ④skye ste/ phal cher sems can de 5rnams ni mtho ris su 'gro ba nyung zhing ngan song gsum du skye ba'o/ /de bas na 'byung po yi dwags kyi lus thob nas kyang gzhan la gnod par byed pa'i sems dang ldan par skye ba'o/ /de dag ni zhes bya ba ni ma rungs pa'i gdon dang 'byung po rnams glags btsal zhing / dge ba dang bsgom pa la sogs pa la bar chod byas nas mtho ris thob tu mi ster ba'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos srod dang tho rangs la mi nyal zhing sbyor ba la brtson par gnas pa rnams la gnod par byed par sems lags te zhes bya ba ni/ phung po la gnod par byas nas rlung dang mkhris pa dang / bad kan dang 'dus pa'i nad btang zhing dge ba'i sbyor ba de yang mi nus par byed pa'i sems dang ldan pa mang po 'dus pa'o / /sems la gnod par byed cing mi dga' bar byed pa ste/ bsgom snying mi 'dod cing log 'upar byed pa'i sems ⑦dang ldan pa mang po yod pa'o/ /bsgom pa'i dus su srog la zhugs shing 'chi bar byed pa'i sems dang ldan pa mang po sha stag yod pa'o/ /bsgom pa'i dus su ltas ngan pa dang rmi lam ngan pa bstan zhing phal cher dngos por 'byung zhing sgom ⑧du mi ster ba ste/ bsgom pa'i gang zag la 'jigs par byas shing / nam sgom pa'i dus su bar chod byed 36—1732

cing sgom du ①ster ba'o/ /de bas na gdon de dag gis gnod par bgyid pa lags te zhes bya'o②/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo bsil ba'i tshal kyi ①bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khor bzhi po la/ gdon gyis glags btsal ba'i gnas skabs te bzhi pa'o// //de dag dgag pa'i slad du zhes bya ba ni gdon ma rungs pa rnams dang sdig can bdud kyi rigs dang sa dang bar snang dang sa 'og la rgyu ba'i 'byung po rnams stong phrag brgyad cu ste/ de phrag nyi shu rtsa drug go/ /de bzhin du g.yog dang chung ma dang bu dang bu mo la yang yin no/ /gnod sbyin ma rungs pa rnams dad par bgyi ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ de bzhin du ma rungs pa'i gdon rnams mi dad de sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun gyi rjobyin gyi rlabs bukyis dad par byed pa'o—/ /dad pa rnams slar zhing dad par bgyi ba dang zhes bya ba ni phyi bzhin nas yod pa'i sems ni yang dang yang du dad pa skyes pa ste/ de 'ong bar mi byed pa'i sems ni brtan par mi byed pa'o/ /'khor bzhi po rnams bde legs dang zhes bya ba ni sngar gnod par byed 'dod pa'i sems dang sdang bar 'dod pa'i gdon dhide rnams ni dad pa'i sems dang ldan par gyur na/ 'khor bzhi po de dag dang sems can thams cad bde bar gnas par 'gyur ro/ /bde bar gnas par bgyi ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ bsgom pa dang nyan pa la yang bar chod med cing de bzhin du spyod pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba la bar chod med cing de rnams la bde bar bgyi bas na bde ba'o/ /ma lus par shin tu mnyam par bzhag par 'gyur ba'i slad du zhes bya ba ni/ rnam par rtog pa ma 36—1733

lus par 'joms te/ de 'joms na bar du gcod pa'i bgegs kyang smos ci dgos te/ shes bya dang bag chags kyi dri mas mi gos ①pa'o/ /bsil ba'i thutshal gyi mdo chen po 'di bshad par 'tshal lo zhes bya ba ni/ 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar yod pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs pa thabs shes rab gnyis su med de/ de'i chos kyi ①nyams myong gis zla ba sems can rnams la bsil bar byed pa bzhin du des kyang sems can rnams la bde bar byas pa'o//rig sngags des kyang 'jig rten kyi khams thams cad la nam mkhas khyab pa bzhin du khyab pa'o/ /mi ma yin pa sdang sems can/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la ma dad pa/ /zhes bya ba ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas sems can rnams la phan par bkyid pas mi ma yin kyi gdon dang / lha'i gdon la sogs pa rig sngags kyi rgyal mo bsil ba'i tshal gyi rjobyin kyi rlabs 3kyis sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa yang sdig pa'i sems med cing srog gcod pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams kyang srog mi gcod cing / bstan pa yang srung rjobar byed pa'o/ /de dag bdag gis bzlog par bya/ /rgyal chen rnams ni bdag la nyon—/ /zhes bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bkas rig sngags kyi rgyal mo'i gzi brjid kyis ma dad par byas pa ste/ dad pa rnams kyang spang ⑦bar mi byed pa'o—/ /rgyal chen bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis kyang sems la zung shig 8 ces bya'o/ /mdo chen 'di ni thos nas kyang / /mi rnams la ni gnod ma byed//ces bya ba ni/ sdig pa thams cad rlag par byed pas na mdo ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dod pas na mdo'o/ /yang na sangs rgyas rnams kyi yon tan dang chos kyi nges tshig dang / dge ba dang mi dge ba thams cad de nas 'byung ⑨zhing bshad 36—1734

de gsal bar bshad pas mdo zhes bya'o/ /chen po ni sangs rgyas kyi bka' dang /ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa ste/ de lta bu'i ye shes kyi don thob pas na thob pa ste—/ de lta bu'i rang bzhin gyi ①don gyis 'jigs pa med cing gnod pa yang mi mnga' ste/ sems can rnams la phan par byed pa'o/ /gnod sbyin srin po klu rnams dang / /nam mkha' lding dang gsang ba pa/ /zhes bya ba ni/ ma rungs pa thams cad de rnams kyis byed de/ sdig pa yang de rnams kyis byed pa/sems can la gnod par byed cing za ba dang 'thung ba tshol ba'o/ /phan par mi 'dod gang yang rung / /de dag thams cad bzlog par bya/ /zhes bya ba ni/sangs rgyas kyi bka' dang rig sngags kyi dmod mos/ ma rungs ⑤pa thams cad rlag snepar byed cing thal bar btang ste/ ma dad pa rnams kyang snang bar mi byed do/ /lha dang lha min rlung lha dang / /ma mo'i tshogs kyis gang ba yi④/ /zhes bya ba ni/ gzugs kyi khams kyi lha dang / 'dod pa'i khams kyi lha rnams dang / phyogs skyong ba la sogs pa dang / dam tshig la gnas pa'i lha mo rnams yin te/ de yang ye shes pa dang / 'jig rten gyi lha mo rnams so/ /gzhal med khang rjomadzes de dag ni/ /me dang 'dra bar 'od gsal zhing / /zhes bya ba ni/ 'jig rten pa ni 'jig rten gyi khams gzhal yas khang la gnas te—/ ye shes pa yang de bzhin yin te/ so so rang rang gi 'od zer kyi snang bas nam mkha' la mdzes par snang ba'o/ /nyi ma zla ba'i tshul 'dra bar/ /rin chen las byas shin tu snang / /zhes bya ba ni/ mun pa mun nag gi nang na—/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po ches mi snang ste/ de bzhin du nyi ma zla bas gsal bar byas shing rin po che mthong ngo / /de bzhin du glo 36—1735

bur gyi skyon nyon mongs pa rnams kyis bkag cing / bla ma dam pa rnams kyi gdams ①ngag bstan pas ye shes de snang ba'o/ /bsod nams byas pa dag gis gang / /rab sdang gdon rnams rnam ④par spangs/ /zhes bya ba ni/de bzhin de'i dge ba byas pa'i bsod nams bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ /gnod par byed pa dang / snyig pa bsags pa thams cad des de'i 'joms par byed pa'o/ /mi la gnod byed gang yin pa'i/ /'byung po grul bum srin po dang / /zhes bya ba ni/ khams gsum tsam yang skad cig gis khyab ste/ la la bza' rgyu yod cing mchod par 'os te/ la la sems can rnams kyis kyang sdang zhing dmod mos ④pa'o/ /de 'byung po rnams kyis kyang mi'i sems can la gnod par byed pa'o/ /yi dwags srul po de dag gis/ /rmad byung de dag mi mthong ste—/ /zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo bsil ba'i tshal kyi ye shes sdig can de dag gis mi mthong ④zhing de dag rnams kyang bde bar gnas par mi 'gyur ro/ /gzi brjid ldan pa'i rjolha rnams kyis/ /grong khyer du yang mi 'gro'o—/ /zhes bya ba ni/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha rnams te/ sems can la gnod par mi byed cing / byams pa dang snying rjes 'tsho ba'o/ /de rnams kyi ༷gzi brjid kyis ma rungs pa'i ⑦gdon rnams kyang rtsar 'gro bar mi nus shing / gnas kyang thob par mi 'gyur ro/ /'byung po chen po 'du ba na/ /der yang de dag 'dur mi dbang ④/ /zhes bya ba ni/sems can la gnod par byed pa ⑨'byung po de kun yang / lcang lo can gyi pho brang ci smos te/ de'i ra ba'i phyi rol yang mi thob cing / rig sngags kyi 36—1736

dmod mos bde bar mi gnas pa'o/ /stan nam ①yang na chu yang rung / /zas dang skom yang mi dbang ngo / /zhes bya ba ni/ de bzhin de la dam las 'das pa rnams 'thung ba dang za ba ci smos te/ 'thung ba'i skom yang zangs kyi chur mthong ngo / /bza' ba'i zas kyang lcags kyi thu ④lum 'bar bar mthong /lus ngan gyi ni pho brang du/ /nam yang de dag 'gro mi 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba ni/gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon lcang lo can gyi pho brang du sdig can 'byung po gnod byed rnams dang / gzhan yang gnod sbyin rnams kyis srung zhing pho brang nang du stan ①yang thob par mi 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po chen po rnams kyi tshig /'byung po gang zhig mi nyan pa/ /zhes bya ba ni/ rgyal po chen po bzhi po dag gis smras pa ste/rgyal po chen po bzhi po ni/ yul 'khor srung ④dang / 'phags skyes po dang /sbyan mi bzang dang / lus ngan po rnams yin te/ de'i rig sngags kyi dmod mo dang rgyal po bzhi'i chad pas/ 'byung po bude rnams bde bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de yi kha nas khrag dron dag /myur du rab tu 'bab par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba ni / ma rungs pa'i 'byung po de rnams rgyal po chen po bzhi'i chad pas ④myur du nad kyis ⑦thebs te/ kha nas khrag dron sgyug cing srog gi dus la bab ste/mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du myur du dmyal bar skyes so/ /de yi brla yi g.yas rol nas/ /phol mig dag kyang 'byung 'gyur te/ /zhes bya ba ni/ 'byung po de rnams kyi brla g.yas rol nas ma rungs pa'i nad 'byung ste④/ de ci'i phyir 'byung zhe na/ rig sngags kyi bka' las 'das pa dang / sems can la gnod par byas pa'i phyir ro/ /de ni nad kyis ⑨'chi 'gyur zhing / /gdon ⑩spyin gzugs kyang ston par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba ni/ nad de rnams kyis 36—1737

btab na 'chi ste/ tshe phyi ma la ①ngan song gsum du skye zhing / 'byung po'i lus blangs par gyur kyang gzhan rnams kyis bsnyen du mi btub cing / de bas kyang sdug bsngal thob par 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten skyong gis bshad pa yi/ /mdo las gang zhig 'gal byed pa/ /zhes bya ba ni/ 'jig rten skyong ba bcu po ste/brgya byin dang / gshin rje dang / chu lha dang / gnod sbyin dang / me lha dang / srin po dang / rlung lha dang / dbang ldan dang / nyi ma dang /zla ba dang / tshangs pa dang / sa bdag dang ngo / /de rnams kyis kyang chad par gsungs so/ /yang na 'jig rten las 'das pa'i 'jig rten skyong ba ni thabs la mkhas pa/ sems can la snying rje che ba/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams so/ /de rnams kyis kyang bden pa'i bka' gsungs pa'o/ /'jigs pa thams cad de la'o/ /mgo bo tshal pa bdun du 'gas/ /zhes bya ba ni/ sa g.yo ba'i 'jigs pa dang / me'i char 'bab pa dang / gnod sbyin 'byung po la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa dang / za ba dang skom med cing rig sngags kyang dmod mos 'chi ba'i dus su mgo tshal par 'gas ②nas 'chi'o/ /rgyal po chen po rnams kyi tshig /gnod sbyin gang dag ma nyan pa/ /zhes bya ba ni/rgyal po chen po rnams thos kyi bu la sogs pas gsungs te/ rig sngags kyi bka' las 'da' ba ④dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi'i bka' ma nyan par gyur na/de rnams kyis snyug bsngal chen po thob pa'o/ /'byung po srin po gang yod pa/ /ngan phreng lhag pa'i ngan phreng rnams/ /zhes bya ba ni/ 'byung po de rnams ni gcig la gcig gi ④phrag dog gis ngan sems skye ste/ de'i ngan pa rjoyang nas yang du ngan pa'o/ /lcags las byas pa'i 'khor lo yi/ /mtshon cha spu gri so 36—1738

'dra bas/ /zhes bya ba ni/ de yis de ngan pa rnams ni rig sngags kyi bka' las 'das te/ mtshon cha lta bu'i las kyi spu gris yang nas yang du gcod ①cing sdug bsngal chen po thob pa'o/ /gnod sbyin de dag brlag par 'gyur/ /rgyal po chen po dpal dang ldan/ /zhes bya ba ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bka' las 'das pa dang / rig sngags kyi bka'i dmod mos rlag ②par byed pa ste/ de bzhin du rgyal po chen po bzhi po rnams kyis kyang /dpal dang ldan pa ni gzi brjid che zhing stobs che ba ste/ rdzu 'phrul dang ldan zhing sems can gyi don byed pa'o/ /go cha sra zhing mtshon rno la①/ /stan rnams la ni 'khod pa dag /ces bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' dang / rig sngags kyi bka' las 'das pa la ni/ de dag dang 'khod par byas nas/mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs nas phyogs phyogs su bsdad pa'o/ /shar phyogs na ni yul 'khor srung rjo/ /lho phyogs na ni 'phags skyes po/ /zhes bya ba ni/ dri za'i rgyal po stong phrag nyi shu rtsa brgyad 'khor g.yog dang bcas pa ste/ de bzhin du grul bum gyi rgyal po 'khor g.yog dang bcas pa'o/ /nub phyogs na ni mig mi bzang / /byang phyogs na ni lus ngan po/ /zhes bya ba ni/ klu'i rgyal po stong phrag nyi shu rtsa brgyad 'khor g.yog dang bcas pa ste/ de bzhin du gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po rnams kyang yin no/ /go cha gon zhing mtshon sna tshogs pa stobs dang ldan pa sha stag go/ /de dag de na 'khod pa yi/ / nyen skor ⑤gnod sbyin 'di rnams gnas/ /zhes bya ba ni phyogs bzhi nas bu dang 'khor g.yog dang chung ma la sogs pa rnams kyis kyang phyogs phyogs nas srung zhing gnas pa'o/ /seng ge'i gzugs dang stag gi gzugs/ /mi sdug pa dang 'go zhing rgyu/ /zhes bya 36—1739

ba ni/ 'byung po de rnams kyang 'dul bar byed pa'i rgyal po rnams ni seng ge dang stag gi mgo can du gnas pa'o/ /skad cig mas stong rgyu zhing 'khor bar gnas pa'o/ /glang chen gzugs dang rta yi gzugs/ /kha cig ma he'i gzugs can te/ /zhes bya ba ni stobs dang ldan zhing gzi brjid che ste/ skad cig mas ri rab rtse mo dang bar snang dang sa steng dang sa 'og tu dus gcig tu rgyu'o—/ /dred mo dang ni ba yi gzugs/ /lug ①dang spyang ki ②phag rgod rnams//zhes bya ba ni/ 'byung po de rnams kyang sna tshogs kyi gzugs su sprul zhing sems can rnams la bstan pa'o/ /rna ⑪ba 'phyang dang rna bo che/ /rna ba gcig pa tha dad pa/ /zhes bya ba ni/ glang po che bzhin du rna ba 'phyang ba ste/ rna ba gcig pus gos byas shing / /lus po thams cad khebs pa ste/ /de bzhin du gzugs bstan zhing sems can rnams la gnod par byed pa'o/ /skad cher 'byin cing 'jigs byed pa/ /sa gzhi rab tu g.yo bar byed/ /ces bya ba ni/bum pa'i nang du skad smras pa bzhin du sems can rnams la 'tshe bar byas shing 'jigs par byed de/ bar chod byed pa dang / gnod par byed pa'i dus su sa g.yo zhing skad sna tshogs 'don par byed pa'o/ /bong bu dang ni rnga mo che/ /cha lugs gzhan yang nye 'khor 'khod/ /ces bya ba ni/ mi'i lus la rnga mo bong bu'i mgo bo dang / gzhan yang sems can kyi gzugs su sprul nas/gzugs dngos su bstan pa dang / rmi lam du bstan pa'o/ /rgyal po chen po stobs po che/ /de dag phan tshun 'du ba ni/ /zhes bya ba ni/ de bzhin du stobs dang ldan pas 'byung po ma rungs pa rnams kyang / rgyal po chen po rnams kyis 'dul zhing sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung ba'o/ /lha yi shing rta bcas pa 36—1740

yis—/ /nam mkha' las ni 'gro bar byed/ /ces bya ba ni/ sna tshogs pa'i mtshon cha thogs shing dpung ①dang bcas shing 'gro ba ste/ de bzhin du bar snang dang sa 'og dang sa stengs ④la rgyu ba'o/ /gnod sbyin dag gi ④bdag po yang / /mi rnams la ni bde legs byed/ /ces bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang / rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' zhing / gnod sbyin 'khor g.yog mestong phrag nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi mebadag po ste/ rnam thos kyi bu de yang sems can la gnod par mi byed cing / snying rje la gnas pa'o/ /de bzhin du rig sngags la mchod par byed cing / gus par byed pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi ngo bo ni gang zhe na/ las kyi rigs las/ las kyi rigs ma yin te/mtshon pa ni bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes/ mtshon byed ni rig sngags kyi rgyal mo'o/ /ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid can/ /sangs rgyas lnga'i dbu rgyan can/ spyan gsum zhal gsum phyag drug pa sku mdog ljang gu'o/ /zhal g.yas bumathing ga /g.yon dmar ba ste/ phyag g.yas pa gnyis na ral gri dang rdo rje rgya gram mo/ /g.yon pa gnyis na/ skyabs sbyin dang 'khor lo bsnams pa'o/ /phyag 'og ma'i g.yas g.yon gyis mda' gzhu 'gengs pa ste/ rgyan thams cad dang ldan pa'o/ /zhabs g.yas bskum pa/ g.yon brkyang ④ba/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs shing / nyi ma'i 'od dang ldan zhing bzhad pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi gsang sngags ni gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ bha ga hu mu le bha ga hu mu le/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa'o/ /rgyal po chen po rnam ⑧thos bu/ /mi la zhon pa sde bcas pa/ /zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo bsil ba'i tshal gyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di thos pa tsam gyis ⑨lus 'dar zhing 'jigs par gnas 36—1741

te—/ gnod sbyin gyi gdon stong phrag nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyang de bzhin no/ /'di smras nas ni tshub ma langs/ /de bzhin ri yang g.yos par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo bsil ba'i tshal 'di'i gzi brjid dang stobs kyis rlung tshub sna tshogs 'byung ste/ sa ni lan drug tu g.yos shing / dril bu'i skad bzhin du rings par snang ngo / /rgyal po chen po rnam ①thos bu'i/ /rin chen shing rta bcas pa na/ /zhes bya ba ni④/ byang ngos kyi rgyal po rnam ④thos kyi bu de yang gzugs sna tshogs bstan zhing / rin po che'i gdan la bzhugs rjonas/skad sna tshogs smra ba'o/ /lha dang mi yi sgra skad bsgragasame/ /rgyal po chen po mchis pa nabyu / /zhes bya ba ni/ lha dang mi'i gzugs su sprul zhing rdzu 'phrul chen po bstan blute/ skad sna tshogs kyang de bzhin du smras pa'o/ /dngos po rnams kyang 'bar 'gyur ro/ /srin po 'dod dgur bsgyur ⑧ba'i gzugs/ /zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo'i gsang sngags kyi dmod mo dang /gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po rnam thos kyi ⑨bu'i stobs kyis kyang / ma rungs pa'i srin po 'byung po rnams kyang dngos po rnams ni skrag par 'gyur ro/ /de yi mdun na rgyug par bkyid/ /mi ma yin pa'i gzugs rnams kyis/ /zhes bya ba ni/gzi brjid de mthong zhing 'jigs par byed cing phyir 'gro ba'o/ /'jigs shing skrag pa skyed par bkyid/ /che zhing gtum la mi bzad pa/ /zhes bya ba ni/'byung po de rnams kyi mtshan nyid ni/ sems can la 'tshe bar byed cing / rmi lam nyams pa la yang gzugs bstan zhing / 'jigs pa'i sgra sgrogs te rtag tu sems can la gnod par byed pa'o/ /drag cing mthong ⑩na mi sdug la/ /spu yang ring la sen mo ring / /zhes bya ba ni/ bzhin mi sdug cing lus dang 36—1742

gdong pa khra bor gnas te/ khab dang 'dra ba'i spus ni lus la khengs shing de bzhin du sder mo yang mtshon dang 'dra ba'o/ /lag na ral gri tho ba thogs/ /so ni zangs can 'jigs par bgyid/ /ces bya ba ni/ 'byung po de rnams ni khrag khrug la dga' zhing / phra ma ①byed pa la dga' ba ste/ de bzhin du khrag khrug byed pa'i sha khrag la dga' zhing 'jigs pa'i ral gri dang 'jigs pa'i zangs kyi so rnams kyis sems can la 'tshe bar byed pa'o/ /sna che rnga mo stag ②gi 'dra/ /drag cing lag pa khrag dmar ba/ /zhes bya ba ni/ 'byung po 'di rnams kyis kyang sna tshogs kyi gzugs bstan zhing / mi'i lus la mgo gcig pa bstan zhing bud med kyi mngal khrag la dga' zhing byis pa rnams la gnod par byed pa'o/ /yan lag ma tshang phyed tshal lus/ /mig ser lus kyang shin tu ser//zhes bya ba ni/ la la mgo bo med cing brang la gdong pa yod pa ste/ la la lag pa gcig med cing / mgo la gnas pa'o/ /tshan gcig la yang rkang pa gcig med cing / lte ba nas res snang res mi snang bar byed de/ la la phyed gzugs su snang zhing sems can rnams skrag par byed pa'o/ /dri ma can la lus skem pa/ /skra badze+es ①lcags kyi mchu can la/ /zhes bya ba ni keng rus la pags ④pas g.yogs pa dang 'dra ba dhiyod de/ de la drag pa chags shing bzhin mi sdug pa ste/ khab kyi rtse mo tsam kyi mchu la gsus pa yang ri tsam mo/ /de lta bu'i lus la skra bzang dhibadze+es pa'o/ /mtshon cha tshabs cher 'debs par bkyid/ /rna ba gzhu 'dra stobs po che/ /zhes bya ba ni/ 'thab mo la sbyar ⑦te/ gcig la gcig 'dzugs shing / 'khrug pa dpung dang bcas pa byas te/ de la mtshon cha tshabs cher ⑧'be+ebs pa zhes bya ba'o/ /rna ba gzhu 'dra ba yod cing 36—1743

bzhin mi sdug pa yin te/ de lta bu'i 'byung po rnams kyis kyang sems can rnams la drag por gnod pa'o/ /sbrul kyi gzugs can be+e'u'i gzugs/ /phag gi gzugs can lto bo che/ /zhes bya ba ni/ mi'i lus la mgo brnyan mi gcig pa ste/ rtag tu ltas dang rmi lam la yang de'i gzugs bstan lashe /rnam par rtog pa skye bar ④byed pa'o/ /de skyes pa dang nad drag pos mi ①tshugs te—/ nad kyis srog dang bral dubar byed pa'o/ /mgo bo che la lag ring ba/ /rna 'phyang po la nu ma 'phyang / /zhes bya ba ni/ tshan rjogacig 'dre mo'i gzugs yod de/ dpag tshad brgya'i bar nas kyang 'tshe bar byas shing sha khrag len nus te—/ bzhin mi sdug cing lag pa ring ba'i sbar dhimos 'debs pa'o/ /de 'dra'i gnod sbyin mang po yi⑦/ /g.yog 'khor dag gis yongs su bskor/ /zhes bya ba ni/ de dag ni rgyal po chen po rnam skethos kyi bu'i 'khor yin te/stobs che zhing mi srun te/ khams gsum tsam la 'gyur zhing dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal na gnas pa'o/ /gnod sbyin bye ba phrag stong rnams/ /de dag ma ni lam log can/ /zhes bya ba ni/ de dag ni byang phyogs na gnas pa ste/byang gi phyogs nas 'ongs nas/ tshan gcig phan bya dang gnod bya gnyis byed par 'ongs pa ste/ tshan gcig snying rje med cing ⑨sems can la 'tshe ba/tshan ⑩gcig snying rje dang ldan zhing sems can la grogs byed pa'o/ /g.yog 'khor de dag lhan cig tu/ /bdag ni phyag 'tshal slad du mchis/ /zhes bya ba ni/ de dag lta bu'i 'byung po rnams kyis kyang / bcom ldan 'das dang lhan cig tu 'khod cing gus pas ⑪phyag 'tshal ba'o/ /go tam dpa' bo khyod la ni—/ /chos bzhin mthun par lta zhing mchis/ /zhes bya ba ni/ sems can 36—1744

rnams la 'tshe bar mi byed de①/ chos dang ldan zhing snying rje skye ste/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo'i gzi brjid kyis 'tshe bar mi nus pa'o/ /drag cing rgod la gtum pa dang / /lto bo che la skra ring ba/ /zhes bya ba ni/ 'byung po de lta bu'i tshan gcig byung ste/ sdeg la mi 'dzem zhing sems can rnams la gnod par byed pa drag po'i tshul bstan nas/ phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhir 'gyu ②ba'o//mi rnams dang ni ri dwags dang / /bya rnams gzi brjid 'phrog par bkyid/ /ces bya ba ni/ tshan gcig grong ngam grong khyer du phyin cing mi rnams kyi lus la zhugs nas gzi brjid 'phrog pa ste/ tshan gcig ni ri dwags la sogs pa'i sems can la 'tshe bar byas nas srog 'phrog ste/ sems can rnams la ma rungs par byed pa'i 'byung po'o/ /me 'bar za dang mang du za/ /mig gcig pa dang mig ser dang / /zhes bya ba ni/ bzhin mi sdug cing gzugs sna tshogs bstan te/ sems can rnams la 'tshe bar byed cing ma'i mngal nas zhugs nas gzi brjid 'phrogs ①pa rnams so/ /sna dang rna ba bcad pa dang / /chad pa mang pos bcad pa dang / /zhes bya ba ni/ tshan gcig kyang sna dang rna ba bcad ④pa'i gzugs su byas nas/ sems can 'tshe bar byas te/ de rnams kyis kyang mi rnams kyi lus la zhugs nas ma rungs pa thams cad byed pa'o//gzhan rnams kyis kyang de'i 'bras bu sna dang rna ba dang / rkang pa dang /lag pa gcod pa'i chad pa byed par 'gyur ro/ /de yang 'byung po rnams kyis skyon byas pa yin no/ /mgo ma mchis dang mgo bcad dang / /lus kyang sgur la gnyer ⑤ma gdong / /zhes bya ba ni/ de rnams tshan gcig gis kyang sems canarnams la rmi lam dang / ltas dang / dngos por mthong bar byas te/36—1745

de'i rtog sdepas nad sna tshogs btang zhing sems can gyi srog 'phrog pa'o/ /de rnams ni ltas ngan gyi 'byung po rnams yin no/ /mig la me 'bar rkang phyed pa/ /mi rnams 'jigs par bgyid pa ste/ /zhes bya ba ni/ nags tshal lam/ dur khrod dam/ ri dang / lung stong la gnas pa ste/ sems can mi rnams kyis mthong bar gyur pa ⑤na ngo sbed pa ste/ 'byung po des sems can mthong na nyin mo gnod mi nus shing / mtshan mo'i rigs la cis kyang phan pa med cing srog 'phrog pa'o/ /'phel ①ka che la rgod bag can/ /de bzhin 'gro zhing rgyu bar bgyid—/ /ces bya ba ni/ 'phel rjoka che zhing mtshan rnams rgyu ba ste/ pho mo nyal ba'i dus su mnyan nas glags rnyed par gyur na lus la 'jug ste/ bdud kyi rigs su skyes nas pha ma rnams skrag par byed pa'o/ /de 'dra'i gnod sbyin mang po yi/ /g.yog 'khor dag gis yongs su bskor/ /zhes bya ba ni/bcom ldan 'das ga la buder 'byung po rnams kyis bskor te/ phyogs gcig tu 'khod de/ 'jig rten mgon gyi spyan sngar bsdad pa'o/ /gnod sbyin bye ba phrag stong rnams/ /de dag ma ni rkun bum lags/ /zhes bya ba ni/ de dag kun kyang dur khrod chen po bsel ba'i tshal na gnas shing / rgyal po chen po rnam ⑦thos kyi bu'i 'khor yin te/ de rnams kyang rig sngags kyi gzi brjid kyis 'khod pa'o/ /g.yog 'khor de dag ⑧lhan cig tu/ /bdag ni phyag 'tshal slad du mchis/ /zhes bya ba ni/ dpon g.yog de rnams kyis kyang /bcom ldan 'das la gus par byas nas/ phyogs gcig tu 'khod nas phyag 'tshal ba'o/ /go tam dpa' bo khyod la ni/ /chos bzhin mthun par lta zhing mchis—/ /zhes bya ba ni/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gi spyan sngar sems can 36—1746

rnams la 'tshe bar mi byed cing snying rje dang ldan te/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo bsil ba'i tshal gyi dmod mos 'tshe bar mi nus pa'o/ /bdag cag gi ①ni gnas 'di na④/ /shing rta zhes bgyi srin po mchis/ /zhes bya ba ni/ lho nub kyi mtshams na lang ka ①na gnas pas srin po'i tshogs mang po 'byung ste/ de rnams kyis kyang sems can rnams la gnod par byed cing 'bru rjogu'i nad rnams gtong ba'o/ /de la bu mo stobs ldan pa/ /stong phrag bcu yi grangs snyed bumachis—/ /zhes bya ba ni/ srin mo'i tshogs kyang de rnams 'byung rjoste/stobs dang ldan zhing rang gi kha dog tu snang ba de rnams kyis kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'khod pa'o/ /de dag bdag gi g.yog lags te/ /de dag phyag 'tshal slad du mchis/ /zhes bya ba ni/ bdag cag kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar g.yog du ma dang bcas nas mchis te/ sangs rgyas dang /chos dang / dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o zhes bya ba'o/ /go tam dpa' bo khyod la ni/ /chos bzhin mthun par lta zhing mchis/ /zhes bya ba ni/ 'jig rten bla ma'i spyan snga ru/ sems can rnams la snying rje dang ldan zhing 'tshe bar mi byed de/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo'i gzi brjid kyis sems can rnams la 'tshe bar mi byed pa'o/ /bdag cag gis ni gnas rnams na/ /mgrin rings zhes bya'i srin mo mchis/ /zhes bya ba ni/ lang ka mgrin bcu'i rigs mgo bcu gcig yod pa 'jigs su rung ba rnams 'byung ④ba'o/ /srin mo shin tu gnag ⑧pa dag /srin mo nag mo zhes bgyi dang / /zhes bya ba ni/ dpal lha mo dang /'khor g.yog yin te/ srin mo ral pa gcig pa rnams/ 'khor g.yog du ma dang bcas pa byung ste/ de rnams kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga ru'o/ /36—1747

srin mo rab gnas ①rnams mchis te/ /de dag go tam mthun par lta/ /zhes bya ba ni/ rgya mtsho'i 'gram na zangs ①gling zhes bya ba'i yul dze+en gnas te/de bas kyang gnag pa lnga brgya yod dedu/ de rnams kyis kyang sems can la 'tshe bar byas shing / bud med du brdzus nas gnod pa skyel ba'o/ /sa yi gnod sbyin bdag nyid che/ /de dag sa stengs ⑤gnas pa lta/ /zhes bya ba ni/ nor rgyun ma'i 'khor g.yog yin te/ de yang ljang ma mo dang / kun du bzang mo dang / 'od ldan ma la sogs pa yin te/ de rnams kyis kyang sems can la gnod par mi byed cing / phan pa sha stag ste/ sa la gnas shing sa la bdag byed pa'o/ /g.yog 'khor de dag rnams kyis ni/ /yongs su bskor te 'dir mchis lags/ /zhes bya ba ni/ srin po dang / srin mo dang / sa bdag mo la sogs pa 'khor g.yog du ma dang thabs cig tu bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar ro/ /de dag kun dang lhan cig tu/ /bdag ni phyag 'tshal slad du mchis//zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags dang / sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sems can la gnod par mi byed cing / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang thabs cig tu 'khod pa'o/ /go tam dpa' bo khyod la ni/ /chos bzhin mthun par lta zhing mchis/ /zhes bya ba ni/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi dbang phyug la bdag cag sems can rnams la 'tshe bar mi byed cing spyan sngar mchis pa'o/ /bdag gi mdun na rgyug pa yi/ /yi dwags gnod sbyin srin po rnams/ /zhes bya ba ni/ lus ngan po'i spyan sngar rgyug pa'i ma rungs pa byed ⑥pa la dga' ba'i 'khor tshan gcig yod de/ sdig la dga' zhing snying la mi sdug pa sha stag go/ /lus chen shugs kyang drag po dze+este/ /so yang che la lto 36—1748

bo che/ /zhes bya ba ni/ 'jig rten g.yo bar nus shing yud tsam gyis gang la yang khyab ste/ gzi brjid che zhing rbad pa la dga' ste/ de'i gzugs kyis sems can la gnod par byed pa'o/ /rna 'phyang 'jigs pa chen po ste/ /slob ①ma sna la rab tu 'phyang / /zhes bya ba ni/ glags btsal te dam tshig nyams pa la smad cing gnod pa che bar byas pa ste/ de rnams kyis kyang chad pa gcod cing drag ①shul bstan pa'o/ /yan lag drug pa so bstan ①pa/ /gur gum mdog can tho ba rjo'adra/ /zhes bya ba ni/ mgo bo drug phyag drug /rkang pa drug de bzhin du sprul pa ste/ mdog mdzes pa ste/ mche ba gcigs shing so gtsigs shing sems can rnams la ston par byed pa'o/ /so yang rtsub cing rno ba dang / /mdung thung rjogasal zhing 'jigs par bkyid/ /ces bya ba ni/sems can la gnod pa byed pa'i dus su ni mtshon cha sna tshogs bstan te/ so rno zhing sems can smad pa la dga' ba'o/ /glang chen mgo dang bum rna can/ /mgo bo seng ge stag dang 'dra/ /zhes bya ba ni/ gzugs sna tshogs par sprul zhing sems can rnams la 'jigs par byed pa ste/ de rnams mi srun zhing gnod par byed pa la dga' ba'o/ /lcags kyi so can lcags kyi skra/ /gdon rnams rnam par skrag bgyid pa/ /zhes bya ba ni/ mtshon gyi so dang khab kyi skra rjoste—/ de bzhin du lus po'i ba sru rnams kyang yin no/ /nang la nang 'thab 'dod cing sems can kyi lus la zhugs nas kyang de bzhin no/ /lag na lcags kyi gtun spyobu thogs/ /lag na lcags kyi tho ba thogs/ /zhes bya ba ni/gdon de rnams kyang 'thab pa'i dus su de bzhin te/ de'i tshul gyis bstan zhing ⑧sems can la 'thab rtsod rngod par byed pa'o/ /so rnon lag pa ring ba ste//36—1749

'jigs pa'i gzugs can lcags kyi mchu/ /zhes bya ba ni/ za ba'i dus su so rno ba/ /gnod par byed pa lag ①ring ba/ /yang na lag pa ring ba ni phyogs gcig na ②bsdad nas dpag tshad brgyar slebs ①pa'o/ /drag po'i tshul du bstan zhing mtshon gyi dumachu dang ldan pa'o/ /mgo bo che la skra g.yengs pa/ /nag cing mig ser sna zhom rjopa/ /zhes bya ba ni/ yan lag phra zhing bong thung ba ste/ mgo bo che la bzhin mi sdug ste/ sol ba'i mdog la mig la me 'bar te⑥—/ sna med cing sug sug byed pa de'i gzugs kyis gnod par byed pa'o/ /bum pa'i mgrin dang mig dmar ba/ /mig gcig pa dang lto bo che/ /zhes bya ba ni/ bum pa 'dra ba'i lba ba gsum yod pa ste/ de'i lus la mig dmar ba'o//mig gcig sbrul gyi mgo can te/ stobs dang ldan zhing sa bdag gi dze+egazugs su gnas pa'o/ /mchu 'phyang ⑧po dang lag gcig pa/ /rkang gcig pa dang rkang gnyis pa/ /zhes bya ba ni/ chu srin gyi mchu dang ldan pa/ lus la lag pa gcig med cing 'jigs su rung ba ste/ la la yang rkang pa re re yod cing gnyis gnyis 'grogs nas 'gro ba'o/ /gzhan yang khro bo'i tshul du yod pa la rkang pa gnyis dang ldan pa'o/ /kha med kha gnyis drag po ste/ /mi rnams rab tu 'jigs par bgyid/ /ces bya ba ni/ khab kyi kha la gsus po che ste/ kha yang kha ltag khung na yang kha yod pas kha gnyis yod pa ste/ de bzhin du mi rnams la yang gnod pa ste/ drag po'i tshul gyis gnod par byed pa'o/ /lag na 'khar ⑨ ba dbyug pa thogs/ /mdung rtse gsum pa drag cing 'jigs/ /zhes bya ba ni/ gdon ma rungs pa rnams la ni/ mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs shing mi rnams la 'jigs par byed pa ste/ de bzhin du 'tshe ba drag po byed 36—1750

pa'o—/ /skrag cing 'jigs par byed pa ste/ /gdon rnams rnam par skrag bgyid pa/ /zhes bya ba ni/ drag po'i tshul gyis gnod par byed de de bzhin du gdon sna tshogs kyis nad sna tshogs btang nas 'tshe bar byed pa'o/ /skrag par bgyid cing smra bar bgyid/ /sems kyang 'khrugs ①par byed pa ste/ /zhes bya ba ni/ nad kyis thebs shing lab lob smrar 'jug pa ste/ yang na sems can de smyos par byas nas sems gtong zhing kha'i kha bden smra ba'o/ /smyo bar bgyid cing rmongs par bkyid/ /de nas gzi brjid 'phrog par bkyid/ /ces bya ba ni/ gdon kyis btab pa de ni 'bog ste/ sems kyang gtong /de bzhin du ngag kyang med do/ /lus de yang nyon mongs shing dpal dang mi ldan te—/ de bzhin du gnod sbyin gyi gdon gyis btab pa'o/ /de dag 'jig rten 'jigs pa ste/ /stobs po che la brten par dka'abu/ /zhes bya ba ni/de bzhin du 'jig rten kyi ①khams thams cad la sems can gyis sems can la gnod par byas te/ 'jigs shing skrag ④par byed pa'i phyir na/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo bsil ba'i tshal la brten pa'o/ /stong phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi po/ /rgyal po chen po'i mdun na rgyug /ces bya ba ni/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon lus ngan po'i mdun du rgyug ste/ de dag 'jigs nas skyabs pyagasol ba'o/ /de 'dra'i gnod sbyin mang po yi/ /g.yog 'khor dag gis yongs su bskor/ /zhes bya ba ni/ lus ngan po dang thabs cig tu/ sangs rgyas ga la ba der 'khor dude/ gus par bskyed nas thabs cig tu'o/ /gnod sbyin bye ba stong phrag rnams/ /de dag phyag 'tshal slad du mchis/ /zhes bya ba ni/ 'khor g.yog bdag cag sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun la skyabs su mchis te/36—1751

gus par byas nas rig sngags la phyag 'tshal ba'o/ /go tam dpa' bo khyod la ni//chos bzhin mthun par lta zhing mchis/ /zhes bya ba ni/ bdud bzhi bcom pa la dpa' bo ste/ de bzhin du mun pa mun nag bsal ①te/ 'jig rten las 'das nas sems can rnams kyi don byed pa ste/ bdag cag gi sems kyis — sems can rnams la 'tshe bar mi byed de/ rig sngags bdag gis gzung bar ༄ bya—/ /sa ga lngas rjortsen zla ba dang / /seng ge sde dang rab gnon dang / /zhes bya ba ni/ de yang gnod sbyin kyi rjosde dpon nyi shu rtsa gnyis yin te/ de rnams kyi ming grangs ni gsang sngags che dang la ba rjol sogs pa'o/ /rig pa stobs chen nor bu dang / /zhes bya ba ni/ gsang sngags chen dang / la ba tsu la sogs pa'i bar nas 'di dag yin te/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon nyi shu rtsa gnyis de yang stobs dang ldan zhing gzi brjid che ba skeste/ kha dog dang ldan zhing rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa/ lha dang lha ma yin gyi rtsod pa las rtsod par nus sh+yite—/ gnod sbyin de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ⑩zhing / rig sngags la rjes su yi rang ba'o/ /'jog ⑪po nag po chen po dang / /la ba can dang rje'u gnyis/ /zhes bya ba ni/ klu'i rgyal po klu rigs bzhi yin te/ de dag kyang sa dang chu la gnas shing bstan pa bsrung ba'o/ /klu yi rgyal po sa srung bu—/ /yan lag chen po rdzu 'phrul che/ /zhes bya ba ni/ stobs dang ldan zhing kha dog dang ldan te/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ⑫zhing 'jigs pa med cing / gnod par mi byed pa'o/ /nam mkha' lding ni shugs chen ldan/ /'dab chags kun gyi mchog gyur pa/ /zhes bya ba ni/ nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po gser mig can yin te/ 'dab chags bya ba ⑫la gzugs che zhing stobs 36—1752

dang ldan pa'o/ /bya yi shugs kyis 'chi ①bgyid cing / /rgya mtsho kun du 'khrug par bkyid/ /ces bya ba ni/ sems can des klu'i sems can rnams la 'jigs par byed de/ de yang de dag rnams kyis kyang / /'tshe bar byed pa'i rgyu la gnas pa'o/ /lha dang lha min dri za rnams/ /'jigs bgyid pa dang dge ba'ang rung / /zhes bya ba ni/ phan byed dang gnod byed gnyis nus te/de rnams kyis kyang phan par byed pa dang / gnod par byed pa la gnas pa'o/ /ma dad pa dang dad pa rnams/ /de dag thams cad 'dir mchis te/ /zhes bya ba ni/ chos la gnas pa dang mi gnas pa gnyis sdig la 'dzem pa dang mi 'dzem pa gnyis yin te/ de dag rnams kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar mchis so/ /go tam dpa' bo khyod la ni/ /chos bzhin mthun par lta zhing mchis—/ /zhes bya ba ni/ ma rig pa la sogs pa bcom ldan 'das snel dpa' ba nyon mongs pas mi tshugs shing thugs rje dang ldan pa ste/ gdon de rnams kyang rig sngags kyi mthus chos dang ldan par gnas pa'o/ /'phrog ma zhes bya ①gnod sbyin morjo/ /'jigs par bgyid pa stobs chen mo/ /zhes bya ba ni/ rang gi bu tsha ni snying du sdug ste/ gzhan gyi bu tsha rnams 'jigs par byed cing / gnod byed nus pa ste/ des kyang byis pa rnams la 'jigs par byed cing srog 'phrog pa'o/ /de yi bu ni lnga brgya rnams/ /'jigs bgyid gnod sbyin mthu rtsal can/ /zhes bya ba ni/ 'phrog ma'i bu ste/ de rnams kyis kyang sems can la gnod par byed cing mngal nas rlag par byed de/ ma dang bu rnams kyang srog 'phrog pa'o/ /bdag nyid kyi ni g.yog lags te/ /de dag phyag 'tshal be+ed du mchis/ /zhes bya ba ni/ 'phrog ma'i bu lnga brgya dang /36—1753

'phrog ma dang bcas pa 'khor g.yog du ma gnas te/ de dag kyang sangs rgyas dang chos dang / dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol te/ de ltar bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der phyogs gcig tu gnas pa'o/ /go tam dpa' bo khyod la ni/ /chos bzhin mthun par lta zhing mchis/ /zhes bya ba ni/ nyon mongs pa rnams bcom zhing / de bzhin du de bcom ldan 'das ①la dpa' bo zhes bya ste/ sdig dang / dge ba dang bral ②zhing sangs rgyas pa'o/ /bdag cag gis kyang chos dang mthun par dge ba la gnas te/ sems can la snying rje bya zhing spyan sngar mchis pa'o/ /ma ga dhā ①na thams cad mthong / /ka shi na ni pad+ma 'chang / /zhes bya ba ni/ mngon sum du 'jig rten gsum la rdzu 'phrul gyis mthong ba duste/ stobs de dang ldan pa'i gnod sbyin ni rgya gar gyi ④dbus su'o—/ /yul ko dhishi ka nas kyang ⑦pad+ma 'chang gnas skete/ pad+ma bzhin du sbyan yod pa'i phyir na pad+ma 'chang ba'o/ /yangs pa can na rgyal mchog gnas/ /gyad yul na ni grags 'dzin gnas/ /zhes bya ba ni/ ma ga d+mā ⑨na gnod sbyin rgyal mchog gnas te/ de bzhin du gyad yul na yang de dang 'dra bar gnas pa ste—/ stobs che zhing gzi brjid dang ldan pa'o/ /rgyal po'i khab na kusnyi ⑩ra/ /ser skya'i gnas na drag po ste/ /zhes bya ba ni/ ri'i ⑪rgyal po'i khab kyi ded dpon ni gnod sbyin chen po ku— ra la sogs pa'o/ /de bzhin du ser skya'i yul na grags pa dang ldan ⑫pa'o/ /ta ma la ni 'byor pa gnas/ /mi thi la dang kun du rgyal/ /zhes bya ba ni/ mi thi la dang ta ma la gnyis ni ma ga sgyu'i ⑫lho phyogs yin te/ gnod sbyin chen po 'byor pa ④dang kun du rgyal gnas pa'o/ /ma mo chen mo 'di brgyad ni/ /gnod sbyin rnams kyi sde dpon mchog /ces bya 36—1754

ba ni/ 'jig rten gyi ma mo brgyad yin te/ de yang 'di dag gi ①ming ni 'joms pa'i dngos grub dang / keng rus can dang / tshangs chen ma dang /nag mo chen mo dang / gzhon nu mo dang / rnam rgyal mo dang / drag mo dang /khyab 'jug mo dang brgyad do/ /de rnams ni 'jig rten gyi mar gyur cing mi srun gnod sbyin rnams kyi bdag mo'o/ /rdzu 'phrul chen mo skal ba che/ /stobs chen de dag thams cad ni/ /zhes bya ba ni/ skad cig mas 'jig rten khams la 'gyu ste/ kha dog ldan zhing gtor ma rnams len par byed pa'o/ /gzhan rnams kyis kyang mchod par 'os shing gtor ma len du gtang ba'o/ /yid ①dge dad pa'i sems dang ldan/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la skyabs mchis pa/ /zhes bya ba ni/ glo bur gyi dad pa ma yin pa snga snenas kyang dad pa dang ldan te/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung zhing rig sngags kyi chos la gus par byas te/sangs rgyas dang chos dang / dge 'dun la rjes su yi rang zhing skyabs su 'gro ba'o—/ /de dag dang ni 'dus nas kyang / /rgyal po chen po stobs chen gyis/ /zhes bya ba ni/ rgyal po chen po rnam rjothos kyi bu yang stobs dang ldan te/ de dag kyang dbang du 'du zhing sems can rnams la 'tshe bar mi byed pa'o/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas bstan la/ /mi rnams la ni snying brtse slad/ /ces bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi rjogazi brjid la brten nas/ rig sngags kyi dmod mo'i 'jigs pas 'jig rten gyi khams kyi mi rnams bu'ajigs par mi byed cing / snying rje skye ba'o/ /gnod sbyin 'byung po yi dwags dang / /sdang ba'i gdon rnams bzlog pa dang / /zhes bya ba ni/ sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa thams cad sangs rgyas kyi bka' dang rig sngags kyi gzi brjid kyis gnod sbyin 36—1755

'byung po'i gdon rnams zlog ①par byed cing / de rnams kyis kyang mi tshugs pa'o—/ /mi ma yin rnams bzlog pa yi/ /bsrung ①ba 'di ni legs par bgyis①//zhes bya ba rgo/ srung ba'i dam pa spod rjogatong dang / rig pa dang / sngags dang / de rnams bzlog pa ste/ de bzhin du 'byung po dang / yi dwags la sogs pa zlog ⑤par byed pa'o/ /de nas rgyal po rnam rjothos bu/ /thal sbyar 'dug ste smras pa ni/ /zhes bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der rgyal po chen po rnam ⑦thos bus/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das la thal mo sbyar nas zhus pa'o/ /khon dang 'jigs pa ⑧kun 'das pa—/ /rnam grol zag pa mi mnga' ba/ /zhes bya ba ni/ shes bya'i dri ma dang /bag chags kyi dri ma mi gnas shing / 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad bcom ste—/ 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral bar byed pa dam pa'i dam pa'o/ /go tam dpa' bo khyod la ni/ /chos bzhin mthun par lta zhing mchis/ /zhes bya ba ni/ 'jig rten gyi khams la dbang mdzad cing / bgegs thams cad bcom pa ste/ de bcom pas na/ dpa' bo zhes bya ba'o/ /go tam la phyag 'tshal skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /khyod la lha dang grub pa ⑨dang / /bram ze thams cad phyag 'tshal te/ /zhes bya ba ni/ mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa la ⑩phyag 'tshal te/ 'jig rten pa'i stong spyi phud kyi bdag po yin te/ yang na bram ze phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bya ba ni/ tshangs par spyod pa'i dbang po de la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchis zhes bya'o⑪/ /gnod sbyin bye ba drug khri dang / /bzhi stong dag kyang lhags nas ni/ /zhes bya ba ni/ gzugs sna tshogs bstan pa—/ sna tshogs kyi lta ba yod pa/ gnod byed dang phan byed gnyis yod pa/36—1756

sdig pa dang / dge ba byed pa sha stag bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar mang po ⑨'dus pa'o/ /kho ra khor yug yongs bskor nas/ /thal mo sbyar te 'khod gyur lags—/ /zhes bya ba ni/ dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal kyi sa gzhi la/ gnod sbyin 'byung po rnams pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga ④sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar phyogs ④nas bskor zhing thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /bdag ni rgyal po rnam thos bu/ /byang phyogs skyong bar bgyid pa ste/ /zhes bya ba ni/ rgyal po rnam rjothos kyi bus kyang gnod sbyin chen po 'khor g.yog dang bcas shing byang phyogs na srung dhibar bkyid pa'o/ /'jig rten mgon po'i nye skor dhidu/ /gnod sbyin rgyu ba smyo byed dang / /zhes bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der gza' dang rgyu skar dang bcas shing bzhin sdug pa dang / mi sdug pa rnams kyis bskor te/ 'byung po mang po spyan sngar 'dus pa'o/ /brjed byed dang ni ⑦mi'am ci/ / skem byed dang ④ni rims drag dang / /zhes bya ba ni/ glo bur du nad gtong ba dang / glo bur du bar chod byed pa 'di rnams yin te/gzi brjid 'phrog pa 'di rnams kyang / bcom ldan 'das kyi sbyan sngar gnas pa'o—/ /de bzhin rims rnams zhag bzhi pa/ /de dag bdag gis ⑨bzlog par bgyi/ /zhes bya ba ni/ rgyal po chen po rnam ⑩thos kyi bus/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo baṅgal ba'i tshal gyi gzi brjid kyis/ rims nad la sogs pa nad rigs mi gcig pa bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zlog ⑪par byed pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo bsil ba'i tshal gyi/ 'byung po mang po rigs brtag pa'i gnas skabs te drug pa'o// //36—1757

bsil ba'i tshal gyi rig sngags zhes bya ba 'di ni/ gang zhe na/ las kyi rigs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs ni/ mtshon pa ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so/ /mtshon byed ni rig sngags kyi rgyal mo bsil ba'i tshal lo/ /gzugs kyi phung po ste/ khams ni sa'i khams so/ /skye mched ni mig ste/ rang bzhin ni ye shes lnga'o/ /sangs rgyas lnga'i dbu rgyan can/ spyan gsum pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhal gsum pa/ phyag drug pa/ sgu mdog dkar mo—/ zhal g.yas mthing ga /g.yon dmar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gnyis na ral gri dang / 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gnyis na dgra sta dang rtse gsum/ 'og ma'i g.yas g.yon gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'gengs pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum pa/g.yon brkyang ①ba/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs ②shing nyi ma'i 'od dang bcas pa ste/ zhi ba'i tshul du bzhugs pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi gsang sngags kyi tshig ni gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ u ha haṃ zhes bya ba la sogs pa'o/ /rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu lus ngan lcang lo can kyi bdag po phyogs skyong bar gyur cig ces bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' ①rig sngags kyi byin rlabs rjokyis sangs rgyas rnams kyi bstan pa srung ste⑤/ byang phyogs skyong zhing sems can rnams kyi don byed pa'o/ /lha'i rgyal po nor lha'i bu zhes bkyi ba mchis te zhes bya ba ni/ sems can rnams la don byed cing / rnam thos kyi bu la phyag 'tshal te/ de bzhin ramye'abyung po rnams kyis kyang skyabs su mchi zhes bya'o/ /de la bdag kyang phyag 'tshal zhes bya ba ni/ gnod sbyin 'byung po rnams kyis phyag 'tshal ba'o/ /de yang bcom ldan 'das nyid la phyag 'tshal te zhes bya ba ni/'jig rten dbang phyug sems can gyi don la sprul pa'i skus khyab pa de la bdag 36—1758

gis phyag 'tshal zhes bya ba'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpa' bo ste/ /kun mkhyen kun gzigs khyod la 'dud/ /ces bya ba ni/ shes bya dang bag chags kyi sgrib pa 'joms shing / 'jig rten gyi rnam par rtog ①pa grol zhing / rgyal ba rnam par rgyal na ②sangs rgyas so/ /'jig rten kun ④'jigs skyob pa khyod la 'dud do zhes bya'o/ /yang dag dpa' bo khyod la 'dud/ /chos bzhin mthun par lta zhing mchis/ /zhes bya ba ni/ phyin ci ma log cing nges par bdud bzhi bcom pa ste/ yang dag pa'i ye shes thob cing / sems can kyi don mdzad pa'o/ /de lta bu'i gzi brjid kyis bdag kyang sems can la snying rje byas shing spyan sngar mchis so zhes bya ba'o/ /de nas zhes bya ba ni/ rnam thos kyi bu'i tshig gi de nas so/ /rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung rjo/ /thal sbyar 'dug ste smras pa ni/ /zhes bya ba ni/ shar phyogs kyi rgyal po dri za thams cad la dbang mdzad pa/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs ⑤pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar thal mo sbyar nas zhu ba'o④/ /chos kyi rgyal po 'od mdzad pa—/ /sangs rgyas dpal la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhes bya ba ni/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong 'jig rten la bshad nas sku mya ngan las 'das te/chos de'i 'od zer 'jig rten gyi khams rnams la khyab ste/ de bzhin du de sangs rgyas shing snying rje che la bdag gis phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba'o/ /go tam dpa' bo khyod la ni/ /chos bzhin mthun par lta zhing mchis/ /zhes bya ba ni/'jig rten gyi khams thams cad spangs shing bdud rnams btul ba ste/ de bzhin du 'khor ba'i mun nag sel zhing sangs rgyas pa'o/ /de lta bu'i chos kyi gzi brjid kyis bdag cag dri za rnams ni sems can rnams la snying rje byas shing 36—1759

spyan sngar mchis so/ /go tam khyod kyis gang mkhyen pa/ /de ni lha rnams ma 'tshal to①/ /zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo bsel ba'i tshal gyi ye shes de ni bdag cag rnams kyis mi shes te/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ rang bzhin dang bral ba/ skye ba med pa'i rang bzhin no/ /srin po mthong na rab 'jigs pa—/ /stong phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi rnams/ /zhes bya ba ni/ bzhin mi sdug pa dang / sdug pa rnams dri za srin po ④mang po 'dus pa'o/ /kho ra khor yug yongs bskor nas/ /thal mo sbyar te 'khod gyur lags/ /zhes bya ba ni/'jigs su rung ba dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal la/ srin po'i gdon dang dri za'i gdon rnams kyis phyogs bzhi nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs ④te—/ thal mo sbyar nas 'jig rten mgon po la'o/ /bdag rgo rgyal po yul 'khor srung / /shar phyogs skyong bar bgyid pa ste/ /zhes bya ba ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bubastan pa srung mezhing / rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' ste/ rig sngags 'di 'chang ④ba'i gang zag la shar phyogs skyong bar bgyid cing sems can kyi don byed pa'o/ /'jig rten mgon po'i nye 'khor du/ /srin po rnams dang sha za dang / /zhes bya ba ni/ de bzhin du rig sngags kyi gzi brjid kyis sangs rgyas kyi bka' las mi 'da' zhing / de rnams kyis kyang skyong bar byed pa'o/ /dri za dang ni rlung lha rnams/ /de dag bdag gis bzlog par bgyi/ /zhes bya ba ni/ dri za'i rgyal po yul 'khor srung gis kyang / sbod ④gtong dang rig pa dang / sngags dang ma rungs pa'i 'byung po rnams bzlog cing rig sngags la gus par byed pa ste/ rig sngags kyi ngo bo ni gang zhe na/ las kyi rigs kyi rin chen rigs/ mtshon pa ni mnyam 36—1760

pa nyid kyi ye shes te/ mtshon byed ni rig sngags kyi rgyal mo bsil ba'i tshal lo//ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin sangs rgyas lnga'i dbu rgyan can/ spyan gsum pa/rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhal gsum pa/ phyag drug pa/ sku mdog ser mo/ phyag g.yas pa gnyis na ral gri dang rin po che/ g.yon pa gnyis na pad+ma dang 'khor lo bsnams pa'o/ /de'i 'og ma g.yas g.yon gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'gengs pa'o/ /zhabs g.yas pa ①bskum pa/ g.yon pa ②brkyang ba/pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs shing / nyi ma'i 'od dang ldan zhing sgeg pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi gsang sngags kyi tshig ni gang zhe na/'di lta ste/ i ṭi mi ṭi la sogs rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung phyogs skyong bar gyur cig ces bya ba ni/ shar phyogs su skyong ba ste/ rig sngags 'di la bka' stsaX zhing ④/ sems can don la skyong ba'o/ /srin po dang zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni/ shar phyogs na gnod par byed pa de rnams ni/ rgyal po chen po ④yul 'khor srung rig sngags kyi gzi brjid kyis de rnams shar phyogs nas byung ba zlog rjopa'o/ /lha'i nang na lha'i rgyal po nor lha'i bu zhes bgyi ba mchis te zhes bya ba ni/ dri za'i rgyal po yul 'khor srung la skyabs su mchi sterjo/ shar phyogs kyi mnga' bdag la phyag 'tshal lo⑦/ /de la phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba ni/ shar phyogs na yod pa'i 'byung po rnams kyis phyag 'tshal ba'o/ /de yang bcom ldan 'das nyid la phyag 'tshal ba ste zhes bya ba ni/ bzhi bcom drug ldan/ de lta bu'i sangs rgyas la bdag cag rnams kyis phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpa' bo ste/ /kun mkhyen kun gzigs khyod la 'dud/ /ces bya ba ni/ rnam par rtog pa thams cad dang bral zhing 'dod pa'i yon tan 36—1761

lnga bcom ste/ de lnga dang bral nas mya ngan las 'das pa'o/ /de lta bu'i sangs rgyas ①kun nas kun du gzigs ②pa bcom ste/ de yang 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa bcom pa'o/ /yang dag dpa' bo khyod la 'dud/ /chos bzhin mthun par lta zhing mchis/ /zhes bya ba ni/ phyin ci ma log cing rig sngags kyi ngo bo nyid bstan to④/ /de'i ye shes kyis nyon mongs pa thams cad bcom ste/de lta bu'i ④chos la mthun par rjobyas shing sems can rnams la 'tshe bar mi byed pa'orka/ /de nas zhes bya ba ni/ yul 'khor srung gi tshig gi de nas so/ /rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po'odu/ /thal sbyar 'dug ste smras pa ni/ /zhes bya ba ni/ rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes pos kyang stan las langs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas thal mo sbyar te zhes bya ba'o/ /'jig rten mgon po skyabs mdzad pa/ /'jig rten kun la phan par mdzad/ /ces bya ba ni/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten kyi khams la sprul pa'i skus khyab ste/ de rnams la byams pa dang snying rjes ④gzigs nas sdug bsngal thams cad 'joms pa'i thabs la mkhas pa'o/ /gau tam dpa' bo khyod la ni/ /chos bzhin mthun par lta zhing mchis/ /zhes bya ba ni/ nyon mongs pa rnams bcom zhing dpa' ba ste/ sku gsung thugs thams cad ma lus par sangs rgyas pa de'i chos bzhin grul bum bdag cag gis mchis te/ sems can la 'tshe bar mi byed cing snying rje'i sems dang ldan pa'o//grul bum yi dwags srul po rnams/ /stong phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi ni/ /zhes bya ba ni / lho phyogs na grul bum gdon rigs mi gcig pa 'byung ste/ srun pa dang mi srun pa sha stag mang po 'dus pa'o/ /kho ra khor yug yongs bskor ⑧nas//36—1762

thal mo sbyar te 'khod gyur lags/ /zhes bya ba ni phyogs phyogs nas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas bcom ldan 'das la gus pas thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /bdag ni rgyal po 'phags skyes po/ /lho phyogs skyong bar bgyid pa ste/ /zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' ste/ gang zag rig sngags 'chang ba'i de la lho phyogs skyong bar byed pa'o/ /'jig rten mgon po'i nye 'khor du/ /'byung po rgyu ba gzi brjid 'phrog /ces bya ba ni ma rungs pa'i 'byung po rnams kyis kyang bar du gcod cing gzi brjid 'phrog pa ste/ drag shul gyis ni gnod pa ①byed pa'o—/ /grul bum yi dwags srul po rnams/ /de dag bdag gis bzlog par bgyi④—/ /zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' dang / rig sngags kyi rdzu 'phrul kyis grul bum gyi gdon bzlog pa dang sbod ④gtong dang / sngags dang /rig pa rnams bzlog ste/ de yang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo'i rig pas bzlog pa'o//rig sngags kyi rgyal mo'i ngo bo ni gang zhe na/ las kyi rigs kyi pad+ma'i rigs so/ /rig sngags 'di'i mtshon pa ni/ so sor rtog dupa'i ye shes so/ /mtshon byed ni rig sngags bdag nyid do/ /phung po ni 'du shes kyi phung po ste/ khams ni me'i khams so/ /skye mched ni lce ste/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas lnga'i dbu rgyan can/ spyan gsum pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/zhal gsum pa phyag drug pa/ sku mdog dmar mo/ phyag g.yas pa gnyis na ral gri dang pad+ma/ g.yon pa gnyis na lcags kyu dang zhags pa/ 'og ma'i g.yas g.yon gnyis kyis ⑤mda' gzhu 'gengs pa'o/ /zhabs g.yas bskum pa/g.yon brkyang ba/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs rjoshing nyi ma'i 'od zer 36—1763

dang ldan pa ste/ cung zad khro bo'i tshul du bzhugs pa'o/ /rig sngags dang gsang sngags kyi tshig ni gang zhe ①na/ 'di lta ste/ a le i le ②le la sogs pa'o—/ /rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po phyogs skyong bar gyur cig ces bya ba ni/yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bka' dang / rig sngags dang gsang sngags kyi tshig gis rig sngags 'dzin pa'i gang zag dang sems can thams cad la rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes pos rig sngags kyi dam las ma ①'da' bar bsrungs pa'o④/ /grul bum dang zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni/ rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes pos kyang lho phyogs skyong zhing nad thams cad 'joms shing grul bum la sogs pa'i yi dwags zlog ⑤par byed cing / rig sngags 'chang gi rjogang zag la skyong bar byed pa'o/ /lha'i nang na lha'i rgyal po nor lha'i bu zhes bkyi ba mchis te zhes bya ba ni/ rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po lho phyogs skyong bar mchis te/ de la bdag gis phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /de la bdag phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba ni/ grul bum gyi gdon la sogs pa 'byung po rnams kyis phyag 'tshal ba'o/ /de yang bcom ldan 'das nyid la phyag 'tshal te zhes bya ba ni/ bdud bzhi bcom zhing sangs rgyas te/ ye shes mnyam pa nyid kyis sems can thams cad la snying rjes khyab ste/ de lta bu'i ye shes ldan pa'i sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal zhes bya ba'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpa' bo ste/ /kun mkhyen kun gzigs khyod la 'dud/ /ces bya ba ni/ nyon mongs pa rnams 'dul zhing 'jig rten gyi bya ba bor nas mun pa'i mun nag sel te/ de lta bu'i 'khor ba bzhag nas sangs rgyas te/ lus ngag yid yang dag par rdzogs pa'o/ /de'i ye shes kyis kun nas kun du nyon mongs pa rnams la sprul 36—1764

ba'i skus 'jig rten gyi khams la khyab ste/ de rnams kyis 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral bar byed cing 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa'i thabs la mkhas pa'o/ /yang dag dpa' bo khyod la 'dud/ /chos bzhin mthun par lta zhing mchis/ /zhes bya ba ni/ nyon mongs pa lnga bcom zhing dpa' ba ste/ phyin ci ma log pa ye shes thob cing / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la 'dud pa ste/bdag cag grul bum gyi gdon ①la sogs pa'i rig sngags kyi rgyal mo bsel ba'i tshal gyi gzi brjid kyis sems can la 'tshe bar mi byed cing snying rje dang ldan pa'o//de nas zhes bya ba ni/ 'phags skyes po'i tshig gi ②de nas so/ /rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang / /thal sbyar 'dug ste smras pa ni/ /zhes bya ba ni/ rgyal po chen po de yang stan las langs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ thal mo sbyar nas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa'o—/ /mun par gyur pa'i 'jig rten la/ /bcom ldan lam rnams ston mdzad pa/ /zhes bya ba ni/ ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis ye shes de yang nus te/de'i ye shes brtan par byed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas bsten ①pa'o/ /go tam dpa' bo bukhyod la nirjo/ /chos bzhin mthun par lta zhing mchis/ /zhes bya ba ni/ bdud bzhi bcom pas na dpa' bo ste/ de bcom zhing ye shes thob pa ste/ bdag cag klu rnams kyang sems can gyi don byed cing snying rje la gnas pa'o/ /'jig rten dag na rjonyi zla 'dra/ /rin chen snying po stobs po che/ /zhes bya ba ni/ rang gi ⑦ye shes shar te/ de'i ye shes kyang thams cad la khyab pa'o/ /de bzhin du nyi zla yang rang gi 'od zer gyis snang ba'o/ /de'i 'od zer thob cing yid bzhin kyi nor bu rin po che lta bu 36—1765

ste—/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che de yang / 'jig rten gyi khams so/ /klu dang mkha' lding gsang ba pa/ /stong phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi rnams/ /zhes bya ba ni/ klu'i rgyal po mig mi bzang dang / klu'i gdon sa bdag la sogs pa nub phyogs nas mang po 'dus te/ de rnams kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar ro/ /kho ra khor yug yongs bskor nas/ /thal mo sbyar te 'khod gyur lagasaske/ /zhes bya ba ni/ gdon de rnams kyis kyang / dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal la bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der phyogs bzhi nas bskor nas/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar thal mo sbyar nas zhu ba 'bul ba'o zhes bya ba'o/ /bdag ni rgyal po mig mi bzang / /nub phyogs skyong bar bgyid pa ste/ /zhes bya ba ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bka' rig sngags kyi gzi brjid kyis rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang gis kyang klu'i gdon srung ba'i don du/ nub phyogs skyong bar bgyid do zhes bya ba'o—/ /'jig rten mgon po'i nye ①'khor du/ /klu dang mkha' lding gsang ba pa—/ /zhes bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der rgyal po mig mi bzang dang / srin po'i gdon dang / sa bdag la sogs pa bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'khod nas/ sems can rnams la gnod par bgyid do zhes pa'o/ /lha min dbang po stobs po che/ /de dag bdag gis bzlog par bgyi⑧/ /zhes bya ba ni/ sa bdag gi gdon la sogs pa/ gsang ba po dang klu rnams kyang rig sngags kyi dmod mos gnod par byed pa'i ①gdon dang / sbod rjogatong dang / sngags dang /rjo gzhan rmi rjorig pa dang / de rgyal po mig mi bzang gis kyang de rnams zlog ⑦par byed pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi rdo rje ni gang zhe na/36—1766

las kyi rigs kyi rdo rje'i rig ①ma ste/ mtshon pa rgo me long lta bu'i ye shes te/mtshon byed ni rig sngags kyi rgyal mo'i bdag nyid do/ /phung po ni rnam par shes pa'i phung po ste/ khams ni nam mkha'i khams so/ /skye mched ni yid kyi skye mched do/ /rang bzhin ni ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas lnga'i dbu rgyan can/ spyan gsum pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhal gsum pa/phyag drug pa/ sku mdog mthing ga /zhal g.yas dkar ba/ g.yon dmar ba/phyag g.yas gnyis na ral gri dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis na zhags pa ②rdo rje rgya gram—/ de'i 'og ma gnyis mda' gzhu 'gengs pa'o/ /zhabs g.yas bskum pa/g.yon brkyang ba/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs shing nyi ma'i 'od dang ldan pa/ khro bo'i tshul du bzhugs pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi gsang sngags kyi tshig ni gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ ṭa ka ge ṭa ka ge zhes bya ba la sogs pa'o/ /rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang phyogs skyong bar gyur cig ces bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' dang / rig sngags kyi gzi brjid kyis/ rgyal po ⑦spyan mi bzang gis kyang / nub phyogs skyong zhing sems can gyi don mdzad pa'o/ /klu dang zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni/ klu'i gdon rnams kyis kyang nad sna tshogs btang rjozhing sems can rnams la gnod pa skyel zhing srog rjogacod pa ste/ de'i gzi brjid 'phrog 'dod pa dang / rig sngags kyi dmod mos rgyal po chen po buspyan mi bzang gis de rnams 'joms par byed pa'o/ /lha'i nang na lha'i rgyal po nor lha'i bu zhes bgyi ba mchis te zhes bya ba ni/ nub phyogs kyi rgyal po srun mi bzang dang / yang dag thabs cig tu gzi brjid che zhing stobs che ba/ kha dog dang ldan zhing rdzu 'phrul dang ldan te/ lha dang lha ma yin gyi rtsod pa la yang ⑦36—1767

rtsod par nus pa de rnams la yang bdag gis skyabs su mchi①/ de la bdag phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba ni/ klu'i gdon dang / gsang ba po rnams kyis ⑧phyag 'tshal ba'o/ /de yang bcom ldan 'das nyid la phyag 'tshal te zhes bya ba ni/bzhi ①bcom zhing phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan te/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyis kyang 'jig rten gyi khams la khyab cing thugs rje'i spyan gyis lta ba'i bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal zhes bya ba'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpa' bo ste/ /kun mkhyen kun gzigs khyod la 'dud/ /ces bya ba ni/ shes bya'i sgrib pa dang / bag chags kyi sgrib pa de nyid spangs pa'o/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs rdzogs pas na rjordzogs pa ste/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba thams cad spangs nas sangs rgyas pa'o/ /go ta ma yang bdag cag gis kyang / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bka' dang / rig sngags kyi gzi brjid kyis rjorgyal po chen po srun mi bzang dang gdon de rnams kyis kyang snying rje dang ldan zhing /sems can gyi don mdzad pa'o/ /de nas zhes bya ba ni/ rgyal po chen po spyan mi bzang gi tshig gis de nas so/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar ⑦nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ thal mo sbyar nas zhes bya ba ni/ 'jigs su rung ba ⑦dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal gyi nang du yul 'khor srung sgedang / 'phags skyes po dang / spyan mi bzang dang / lus ngan po dang / rgyal po rngubazhi po dag gis ⑩bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der bcom ldan 'das la bskor nas/ bcom ldan 'das la zhu ba 'bul ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'ba' zhig la phyag 'tshal zhing zhes bya ba ni/ rgyal po chen po bzhi po dag gis kyang / bskor ba lan gsum byas nas yang nas yang du phyag 36—1768

'tshal ba'o/ /gros mthun pa dang / tshig mthun pa dang / skad mthun par bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to zhes bya ba rgo/ rgyal po de dag gis dbyangs gcig tu byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das la zhu ba 'bul ba'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das zhes bya ba ni/ rgyal po chen po bzhis bcom ldan 'das la zhu ba 'bul ba'i ①tshig go/ /bsel ba'i tshal gyi mdo chen po 'di rgyal po chen po bzhis gsungs pa ②ste/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs pa/ de bzhin du 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba shākya thub pas gsungs te/ gzi brjid che zhing stobs che ba/ byams pa dang / snying rje dang / dga' ba dang / btang snyoms dang ldan pa/thabs shes rab gnyis su med cing / 'khor ba bcom pa/ rgyal po chen po bzhi po dag gis kyang yi ①dam du bzung ba'o/ /'khor bzhi po rnams la yongs su khyab pa lags buso zhes bya ba ni/ dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma'am/⑤ gzhan yang lha dang / mi dang de na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi dag gis kyang rig sngags kyi gzi brjid kyis/ bsrung rjob dang yongs su bskyab ⑦pa dang /yongs su gzung ⑧ba dang / yongs su zhi ba dang / mtshams gcad ⑨pa dang /dug gsad ⑩pa dang / dug zhi ba dang / chad pa gcod pa dang / bde legs su gyur cig ces bya ba'o/ /gnod sbyin dang srin po nas gnod pa bgyid pa'i bar du zlog ⑪par bgyid pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi gzi brjid kyi mthus ma rungs pa'i 'byung po rnams dang / sngags dang phyag rgya dang /gzhan gyi sbod gtong gtang ⑫ba dang / rig pa dang / khrag khrug dang /36—1769

dus ma yin par 'chi ba rnams bzlog pa'o/ /de yang rgyal po ①bzhis kyang rig sngags kyi gzi brjid kyis bzlog pa'o/ /'khor bzhi po rnams la srung sdeb dang zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni/ bde bar gnas shing yang dag pa'i ye shes thob ste/gal te 'jig rten gyi khams su skye bar 'gyur na/ rig pa 'di dang ma bral ①zhing nam skye ba'i dus su dran par 'gyur zhing / bde ba phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi po dag gis kyang de bzhin du srung dub dang /skyob pa la sogs pa byed par 'gyur ro/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang zhes bya ba niske/ de dag ni rgyal po chen po bzhi po de ⑤dag gis smras pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po chen po bzhi la 'di skad ces bka' 20 to zhes bya ba ni/byams pa dang / snying rje dang / btang snyoms kyis khyab pa'i sems kyis sems can kyi don la rgyal po chen po bzhi la bka' sprul pa'o/ /kye rgyal po chen po dag /rig sngags kyi rgyal po chen po bzung zin no zhes bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang rgyal po chen po byin gyis brlabs nas rig sngags 'dzin du bcug rjopa dang / dran par byed pa dang / rig sngags kyi tshig rgyal po chen po bzhi'i zhal nas smras par ⑦bgyid pa'o/ /bsil ba'i tshal gyi mdo chen po ngas yongs su bzung zin no zhes bya ba ni/ bskal pa grangs med pa'i sngon rol ⑧du rig sngags kyi rgyal mo bsil ba'i tshal 'di dag ⑨thugs la bzung ste/ de bzhin du gsung ⑩dang skus kyang yin no/ /de bas na yongs su bzung ⑩ngo zhes bya ba'o/ /kye rgyal po chen po dag ces bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑫rgyal po chen po bzhi la yang nas yang du bka' stsaX pa'o/ /gzhan yang ngas kyang babil ba'i tshal gyi mdo chen po rjes su yi rang ba'i zhes bya ba ni/ 'das pa'i 36—1770

sangs rgyas 'od srungs la sogs pa bsam gyis ①mi khyab pas rjes su yi rang zhing /'di gsungs pa'o/ /de bzhin du ma 'ongs pa rnams kyang gsung bar ②'gyur te/de yang byams pa la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsung bar ①'gyur ba'o/ /da ltar bdag gis kyang rjes su yi rang zhing gsungs pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo brjod kyis de legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung shing ④dang ngas brjod do zhes bya ba ni/ gnyug ma'i rang bzhin gzhan gyi dri mas ma gos pa ste/ rang bzhin med cing rnam par dag pa/srid pa dang / mya ngan las 'das pa med cing nam mkha' bzhin du khyab pa ste/de lta bu'i rig pa nyon mongs pa rnams kyis zung shig rjobacom ldan 'das kyis bshad do zhes bya'orjo/ /bcom ldan 'das ⑦de ltar 'tshal zhes bya ba ni/ gnyug ma'i rang bzhin/⑧ stong pa nyid kyi don 'di rgyal po chen po bzhis kyang bzung nas/ 'khor ba na 'khyams nas yod pa nyon mongs pa rnams la ston par bgyid do zhes bya ba'o/ /rgyal po chen po bzhis bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' la mnyan to zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags 'di'i cho ga ⑨ni ngo bo ⑪dang bral zhing rang bzhin med de/ de lta bu'i ye shes kyi tshig ni mnyan to zhes bya ba'o/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo bsil ba'i tshal gyi las kyi rigs lnga bshad pa'i gnas skabs te bdun pa'o // //⑪ de nas ⑫zhes bya ba ni rgyal po chen po bzhi la gtad pa'i de nas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑫phyag rin po che g.yas pas na bza' chos gos phye nas 'byung po'i tshogs de dag la bka' stsal to zhes bya ba nas④/ rdo rje seng ge'i 36—1771

pad+ma chen po'i khri la rdo rje skyil krung du ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa bshig nas—/ skyabs ①sbyin kyi phyag rgya bstan pa'o/ /chos gos de phye ④ba'i rgyu mtshan ni—/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo bsil ba'i tshal bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs shing / 'byung po rnams rlag par byed pa'o/ /de'i phyir na chos gos phye ①ba zhes bya ba'o/ /rin chen ④phyag gis skyabs sbyin bstan pa ni/yid bzhin kyi nor bu rin po che bzhin du yod de/ de lta bu'i chos kyi nyams stsong sems can thams cad sangs rgyas shing / sdig can bdud kyi rig sngags ⑤la mi 'jigs pa bstan pa'o/ /sor mo re re la yang 'od zer sna tshogs dang ldan pa 'od zer de yang ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du yod dedu/ ye shes lnga ni phung po lnga ste/ phung po lnga ni rigs lnga/ rigs lnga ni khams lnga/ khams lnga po de yang ④stong pa nyid du bsam mo/ /de lta bu'i ⑧phyag rgya 'byung po rnams la ston pa'o/ /bsam gyis ⑨mi khyab pa'i rig sngags 'di bka' sprul pa'o/ /ngas 'di bstan par bya'o zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi rang bzhin gyi ye shes ngo bo nyid nas dag pa ste/ dngos po med pa'i rang bzhin brjod du med pa/ ngag gis ⑩'di yin zhes bya bar brjod par mi nus so/ /rig sngags kyi ⑪phyag rgya'i phyag rgya de ni ⑫rnam thos kyi bu la bstan te/ de yang rgyal po bzhi'i gtso bo nas yin no/ /thams cad la go bar bya'o zhes bya ba ni/ stong gsum kyi ⑫stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams la sprul pa'i skus khyab ste/ de lta bu'i sems can rnams kyis go bar ④byed pa'o/ /de nas zhes bya ba ni/ rgyas par bshad pa ⑫de nas so/ /bcom ldan 'das yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis rig sngags 'di bka' sprul to zhes bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka nas hūṃ ⑩36—1772

gi yi ge las 'od zer sna tshogs 'phros te/ 'od zer sna tshogs de yang 'gro ba rigs ①drug gi don byas te/ 'od sna tshogs de yang bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka'i hūṃ ①la thim mo/ /hūṃ ①de'i yi ges bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka nas rig sngags kyi rgyal mo baṅgal ba'i tshal rdo rje'i rigs su sna rjol 'phros pa'o /de'i thugs ka nas kyang hūṃ gi yi ge las 'od zer sna tshogs snang ba'o/ /rig sngags 'di rjoni zhal bzhi pa/ phyag bcu gnyis pa/ sku mdog nag mo khro mo'o/ /dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar ba/ thod pa lnga yis dbu la brgyan pa/ dbu la rdo rje'i mtshan ma dang ldan pa/ spyan gsum pa/ zhal g.yas dmar po/g.yon ljang gu/ rgyab dmar po'o/ /zhal bzhi yang mche ba gcigs pa/ khro gnyer dang ldan pa/ rgyan thams cad ni sgrul gyis brgyan pa/ phyag dang po'i g.yas g.yon gyis rdo rje snying gar 'dzin cing / g.yon gyis rjodril bu dkur brten zhing gnas pa'o/ /de'i 'og ma g.yas g.yon gnyis kyis ⑦chos kyi dbyings kyi phyag rgya dbu steng du mdzad pa'o/ /g.yas pa gsum na rdo rje/ bzhi pa na ral gri/ lnga pa na 'khor lo/ /g.yon pa gsum na rin bo che/ bzhi pa na zhags pa/ lnga pa na lcags kyu de'i 'og ma g.yas g.yon gyis mda' gzhu 'gengs pa'o/ /thabs shes rab ngo bo nyid du bzhugs pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin mi bskyod pas rgyas btab pa/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes te/de yang sgyu ma lta bu me long lta bu'i ye shes kyis brgyan pa'o/ /de gnyis kyi rang bzhin gyi ye shes lnga rgyas btab pa'o/ /mtshon pa ni ye shes lnga yin te/mtshon byed ni rig sngags kyi rgyal mo'o/ /phung po ni rnam par shes pa'i phung po'o//khams ni nam mkha'i khams/ skye mched ni yid kyi skye mched/ zhabs phyed 36—1773

skyil du bzhugs shing / klu pho mo dang / gnod sbyin pho mo mnan pa/ pad+ma dang zla ba nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs shing / bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od dang ldan zhing / ma rig pa'i mun pa thams cad sreg pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi rdo rje'i snying po ni gang zhe na/ 'dir bstan pa ste/ gang gis ①bstan zhe na/yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas bstan pa'o/ /de yang rdo rje'i snying po'o/ /hi lī hi lī ⑤rnyi sa ni la sogs pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di bka' sprul pa na zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di'i ①gzi brjid dang stobs dang / dpa' bas 'di'i gsang busngags bshad ma thag tu sa g.yo ba dang / sgra chen po byung ba'o/ /sa ni kun du g.yos zhes bya ba ni/ rnam pa drug tu g.yos/ ji bzhin du rjogayos she na/sa chen po 'di rnam pa drug tu g.yos/ rab tu g.yos/ kun du rab tu g.yos so—/ /'gul rab tu 'gul/ kun du rab tu 'gul/ ldeg rjorab tu ldeg⑦ /kun du rab tu ldeg⑧ /ches chem rab tu stichem/ kun du rab tu ches chem/'ur 'ur rab tu 'ur⑩/ kun du rab tu 'ur 'ur/ shig shig rab tu shig shig /kun du rab tu shig shig ste/ ltas chen po bco brgyad byung ba'o/ /des na sa ni kun du g.yos zhes bya'o/ /rig sngags kyi gzi brjid kyis sa des kyang mi theg cing g.yos pa'o/ /'byung po thams cad ni rab tu 'dar nas zhes bya ba ni/ skad kyang d+nghasmra bar mi nus shing / lus kyang 'thoms nas ba spu yang gyen du log ste/ 'jigs par byas nas 'bros pa'i tshul du bstan to/ /kye ma kyi ⑫hud kye ma sdug bsngal sgra chen po byung ngo zhes bya ba ni/ 'byung po'i tshogs rnams kyang rab tu 'jigs nas 'byung po rnams rlag par byed do snyam nas skad 36—1774

chen po bton ①to/ /yang nas yang du skad ngan chen po bton ⑤to/ /srin po rnams kyis kyang 'di skad ces smras te zhes bya ba ni 'byung po dang bcas shing /bcom ldan 'das la zhu ba 'bul ba'o/ /'di ltar yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas//sems can kun la thugs brtse ①ba/ /zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo'i lam nas kyang sangs rgyas te/ de bzhin du bskal pa grangs med pa'i sngon du tshogs bsags te/ tshogs bsags pa de yang sems can thams cad kyi don du bsngo ste/ mnyam pa nyid kyis dhisems can gyi don mdzad pa'o/ /'byung po kun 'jigs nyen pa yi/ /rig sngags 'di 'dra gsung bar mdzad/ /ces bya ba ni rig sngags kyi dmod mos ma rungs pa'i 'byung po rnams kyang bcom zhing thal bar rlog pa ste/ de lta bu'i gzi brjid che ba'i rig sngags ni sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i zhal nas gsungs pa'o⑤/ /de nas kun mkhyen ston pa po/ /sems can kun la thugs brtse bas/ /zhes rjobya ba ni/ de nas rgo mtshams sbyor ba'i de nas so/ /chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong bstan te/ de yang sems can rigs mi gcig pas theg pa sna tshogs bstan pa ste/ 'khor ba'i sems can rnams la byams pa dang snying rjes khyab pa'o/ /gnod sbyin srin po ⑦dri za dang / /klu dang mkha' lding gsang ba pa/ /zhes bya ba ni/ sems can las kyi 'bras bu mi gcig pas/ 'byung po'i lus su gzhan la gnod pa'i sems dang ldan par skyes te/ de yang yi dwags dang / byol song gi lus su skyes pa'o/ /'byung po rgyu ba gzi brjid 'phrog /grul bum yi dwags srul po dang / /zhes bya ba ni/ skergyu ba dang sems can phrad par gyur na/ gti mug dang zhe sdang yod pas/ sems can rnams la gzi brjid 'phrog ste/ snying 36—1775

rje'i sems dang mi ldan pa'o/ /lha min gshed byed ro langs dang / /brjed byed dang ni mi 'am ci/ /zhes bya ba ni/ de rnams la bza' ba med cing skom pa'i sbyin pa ma btang zhing khro ba ste/ la la yang mchod rdzas la sogs pa za bar yod pa ni sbyin pa gtong zhing khro bar byas pa'o/ /skems ①byed dang ni rims drag dang / /de bzhin bram ze srin po ②dang / /zhes bya ba ni/ gzhan la grags pa 'dod pas/ sems can gyi srog gcod cing / sbyin pa zad pa med pa btang ste/ de'i 'bras bus kyang srin po la sogs par skye zhing snying rje med pa'o—/ /smyo byed rims nad zhag gsum pa/ /de bzhin zhag ni bzhi pa rnams//zhes bya ba ni/ 'byung po dang / 'byung po ma yin pa/ rims de dag kyang rig sngags kyis 'joms shing 'byung po de rnams kyang ④rig sngags kyi dmod mos 'joms pa ste/ gzhan yang nad rlung dang / bad kan dang / mkhris pa las gyur pa bzhi brgya brgyad cu rtsa bzhi yang 'joms pa'o/ /skrag cing rab tu 'dar gyur te/ /phyogs bcur rgyug pa gzigs nas kyang / /zhes bya ba ni/'byung po'i tshogs rnams kyang rig sngags kyi gzi brjid mthong bas 'jigs shing skrag pa ste/ phyogs bzhi nas kyang 'bros par 'gyur ro/ /de dag la ni thugs brtse'i ④phyir/ /rig sngags 'di ni rjod rjopar mdzad/ /ces bya ba ni/ de dag kyang las kyi 'bras bus skyes te/ de yang sangs rgyas thugs rje'i sems kyis sems can la 'bros par 'gyur ro/ /de dag kyang las kyi dhi'abras bus skyes te/ de yang sangs rgyas thugs rje'i sems kyis sems can la mnyam pa nyid du khyab ste/ de yang rig sngags kyi ngo bo ni/ thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa ste/ ye shes kyi rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so/ /thabs 36—1776

kyi ngo bo nyid ni stide bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs te/ phung po ni gzugs kyi phung po'o—/ /khams ni sa'i khams te/ skye mched ni mig gi ②skye mched do/ /ye shes lnga dang ldan zhing / sangs rgyas lnga'i dbu rgyan can/ spyan gsum pa/rgyan ①thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /zhal bzhi pa/ phyag brgyad pa/ sku mdog dkar mo zhal g.yas mthing ga /g.yon lngang gu/ rgyab dmar ba'o/ /dbu la 'khor los brgyan pa'o/ /zhi ba'i gzugs can ma'o/ /phyag g.yas dang po na/ snying gar rdo rje brten zhing / g.yon dril bu dku la brten pa'o/ /de'i 'og ma g.yas pa gsum na ral gri dang / 'khor lo dang / dgra sta'o/ /de bzhin du g.yon pa gsum na/ zhags pa dang / rtse gsum dang / dung bsnams bupa'o/ /zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung du bzhugs shing dhi/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la nyi ma'i 'od dang ldan pa'o/ /rig sngags bsel ba'i tshal rjode bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi ngo bo yin no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ni gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ rig sngags dang gsang sngags kyi tshig go/ /nyi ri ma kha⑦/ ti ri ⑧kha kha ka stiṭa ma ṭā ⑫la sogs pa'o/ /gsang sngags chen mo'i rig sngags chen mo 'di las 'gal bar ma byed cig ces bya ba ni/ 'byung po la sogs pa rnams kyis kyang rig sngags las 'gal bar byed par gyur na tshe 'di la yang sdug bsngal drag po thob cing / phyi ma la yang dmyal bar skye bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑪gsung gi chos la yang dag par rtogs shig ⑫ces bya ba ni sangs rgyas kyi bka' la mi bden pa mi mnga' ste/ de bzhin du rig sngags kyi gzi brjid kyang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ / khyed kun ⑫lus zhig ste zhes bya ba ni/yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bka' las 'das shing / rig sngags 36—1777
