la smra bar gyur na/ mgo bo dang lus tshal pa brgyar 'gas shing / ardza ka'i mañja ra ①bzhin du 'gas te/ tshe 'di la yang nad kyi ④sdug bsngal chen po theb ①par 'gyur ro/ /shi ba'i 'og tu ngan song ngan 'gro log par thong ba sems can dmyal ba rnams su skye zhing 'khor bar 'gro ba re zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas dang rig sngags kyi bka' las 'das pa'i 'byung po rnams ni/ shi 'phos ma thag tu mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du mnar mes dhisreg ste/ gal te dmyal ba de nas 'phos na yang dmyal ba gzhan du yang nas yang du skye bar 'gyur ro zhes bya ba ni/rgyas par bshad pa'i de nas so/ /rgyal po chen po bzhis/ bcom ldan 'das kyi rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rjosngon ma thos pa 'di thos nas zhes bya ba ni gzhan gyis mi byub pa 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad bcom pa/ stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin—/ thabs la mkhas pa/ 'byung po thams cad kyi gnyen po'orjo/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi yum/ sems can rnams la khyad par 'phags pa 'di thos pa'o/ /skrag cing sngangs te/ mi dga' la skyi bung zhes byed nas/ thal mo sbyar te zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi dmod mos rgyal po chen po bzhi yang mdog shor zhing ba spu rnams kyang gyen du log ste/bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar dad pa skyes nas thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal zhing gros mthun pa dang tshig mthun pa dang zhes bya ba ni rgyal po chen po de rnams kyis kyang / bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar phyag 'tshal zhes bya ba'o/ /skad mthun par bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to zhes bya ba ni dbyangs gcig tu byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das la zhu ba 'bul ba'o/ /sdang ba'i 'byung po zad bkyid pa/ /rig sngags 'di ni legs par gsungs/ /36—1778

zhes bya ba ni/ sdig can bdud kyi rigs/ sems can rnams la gnod par byed pa rnams/ rig sngags kyi dmod mos rlag par byed pa'o/ /dngos po med cing yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral bar byed pa'o/ /mi yi 'jig rten bde ①bgyid pa'i/ /rig sngags bdag cag brjod par 'tshal/ /zhes bya ba ni/rig sngags 'di 'chang ba rnams bsrung ba dang / sba ba dang / bskyab ②pa dang / zhi ba dang / bde legs su 'gyur zhing / sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral bar byed pa'o/ /de la rig sngags 'di lags te/ /'jig rten mgon po bdag la gson/ /zhes bya ba ni/ sha za dang / yi dwags dang /gnod sbyin gyi gdon 'byung po rnams kyis mi tshugs shing / ngo bo nyid dang bral zhing mi dmigs pa'o/ /'jig rten dbang phyug gis kyang / rig sngags legs par gsungs shing legs par nyon cig ces gsungs pa'o/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ①byen gyi rlabs bukyis/ rgyal po chen po bzhis bsrungs te/ rig sngags kyi ngo bo ni gang zhe na/ thabs dang shes rab ma bral ba'o—/ /mtshon pa ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes te/ mtshon byed ni rig sngags bsil ba'i tshal lo/ /rigs dhini rin po che'i rigs te/ phung po ni tshor ba'o /khams ni chu'i khams te/ skye mched ni sna'i skye mched do/ /ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin sangs rgyas lnga'i dbu rgyan can/ spyan gsum pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /zhal bzhi pa/ g.yas dkar porjo/ g.yon mthing ga /rgyab dmar po'o/ /phyag brgyad pa/ sku mdog ser mo/ phyag g.yas pa na rdo rje 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa dril bu dkur brten pa/ phyag g.yas pa gnyis pa dang /36—1779

gsum pa dang / bzhi pa rnams ni ral gri dang / rin po che dang / mda' bsnams pa'o/ /g.yon pa gnyis pa dang / gsum pa dang / bzhi pa rnams na zhags pa dang / 'khor lo dang / gzhu bsnams pa'o/ /zhabs rdo rje'i ①skyil krung du bzhugs shing / pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs shing / nyi ma'i 'od dang ldan pa ste/ lo bcu gnyis pa'i tshul du bzhugs shing / sgeg pa'i tshul dang ldan pa'o/ /rig sngags dang gsang sngags gzhan kyis mi thub ④pa ni/ gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ u hu ha la ku li dzi pa la sogs pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'byung po thams cad bzlog pa 'di gzung ①bar gsol zhes bya ba ni/ sngags dang / sbod rjogatong dang / gzhan gyi rig pa dang / ma rungs par byed pa'i 'byung po rnams/ rig sngags kyi gzi brjid dang /stobs kyis zlog dhipar byed pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi ngo bo 'di yang stong pa nyid yin te/ thabs dang shes rab buganyis su med pa'o/ /shes rab kyi ngo bo ni so sor rtog pa'i ye shes yin te/ thabs kyi ngo bo ni rig sngags nyid do/ /de yang thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med cing / mtshon pa dang mtshon byed kyang gnyis su med do/ /rig sngags de'i rigs ni pad+ma'i rigs te/ phung po ni 'du shes kyi phung po'o/ /khams ni me'i khams te/ skye mched ni lce'i skye mched do / /ye shes lnga'i ngo bo nyid ⑦ni rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan can/ spyan gsum pa/rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhal bzhi pa/ phyag brgyad pa/ sku mdog dmar mo/ phyag g.yas pa dang pos ④rdo rje snying gar brten pa/ g.yon pa dang pos dril bu dkur brten pa'o/ /g.yas gnyis pa ⑨na ral gri/ gsum pa na pad+ma/ g.yon gnyis pa na dgra sta dang / gsum pa na ⑩rtse gsum mo/ /36—1780

de'i 'og ma g.yas g.yon gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'gengs pa'o/ /zhabs rdo rje skyil krung du bzhugs shing / pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs shing / nyi ma'i 'od zer dang ldan te/ zhal g.yas dkar po/ g.yon mthing ga /rgyab ser po/ bzhad pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi gsang sngags pad+ma'i snying po ①gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ i li i li la sogs pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di ni lo gcig gi bar du mtshams gcod pa dang zhes bya ba ni/lo gcig gi sngon du yang srung ba ①byed par 'gyur/ srung ba dang / sbra ba dang / bskyab pa dang / mtshams gcod pa dang / dug zhi ba dang /dug gsad pa dang ④/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur zhing / rig sngags kyis yongs su bskyab rjopar 'gyur ro/ /'byung po thams cad bzlog pa dang /don thams cad sgrub pa lags so zhes bya ba ni/ de bzhin du byas par gyur na/sdig can kyi rigs ma rungs pa'i gdon thams cad kyang mi 'ong ste/ gal te 'ong bar gyur na/ rig sngags kyi dmod mos brlag par 'gyur ro/ /bya ba thams cad grub cing bde bar gnas pa'o/ /de nas zhes bya ba ni/ bar du gcod pa'i de nas so/ /gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / dri za nas gnod par byed pa'i bar rnams kyis zhes bya ba ni/ de dang de ma slebs pa'i mtshams su 'byung po de rnams kyis kyang bar du gcod ⑤par byas te/ rig sngags 'di byung ba tsam gyis kyang / bar du gcod par mi nus pa'o⑥/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo sngon ma thos pa 'di yang thos zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes 'dis ⑦chad pa thams cad 'joms par byed pa/ nor bu rin po che lta bu bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'oske/ /36—1781

rgyal po chen po bzhi'i srung ①ba/ sngon ma thos pa 'di yang thos nas/ skrag cing dngangs la mi dga' ste zhes bya ba ni/ khyad par du 'phags shing sems can gyi don mdzad pa ste/ de bzhin du rgyal po chen po bzhi po dag kyang yin te/ma rungs pa rnams la 'jigs par byed pa ngan song gsum nas 'byin pa'i gzugs ⑤'di yang dag pa'o/ /skyi bung zhes byed nas sa la 'dzul/ kun du 'dzul / kun du rab tu 'dzul bar byed do zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi gzi brjid dang / dmod mos sdig can gyi rigs 'byung po rnams/ de yang rig sngags kyi gzi brjid mthong bas ma tshugs par ④skad ngan grag sterjo/ de rnams kyang sa la 'dzul zhing bying bar 'gyur ro/ /mthong bar mi gnas shing so so rang rang bros so/ /de nas zhes bya ba ni 'byung po rnams 'jigs pa'i de nas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi sa gzhi rdo rjer sprul nas zhes bya ba ni/ sdog can bdud kyi rigs de rnams rdzu 'phrul sa la 'dzul du mi ster zhing / rig sngags kyi gzi brjid kyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ rdo rje'i sa gzhir snang ba'o/ /de dag phyogs bzhir rgyug go zhes bya ba ni/ sdig can 'byung po bdud kyi rigs de rnams ni/ sa la 'dzul ma nus shing phyogs phyogs su bros te hag zad do/ /de nas zhes bya ba ni 'byung po rnams bros pa'i de nas so/ /rgyal po chen po bzhis phyogs bzhir me lce'i phung po mngon par sprul to zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo'i gzi brjid kyis/ rgyal po chen po bzhi po rnams kyis kyang /phyogs mtshams thams cad du me sna tshogs sprul zhing / sdig can de rnams 'gror mi ster ba'o/ /de nas zhes bya ba ni/ tshig stel ⑤ba'i de nas so/ /de dag nam mkha' la rgyug go zhes bya ba ni/ sdig can rnams rdzu 'phrul gyis nam 36—1782

mkha' la rgyug ste/ phyogs mtshams bzhi la 'dzul ba med cing nam mkha' la rgyug pa'o/ /de nas zhes bya ba ni/ nam mkha' la bros pa'i de nas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis ①nam mkha' gser du sprul to zhes bya ba ni/ nam mkha'i ①phyogs na rdo rje'i gser gyi sa gzhir byin gyis brlabs te④/ sdig can de rnams kyang 'gro dbang med cing rdugs pa'orjo/ /de nas zhes bya ba ni/rdugs ⑤pa'i de nas so/ /'jig rten skyong ba ༷rgyal po chen po rnam ⑦thos kyi bu lta bu ⑧dang / dri zas bskor zhing mdun du bdar te/ steng gi ⑨bar snang la 'phags nas zhes bya ba ni/ sems can la gnod par byed pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa/drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa/ gzhan la srog 'phrog pa'i sems dang ldan pa sha stag /sdig can kyi ⑫'byung po de rnams 'gro sa ⑪mi rnyed cing mar log nas rgyal po chen po rnam ⑫thos kyi bu la skyab ⑫tshol ba'o/ /gnod sbyin dang srin po ⑫nas gnod pa byed pa'i bar rnams gzhom ⑫pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ dpa' zhing gzi brjid che ba ste/ stobs dang ldan zhing sdig can bdud kyi rigs/ rig sngags kyi dmod mos 'joms pa'o/ /sems can thams cad la snying brtse ba dang / 'byung po thams cad bzlog pa dang zhes bya ba ni⑫/ 'jig rten gyi khams su sems can gyi don du byams pa dang / snying rje dang btang snyoms kyis khyab ste/ de lta bu'i thugs rjes khyab nas/ byad dang / ro langs dang /dug dang / dug sbyor dang / dug 'thung ba dang / gzhan gyi rig pa dang /sngags dang / sbod gtong ⑩dang / 'jig rten gyi ma mo dang / ngan sngags sbyor ba dang / sdig can bdud kyi rigs de rnams la sogs pa rig sngags kyi 36—1783

gzi brjid 'joms pa'o/ /'khor bzhi po rnams bsrung ba dang zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni/ de bzhin du bdud kyi rigs 'byung po la sogs pa bcom zhing /bar chod med cing bde bar gnas te/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral stibar byed do④/ /rig sngags 'di brjod do zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi rang bzhin gzhan gyis ma bcos ①par gnyug ma ste/ phyogs dang bral zhing rang bzhin med pa de lta bu'i ye shes brjod pa'o/ /de yang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo las kyi rigs ni las thams cad rdzogs par byed pa/ las kyi gdon thams cad 'joms pa/ las thams cad grub paX/ sna tshogs kyi rigs su snang ba'o//de yang rig sngags kyi mtshon pa ni bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes so/ /mtshon byed ni rig sngags kyi dhibadag nyid do/ /phung po ni 'du shes kyi phung po'o/ /khams ni rlung gi khams so/ /skye dumached ni lus kyi skye mched do/ /ye shes lnga'i ngo bo nyid sangs rgyas lnga'i dbu rgyan ⑦can/ spyan gsum pa/ zhal bzhi pa/ phyag brgyad pa/ sku mdog ljang nag /zhal g.yas dkar po/ g.yon dmar po/rgyab ser po/ phyag g.yas dang po na rdo rje gdengs pa/ gnyis pa na ral gri/gsum pa 3rdo rje rgya gram mo/ /g.yon dang po na dril bu/ gnyis pa na dhizhags pa—/ gsum pa na ⑩'khor lo'o/ /'og ma'i phyag g.yas g.yon gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'gengs shing / zhabs g.yas pa pus mo btsugs pa/ g.yon brkyang ba/ bdud bzhi'i rang bzhin 'byung po rnams mnan pa'o/ /pad+ma'i steng na nyi ma'i gdan la nyi ma'i 'od dang ⑩ldan pa'o/ /yan lag thams cad sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ khro bo 'jigs su rung ba'i gzugs so/ /rig sngags kyi gsang sngags las kyi snying pos ni/ las thams cad 'grub cing bdud thams 36—1784

cad 'dul ba ste①/ sems can thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'o/ /gsang sngags kyi tshig ni 'di lta ste/ gi ma gi ma la sogs pa'o/ /rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu phyogs skyong bar gyur cig ces bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' dang / rig sngags kyi byin kyi rlabs kyis ①gang zag rig sngags la gus pa dang /sems can thams cad dang / de la srung ①ba dang / skyob par byed cing /rig sngags kyi chos kyi bstan pa bsrung ba'o/ /lha rnams kyi nang na lha'i rgyal po nor lha'i bu zhes bgyi ba mchis te zhes bya ba ni/ sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad pa0/ nor thams cad gzhan gyi don du byin pa/ sems can thams cad kyi don byed pa ste/ de lta bu'i sems dang ldan pa/ nor lha lta bu 'byung rjoba'o—/ /de la bdag phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba ni/ de lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' la rgyal po rnams dang / 'byung po rnams kyis phyag 'tshal ba'o/ /de yang bcom ldan 'das nyid la phyag 'tshal te zhes bya ba ni/ bdud rnams las rnam par rgyal zhing dgra rnams kyang ma lus te/ phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan zhing sangs rgyas pa ste/ de lta bu'i bcom ldan 'das la/ bdag cag rnams kyis phyag 'tshal ba'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpa' bo ste/ /kun mkhyen kun gzigs khyod la 'dud/ /ces bya ba ni/ nyon mongs pa thams cad bcom zhing dpa' ba ste/ sku gsung thugs rdzogs par byas pas na rdzogs pa ste/dug gsum dang bral zhing / sangs rgyas pa'o/ /de lta bu'i sangs rgyas la 'dud ces bya ba'o/ /rdzogs pa'i busangs rgyas rkang gnyis mchog /shes rab chen po byed la 'dud/ /ces bya ba ni sngon bskal pa grangs med pa'i dus su tshogs rdzogs te/ da ④ltar ma lus par sems can thams cad rdzogs par 36—1785

'dod nas/ theg pa sna tshogs dang / thabs sna tshogs bstan pa ste/ rkang gnyis kyi tshogs kyi dam pa/ phyi nang gi tshogs la mkhas pa/ thams cad mkhyen zhing thams cad la byams pas khyab pa'o/ /de lta bu'i thub pa chen po la 'dud pa'o/ /go tam khyod kyis gang mkhyen pa/ /de ni lha rnams ma 'tshal to/ /zhes bya ba ni/ yang dag pa'i ye shes ni rgya mtsho lta bu ste/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan yang de bzhin no/ /de lta bu'i ye shes shes ①pa ni lta ci smos te/ rang nyid kyis rang gi rig pa yang mi shes pa'o/ /rang gi rig pa ②ci'i phyir ma shes na—/ rang la skyes pa'i ma rig pas ma shes pa'o/ /yang dag dpa' bo khyod la 'dud—/ /chos bzhin mthun par lta zhing mchis/ /zhes bya ba ni/ yang dag par bdud bzhi bcom ste/ de 'dul bas na dpa' bo ste/ de lta bu'i ye shes dang ldan pa la yang dag par 'dud de/ bdag cag kyang snying rje dang ldan zhing mchis pa'o zhes bya ba'o/ /gnod sbyin dang / srin po skedang / dri za nas gnod par byed pa'i bar rnams ming rjo'adi zhes bya ba'i lus la babs pa las gud du dengs shig ces bya ba ni/ ma rungs pa'i rjosdog can 'byung po rnams ni/ gang zag rig sngags 'chang ba dang / sems can rnams la gnod pa byas nas/ rig sngags kyi dmod mos mgo bo ardza ka'i mañja ra'i ④rdog pa bzhin du tshal par 'gas pa'o/ /gal te ming 'di zhes bya ba'i lus la dze+emyur du ma dong na zhes bya ba ni/ rig pa mi 'chang ba'i gang sgedu/ sdig pa ⑨can ma rungs pa rnams kyis gzung ⑩bar gyur na/ de nas sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs pa bzhin du rig pa 'chang ste/ de'i chos bzhin du gang zag dang sems can la bsrung bar bya ste⑪/ myur du ma thon na nyes pa chen por 'gyur ro//36—1786

de dag la myur du 'jigs pa chen po dang / nad drag pos 'debs par 'gyur la zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi bka' las 'das pa sdig can gtum po'i rigs 'byung po rnams ni nad drag po mdze dang / phol mig dang / 'bras dang / lhog pa dang / sha bkra ①dang / me dbal ④dang / chu sbur ④dang /'brum bu dang / lus thams cad rul zhing g.yan pa la sogs pa'i nad kyis ④thebs shing srog dang 'bral te/ shi 'phos nas kyang mnar med du skye ba med pa'orjo—/ /de'i rkyen gyis mgo dang snying tshal pa brgyar rjo'ags par 'gyur te zhes bya ba ni/ gang zag ji bzhin du gnod par byed bzhin te sdig can de yang sdug bsngal drag po ⑦ste/ nad chen pos btab pa'o/ /de'i mod la sdug bsngal bu ma byung ⑧ba dang brlag pa dang / mtha' med par 'gyur ro zhes bya ba ni—/ rig sngags kyi dmod mos sdug bsngal drag po 'byung ste/ gar yang 'go sa med cing be+eng lo can gyi pho brang yang mi thob ste/ de'i lus kyang zhig cing rul bar 'gyur ro/ /'brum bu'i gdon gang yin pa dang / skya rengs ⑨'char ka'i gdon gang yin pa dang / grib gnon gyi gdon gang yin pa de dag kyang bsil ba'i tshal gyi mdo chen po 'di thos nas zhes bya ba ni/ 'di 'don ⑫pa dang sgom pa dang yid la byed pa dang gdams ⑪ngag byin pa dang / bshad pa dang / rjes su yi rang zhing 'chang ba ste/ de dag la gnod par 'gyur na/rig sngags kyi bka' las 'das pa'o/ /yang na rig sngags 'di mnyan nas/sems can la 'tshe bar mi bya'o/ /ming 'di zhes bya ba'i lus las ⑩myur du gud du dengs shig ces bya ba ni/ gnod par byed pa de ⑫rnams gang zag dang sems can thams cad kyi don la myur du thon cig ces bya'o⑫/ /yang na rig 36—1787

sngags kyi dmod mos sdug bsngal myur du thob po zhes bya'o①/ /gal te myur du ma dong ⑤na 'jigs pa chen po dang / nad drag pos 'debs par 'gyur la zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi bka' las 'das shing ma btang bar gyur na/ rgyal po chen po bzhi'i chad pa'i 'jigs pa dang / g.yan pa'i nad la sogs pas myur du thebs par 'gyur ro/ /de'i rkyen gyis ①mgo bo dang snying tshal pa brgyar ④'gas par 'gyur zhes bya ba ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bka' dang / rig sngags kyi dmod mos ardza ka'i ma rdza ri'i dogs rjopa bzhin du 'gas pa'o/ /de'i mod la sdug bsngal du ma 'byung ba dang / brlag pa dang mtha' med par 'gyur ro zhes bya ba ni/ de bzhin du rig sngags kyis kyang pyadamod mos 'gro sa mi rnyed cing / de'i rnam par smin pas sdug bsngal drag po thob ste/ shi nas kyang mnar med kyi mes bsreg ⑦cing / dmyal ba nas dmyal bar 'khor bar 'gyur ⑧ro/ /gzi byin dang ni khrag za ba/ /nyin mtshan rgyu ba gang yin pa/ /zhes bya ba ni/ zas su khrag za ba ⑨dang sha za ba ⑩la sogs pa rnams kyis kyang gzi brjid 'phrog pa dang / sems can la 'tshe bar byed pa dang / nyin mo dang mtshan mo la sogs pa rgyu zhing ma byed cig ces bya'o⑩ske/ /de dag gis kyang legs gsungs pa'i/ /mdo bshad thos nas spang bar gyis/ /zhes bya ba ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis/rig sngags 'di yang yang dag par gsungs te/ de bzhin du rgyal po chen po bzhi po rnams kyis kyang / rjes su yi rang zhing srung ba ste/ de bzhin du khyad par du 'phags pa'i mdo 'di thos par gyur nas⑫/ sems can la gnod par byed pas sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa ⑫thob pa'o/ /de bas na spang bar gyis 36—1788

zhes bya ba'o/ /sha za lus 'phags skem byed dang / /'byung po 'jigs byed srul po rnams/ /zhes bya ba ni/ 'byung po de rnams kyis kyang sems can la gnod par byas te/ de yang dam la btags nas gnod par byed pa spangs pa'o//de dag gis kyang legs gsungs pa'i/ /mdo 'di bshad pa thos nas mthong ①/ /zhes bya ba ni 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang / da ④ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang gsungs te/ de bzhin rgyal po bzhi po rnams kyis kyang dam tshig bsrung ①ste/ rig sngags kyi gzi brjid kyis sdig can 'byung po de rnams kyis kyang gzhan la 'tshe ba spangs pa'o/ /lha dang lha min rlung lha dang / /dri za dang ni gdon gyi bla/ /zhes bya ba ni/ zhe sdang dang / gti mug gis sems can thams cad la gnod par byas te/ de duyang rig sngags kyi gzi brjid dam pa thob pa'o/ /'byung po dang ni sha za dang / /de bzhin gnod sbyin srin po rnams/ /zhes bya ba ni/ ser sna dang / zhe sdang dang / 'dod chags kyi sems can rnams la 'tshe bar byas te/ de yang rig sngags kyi dmod mo'i 'jigs pas gnod mi nus pa'o/ /kun du 'khrugs shing kun du g.yos/ /skrag cing kun du rab tu 'gul/ /zhes bya ba ni rig sngags 'di'i gzi brjid dang / stobs kyis sa lan drug tu g.yos te/ de bzhin du ltas chen po bco brgyad byung ba'o/ /kun du 'khrugs rjoshing kun du g.yos pa ni shar dma' ste/nub mtho ba'o/ /nub dma' na shar mtho ba'o rjo/ /phyogs phyogs rnams kyang de bzhin no/ /mgo 'khrugs shing phyogs rnams gtor ba'o/ /de bas kyang skrag cing kun du 'gul ⑦ba ste/ yun ring zhing drag pa'o/ /gdon dang gnod pa skebyed pa rnams/ /lhung zhing rab tu pham par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba ni/36—1789

sdig can bdud kyi rigs kyi 'byung po rnams ni/ sems can la gnod par byed pas rang pham ste/ sdug bsngal chen po thob cing rig sngags kyi dmod mos 'joms pa'o/ /sa gzhi ①dag kyang rab tu g.yos/ /sgra bo che yang sgrogs par byed—/ /ces bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi gzi brjid kyis/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams sa g.yo zhing 'byung po rnams skrag par byed degs de yang rnga bo che dang cha lang dang dril bu'i skad 'byung ngo / /kun du rab tu 'byung ngo zhes bya'o/ /yi dwags dang ni grul bum rnams/ /sdang ba'i gdon ni zlog ④byed pa'o/ /zhes bya ba ni/ 'byung po de rnams kyang sems can drag pos rjoganod par byas te/ gzhan gang bugis kyang mi thub cing de'i gnyen po lta bu rig sngags kyi rgyal mo yin te/ mdo 'di dag ni thos gyur na/ /'jigs pa drag po 'be+ebs par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba ni/ gnod byed sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa dang sdog pa'i sems dang ldan pa dang / sems can gyi srog 'dod pa rnams/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo bsil ba'i tshal 'dis rlag rjopar byed pa'o/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /dad pa'i gnod sbyin gang yin pa/ /zhes bya ba ni/ 'byung po byang chub sems dpa'i rigs yod de/ yang dag par sdogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa dang / chos dang dge 'dun la dga' zhing 'jig rten gyi khams rnams skyong bar byed de/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung zhing sems can rnams kyi don byed pa'o/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo bsil ba'i tshal 'di la rjes su yi rang zhing rig sngags kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba'o/ /de dag mgu zhing yid dga' nas/ /legs par rjes su yi rang ngo / /zhes bya ba ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i rigs 'byung de rnams kyang rig sngags kyi rgyal 36—1790

mo bsil ba'i tshal gyi chos la dga' zhing snga nas kyang chos la dad pa yod do①/ /de ltar dad pa kun du rab tu skyes nas/ dga' bas rab tu dga' ste/ chos la mchod pa legs par mchod nas/ de rnams kyis snerjes su yi rang ngo zhes bya ba ni①/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo bsil ba'i tshal kyi 'byung po dam la btags pa'i gnas skabs te brgyad pa'o// //de nas zhes bya ba ni/ 'byung po dam la btags pa'i de nas so/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi bar snang las babs nas zhes bya ba ni/ rgyal po chen po de yang chos la rab tu dga' ste/ bcom ldan 'das la snga nas kyang dad pa skyes te/da rjoltar yang rab tu skyes nas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste/ lhags nas zhes bya ba ni/ so so rang gi 'od zer yang 'phags te/ bsil ba tshal gyi chos 'di la dad pa yang nas yang du skyes te/ de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das la yang de bzhin no/ /de bas na rgyal po chen po bzhis kyang legs lhags pa zhes bya ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te zhes bya ba ni/ rgyal po chen po bzhi rab tu dga' nas zhabs kyi pad+ma la gus pas phyag 'tshal ba'o/ /thal mo sbyar nas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal zhing zhes bya ba ni/ rgyal po chen po bzhis bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs ④te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das la thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /gros mthun pa dang / tshig mthun pa dang / skad mthun par bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to zhes bya ba ni dbyangs gcig tu byas shing / rgyal po chen po rnams kyis kyang rig 36—1791

sngags kyi chos la gus pa'i sems kyis bcom ldan 'das la zhu ba 'bul ba'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bsil ba'i ①tshal gyi mdo chen po 'di ni zhes bya ba ni srung ②ba dang / skyob pa dang / sbed pa dang / sems can thams cad la rig sngags kyi gsang sngags kyis khyab ste/ sdang ba'i sems zhi bar byed pa 'khor ba rnams bcom zhing yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi lam bstan pa'o/ /rgyal po chen po bzhis zhabs la phyag bgyi ba dang zhes bgyi ba ni gus par bya ba phyag 'tshal te/ rgyal po chen po bzhis kyang rang bsrung ④zhing / ngag gis 'don pa dang / yid kyis bzung ba dang / lus kyis ④bcang bar byas te/ rig sngags 'di yang btags nas kyang / ngan song gsum du mi 'gro zhing byang chub kyi lam bstan pa'o/ /'khor bzhi po rnams la bsrung dhib dang zhes bya ba ni/dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen rjonam/ dge bsnyen ⑦ma la sogs pa'i sems can rnams kyang bsrung ba'i dam pa'o/ /yongs su skyob pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ gzhan las kyang khyad par du 'phags te/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur zhing sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral ba'o/ /gnod sbyin dang srin po nas gnod par bkyid pa'i bar rnams 'joms pa lags so zhes bya ba ni/ma rungs pa bdud kyi rigs rnams kyi 'byung po de yang 'joms shing rig sngags dang / gsang sngags kyi dmod mos rlag par byed pa'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das zhes bya ba ni/ rgyal po chen po bzhi dag gis kyang bcom ldan 'das la rig sngags 'di 3'dri bar byed pa ste/ de yang 'khor bzhi la rtag tu srung bar byed pa'o/ /dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen ⑨nam/dge bsnyen ⑩ma de dag gis kyang zhes bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das la rtag tu 36—1792

'khor ba'i 'khor bzhi yin te/ rig sngags kyis kyang de dag srung zhing bar gcod ①bsal te rtag tu bde ba thob pa'o/ /bsil ba'i tshal gyi mdo chen po 'di gzung ⑤bar bgyi/ bcang bar bgyi/④ brjod par bgyi/ kun chub par bgyi'o rjozhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'di dur khrod chen po yi dwags dang / 'byung po rnams kyi gnyen po/ mi'i sems can rnams kyi ston pa/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams skyong bar byed pa ste/ 'khor bzhi po dag gis kyang 'chang ba dang / bzung nas kyang sems can thams cad la bstan nas/ sdug bsngal thams cad dang 'bral khye/bar byed pa ste/ 'khor bzhi po dag gis kyang lus ngag yid gzung buba'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das zhes bya ba ni/ rgyal po bzhis kyang bcom ldan 'das la yang dang yang du ⑦zhu ba 'bul ba'o/ /dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am—/ dge bsnyen ⑧nam/ dge bsnyen ⑨ma gang la la zhes bya ba ni/'khor bzhi bo dag dang / sems can thams cad la bsrung zhing sdug bsngal thams cad dang 'bral bar byed de/ 'di'i lam nas kyang byang chub kyi tshogs bstan pa'o/ /bdag bsrung ⑩ba dang / bdag sba ba dang / gzhan bsrung ba dang ⑪/ gzhan sba ba'i slad du zhes bya ba ni/ gang zag rig sngags 'chang ba dang / nyon mongs pa'i sems can rnams srung ba ste/ byams pa dang /snying rje'i lam nas bdag gis kyang sems can gyi don la bstan par bya'o⑫/ /bsil ba'i tshal kyi mdo chen po 'di 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / brjod pa dang / kun chub par bgyid pa de la ni zhes bya ba ni/ stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin—/ thabs dang ⑫shes rab gnyis su med pa ste/ chos dang / longs 36—1793

spyod dang / sprul pa'i skus khyab pa ste/ de bzhin du 'di la gus pa byas pa'i gang zag ni/ sdug bsngal thams cad dang 'bral ba'o/ /gnod sbyin dang /srin po ①nas gnod par bgyid pa'i ④bar rnams nye ④'khor yang gnas par mi 'gyur na/ gnod par bgyid pa lta ga la sems lags zhes bya ba ni/ mthu che zhing gzi brjid che ba sterjo/ dpa' ba stobs che zhing sems can rnams la byams pa dang / snying rje dang ldan pa ste/ gang zag 'di 'chang ba la da lta'i rkyen lta ci smos te/ tshe phyi ma la yang de bzhin no/ /de gang du mtshan gcig tsam gnas pa der yang zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi durgyal mo bsil ba'i tshal 'di yang grong ngam/ grong khyer ram/ grong rdal lam/ ljongs la sogs pa la yi ge gcig tsam yang dag par gyur na/ de bzhin du 'byung po'am/ yi dwags la sogs pas pyaganod par mi 'gyur te/ grong de na gnas pa'i sems can rnams la yang khrag khrug dang / rtsod pa dang / rims drag po'i nad mi 'byung ste/ gzhan gyi ⑦rgyal po'i chad pa yang mi 'byung ngo / /gnod sbyin dang /srin po nas gnod par bgyid pa'i bar rnams nyen kor ④du yang gnod par mi 'gyur zhes bya ba ni/ mtshan de yang lus la btags pa'am/ yid kyis 'dzin pa'am/ ngag gis 'don ⑨pa'am/ rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'am/mchod rten kyi rtse mo la btags nas/ de thos pa dang / de mthong ba tsam gyis de'i 'od zer gyi gzi brjid kyis rgyang grags kyi bar tshun chad du yang nye bar mi nus so/ /de gang du rtag tu gnas pa der lta smos kyang ci 'tshal lags zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags 'di yang 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams kyis rjes su yi rang zhing gsungs pa'o/ /de bzhin du ma 'ongs pa rnams 36—1794

kyis kyang gsung bar 'gyur ba'o/ /da ltar yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas/ sems can gyi don la gsungs pa ste/ gnyis pa'i sems med cing / nges par the tshom med do zhes bya ba'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das gang la la ①mi ma lags pa'i gnod pas thebs pa'i mdun du bsil ba'i tshal ②gyi mdo chen po 'di brjod na zhes bya ba ni/ yul 'khor bsrung ba dang / byad dang / ro langs kyi nad kyis btab pa dang / bsgom nyes pa ④dang / dz+re nyes la sogs pa gso ba dang / bkra mi shis pa bkra shis par byed pa dang / gzhan yang de la sogs pa thams cad la sngags te/ gzhan yang mkha' la rgyu ba'i yi dwags rnams bzlog pa'i cho ga yang dag par bshad par bya'o//lci ba chu dang 'dres pa yis④/ /dkyil 'khor yang dag byug par bya/ /nad pa'i mdun du yang dag tu/ /de bzhin gzhan yang mkhas pas shes/ /sa tshon lngas duni yang dag tu/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mdzes par bris/ /dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma la/ /phyi rim rdo rje ra ba ste/ /de phyir 'khor lo sna tshogs rtsibs//de phyir lha snam 0zlum por bri/ /de yi phyi rim gru bzhi la/ /lha snam ⑦pad+ma rā ga'i mdog /gru bzhi sgo bzhi ka ba brgyad/ /twa ra bzhi yis yang dag brgyan/ /dra ba la sogs brgyan pa la/ /rin chen sna bdun gzhal yas khang / /gdugs dang ba dan de bzhin rgyan⑧/ /mdzes pas yang dag rnam ⑨par brgyan//pad+ma 'khor lo lha rnams dang / /ye shes lha dang 'jig rten lha/ /gzhan yang gsungs pa de bzhin du/ /mkhas pa'i blo yis shes par bya/ /bzhi pa'i dbus su yang dag tu/ /rnam par rgyal ba dbus su gzhag /lto ba ldir ba rke ba ring //mchu 'phyangs mtshan ma legs pa la/ /nag po ra ri rtsa ba spangs/ /de lta bu yi 36—1795

bum pa la/ /gu gul la sogs bdug par bya/ /rin chen 'bru lnga sman lnga dang //dri lnga byang chub shing lnga dang / /mgul chings dang ni gdugs dang ni/ /me tog phreng dang rin chen phreng / /gzhan yang ji snyed yang dag brgyan/ /de bzhin rgyal ba'i bum pa'i gzugs/ /gzhal yas khang gi dbus su gzhag① /rims nad phyugs nad gang yin pa/ /de ni bkra shis la sogs dang / /dbang bskur sbyin sreg ②de bzhin te/ /lha dang rab gnas de bzhin shes/ /rdo rje slob dpon mkhas pa yis/ /dkyil chog blo yis yang dag shes/ /gro ga shing shun dar sogs la/ /gur gum gi wang ①la sogs bri/ /phyi rim mu khyud ra ba la/ /rgyal ba'i mtshan ni yang dag bri/ /dar gyis bubacings pa'i pad+ma la//de steng phyag mtshan rgyas pa bri/ /ral gri skyabs sbyin rin chen dang / /rin chen steng du rdo rje gnas/ /zhags pa lcags kyu bum pa dang / /de steng rdo rje yang dag gnas/ /mtshams bzhi rdo rje rgya gram duyin/ /be+e con dang ni a la dang—/ /pad+ma la sogs 'khor lo dang / /gzhan yang phyag mtshan gang yod pa//mkhas pas brtags skyenas bri bar bya/ /de nas mu khyud zlum po la/ /rdo rje rgya gram yang dag bri/ /rdo rje rgya gram bar du ni/ /las kyi snying po yang dag bri/ /phyag mtshan bar du rdo rje rigs kyi yi ge dgod/ /de nas mu khyud gsum po la/ /sngar gsungs las kyi snying po bri/ /de nas mu khyud 'khor lo bri/ /'khor lor bri ba'i yi ge ni/ /rig sngags skyed byed yang dag tu/ /hūṃ dang phaṭa kyis rnam par brgyan/ /de nas mu khyud gsum po la/ /rig sngags snying po yang dag bri/ /de nas pad+ma 'dab brgyad la/ /yang snying snying po bri bar bya/ /de bzhin mu khyud bskor ba la/ /gzhan gyis ⑦mi thub snying po bri/ /de dbus yi ge gnas 36—1796

pa ni/ /bsil ba'i tshal gyi bskyed yig stibri/ /yi ge'i nang du mkhas pa ②ni/ /yang dag gis ni bri bar bya/ /de bzhin rig sngags 'chang bris la/ /mgul lam phyag ①sogs gdags par bya/ /de bzhin btags par gyur na ni/ /nad dang 'jigs pas mi tshugs te/ /mya ngan la sogs de bzhin du/ /mi rigs thams cad mi tshugs so/ /tshe ring sdug bsngal thams cad med/ /ngan song gsum yang de bzhin no/ /rgyal ba'i bsrung ba yang dag tu/ /nga yis yang dag bshad par bgyi/ /rdo rje'i bur ba gur dang ni/ /bla res sa gzhi dra ba dang / /rdo rje'i rang bzhin shes par bya/ /de phyir me ri sna tshogs kyis/ /yang dag gis ni bskor ba'o/ /nad pa'i drung du dkyil 'khor 'di/ /de bzhin yang dag bri bar bya/ /ring bsrel gdung rten lugs ma 'am tsha tsha la sogs mchod rten gang / /nad pa'i mdun du yang dag mchod/ /rig sngags bsil ba'i tshal gyi 0gzungs/ /cho ga'i dus su yang dag gdon/ /bar kyis mi chod de bzhin du/ /bzlas pa la sogs de bzhin bya/ /phyogs skyong gza' dang rgyu skar dang / /de bzhin 'byung po la sogs la/ /rjes su mthun par dbul bar bya/ /dri dang me tog spos dang ni/ /arga ⑥la sogs yang dag dbul/ /de bzhin mkhas pas thun gtor du/ /yang dag gis ni dbul bar bya/ /nad pa la sogs khrus byas la/ /rig sngags gtad pa'i cho ga bya/ /dbang bskur ④la sogs gzhan yang mthun/ /de bzhin sdom pa 'bogs pa dang / /gzhan dang la sogs mthun pa ste/ /de bzhin la sogs byas na ni/ /gang yang las kyang 'grub par 'gyur/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo bsil ba'i tshal gyi dkyil 'khor dang bsrung ba bshad pa'i gnas skabs te 36—1797

de bzhin du dkyil 'khor la sogs pas bsrung ba byas na/ sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral te/ ma rungs pa'i gdon thams cad kyang de bzhin no/ /bde bar 'gyur zhing thar bar 'gyur la zhes bya ba ni/ tshe da lta dang phyi ma la yang bde bar 'gyur ba ste/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad las thar ba'o/ /mi ma lags pa rnams de la log pa mi bgyid cing / myur du 'chi ①bar 'gyur lags te zhes bya ba ni 'di 'chang ba'i gang zag rnams la 'byung po de rnams grogs mi byed na 'byung po de rnams kyang rig sngags kyi dmod mos sdug bsngal drag po thob ②par 'gyur ro/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das zhes bya ba ni/rgyal po bzhis bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa'o/ /bsil ba'i ①tshal gyi mdo chen po 'di ni/ de ltar don che ba lags so zhes bya ba ni/ stong gsum kyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams la/ sems can rnams la bde bar gnas rjopar byas shing tshe da ltar dang phyi ma'i sdug bsngal zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das/ dge slong ngam dge slong ⑤ma gang la la sogs pa ni yang nas yang du bcom ldan 'das la/ rgyal po bzhis zhu ba 'bul ba ste/ de yang 'khor bzhi'i don la zhu ba 'bul ba'o/ /bsil ba'i tshal kyi mdo chen mo bu'adi 'dzin pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ grong ngam grong khyer ram grong rdal ⑦lam/ de la sogs pa la yod pa tsam gyis kyang 'jigs pa thams cad dang ⑧'bral bar 'gyur te/'chang ba dang zhes bya ba ni/ mgul du btags nas gus par byas par gyur na/36—1798

rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di'i nus pas sdug bsngal thams cad las thar bar 'gyur te/ tshe da lta dang tshe phyi ma de bzhin no/ /brjod pa dang zhes bya ba ni/klog pa bsgom pa rjes su yi rang ba de la bshad par byed pa/ de ①la sogs pa byas par gyur na de bzhin du sdug bsngal dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /kun chub par bgyid pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can gyi don la khyab pa'o/ /yang na rig pa ni nam mkha' bzhin du khyab pa ste/ sems can gyi don la khyab pa'o/ /sbyor bar bkyid pa de la ni zhes bya ba ni 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar yod pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs pa/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo bsil ba'i tshal 'di ni rjes su yi rang zhing gsungs pa'o④/ /de dag gi gang zag ni sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral zhing de bzhin dus gsum du yin no/ /dad pa can kyi gnod sbyin dge bsnyen ①rnams—/ rgyal po chen po bzhi'i gan du mchis nas/ ming smos par bkyid do zhes bya ba ni/ mi ma yin pa'i 'byung po rnams kyis kyang / tshes brgyad dam/bcu dgu'am/ nya'am/ stong la sogs pa la/ rgyal po chen po bzhi dang /de bzhin du byas par gyur na/ gdug pa can kyi gnod sbyin rnams kyang dad par 'gyur ro/ /kye rgyal po chen po dag ces bya ba ni/ bsil ba'i tshal gyi mdo chen po 'di la rgyal po chen po bzhi dag kyang 'di la 'chang bar 'gyur na/dad par 'gyur te/ de bzhin du yang dag pa'i don yang thob par 'gyur ro/ /dge slong ngam zhes bya ba nas dge bsnyen ma zhes bya ba ni/ 'khor bzhi la yang bsil ba'i rjotshal gyi mdo 'dis bsrung bar 'gyur ro/ /che ge mo zhig ces bya ba la sogs pa ni/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems 36—1799

can thams cad do/ /yang na ni gang zag sems can 'di 'chang ba'o /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das zhes bya ba ni/ rgyal po chen po bzhis bcom ldan 'das la yang nas yang du zhus pa'o/ /dad pa can gyi gnod sbyin dge bsnyen rnams—/ /rgyal po'i pho brang lcang lo can du mchis nas zhes bya ba ni/ sngon du bshad pa bzhin du bsil ba'i tshal gyi mdo 'di'i bka' bzhin du rgyal po chen po bzhi po de mchod pa byas na/ nad thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu'i mdun du gnod sbyin rnams 'dus shing / 'byung po thams cad tshogs pa'i nang du yang bsgrags nas zhes bya ba ni/ gnod sbyin mthu bo che sum cu rtsa gnyis dang sde dpon chen po nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu rnams kyi mdun du bsil ba'i tshal kyi mdo 'di bsgrags na/ sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur①/ der de dag mngon par dga' bar 'gyur te zhes bya ba ni/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo bsil ba'i tshal gyi byin gyi rlabs ⑤kyis/ de rnams kyis kyang grogs byed par 'gyur ro/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bsil ba'i tshal gyi mdo chen mo ①'di ni de ltar don che ba lags so zhes bya ba ni/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'o/ /yang dag pa'i don thob ste/ mi'i yul du skye bar gyur nas kyang /chos 'di dang mi 'bral ba'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das zhes bya ba ni/sems can gyi don la rgyal po chen po bzhis yang nas yang du zhu ba phul ba'o/ /dge slong ngam zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni/ sde ba bzhi dang / mi dge ba bcu dang / dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa lnga'o/ /sde ba bzhi ni/ phal chen pa dang /thams cad yod par smra ba dang / gnas brtan pa dang / mang pos bkur ⑦36—1800

ba'i sde'o/ /mi dge ba bcu ni/ srog gcod ①pa dang / ma byin par len pa dang / mi tshangs par spyod pa dang / brdzun ②du smra ba dang / tshig rtsub mo dang / ngag 'khyal pa dang / phra ma'o/ /brnab sems dang / gnod sems dang / log par lta ba'o/ /dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa gni/ srog gcod pa dang / ma byin par len pa dang / 'dod pas log par g.yem pa dang /brdzun ༷du smra ba dang / chang dang lnga ste/ bsil ba'i dhitshal gyi mdo 'di bton rjopa tsam gyis kyang / de rnams kyi sdom pa nyams kyang / de'i sdig pa las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /chang mi btung ba dang / dran pa dang / shes bzhin du mchis pa ⑦dang zhes bya ba ni/ chang mi btung skeb ni/ sgog pa dang /sha dang / bud med ⑨la sogs pa bkag pa kṛ ⑩ya'i gzhung ngo / /dran pa ni rig sngags 'di dran pa ⑪ste/ de dran pa ⑫tsam gyis kyang zas nyams pa las kyang thar bar 'gyur ro/ /shes bzhin du mchis pa ni/ sdig pa'i rang bzhin du shes pa yin te/ de bzhin du dge ba'i ⑫rang bzhin du ④yang shes par bya'o⑫//dge dang mi dges mi tshugs shing / de dran pa tsam gyis thar bar 'gyur ro/ /zas rnam pa lnga la 'di lta ste zhes bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po chen po bzhis zhus pa'o/ /bu ram dang / sbrang rtsi dang / til dang / sha dang /nya sha rnams ⑩yongs su spang bar ⑩bgyi'o zhes bya ba ni/ 'byung po rnams kyi zas yin no/ /de yang sdig par 'gyur ba'i zas yin pas/ bu ram ni 'bu rnams kyi zas yin no/ /sbrang rtsi ni bung ba'i zas so/ /til ni srog chags rnams kyi zas so/ /sha ni srog bcad pas ⑫sdig par 'gyur ba'i ⑪zas so/ /nya sha yang de bzhin no/ /de'i phyir na zas rnam pa lnga yongs su spang ba'o zhes 36—1801

gsungs pa'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na zhes bya ba ni zas lnga po de sdig par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das zhes bya ba ni/ rgyal po chen po bzhis zhu ba'i phyir bos pa'o/ /gnod sbyin dang srin po nas gnod par bgyid pa'i bar rnams zhes bya ba ni/ zas rnam pa lnga po de spangs par gyur na/dpag tshad lnga brgya'i nang tshun chad du/ gdon de ①rnams kyis mi tshugs so/ /bsil ba'i tshal gyi mdo chen po 'di 'dzin pa la sogs pa ni/ bye ba khrag khrig gaṅgā'i ④klung gi bye ma snyed kyi①/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang rjes su yi rang ste/de bzhin du 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang rjes su yi rang ba ste/ de rnams bka' bden pas sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad pa'o/ /de dag gzhom pa'i slad du yi dam 'di bgyi 'tshal lags so zhes bya ba ni da ltar kyi shākya thub pas gsungs terjo/ sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral bar byed cing 'khor ba las thar te/ de bzhin du yang dag pa'i don thob nas rig pa'i don gyi rjes su 'brang ba'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das zhes bya ba ni rgyal po chen po bzhis sems can gyi don du yang nas yang du zhu ba'o/ /dge slong ngam dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma gang la la zhes bya ba ni sems can thams cad do/ /bsil ba'i rjotshal kyi mdo chen mo ⑥'di zhes bya ba ni nam mkha' bzhin du 'jig rten kyi khams thams cad la khyab ste/ de bzhin du sems can thams cad bsil bar byed pa'o//'dzin pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni dad par byas shing rjes su yi rang bar gyur ④na—/ sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral te/ sems can thams cad thar pa thob pa'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das zhes bya ba ni gong du bshad pa'o/ /36—1802

bsil ba'i tshal gyi mdo chen po 'di ni de ltar don che ba lags so zhes bya ba ni nam mkha' bzhin du khyab pa ste/ me long gi gzugs brnyan ①bzhin du sgyu mar snang bas/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad la khyab pa'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das gzhan mu stegs can zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni/ bdud kyi rigs sdig can/ bstan pa 'jig pa'i lta ba log pa'i rigs/ de rnams kyi don mi 'grub cing the tshom kyi ②dus su yang pham ④par 'gyur ro/ /de'i phyir na mdo 'di la dad pa la don che ba'o/ /mi ma lags pa rnams kyis 0bar ma dor 'gum pa dang zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni/'di 'chang ba'i gang zag de la/ chu dang / me dang / rkun ma dang /chom ⑤rkun dang / seng ge dang / glang po che dang / dug dang / thog dang / rgyal po'i chad pa la sogs pa zhi bar byed pa yin te/ yang na ni mi rigs rjopa'i 'byung po rnams kyis rims kyis gsad ⑦pa'o/ /de ci'i phyir ⑧zhe na zhes bya ba ni 'jigs pa de rnams rlag ⑨par byed pa'o/ /de ni de dag la gnod par 'tshal ba dang zhes bya ba ⑩la sogs pa ni bar du gcod pa'i bgegs rnams glags tshol te/ gang zag de gus par gyur na glags mi rnyed cing bar du gcod par mi nus so/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten na sems can rnams bsrung ba dang zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni snying rje che zhing sems can thams cad la byams pas khyab pa ste/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo bsil ba'i tshal 'di chad pa thams cad dang bral zhing bde bar gnas pa'o/ /de nas zhes pa ni bsil ba'i ⑪tshal gyi yon tan bshad pa de nas so/ / bcom ldan 'das la ⑫rgyal po chen po bzhis tshigs su bcad de gsol ba zhes bya ba ni rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 36—1803

rnams kyang bsrung bar 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas/ /de nyid du ni mi snang 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba ni/ dur khrod babil ba'i tshad du bcom ldan 'das la bar chod byed cing glags lta ba rnams glags mi rnyed cing /bcom ldan 'das la gus par byas na/ sems can la 'tshe bar mi byed cing mi snang bar 'gyur ba'o/ /de nas zhes pa ni tshigs su bcad pa'i de nas so/ /bcom ldan 'das de'i mtshan ①mo 'das te zhes bya ba ni 'jigs su rung ba bsil ba'i tshal gyi nang na bcom ldan 'das 'khor bzhi dang bcas pa bzhugs pa'i nam la 'das pa'o/ /nam langs nas/ dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung la bzhugs te zhes bya ba ni rnam rtog gsum dang bral ba'i dur khrod babil ba'i tshal gyi dbus su bcom ldan 'das 'khor bzhi dang bcas pa'o/ /dge slong rnams la bka' 6) pa zhes bya ba ni/ de'i tshe de'i dus su bcom ldan 'das kyis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi ②sems can gyi don la bka' 6) pa'o/ /dge slong dag mdang sum ④dag rgyal po chen po bzhi bu dang bcas zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni/ rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / 'khor rnams dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal du 'ongs te/ de dag gis kyang glags tshol ba ste/rig sngags kyi rgyal mo bsel ba'i tshal gyi gzi brjid kyis glags tshol mi nus par gnas pa'o/ /nga'i rkang pa la mgo bos phyag byas rjote zhes bya ba ni/ rgyal po bzhi dang / 'byung po de rnams kyis bskor ba lan gsum byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das la gus par byas nas rig sngags kyi rgyal mo bsil ba'i tshal la rjes su yi rang ba'o/ /phyogs gcig tu 'khod do zhes bya ba ni rgyal po chen po ⑤bzhi dang / 'byung po thams cad phyogs gcig tu 'khod/ phyogs gcig tu 'khod 36—1806

nas—/ rgyal po chen po bzhis nga'i thad du bsil ba'i tshal kyi mdo chen po 'di brjod nas dong ngo zhes bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khor bzhi la bka' stsal zhing / rig sngags kyi rgyal mo bsil ba'i tshal gyi don yang dag par bstan pa'o—/ /khyed kyis de ①legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung shig ②dang /ngas bshad do zhes bya ba ni sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral ba stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no/ /rig pa mthar thug pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis ①gsungs pa'o/ /btsun pa de ltar 'tshal lo zhes gsol te rjozhes bya ba ni/ dge slong la sogs pa'i 'khor rnam rjobazhis bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa'o—/ /dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa mnyan nas zhes bya ba ni/ de rnams kyis kyang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di la rjes su yi rang zhing / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / bsgom pa la sogs pa byas pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni chad pa med cing tshig la yang dag pa dhikhyab pa ni nam mkha' bzhin du khyab pa/ rig pa phyi nang yang dag par bstan pa thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis ④de skad ces bka' stsal nas zhes bya ba ni/ gzhon ⑧nu sgra gcan 'dzin gyi sems can thams cad kyi don la bsil ba'i tshal kyi mdo chen po 'di rgyas par bka' stsal te/ de yang bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'das nas kun dga' bos bsdus ⑫pa'o/ /dge slong dang zhes bya ba ni sgra gcan 'dzin la sogs pa nyis brgya lnga bcu'o/ /dge slong ma dang zhes bya ba ni grags 'dzin ma la sogs pa'o/ /dge bsnyen dang zhes bya ba ni rgyal po ma skyes dgra la sogs pa'o/ /dge bsnyen ma de dag yi rangs te zhes bya ba ni/ ma skyes dgra'i btsun mo la sogs pa de 36—1807

dag gis kyang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di la rjes su yi rang ba'o/ /gzhan yang rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / sum cu rtsa gsum kyi lha rnams dang / gnas gtsang ma'i lha rnams dang / gzhan yang lha dang / lha ma yin la sogs pas rjes su yi rang ba'o/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo bsil ba'i tshal gyi mdo'i 'bum 'grel—/ slob dpon mkhas pa chen po las kyi ①rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //smon lam stobs kyis ⑤grong khyer mu gyer btsas/ /mkhas par grags pa sgemi mnyam rdo rje'i sras/ /skye ba lnga brgyar sbyangs pa'i 'bras bu yis/ /rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la ma rmongs shing / /gsang sngags gdams pa ma lus thugs la mnga' ba can/ /mtshan yang don yod rdo rje zhes par grags/ /sngon gyi smon lam dbang gis bod yul dbus su byon/ /smon lam stobs kyis dam pa 'bro lo'i bla mar gyur/ /'dzam gling byang phyogs brag dmar dpal kyi bsam yas su/ /rgyal po khyad par 'phags pa khri ba'i gdung rjorgyud sras/ /lha gcig khyad par 'phags pa lha lcam dar sgron gyis/ /bkra shis pho brang rdo lung dgon pa ru—/ /lo paṇa zhabs nas bteg nas dam chos 'di bsgyur ba/ /bsgyur ba'i bsod nams gang thob bsags pa des/ /bdag dang mtha' yas sems can kun—/ /bla med byang chub rjothob par shog/ //rjo36—1808

deb so drug pa/krung go'i bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gis dpe sdur dang dpe sgrig zhus/krung go'i bod kyi shes rig dpe skrun khang gis bskrun/zhin hwa dpe tshong khang pe cin 'grem spel khang gis bkrams/bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gi glog rdul rtsis 'khor khang gis par gzhi bsgrigs/krung go'i glog brnyan dpe skrun khang par khang gis dpar btab/spyi lo 999lo'i por pa ra gzhi dang ngo bsgrigs/spyi lo 999lo'i zla por par thengs dang pa btab/dpa ra grangs/ 0 byed ༷ ci2ma7—80057—3pya—0snu 89
